title.title: Ya viví esta escena y con mucha FUERZA digo NO [esp-eng]
title.body:
<center>![1000032040.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23x19TVSVgVJeaUM9p2PsGNVigh85GHxe2brPU1SdebEVVnekeWCocRZ6aDXMXVnpZQqB.png)</center>

​A veces pienso que la vida individual pertenece a un film o bestseller que quizás alguien más está viendo o leyendo. Es ahí donde nuestra mente divaga en retroceso, en esas vivencias de antes en las cuales muchas veces—más de las que quisiéramos—nos arrepentimos de los “si hubiera, si tan solo y quizás”. Esos que duelen de una manera tan suave que no nos hace gritar, pero sabemos que están ahí, como la astilla del borde de la mesa que parecía estar cien por ciento lijada; pero la realidad era distinta, la madera conservó una astilla esperando el momento exacto para manifestarse.

<center>![1000032041.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23x1FBBRGABpJTKdmeG6hcaVg2TJ3XpvfEMzASmUDZEspL4NzTtFUY2Gqj6DZWuv1FbjT.png)</center>


​@damarysvibra dice en su trabajo que el ser humano vive en el presente con miras al futuro, soñando con lo incierto de aquello que nos depara, y es lo más lógico y cuerdo. En este sentido, nadie quiere vivir del pasado; buscamos estar bien en ese presente imaginando aquel futuro prometedor que nos ofrecerá todo lo bueno del mundo. Y no me refiero únicamente a la riqueza, ya que lo primordial que debemos querer y resguardar es la salud.

​Y me detengo seriamente en sus palabras ya que, al igual que ella, mi familia también ha tenido que concentrar todas sus fuerzas en la salud. Así como ella expresa que “Dios no trabaja solo”, cada uno, de manera personal e individual, debe poner su porcentaje de fuerza en este aspecto para salir airosos, dando gracias cada día, sin importar si el avance es diminuto o grande.

En este sentido, y sabiendo que estamos plantados en el presente —que no es más que el ahora, porque el ayer ya pasó y el mañana es un misterio—, solemos guardar momentos de silencio. Lo hacemos con la sutil espera de que el presente no se nos escape, por temor a revivir el pasado. Y es que los recuerdos de \

parecen apagarse para dejar que se sobrepongan los momentos difíciles.

Ahí es donde nacen las preguntas: ¿Por qué no hice esto antes? ¿Por qué no actué a tiempo? Ante esas dudas, es inevitable aceptar que este viaje involuntario no respeta lo que uno quiere evocar; simplemente nos arroja aquello que nos causa más terror e incertidumbre frente a las vivencias del hoy.

​En el día a día me sobreexijo, ya que es en el presente donde realmente uno cuida. Podría decir que este \

representa ese porcentaje de fuerza que nos mantiene cuerdos, el espacio donde se celebran los pequeños avances y donde se nos permite seguir soñando con el mañana. El presente no nos deja respirar; sin embargo, aunque sea un centímetro, hemos logrado dejar atrás el ayer. Hemos avanzado un poco, entendiendo que nuestra meta absoluta se defiende en el presente.

​Ese futuro esplendoroso no es el que acumula millones ni el que guarda joyas a montón en cofres sobre el buró. El verdadero futuro es atesorar la salud aprendiendo del ayer, ese mismo pasado que nos ayudará a no cometer errores hoy, para así poder disfrutar del mañana sin lágrimas amargas en los ojos.

Muchos sufren con el ayer, pero yo lo tomé como un arma. Me tuve que obligar a pasar por el mismo lado; por instantes, mi mente no estaba en este 2026, sino atrapada en el 2013. Pero esta vez fue diferente: me tragué las lágrimas y caminé sola, firme. Me dije a mí misma que esta vez no sería igual, porque así lo creo y así será. Me paré fuerte aunque temblaba por dentro, y gracias a eso, hoy salimos juntos sin caer en esa escalera desbordada del llanto.

​En este sentido, y a modo muy personal, aprendí a revivir mi pasado porque misteriosamente busca volver al presente. Sin embargo, aquella versión pasada —la que lloraba sin hablar, la que dudaba, la que era pesimista— se quedó allá, en ese mismo ayer. Mi versión presente estudia, pregunta, se planta firme y dice las cosas tal como las entiende, a veces con analogías extrañas o que para muchos resultan rebuscadas, pero que al final sacan risas porque demuestran que no estaba equivocada.

​Yo ya viví esta escena, y esta vez me planto firme. Me planto así porque el presente está siendo diferente, y el futuro —que no es más que ese mañana— será maravilloso. No importa si amanece nublado o si quizás esté lloviendo: el sol saldrá igual. Será un futuro donde estemos todos juntos, tomados de la mano, disfrutando de un helado sentados en el patio.

<center>![1000032042.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23ynX4EcxRoqbZLDGNDYRU1W6ecoYeB76H4g7dAo3WZMEZJjpUe4f2Dee1uWkdVr8idCn.png)</center> 
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000032040.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23x19TVSVgVJeaUM9p2PsGNVigh85GHxe2brPU1SdebEVVnekeWCocRZ6aDXMXVnpZQqB.png)</center>

Sometimes I think that our individual lives are part of a film or a bestseller that perhaps someone else is watching or reading. That is when our minds wander back in time, to those past experiences in which we often—more often than we’d like—regret the ‘what ifs’, the ‘if onlys’ and the ‘maybes’. Those that hurt so gently that they don’t make us scream, but we know they’re there, like the splinter on the edge of the table that seemed to be completely sanded down; but the reality was different, the wood retained a splinter, waiting for the exact moment to reveal itself.

<center>![1000032041.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23x1FBBRGABpJTKdmeG6hcaVg2TJ3XpvfEMzASmUDZEspL4NzTtFUY2Gqj6DZWuv1FbjT.png)</center> 


@damarysvibra says in her work that human beings live in the present with an eye to the future, dreaming of the uncertainty of what lies ahead, and that is the most logical and sensible thing to do. In this sense, nobody wants to live in the past; we seek to be well in the present, imagining that promising future that will offer us all the good things in the world. And I am not referring solely to wealth, as the most essential thing we must cherish and protect is our health.

And I pause seriously to reflect on her words because, like her, my family has also had to focus all our efforts on health. Just as she says that ‘God does not work alone’, each of us, personally and individually, must contribute our share of effort in this regard to come through successfully, giving thanks every day, regardless of whether the progress is small or great.

In this sense, and knowing that we are rooted in the present—which is nothing more than the now, because yesterday has passed and tomorrow is a mystery—we often observe moments of silence. We do so with the subtle hope that the present will not slip away from us, for fear of reliving the past. And the fact is that memories of ‘when everything was fine’ seem to fade, allowing the difficult moments to take over.

That is where the questions arise: Why didn’t I do this sooner? Why didn’t I act in time? Faced with these doubts, it is inevitable to accept that this involuntary journey does not respect what one wishes to recall; it simply throws at us whatever causes us the most terror and uncertainty in the face of today’s experiences.

In my day-to-day life, I push myself too hard, because it is in the present that we truly take care of ourselves. I could say that this ‘now’ represents that sliver of strength that keeps us sane, the space where small steps forward are celebrated and where we are allowed to keep dreaming of tomorrow. The present leaves us no room to breathe; yet, even if only by a centimetre, we have managed to leave yesterday behind. We have moved forward a little, understanding that our ultimate goal is defended in the present.

That splendid future is not one that amasses millions, nor one that hoards heaps of jewels in chests on the bedside table. The true future is to treasure our health by learning from yesterday, that very past which will help us avoid making mistakes today, so that we may enjoy tomorrow without bitter tears in our eyes.

Many suffer because of yesterday, but I took it as a weapon. I had to force myself to walk down that same path; for a moment, my mind wasn’t in this year 2026, but trapped in 2013. But this time was different: I swallowed my tears and walked alone, steadfastly. I told myself that this time it wouldn’t be the same, because that is what I believe and that is how it will be. I stood strong even though I was trembling inside, and thanks to that, today we walked out together without falling down that staircase overflowing with tears.

In this sense, and on a very personal level, I’ve learnt to relive my past because, mysteriously, it seeks to return to the present. However, that past version of me — the one who cried without speaking, the one who doubted, the one who was pessimistic — stayed there, in that very yesterday. My present version studies, asks questions, stands firm and says things exactly as she understands them, sometimes using strange analogies or ones that many find far-fetched, but which in the end make people laugh because they show I wasn’t wrong.

I’ve been through this before, and this time I’m standing my ground. I’m standing my ground because the present is different, and the future—which is nothing more than that tomorrow—will be wonderful. It doesn’t matter if it’s cloudy at dawn or if it might be raining: the sun will rise all the same. It will be a future where we’re all together, holding hands, enjoying an ice cream sitting in the garden.

<center>![1000032042.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23ynX4EcxRoqbZLDGNDYRU1W6ecoYeB76H4g7dAo3WZMEZJjpUe4f2Dee1uWkdVr8idCn.png)</center> 
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)</center>

</center>

title.title: 人家欺騙日，我欺騙周
title.body: 最近流行Cheat Meal Day，即是欺騙餐或者作弊餐，我則喜歡Cheat Meal Weekend，整個週末都放開吃。 其實我也是最近才知道有這一個名詞，也是最近才知道現在都挺流行這一個詞，我有節食，但節得不多，就只是星期一至四的晚餐節，這是來自過往的斷食經驗，每天斷食把身體的代謝都變差了，能量攝入是少，但能量消耗也減少，到頭來一場空，恢復代謝時還增重了，所以我把周末都定為Cheat Day，保持代謝也不影響周末的社交和家庭聚餐，後來我才知道有Cheat Meal Day這一詞，可謂不謀而合了。 慢慢的，星期五晚上的Cheat Meal，十分固定的成了麥當勞。 對部份人而言，例如以前的我，麥當勞根本就是不知吃什麼好的選擇，又或是比較匆忙時的選擇，但對現在的我來說就是Cheat Meal，是能夠好好享受Junk Food的一餐，這是進步吧哈哈，當麥當勞都成為享受，對吃的追求自然減低了，不論對身體或是錢包應該都是好事。

/>

現在世界盃，麥當勞的食物包裝也換樣子了，薯條盒變金色了，還有個足球在金拱門上，還出了一款黃金椰脆新地，很甜，很邪惡。突然發現，麥當勞也經常有新的新地口味。

吃完這一餐麥當勞，又要等下一個星期才能再吃了，不，下星期五不在香港，也好，試一下湖南的麥當勞什麼模樣。

title.title: Why on earth? | ¿Con Qué necesidad?.Mi informe de Actifit: junio 14 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7615ed08-e512-4efb-8bb9-a1a3372cc55e.jpg) It’s a long weekend in Argentina, which gives us a great opportunity to organize long-distance training rides with the cycling team. It’s very cold right now, so we decided to head out at 8 a.m. to take advantage of the sunrise and, of course, the sunshine. ___ Fin de semana extra largo en la Argentina y es motivo por organizar entrenamientos de fondo con el equipo de ciclismo. Estamos en épocas de mucho frío, y es por eso que decidimos salir a las 8 de la mañana para aprovechar el amanecer y por supuesto el sol. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f0fade38-a21a-411f-bf35-ad143b15630e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e180e755-843f-4f60-8acc-ed0361a79e67.jpg) We really bundled up, but it wasn't enough. I put on a pair of socks, then some nylon bags over my feet, and another pair of socks on top. Under the first layer on my chest, I put on a small, adhesive Ziploc-style bag to block the wind. Gloves and very warm clothing all over. Nothing was enough against the beating we took from the wind, the frost, and the cold everywhere along the way. ___ Realmente nos abrigamos, pero no fue suficiente. Me coloqué un par de medias, luego unas bolsitas de nylon en los pies y arriba otro par de medias. Debajo de la primera piel en el pecho Me puse una bolsita tipo ziploc que se pega para aminorar el viento en el pecho. Guantes y muy abrigados en todo el cuerpo. Nada fue suficiente para la paliza que nos dio el viento, la helada y el frío por doquier en todo el camino. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6cab8ad8-56a9-448e-8723-a4f9a5d81f59.jpg) Rubén and Damián turned back halfway. They stayed in Cañuelas and got ready to have breakfast, while we initially headed toward Lobos. They were already posting photos in the WhatsApp group. The two brave souls were Gonzalo and yours truly. Chatting along the way, we decided it wasn’t necessary to go all the way to Logos and that we’d only go as far as Uribelarrea. It’s still quite a distance, though, since it’s 91 km. ___ Rubén y Damián abandonaron a mitad de camino. Se quedaron en cañuelas y ya se dispusieron a desayunar, mientras nosotros en primera instancia íbamos rumbo a lobos. Ellos ya estaban colocando las imágenes en el grupo de WhatsApp. Los dos valientes éramos Gonzalo y quien escribe estas líneas. Charlando en el camino llegamos a conclusión de que no era necesario ir hasta logos y llegaríamos solamente a uribelarrea. Es una distancia bastante importante igualmente ya que son 91 km ida y vuelta. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/85688217-8352-425e-93bb-59962b4c0aeb.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/750b2563-8f9c-429f-a534-d61d23a2ee78.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f43869fb-b57e-446e-9be4-11bafba01a60.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8aec76ad-19cb-4837-b4ec-6cbf91266c85.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fbe200fe-6b78-4944-9556-bf1f00087451.jpg) We arrived at the main entrance to Uribelarrea, but my companion wanted something hot to drink, so we headed 5 km into town. It was around 10 a.m., and the shops were just starting to open in the pretty town of Uribelarrea. We came across a bakery where we always used to have breakfast, but for reasons unknown to us, it was closed. We started walking around and found a man who was just opening his street stall; he told us that if we waited 10 minutes, he’d make us a cup of coffee with milk and an alfajor. Without hesitation, that was the decision we made. ___ Llegamos al ingreso principal de uribelarrea, pero mi compañero quería tomar algo caliente e ingresamos al pueblo 5 km adentro. Eran aproximadamente las 10 de la mañana y los negocios recién estaban despertando en el bonito pueblo de uribelarrea. Conocemos una panadería que siempre desayunamos ahí y que por cuestiones que desconocemos cerró. Empezamos a caminar por el lugar y encontramos a un señor que recién estaba abriendo su negocio ambulante y nos dijo que si esperábamos 10 minutos nos preparaba un café con leche con alfajor. Sin dudarlo esa fue la decisión. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d7f30ad5-e27c-4857-a6fd-669e0fed47de.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/11a3c1d4-e47b-4c5c-961b-bebd3daa4660.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4e695e5e-d3f7-4ac5-85e8-9c3bdcd334b1.jpg) After warming up and fueling up with a few carbs, we set off on our return journey. Even with the sun shining brightly, the temperature still wouldn’t rise. On top of that, it had rained the day before, which is why we couldn’t get down to ground level and just stick to the pavement. And as you know—and as common sense dictates—the pavement is always higher than ground level, so the wind hit us head-on. Uribelarrea is a beautiful town and is always packed with people on long weekends. ___ Luego de calentar el cuerpo y cargarnos un poquito de carbohidrato nos dispusimos a volver. Con el sol radiante, la temperatura igualmente no subía. Sumado a eso, el día anterior había llovido, motivo por el cual no podíamos bajarnos a la Tierra y simplemente seguir en el asfalto. Y como sabrán y por sentido común el asfalto siempre está a una altura superior a la Tierra y por lo tanto el viento nos pegaba de lleno. Uribelarrea es un pueblo hermoso y siempre se llena de gente los fines de semana largo. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/65e13d4f-f7d0-4ec4-ab11-b14759e7a437.jpg) My friend Alejandro made a smart decision and got up much later, doing his workout here in Ezeiza, because, as he says, the cold really makes him suffer too much. The plan was to continue training tomorrow, but we decided against it for obvious reasons. A Sunday of mountain biking, doing what we had to do, but we definitely miss summer. Have a great day, everyone 🧉 ___ El amigo Alejandro tomó una decisión inteligente y se levantó mucho más tarde, y realizó su entrenamiento por acá en ezeiza, porque según él el frío realmente lo hace sufrir en demasía. La idea era seguir mañana con los entrenamientos pero, desistimos por obvias razones. Domingo de ciclismo mountain bike cumpliendo con lo que hay que hacer, pero definitivamente extrañamos el verano. Feliz día para todos 🧉 ___ ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/eaba8b3b-6d19-4fbf-bdb7-aa55c310952c.jpg) Photos taken with my Samsung S22. Thanks to Alejandro, Gonzalo, and Damián for sharing some photos with me and giving me permission to use them. ___ Capturas con mi celular Samsung s22. Gracias a Alejandro, Gonzalo y Damián por compartirme algunas imágenes y autorizarme a utilizarlas.

title.title: Drive Is A Stylish Crime Film With A Unique Identity. Ryan Gosling Delivers A Memorable Performance In One Of The Most Original Modern Thrillers. Nicolas Winding Refn Created A Cult Classic That Still Stands Out Today.
title.body:
Drive Is A Stylish Crime Film With A Unique Identity. Ryan Gosling Delivers A Memorable Performance In One Of The Most Original Modern Thrillers. Nicolas Winding Refn Created A Cult Classic That Still Stands Out Today.

![IMG_3209.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwyGfqcM5qheAjAE6W5fFFwPA1uU242tyHVNySdmJuy5/IMG_3209.webp)

Some movies are built around huge action scenes, and others are remembered because of the atmosphere they create. Drive is a film that stands out because of its style, mood, and unforgettable characters. Released in 2011, it feels like a throwback to classic crime movies while still creating something completely different.

The film was directed by Nicolas Winding Refn, who brought a very unique vision to the project. Instead of making a typical action movie, Refn focused on tension, silence, and character development. His direction gives the movie a slow burn feeling where every scene builds toward something bigger.

Ryan Gosling stars as the Driver, a quiet Hollywood stunt driver who works on the side as a getaway driver for criminals. Gosling’s performance is one of the biggest reasons the movie works so well. He says very little, but his expressions and actions tell the audience everything they need to know about the character.

The supporting cast is excellent as well. Carey Mulligan plays Irene, a neighbor who develops a connection with the Driver. Their relationship becomes the emotional center of the story and shows a different side of a character who usually keeps everyone at a distance.

The movie also features Bryan Cranston as Shannon, the Driver’s mechanic and mentor. Cranston brings a lot of personality to the role and helps add depth to the world around the Driver. Oscar Isaac, Albert Brooks, and Ron Perlman also deliver memorable performances as the story moves deeper into the criminal world.

The plot follows the Driver as he becomes involved with Irene and her family after her husband Standard returns from prison. When Standard gets caught up with dangerous criminals, the Driver decides to help protect them. That choice pulls him into a violent situation that becomes more dangerous with every step.

One of the biggest strengths of Drive is its atmosphere. The neon lighting, nighttime city scenes, and incredible soundtrack create a style that feels different from most modern films. Every shot feels carefully planned, almost like watching a crime story mixed with a visual dream.

The movie is also interesting because it does not follow the typical action movie formula. The Driver is not a loud hero making jokes and giving speeches. He is quiet, mysterious, and unpredictable, which makes the moments when he does explode with violence much more impactful.

The soundtrack deserves a lot of credit as well. The music creates a unique emotional tone and has become one of the most recognizable parts of the film. It helps make the movie feel like a modern classic with a strong identity of its own.

Albert Brooks is especially memorable as Bernie Rose, a character who appears calm and professional but reveals a much darker side. His performance shows that the movie is not just about the Driver, but also about the dangerous people surrounding him.

What I like most about Drive is that it takes its time. It is not trying to rush from one action scene to another. The movie builds its characters, creates tension, and lets the audience sit with the atmosphere before things become intense.

Some viewers expected a traditional action film and were surprised by how slow and artistic it was. That slower approach is actually one of the reasons it has developed such a strong following. It feels different, and that is what makes it memorable.

For me, Drive is a great film because everything comes together perfectly. The cast is excellent, Nicolas Winding Refn’s direction is unique, and Ryan Gosling creates one of his most iconic characters. It is a film that takes a simple crime story and turns it into something much more stylish and emotional.

![IMG_3210.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUgziZLhHKdjLKqmUJd9gRkfp5o4sc3DhsocJdtZ2EvQt/IMG_3210.webp)

More than a decade after its release, Drive remains a standout modern thriller. It is visually impressive, well acted, and completely different from most movies in its genre. That is why it continues to be remembered as a true cult classic.

title.title: Beautiful crocheted necklace with a chain //Hermoso collar tejido con cadena a crochet (ENG-ESP)
title.body:
>Good morning, my wonderful community at @NeedleWorkMonday! I hope you’re having a great start to the week, and today I want to share a beautiful project I made this weekend. Since we’re dealing with power rationing due to high electricity consumption from the summer heat, I’m using that time to create small, very original knitted pieces—handmade with materials we all have on hand at home. It’s a beautiful necklace made with a crochet chain, super easy to make, and perfect for creating unique, personalized necklaces in no time. A beautiful necklace—I hope you like the final result. Below, I’ll show you the materials. >Muy buenos días mi gente hermosa de mi comunidad,@NeedleWorkMonday, les deseo un excelente inicio de semana, y hoy le quiero compartir un bello proyecto que realice, este fin de semana, como estamos con racionamiento eléctrico, por las altos consumos eléctrico por el calor de la temporada, ese tiempo lo aprovecho en realizar pequeñas labores tejidas muy originales, hechas a manos con materiales que todos tenemos a la mano en casa, un hermoso collar tejido con cadena a crochet, súper sencillo para hacer unos collares únicos, personalizados y muy rápidamente de realizar. >Un hermoso collar espero les guste el resultado final a continuación les muestro los materiales.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqv7sLQJ7z4hqLtQN46w2ER9f2EkmA76Uy3Zc4kBgRR9/image.png
##
Materials//Materiales:
01 size 4 crochet hook. 01 pair of scissors. 01 skein of ochre-colored crochet yarn. 01 20-cm chain. 02 rings. 01 adjustable clasp. >01 aguja # 04. 01 tijera. 01 hilo crochet color ocre. 01 cadena 20 cm. 02 aro. 01 pinza para ajustar. ##
Paso a paso / Step by step
1.- I’ll use a chain of the desired length; I chose twenty centimeters so it would be quicker to make. We need to take into account the thickness of the yarn and the chain so the hook glides smoothly when we start working. Since I’m using fine crochet yarn, we’ll make one single crochet stitch per chain stitch, as was the case with the first necklace. I had previously attached rings to the ends of the chain, properly adjusted with pliers, leaving one chain space open. Start working by attaching the yarn to the second chain space, and crochet the entire chain in single crochet. >1.- Utilizaré una cadena con el largo deseado, lo preferí de veinte centímetros para que se me haga más rápido en realizar, debemos tener en cuenta grosor del hilo y la cadena, para que la aguja fluya bien cuando comencemos a trabajar. Como voy a utilizar hilo crochet que es fino, obtenemos de un punto bajo por cada eslabón, como es el caso de primer collar. La cadena previamente le había colocado los aros en los extremos, debidamente ajustado con la pinza o alicate, dejar un eslabón libre, comenzar a trabajar ajustando el hilo en el segundo eslabón, tejemos toda la cadena a punto bajo de ganchillo.

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3uWWcT2tJCjYLpj6TkGTXTTp1Wwmf4TA9C13g8ja3hM/image.png 2.- Turn the work, chain three, then make a double crochet. Counting from the second chain, make a single crochet followed by five chains, and repeat this sequence eighteen times. Finish this round with two double crochets to complete the round. >2.- Girar el trabajo, realizar tres puntos al aire, seguidamente un punto alto, contaremos al segundo eslabón un punto bajo más cinco cadenas y repetir dieciocho veces arcos y finalizar esta vuelta con dos puntos altos así terminar la vuelta.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmSzsgZPq1KvUUYRrTVkzMq5SuvMevG8cdiAHVuUu8g3Aq/image.png
3.- On this round, turn the work, fill in the arcs, chain four, then (I_I_I_I_I__x__I_I_I_I_I__) work a double crochet with a chain, work five double crochets with chains, at the fifth double crochet work two chains and a single crochet, then two more chains, and repeat; finish with two double crochets. >3.- En esta vuelta giramos el trabajo, rellenar los arcos, haremos cuatro puntos al aire, seguidamente (I_I_I_I_I__x__I_I_I_I_I__) de un punto alto con una cadena, realizar cinco puntos altos mas cadenas, al quinto unto alto trabajar dos cadenas y un punto bajo, mas dos cadenas y repertir, cerramos con dos puntos altos.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTA9bQu9TibnJcRhR3i2FjYtv1RUGvrerw2JsavHKmNGj/image.png
4.- For the last row, work in single crochet (x.x.x.x.x..) until the end of the row, cut the excess yarn, and secure the chain stitches with the rings so the yarn doesn’t come loose. >4.- La ultima vuelta la trabajare con puntos bajos (x.x.x.x.x..) hasta terminar la vuelta, cortar el exceso de hilos, ajustar los eslabones con los aros para que no se nos zafe el hilo.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmRLjNb2Cx4QDPKqA2QKg2X812AUn7gxHtQ4HJ14WchKw2/image.png
It's turning out really nice. >Así de lindo va quedando.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmQaZefKHGpiEoUJ3rH6XinEnZsmSfb7SiSUhshUzfTzL3/image.png
It looks so beautiful on me! > Que bello me quedo!
https://images.hive.blog/DQmRijLCTw6Qd76bNWnhjDs76ZSWPaKHr2Yt45kw6kJ7g1K/image.png

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfFr136cqQbD6RBMVrr8Mi5VR5arJvWAYcSVe4KBWKNuj/1781487024055.jpg)

မနေ့ မနက် ၇ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသည့် Haiti vs Scotland ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ Scotland က ၀-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ Scotland အတွက် အနိုင်ဂိုးကို ပထမပိုင်း ၂၉ မိနစ်မှာ သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ ဒုတိယပိုင်းမှာလည်း ဂိုးထပ်မံ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခြင်း မရှိဘဲ ၀-၁ ဖြင့်သာ ပွဲပြီးသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ 

မနက် ၁၀ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသည့် Australia vs Turkey ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ Australia က ၂-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ ပထမပိုင်း ၂၇ မိနစ်နှင့် ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၇၅ မိနစ်တို့မှာ သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်လေ၏။ 

လောလောဆယ် ကမ္ဘာ့ဖလား၏ ဂိုးအများဆုံး ပွဲစဉ်ကတော့ Germany vs Curacao ပွဲ ဖြစ်လေ၏။ Germany က ၇-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့၏။ အဖွင့်ဂိုးက ၆ မိနစ်မှာ သွင်းယူ၏။ ၂၁ မိနစ်မှာ Curacao က ပြန်လည် ချေပ၏။ ဘယ်ဆိုးလို့တုံး ရှိသေး ၃၈ မိနစ်နှင့် ၄၅+၅ မိနစ်တို့မှာ Germany တို့က ၂ ဂိုးထပ်မံ သွင်းယူပြီး ၃-၁ ဖြင့် ပထမပိုင်း ပြီးသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9hvuXGqKKnyG4FqbvCZDzHS6pYUA41nPMSgZRzgFvBj/1781487024074.jpg)


ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၄၇၊ ၆၈၊ ၇၈၊ ၈၈ မိနစ်တို့မှာ ၄ ဂိုး ထပ်မံ သွင်းယူပြီး ၇-၁ ဖြင့် ပွဲပြီးသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ လက်ရှိမှာ FIFA အဆင့် သတ်မှတ်ချက် အဆင့် ၁၀ အသင်းက အဆင့် ၈၂ အသင်းကို မညှာမတာ ဂိုးမိုးတွေ ရွာပစ်ပလိုက်တာဟု ပြောရမည်ထင်။ 

ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၂ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ Netherlands vs Japan တို့ ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ကစား၏။ ပထမပိုင်းမှာ ဘယ်သူမှ ဂိုးမသွင်းနိုင်ကြပဲ ၀-၀ ဖြင့် ပြီးသွားခဲ့၏။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း မိနစ် ၅၀ မှာ Netherlands တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး ရသွား၏။ ၅၇ မိနစ်မှာ Japan တို့က ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည်သွင်းယူ၏။ ၆၄ မိနစ်မှာ Netherlands တို့ ဒုတိယ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူ၏။ ဒါပေမဲ့ အဆိုပါ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကို ၈၈ မိနစ်မှာ Japan က ချေပနိုင်ခဲ့ပြန်၏။ တဖက် ၂ ဂိုးစီဖြင့် သရေကျသွားခဲ့လေ၏။

လက်ရှိ အုပ်စု ပွဲစဉ်များ ကစားပြီးသလောက်မှာ အိမ်ရှင် အသင်းအပြင် အာရှက အသင်းတွေ အတော်လေး အခြေအနေကောင်းနေတာကို တွေ့ရ၏။ ဒီမနက် Netherlands vs Japan ပွဲမှာဆို Japan အသင်း၏ ကစားပုံက အတော်လေး ကောင်း၏။ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးတွေ ပေးလိုက်ရပေမဲ့ နောက်ကနေ ချေပဂိုးတွေ ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူနိုင်၏။ South Korea ဆိုရင်လည်း ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်းခါထားရသည့် အနေအထားကနေ ချေပဂိုး အနိုင်ဂိုးတွေ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့၏။ Qatar ဆိုရင်လည်း Switzerland ကို သရေ ကစားထားနိုင်ခဲ့၏။ ဒီနှစ်က အာရှအသင်းတွေ၏ နှစ်များ ဖြစ်နေမလား။

title.title: 恢复用水了
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![9rFB5BqtQiP5q83y_IMG_20260614_075736.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/9rFB5BqtQiP5q83y_IMG_20260614_075736/9rFB5BqtQiP5q83y_IMG_20260614_075736.webp)
![sRawzGde3qGCvls9_IMG_20260614_075828.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/sRawzGde3qGCvls9_IMG_20260614_075828/sRawzGde3qGCvls9_IMG_20260614_075828.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

从昨天晚上十点洗完澡后，突然家里没自来水了，我也不知道什么回事！最后在业主群看到大家说才知道，附近水管漏水，需停水抢修，恢复供水时间可能会提前或顺延，反正最快都要早上八点！实际上早上十点多才来水，还是很多邻居去打投诉电话！

打电话投诉，昨天抢修没成功，笑死人这回复！夜间施工→爆水管→抢修（夜间施工）→噪音扰民→投诉→延迟施工→投诉咨询→回复因投诉引起延时，这是我能想到的逻辑！附近几个小区的都有水了，我出去吃早饭问店里老板，他住群星星村的，他也是说昨晚来水了！

就是我们小区最后才修好，我也出去拍照了，确实还在维修中！家里也没水喝，本来以为在家煮面条的！所以只能洗漱一下，护肤好就出门了！都是用家里的喝的开水简单洗漱一下的！

吃完早饭回来小区，看到保安大哥拉着长长水管给我们抽地下水，叫我们拿东西来装！突然觉得这个小区其实物业挺好的！能及时出来处理问题，不像以前只会收钱不干事的！希望小区越来越好啦，晚上我房间的灯也坏了，我也是醉了哈哈！最近要维修的东西太多了……

title.title: (ENG/ESP) 😸✨👌 Cleo's near recovery after her sterilization / La casi recuperación de Cleo luego de su esterilización 😸✨👌
title.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to everyone in this community and all cat lovers! After little Cleo had her spay surgery and came home, the recovery process began. It wasn't easy for us, because being used to a playful and energetic kitten, seeing her so still, listless, and not playing was like we'd been given a completely different cat. Even Ying seemed different. He knew something was wrong, because he stopped going near Cleo and didn't seek her out to play or sleep together. It was as if they'd had a fight and didn't want to talk anymore, each doing their own thing, haha.
![IMG_20260528_093505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoeExYnigZK2VTeaE1e2k5W68cn5X74wMnMBYeMznhv2HFCZtWTEWciwFriiHyLpRXo.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_195721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyPUQBm3ZyoaRyiMryRcP9QQf9XoYW5ibGLXoJowCRoDahhABp5cpNDi6Yszxzvhr7.jpg)
**😿 Everyone to their own thing 😿**

However, now that Cleo's wound has healed, she's back to her usual personality and spirit, as if nothing ever happened. In fact, even my siblings are a little stressed by her antics, as she seems to be more mischievous to make up for the mischief she missed while recovering, haha. She's even started playing with Ying again like always; they groom each other and sleep together. That made me feel much more relieved, because if Cleo lets Ying near her, it's because she feels good, and Ying loves playing with and grooming his baby. He's a great adoptive cat dad 💖
![IMG_20260606_191642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowG4KG8S6qKqLbYuTWdvEBnRFAKsE88xBiBftAJzYgE48EoZRVvRXHZNbdk8fWsXGh.jpg) ![IMG_20260612_133518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoiUJ6huSfqCRVtfdqjGN2fhogmhgKXR7tBTZRDViuZRthxVkjexyFatiZFCPwod8uu.jpg) ![IMG_20260606_191638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqiMTspZYfd6NyawphQxdpmbou4XjqcGK8DgZFq627sBC7xdFKsKjxep2345VsEDnr6.jpg)
**😻 Ying and Cleo sharing their favorite blanket, again 😻**

Even so, I'm afraid to pick her up, so I still do it carefully haha. The part of her skin that was shaved is already growing back fur. Also, we've noticed that Cleo has grown quite a bit! She seems to be the same size as Ying! Although not the same build, because Ying is still a cat I like to say weighs \

because of how big he is haha.
![IMG_20260602_170338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eou9gYfpU2MXf1NywijwWimazZUbiN8dJNJtHd6wQkgGeVMEnMyGDnAbojWAHo5jopu.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK6p9E3w9nSJ1GQQxW1cwK9w2yRMdddqRAgwLwPGNdoNopZoj1dyh2kZCckXbSqYoZ.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyQ2PQc22qhDNmUpk6RjZ1VW8uuwSSL2rBL1SdcqWFsYzVytHFPq8QPPtvsicJGScy.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EogNpqYk3Sp5pSqTDv4G93fCth4pEv8fGksZtAn3PA4i5EhxpDUNSUPKQH5wvSrTxtR.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eou8HWWFZgeMSKdGfWys3ruxZrTWD6FH9ma7XyviJEz41CWnyYYHXRBuueEb4sYThoj.jpg)
**😸 Cleo being caught playing excitedly with a box, as if she'd never seen one before in her life 😸**

It's a relief that Cleo is feeling better, so now we just have to make sure she doesn't cause any damage, because I think she's still in a rebellious and mischievous phase 😼
![IMG_20260603_094129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpCAuvgC3ZRUXp4tj3AbsXYvrkwY45VobFbTyfa1SVcJXXSLkY433d3hbLmNjpQURuw.jpg)
**💕 I loved that photograph of them. It seems like a very \

pose that reminds us that despite the hardships, they are together 💕**
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sticker-hive-ikki.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK6W53nZk27Way4ADpHJXF3ienr5k8cvBuxY5GRG63otvMAxjSqoZ8DgrDqkvbL.gif)

#
💚 Until next Caturday! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de los gatos! Luego de que la pequeña Cleo fuera sometida a su operación de esterilización y volviera a casa, comenzó el proceso de recuperación. No fue nada fácil para nosotros, porque estando acostumbrados a una gatita juguetona y enérgica, verla quieta, desganada y sin jugar, fue como si nos hubieran entregado a otra gata. Hasta Ying, se notaba diferente. Él sabía que algo ocurría, pues dejó de acercarse a Cleo y tampoco la buscaba para jugar, ni dormir juntos. Era como si se hubieran peleado y ya no quisieran hablarse, cada quién en lo suyo jaja.
![IMG_20260528_093505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoeExYnigZK2VTeaE1e2k5W68cn5X74wMnMBYeMznhv2HFCZtWTEWciwFriiHyLpRXo.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_195721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyPUQBm3ZyoaRyiMryRcP9QQf9XoYW5ibGLXoJowCRoDahhABp5cpNDi6Yszxzvhr7.jpg)
**😿 Cada quién en lo suyo 😿**

Sin embargo, ahora que Cleo ya tiene la herida cicatrizada, ha vuelto a su carácter y ánimo de siempre, como si nunca hubiera pasado nada. Es más, hasta mis hermanos están algo estresados con sus ocurrencias, pues parece que está siendo más traviesa para cumplir con la cuota que no realizó de travesuras cuando estaba en recuperación jaja Hasta ha vuelto a jugar con Ying como siempre, se acicalan y duermen juntos. Eso, hizo que me sintiera más aliviada, ya que si Cleo permite que Ying se le acerque, es porque se siente bien y Ying, adora jugar y acicalar a su bebesa. Es un gran padre adoptivo gatuno 💖
![IMG_20260606_191642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowG4KG8S6qKqLbYuTWdvEBnRFAKsE88xBiBftAJzYgE48EoZRVvRXHZNbdk8fWsXGh.jpg) ![IMG_20260612_133518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoiUJ6huSfqCRVtfdqjGN2fhogmhgKXR7tBTZRDViuZRthxVkjexyFatiZFCPwod8uu.jpg) ![IMG_20260606_191638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqiMTspZYfd6NyawphQxdpmbou4XjqcGK8DgZFq627sBC7xdFKsKjxep2345VsEDnr6.jpg)
**😻 Ying y Cleo compartiendo su colcha favorita, de nuevo 😻**

Aún así, me da miedo cargarla, de modo que lo sigo haciendo con cuidado jaja La parte de su piel que raparon, ya está volviendo a tener pelaje. También, nos hemos dado cuenta de que Cleo ha crecido bastante ¡Parece estar del mismo tamaño de Ying! Aunque, no de la misma contextura, porque Ying sigue siendo un gato al que me gusta decir que pesa \

por lo grande que es jaja.
![IMG_20260602_170338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eou9gYfpU2MXf1NywijwWimazZUbiN8dJNJtHd6wQkgGeVMEnMyGDnAbojWAHo5jopu.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK6p9E3w9nSJ1GQQxW1cwK9w2yRMdddqRAgwLwPGNdoNopZoj1dyh2kZCckXbSqYoZ.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyQ2PQc22qhDNmUpk6RjZ1VW8uuwSSL2rBL1SdcqWFsYzVytHFPq8QPPtvsicJGScy.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EogNpqYk3Sp5pSqTDv4G93fCth4pEv8fGksZtAn3PA4i5EhxpDUNSUPKQH5wvSrTxtR.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_170353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eou8HWWFZgeMSKdGfWys3ruxZrTWD6FH9ma7XyviJEz41CWnyYYHXRBuueEb4sYThoj.jpg)
**😸 Cleo siendo descubierta jugando con mucha emoción con una caja, como si nunca hubiera visto una en su vida 😸**

Es un alivio que Cleo ya esté mejor, así que ahora toca cuidar que no haga algún destrozo, porque considero que sigue estando en una etapa en la que quiere ser rebelde y traviesa 😼
![IMG_20260603_094129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpCAuvgC3ZRUXp4tj3AbsXYvrkwY45VobFbTyfa1SVcJXXSLkY433d3hbLmNjpQURuw.jpg)
**💕Amé esa fotografía de ellos. Parece una pose muy \

que nos recuerda que a pesar de las vicisitudes, ellos están juntos 💕**
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![Sticker-hive-ikki.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK6W53nZk27Way4ADpHJXF3ienr5k8cvBuxY5GRG63otvMAxjSqoZ8DgrDqkvbL.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta un próximo Caturday! 💚

title.title: An Invitation to Chess Analysis / Una invitación al análisis ajedrecístico
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyWAGKwYPgHxiTuz9soL9ZcG5s8Tm4WsemMopKRpXVts/1781486439543.jpg)

Greetings, my dear friends of The Community Chess.  
It is truly a pleasure for me to share with you this fascinating position, which arose immediately after White’s 27th move. Based on this moment, I would like to invite all chess enthusiasts here on Hive to reflect on the many factors that must be considered when evaluating a position on the board.  

This game was played in the renowned St. Petersburg Match of 1878, with Emmanuel Schiffers leading the white pieces and Mikhail Chigorin commanding the black ones. I would like to extend a warm greeting to my esteemed friend @enoilw, and especially invite him to share his perspective on the key elements that, in his view, should be taken into account when assessing this position. Naturally, this invitation is open to all members of The Community Chess, as part of an interactive proposal that encourages active participation, collective learning, and the exchange of ideas.  

I am convinced that such an exercise will help us grow together as chess players, strengthening both our analytical skills and our appreciation of the game. I look forward with great enthusiasm to your thoughtful comments.  

Thank you very much.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKffNs5EWqSF7irjaFD2hnahPFPe6aXdXqp15fNrpmXb/1780686284632.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyWAGKwYPgHxiTuz9soL9ZcG5s8Tm4WsemMopKRpXVts/1781486439543.jpg)

Saludos, mis estimados amigos de The Community Chess.  
Es para mí un verdadero placer compartir con ustedes esta interesante posición, surgida inmediatamente después de la jugada número 27 de las blancas. A partir de ella, quisiera invitar a todos los apasionados del ajedrez en Hive a reflexionar sobre los múltiples aspectos que deben considerarse al momento de evaluar una posición en el tablero.  

La partida tuvo lugar en el prestigioso Match de San Petersburgo de 1878, con Emmanuel Schiffers conduciendo las piezas blancas y Mikhail Chigorin las negras. Aprovecho la ocasión para enviar un afectuoso saludo a mi estimado amigo @enoilw, a quien invito especialmente a compartir su visión sobre los elementos que, en su criterio, resultan esenciales para valorar esta posición. Por supuesto, la invitación se extiende a todos los miembros de The Community Chess, en el marco de una propuesta interactiva que nos permita participar activamente en el aprendizaje colectivo y el enriquecedor intercambio de ideas.  

Estoy convencido de que este ejercicio nos ayudará a crecer juntos como ajedrecistas, fortaleciendo tanto nuestro análisis como nuestra apreciación del juego. Espero con entusiasmo sus valiosos comentarios.  

Muchas gracias.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8NxVgy4gwzyp6DQhH5bFiDnCC7e3UoZD2sHdkm8NfM4/1780686186831.jpg)

title.title: Yellow tint on nature's canvas.
title.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZDo4J4duxg8wrGs2hvQGK7PddqBm5L94WD94GJZ24Gqo/1781486423181.jpg) We often don't realize how beautiful the familiar nature that surrounds us can be. Whenever we turn our eyes away from the busyness of mechanical life and look at nature for a moment. Then the mind is filled with a strange peace. Just as it is depicted in the picture. The small yellow flower in the crowd of green leaves is like a living canvas. This scene painted with nature's own brush reminds us that It doesn't have to be something huge or grand to be beautiful. Even this neglected flower hidden in the crevices of leaves can stir up the surroundings with its own form and sweetness. The light blur or bokeh atmosphere of the background of the photo and the soft touch of light make the beauty of the flower even more mysterious and attractive. We are constantly chasing success, striving for great achievements. But the real joy of life lies in the small moments like these. The first rays of the sun falling on the dewy leaves of the morning, or the gentle swaying of some nameless wildflower blooming by the roadside. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKdxp8tZaUkges4G5vVAXczwagc61GJLvefR54xcC4Fe/1781486423377.jpg) In all of this lies the ultimate happiness. Looking at this picture, one can feel a kind of mental peace that the hustle and bustle of the city and the concrete walls cannot give us. Let's take some time out from this daily boredom. Let's put a little touch of greenery on the windows of the house, or let's pay attention to the plants around us while walking in the afternoon. Nature gives us its forms in our generous hands without any reward. This tenderness removes our mental fatigue and gives us the strength to live anew. This yellow flower in the picture seems to be giving us a silent message: no matter the situation, thrive on your own strength and beautify your surroundings. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh|

title.title: Day 2900 | First Trip to the Wildlife Rescue Center
title.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVoMoTaAjm83VnkrP76kNb9eoGpi8qJQQKJ8fQsap4zv/IMG_2639.jpeg
I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. I enjoyed it and continued afterward trying to build better habits and find a good balance between health, fitness, work, entertainment, and my personal life...

Sunday was when I did my first longer distance trip here in Hua Hin along with my friend from Indonesia to the Wildlife Rescue Center which was about 54 minutes driving away. I did sleep late and headed to my friend first to get something to eat as an 'instagran restaurant' near the sea where they have some decorated rooms with sea view where a ton of people come to just to take instagram pictures. We ate an omelet with some fruit juice https://images.hive.blog/DQmULqP1dnKzC1NyDkqDX5wRe4Y185gTCxL97fBKV6tWbpu/IMG_2603.jpeg https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7miUpMkEZrFxi8sQj5M5btJLcZ92hsz2D3Qr2kQPxwK/IMG_2605.jpeg Afterward we went to her place and she showed me an episode of assasionation classroom which is an anime series that I probably will check out once I'm back in Belgium. We took a bolt toward the destination and after some negotiation got to a price of 500 baht and the driver was willing to wait for us and drive us back for another 500 Baht. So about 14€ each to get there and back. https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjwhmZxiGZN71xBp38FnoewxJTZkzE3fJSBqF4o4oYQL/IMG_2620.jpeg When we arrived it was quite empty there as it is low season and honestly there was not too much to do. We were able to walk a bridge and watch some of the tigers https://images.hive.blog/DQmVkrmq3uMpuH6YP3HRLpuLPs5u471Qz4Ds7zpWRCQHxRi/IMG_2621.jpeg https://images.hive.blog/DQmRR3ZTrDS1dZQoBD7pxXCWwvRK8d7ubF6MChJbwS7ZTEq/IMG_2629.jpeg A bit further down, there were also elephants which we went to https://images.hive.blog/DQmULPUoeDY8KFecYqYvvGainwZH5rjm93KoWnixe5PtqZr/IMG_2644.jpeg|https://images.hive.blog/DQmapspnvFyRxEzB36fxAECcnexbHBTF6WQj1MsNHMv7sd9/IMG_2646.jpeg -|- I also got to speak some dutch while asking a guy at a glamping place I heard a clead dutch accent so I asked if he was from holland and he was. https://images.hive.blog/DQmVd5w5kggNLJbgzHh9h5uyy9x7z4CrarSimJ8EaQWSNvG/IMG_2654.jpeg It was one of those trips that wasn't spectacular and if I had known in advance I still would have gone but there is no chance I would go back a 2nd time. Once the taxi got us back to Hua Hin, I took a walk back to my room stopping by the Tamarind market to get something to eat and the Cicada market tp pick up a gift for my youngest niece. https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbCEKd6nqi6YBvQoRYgDu3PNkEjoaYqgzj7kFT4EBqy6/IMG_2663.jpeg Once back at my appartment, I went for a swim. did some texting in the evening and went to bed. Next Day Goals: Monday will be back to Muay Thai Boxing and I will swap back to full health mode. In the evening I'm having a 3rd date with the girl that I'm seeing and we should go watch a sunset if the weather is good and there are not that many clouds.

title.title: First Time Fishing
title.body:
> Hello everyone. This is my very first post in this community, and honestly, it was also my actual first time going out to fish lol. Lately, I have developed a real interest in fishing. Even though I know absolutely nothing about the subject right now, I am determined to master this discipline and become an expert, whatever it takes. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNrj1x3PmaEL9hiaR2kKEo9rUss5NcVWvWByXNfa9TAx/1781457133562.jpg) Living in a Caribbean coastal city is definitely a big plus and luckily, my friend @monk3y45 knows a lot about this world. Since he has the expertise I lack, I decided to join him last Tuesday for my first real session near the water. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmed1Qmy1xiJ3UE2a14LYecqHfz1qKQexU1eYybaJWSdqZ/1781457133729.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSypHpUvvntoGyZUHJVVNw45uDi1zo41G54qKwGWzjUz8/1781457133906.jpg) To put it mildly, the experience was quite rough for a beginner. It turns out that casting a line is not as simple as it looks. I spent the first part of the day struggling just to throw the hook properly. To make matters worse, the intense coastal sun completely scorched my hands, and at one point, I managed to get the nylon line tangled around my own legs. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXC88XNzw5oA1N8Ge3syw2BD9tFJqfgdkBCyX2hsW5WS5/1781457134096.jpg) The fish also made sure to give me a proper welcome. They were fast, completely outsmarting me by snatching the bait off my hook in a single, clean movement before I could even react. Every time I thought I had a chance, I pulled up an empty line. I ended the day without catching a single thing, while my friend handled the situation with the ease of someone who has done this a thousand times. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJJkgG3uhRmuU9CzRvNJVVDPCuqLaKu72MztBiTvWnSt/1781457163596.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4YBDdE3bymLNHtHiwsYuGh3zd2dXNo5Th662ZhSA3aK/1781457163788.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZdsBNiDhVSFqaCgTp32zgUDBSYhRNGcgepR9aegADnV/1781457163971.jpg) Despite the frustration and the sunburn, I am not giving up. I took this first trip as a learning experience and already made several notes on what to do differently next time. I now have a clear list of the specific gear I need to bring, the right clothing to protect myself from the sun, and the basic techniques I need to practice to improve my casting and bait management. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH4bhPdoXSP8GawGkn9xh9Ra5zshtZxyahcS1UHPbqdk/1781457164128.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYoct6VvZQpMNbC7N767RvfZ7RpYSJ886pELeKs5Sr32J/1781457164314.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmak26yLjonzji6cuMFAe1kH3eUePVEi74Kx1M7cYFdTAN/1781457186203.jpg) Next Tuesday is the second round of this challenge, and I am heading back out there with a better plan. Since I am completely new to this and eager to improve, I would really appreciate any tips, gear recommendations, or basic advice you guys can share. I will be reading your suggestions in the comments down below. See y'all next tuesday! ------ ---- |

title.title: Carta 1: Antes de conocerte
title.body:
Querido Lukas:
Hoy quiero contarte cómo era mi vida antes de conocerte.
Hubo un tiempo en que no sabía que existías. No conocía tu nombre, no imaginaba tu rostro y tampoco podía imaginar cuánto amor cabría dentro de mi corazón.
Era una muchacha joven llena de sueños, miedos e incertidumbres. Como muchas personas, pensaba en el futuro y me preguntaba qué camino tomaría mi vida. Tenía metas, preocupaciones y días buenos y malos, pero todavía no sabía que algo maravilloso estaba por suceder.
![IMG_20260109_211149_794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/Eq9VfdJ2ac9zfYw7QTnRh1f5UmgSwzu3yFuy8pwPfkjqdDTv5oJTgFpjuBx7bunTvkb.jpg)

Antes de conocerte, creía que entendía lo que era amar. Amaba a mi familia, amaba a tu papá y amaba las pequeñas cosas que daban sentido a mis días. Sin embargo, aún no conocía el amor inmenso, profundo e inexplicable que una madre siente por su hijo.
Tú llegaste a mi vida sin avisar cuánto la transformarías.
Aún no escuchaba tu corazón latir, no sentía tus movimientos y no sabía que un día ocuparías cada rincón de mis pensamientos. Pero de alguna manera, ya venías en camino para cambiar mi historia.
Mirando hacia atrás, me doy cuenta de que mi vida estaba dividida en dos etapas: antes de ti y después de ti.
Antes de ti existían los sueños.
Después de ti apareciste tú, convertido en el sueño más grande de todos.
No sabía que tendría noches sin dormir por cuidarte, que aprendería a preocuparme por alguien más que por mí misma o que descubriría una fuerza que ni siquiera sabía que poseía.
Tampoco sabía que un día una simple sonrisa tuya sería capaz de alegrarme el alma después del peor de los días.
Hoy, mientras escribo estas palabras, te veo crecer poco a poco. Veo al niño curioso, inquieto, alegre y lleno de energía que ilumina nuestro hogar.
Y aunque esta carta habla de un tiempo en que todavía no te conocía, la verdad es que ahora me cuesta imaginar cómo era la vida sin ti.
Porque desde que llegaste, todo cambió.
Y por eso este libro lleva el nombre que lleva.
Mi vida cambió contigo.
Con todo mi amor,
Mamá.

![IMG-20250706-WA0020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/EoEsPnDCaioGChLFcoGo1zTMEGgev9jUgApJoYX5rrsArZyXAH3N4yQrptrphgssrS5.jpg)

Como siempre agradecer a mis amigos @bradleyarrow y su esposa @cathyarrow por estar siempre presente en la vida de nuestro hijo y en la de nosotros.

title.title: Miniature Natural Paintings: The Magic of Yemeni Dendritic Agate
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQfV3QY4fFUkyBHo7m9c38TggQyAdr33amdtnuXGpGbri/1781484207253.jpg)
​Hello Hive friends,
​Today, I want to share a unique beauty with you—not created by an artist's brush, but by Mother Nature over thousands of years.
​The attached image image_0.png showcases a collection of agate cabochons that I have prepared and polished. This specific type is known as \

characterized by its internal patterns and formations that resemble trees, ferns, or miniature landscapes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdj2yzNijBAYVxbnd6tw4vcacMeHaEEJaYuFffTnKq5jS/1781484600413.jpg)

​These internal \

are actually mineral deposits of iron or manganese that permeated the agate stone during its formation, creating these captivating paintings. Every cabochon in this set is entirely unique; no two stones in the world are exactly alike.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmStkC5v6iXrJeitKvgaKTxvXuiAum4zHQuzbU4Dfp6npq/1781484625841.jpg)
​As a craftsman and photographer of these stones, I find great joy in the challenge of capturing these intricate details through the lens. In this post, I wanted to share several shots of the same cabochons, but using two different lighting techniques:

​Natural Light: Gives the stone a realistic look, with soft, eye-comforting colors that reflect its true nature.

​Flash Light: I used it to penetrate the translucency of the stone, sharply highlighting the delicate mineral branching and internal depth.

​I hope you enjoy this visual comparison.
________________________________________________

All attached photos are completely my own original work.

Photography Behind the Scenes:
​Device Used: Samsung Galaxy Note 10 Plus.

​Lighting: A comparison between natural daylight and direct flash lighting to highlight translucency and fine details.

title.title: Weekend Analysis (SPS Forecast, June 13, 2026) [ES-EN]
title.body:
> Something I’ve been planning is to conduct a weekly analysis of SPS on the weekends to provide a more visual perspective on what to expect from the asset in the coming week or the week following the analysis, covering both the fundamental aspects—such as how news and updates affect the price of SPS— and, of course, the technical side, which is much easier—and ultimately, everything that happens fundamentally impacts the asset’s price movement, something you can identify on the chart if you know how to analyze it. Although this is by no means intended to be a trading class—you can find plenty of free content online about that, at least the basics—I will explain in detail how the analysis works and go into the finer points. The most important thing here is the SPS projection, so if you follow the price closely, you might gain some interesting insights. and although this is NOT an INVESTMENT RECOMMENDATION—just educational and informational content—you can use this as a guide for your decisions. In my case, I want to follow it closely because in my last post I talked about my plan for selling and investing in the Splinterlands ecosystem. **So, if you’d like me to continue providing these kinds of weekly analyses on SPS, DEC, or other assets related to “Splinterlands,” please leave a comment on this post so I can gauge how much the community values this information and dedicate time to bringing you analyses of other assets.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# The latest “SPS Cycles”
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> ![Ciclo completo del SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23t76y3221qbwcRtACBVxLJkF8cvxcQCBrhZY4ZErMkPjk9jfSgEGEnPbZgH7xYeSLaao.png) In the SPS cycles of recent years—specifically from late 2023 to the present—bearish momentum has predominated over bullish momentum; however, here we can see what I clearly mentioned in my last post, where I noted that when the bullish cycle marked by BTC arrives, the SPS tends to respond very well during those phases, even if the overarching trend is bearish, because the price structure on “1-Week” charts is clear; the reality is that at those moments the SPS surges, in fact, in the last cycle we can see that SPS launched a very strong bullish micro-trend of 230.61% lasting about 252 days. That said, there is no clear pattern to these bull cycles, because the one preceding the one I just mentioned lasted only about 98 days, with a much more parabolic surge followed, of course, by a sharp decline. However, it’s worth noting that we’ve been in a bear market for 413 days since April 2025—one of the longest in recent memory. But if I had to make a projection, it could continue to fall a bit more, as the bearish cycle will likely extend through “October and November” of this year, before shifting to a new cycle and giving way to a fresh bullish momentum lasting at least 3 or 4 months that could bring the price back to between $0.012 and $0.014. **NOTE: This could change if there is a major update or a significant improvement to the game that alters or disrupts what the price action is currently indicating.** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Technical Analysis in 1 Week

![Grafico de 1 semana SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23t74tdEXs8y9vBrKLFwPWuADrC2nbZXBUUctxk1b8nxave6kZKFc4mMGYVtfXz2rNzPm.png) In the image above, we can see the downtrend marked by a diagonal blue line connecting the price highs since the highs reached in 2023. On the other hand, there is a clear “support” level forming a distinct “descending triangle,” a chart pattern indicating a continuation of the trend, which is in fact clearly breaking through that level. Now, as I mentioned earlier, the price will most likely continue to fall because the cycle is still ongoing. Furthermore, “Bitcoin” probably needs one more downward push to complete this bearish trend, which would mark the end of the cycle. As a result, money would start to flow in, and it would be the perfect time for SPS and Splinterlands to drive growth more than ever. In addition, I have charted the possible price range between $0.012 and $0.015.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# Schedule for the week of June 15–21 https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> ![Grafico 4H SPS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tGTZ13mtQf4R6sEHWziTc5QE1n6hf8GmeGDnZviHHZKAHNEkhyT3oehGDjWyMJCz15J.png) As you can see in the chart, the week of the 15th to the 21st may see significant sideways movement if the BTC price also remains range-bound; that’s what we’ll likely see, although the probability is that it will continue to fall, so I lean toward the bearish scenario shown in the chart, However, if we continue to see a brief upward price rally, we will most likely test the recent high of $0.003522 before continuing to fall. These projections may not be all that encouraging, but I’m leaning more toward the long term. Once this bear market cycle ends, that’s when accumulation will pay off. As I said, I’d be accumulating as much as I can and trying to average down to a better entry price on the SPS in order to lock in profits in less than a year—or more, depending on how the price behaves. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) ***NOTE: In any case, I remain confident that the Splinterlands team will continue to pursue the partnerships that are so necessary to help the game gain widespread adoption, attract new players, and bring in investors—all of which will help reduce the current “oversupply” surrounding SPS.***

title.title: Rolka niewypał?
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWksjKsuXgfy2zNi3tdKvQBHXbvzcxvJGcGsasNkYhgvq/image.png)

Nad najnowszą rolką siedziałem do 5.00. Po przebudzeniu [opublikowałem ją](https://www.instagram.com/p/DZkE5QuM4V1/). I początkowo zdawało się, że pójdzie lepiej niż poprzednie, bo po kwadransie miała 350 wyświetleń, ale ostatecznie (chyba) wyszedł zakalec. Oczywiście niczego nie można wykluczyć. Na ten moment jednak (po 12 godzinach) ma ona tylko 2002 wyświetlenia. Niemal równo tyle samo na Instagramie i Facebooku. Co prawda, jeśli porównać to do rolek sprzed roku, to nie jest to zły wynik, no ale nakłady pracy są nieporównywalnie większe. I w sumie im więcej ich robię, tym dalej jestem od jakiegoś uniwersalnego przepisu na rolkę.

Na marginesie, IG zaczął publicznie informować co i w jakim stopniu ma wpływ na algorytmy. Poniżej cała lista od najważniejszego czynnika do najmniej ważnego.

- Współczynnik pominięć (odsetek wyświetleń przez osoby, które pominęły Twoją rolkę podczas pierwszych 3 sekund)
- Współczynnik udostępnień (odsetek wyświetleń, które skutkowały udostępnieniem)
- Współczynnik polubień (odsetek wyświetleń, które skutkowały polubieniem)
- Współczynnik zapisań (odsetek wyświetleń, które skutkowały zapisaniem)
- Wskaźnik repostowania (odsetek wyświetleń, które skutkowały repostowaniem)
- Współczynnik komentarzy (odsetek wyświetleń, które skutkowały dodaniem komentarza)

Trochę mnie to zaskoczyło, bo obstawiałbym, że komentarze nie będą na końcu. Tak czy owak, w jakiejś perspektywie czasu dobrze byłoby wypracować jakiś format, który będzie ciekawy dla odbiorcy (zwłaszcza w kontekście tych 3 sekund), ale równocześnie będzie pochłaniał mniej czasu.

Swoją drogą czytałem przed chwilą wyniki badań dot. marketingu KBK, które robiła Alicja. Zaskoczyło mnie, że więcej ankietowanych śledzi Królestwo na Hive niż na Instagramie...

title.title: Tomato Oatmeal
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbuF2Aujq7CNpPhgV28aXTM2z215cwCgz5u23kfxBv9uR/1781484672149.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, how was your weekend? Did everything go well? Did you enjoy your weekend? Today I’m sharing a meal that isn’t noodles or rice, I made savory oatmeal for lunch. The texture is soft like porridge, so it’s easy to eat, and the fresh homemade tomato sauce makes this dish even more delicious. Alright, let’s get right to it

**Ingredients:**

- 2 tomatoes
- 1 tbsp tomato sauce
- 4 tbsp oats
- 200ml water
- 1 tbsp oregano
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 clove fresh garlic
- olive oil
- 1 shrimp
- cheddar cheese 

**Instructions:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEiECFMfBm5pAjJEJUWZktoXzhxtph62yNHpNJBKkzVu/1781484700653.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYyzT8bzKqeMkFFXrDKXdM7B2StPos1y4vMPPy57Yijp/1781484700875.jpg)

- Prepare the tomatoes by scoring the tops

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVfJKqmTL4DfFoyvY5dFTJChX3Fw69oZLt5v4jidhiRE/1781484720509.jpg)

- Blanch briefly in boiling water for 30 seconds

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNRfavPAJgRWM8dUui7kewdJ1u4thUekNJ5Und2rdxbhG/1781484749283.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCXPzKbmhXXErk5XCaQpV5TryY6vTfiRNVzQgVLmueAU/1781484749458.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWRfgTjYT2Yp6hHzCMQkLHaLry2Gvz2WQkcS2ZdiyX8H/1781484749630.jpg)

- Peel the tomato skins, then dice the tomatoes and set aside

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNEQ9wB5CGugT4fdzWXsk6DxrQaJNWx5hsS925CVX8RW/1781484786243.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQm9Pco6dH6LzqEnqeAMfcLTh9WANyuoRu93NAVEys7BM/1781484786412.jpg)

- Heat olive oil in a pan, then add the shrimp

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfVLrsg1ExPxrMZ8hGLnroKzmGcSJs1E3hzWk79MdAhb4/1781484804220.jpg)

- Pan-fry the shrimp briefly until cooked, then set aside

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgStsj8q7zW1nf7sfLmJA3zaDTjkFGkED6H8sZSeUdXG/1781484820495.jpg)

- Sauté the minced garlic in the same pan until fragrant

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVWv1LiFXtpHerhQAruQfxdqxnyPwcBqkJALzqFCsVQT/1781484836186.jpg)

- Add the tomato pieces to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTq7RnhHUvc2fR4xfQBhcu88hAMHKh6c86J8qPzQLuXjr/1781484857235.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6t2aKLqbATXNxpcnNDXxNB8kKDanHZoH2ujrai6vcAV/1781484857421.jpg)

- Sauté the tomatoes until the liquid is released

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEDu2Mu52VdFHCYV55GiezDgVziKVzPdMRWn67mu3EQF/1781484875478.jpg)

- Add the oregano to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcKsafWwfWYRHXVDwTfFqGw5WVfiDdmDjuAeyyia9ZZqJ/1781484896271.jpg)

- Add the oatmeal

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmViMq6FYV9qc2yvmtpJoCZ5GSV3sqPfpBGvmQqdMmU5Kz/1781484919041.jpg)

- Add water and stir briefly and add the tomato sauce

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGfH5qBC3CzSNrtkrTtVUdxoTUz8eRpTGDKib8ejTK2v/1781484951565.jpg)

- Cook until the liquid has reduced and the oats are cooked

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmViky7qwBhp9iughoDbx2ejgpwbQWRSAzQU3hxtoViif5/1781484968716.jpg)

- Add salt and pepper to taste, then stir until well combined

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7XuVSFjENuEhW6Bc7s9D88yYK9Mg28UxdZEKksq9uAK/1781484993309.jpg)

- Serve on a plate and top with grated cheese and the previously pan-fried shrimp

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf3NRouhbnbRDQP6vVT5c5FsHntxjS6fWWw7GchSfcJed/1781485009555.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtjJVN36PQTSCbqLKwkiHMmqmkChHPtzwG16RRoNodft/1781485009829.jpg)

- The tomato oatmeal is ready to eat

title.title: I Envy You
title.body:
The other day I was talking to some of my friends about revenge, and during that conversation, one of them had said something about how long they can wait just to get back at someone for something they did to him.

Apparently, he happens to be the kind of guy who could pretend to be your friend and act like nothing is wrong after you've offended him, just so that you could let your guard down in the future for him to retaliate and do some payback.

![1001151626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23swbi2DVBz9f7NfZS5HozgasgerujbpFiYMBSV6CUJyQRJNJAdqtKucdQ7V7Nriy4xEr.jpg)
<sub> [photo by Peter Forster](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-face-ouVAsbiwzlo) </sub>

And I know this isn't the right thing to say, but I envy people like that, people who could hold a grudge inside while pretending like all is well on the outside, just so that they could deliver a much more painful revenge.

The reason I envy people like that is simply because I'm the complete opposite of that. When I get offended by people, I tend to want to deal with the issue immediately, and this is because the moment I waste any more time on the matter, I find myself no longer feeling as pissed as I was when it first happened.

And sadly, the one time that makes revenge satisfying is the anger you have behind it. But unfortunately for me, having to retaliate immediately because I'm offended means that those people tend to see it coming because they know they've offended me and they expect a retaliation.

So now their guard is up, and they're basically ready for whatever it is I'm about to throw their way, and I hate that. Because in as much as it is good to be forgiving, it is also good to occasionally remind people why they shouldn't mess with you. And most times, it is best when you do it when they least expect it.

title.title: Two delicious tropical fruits with a hint of freshness [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
After being away for a few days, I'm back to share a delicious fruit smoothie that I enjoyed yesterday in the comfort of my own home.

>Después de unos cuantos días de ausencia, estoy de vuelta para compartir un delicioso batido de frutas que disfruté ayer en la tranquilidad de mi hogar.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeX9rYSsvvSZDeJsTpK4SCH4AWsiN7X6NFLahMukEMeK/1781479025840.jpg) 

I’d been thinking about combining a couple of fruits for a few days, but it wasn’t until yesterday that I actually had them on hand in my kitchen. I also added a touch of freshness with a very aromatic herb.

The result was a true delight packed with all the goodness of two delicious tropical fruits—tart and sweet at the same time (one more tart than the other)—with flavors that complement each other perfectly and that not only delight the palate but also nourish, hydrate, and refresh us. A fantastic smoothie—join me in making it 😉

>Mezclé un par de frutas que ya tenía en mente desde hace algunos días, pero fue hasta ayer que las tuve juntas en mi cocina. También agregué un toque de frescura con una hierba muy aromática.
>
>El resultado fue una verdadera delicia cargada con todo el poder de dos frutas tropicales deliciosas, ácidas y dulces a la vez (una más ácida que otra), con sabores que se complementan muy bien y no solo le brindan un gusto al paladar, sino también nos nutren, hidratan y refrescan. Un batido genial, acompáñame en su preparación 😉

----------------------------------
-------------------------------------------------------

# Ingredients for 2 small glasses:

- 1 slice of a medium pineapple.
- The flesh of one manga (a larger, elongated variety of mango).
- 3 washed mint leaves.
- 1 cup of cold water.

># Ingredientes para 2 copas pequeñas:
>
>- 1 rueda de una piña mediana.
>- La pulpa de una manga (una especia de mango más grande, alargado).
>- 3 hojas lavadas de hierbabuena. 
>- 1 taza de agua fría.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeCAZ2VgAQw1pBAFJTbhGN23txg7cYH8wKCbCjRRvMJLw/1781479000801.jpg)

# Preparation // Preparación:

This recipe is very simple: just cut the fruits into medium-sized pieces and blend them with the mint leaves and water until all the ingredients are thoroughly combined. 

>Esta preparación es muy sencilla, basta con cortar las frutas en trozos medianos y licuarlas junto a las hojas de hierbabuena y el agua, hasta que todos los ingredientes se integren muy bien. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCCAWxrjWsrQbzvhynrT17UXS74oWVxQMUMzHP8cucy4/1781479000896.jpg) | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNcZNWXbDpTnwQLZMVDgbXRc6y7KvGt4gm6wHoV9MPDnT/1781479000936.jpg) | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNfZiRse4RxbMV7fpKEQg16ycaD3HVnY6tF3VDkGMkDQ6/1781479000977.jpg)
-|-|-


Although I know it's good not to strain some smoothies to retain the fiber, I prefer to do so for a completely liquid texture. I don't waste the fiber anyway, since I just scoop it up with a spoon and eat it 😉

>Aunque sé que es bueno no colar algunos batidos para aprovechar la fibra, yo prefiero hacerlo para obtener una textura totalmente líquida. De igual manera no desperdicio la fibra, ya que la agarro con una cuchara y me la como 😉

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtbpD7xNKwZ8k1x9YzsawC7jThNhxjExxVfGoV33aBcL/1781479001059.jpg) | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPh8Wra9Ys7rtVPY3a9KHsXiUJBgpcdRHMm2QkdReChDd/1781479025668.jpg)
-|-

And after blending it well and straining it, I had my delicious, refreshing drink.

>Y luego de una buena batida y una colada, obtuve mi deliciosa y refrescante bebida.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUUEoHuRmxVeKZNNeLjxjZWW6fmecUq7vVi2AqJPHPpT/1781479025749.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQmLMMTS7pyFvtw9T77kYK4yzNvtwNTudbVNCU1YLC7nA/1781479025921.jpg)

title.body:
¡Hola, Comunidad de Hive! Hoy les traigo los resultados de una nueva sesión de dibujo urbano que tuve hoy, domingo, con mi grupo habitual para este tipo de actividades. Nuestro punto de encuentro fue la Iglesia Santa Bárbara de la ciudad de Mérida, una de las más visitadas de la misma. La mayoría empezamos dibujando la fachada de dicha iglesia. En mi caso, usé un bolígrafo negro para la mayor parte del dibujo y un marcador también negro para algunos detalles. Este dibujo me tomó aproximadamente una hora con quince minutos. A continuación pueden ver una fotografía del dibujo con la referencia y una sólo del dibujo. 
.
Hello, Hive Community! Today I’m sharing the results of a new urban sketching session I had today, Sunday, with my usual group for these kinds of activities. Our meeting spot was the Santa Bárbara Church in the city of Mérida, one of the most visited churches there. Most of us started by sketching the church’s façade. In my case, I used a black pen for most of the drawing and a black marker for some details. This sketch took me about an hour and fifteen minutes. Below you can see a photo of the sketch with the reference and one of the sketch alone. 
![P1120720.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXHevobS7TgsjihPvLQ9YTJWEFA7VMkdkNsxKBibV3JLr/P1120720.JPG)

![IMG_20260614_133629_067.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVGsfABxWof27nhUhRuMNM6AZ89eU2nsXLwBkrcBZ4NUD/IMG_20260614_133629_067.jpg)
Después, fuimos a una calle cercana y decidimos dibujar la fachada de un edificio residencial cercano, el cual nos llamó bastante la atención por su diseño. Este dibujo me tomó cincuenta minutos y usé los mismos materiales que en el anterior. 
.
After that, we went to a nearby street and decided to sketch the facade of a nearby residential building, which really caught our attention because of its design. This sketch took me fifty minutes, and I used the same materials as in the previous one. 
![P1120723.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMag9QMEQ8GL6mJE7AavArFSjumHXoM88mix3WGi2syL/P1120723.JPG)

![IMG_20260614_133720_969.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNmz4GRa1rpj4daRCnkWg9t4ZgawgAXjF8Za6pzRQjnMS/IMG_20260614_133720_969.jpg)
Eso fue todo por hoy. Muchas gracias por leer. 
.
That's all for today. Thank you very much for reading.

title.body:
Hola María Francia, Bienvenida a Hive. 
En lo personal me encanta todo lo que tiene que ver con desarrollo personal, pienso que eres de gran valor y que tienes mucho que aportar a la comunidad.
No sé que sabes de este ecosistema, pero lo más bonito es crear comunidad con quienes realmente sintonices y hacer de tu blog tu espacio personal, con el que te identifiques. 
Hay nichos para todos los gustos y diferentes comunidades en las que puedes publicar, si así lo deseas. Sólo debes tener en cuenta las normas de cada comunidad. 
Escribe lo que te guste, participa en iniciativas sólo si te provoca. Desde mi punto de vista, lo más importante es que tus líneas sean honestas.
Haz presencia en las publicaciones de otros, mediante comentarios significativos.
En cuanto a las recompensas, deja que te sorprendan, que no seas lo primero que esperas, que tu prioridad sea amar el espacio que estás creando. Algunos las reciben rápido, a otros nos costó años. Buenas fotografías, un texto original (algunas comunidades piden mínimo 300 palabras, otras 500) y mantener a la IA al margen de tu post, ayudan bastante.
Mucho éxito en este nuevo camino que emprendes ✨.

>The remaining ICO soldiers retreated, taking cover behind thick trunks of surrounding pines. Detecting them, Amos sprinted laterally, his hybrid speed blurring his silhouette against the dark forest backdrop. He slid behind a massive oak tree. His body warned him that he was fifty Earth years old; his mind propelled him toward a hybrid lifespan.
>
>*Initially, he breathed heavily before verbally ordering, \
as his ears pricked back and detected a directive from one of the remaining retreating soldiers. \
Commence planetary purge protocol. Countdown: D-1.\
I know what I must do. I've known all along. I've seen the answer. It lies within the compound. I must move quickly.\n>\n>*\
Amos declared.\n>\n>*But Julius, Annetta, Benetiz, and Viktor refused. \

Benetiz proclaimed.*\n>\n>The drive toward the compound in the Pacific Northwest was a blur of rainy, desolate highway. Although late summer, the weather had definitely broke the farther north they drove. \

\n>\n>*Amos remained quiet, peering out the fogged window, focusing on his mission. The tingling in his hands grew intense the closer they came. He studied them, watching the faint, shimmering veins; a color he now understood as the signature of his Omicron Vorsey lineage. \
Amos muttered, the name leaving a bitter taste. \
Viktor replied, his eyes glued to the slick road. \
Amos completed, the realization crystallizing into a cold, hard purpose. \

\n>\n>*Amos turned his face toward Viktor, his stare hardening. The metal humming in his palm unleashed a new, unidentifiable clarity that washed over him. The anger was immediate and all-consuming. \
And, I’ll proceed to scorch the core into oblivion.\
Make sure you follow the perimeter behind the compound then,\

Headquarters faces west. I've never been inside. My security clearance wouldn't allow entrance. I was restricted to the Silver Otherworld Watchtower on the east side. Its towers misses nothing, so stay vigilant.\
I've been waiting a long time to meet you. I\
\n\nBenedikt Inhumos. The name tasted like ash. \
Amos hissed, his voice vibrating with a frequency that shattered a small vial on a nearby counter. He didn't just feel anger; he felt a genetic mandate for destruction.\n\n\

he growled, his voice vibrating with latent alien energy.\n\nInhumos shifted directly in front of the consoles, his hands behind him steadily pushing buttons on the console, while he spoke. Surrounded by cold screens, his focus was on finalizing the \
to eliminate all humans on Earth.\n\n\

Inhumos talked as if he'd not sent his soldiers to kill him the night before.

\
\n\nBenedikt's eyes widened. He stammered, staring at the unnatural hue of Amos' eyes. \

Amos didn’t let him finish; nor did he strike Inhumos. 

Instead, with a thought, he overloaded the electronics in the room, shattering the windows and sealing the doors, shutting down the entire floor. 

But he didn't kill him instantly. He needed the breach to mean something.

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

Instantly, his thoughts turned to Annetta. He knew she wouldn't stay behind, but attempt to help. And, of course, Julius and the rest would follow.

He couldn't abandon his mission to search for them. As he studied the room for his next move, a chilling sensation overcame him.

In the far corner, he caught sight of a familiar digital display scrolling inside the wall.

He stared up at the embedded depression. A replica of the Wall of Success at the research hospital in another sector of ICO North. His lips pursed and a wry smile slowly formed, together with a tinge of regret reading the accolades of five Goodall family members.

He recalled time there under observation.

From the depths of the pity they heaped upon his head, a single-minded focus took shape. He, Annetta, Julius, Roy and the other dissenters had planted the seeds of doubt in all four corners of the continent. ICO was destined to succumb to their enlightenment. 

And my small part I played in unveiling the black hole of success is my reward. Success. Riches. Rewards. Resentment. Destruction. Angst. Betrayal. Deserting one's family. From the outside, it looks like a world not of this planet. I always knew within my depths that ICO was not of this world. Sent to destroy our civilization, they gained a stronghold.

But how much longer will it last? he recalled thinking as his head filled with a foreign substance meant to befuddle the mind and ease into compliance.

And all due to the ownership of that Silver Coin in exchange for freedom. The fragment of life comes at too steep a price for mankind.

The dream was vivid, even through the mind-submission drugs. 

Clothes fell from my body effortlessly as I ran. Where I was running to I didn't know. The Silver Coin that once meant my demise once deactivated was a myth; at least for me. I controlled The Silver Coin. Thoughts of my parents flashed in a nearby bush. For a second, hands flew out and beckoned me to join them in the shade.

I struggled to loosen the restraints around my arms and body. The stark, white hospital walls closed in as if a kaleidoscope.

I remembered voices of the four ICO Quality Control medical staff sitting; observing. Notes recorded quickly on individual electronic devices registered in the ICO database.

Agent Control No. 4 muted his microphone. She turned to her colleagues and implored, *\
Agent 2 covered the microphone as he spoke. \

Amos shook his head violently as he recovered from what the nightmare at ICO North medical facility. A horrific place where the **fragment of life** hung heavily over one's conscious. 

\

he declared. *[to be continued]*
