> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes mi entrenamiento de caminata que realicé en la ruta del asentamiento campesino Montero, en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to all my friends on Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you the walking workout I did along the Montero peasant settlement route, in the community of Villa de Cura, Zamora municipality, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260614_181357106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xKzo9mDqN7eyv3xU9pAAJtVgTxdj2UR37SRjGdQoBqbq7cWxgt1NRL2HUEBKN3Urx3q.jpg) Cabe destacar que este entrenamiento lo realicé el día de hoy domingo, aprovechando que no tenía actividad del fútbol de mi hijo, me levanté temprano para hacer mis ejercicios de calentamiento y salir a la 5:55 am desde la avenida Lisandro Hernández, recorriendo toda esta carretera para adentrarme al asentamiento campesino de Montero, por la primera entrada, algunas partes al inicio estaban llenas de barro por las lluvias recientes, pasando los primeros 2K en un tiempo de 20 minutos. >It’s worth noting that I did this training session today, Sunday, as my son didn’t have any football training, I got up early to do my warm-up exercises and set off at 5.55 am from Lisandro Hernández Avenue, running the whole length of this road to enter the Montero farming settlement via the first entrance; some sections at the start were muddy due to recent rain, and I covered the first 2 km in 20 minutes. ![IMG_20260614_062054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243qH4hY7mfDSJyEyomwA2otL4HNqfewuxf6MeLePPXRRynaCjUBvVgzSm7VRnyF5mNyo.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_061156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/246b2gC4qkWrvkSoV9uQMoN9c3mo1Qescxi7HVbwWocDdsTxE4qGxeuuFa7RzGs63VwzM.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_062234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244UjQQaFph9GATRdvsmzBGMR1EVPyz6DFV52L7XDR7G54Jd3qj64Z1H43Y12VufugsUe.jpg) Asimismo, a medida que avanzaba pensé completar una distancia de 3K y desviarme hacia el otro asentamiento El Samán, pero después cambie de idea, y continúe mi caminata, este recorrido como pueden observar es de pura tierra, la única parte que es asfaltado es al inicio, una vez que llegué al final de Montero, me encontré con unos amigos corredores y aprovechamos para conversar y tomarnos unas fotografías. >As I went along, I had thought about covering a distance of 3 km and turning off towards the other settlement, El Samán, but then I changed my mind and carried on with my walk. As you can see, this route is entirely on dirt tracks; the only paved section is at the start. Once I reached the end of Montero, I bumped into some fellow runners and we took the opportunity to have a chat and take a few photos. ![IMG_20260614_062342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23sddmieqtNMLuopHZ3hWwhpwKHnsTSBEEu6CoBzxRneAHVkT8N8ZzNG4Z5XCa44jfF3Q.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_062347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2466rVdDwh5dMcLvuuGtVG9ht3UCZF2MzLvQNEdmKJTQMTezycZEmZ2NB13YyYntvs4zU.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_062905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23y8mdzVQxPorDezV9YPK3SCq3RjUvhCc7yuepwCdzoqrs4CN1CXNJZKhuH1o6CeFWSTr.jpg) De regreso, ellos continuaron trotando y yo aumenté el ritmo para tratar de que no me dejarán tan atrás, manteniendo un paso a 8 minutos por kilómetro, a medida que avanzaba se fueron alejando, ellos iban a realizar la vuelta al asentamiento campesino El Samán, y yo también pensaba hacer ese trayecto, que son como 17K, pero será en otra oportunidad, quedé sorprendido en la recta para llegar a la carretera nacional, los pude ver, me llevaba una ventaja de casi 4 minutos. >On the way back, they kept jogging and I picked up the pace to try and stop them from leaving me too far behind, maintaining a pace of 8 minutes per kilometre; as I went on, they pulled further ahead; they were going to run the loop around the El Samán farming settlement, and I had also planned to do that route, which is about 17 km, but that will have to wait for another time. I was surprised on the straight stretch leading to the main road; I could see them, and they had a lead of almost 4 minutes on me. ![IMG_20260614_062924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/246axkGWVgav4VdX5YCqUbbodS1Gf8VgRQmiFg9raVAEkKaFUrXYhXYB1dzukGr9bgjL4.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_065128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/EoiUjXdp7buv9hhV1jtDtQJx6CAgA8Z4duELHXRBw2ykJQTtdsfge2RoiKp1dbx3Ryb.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_064223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/24329PL25yAH95XZhPCpHraTP1LaxpZ9W8EpsB11JB2zePpLf76LAVpHBhZbie4Hfv4NV.jpg) Una vez que llegue a la carretera nacional, tomé la dirección hacia el monumento de Ezequiel Zamora,para caminar toda esta recta, y llegar nuevamente a la avenida Lisandro Hernández, con una distancia de 11.6K,con un desnivel positivo de 119 m,un desnivel máximo583 m y un tiempo de 1 hora 52 minutos, registrado en la aplicación Strava. >Once I reached the main road, I headed towards the Ezequiel Zamora monument to walk the entire stretch and return to Lisandro Hernández Avenue, covering a distance of 11.6 km, with an elevation gain of 119 m, a maximum elevation of 583 m, and a time of 1 hour 52 minutes, as recorded on the Strava app. ![IMG_20260614_065348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/242DC5Shb4jYm7yRCChk89Kc3wvCaR1YTqFfxBiFCCWA3fkmKbPck1gBjyqZuhp3Jfp85.jpg) ![IMG_20260614_070707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/242NaWDgMsMNGptE9uC3qotZPnRHQ1guDvHmd4FspxWffFfXgnXdS2rQpUWiSk8kyFd7g.jpg) ![GridArt_20260614_180550665.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23uFueZwVPfqX9wrTTGPJyuMRAL7mdjXMegEWjedQ1cXBdsWV2di9EANNKcGy2H9dyGeu.jpg) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cetb2008/entrenamiento-de-caminata-ruta-montero-116k-cq9)

body.title: La noche (ejercicio poético para Jorge Luis Borges) (Esp | Eng)
body.body:
Se cumplen hoy 40 años de la muerte del sin par escritor argentino y universal [Jorge Luis Borges](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_Luis_Borges), ocurrida en 1986. Son varios los artículos que he publicado acerca de él en #Hive; les indico algunos enlaces: [1](https://peakd.com/@josemalavem/jorge-luis-borges-y-la-vision-del-hecho-estetico); [2](https://peakd.com/@josemalavem/jorge-luis-borges-de-la-lectura-a-la-escritura-or-jorge-luis-borges-from-reading-to-writing); [3](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/borges-y-el-libro). Esta vez he escrito un ejercicio poético en su memoria.
![Foto de Borges 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/241tdRo5VknVGjgFTY1hS4bWqkqKHYaU6F9WWPPUmnAn1qYaGjY5vPSqwYWsD6oqqAS7U.png)
Foto de J. L. Borges hecha por el fotógrafo Pepe Fernández en París - [Fuente](https://debateyconvergencia.com.ar/jorge-borges-un-genio-literario-poco-valorado-en-su-propia-tierra/)

La noche me alcanzó con su definitivo nadir Otras veces se había amagado en mis ojos velados en la despedida de mi madre en la inasible presencia de mi Beatriz En el espejo vi mi sombra y el universo al revés La noche oscura de San Juan me iluminó y abrió mi alma al soterrado gusto de la oscuridad y el silencio La biblioteca presagió el laberinto de mis días tenues como el ocaso y en los libros el secreto de la soledad Soñé muchas muertes a la luz de Sherezade y de Milton Una llegó hasta mí y no me abandonó



(English versión)

The Night (A Poetic Exercise for Jorge Luis Borges) Today marks the 40th anniversary of the death of the unparalleled Argentine and universal writer [Jorge Luis Borges](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_Luis_Borges), which occurred in 1986. I have published several articles about him on #Hive; here are some links: [1](https://peakd.com/@josemalavem/jorge-luis-borges-y-la-vision-del-hecho-estetico); [2](https://peakd.com/@josemalavem/jorge-luis-borges-de-la-lectura-a-la-escritura-or-jorge-luis-borges-from-reading-to-writing); [3](https://peakd.com/hive-111516/@josemalavem/borges-y-el-libro). This time I have written a poetic exercise in his memory. Night overtook me with its final nadir Other times it had threatened in my veiled eyes in my mother's farewell in the elusive presence of my Beatrice In the mirror I saw my shadow and the universe upside down The dark night of Saint John's illuminated me and opened my soul to the hidden taste of darkness and silence The library foreshadowed the labyrinth of my days, faint as dusk and in the books the secret of solitude I dreamed many deaths in the light of Scheherazade and Milton One reached me and did not leave me
![Separador 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xytLgBJF58i9FArKpiv5gk1JddyGQjCiM6Q5kM9ahmcMhHqCbMrWN8sZvFsdAe5tmG4.jpg)

>Gracias por su lectura | Thank you for reading.

body.title: Chapters 1-6 - My Thoughts (Book 10 of 12)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzDzbZjsmn9npZSiEA6VaH4hKwUeVg6psy6ZJcoHgHL7/1781479852647.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3uT523qBj6pSPNuXsEC3Ph7sZpmV5QzeSDiDDUBunEk/1781479852741.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

### Chapters Read: 1-6

Well, *'The Lake of Souls'* is by far the most trippy book of the series and I'm very excited to re-experience it. It's the most interesting book of the series too. It simply feels like a whole different genre all of a sudden. I mean it still has it's horror elements no doubt but, it really feels like a pure fantasy more than any other book in the series. *'Sons of Destiny'* is pretty darn fantasy heavy in many ways as well but, this one still probably has it beat in that department. 

Darren is obviously really shaken up by Mr. Crepsley's death and much of these opening chapters are of him basically experiencing the stages of grief. It's pretty depressing for sure. I mentioned in one of my *'Killers of the Dawn'* posts that the series completely enters a new phase after book nine and well, now that I'm into *'The Lake of Souls'* officially, I really feel the vibe shift. Each new trilogy feels like a new phase has begun but, these last three are just built different. In these opening chapters, Darren really feels empty and aimless and man, that's just tough. 

Without a real idea where to go next, and wanting some time to himself, Darren briefly returns to the Cirque Du Freak and it's pretty cool honestly. I love how this series is twelve books and everything, but of course each book is fairly short. So the series feels long but it also has that short story vibe as well. Many events in the story move swiftly, and certain details are up for interpretation. The way these books cover timespans is just really beautiful to me. 

So yeah after the battle and death of Mr. Crepsley, Darren returns and Truska helps him deal with the pain and it's really touching. Overall it appears that Darren spends roughly five months with the Cirque. November to March. It's described as a wintry November to start, and later towards the end of his stint with the Cirque, it's described to be in March. Specifically, the **opening line of chapter three goes:**

***\

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcty6zbU2uyQfRTsJn5xGGVxpejz3xCjkBYmMuhagKTzn/1781480434424.png)

I won't necessarily pretend that that's the most beautiful line ever written, but it is **very** beautiful. I can easily picture days like that in my mind and appreciate them. Also, the timing and context of when it was written was actually amazing. It just feels as if Darren is finally healing after his loss. Ugh, so nice. 

This time span from November to March essentially is covered in a singular chapter and I actually love it for some reason. It's just real, and it's just beautiful because well, time does tend to fly in real life. Sometimes five months feels like two weeks. 

But furthermore, this book really transforms into like an out of body experience. As corny as it sounds, it's sort of therapeutic after Darren deals with such a loss. Well, that's a bit self-centered I guess because the journey he's about to partake in, is actually for the benefit of Harkat Mulds but, hear me out I guess. If anything it's perhaps good for Darren that he's helping a friend instead of being in his own head and wallowing in self pity. 

Darren has dealt with a major death. Now he's thrust into an other worldly journey in an unknown dangerous place. It's disorienting, scary, and simply cryptic. The point of it is to help Harkat discover who he was in his prior life. 

This seemingly alien land and new quest is sort of symbolic of what it must feel like for Darren right now. He's over the initial sting of Mr. Crepsley's death, but he's still getting over it. It must feel unsettling, new, and simply blatantly scary and uncomfortable imagining how he'll navigate this new phase of his life without Mr. Crepsley by his side. Of course, Darren is getting older in general and dealing with the truth of who Steve really is as well. It's been a crazy ride no doubt about it. 

When I first read these books, this book felt random as heck to me, it was thrilling, don't get me wrong, but I of course didn't necessarily fully understand the bigger picture of this book. 

Even though I can more clearly see what the purpose of this book is, well, I could be wrong what do I know. But I think I'm on the right track. Anyway, even though I can see the point of this book a bit more nowadays, it still makes it an exciting re-read because I can look at it with a new angle, a new perspective, and appreciate the deeper meaning behind much of this. In fact, while Mr. Tiny is insufferable in many ways, he's literally destiny in the form of a human (basically). So, now in this read, I find it harder to really *fully* hate him. He's simply living on a totally different, incomprehensible level. He's a god basically, and mother nature, and father time all wrapped in one. He's annoying and frustrating of course, but he's also just inevitable. 

Beyond Darren, I am of course SERIOUSLY curious about how I'll interpret and feel about Harkat here. This is basically Harkat's book I feel. It's like, we are all of a sudden enjoying Kurda/Harkat's storyline and Darren honestly takes *a bit* of a backseat. He learns a lot of course don't get me wrong and he shows solid character by being loyal to Harkat after all Harkat has done for him but yeah, this is Harkat's time right now. 

I'm so curious what new thoughts and new feelings will come to me as I progress. 

This series is just unbelievable. I love it. This is also the longest book of the series, which is pretty cool. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuC9v5RArB76XWK1BFGmVPr9wxT8N8JTmAHYX9biFmF7/1781479852842.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1Kt2y3vXP2amzyCqoSQ9XK8Br2qTK4LWKjw3e1xSYWG/1754644078339.png)

body.title: Michael (film):  A good film and a little conspiracy theory of mine to go along with it
body.body:
I wanted to go and see this film when it was in theaters but my logic kicked in the day I was thinking of going to it.   You see, I believe there are a few types of movies that are greatly enhanced by being in the theater and you can't replicate that same experience at home, no matter how much you spend on your home theater.   These sorts of films are normally action or fantasy films and often they can be really good in the cinema even if the film isn't really that good.  I use all the *Jurassic Park* films as an example here:  none of those films are particularly noteworthy (outside of maybe the first one) yet they are continually very good experiences in the theater.

When it came to *Michael*, I really felt like this was a film that would be just fine at home and being in front of a huge screen with a loud sound system wasn't going to change the experience all that much, so I held off.  I think me and my $25 or so made a wise decision here. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/243BieDCSbhFNQbmoqpNvyFmxzanuV4aEieQw2DtkNWesLm21aE65NnsUw29ciayDNg9b.png)
[src](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/MV5BNzllNmRlN2EtMDQyOC00ODJjLTg4OWQtZDNmNGU3YzlkNjc1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)</center>

I am old enough to have been aware of my surroundings for most of MJ's career although I was just a baby when the \

album was released and I don't think I was born when the Jackson 5 were a big deal.   I did see the meteoric rise of Jackson though and was a child when Thriller was released and yes, that was a very very big deal.

This movie documents Michael Jackson's departure from his family to being a solo artist and the main focus of the movie is about how his father Joseph was a rather oppressive figure in Michael's life, although you can't help but realize that had his father not been so much of a driving force  that the world might not have known about Michael at all.  He might just have been some dude in Indiana that was really good at karaoke had his Dad not been such an asshole.  

<center> https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/EWKA_Michael-Rep.jpg
[src](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/EWKA_Michael-Rep.jpg)</center>

I gotta give some real credit to the cast here.  If there is one person that would be very difficult to emulate it would probably be Michael Jackson.  The reason why the world went so gaga for the dude is because of the fact that he was so unique and unusual.   Even if you were not a fan of pop music you probably liked MJ's work.  I always enjoyed Jackson's music even after I was in college and had kind of determined that metal was my thing.  Michael Jackson was on of those musicians that had the following of everyone and I don't think many people were ashamed to admit this.  I wasn't and I was very particular about what sort of music I would listen to.

This is kind of touched upon in the film and how everyone loved Michael, regardless of what they were all about.  While I am sure some creative liberties were taken they state that MJ was inspired to get actual gangsters from the Bloods and Crips into the \

video after hearing about gang warfare on TV.

<center> https://i0.wp.com/www.thewrap.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/TheWrap-Photos-1-1.jpg?fit=990%2C557&quality=89&ssl=1
[src](https://i0.wp.com/www.thewrap.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/TheWrap-Photos-1-1.jpg?fit=990%2C557&quality=89&ssl=1)</center>

his iconic look and high pitched voice are on full display in this film and I gotta hand it to Jaafar Jackson, who is Michael Jackson's actual nephew, for his portrayal of the \

I bet this was a tough sell to put this guy in that role because he doesn't exactly have a huge CV of acting experience.  He is Jermaine Jackson's son.  

If I hadn't looked that up I probably wouldn't have known but whether or not you are related by blood to Michael, you probably still have to work a ton in order to accurately emulate the man who is arguably the most famous musician of all time.  

This movie concludes at the \

(the album) portion of Michael's life and it is more about his struggles with his father than anything else. Speaking of which Colman Domingo is someone else who I am not all that familiar with despite the fact that he has won an Emmy and has been been nominated for two Oscars! His performance as Michael's father, Joseph, is absolutely outstanding and I guarantee it will result in another Oscar nomination and I'm betting on an Oscar win for best supporting actor.
https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/colman-domingo-michael-6980ba96ea6b4.jpg?crop=1.00xw:0.845xh;0,0.0968xh [src](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/colman-domingo-michael-6980ba96ea6b4.jpg?crop=1.00xw:0.845xh;0,0.0968xh)
If you watch this film for no other reason you should do it for this. Not only does he absolutely nail the role of an oppressive but ultimately loving father, but they were able to make him genuinely look like Joseph the real person as well. It's kind of uncanny.
Now briefly I want to discuss my conspiracy theory about this film. The documentary that recently dropped on Netflix about the child-exploitation trial about Michael Jackson didn't really present Michael in the best light. While they didn't go so far as to say that MJ was guilty and got away with it, they kind of hint at exactly that. The Jackson Family is still a money-making machine and always will be, and in a way I feel like this film's release date kind of feels like damage control in a way. The fact that it has made nearly a billion dollars in worldwide box-office take is just an added bonus. Ok, that's all I have to say about that https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3zOLzsbOleM

Should I watch it?

I kind of think that all the people that were going to watch this already have done so or at least the HUGE box office would indicate that this is the case. However, if you are one of the people that has been avoiding seeing it for perhaps the same reasons that I did, you really should see this. I would be willing to bet that you will learn a thing or two about Michael and the rest of the Jackson family while doing so. Is it all true? Well, who knows? I would imagine there was a lot of creative liberty taken and of course they want to protect the Jackson family. Regardless though, this is a very entertaining film that takes us through the years before things started getting really strange with Michael. I started the film up intending to watch just a bit of it and then go to bed but ended up watching all of it. For me anyway, that is a sign that a film is truly top drawer.
![photodune-6774981-recommended-grunge-red-stamp-xs-643x272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/2424GudAc7bFr8LHXNQd8JLsDNgGoxs5MdjkNGMffLso1dZZdkwAvVmdd5ooMynWyTa3r.jpg) it is not yet possible to watch this anywhere as part of a basic subscription. You can legally rent it for around $20 (which I think is too much) on almost all streaming services. It is not available on Netflix and is unlikely to ever be.

El lunes comenzó con un trote de 30 minutos seguido de entrenamiento de fuerza enfocado en el tren inferior. El martes corrí 45 minutos en terreno con quiebres. El miércoles hice mi entreno en la pista del estadio Guillermo Soto Rosa; el sol estaba en su máximo esplendor.

En esta ocasión, el coach planificó un trabajo de resistencia a la fatiga. Consistió en correr 1.000 metros en Z5 (4:08), luego 3x1.000 en Z4 (4:31, 4:29 y 4:27) y, para cerrar, 2.000 metros a ritmo de umbral láctico (9:40). Nuevamente terminé mi sesión muy contenta. Durante el entrenamiento usé miel y me dio un plus de energía.

El jueves fui al gimnasio e hice una sesión de 1 hora y 30 minutos enfocada en el tren inferior; en la tarde, salí a soltar con 45 minutos. El viernes descansé y el sábado calenté 30 minutos para luego hacer un cambio de ritmo de 12 minutos.

Hoy cerré mi semana con un fondo en terreno con quiebres de 1 hora y 40 minutos en San Mateo, bajando y subiendo la cuesta de Las Heroínas.

Ahora me preparo para bajar las cargas esta semana para asimilar todo el esfuerzo acumulado. Aún sigo considerando no competir hasta que me sienta lista. ¡Así que seguiré disfrutando el proceso!

body.title: The Chosen Movie Review
body.body:
What prompted me to start this movie wasn't the wide media fame or awards it had gotten, nor was it my regular Instagram feed that brought an edit of it to my eyes.
My mom had asked me to download the first 3 seasons for her to watch. That happened close to 4 weeks ago, and now, I am the one who has finished the series and is left in awe at how the life of Jesus has been retold.
***
### <center>The Chosen</center>
***
#### Plot
> The story of Jesus, retold.

https://youtu.be/K1-FoFj8Jbo?si=JL5bs77rRUpV8eZ_
***
I believe the initial problem anyone would've had when creating a series like this is how to keep the viewers entertained.
It's one of, if not the most popular tales ever told with creative freedom of how it's supposed to go being 0.
> I doubt any Christian would be thrilled watching a version of Jesus story that isn't biblically accurate.

So there is no individualism in the tale, in the location or in the plot. What and how can you make this show as interesting as it is?
> **Be creative with the people!**

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/r7HnNh6Mzf0AAAAC/the-chosen-salome.gif)
***
I'm very sure this was his plan when he chose a cast as colorful, dynamic and talented as this.
The idea of not focusing on the prophecy itself but how the prophecy interacted with the people. The little intricacies that the Bible fails to point out or highlight.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/V5UOJPclhfsAAAAC/happy-the-chosen.gif)
This series was carried by it's cast. The acting was beautiful, very beautiful.
In the five seasons the ones I was enamored with the most was Jesus and Rabbi Shmuel.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/W4yGA5G3BmgAAAAC/the-chosen-jesus.gif)
It's rather ironic how the two opposing forces were headed by two of the most talented actors I have ever seen even though I'm just seeing them; Jonathan Roumie and Shaan Shamar
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/PC3WP9Dhk9QAAAAC/the-chosen-shmuel.gif)
The epic aspect of this show is to be appreciated too, although I guess that's just how the story is in the Bible too 😂 
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/2fC6OkQwxu8AAAAC/the-chosen-os-escolhidos.gif)
What this series did is to bring the events of the Bible into something of a visual understanding for Christians and non-christians alike.
It's theological, mostly religious, yet still, factually historical and that is what makes it feel so real.

![17814800406899179935437221552270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/EqBf4aoqRoP3szBWDfonni2tjYqyRcbVoUAR1Rpw8wJfjD9juTmdjDionzzGEQkivWg.jpg)

body.title: Murderous Trials
body.body:
***Original Poem***

![1000029841.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhshrooms/EoCfmk2rQqGRAdnHhnYAjQe1C9G4ZKhjbe3cpZ9ZU2jV34TkYMNX44J9gCWoUkusiWq.png)


Interstellar travels on rewind
The dimensions of the mind
Sins as heaven's entrance to the kind
I'm numb, from the cold of the blind

Intersections of crimes that defy
The logic of the people that lie
Humanity and his intelligence of an animal but never asks why
The ironic potential of their cry

It strikes the soul
Hitting like a boxer with a goal
Keep the emptyness of the toll
Burn the bodies beneath the coal

Hysterical
I'm lost among the miracle
Alone to face my Pentacle 
The return of the pinnacle

The weight of acceptance
Burns along the fence
And I, walk among its coals with a lance
Killing my targets with a glance

Death before the play
The chance of the day
The promise you never say
And the actions that was suffered inside my decay

It's absurd
To live among the herd
When you constantly facing the bird
Conflicting from the burning firb

Bathing, in the word of the spiritual
Evading, the corralled sacrificial ritual
The painting of the habitual
Telling us what is mutual

Yet. I'm. Consumed.
Vultures, pecking at what's assumed
The infringeness of the fumed
Starved from truth as they become marooned

I'm stretched across the miles
The sharks giving their smiles
Undaring to approach against the files
As I write down the murderous trials

And now it's official
The reality of world is screaming artificial
The ending as clear as an illuminated fascial
The vastness of perspective is spacial

But for now we're swimming in the aquarium
Free to leave but only through delirium 
Meanwhile my tongue cuts like obsidian
As demons bleed at the medium

***

昨天是周六，大学同学中午在微信群里发消息说晚上出去聚聚。刚看到这条消息我内心是拒绝的，虽然已经一年没有见面了，但其实见面也没啥好聊的。但去年有一次聚会原本说好了去，结果我临时有事没有去成，相当于放了鸽子，心里有些愧疚。这次不去有些说不过去，于是我一口答应下来。下午我把孩子送到奶奶家，晚上6点多我先回趟家，考虑到吃烤肉难免弄脏衣服，于是我回去换了一件衣服再前往烤肉地方。

到了后几个同学也刚刚到，点了一些烤串，几盘菜，我和其中一个同学又点了两瓶啤酒，其实我平常压根不喝啤酒，也不喜欢喝，只是和同学好久不见面了才多少喝一些，并且现在是夏天非常热，喝些冰啤酒解热。大家还是聊工作生活中的事情，免不了聊到孩子，毕竟都已经为人父母了。过了一会其中一位同学的老婆也过来了，说是不想在家里和孩子怄气，又过了一会可能孩子自己在家没有意思，也过来了。

同事家的孩子上初中，正值青春期有些叛逆可以理解。据说怄气原因是想玩手机游戏，同学又不给玩因此产生了矛盾。其实这位同学的孩子是学霸，去年刚刚考入市里乃至省里数一数二的重点中学，简直就是现实中”别人家的孩子“。我们给孩子支了个招，手机游戏不是不能玩，要知道控制时间。比如规定玩10分钟，到时间后马上关闭手机，不能有一秒拖延，如果做得到就可以玩，否则就是沉迷手机游戏，一周内不能再玩。

body.title: The Failed Disruption: Why Stablecoins Abandoned the Crypto Revolution to Become Idle Cash for Wall Street
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPBWQCi62h3Hs85JtJwP5BYeQDWs4KTUGQcspg7NygkCa/stablecoin.png 


The original thesis of decentralized consensus was rooted in systematic financial disintermediation. Stablecoins were engineered to be the programmatic execution layer of this doctrine—a friction-free, censorship-resistant medium of exchange capable of bypassing the architectural bottlenecks and rent-seeking infrastructure of traditional banking. However, a rigorous structural audit of contemporary macroeconomic data reveals an undeniable anomaly: stablecoins have abandoned their revolutionary trajectory to become nothing more than digitized instruments of idle capital, functioning as back-end liquidity providers for the very legacy systems they claimed they would destroy.

Let’s look at the hard evidence and decision support data. The aggregate market capitalization of top-tier stablecoins sits at historic highs, yet velocity metrics tell a completely different story. The vast majority of this capital is not circulating within the real-world economy, nor is it actively driving Web3 commerce. Instead, it remains entirely static. Corporate issuers like Tether and Circle have built highly lucrative business models by absorbing user deposits, minting digital tokens, and immediately recycling that fiat capital back into traditional financial instruments—predominantly short-term U.S. Treasury bills yielding upwards of 5%.

From a systems-thinking viewpoint, this is the ultimate capitalist capture. The issuers reap billions in risk-free yield from treasury interest, while the end-users bear 100% of the smart contract and counterparty risks without receiving a single basis point of the revenue generated. The stablecoin ecosystem has effectively transformed into an unregulated, shadow-banking pipeline that channels decentralized liquidity straight back into sovereign debt markets.

Furthermore, the narrative that stablecoins act as tools for global financial inclusion is heavily flawed. While they do offer a temporary hedge against local currency devaluation in emerging markets, they remain fundamentally anchored to the U.S. dollar, thereby exporting American monetary policy globally. In developed nations, they are used almost exclusively as speculative staging capital—idle cash parked in digital vaults, waiting for market volatility to clear so traders can rotationally re-enter high-risk crypto positions. If a medium of exchange fails to facilitate micro-transactions and everyday commerce, it ceases to function as currency; it becomes a speculative tool. Web3 investors must stop conflating market cap expansion with genuine utility. Until stablecoins break free from their dependency on legacy yield structures and integrate natively into mainstream retail logistics, they remain a subservient extension of Wall Street.

Source : [coindesk.com](https://www.coindesk.com/opinion/2026/06/13/stablecoins-were-meant-to-disrupt-finance-instead-they-became-idle-cash)

In total, I had a good number available to open and search for these elusive letters. |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7faSM5axPmvzSPAYrbhW2u3E5iA2hqYGmnrwTEeD23L/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvH2xQ9UvpPYYPAAJs4G5L2V45rk17M7TpFtCo1L26Hi/image.png)| |------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNbxW19ivN2CcjUZz8ecwA4Ko94wA9APc1Y7J2SK8pX2U/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTba6LuRq7hVfz1gQFYYuHSkYkAMy19xxnZbUZxRSnJL1/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYYPQa9b2oDtEN5bveviX2AdErHy7tMZx7hA8xMwf3pX/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRuEZzsbaJYmLTw6KVw7PUF425CLWwW3znLAoMGBnEky/image.png)| |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyjqimavo1fckt4yKJ6LEB76NC6yq6Tfq69iY6isLsxv/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUTaBX7rKBt2TAeVfLhUUotDCNWwtP3XstUHqkYuvDML/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUgQHMUQAVBuEiYsBrzZgAyhYEJkM4oU342UdsZbci56m/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9ZiaVkBVGLSVCcw4oY4LVrsTU2Gs9TuiBpwggd3Ynh5/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThVvQqBw4oa7LhBC1mmaMDhbNNWTdwhJPkdSyehh1qgr/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9b8viZieU8cTfyE4WuivyDfVxUrQKp11cba4RMfDk5B/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWdnhoFEvUDrGBxUV6BdinZxHQ1SrtmHwrWsDKUdKugv/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcXv3tQNi4C9dMP6fbxqvHYdyJb3hnkrwxZY8hCTQcfsu/image.png)| |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPi28f9QqB3RMAY3gRnjpD7ygU8tAESj5hq1BMwfKtcqn/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZmoJDLivbNLZQNKnfD6WB1cKYXDaBadBfe5RL5YTfMD/image.png)| In the end I found good cards; among them were copies of each archon, some golden cards, others legendary and epic. These copies I received help me move forward in my goal of completing the set. But now, I tell you what are the cards that level up. --- Completing the section of common cards with Grand Consul Minion, now it will only be a plus if I find any common card in its golden version.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQgiLS56n8z3o9ncbA79ibPSeYuKVyddzeXandzC7BYSh/image.png)
--- Moors Malik is one of the rare cards that was on hold to level up; I hadn't had any luck with his copies since the year came out.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvBeuPZtWJsCyAF9A93UcxhNSkdL3H3e1kqF91mDkWXa/image.png)
---- So far the epic cards are the ones I've encountered the least; I had better luck with the legendary ones and it's a pleasure to be able to add one more to complete these cards. Ash Archer: With this card I complete the epic fire cards to the maximum.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXt3vPh4i6oefi9M378LDEHppDwrtoAAjWcXgftVxpf9J/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Gladius

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Lately I have only opened Gladius packs from time to time, I was participating in the Brawls and I was accumulating the Merits in the meantime. I currently have like 80k merits and I wasn't combining any cards; however, I can't leave these in oblivion and I must try to add some of my interest. |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQesuKqAUHkEgFNF86Cv1hgvTdVDp2YDfYUqNRQxKx9ni/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMvDGzJCg53NUgGP9BSqRSCv73j4122EqDLoDQnAj6TA/image.png)| |------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRQmEMoQsZm9nF3EUiNjWRRi3WyMZTBXB4gdbeUnxudaW/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSq9wPpXAvbY8QbYuWq4doyupYC9naL5cGKXGgn6htaD/image.png)| I opened a few packs, I only ended up finding one epic and generally just regular copies. I was interested in finding some legendary, especially the legendary one of the life element, Sola Ranjell (nothing I find it). --- But hey, my progress on the Gladius cards is as follows in its regular version: - The common cards are between levels 5 and 6. Chimney Wallstop, Krash Wanderford, Alva the Crusher, Isgald Vorst and Katrelba Gobson are my favorites; I usually use them more regularly.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbd6qsq86n19yYpgjmLNmXnYUWYuRzg46kmqGKZrG2mYV/image.png)
- Rare cards are between levels 4 and 5. Orella Abadon, Relenor Cleaver, Palidon Rakk, Captain Katie and Liza Fox were the cards I wanted to have at level 4 for their power and abilities.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmccPQjB8gEGxN9QVZmCUtsYcP611RvozteuZiwjxU9rUY/image.png)
- The epic cards are between level 3. Quora and Marisol are my favorite warriors in the Survival format, apart from using the elf Edith in some battles.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoQEZmwGcRjqFG5e4WfsgYfarbhRaq1r6sJedkLZD6FC/image.png)
- Legendary cards are still dominated by level 1 and only the legendary Fina is at level 2. Fina, Flagulon, Xulax and Tatiana are my favorite cards, especially Fina and Xulax.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVgSi2UwGE9BCiFmAKDbERmgjzEh5V68UfeLcbEmJzutP/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> I have made progress in my goal of completing the Foundations set, leaving aside the Extra cards. I'm missing eight epic warriors, one legendary warrior (Giam Root) and the archon Incessant Sage. I'm almost sure that it will take me a while to complete it, although I might sell some copies that I have left over; I want to try to complete it with the packs that I win. On the other hand, as for the extra copies, there is a possibility that I will have to buy them, since I have only found Aimee. As for the Gladius cards, I could keep adding copies of the cards little by little and increasing the level of them. Especially looking for legendary copies and the elusive Ranjell Alone. Since these are soulbound, I have to be patient to complete them. ---- Currently I have a doubt: will they bring any changes to the Brawls and Gladius cards in the future or will it just stay the same? It would be nice if they thought of some update that surprises us. -----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Estamos prácticamente a mitad del mes de junio; la temporada actual está por terminar. Lo considero un buen momento para compartir mi progreso completando las cartas del set Foundations al nivel máximo y a la vez compartir un poco sobre mi progreso algo estancado con el set Gladius. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Foundations

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Una de mis publicaciones anteriores de la anterior temporada había mencionado cuáles eran las cartas del set Foundations que no tenía al nivel máximo: un guerrero común (Grand Consul Minion), un guerrero raro (Moros Malik), nueve guerreros épicos, un guerrero legendario (Giam Root) y el más importante, el arconte Incessant Sage. Durante la actual temporada no abrí ningún pack; decidí acumular todos los que conseguí ganar en estos días. En total, tenía un buen número disponible para abrir y buscar estas cartas tan esquivas. |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7faSM5axPmvzSPAYrbhW2u3E5iA2hqYGmnrwTEeD23L/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvH2xQ9UvpPYYPAAJs4G5L2V45rk17M7TpFtCo1L26Hi/image.png)| |------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNbxW19ivN2CcjUZz8ecwA4Ko94wA9APc1Y7J2SK8pX2U/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTba6LuRq7hVfz1gQFYYuHSkYkAMy19xxnZbUZxRSnJL1/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYYPQa9b2oDtEN5bveviX2AdErHy7tMZx7hA8xMwf3pX/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRuEZzsbaJYmLTw6KVw7PUF425CLWwW3znLAoMGBnEky/image.png)| |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyjqimavo1fckt4yKJ6LEB76NC6yq6Tfq69iY6isLsxv/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUTaBX7rKBt2TAeVfLhUUotDCNWwtP3XstUHqkYuvDML/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUgQHMUQAVBuEiYsBrzZgAyhYEJkM4oU342UdsZbci56m/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9ZiaVkBVGLSVCcw4oY4LVrsTU2Gs9TuiBpwggd3Ynh5/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThVvQqBw4oa7LhBC1mmaMDhbNNWTdwhJPkdSyehh1qgr/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9b8viZieU8cTfyE4WuivyDfVxUrQKp11cba4RMfDk5B/image.png)| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWdnhoFEvUDrGBxUV6BdinZxHQ1SrtmHwrWsDKUdKugv/image.png)| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcXv3tQNi4C9dMP6fbxqvHYdyJb3hnkrwxZY8hCTQcfsu/image.png)| |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPi28f9QqB3RMAY3gRnjpD7ygU8tAESj5hq1BMwfKtcqn/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZmoJDLivbNLZQNKnfD6WB1cKYXDaBadBfe5RL5YTfMD/image.png)| Al final encontré buenas cartas; entre ellas se encontraban copias de cada arconte, algunas cartas doradas, otras legendarias y épicas. Estas copias que recibí me ayudan a avanzar en mi objetivo de completar el set. Pero ahora bien, les cuento cuáles son las cartas que ascienden de nivel. --- Completando el apartado de cartas comunes con Grand Consul Minion, ahora solo será un plus si encuentro cualquier carta común en su versión dorada.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQgiLS56n8z3o9ncbA79ibPSeYuKVyddzeXandzC7BYSh/image.png)
--- Moros Malik es una de las cartas raras que estaba en espera para subir de nivel; no había tenido suerte con sus copias desde que salió el año.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvBeuPZtWJsCyAF9A93UcxhNSkdL3H3e1kqF91mDkWXa/image.png)
---- Hasta ahora las cartas épicas son las que menos me he encontrado; había tenido mejor suerte con las legendarias y es un gusto poder ir sumando una más para completar estas cartas. Ash Archer: Con esta carta completo las cartas épicas de fuego al máximo.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXt3vPh4i6oefi9M378LDEHppDwrtoAAjWcXgftVxpf9J/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Gladius

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Últimamente solo he abierto de vez en cuando packs Gladius, participaba en las Brawls e iba acumulando los Méritos mientras tanto. Actualmente tengo como 80k méritos y no estaba combinando ninguna carta; sin embargo, no puedo dejar estas en el olvido y debo intentar sumar algunas de mi interés. |![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQesuKqAUHkEgFNF86Cv1hgvTdVDp2YDfYUqNRQxKx9ni/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMvDGzJCg53NUgGP9BSqRSCv73j4122EqDLoDQnAj6TA/image.png)| |------------|------------| | ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRQmEMoQsZm9nF3EUiNjWRRi3WyMZTBXB4gdbeUnxudaW/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSq9wPpXAvbY8QbYuWq4doyupYC9naL5cGKXGgn6htaD/image.png)| Abrí unos pocos packs, solo terminé encontrando una épica y, en general, solo copias regulares. Me interesaba encontrar alguna legendaria, en especial la legendaria del elemento vida, Sola Ranjell (nada que la encuentro). --- Pero bueno, mi progreso en las cartas Gladius es el siguiente en su versión regular: - Las cartas comunes están entre los niveles 5 y 6. Chimney Wallstop, Krash Wanderford, Alva the Crusher, Isgald Vorst y Katrelba Gobson son mis favoritas; suelo usarlas más habitualmente.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbd6qsq86n19yYpgjmLNmXnYUWYuRzg46kmqGKZrG2mYV/image.png)
- Las cartas raras están entre los niveles 4 y 5. Orella Abadon, Relenor Cleaver, Palidon Rakk, Captain Katie y Liza Fox fueron las cartas que quería tener en el nivel 4 por su poder y habilidades.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmccPQjB8gEGxN9QVZmCUtsYcP611RvozteuZiwjxU9rUY/image.png)
- Las cartas épicas están entre el nivel 3. Quora y Marisol son mis guerreros favoritos en el formato Survival, aparte de usar en algunas batallas a la elfa Edith.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoQEZmwGcRjqFG5e4WfsgYfarbhRaq1r6sJedkLZD6FC/image.png)
- En las cartas legendarias sigue predominando el nivel 1 y solo la legendaria Fina se encuentra en el nivel 2. Fina, Flagulon, Xulax y Tatiana son mis cartas favoritas, en especial Fina y Xulax.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVgSi2UwGE9BCiFmAKDbERmgjzEh5V68UfeLcbEmJzutP/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> He avanzado en mi objetivo de completar el set Foundations, dejando de lado las cartas Extra. Me faltan ocho guerreros épicos, un guerrero legendario (Giam Root) y el arconte Incessant Sage. Estoy casi seguro de que me tomará un tiempo completarlo, aunque podría vender algunas copias que me sobran; quiero intentar completarlo con los packs que gano. Por otro lado, en cuanto a las copias extra, esas sí existe la posibilidad de que tenga que comprarlas, ya que solo me he encontrado a Aimee. En cuanto a las cartas Gladius, podría seguir sumando de a poco copias de las cartas e ir aumentando el nivel de ellas. En especial buscando copias legendarias y a la esquiva Sola Ranjell. Ya que estas son soulbound, tengo que ser paciente para completarlas. ---- Actualmente tengo una duda: ¿será que en un futuro traerán algún cambio a las Brawls y a las cartas Gladius o solo seguirá igual? Sería bueno que pensaran en alguna actualización que nos sorprenda. -----

> Muchas gracias a los que leen mis publicaciones y muchas gracias por sus votos o comentarios. En el siguiente enlace podrás unirte al juego y conocer este fantástico mundo: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99). Espero verlos pronto en un Challenge contando sus batallas y experiencias. Nota: Esta publicación no es un consejo de inversión; realicen sus propias investigaciones. ___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxXswzbWQTYK9VKwK2Wy5BQfQUwDKD8c2TK4EK89eWbb/image.png)
![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uFMJtwBYqobHGRfKciFJvEUovh86N3Qbweq2XJqMVxibXhLkqGtxyReVgTmL1Kqs5mU.gif)

body.title: Mis gatos soportando el calor
body.body:
>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/244KP6mPhKXvxNfH56UbMBLjg9s1TjaJgnahUH614RGWoK7ymA9aPaaagKdhxReN4TuUg.jpg
</center>

Saludos amantes de las mascotas, aquí en  el estado en donde vivió volvió el calor insoportable, a pesar de que hasta hace pocos días atrás parecía que vendrían lluvias esto no pasó de ser un alegría en vano, aunque me contó una amiga que en su estado su hubo bastante lluvia, el clima de mi ciudad es semiárido y ya regresamos al calor habitual, pero por mucho que nuestro clima sea siempre así nunca nos acostumbramos del todo, porque cada año parece estar más caliente y es más difícil lidiar con la situación, sobre todo para las mascotas.

> Greetings fellow pet lovers! Here in my state, the unbearable heat has returned. Even though it seemed like rain was on the way just a few days ago, it was a false hope. A friend told me that her state had quite a bit of rain, though. My city has a semi-arid climate, and we're back to our usual heat. But even though our climate is always like this, we never really get used to it, because every year it seems to get hotter, and it's harder to deal with the situation, especially for pets.

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/2458NMZN1aTrWSXKQFkEDRftqSRDVcjTkC8Gni4yoTyNVzvmjZfBPiWVqUJr5T98zwaLJ.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Mis pobre gatos ya no encuentran ni donde echarse, buscan cualquier lugar de la casa que les permita tener menos calor, se duermen pegados a las paredes internas de la casa buscando que estas este un poco mas frías, se arriman al tanque de agua en busca de lo mismo, también se acuestan en el piso del baño y también han hecho las maceteros su nuevas camas, basta con que mi mamá riegue las plantas en la mañana para ellos de inmediato ocupen su lugar, pero el clima esta tan seco que la tierra absorbe el agua casi de inmediato y la frescura no dura mucho, aun así ellos tratan de soportar lo mejor que pueden.

> My poor cats can't even find a place to lie down anymore. They look for any spot in the house that will let them cool down. They sleep pressed against the interior walls, hoping they'll be a little cooler. They snuggle up to the water tank for the same reason. They also lie on the bathroom floor, and they've even made the flowerpots their new beds. All it takes is for my mom to water the plants in the morning for them to immediately take their place. But the weather is so dry that the soil absorbs the water almost instantly, and the coolness doesn't last long. Even so, they try to endure it as best they can.

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23tvnpxbrEWpDCBwvUeTyCFKVqr1hqssNiKfU46P4LfY84ow6c3j6oz1Qeq6bFRifFBae.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Yo por mi parte les tengo envases de agua en diversas zonas de la casa a las cuales procuro cambiar el agua varias veces al día para que esté fresca, pues si se deja el agua en el suelo por mucho tiempo esta se pondrá muy caliente, lamentablemente no tengo aires acondicionados en la casa así que no hay un ambiente en que los gatos puedan refugiarse del calor, mi temor es que se sigan elevando las temperaturas porque en agosto es el mes mas caluroso y si estamos ya asándonos no me quiero imaginar dentro de dos meses, espero que mis gatos no sufran tanto este año.

> For my part, I keep containers of water in various areas of the house, and I try to change the water several times a day to keep it fresh. If the water is left on the floor for too long, it gets very hot. Unfortunately, I don't have air conditioning in the house, so there's no place for the cats to escape the heat. My fear is that the temperatures will continue to rise because August is the hottest month, and if we're already sweltering, I don't want to imagine what it will be like in two months. I hope my cats don't suffer too much this year.

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKVWX1dHdEnsKF5pmtt8xdEhfLNcwCD7A8peyYcFG17Gzse2nV46iathfmaYGd7.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>





<div class=\

>
https://i.imgur.com/Ho6tDfz.png

Les invito a leer mis próximas publicaciones y siempre estaré dispuesta a responder sus preguntas y comentarios, también pueden seguirme y contactarme en cualquiera de mis redes sociales. ¡Muchas gracias! > ##### I hope you liked it. Feliz domingo!✨ Hoy vengo contenta a contar por aquí mi experiencia en esta nueva ruta que amé! 

Para empezar, no estaba segura si ir, pero finalmente me convencí, ya que es una ruta diferente a lo que normalmente se hace en Caracas, mi hermano quería hacerla junto a mi sobrino, mi amiga Nico sería pacer y su mami también haría la carrera y muchos otros del Team a los que les tengo mucho cariño. 

A mí en principio me tocaba hacer 10K suaves, sin embargo, cuando me enteré de que Nico sería Pacer de 1:00 Hr, le pregunté a mi entrenador si sería muy loco intentar hacer la ruta con ella y su respuesta fue \

. Yo estaba consciente de que la ruta era dura y que hacer esa ruta y esa distancia a lo que es mi Tempo ahorita que estoy retomando, sería todo un reto para medirme. También sabía que dependiendo de cómo me sintiera, ahí veria si mantenerme con ella o solo dejarla ir y ajustar un poco con tal de llegar bien, sin presionarme.

Finalmente, esto fue lo que pasó: 
Estuve con Nico, mi hermano, mi sobrino y otra amiga del Team (Vicky) durante los primeros 2K ♥️. Debido al desnivel y cómo me iba sintiendo de exhigida, decidí dejarla ir en ese punto y ajustar un poco el ritmo con el objetivo de no quemarme y administrarme para llegar bien a meta, así que poco a poco ella se fue alejando con mi hermano y mi sobrino, mientras que Vicky solo decidió quedarse a mi lado a acompañarme y convertirse en mi pacer oficial de esta carrera, lo cual amé 😍. Luego del km 4 pasó lo más duro 😮‍💨, así que ahí me empecé a soltar un poco más e ir retomando el ritmo y recuperando ✨. Como por el km 8 comencé a ver nuevamente a Nico a lo muy lejos, eso me dijo \

, cabe acotar que traté en lo posible de no mirar el reloj para ver cómo iba mi ritmo promedio. Y como resultado: llegué en 1 hora con 1 minutico y un poco más vs esa hora que quería intentar 🥹.

Así que no salió nada mal para estar retomando de nuevo. Esto no se acerca ni un poco a mi PR en 10K, pero vamos poco a poco volviendo, sin forzarla y disfrutando 🙌🏻. 

Si duda hoy fue un bonito día y yo me sentí muy bien y muy feliz ❤️‍🩹.

Espero que si hiciste esta ruta, te haya ido muy bien y la hayas amado tanto como yo, estuvo increíble aprovechar esta ruta para recorrer el centro de Caracas ✨.

body.title: 😋🍕Delicious pita or Arabic bread pizza. / Deliciosa pizza de pan pita o árabe.😋🍕 (Esp/Eng).
body.body:
>Dear friends in my #HiveFood community, I hope you’re all having a great day. One of the things that defines us as a family is that on Sundays, my sister and I get together at our mother’s house to spend time together; beforehand, we agree on what each of us will bring to prepare. We had decided to make pizzas with pita bread, also known as Arabic bread, and without any hassle, we used the ingredients we already had to make the pizzas our way. I’ll tell you that the sauce was leftovers from some pizzas that had been made earlier. Another important detail to note is that we used a skillet with a lid instead of the oven. That improvisation paid off because the pita bread, being thin and topped with ingredients, is easy to prepare: you just have to wait for the cheese to brown, and it’s ready to eat. Without further ado, here are the details of the preparation

>Apreciados amigos de mi comunidad #HiveFood, espero que se encuentren disfrutando de un gran día. Una de las cosas que nos caracterizan como familia es que los domingos nos reunimos en la casa materna, mi hermana y yo, para compartir; previamente nos ponemos de acuerdo en qué vamos a llevar para preparar. Habíamos elegido preparar pizzas con pan pita o árabe, como también se le conoce, y sin ninguna complicación dispusimos de los ingredientes que ya teníamos para preparar las pizzas a nuestra manera. Les cuento que la salsa era un sobrante de unas pizzas que se habían preparado con anterioridad. Otro detalle importante que acotar es que usamos una sartén con tapa y no el horno. Esa improvisación valió la pena porque el pan pita por ser delgado junto a los ingredientes; es de fácil preparación: solo hay que esperar a que el queso se gratine y listo para comer. Sin más nada, paso a dar los detalles de la preparación. #

***INGREDIENTES / INGREDIENTS***
* 6 pita or Arabic breads. * Pizza sauce. Homemade. * White cheese. * Coarsely shredded ham. * Strips of red bell pepper. * Butter. * Stuffed olives. >* 6 unidades de pan pita o árabe. >* Salsa para pizza. Preparación casera. >* Queso blanco. >* Jamón rallado con la parte gruesa. >* Tiras de pimentón rojo. >* Mantequilla. >* Aceitunas rellenas.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR2tbrDUQAxz77LZZWigVp77xcCK4fU4Hs9oqtH9m1uA4/image.png)
#
***PREPARATION / PREPARACIÓN***
* Spread a layer of pizza sauce on the pita bread. >* Untar una capa de salsa para pizza en el pan pita.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTX2mnimxApuU3CUok6KmH2sEj1PdJthebJJ9im6W4dnr/image.png)
* Next, spread a generous layer of cheese, followed by a layer of shredded ham, then add the olives and strips of red bell pepper. >* Luego, colocar una capa generosa de queso, otra de jamón rallado, agregar las aceitunas y las tiras de pimentón rojo.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf2zuEbvDq1AnFTpN32R5MosUSXy5HLSpLjE3JujvN3vN/image.png)
* Place the skillet over low heat, wipe it with a napkin dipped in butter, add the pizza, cover it, and wait for the cheese to brown. >* Colocar el sartén a fuego lento, con una servilleta impregnada de mantequilla y pasar por el sartén, colocar la pizza, tapar y esperar a que el queso se gratine.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWfpcx7sU7vr5rxKYgR93p6pJbbHqrQZoxSwvqugtUXJg/image.png)
AND THAT'S IT!!! * Delicious pita bread pizzas, my way. Let me tell you, they're easy and quick to make for dinner—and they're spectacular. You can mix and match whatever ingredients you have on hand. Plus, if you like, you can add a pinch of oregano. We made 6 pita bread pizzas to share with the family. >Y LISTO!!! >* Unas ricas pizzas de pan pita a mi manera. Les cuento que son fáciles, rápidas de hacer para resolver una cena; son espectaculares. Puedes combinar los ingredientes que tengas a la mano. Además, si es tu gusto, le agregas una pizca de orégano. Para el compartir familiar preparamos 6 pizzas de pan pita.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX5oV9uTg6Lcfy72qaTB8ZbvS7UtLwrhax4dGeYQDu1fi/image.png)
* Now it's time to enjoy this delicious pita bread pizza. 😋 >* Ahora a saborear la rica pizza de pan pita. 😋

body.title: Todos somos buenos en algo, aunque no sepamos en qué. | We are all good at something, even if we don't know what it is. 📚🔎 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
##### Todos somos buenos en algo, aunque no sepamos en qué. ![1000056204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQriJHQzWqipSbZyTcKW9KXXWT6YfGU5Qw2Vwz2L2wKg4g4vtUoujH6jAGy3LaULGJs.jpg)
[fuente](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-libros-libreria-en-pie-17461472/) Hola amigos, espero que se encuentren muy bien. He estado pensando mucho en la forma en la que a veces nos volvemos nuestro propio muro de limitaciones. Llevo días pensando en que soy una persona muy mala para recordar ciertas cosas, sobre todo si son temas que nunca he estudiado o leído. Algunas personas me dicen que soy muy buena recordando, sobre todo si tiene que ver con cosas como fechas, películas, momentos del pasado. Pero realmente me cuesta acostumbrarme a temas que sean desconocidos para mí. Siento que a todos les ha pasado alguna vez que intentan y se esfuerzan por aprender algo nuevo y no les sale bien por más empeño que pongan, eso me sucede a menudo, sobre todo porque me limito a decir que si no sirvió mi esfuerzo en el primer intento, entonces no vale mucho la pena seguir intentándolo. Aunque es una contradicción también, porque soy bastante terca, y esto en algunas ocasiones me ha permitido salir adelante sin saber cómo ni cuando, pero he logrado salir de momentos difíciles aunque mi mente me diga lo contrario o aunque pensaba que no podría soportar la situación. En el colegio recuerdo que era muy buena para los idiomas y también para el área de la escritura. Me gustaba muchísimo ver las materias de inglés y castellano, eran de mis preferidas y en donde mejor salía cuando me daban el boletín con las notas. Pero si que me costaba aprender cosas como de historia, matemáticas o química. Eran materias que no me llamaban la atención pero tenía la obligación de pasarlas aunque fuese de manera obligada. Entonces eso me recuerda que tal vez no soy muy buena en algunas cosas, como aprender temas que no son de mi interés o que nunca he leído. Pero si soy buena para otras cosas. ![1000056205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23zGkf6F9XjtEGtZjKHDkMgNJnVFjtZBHYK9ovUKTRs5KjEt8JwVcRYgQKdAWnqUp6wCy.jpg)
[fuente](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/libros-biblioteca-educacion-universidad-19685635/) Las limitaciones nos pueden llegar a hacer sentir como que vamos más lento, que no podremos con el peso de las responsabilidades que tenemos. Pero, pienso que es mejor intentarlo aunque tengamos dudas, que quedarnos con la simple idea de que no somos buenos en nada. Yo llego a pensar mucho en cómo podré aprender tantas cosas que necesito estudiar dentro de mi carrera, que llego a un punto donde me siento abrumada. Sin embargo, se que siempre hay oportunidades, hay personas que nos apoyan y que nos impulsan, además también creen en nosotros. Y si ellos lo hacen, porque nosotros no podríamos creer también en nuestras capacidades. Tal vez mi problema más grande es siempre sentir la inseguridad o el temor a ser tomada como ejemplo de lo que no se debe hacer. Pienso que los profesores están haciendo un muy buen trabajo dentro de tantas dificultades que se viven diariamente dentro de mi país, y que eso vale mucho, así que lo mejor que puedo hacer antes de preocuparme es recordarme que si antes pude con cosas que se me hacían imposibles de realizar o estuve en situaciones donde creía que no podría salir de allí ilesa. Entonces debo darme las oportunidades que sean necesarias, porque nadie nace sabiéndolo todo y se que siempre es necesario practicar hasta lograr lo que se desea aprender. Saber que hay cosas que puedo hacer me hace sentir más segura, y reconocer que hay otras en las que debo trabajar, me permite aprender a reconocer que en la vida siempre estaremos en constante movimiento y aprendizaje. Todos los días aprendemos algo de nuestro entorno y también de las personas con las que nos cruzamos. Quiero ser más consciente de la manera en la que me hablo y de la forma en la que recuerdo esos momentos donde pensé que no podría o que sería muy díficil y aún así seguí caminando, con dificultad pero seguí adelante. De eso se trata la vida y también de vivir un día a la vez. ![1000036591.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5GGWRAFPwDXXLBARiEGCJUDCp6CAFD1qEsgMuUe5Dt9qDVjRNtfAfJkxbVS266n9.png) ##### We are all good at something, even if we don't know what it is. ![1000056204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQriJHQzWqipSbZyTcKW9KXXWT6YfGU5Qw2Vwz2L2wKg4g4vtUoujH6jAGy3LaULGJs.jpg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-libros-libreria-en-pie-17461472/) Hello friends, I hope you are doing very well. I have been thinking a lot about the way we sometimes become our own wall of limitations. I've spent days thinking about how I am a very bad person at remembering certain things, especially if they are topics I have never studied or read about. Some people tell me that I am very good at remembering, especially when it comes to things like dates, movies, or moments from the past. But I really struggle to get used to subjects that are unfamiliar to me. I feel that it has happened to everyone at some point: you try and make an effort to learn something new, and it doesn't go well no matter how much dedication you put into it. That happens to me often, mostly because I limit myself by saying that if my effort didn't work on the first try, then it's not really worth it to keep trying. Though it's a contradiction too, because I am quite stubborn, and on some occasions, this has allowed me to move forward without knowing how or when. I have managed to get through difficult times even when my mind told me otherwise or when I thought I couldn't handle the situation. In school, I remember I was very good at languages and also in the writing department. I really loved taking English and Spanish classes; they were among my favorites and where I got the best results when I received my report card. But I did struggle to learn things like history, math, or chemistry. Those were subjects that didn't catch my attention, but I had the obligation to pass them, even if it felt forced. So that reminds me that maybe I'm not very good at some things, like learning topics that aren't of my interest or that I've never read about. But I *am* good at other things. ![1000056205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23zGkf6F9XjtEGtZjKHDkMgNJnVFjtZBHYK9ovUKTRs5KjEt8JwVcRYgQKdAWnqUp6wCy.jpg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/libros-biblioteca-educacion-universidad-19685635/) Limitations can make us feel like we are moving slower, or that we won't be able to handle the weight of the responsibilities we have. But I think it is better to try even if we have doubts, rather than staying with the simple idea that we are not good at anything. I often think so much about how I will be able to learn so many things that I need to study within my career that I reach a point where I feel overwhelmed. However, I know there are always opportunities; there are people who support us and push us forward, and they also believe in us. And if they do, why shouldn't we believe in our own capabilities too? Perhaps my biggest problem is always feeling insecure or fearing being taken as an example of what *not* to do. I think teachers are doing a very good job amidst so many difficulties experienced daily within my country, and that is worth a lot. So, the best thing I can do before worrying is to remind myself that if I could previously handle things that seemed impossible to do, or if I was in situations where I thought I wouldn't make it out unscathed, then I must give myself as many chances as necessary. Nobody is born knowing everything, and I know it is always necessary to practice until achieving what one wishes to learn. Knowing that there are things I can do makes me feel more confident, and recognizing that there are others I need to work on allows me to learn to acknowledge that in life, we will always be in constant motion and learning. Everyday we learn something from our environment and also from the people we cross paths with. I want to be more conscious of the way I speak to myself and the way I remember those moments where I thought I couldn't or that it would be too difficult, and yet I kept walking—with difficulty, but I kept moving forward. That is what life is about, and also about living one day at a time. ![1000036591.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5GGWRAFPwDXXLBARiEGCJUDCp6CAFD1qEsgMuUe5Dt9qDVjRNtfAfJkxbVS266n9.png)

body.title: The Boy Who Could Hear Lies 😲
body.body:
Nobody knew why Ken could hear lies.

Whenever someone lied, their voice sounded like two voices speaking at once.

At first, he thought everyone heard it.

One day, his teacher asked who had broken a classroom window.

A boy named Daniel stood up.

\

he said.

Immediately, Ken heard the second voice.

\

Kele pointed at Daniel.

The class laughed until Daniel confessed.

Years passed, and Ken became famous throughout the village.

People came from far away to seek his judgment.

Then one day, an old woman arrived.

\

she said.

For the first time, Ken heard no second voice.

But something frightened him.

The woman's shadow was missing.

That night, he could not sleep.

If she never lied, what exactly was she?

body.title: The Blue Meanie Talks About New Jack Crossing The Border Into Canada
body.body:
In this short YouTube clip, The Blue Meanie (then performing in ECW as Blue Boy) discusses in an interview about the time when New Jack appeared at ECW's first show in Canada. This show took place in September 2000 in Mississauga Ontario at the Hershey Centre.

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/UcGPn8FUC3Q

The shock was the assumption that New Jack would not be permitted to cross into Canada due to his then-already-existing criminal record in the United States. 

Should a wrestling promotion based in the United States ever be in a similar situation, running its first-ever show in Canada, then not only would the promoter & wrestler need to seek permission from the province in Canada such as through a Canadian immigration attorney - the promotion itself might be in legal jeopardy or incur financial fines. In such a case it is wise to seek a Canadian business law firm like [Substance Law](https://substancelaw.ca/) or similar firms.

Here are some topics related to this issue:

https://scholarlycommons.law.case.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=2026&context=cuslj

https://www.canadavisa.com/business-visitors-entertainment-industry.html

This would be in addition to factors like travel, paying any union labor and extra fees for venue bookings, currency rate fluctuations, and more.

body.title: Conquer the night sky with the Samsung Galaxy S10: A thrilling experience of astrophotography on a smartphone
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXKFCUJceQCiC7iFEWv5xEpABcE8nqWhZkfkiTmt9JwB2/polish_20260615_041210577.jpg)


Usually, my camera lens is more busy with macro photography, getting very close to nature and finding the fine details of insects or leaves. The joy of finding vastness in a small world is different. But sometimes the infinite sky above my head also attracts me strongly. The dark nights of our village are like a perfect canvas for this attraction. Being located far away from the intense light pollution of the city, the night sky here is full of stars. And to frame this wonderful beauty, I went out with my old yet very powerful device, the Samsung Galaxy S10. In today's post, I will share with you how I captured our galaxy or Milky Way with a simple smartphone.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQuXtcMHudCpW2MKSyhrDEiAWMJmrFzeFoU5Ew4nK6tFn/20260615_013830.jpg)

​Preparation and camera settings
​Taking astrophotography or taking pictures of the night stars on a smartphone is not like taking ordinary pictures. What is needed most here is steadiness and patience. The slightest hand shake can make the pictures of the stars become elongated or blurry. So first of all, I placed the phone very firmly on a tripod, so that it did not move even a hair.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma99hXQMcYeX1nKU3GKyr9NRcA2Zc9zCwrvryba23ajMc/20260615_015833.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcde8boLMJLzSBCqMpiP68vmSYGy4x9tYUrN8QXdB4Ytw/20260615_020002.jpg)

Since the S10 phone does not have a separate 'astro mode' like the latest phones of today, I had to use the Pro Mode of the default camera. For those who want to try taking such pictures with their phones, I am sharing my manual settings below:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXPdFCJvBjz5SspRkqs22QSNaPRX9EmUzRTqHUCWCM8b/20260615_012335.jpg)

​Focus: I moved the slider all the way to infinity using manual focus.

​Shutter Speed: I set the shutter speed to the maximum, i.e. 30 seconds (30s), to give the lens the time to capture the maximum amount of light.

​Aperture: I chose f/1.5 & f/2.4 aperture to allow the most light to enter in the darkness of the night.

​ISO: I kept it between 1600 and 4000 based on the darkness around.

​Timer: I set a 2-second timer so that the phone wouldn't shake even a little while I pressed the shutter button.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaAikbCg83Gv9NCDDivxhwTJNSqWvzmNkXqVDtZMd4pTK/20260615_013138.jpg)

​The waiting time and the first raw image (Raw Output)

Every 30 seconds of waiting after clicking the shutter button felt like an eternity. The pin-drop silence around and the silhouette of the dark trees created a very mysterious atmosphere. But when the first image appeared on the screen after processing, I was literally mesmerized. The image captured thousands of times more stars than the number of stars visible in the sky with the naked eye. Even a layer of our Milky Way galaxy, like a light haze of clouds, was clearly visible in the middle of the image. The black shadows or silhouettes of coconut and betel trees on one side of the frame made the vastness of the sky even more dramatic.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUfXcXQ14Qj8orfzpapKcQXQU7AbzUYC48XdDf2dXevys/20260615_015908.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY6pAvfiUz5q59qL16q6Ynmik2chxVpZS6rS5kWSBgDny/20260615_020115.jpg)

​However, smartphone sensors also have some limitations in taking pictures in such darkness. The high ISO resulted in a bit of graininess or 'color noise' in the raw images. In addition, the sky had a pale greenish tint instead of its usual dark or bluish hue.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRT88HLpay5jZVc85GUhmYQUEDorGdrtC1sTTBAxBW9eG/20260615_020150.jpg)

​The Magic of Adobe Lightroom

A raw astro image is like a diamond that needs to be polished to shine. I did this polishing with the Adobe Lightroom mobile app. My first challenge was to remove those annoying green specks from the images.

​I went to the Detail panel in Lightroom and turned up the Color Noise Reduction quite a bit. As if by magic, the specks in the sky disappeared and the image became completely smooth. Then, when I went to the Color panel and dragged the Tint slider towards a light magenta or purple, the greenish tint disappeared and the true, deep, and soothing appearance of the night sky emerged.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPQJpb12eVz3DXaR2sRRRgtrpxSZrKbBqJaVEEEW1dCQ/20260615_015718.jpg)

Finally, to make the sky a perfect black, I reduced the Blacks and Shadows values ​​to minus (around -30). This makes the sky background a solid black and the stars sparkle like diamonds on black velvet. I also slightly increased and decreased Dehaze and Clarity to make the cloud-like part of the galaxy clearer and clearer.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWe4qJ3FTTC9xfA49q5KWjrNj5JVU3rtiFvjvuAtyUTLM/20260615_020450.jpg)

​Last words
​The whole process - from standing in the pitch-black silence of the village to editing in Lightroom to seeing this final version of the image - was a strangely beautiful and exciting experience. This 'heaven-on-earth' difference between the raw image and the edited image proves that with the right manual settings and a little post-processing, it is possible to capture the infinite beauty of space with an old flagship phone.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVgmA4u86KjDhQUCnpnZ4kVKjomxSzsnEVQdN3uDXpxnY/20260615_020346.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPmmadFpYdKkgrpWdEcwwnFkpor222ipAw1RmwdQABWP/20260615_011435.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYBn9dWJY3MP4i82eXt4u5PWj77wc35wkd3MqwaH7fiEK/20260615_013742.jpg)

If you like night photography and want to participate in the competition, then quickly join the Night Photography Competition Round 2 under my management. Link: https://ecency.com/@mshbd/night-photography-competition-round-02

​I hope my experience will inspire you too. If you get a chance, you can also look at the dark sky with your smartphone, who knows, maybe you will catch an unknown constellation on your camera. Don't forget to tell us in the comments how you liked this change in the Before & After pictures.




(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)
