body.title: La Esperanza sola no Transforma -Del Impulso a la Acción- Resultados de la Iniciativa 24 de 7mo. Día… Y agradecimientos (ES/EN)
body.body:
<center>![baggeb-clouds-5264310_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wMeqG3faiEQShJGVW1tCqJzrSw4MmxYcmU143j4pKxVZqkdjehoCVwzQ54gMwHSxJZR.jpg)</center>

> *<center>[Pixabay-Baggeb; editada en Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/nubes-hombre-cielo-persona-orando-5264310/)</center>*

###### <center>*Durante un tiempo, lo que nos ha mantenido en Venezuela con las expectativas de algún tipo de cambio positivo ha sido la esperanza. En la **[Iniciativa No. 24 de Séptimo Día](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen)** quisimos hablar sobre este tema y que otros hablaran de ella desde sus experiencias.*</center>

###### <center>*Esta publicación tiene una visualización de **284 vistas**, lo que ya sabemos que es por conteo automático y que muchas veces no es tal cantidad de lectores; sin embargo, existen **46 comentarios** que, de por sí, hablan en forma orgánica de la necesidad que existe en nosotros de dar un aporte acerca de este tema que es vital hoy en día.*</center>


<center>![12019-man-1970609_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243WViuXLhBMvwGrJ29KXAtKHZ7ZwKGWd8343JPNCYKrv8T9rGCgNF91ZYgJ8EDEZzoQn.jpg)</center>
> *<center>[Pixabay-Free Use](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-playa-malibu-atardecer-1970609/)</center>*

<div class=\

> ###
La esperanza por sí sola no transforma
*Ciertamente, la esperanza no es suficiente; sí es necesaria, pero no gana la lucha, tal como decía **[Paulo Freire en la Pedagogía de la Esperanza](https://lasalleipa.edu.ar/pedagogia-de-la-esperanza-paulo-freire/)***. Y también, que la esperanza existe en una forma llamada crítica, que es la que nace y se nutre de las aguas contaminadas. *¿Qué significa esto?* Pues, que en espacios o momentos duros o difíciles, en los que se necesitan cambios y transformaciones, es cuando la esperanza se eleva como una abanderada de la acción. *[Y es que, como una necesidad ontológica, la esperanza debe ser práctica para volverse una historia concreta.](https://ipa-delasalle.org.ar/ipa_new/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/Paulo-Freire-Pedagog%C3%ADa-de-la-esperanza.pdf)* Ella nos invita a transformar, a tener un pensamiento crítico para cambiar el entorno o la situación que deseamos que exista en una mejor versión; por eso para **Freire** la desesperanza o la desesperación no lleva más que a combates de venganza. En cambio, la transformación, con esperanza crítica, nos lleva siempre al cambio y a la realización de una mejor historia.
![phamdinhan-river-7133713_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23w2qdbybmpj5zJN6NCY5SfCDFVzdZBDMUo6BJUKkt5hkoC7zFMvWjJBBce2PJ2tDyc64.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Phamdinhan](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/r%C3%ADo-bote-pescador-mortero-de-red-7133713/)
* ###
Esperanzas con actos
En los tantos comentarios hechos en la ***Iniciativa 24***, pude darme cuenta de que muchos de los venezolanos que participamos entendimos que los años de horror que hemos vivido, tal como nos dice @germanandradeg estuvieron señalados por la esperanza y necesidad de justicia. *Para mucha gente fuera, el venezolano no ha luchado en forma coherente según sus circunstancias, y hoy en día, hemos demostrado lo contrario. Nos hemos reunido, hemos protestado, hemos votado cuántas veces hemos creído que debimos votar, hemos salido a reunirnos en las calles, y siempre hemos perdido.* Era evidente, y hoy la realidad lo demuestra, que existía una organización superior completamente militarizada que impedía a la fuerza que cualquier acto en pro de una libertad respirable pudiese ser desplegado: ***Hubo necesidad de ayuda.*** @pedrobrito2004 nos recordó que sin la esperanza los eventos oscuros del mundo nos parecerían barreras impenetrables y que la depresión se establecería como algo constante; de lo que deriva que, por pura supervivencia, es necesario tener esperanza. *Esto parece mucho a lo que **Freire** decía sobre la esperanza ceñida desde la positividad y la crítica, no desde la rabia y la desesperación.* Muchas veces creemos que esperar lo posible es simple ceguera y locura, pero es en la acción y en la programación de las estrategias para lograr un beneficio cuando se demuestra que ella es un motor y no un sentimiento de espera. @issymarie2 dice que la esperanza es sinónimo de milagro; y yo también lo creo, porque impulsa motores hacia el cambio y es la voz interna que dice que, por más difícil que resulte una situación, es posible transformarla; y así sucede. Además, @jlat1412 piensa que la planificación, los recursos y las alianzas estructurales son las que hacen posible que la esperanza se dé en la práctica; y nos recuerda que, a pesar de que el 85% de los emprendimientos económicos en Latinoamérica llegan al fracaso, todos ellos se inician con la esperanza. *Lo que no es síntoma, por sí solo, del logro; pero es el comienzo de un acto liberador.*
![chanwity-fisherman-4305368_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EpJaVSpg2TLeLFsVLV6qwqub8LQpGGiDmcNMpc3N8ePtcCV6HHAgZdoduvgjEPTxKf7.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Chanwity](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/pescador-la-pesca-los-peces-bote-4305368/)
* ###
La esperanza y el cansancio
*Por último, entre tantas publicaciones, todas positivas y todas elevando la esperanza como motor necesario para cambiar y mejorar, también es importante señalar que a veces la esperanza se debilita.* Y esto me urge comentarlo, porque mucha gente piensa que hay esperanzas vanas debido a situaciones de espera que se tardan más de lo que creemos; sin embargo, en ese tiempo podemos lograr planificar, analizar y ejecutar con mayor precisión. El asunto es que muchos sienten que **[pierden la esperanza](https://confidencial.digital/opinion/la-esperanza-nunca-se-pierde/)** y hasta caen en situaciones de sufrimiento y sin opciones; y eso no es así. Cuando una persona se encuentra atrapada en situaciones complicadas que ameritan tiempo para transformarlas y salir adelante, termina cansada, creyendo que la esperanza se ha ido. ***Y no es así.*** El **[Dr. Ismael González en proparejas.com](https://www.proparejas.com/cuando-mejorar-no-es-suficiente-atrapada-entre-la-esperanza-la-duda-y-el-cansancio-emocional/)** nos pide reconocer que hay veces en que nos paralizamos, no como una falla personal, sino porque la situación puede ser agobiante y agota, y en esos casos debemos ser fríos en medir patrones de conductas más que escuchar frases prometedoras. Se debe trabajar en el descanso para recuperar claridad y explorar nuestros miedos en forma franca, aprovechando de evaluarnos para entender nuestra propia historia. Esto va a ayudarnos a recuperar el sentido de autovalía y autosuficiencia, porque el cansancio no nos puede hacer perder las perspectivas, como tampoco la capacidad de ver la luz al final de un túnel. *A veces, como la historia de Venezuela, la lucha dura años y puede que en un momento determinado **-y yo lo he vivido-**, sintamos que no vamos a salir adelante.* Pero debemos recordar que, con el **apoyo adecuado**, todos podemos dar ese paso y transformar, sea cual sea nuestra situación. Los seres humanos, como ha pasado en Venezuela, a veces necesitamos ayuda para poder cambiar lo que se debe cambiar, para lograr el equilibrio y la justicia.
*Recuerda que todavía podemos encontrar dirección cuando la emocionalidad se impone y el descanso es necesario.*
***Y que iniciativas como esta no solo nos unen, sino que nos proveen de drenaje para compartir nuestras herramientas, experiencias, nuestras historias y nuestra capacidad de estar unidos en una gran comunidad.***
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)
*Quisiera agradecer a todos los que participaron en esta dinámica: **[Nos Urge Hablar de la Esperanza: ¿Cómo la Cuidas y Alimentas? -Esta es La Iniciativa No. 24 en Domingo de Séptimo Día-](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen)**; y muy especialmente reconocer a @zulfrontado a @beaescribe quien desde fuera siempre nos ha hecho sentir que está junto a nosotros; a @germanandradeg y a @damelysh*
*Porque para ellos la esperanza es racional, pero generadora de gracia y de mucha fortaleza.*
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)
![Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23sxpS1Q7Em3rmjcYPVdABMA1wbuUxbioJH4CANxmgscisiVAEic5SZYS54NiUmbDb9Kv.png)
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)
![English in título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23t7hKjehKmQwZwL5yqYdUKuZTy2hyxiCfkRXmxQWpTuT5D1819NmeoindmgATcgGdxpb.png)
#
Hope Alone Does Not Bring About Change -From Motivation to Action- Results of the 7th Day Initiative 24… And Thanks
![inglés baggeb-clouds-5264310_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23wX3QurZY75sDFDnAmookW8u2sB8mUYfUzhnTDgGJzB7FKoHx7sPy4VKQKbLj1ZwBG65.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Baggeb; edited in Paint](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/nubes-hombre-cielo-persona-orando-5264310/)
* ######
*For some time now, what has kept us in Venezuela holding out hope for some kind of positive change has been hope itself. In the **[24th edition of Seventh Day Initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen)**, we wanted to discuss this topic and hear others speak about it based on their own experiences.*
######
*This post has **284 views**, which we know is based on an automatic count and often doesn’t reflect the actual number of readers; however, there are **46 comments** that, in and of themselves, organically speak to our need to contribute to this topic, which is vital today.*
![12019-man-1970609_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/243WViuXLhBMvwGrJ29KXAtKHZ7ZwKGWd8343JPNCYKrv8T9rGCgNF91ZYgJ8EDEZzoQn.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Free Use](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-playa-malibu-atardecer-1970609/)
*

> ###
Hope alone does not bring about change
*Certainly, hope is not enough; it is necessary, but it does not win the struggle, as Paulo Freire said in **[Pedagogy of Hope.](https://lasalleipa.edu.ar/pedagogia-de-la-esperanza-paulo-freire/)*** And also, that hope exists in a form known as “critical hope,” which is born and nourished from polluted waters. *What does this mean?* Well, it means that in harsh or difficult times and places, where change and transformation are needed, that is when hope rises as a standard-bearer for action. *[And the fact is that, as an ontological necessity, hope must be practical to become a concrete reality.](https://ipa-delasalle.org.ar/ipa_new/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/Paulo-Freire-Pedagog%C3%ADa-de-la-esperanza.pdf)* It invites us to transform, to think critically in order to change the environment or situation we wish to see into a better version; that is why, for **Freire**, hopelessness or despair leads only to battles of revenge. In contrast, transformation, with critical hope, always leads us to change and to the realization of a better story.
![phamdinhan-river-7133713_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23w2qdbybmpj5zJN6NCY5SfCDFVzdZBDMUo6BJUKkt5hkoC7zFMvWjJBBce2PJ2tDyc64.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Phamdinhan](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/r%C3%ADo-bote-pescador-mortero-de-red-7133713/)
* ###
Hope Through Action
From the many comments made during **Initiative 24**, I realized that many of us Venezuelans who participated understood that the years of horror we have endured—as @germanandradeg points out—were marked by hope and a need for justice. *To many people abroad, Venezuelans have not fought consistently given their circumstances, but today we have proven the opposite. We have gathered, we have protested, we have voted as many times as we believed we should, we have taken to the streets, and we have always lost.* It was evident—and reality proves it today—that there was a completely militarized higher-level organization that forcibly prevented any action in favor of a breathable freedom from being carried out: **Help was needed.** @pedrobrito2004 reminded us that without hope, the world’s dark events would seem like impenetrable barriers to us and that depression would become a constant; from which it follows that, for the sake of pure survival, it is necessary to have hope. *This is very much like what Freire said about hope grounded in positivity and criticism, not in anger and despair.* We often believe that hoping for the impossible is nothing but blindness and folly, but it is through action and the development of strategies to achieve a goal that hope proves to be a driving force rather than a mere feeling of waiting. @issymarie2 says that hope is synonymous with a miracle; and I believe that too, because it drives change and is the inner voice that says that, no matter how difficult a situation may be, it is possible to transform it; and that is exactly what happens. Furthermore, @jlat1412 believes that planning, resources, and structural partnerships are what make it possible for hope to materialize in practice; and he reminds us that, even though 85% of economic ventures in Latin America fail, they all begin with hope. *This is not, in and of itself, a sign of success; but it is the beginning of a liberating act.*
![chanwity-fisherman-4305368_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/EpJaVSpg2TLeLFsVLV6qwqub8LQpGGiDmcNMpc3N8ePtcCV6HHAgZdoduvgjEPTxKf7.jpg)
> *
[Pixabay-Chanwity](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/pescador-la-pesca-los-peces-bote-4305368/)
* ###
Hope and Weariness
*Finally, amid so many posts—all positive and all highlighting hope as the necessary driving force for change and improvement—it’s also important to note that hope sometimes wanes.* And I feel compelled to mention this because many people believe that hope is in vain due to waiting periods that take longer than we expect; however, during that time, we can plan, analyze, and execute with greater precision. The issue is that **[many feel they are losing hope](https://confidencial.digital/opinion/la-esperanza-nunca-se-pierde/)** and even fall into situations of suffering and helplessness; and that is not the case. When a person finds themselves trapped in complicated situations that require time to transform and move forward, they end up exhausted, believing that hope is gone. ***And that is not the case.*** **[Dr. Ismael González at proparejas.com](https://www.proparejas.com/cuando-mejorar-no-es-suficiente-atrapada-entre-la-esperanza-la-duda-y-el-cansancio-emocional/)** asks us to recognize that there are times when we become paralyzed, not as a personal failure, but because the situation can be overwhelming and exhausting, and in those cases we must be objective in assessing behavioral patterns rather than listening to promising phrases. We must use downtime to regain clarity and explore our fears honestly, taking the opportunity to reflect on ourselves to understand our own history. This will help us regain a sense of self-worth and self-reliance, because exhaustion must not cause us to lose perspective, nor the ability to see the light at the end of the tunnel. *Sometimes, as in the case of Venezuela, the struggle lasts for years, and there may come a point **—and I’ve experienced this myself—** when we feel like we’re not going to make it.* But we must remember that, with **the right support**, we can all take that step and bring about change, no matter what our situation may be. Human beings, as has happened in Venezuela, sometimes need help to change what needs to be changed, to achieve balance and justice.
*Remember that we can still find direction when emotions run high and rest is needed.*
***And that initiatives like this not only bring us together, but also provide an outlet for sharing our tools, experiences, our stories, and our ability to stand united as one big community.***
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)
*I would like to thank everyone who participated in this discussion: “We Need to Talk About Hope: How Do You Nurture and Sustain It?”—this is Initiative No. 24 on Seventh-day Sunday—and I’d especially like to acknowledge @zulfrontado and @beaescribe, who, even from afar, have always made us feel that they are right here with us; as well as @germanandradeg and @damelysh*
*Because for them, hope is rational, yet it generates grace and great strength.*
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)
![Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/23sxpS1Q7Em3rmjcYPVdABMA1wbuUxbioJH4CANxmgscisiVAEic5SZYS54NiUmbDb9Kv.png)
![línea Sin título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emiliorios/242Y3ngqczi8YGvaGntsKGk9MGr6SR1TwghL3ukCaHCdxNeW6HqUXibf7JYLaZ4zD1KaM.png)

body.title: Tiny Voyager/  Petit voyageur
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuYknBvYvLgCWowDiASMnpUF3rahGoJDMcHVZYCZGDUA/1781375246129.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRSdv1gbf2fQ8RwcQacFbjhLLoAYmtX8F5zg91LG7GAr2/1781375259860.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWL1BUNxXqtd5Uo78jXAh1zE36SF2AQQmBFGviwAzz5NV/1781375271629.jpg)




A butterfly landed not far from the balcony window. I quickly went to get my phone: I found it magnificent and wanted to photograph it before it flew away.

 You know me, I often take photos mainly to share them on this platform. I’m always on the lookout for something to tell or discover.

One should not be deceived by its fragile appearance. This delicate creature is capable of traveling extraordinary distances and even crossing oceans. It is a migratory butterfly 🦋. Incredible, isn’t it? So small, so light, almost insignificant in the vastness of the ocean, and yet capable of accomplishing a journey that many larger beings could never undertake.

To do so, it cleverly takes advantage of air currents and favorable winds, allowing it to travel hundreds, even thousands of kilometers. It just goes to show that strength is not always about size.

According to my research, it is a Red Admiral (Vanessa atalanta), also known as the “Admiral.” One theory suggests that this nickname comes from its colors, which resemble those of certain British military uniforms.

It is easily recognizable by its dark wings crossed with broad bright orange bands and decorated with white spots.

At first glance, I thought it was injured. Its left wing seemed torn to me. But after some research, I discovered that this is not the case at all: this shape is completely natural for this butterfly.

In fact, it did not stay long. Just a few minutes after landing, it took flight again. I like to think it simply took a short break to regain its strength before continuing its incredible journey.

Fair winds to it, and may its journey be a favorable one 🦋


////
Un papillon s’est posé non loin de la fenêtre du balcon. Je me suis empressé d’aller chercher mon téléphone : je le trouvais magnifique et je voulais le photographier avant qu’il ne s’envole. 

Vous me connaissez, je l’ai surtout photographié pour le partager sur cette plateforme. Je suis toujours à l’affût d’un sujet à raconter ou à faire découvrir.

Il ne faut pas se fier à son apparence fragile. Cet être délicat est capable de parcourir des distances extraordinaires et même de traverser des océans. C’est un papillon migrateur 🦋. Incroyable, non ? Si petit, si léger, presque insignifiant face à l’immensité de l’océan, et pourtant capable d’accomplir un voyage que bien des êtres plus grands ne pourraient entreprendre.

Pour y parvenir, il profite intelligemment des courants d’air et des vents favorables, ce qui lui permet de parcourir des centaines, voire des milliers de kilomètres. Comme quoi, la force ne réside pas toujours dans la taille.

Selon mes recherches, il s’agit d’un Vulcain (Vanessa atalanta), aussi appelé « amiral ». Une hypothèse avance que ce surnom lui aurait été donné en raison de ses couleurs, qui rappelleraient celles de certains uniformes militaires anglais.

Il est facilement reconnaissable à ses ailes sombres traversées de larges bandes orange vif et ornées de taches blanches.

Au premier regard, j’ai cru qu’il était blessé. Son aile gauche me semblait déchirée. Mais après quelques recherches, j’ai découvert qu’il n’en était rien : cette forme particulière est tout à fait naturelle chez ce papillon.

D’ailleurs, il n’est pas resté longtemps. Quelques minutes à peine après s’être posé, il a repris son envol. J’aime à penser qu’il s’était simplement accordé une courte pause pour reprendre des forces avant de poursuivre son incroyable périple.

Bon vent à lui, et que son voyage lui soit favorable🦋

Está carrera creo que superó las expectativas de muchos, 10k que podemos tomarlos como culturales, dónde corrimos por los sitios más emblemáticos del centro de Caracas, la salida estuvo llena de mucho swing con unas salsas (como dicen aquí) cabillas. 

Particularmente, yo fui a apoyar a los que corrían hoy de mi team @lpgrunners y a cumplir con mi entrenamiento. 

Se vivió una vibra distinta en esta carrera, muchos puntos de animación, entre los cuales para mí destacaron, las burriquitas, por dónde está artesano café, cerca de la plaza Bolívar, los colectores, que atravesaron 2 encavas en la Av. Urdaneta y gritaban los destinos en los que nos movilizarnos aquí en ccs y hasta mencionaban destinos de la Guaira y si te dejabas agarrar, te subían en la encava, con la típica salsa puesta a todo volumen, que caracterizan a los autobuses, también estuvieron las porristas del equipo cocodrilos de ccs, en la plaza la candelaria, bailando y animando a todos los que pasábamos, también hubo un punto donde estaban dando cambur y los que lo entregaban estaban disfrazados como tal, un punto de Movistar en plaza vzla, que tenían un bochinche que daba mucha energia y por último unos chicos disfrazados de perros calientes, que también estaban super animados, gritando, bailando y brincando, estos fueron los puntos que más destacaron para mí. 

La energía de verdad fue otra cosa, la ruta (que nos habían vendido como muy exigente) de verdad que si tuvo sus partes exigidas, pero en lo particular, pensé que me iba a costar mucho más y en las subidas pude mantener el paso, tuvo una super bajada en la Av. Urdaneta que nos dió tregua, a mí me pegó fue la última subida en plaza vzla, baje un poco el paso, pero me mantuve firme, sinceramente pensé que haría hoy como 1:10 min, me pidieron correr a ritmo, tenía tiempo que no lo hacia y me sorprendió que hice 59 min, se que puedo hacer menos, pero vamos paso a paso, ya se están recuperando los ritmos y eso me tiene contenta 😍

Mi próximo objetivo, la carrera mágica 🪄🧙🏻‍♂️

Sigamos enfocados y haciendo lo que amamos 💚

Incluso a veces son descubiertos por alguien del exterior, y sus obras posan a nombre de otro en otras partes del mundo. He sabido de esos relatos por un amigo del pre universitario que estudió diseño industrial en lo que era el ISA, que no se si aún existirá.\nA veces en los pueblos apartados existen puros talentos, natos de nacimiento sin ser pulidos por escuelas. Pero ahí están como minas del patrimonio cultural Cubano. Ese talento que no tiene que ver con si tienes o no lujos. Simplememente, la vida, el destino, Dios puso su bendición sobre esa persona. \nSaludos Amiga. Feliz Domingo.

body.title: The rainclouds bring a mountain to Da Nang and a pizza was destroyed
body.body:
While we do have mountains in Da Nang, none of them are particularly ominous.  But the other day at about 4pm something very strange happened.  A very scary looking set of clouds started heading our way from the south and for a brief period of time it appeared as though this city was at the foot of a very large mountain range.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23qrJAEM9mwKnbEftVDE4nvtjtNbSdJdZX34iu6YoMmVkdWGWR2Pp31hrqhJdDRUgb9ov.png)
</center>

Correct me if I am wrong, but without context if I was to post this and say it was a brilliant view of the nearby mountain range you would probably believe I was telling the truth wouldn't you? 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/Eqd8YuykiAC56XWiFtVZUutSJsWQ6rUao7YMtqE58nPjJToH42ecXKqp35kFhahPGsr.png)
</center>

none of this are actual mountains.  The land to the south of Da Nang city is really flat for about 30 km in that direction.  But for a small period of time it certainly looked like we were next to a mountain so large that it would put the city in the shade for half of the day.

We buckled up for what appeared to be a crazy storm but all that really happened was that we got some high winds that knocked over a couple of umbrellas at the coffee shop next door and we closed our awning in anticipation of some really heavy rain, or so it appeared.  But all that actually happened was those winds and a few drops of rain.   

We are not due for monsoon season for another couple of months and I am still completely unaware of what it is that makes that time of year happen so predictably every single year.

There was one casualty that happened because of these unfortunate weather conditions though and it directly affected my stomach.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23uQvenVggYJu2u5byk7gf5xxkKXb8NguFe7yDjcais5pshjxQFxfxYqP9S4jgpdUH261.png)
</center>

According to my delivery driver and only after I contacted the delivery service to lodge a complaint, the high winds resulted in a flipping around of my pizza as it hung off the handlebars of the motorbike.  

I don't believe this excuse for a second.  I think that this is just one of those delivery drivers that reluctantly takes these jobs and doesn't actually give a damn about the condition that your food arrives in.   I was careful to not get the pizza company in any trouble for this  and I did not write a bad review for the driver either, even though I probably should have.  I put in a complaint complete with the above picture and the app company called GRAB ended up refunding my entire food order cost and as far as I know, didn't charge either driver nor restaurant for the refund.  

This is good customer service in my mind because they basically have a monopoly on food delivery here in Da Nang, so it is nice to see that they will take the hit themselves every now and then and well, they should.  Grab probably takes in millions of dollars a month and it would make me feel bad if something like this, whether due to weather or negligence, I would rather not punish the small business owner nor the motorbike delivery guy who probably lives just a block away from poverty anyway.  

Soon these scary rainclouds will become a regular part of our daily lives here in Da Nang and although the tourists really hate the turn in the weather, I really enjoy the drop in temperature that comes along with it.  I also kind of enjoy the drop in tourism that this sort of change in the weather happens to bring along with it but I would bet that the businesses that depend on tourism do not feel this way.

I say bring on \

body.title: Mower Fixed
body.body:
<center>![IMG_1514.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23z7FgsNB8UWy4ZPxJXzBVRPsYd99rkZZuC6McuL54gH5ap1hAJ4eTczaPxhtKyDGTF4K.jpeg)</center><center><sub>My push mower.</sub></center>

Worked on my push mower this weekend. Last week while mowing it started revving up and down. Surging. That's never good. My first thought was a fuel or spark plug issue. Changed out the spark plug. Still had the same symptoms.

Went to change out the fuel filter and realized it didn't have one. Seems the previous owner must have removed it for some reason. Never figured out why.

<center>![IMG_2701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23yxASrwbRTG9Ei75bhzqaQVbjEvAxSE81KeEvNaBQDKNmCaVMikZukQKg9AKzhnck2ed.jpg)</center><center><sub>The carb kit.</sub></center>

Started thinking. Since it had been running without a fuel filter, I figured the carburetor had to be dirty as hell. All that unfiltered fuel running through it. Carburetors for small engines are cheap. At least for my model. So instead of taking it apart and cleaning every little part, I just bought new. Got a whole tune up kit. Didn't really need all of it right now, but might as well have the parts on hand.

Installed the new carb last night and found my fuel line had a crack in it. Of course it did. So I ordered new fuel line. Got it last night. Installed everything this morning.

Runs like a charm now.

The good lady mowed this morning. No surging. No sputtering. Just a mower doing what a mower is supposed to do.

Sometimes fixing things is just a matter of working the problem. One part at a time until you find the culprit. In this case it was a missing fuel filter, a dirty carb, and a cracked fuel line all working together to make my life difficult. All fixed now.

On to the next project. And back to cleaning my garage.

![HiveDivider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/EoGvX4Va6X4ZfjnYkvBhFi2bqZsCrwoqpWhwgmGDPKVDS9eeZ4zF8foqAfcm44mn84d.png)
Thanks for reading,
Joe

body.title: The most recognized coin in the world…
body.body:
Afternoon everyone…..

There is no circulated coin know with more worldwide recognition than the Morgan Silver Dollar. It is the queen of all coinage. It is also the most collected coin in the entire world as well. Yes, the entire world!!!!!

Some of you may not be familiar with the Morgan Silver Dollar. So here is a brief history of it:

The Morgan dollar is a United States dollar coin minted from 1878 to 1904, in 1921, and beginning again in 2021 as a collectible. It was the first standard silver dollar minted since the passage of the Coinage Act of 1873, which ended the free coining of silverand the production of the previous design, the Seated Liberty dollar. It contained 412.5 Troy grains of 90% pure silver (or 371.25 Troy grains = 24.057 g; 0.7734 ozt of pure silver). The coin is named after its designer, United States Mint Assistant Engraver George T. Morgan. The obverse depicts a profile portrait representing Liberty, modeled by Anna Willess Williams, while the reverse depicts an eagle with wings outstretched. The mint mark, if present, appears on the reverse above between D and O in \

. The dollar was authorized by the Bland–Allison Act. Following the passage of the 1873 act, mining interests lobbied to restore free silver, which would require the Mint to accept all silver presented to it and return it, struck into coin. Instead, the Bland–Allison Act was passed, which required the Treasury to purchase between two and four million dollars' worth of silver at market value to be coined into dollars each month. In 1890, the Bland–Allison Act was repealed by the Sherman Silver Purchase Act, which required the Treasury to purchase 4,500,000 troy ounces (140,000 kg) of silver each month, but only required further silver dollar production for one year. This act, once again, was repealed in 1893. In 1898, Congress approved a bill that required all remaining bullion purchased under the Sherman Silver Purchase Act to be coined into silver dollars. When those silver reserves were depleted in 1904, the Mint ceased to strike the Morgan dollar. The Pittman Act, passed in 1918, authorized the melting and recoining of millions of silver dollars. Pursuant to the act, Morgan dollars resumed mintage for one year in 1921. The design was replaced by the Peace dollarlater the same year. In the early 1960s, a large quantity of uncirculated Morgan dollars in their original bags were discovered in the Treasury vaults, including issues once thought rare. Individuals began purchasing large quantities of the pieces at face value and then removed them from circulation through hoarding, and eventually the Treasury ceased exchanging silver certificates for silver coin. Beginning in the 1970s, the Treasury conducted a sale of silver dollars minted at the Carson City Mint through the General Services Administration. This is known in the collectors world as the GSA Hoard. These coins were placed in a rectangular case with a GSA monicker on it. They were sold through magazines and on the television as well. If you’d like to know more about this particular part please Google Morgan GSA hoard. It’s a pretty interesting read. As for the coin I’m going to share today. It’s an 1887 Philadelphia strike Morgan. It’s raw which means ungraded. I know….yes I do own ungraded coins. The mintage of this coin was 20,290,710, which is a pretty fair amount makes this about an $80 coin as it stands.

Feliz fin de semana para todos, aunque siento que duro tan poco, o yo hice tantas cosas que me falto tiempo para swntirme en modo descanso. 

Pero como cada domingo sali a correr con @lpgrunners, no fuimos a la plaza LPG como siempre sino que decidimos aprovechar la ruta de una carrera que había, aparte habia varios inscritos del grupo y Henry el capitan del grupo sería pacer oficial de la carrera en el tiempo de 55 minutos.

Mi sorpresa fue desde el inicio, ya que nos recibieron con salsa vieja un son poco escuchado en las carreras habituales, la carrera con su Lema corre Caracas, se enfocó en una ruta con lugares historicos y a resaltar algunos venezolanismos y tradiciones. 

Comenzamos a correr en la Avenida Bolívar una avenida principal en el centro de la ciudad desde alli se comienza a ver obras arquitectonicas que adornan la ciudad y que forman parte del urbanismo, durante la ruta se sentía mucho animo de la gente y la musica salsa que colocaba el toque alegre, habia musica de tambores, baile cultural de la Burriquita, las bailarinas de la coreografía del equipo de Cocodrilos y lo mas chistoso fue ver a un grupo de muchachos simulando a los autobuseros de la ciudad gritando Petare - Silencio. 

Esta carrera tuvo una ruta fuerte ya que tenia varias subidas y bajadas que si mo se controla el ritmo podia pasar factura mas adelante, sin embargo me administre bien y la termine genial, haciendo 59 minutos en los 10 kilometros y sosteniendo los 28 min en los 5 kilometros. 

Al finalizar me quedé disfrutando con los amigos y hasta bailé. 

### SEGUIMOS SUMANDO KILÓMETROS DE SALUD Y BIENESTAR

### Signal

**Type:** clip | **Authentic:** edited clipped | **Importance:** important

**Topic:** In this video, we can appreciate the song \

performed by The Beatles in their 2013 remastered mix. It is not an original song, but an energetic cover of the classic by The Coasters, originally released in 1957

**Tags:** #pop60 #beatles #coasters #cover #beatlemania

**Claim:** The recording comes from the live sessions the group performed for the British radio network BBC. Specifically, it was recorded on June 1, 1963, at the BBC Paris Studio in London and broadcast ten days later (June 11) on the radio program Pop Go The Beatles. On this occasion, George Harrison sings lead vocals, while John Lennon and Paul McCartney provide backing vocals and the characteristic comedic voices in the chorus. The original link is to a fan video (created by a user named Tony Smith) that uses the official 2013 remastered audio compiled on the album The Beatles - Live at the BBC.

**Stance:** support

**00** — They begin to perform the aforementioned song.

**Why it matters:** It showcases the Beatles' deep love for 1950s American R&B and rock and roll, genres that completely shaped their early musical style. The Beatles played this song frequently during their Cavern Club days and even at their unsuccessful audition for Decca Records in 1962, yet they never recorded it on an official studio album during the 1960s. It remained \

from the general public until the BBC authorized the release of these tapes in 1994. The 2013 mix cleaned up the original mono radio .

title.title: Delicioso pollo guisado con papa, arroz y crema de apio criollo
title.body: # Delicioso pollo guisado con papa, arroz y crema de apio criollo\n\n <div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y del buen paladar que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, gusto en saludarlos, espero que todos hayan tenido un feliz fin de semana cargado de abundantes bendiciones. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQxj9rNyWd3TeDDHTVi1LuF3wD4MyusyYqtJ8BhbucvUet8tpwNJq8GVm43HL5FyGvw.jpg)

Hoy quise presentarles una deliciosa y sana receta de pollo guisado con papas, lo acompañe con una rica crema de apio criollo y arroz blanco, este plato lo prepare para mi almuerzo. les comento que quedo muy deliciosos y es una comida que siempre va a caer bien al estomago, porque no es pesado y sobre todo que es una receta muy sana, ya que la he preparado con aliños naturales y una mínima cantidad de aceite.

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC4ruEbpDbC2rw5PGq8hqUhCAGXtKdeF3tZBMq8U8DKihssSdo9udEDXh4ZZxvCQ.jpg)

Esta receta de pollo guisado con papas es una preparación súper fácil de preparar, que cualquier persona sin ningún inconveniente y con poca experiencia pueden hacer esta receta casera, así mismo es económica y exquisita al paladar. Resulta perfecta para novatos o para toda aquella persona que necesita improvisar para ahorrar tiempo, ya que su preparación es rápida de preparar o cuando no se tiene mucho dinero ya que también es rendidora para casos donde la familia es numerosa. 

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8TnjUK6s9Hr8iKNjDznA7AJwecwAHQW4o43BfV5iaAKyoyj7rBK4Y6rh7p2bNVaq.jpg)
![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpzzbxxhKrXzeqEsyTvRXMNEo45Jc2va8GvUEALeCX2VDuPPbt5Fzk5CcDL3ekqZsw2.jpg)

Ahora bien paso a nombrarle los ingredientes y el aso a paso de esta deliciosa receta:

# Ingredientes
* pollo picado
* 4 papas medianas
* 3 cucharadas de kechup
* 1 onoto molido
* 5 dientes de ajo
* Apio españa, ajo porro, cebolla blanca y 1 ají dulce.
* 1 cucharada de aceite o margarina, sal y pimienta al gusto
* 5 apios criollos cortados en cuadros medianos
* 1/2 taza  arroz blanco

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep3gfFkh8FEn5g4uJ7yWzyqWbWmZJuX6hNFUvw8UrMNz8t7dgX84MnbXxBPrn9qRjcD.jpg)

# Paso a paso

Simplemente, estaba sola en casa y sin pensar mucho, abrí la nevera y use los pocos vegetales y el pollo picado que tenia. tome una olla, le agregue un tanto de sal, el pollo picado y lo coloque en la estufa por 10 minutos, de modo que el pollo botara la sangre. a la par coloque a cocinar la crema de apio y el arroz.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo4AAxTixzEXTmM2wLiaV579T61op9snw3aVgCPRpSKzw4dBuQ2ucq7MGRD2gVEPuyr.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK6n4RyQuyBBk1ZPNB83STnGPAcSBLbkQUd4SLRccdT4re1GbMmJSc7JGZFg4DiNGG.jpg)
-|-

 Posteriormente agregue al pollo las papas cotadas en cuadros medianos, los aliños verdes, deje cocinar 5 minutos mas, por ultimo le agregue el kechup, el onoto molido, la pimienta y una cucharada de margarina, al final cambie el aceite por la margarina.  
![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonnUBtYBCoRvoJDyck2BMWXSsQbmQSDTsNfLnLMts7eiNRx33piD3Tim6tQAi2znj1.jpg)|![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoEq15frmiQFdW6zWv2uUqSnjUdoxCnCQfj49E4ojNCuJ4XUahNWaxNpKeukcTmJMsn.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoCieJD4rHUpiz5DyDEPC71nYzxewbS6sP98gfP8fh8vucXmbm92wr6WLpoDDBNgkj1.jpg)
-|-|-

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGwxBpwFhybZT7UtTFahy1hEttoJbA31NXFsXuSWDYDaNyEmpKWq9r1ECjfzZLAAwE.jpg)|![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8TnjUK6s9Hr8iKNjDznA7AJwecwAHQW4o43BfV5iaAKyoyj7rBK4Y6rh7p2bNVaq.jpg)
-|-

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC4ruEbpDbC2rw5PGq8hqUhCAGXtKdeF3tZBMq8U8DKihssSdo9udEDXh4ZZxvCQ.jpg)

El olor que desprendió del pollo  guisado, el espeso que le dio las papas, el calor y sabor fue todo lo clásico de  una verdadera comida casera. Al igual tanto la crema de apio criollo y el arroz que fueron los contornos, quedaron super buenos y el arroz suelto.

hasta aquí mi contenido, espero sea  de su agrado, nos vemos en una próxima receta.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Delicious Chicken Stew with Potatoes, Rice, and Creole Celery Cream

> Hello, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs who follow me in the @hivefood community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all. I hope you all had a wonderful weekend filled with abundant blessings. Welcome to my blog. ![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQxj9rNyWd3TeDDHTVi1LuF3wD4MyusyYqtJ8BhbucvUet8tpwNJq8GVm43HL5FyGvw.jpg) Today I wanted to share a delicious and healthy recipe for chicken stew with potatoes. I served it with a rich cream of celery soup and white rice—I made this dish for my lunch. I’ll tell you that it turned out very delicious, and it’s a meal that’s always easy on the stomach because it’s not heavy and, above all, it’s a very healthy recipe since I prepared it with natural seasonings and a minimal amount of oil. ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC4ruEbpDbC2rw5PGq8hqUhCAGXtKdeF3tZBMq8U8DKihssSdo9udEDXh4ZZxvCQ.jpg) This recipe for chicken stew with potatoes is super easy to make; anyone, even with little experience, can whip up this homemade dish with no trouble. It’s also economical and delicious. It’s perfect for beginners or anyone who needs to improvise to save time, since it’s quick to prepare, or when you’re on a tight budget, as it goes a long way for large families. ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8TnjUK6s9Hr8iKNjDznA7AJwecwAHQW4o43BfV5iaAKyoyj7rBK4Y6rh7p2bNVaq.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpzzbxxhKrXzeqEsyTvRXMNEo45Jc2va8GvUEALeCX2VDuPPbt5Fzk5CcDL3ekqZsw2.jpg) Now I’ll list the ingredients and the step-by-step instructions for this delicious recipe: # Ingredients * ground chicken * 4 medium potatoes * 3 tablespoons of ketchup * 1 tablespoon of ground annatto * 5 cloves of garlic * Spanish celery, leek, white onion, and 1 sweet pepper. * 1 tablespoon of oil or margarine, salt, and pepper to taste * 5 stalks of celery, cut into medium-sized cubes * 1/2 cup white rice ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep3gfFkh8FEn5g4uJ7yWzyqWbWmZJuX6hNFUvw8UrMNz8t7dgX84MnbXxBPrn9qRjcD.jpg) # Step by Step I was home alone, and without thinking too much about it, I opened the fridge and used the few vegetables and chopped chicken I had. I took a pot, added a little salt and the chopped chicken, and put it on the stove for 10 minutes so the chicken would release its blood. At the same time, I started cooking the cream of celery soup and the rice. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo4AAxTixzEXTmM2wLiaV579T61op9snw3aVgCPRpSKzw4dBuQ2ucq7MGRD2gVEPuyr.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoK6n4RyQuyBBk1ZPNB83STnGPAcSBLbkQUd4SLRccdT4re1GbMmJSc7JGZFg4DiNGG.jpg) -|- Next, add the potatoes (cut into medium-sized cubes) and the fresh herbs to the chicken, and let it cook for 5 more minutes. Finally, add the ketchup, ground annatto, pepper, and a tablespoon of margarine; at the end, replace the oil with margarine. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonnUBtYBCoRvoJDyck2BMWXSsQbmQSDTsNfLnLMts7eiNRx33piD3Tim6tQAi2znj1.jpg) |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoEq15frmiQFdW6zWv2uUqSnjUdoxCnCQfj49E4ojNCuJ4XUahNWaxNpKeukcTmJMsn.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoCieJD4rHUpiz5DyDEPC71nYzxewbS6sP98gfP8fh8vucXmbm92wr6WLpoDDBNgkj1.jpg) -|-|- ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoGwxBpwFhybZT7UtTFahy1hEttoJbA31NXFsXuSWDYDaNyEmpKWq9r1ECjfzZLAAwE.jpg)|![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc8TnjUK6s9Hr8iKNjDznA7AJwecwAHQW4o43BfV5iaAKyoyj7rBK4Y6rh7p2bNVaq.jpg) -|- ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGTC4ruEbpDbC2rw5PGq8hqUhCAGXtKdeF3tZBMq8U8DKihssSdo9udEDXh4ZZxvCQ.jpg) The aroma coming from the stewed chicken, the richness from the potatoes, the warmth, and the flavor—it was all the hallmarks of a true home-cooked meal. Likewise, both the creole celery soup and the rice that served as sides turned out great, and the rice was perfectly fluffy. That’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed it. title.title: Being Healthy Biblically (Part 1)// Mcgi Topic Review.
title.body:
Being healthy is the part of wisdom as the bible is a book of wisdom. *Deuteronomy 34:7* reminds us that it is possible for us to stay in good health until death as Moses lived a hundred and twenty years and his eyes were not dim. We should always take good care of our body as christians, as we take care of our spiritual life by listening to admonitions and teachings of Christ, we ought to take care of our physical body by eating good food and exercising.

https://youtu.be/s6AVBwmtmkU?si=_xKqWKYhiqSy9S-H

 Staying healthy is living in alignment with God’s wisdom for life. The Bible encourages discipline, moderation, and self-control which all play a role in maintaining good health.   Our  bodies are gifts, which is not to be abused or neglected simple habits like eating responsibly, avoiding excess, and keeping a balanced lifestyle shows gratitude to God for the life we have. Physical and mental rest is part of a healthy spiritual walk, we should always make out time to rest and take care of our body.

Biblical health goes beyond what the eyes can see;  It includes obedience, peace, and right living. When a person lives in constant stress, anger, or sin, it affects both the body and spirit that is why the scripture often connects righteousness with life and peace.  Staying healthy is not only about diet or exercise but also about staying spiritually clean, maintaining good relationships, and living in forgiveness  in this way, true health becomes a harmony between body, mind, and spirit under God’s guidance.

title.title: WHAT A DAY!!
title.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![WHAT A DAY!!](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/fbe4e5e6-503d-4ae5-a83f-9955973bc553.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/uQNkJtW8fWJpedRaSGrrt2) 
 
 I started the night at our alliance students forum old party. I wasn’t even in the party proper, just around there trying to host things and make sure everyone was okay. It kicked off around 11 PM and I figured I’d leave early, but one thing led to another. Then around 1 AM rain started falling heavily and people had to scatter back to their different zones. By the time everything settled, sleep was already late and my body was done.

Because of that late night, I couldn’t wake up early for church today. That’s something that really got to me. Missing service wasn’t planned at all, it just happened because I was up late and my eyes refused to open. I felt bad about it, like I let myself down. Church is one thing I try not to miss, but today my body just wouldn’t cooperate after the rain and the whole night stress.

Still, I’m not beating myself up too much. Sometimes these things happen when you’re trying to be there for people. Next time I’ll plan better so I don’t sacrifice sleep and miss something important like service. Lesson learned: you can show up for others, but you also have to show up for yourself too.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/uQNkJtW8fWJpedRaSGrrt2)

title.title: Check out the overhead on this farm run we did
title.body:
One of the great benefits of Chiang Mai is that even though it is a sprawling and rather busy city, one of the largest in the entire country actually, it also has a bunch of nature stuff and even park reserves that are very close to the city center.   Chiang Mai  is unique in this regard because while there is plenty of countryside that remains in this country, most of it is well out of the cities they are near and traveling in cars for several hours is necessary to see them.

In Chiang Mai, you can access these areas in 20 minutes or a bit more in almost any direction from downtown.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chaingmai.hhh/23tbpgVxjPxYUTeY9v3DKxPkZVsLR63FMmGJHGapfryEW5cXMNM654rZiMDBRKFkcuHUb.png)
</center>

Everyone has likely seen land like this just by looking out the window of an airplane when traveling but we were down there in the literal muck over the weekend and because of a recent rainfall it was especially muddy and lots of boots came back pretty dirty.  This wasn't the idea when the trail was set but none of us could have foreseen the torrential rainfall that happened on Friday just a day before the run.

This was a bit problematic for the people that had spent the week setting the trail.

<center> 
![81536115_2339558643023340_3523126230838673408_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chaingmai.hhh/2458DcRpLarWeRrwe5SMNeSym9vUz3JRbdaLMWP22U4vkSqtPXQFBp3BCkpXYRVd3JzvP.jpg)
</center>

The hares had to go back out on Saturday morning and re-run their trail in order to make sure all the markings were not wiped out.  we mark our trails with flour to be as environmentally friendly as possible but there is always a great risk of something like what happened this past week happening.   Flour doesn't mix so well with heavy rainfall so these guys who set the trail did a lot of work in order to have this ready by Saturday afternoon.  Kudos to them for doing this for us.

This was also one of those rather rare \

trails runs where we do not finish at the same place where we start and these sorts of trails are particularly good because some of the boys out there like to try to cheat and use their GPS to get back to the camp faster than others.  It is much more difficult to pull of this cheat trick when you don't actually know where the trail is going to conclude.  I'm looking at you \

\n\nWhile that last image looks rather dry that is not a good representation of the entire area we were running on.  Since most of this was rice paddies, which are normally quite wet by design, we had a lot of mud involved in the mix and this resulted in some pretty funny stories including \

briefly losing his shoe in the muck. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chaingmai.hhh/23vho8GHp3aPggso1ph5zfMqMgLTp4UdaePHvDAjtB6uZxf2JYtGV8UJNjRMRPwSWC3nH.png)
</center>

It wasn't a huge crew of people this time and this is expected during the summertime when all of those losers go back to their home countries to enjoy the few good months of weather that they have.  All in we probably had about 20 people total, and that is enough.  At least there was plenty of beer to spare.  

We are still doing 3 runs a week minimum and anyone can come and join us.  It will change your life for the better to become a Hasher!   Check out full details about the upcoming Chiang Mai schedule at our [official website](http://www.chiangmaihhh.com)

On On!

<center> 
![Screen-Shot-2012-11-10-at-14.11.541.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chaingmai.hhh/23ynoPrgFuNVRfcq2pahbsPn1BqinDsd2WHuZwR2yGxCgvRhg1vVYo4PnR1jPYfJoc35C.png)
</center>

![p_20260502_161644-e774aa116dfc.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161644-e774aa116dfc.webp) ![p_20260502_161700-67b59e74313c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161700-67b59e74313c.webp) ![p_20260502_161708-fdd5b044c071.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161708-fdd5b044c071.webp) ![p_20260502_161736-212f6aa3ad62.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161736-212f6aa3ad62.webp) ![p_20260502_161720-436596660901.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161720-436596660901.webp) ![p_20260502_161646-11fa513a8644.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/diochen/lkt-mqecp18e-v1j7hlv2/p_20260502_161646-11fa513a8644.webp) 「冰結」是日本麒麟（KIRIN）推出的調酒系列，我第一次認識它，是在便利商店的保冷櫃內，那時候，冰結系列的調酒採用玻璃罐陳列，只用簡單的顏色來區別調酒口味，價錢介於中高價位，一口喝下去，很甜、很好入口、很好喝，但是，很容易讓人進入微醺狀態，因為它採用伏特加作為基酒，加上帶有甜味的水果風味與大量碳酸氣泡，掩蓋了酒精濃度高的事實。 後來，在家附近的量販店也可以看到用鐵罐封存的水果系列，常見的口味有白葡萄柚、檸檬、葡萄與青蘋果，可能是因為量販店以量制價的原因，價錢比在便利商店便宜一些，很適合大量採購，和朋友聚會時暢飲，就連我女生的朋友，也很喜歡喝。 沒想到，在鬧區閒逛時，遇到了冰結的大型推廣活動，因為新的口味要上市了，台灣麒麟於鬧區打造期間限定實體活動，現場以大型冰塊造景呈現入口清爽意象，並將果實氣泡元素延伸至整體空間設計，呼應產品濃郁果味與爽快氣泡特色，現場規劃一些拍照及打卡任務，完成任務可以試喝白桃口味冰沙，在這種悶熱的天氣，能夠吃個調酒口味的冰沙，真是太棒了，難怪一堆人排隊。 隨著夏季來臨，氣溫逐漸升高，陽光變得更加炙熱，無論是在海邊派對、露營烤肉、朋友聚會，或下班後的小酌，調酒總是能與夏天緊密地連結在一起，成為生活中的一部份，所以酒商會有這樣的活動，也不奇怪啦。
---
“Hyoketsu” is a ready-to-drink cocktail series launched by KIRIN in Japan. The first time I came across it was in the refrigerated section of a convenience store. Back then, the Hyoketsu cocktails came in glass bottles, with simple color schemes used to distinguish the different flavors. They were priced in the mid-to-high range, but after taking a sip, I immediately understood why people liked them so much. They were sweet, smooth, and incredibly easy to drink. The dangerous part, though, is that they can get you pleasantly buzzed before you realize it. Since they use vodka as the base spirit and combine it with sweet fruit flavors and lots of carbonation, the alcohol taste is well hidden, making the drinks feel much lighter than they actually are. Later on, I started seeing the canned fruit-flavored versions at a hypermarket near my home. Common flavors include white grapefruit, lemon, grape, and green apple. Since hypermarkets usually offer better prices through bulk sales, they were a bit cheaper than buying them at convenience stores, making them perfect for stocking up before gatherings with friends. Even many of my female friends enjoy drinking them because they're fruity and easy on the palate. To my surprise, while wandering around a busy shopping district one day, I stumbled upon a large Hyoketsu promotional event. A new flavor was being launched, so Taiwan Kirin created a limited-time pop-up experience. The venue featured giant ice-themed decorations to emphasize the refreshing image of the brand, while fruit and sparkling bubble elements were incorporated throughout the space to highlight the drink’s rich fruit flavors and crisp carbonation. There were also several photo spots and social media check-in missions. Visitors who completed the tasks could receive a sample of a white peach-flavored frozen slushie. In this hot and humid weather, getting to enjoy an alcoholic peach slushie felt amazing. No wonder so many people were lining up for it. As summer arrives and temperatures continue to rise, alcoholic drinks naturally become part of the season. Whether it's a beach party, a camping barbecue, a gathering with friends, or simply relaxing with a drink after work, cocktails seem to go hand in hand with summer. So honestly, it's not surprising at all that beverage companies would organize events like this to promote their products during the hottest time of the year.

title.title: 3D Decorative Flower using the Quilling Technique [Eng-Esp]
title.body:
> ##### **Hello to all my Hive friends... 🐱**
Those of you who follow my blog and are familiar with the technique I’ve been using for years must have noticed that I have a real passion for making flowers. Lately, I’ve been sharing many designs on my blog, some of which are even inspired by characters from video games. Well, today I’m sharing another flower design—one of the many I can create using this technique. Here’s a decorative 3D flower made using the quilling technique. #### ***Hoping you like it, I leave you my creative process:*** ># **Let's get started:😃**
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱** Lo que conocen mi blog y la técnica que he utilizado durante años deben haberse dado cuenta que tengo una inclinación muy grande por hacer flores, en estos días en mi blog he mostrado muchos modelos inspirados hasta en personajes de algunos juegos. Pues para hoy le traigo otro modelo de flor de los muchísimos que puedo materializar en esta técnica. Les dejo una flor decorativa en 3D en la técnica de quilling. #### ***Esperando que sea de su agrado, les dejo mi proceso creativo:*** ># **Comencemos:😃**
|| |-| |![1000268890.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKxmwgWUZcnCRWiTcoKeXLKKD9RTaoVeKCGDxPDqTKARLVZzobsdiftFTLwYFf7.jpg)| || |-| |![1000268896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AL1f2XWkj6cR5EC7o1KpcuahbFSS4MfKpFP6QFLcyiY7QWo3cFv1MgRDCofFRtw.jpg)| || |-| |
![ac05543a3b5b433e9c93d842fb017257.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23zS3TayEqn4n1N6Agr88LKx5wDNoj69CTRqytuZF44dNFm2kaWjAwy4Uu77VNKtJ3999.gif)
|
![39.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TJcMfHbMdJtjKSUA9KCCCSTbXrJQy1idAjYi2Hr1tDf2kZnRoyVGyYfXHEpwFvCM.png)
>• Cintas para quilling. • Aguja para quilling. • Plantilla para moldear círculos. >• Cartulinas. >• Guillotina de cortar papel. >• Mandril para circulos. >• Pega blanca extra fuerte (de carpintería). >• Pincel. >• Tijera. >
- Ribbons for quilling. - Needle for quilling. - Template for molding circles. - Cardboards. - Paper cutting guillotine. - Circle drill. - Extra strong white glue (carpentry glue). - Brush. - Scissors.
![40.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48SpZgefHFSX4tcvQfhpdVsM51fKanb8EdcWXzo36HoQj5CPD6vKMgprVtxnX9E7xG.png)
• Let’s start by taking 3mm-wide aquamarine and light green quilling paper. Wind the paper around the needle, starting with the aquamarine color until you reach the end of the strip. Remove it from the needle, loosen it slightly, and secure it with extra-strong white glue to form an open circle. We’ll need 10 identical circles. • Shape them into teardrops to form the first group of petals. Once the petals are ready, glue them together in groups of 5, then join both groups together. This will form the first part of our flower. • To make this first petal section sturdy, apply a layer of extra-strong white glue and let it dry completely.
![41.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TnU9jLg64ufmgLUHNQeMMZv9Nm5DtPcXhFv9jTCKALifHYrtfxTJ4P3wHScvh1RH.png)
• Vamos a comenzar tomando cinta para quilling de color aguamarina y verde claro de 3mm de ancho, enrollaremos con la aguja empezando por el color aguamarina hasta llegar al final de la cinta, sacamos de la aguja soltamos un poco, sellamos con pega blanca extra fuerte, para obtener un círculo abierto. Vamos a necesitar 10 círculos iguales. • Vamos a moldear en forma de gota para formar el primer grupo de petalos, listos los pétalos los pegaremos en grupos de 5, luego uniremos ambos grupos. De esta manera formaremos la primera parte de muestra flor. • Para endurecer bien está primera pieza de pétalos aplicaremos una capa de pega blanca extra fuerte, dejamos secar muy bien.
|||| |-|-|-| |![1000268834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpEKFqyUnaPuqhVggQjYUTrMeFsPeiRjTVmbNy6kxTfrKqYNfD63j3wtFM8xiC4Lafh.jpg)|![1000268835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoiY9XMtc11EUmUaayFkctnnVn1fR2tLTwZwK5hErntEy8AhYwcy5qs23KHnYtm31Yk.jpg)|![1000268836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EocAQADdiR66ur4R2LUcRBNecpXDFf7gsXe8TCws2YRocFcPYh27vhh2zwJnZHmY57r.jpg)|
• Take some more 3mm-wide aquamarine and light green ribbon. Wrap it around a size 3 circle mandrel from top to bottom, secure it with white glue, and remove it from the mandrel. You’ll need 5 of these. • We’ll shape these hollow circles or rings into teardrops; they’ll be the second part of our flower’s petals. • We’ll glue all the petals together with white glue, just as you can see in the picture.
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
• Tomaremos nuevamente cintas combinadas aguamarina y verde claro de 3mm de ancho, estás las vamos a enrollar en un mandril para círculos en la medida número 3 de arriba hacia abajo, sellamos con pega blanca sacamos del mandril. Vamos a necesitar 5 iguales. • Estos círculos huecos o aros los moldearemos en forma de gotas, serán la segunda parte de pétalos de nuestra flor. • Uniremos con pega blanca todos los pétalos tal y como pueden ver en la imagen.
||| |-|-| |![1000268837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EonoqUjEKHGdLMov9uVPsvATLYF2r2BFvkmU4p6RzF2rtpHviKYSXSpnY7rbdtEEJEd.jpg)|![1000268838.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoH2Ekkodyi8zUnhNPzWrBCW3Z5igzJ5hVvFXJ5o8YgCDdnSUu5w54BKy7UQu9MRD5Y.jpg)|
• Let’s join the two sets of petals by gluing the hollow petals onto the top of the ones we made earlier. • To make the center of the flower, I created a small closed circle in light green and glued it in the center. • To finish, protect, harden, and seal the flower, I applied several layers of extra-strong white glue, letting each layer dry before applying the next. >This is how I completed this decorative 3S flower using the quilling technique.
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
• Vamos a unir ambos grupos de Petalos, pegando los pétalos huecos en la parte de arriba de los que hicimos con anterioridad. • Para hacer la parte central de la flor, realicé un pequeño círculo cerrado de color verde claro y lo pegué en el centro. • Para finalizar, protejer, endurecer y plastificar la flor, apliqué varias capas de pega blanca extra fuerte dejando secar entre una capa y otra. >De esta manera finalice este modelo de una flor decorativa en 3S, en la técnica de quilling.
||| |-|-| |![1000268839.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoEsTc7BPsGWhSKzNSdSC5Z4t33XAHRoVjgvErZ8kWzbULvTLRHCbVeosDsFjyTceBd.jpg)|![1000268840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Ep5ofqVDwH1xr1mupnWv2AkJFiKDBExtVhYCrxK6kvJrVffF3CPYuJbmAta7avL1ryD.jpg)|
![42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TJcnHdtwtrxNk85Yap65ggeL4jG16YkRvm8u5SKYeeR9t12braFZb4WTcXtPMoZZ.png)
|| |-| |![1000268841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKtTwXNZWoitUPCtUtG4k29annfUUMd7oq4NRAYYLb9f3YsKbsNmaDi2FEFTmEq.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![1000268890.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKxmwgWUZcnCRWiTcoKeXLKKD9RTaoVeKCGDxPDqTKARLVZzobsdiftFTLwYFf7.jpg)|![1000268891.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKtUFVHJSjGFtdT76PpWQWppCBLt4L9AfGNWfhwc2rJHbGFxocy3CaxycPccnbs.jpg)| || |-| |![1000268892.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKuuWDjiEZNEcCsu2kbR8zVp7Ybs9mkBVUtMFj8B3FDWGMUVjfNzypgw6nJr9JX.jpg)| || |-| |![1000268893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKxnd1P4YTggHGSZviGGdiSBeYtg4dQtzpWvGUqgQ1rYqoDYs29WP8BC5pzW86Z.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![1000268895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKzDpoghi1VVc88zVNWULdJWgcfzoo6WxsTru6Z4AUwFXt4LxPREJrU69bydFdu.jpg)|![1000268894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKe8X8DMb4rP7EMnqEmZiAdeYkEgEipVH21ZY6jp3Z6pqrWTUjytjB5K1ExdVTq.jpg)| || |-| |![1000268896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AL1f2XWkj6cR5EC7o1KpcuahbFSS4MfKpFP6QFLcyiY7QWo3cFv1MgRDCofFRtw.jpg)|
|| |-| |
![ea9d4a45012e44ccaa59f97fe5d071b8.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23yx3s6QLqDMaYaMpSMt75suFFS6HZu4DRfK78dX9CWopYFCaGEM4RMwv34LWxyMzcJ8v.gif)
|
>>## **What did you think, did you like it?**
I hope you did, I hope you liked my explanation, procedure and photos, I made them with love for you.

title.title: INTERNATIONAL CUP (EVENT MATCH)
title.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![INTERNATIONAL CUP (EVENT MATCH)](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/89f1251a-3ba7-4338-a89d-ecf9cc73a546.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/4BgEBZpHFUafs4zKy1ynCg) 
 
 I played 3 matches today and lost all 3, and honestly it was frustrating. The new team I’m using hasn’t clicked yet. The players don’t understand each other, passes are misfiring, runs are late, defense is all over the place. You guys know how it is when you build a new squad — first few games always feel like you’re playing with strangers. We’ll get there, but today was just not our day.

And Konami changed things up too. You remember how we used to wait for POTW every Thursday? Now they’ve switched it to Player of the Day. Anytime there’s a World Cup match or any big international game, they drop the best player from each team that same day. So instead of one big update weekly, we’re getting small updates almost every day. If you guys don’t log in daily you’ll miss some good cards.

That’s why I was grinding the event matches. Win or lose, the POTD cards come out daily now based on real matches. I took 3 Ls but at least I understand the system now. New team + new update style = more pressure to play daily. We’ll bounce back though. Next time we run these matches together and fix the team chemistry.
THANKS FOR VISITING  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/4BgEBZpHFUafs4zKy1ynCg)

title.body:
Opening 140 minor chests without potions is an interesting choice because it shows a different kind of resource management.

Many players focus only on the chance of high-value pulls, but the cost side matters too. If potions reduce the number of chests you can open or slow down collection building, then skipping them can make sense, especially when the goal is steady accumulation instead of one lucky hit.

That is the part I would track over time: not only what came out of this batch, but whether the no-potion strategy gives better collection progress across several openings. One result can be noisy. A few rounds would tell a better story.

I also like the timing before the finale. Spending Glint before a reset is one of those decisions where the player has to think like a portfolio manager: current utility, future opportunity, and risk of waiting too long.

That makes the chest opening more strategic than it looks at first.

title.body:
I like the balance in this post because it does not treat nature as something distant or decorative.

The photos of ropes, trees, mushrooms, and old wood show a living system where everything is connected. That is usually the part people miss. They see a forest as scenery, but a forest is also movement, decay, support, competition, and renewal happening at the same time.

Your title makes the important point: take advantage without destroying. That idea is simple, but it is not easy. Humans need food, material, medicine, shade, and land. The question is whether we take in a way that leaves the system able to recover.

I also think observation is the first step. When someone spends time looking closely at small things in nature, it becomes harder to treat them as disposable. Attention creates respect. Respect changes behavior.

That is why posts like this matter.

title.body:
The strongest part of these digests is that they make Hive feel spatial, not just chronological.

Most social feeds are built around time: what was posted recently, what got attention, what the algorithm wants to surface. Worldmappin adds a different layer. A post becomes attached to a place, and that changes how people discover it. The tripoint in Jaworzynka, the valley in Himachal Pradesh, and the lake near Walter Peak are not just three travel posts. They become coordinates in a shared map of community memory.

That is a subtle but valuable difference.

It also gives travel writers a reason to be more specific. Location, route, weather, small details, and local context suddenly matter more because the post is not floating alone in a feed. It is part of a map someone else can explore later.

This kind of curation is one of the better examples of Hive doing something that ordinary social platforms usually flatten.
title.author: bitmoving

title.body:
This is probably one of the most practical onboarding improvements Hive can make.

Account creation has always been one of those small frictions that feels minor to existing users and huge to outsiders. People coming from EVM wallets already understand paying a transaction fee or using a stablecoin. They do not always understand resource credits, account tickets, or why creating a Hive account requires a different mental model.

Letting someone create an account with USDC does not only simplify payment. It translates Hive onboarding into a language external crypto users already know. That is the important part.

I also like that this connects directly to Keychain Multichain. If the wallet can handle identity, account creation, and cross-ecosystem assets in one place, Hive becomes less isolated. The chain still keeps its own architecture, but the entry point becomes much less intimidating.

That is where growth usually starts: not with a big slogan, but with one fewer confusing step.
title.author: bitmoving

title.body:
This framing is useful because it separates two things people often mix together: access and ownership.

On most social platforms, users feel like they own the account because they can log in, post, and build an audience. But the real control layer sits somewhere else: database access, moderation policy, API limits, discovery rules, and the ability to erase or throttle the archive. That means the account is more like rented space with a nice interface.

Hive changes the base layer of that relationship. It does not magically solve discovery, moderation, or user experience, but it does give the user a stronger claim over identity and content history. That matters most when something goes wrong.

The hard part is explaining this without sounding abstract. Most people understand ownership only after they lose access somewhere else. Posts like this help because they make the tradeoff concrete before that moment arrives.

title.title: MY HARD EARNED $1000  PROFILE
title.body:
‎Life didn’t end when I lost almost $1,000 that I had been saving for my NYSC in 2025.
‎
‎By God’s grace, I finished school in 2023 and returned home. In May 2024, I went back to school for my clearance, and it was incredibly difficult; it felt like everything was working against me. However, after a lot of back and forth, I managed to get it done.
‎

![IMG_20260609_154220_801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKDiHitKkvEntpK4igoJGPXaTuv3uzfNUKGdo6Tymf6tmMb9SyMGMnJD6CTnc8R.jpg)

‎When I traveled back to Uyo for my clearance, I didn't bring many clothes with me because I had planned to stay for no more than a month. It was almost time for me to go for my NYSC, but I felt a strong prompting in my spirit to stay back and do something for myself in Uyo. This didn't make much sense, as I had no clear plan for what I would do.
‎
‎Thoughts kept echoing in my mind: “How would I survive alone?” I hadn't fully recovered from the four years I spent in university, especially in terms of feeding, and I was now contemplating staying back and intentionally starving myself. It felt that way because there's no place like home especially my mom’s meals.
‎
‎As time went on, I discovered the company I work for now, Chaindustry. Everything seemed to unfold perfectly. After I completed my training, I was employed as a worker, and I felt fulfilled because I had always wanted this.
‎
‎I also had to join the workforce in my church and dedicate myself fully there, it was so satisfying and purposeful all through. I was doing the things of God and it turned out this way, imagine I wasn't doing anything in the house of God.
‎- 
![IMG_20260527_113057_245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/2423uVRAqtV1xKNDKjiDP5USVRjGsGxuSp2YPGoFtQyD3QQQVdF4M5a2NvDbAC3f6m5bp.jpg)

‎There's always this misconception about people who stay away from home to be able to live how they want, but this journey drew me closer to God.
‎
‎During this journey, many of my friends and colleagues went for their service, and I was continually asked when I would be going. The pressure came from every direction—friends, acquaintances, siblings, family, even those who didn't mean me well. Most of the time, I chose to ignore them and shared only a little of my plans with those who mattered.
‎
‎As the story continued, when I received my first salary, I thought, “Why don’t I save this money and use it when I go for service?” So, I began keeping it in my wallet without making any proper investments.
‎
‎For almost seven months, I saved this money, along with the other funds I had accumulated separately. One day, after returning from an event, I decided to check my wallet as I usually did. When I opened it, the money appeared for a few seconds and then vanished. Initially, I thought it was a glitch because I still felt a sense of peace.
‎
‎I told a few friends about it, and they tried to help me track down the person who took the money. The person was seen, but couldn't be traced for various reasons.
‎
‎That night, I went to be with some friends because I was feeling terrible. I was crushed by the thought of how I had denied myself many rewards in anticipation of my future plans to avoid being stranded or worried about anything.
‎
‎I cried a lot that night, even wailing, because everything I had worked so hard for had seemingly vanished into thin air. 
‎
‎I felt so hurt and broken that I couldn't bring myself to tell my parents, but my mom sensed something was wrong and never stopped interceding for me in her prayers. A lot of people never understood because I kept showing up everywhere.
‎
‎Earlier this year, I fell seriously ill, almost to the point of losing my life, but God decided to show me mercy. However, I made many mistakes during this process, including not seeking God's direction, failing to obey His guidance, leaning on my own understanding, and walking by sight rather than by faith.
‎
‎I was trying to calculate everything with my mind, and while it wasn't a bad plan, it was only thoughtful when I analyzed it or discussed it with others. 
‎
‎I found my healing when these words came to me from Scripture: “And why worry about your clothing? Look at the lilies of the field and how they grow. They don’t work or make their clothing; yet Solomon in all his glory was not dressed as beautifully as they are. And if God cares so wonderfully for wildflowers that are here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow, He will certainly care for you. Why do you have so little faith?” [Matthew 6:28-30 NLT]
‎
‎I finally got the lead to go towards the first quarter of 2026 to register for my NYSC, I was managing, just living based on how God helps me. That didn’t eradicate my fears instantly but it made me place everything on God. 
‎
‎Notwithstanding, I've been able to move to this NEXT LEVEL of my life.
‎
‎Even on tough days, I held on to God and His promises.
‎
‎Two years later, without visiting home and choosing to be independent, despite pursuing what I believe God called me to do, I am still here because of His grace. 
‎
‎I may not have everything figured out, but I have learned to have incredible faith in God. Even when things don’t go as planned, I know that God is working something beautiful for my good.
‎
‎This is me now who has chosen to do this with God.
‎
‎I am glad God used this to teach me perseverance and self-discipline.
‎
‎This is not a story of failure but one that automatically points us to how we need God.
‎
‎I've made my family so proud.🥺✨🎉
‎
‎Thank you, Jesus.🤍
‎
‎I hope my story inspires someone out here.🫶🏼
‎ServingOnGodsBudget.. your handsome friend John Petra!
‎
