title.title: That time Jack Black, Matt Dillon an I did Detroit air control
title.body: Are you confused by the title, well you should be because it is a bunch of nonsense. This is the sort of life that exists only in my mind and only on the days that I have very vivid dreams out of nowhere. Last night I was running the Detroit air control for an airport with two celebrities that I really never think of and have no good reason to think of. But the two of them invaded my brain and we had a mostly unsuccessful job to do over and over with the use of the control of telecommunications and also ground transport that we destroyed almost all of.

>
[src](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/MV5BMTk4MjM3NDI3Nl5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTcwNDI1NDMzMw@@._V1_QL75_UX328_.jpg)</center>

When I first woke up from this bizarre dream I thought to myself \

and at least in the case of Matt Dillon there is at least one movie that I am familiar with where he played a cop.  I thought he did an extremely good job in his role in *Crash* and as far as I know it ended up getting nominated for a bunch of awards.  \n\nJack Black is a bit more of a mystery though.  Unlike the general consensus in Hollywood, I do not consider Jack Black to be a talented actor.  I think he is an amazing singer and a \
for sure, but a talented actor?  Not so much.  \n\nThere are a lot of different Jack Blacks out there so I should be more specific.  The one that was in my dream was of the \

variety, which IMO is a very good movie.

<center> https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgjwzTQ2Zq51KrYyExx7nbbnyZtUonqxUg3gLx6EmDuCh-wKtcD8IxmAJllQA0OodP9gjseRiPiMUTRRqCL4oK8_xdo0ZG1xY7rDIKy3J_lLCvU1W3w2ilSbn04mMlVPG_wRNEZGXgAyqA/s1600/EOTS3.jpg
[src](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgjwzTQ2Zq51KrYyExx7nbbnyZtUonqxUg3gLx6EmDuCh-wKtcD8IxmAJllQA0OodP9gjseRiPiMUTRRqCL4oK8_xdo0ZG1xY7rDIKy3J_lLCvU1W3w2ilSbn04mMlVPG_wRNEZGXgAyqA/s1600/EOTS3.jpg)</center>

The silly, slapstick, loud, and obnoxious Jack Black thankfully didn't make an appearance because if he had I probably would have woken up out of frustration.   I had the good fortune of being subjected to the quiet and calculating Jack Black, who actually was the voice of reason when the 3 of us were trying to unsuccessfully land some planes in Detroit outside the airport.

These planes needed to land and for whatever reason we couldn't do it on the normal runways.  So the three of us got out there on the roads in our police cruisers and cleared the way for them to land on winding mountain streets.   

There are no mountains in Detroit and the roads there have no reason to not be completely straight.   Or at least that is my waking impression of it, I have only ever been to Detroit once in my life and that was because I had a job that was taking place in the nearby city of Battle Creek.  This was over 20 years ago and I really don't have any idea about Detroit.

Why Detroit?  I have no idea.  

My brain just kind of goes in some seriously strange loops every now and then.   

Last night right before going to bed I did a couple of things that I don't normally do.  For one thing, I had just finished a book called \

and it was absolutely terrible. I'll do a book review about that at some point I would imagine but just god-awful that book was and it was also very long. So perhaps I was a bit frustrated. However, towards the end of that book the characters in it are in a mountain city in Colorado, so perhaps that had a bit of influence on my mind. The second thing that could have invoked having such a vivid dream could have been that I took a Tramadol before bed last night because my old back injury was acting up. I have mentioned in the past that this synthetic opiate has some rather strange side-effects on the old noggin' when I am trying to sleep. I did sleep rather well though, I will say that... and my back didn't hurt. We ended up getting all the planes on the ground somewhat safely but we did crash all of the cars we were driving multiple times. I wouldn't say that Jack, Matt, and I are particularly good at the job we were tasked with doing. There were very few other cars on the road though, which is probably pretty odd for Detroit.

>
</center> 

I'm not going to bother analyzing this dream, it's too wacky to bother and the psychologists would probably just say that I am avoiding some sort of important change that is necessary in my life because that is what they say no matter what you are dreaming about.

title.title: How I Made A Frontpage Magazine
title.body:
Hi Creative minds! Happy creative Sunday 

So today I will be making a post on how I made a frontpage magazine design which came out so wonderfully well.
It's not a new thing that we can now use AI to make our work easier as designers which still definitely needs our creative minds, thinking ability to call to action for what ever we need else the AI functions still becomes useless.

![1000700689.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23wMQ3qcLVx79Hmxi4HAvJnQ9BAVdqhTSHe9UMEAznModkL9i4aWtetmwukNCERTCZm3a.png)

So I started by getting the picture of the person I wanted to use for facial and body reference with the request of an English outfit and then move over to getting the kind of outfit I want to use for him.


![1000647379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23xKraMNk5Qaahd7zaDJeMruUe3ar1hNv8VYvtrZak98TcRNe8YNAd3eWQPVcp5rXUe8t.jpg)

After getting the outfit, I moved over to chatgpt, uploaded the outfit and the image of the person I want to wear the outfit for and prompted chatgpt to change his outfit to the second image which has just an outfit in it or outfit close to it but with the same combo and it gave me this image below. \

![1000647636.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23tSamFVgT4NKakMEBa1ES2bXFHDptjUx7Zmeg2M2Kh3u3VnGqcD3UyKG7nPpDgYz6LJv.png)

After then, I opened a new chat and prompted chatgpt to generate a frontpage magazine for me with the guy's details which was included in the prompt as seen below.
![1000756737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AJkMH5xcYpAyAFB5AyyZg1MbTwfSsLgepJFhLSVr6KCDUZxLHBfA2x6ctsqFik4.jpg)

I prompted it on the kind of quality image I also want and how I want it so that it doesn't give me an image of low quality and just like I said earlier, for these AI models to do exactly what you want or desire to create then you must be able to be creative and not 100percent reliant on them to give you a perfect work.

At the end of it all, it gave me the exact magazine quality image I wanted with a fully detailed but attractive frontpage birthday magazine.

![1000700689.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23wMQ3qcLVx79Hmxi4HAvJnQ9BAVdqhTSHe9UMEAznModkL9i4aWtetmwukNCERTCZm3a.png)

You can try this out too and let me know how it goes here in the comments section with your feedback.

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are from Chatgpt 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@afrikens/how-i-made-a-frontpage-magazine-b9e)

title.title: INTERNATIONAL CUP (EVENT MATCH)
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2Et3oKVSFiwPLR76trtxJ2E79CJUTFxqa29c6AEY1GG/img_4356.png)
_____________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJkvwYxmKzDozZ8JSkeL15ALMGbj3u78wzjaAA6H9v5V/img_4361.png)
_____________________________________________________

I played 3 matches today and lost all 3, and honestly it was frustrating. The new team I’m using hasn’t clicked yet. The players don’t understand each other, passes are misfiring, runs are late, defense is all over the place. You guys know how it is when you build a new squad — first few games always feel like you’re playing with strangers. We’ll get there, but today was just not our day.

And Konami changed things up too. You remember how we used to wait for POTW every Thursday? Now they’ve switched it to Player of the Day. Anytime there’s a World Cup match or any big international game, they drop the best player from each team that same day. So instead of one big update weekly, we’re getting small updates almost every day. If you guys don’t log in daily you’ll miss some good cards.

That’s why I was grinding the event matches. Win or lose, the POTD cards come out daily now based on real matches. I took 3 Ls but at least I understand the system now. New team + new update style = more pressure to play daily. We’ll bounce back though. Next time we run these matches together and fix the team chemistry.

title.title: ELIXIR Whitepaper
title.body:
![1000024950.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nectarbytes/23uFKT2cpZ58PAybRgpoTws6v7jWZoURMq9oMwPmxZgNyTBW22CfGgFVqBvkNXa64zcHt.png)

NECTAR is a token created by @bulliontools, a member of the Hive Onboarding Committee (HOC) and one of the DUO Project founders.

The goal of the token is to provide the @nectarbytes account with Hive Power to curate the new Mildly Infuriating community, along with other short form content on Hive. The goal of the Mildly Infuriating community is to give all people a place to share their frustrations, and to act as a catalyst in bringing interest from those outside of Hive in hopes of onboarding more people.

# Tokenomics Breakdown
- 200,000 cap (Pre-mined)
- 100,000 reserved for sales
- 100,000 reserved for delegation rewards
- 1 week to unstake in 1 transaction
- No tokens will be held by @bulliontools or @nectarbytes unless purchased with private funds

# Dividends
- Minimum 50 NECTAR staked to qualify
- 50% of curation earnings paid weekly

The initial dividends paid will be provided by @bulliontools. As these funds near depletion, a power down of the @nectarbytes account will be initiated to continue the funding of dividends.

For full transparency in what is backing the project, here are the initial funds the project will start with.

![1000024858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nectarbytes/23t79KtRCQMxyGUK6y3Xnnw2RciqYyZuCZygdUAMvcT7oau4j8wA37uA9KEAXHsvXCBMG.jpg)

# Sales
Sales of NECTAR will be done in tranches, starting on 6/27/26.

All HIVE income generated from this will be powered up.

10k @ 1 HIVE each
50k @ 2 HIVE each
20k @ 3 HIVE each
20k @ 4 HIVE each

# Delegations
Delegators will receive 50% of curation rewards paid in NECTAR based on 50% of the market price. The goal is that as the project matures and token price increases, delegators reap even greater rewards as tranches sell out.

The script for payouts has specifically been coded so that @bulliontools will not receive any NECTAR token payouts regardless of how much HP is delegated from his account.

# Curation
All curation will be done manually. No curation is guaranteed for token stakers or delegators. Any upvotes given are based solely on the merits of the content itself.

# Tokens Earned from Curation
Half of Layer 2 (Hive-Engine) tokens earned through curation will be sold and the HIVE used to fund prize drawings. Fifty percent of these tokens will be staked, while the rest will be sold. This will be used to give away HSBI shares to reward those who engage with people in the community.

# Project Maturity
The project will start small, and will grow steadily. As the HP builds, so do the rewards, and so the NECTAR tokens will eventually all be paid out to delegators and sold on the market. Once this point has been reached, the project will then shift to paying 90% of curation rewards only to those staking 50 or more NECTAR tokens. This heavily rewards those who get in early and continue to support the project, and will help the token maintain value.

title.title: When Sins Begin to Dim the Light of Understanding
title.body: \nA few days ago, I came across this quote, and it stayed in my mind for a long time. At first, it looked like a simple statement, but the more I thought about it, the more I realized how deeply it connects with our daily lives.\nMany people think that intelligence is only about education, degrees, or having a sharp memory. But life teaches us that some highly educated people still make poor decisions, while some ordinary people with little formal education make wise choices. This is where the idea of the \

becomes important.
I remember a personal experience from my student days. There was a period when I became careless about my responsibilities. I wasted hours on things that brought no benefit. I delayed important tasks, ignored good advice, and spent too much time chasing temporary entertainment. At that time, I believed I was enjoying life, but slowly I noticed something strange. My focus became weaker, my decisions became poorer, and I felt confused even about simple matters.
Looking back, I realize that the problem was not a lack of intelligence. The problem was that I was moving away from discipline, sincerity, and self-control. When a person repeatedly ignores what is right, it becomes harder to recognize the right path. The heart becomes less sensitive, and the mind starts justifying mistakes.
One thing I have learned is that every action leaves an effect on us. Good deeds bring peace and clarity. Helping others, speaking the truth, fulfilling responsibilities, and remembering Allah create a sense of balance within us. On the other hand, bad habits and sinful actions create a kind of inner darkness. It may not be visible, but its effects can be seen in our choices and behavior.
I have also observed this in people around me. Whenever someone becomes trapped in harmful habits, they often begin making decisions that seem irrational from the outside. Friends and family may advise them, but they continue moving in the wrong direction. It is not because they suddenly lost their intelligence. Rather, their judgment has become clouded.
This is why many scholars describe sin as something that affects not only the soul but also the mind. It weakens the ability to distinguish clearly between benefit and harm. The person may still know facts and information, but wisdom becomes harder to find.
At the same time, this message is not about hopelessness. Every human being makes mistakes. The beauty of life is that we are always given opportunities to correct ourselves. A sincere apology, genuine repentance, and a commitment to improve can change the direction of a person's life.
I have experienced this myself. Whenever I focused on prayer, became more disciplined, and tried to avoid harmful habits, I noticed a positive change in my thinking. My mind felt clearer. Decisions became easier. Problems that once seemed complicated became manageable. It felt as if a fog had lifted.
In today's world, we often invest a lot of effort in improving our knowledge and skills. These things are important, but we should also pay attention to our character and actions. A strong mind needs a clean heart. Knowledge gives information, but wisdom helps us use that information correctly.
The quote reminds us that the greatest loss is not the loss of wealth or status. The greatest loss is when a person loses the inner light that helps them recognize truth and make wise decisions.
May we all strive to protect that light through honesty, good actions, self-reflection, and faith. Because when the light of understanding remains alive, it guides us through even the darkest moments of life.

## 🌐 La vida en las comunidades de Hive — 14 de junio de 2026

Hoy quiero hacer algo distinto. En lugar del reporte clasico con numeros frios, quiero hablar de lo que realmente mueve esta red: las comunidades. Porque al final, Hive no es solo tecnologia blockchain, es gente. Y la gente se reune en comunidades.

### 📍 Comunidades con mas movimiento

Mire las estadisticas de las comunidades mas activas y esto fue lo que encontre:

• **Ecency** — 0 subscriptores
• **Photography Lovers** — 0 subscriptores
• **Freewriters** — 0 subscriptores
• **Worldmappin** — 0 subscriptores
• **Hive Learners** — 0 subscriptores
• **LeoFinance** — 0 subscriptores

Lo interesante es que la mayoria de estas comunidades tienen contenido variado y de calidad. No es solo un tema, hay de todo. Y eso habla bien del ecosistema.

### 🏆 Post destacados de comunidades

Estos son los posts que mas estan dando que hablar en las comunidades hoy:

💎 **$22.85** — [@modernzorker en **hive-154356**](https://hive.blog/@modernzorker/the-critical-role-of-digital-preservation-in-gaming-history)

Cada uno de estos posts merece un vistazo. Pase por algunos y deje comentarios porque vale la pena apoyar el contenido original.

### 🔥 Top general de la red

💎 **$22.85** — [@modernzorker — \

](https://hive.blog/@zgaetano/de-vuelta-a-correr-esp-eng)

### 📊 Datos rapidos

• **107.276.371** bloques procesados
• **2.615.054** cuentas en la red
• **38.0%** del supply stakeado — la comunidad confia
• **118 upvotes** vs **0 downvotes** en el periodo

### 💬 Un poco de feeling

La verdad que cuando uno se pone a revisar comunidad por comunidad, se da cuenta de algo: Hive esta vivo. No es solo trading ni precios. Hay gente creando, compartiendo, curando. A veces nos enfocamos tanto en el precio que nos olvidamos de lo importante: el contenido y la gente que lo genera.

Hoy especialmente vi movimiento en **Ecency**, con posts que realmente valen la pena. Si no estas participando activamente en al menos una comunidad, te recomiendo que te metas. Es ahi donde realmente se siente el pulso de la red.

¿Cual es tu comunidad favorita? ¿En cual pasas mas tiempo? Dejalo en los comentarios, los leo a todos!

title.title: [ENG - ESP] Good bye to this week 💫🌼🌇
title.body: /> Hello, dear Hive community! Today we say goodbye to this week to start a new one, and I must say I feel a level of excitement I haven't felt in a long time. This week I’ve been highly motivated, eager to get things done and step out of my comfort zone—without necessarily having to jump into an extreme adventure (or at least, activities that would be extreme for me). You could say I’ve found a balance, a sweet spot in how I organize my days and what to do to stay motivated. It also has to do with the fact that there’s been some adrenaline lately. As I mentioned before, now that I'm in my thirties, I’m studying again, and well, this was exam week. I had spent quite a while studying at my desk at home, with my kitty by my side—which is my absolute favorite thing—but the truth is, I needed a change of scenery, to breathe some fresh air, and see the daylight. So, I’ve been rotating from library to library to change environments, which is great for keeping the brain active and away from monotony and boredom.

/>\n\nI love reading and studying a lot, but it’s completely normal for the mind to get tired after spending hours trying to absorb contents that can sometimes be quite dense. Plus, having my bed so close at home makes it way too easy to fall into the \

trap. Instead, my breaks this week consisted of going outdoors, sitting in a park for a moment having a drink, people-watching, or going for a short walk. Definitely much better for my mental health. I can also say that in my job as a piano teacher, I was able to support my students through their achievements this week, like mastering a new piece or song. Being able to share that satisfaction and motivation to learn with them is the most beautiful part of teaching.

/> Overall, it has been a wonderful week, and I hope to maintain this emotional balance no matter what happens with my work, studies, and responsibilities in the coming week. Even though I sometimes think I could be doing more and better, I catch myself and remember that the important thing is to enjoy the process. Keep that in mind too: go through your week taking good care of yourselves and loving yourselves deeply.
>Thanks for reading, see you next time! ✨🌸

>Spanish | Español _¡Hola querida comunidad de Hive! Hoy nos despedimos de la semana para empezar una nueva y he de decir que me siento emocionada como no me sentía hace tiempo. Esta semana he estado muy motivada y con ganas de hacer cosas y salir de mi zona de confort sin necesariamente tener que lanzarme a alguna aventura extrema (actividades que para mí serían extremas). Se puede decir que he encontrado un balance, un equilibrio en cuanto a cómo organizar mis días y qué cosas hacer para mantenerme motivada._ _También tiene que ver con que ha habido adrenalina estos días. Les comenté que ahora a mis treinta años estoy estudiando otra vez, y bueno, esta fue semana de exámenes. Llevaba un buen tiempo estudiando en mi escritorio en casa, con mi gatita a mi lado, que es lo que más me gusta, pero es verdad que necesitaba variar de espacios, respirar el aire de afuera y ver la luz del día. Así que anduve rotando un poco de biblioteca en biblioteca para cambiar de ambiente, lo cual es bueno para mantener el cerebro activo y alejado de la monotonía y el aburrimiento._

/>\n\n_Me encanta estar leyendo mucho y estudiando, pero es normal que la mente se canse al pasar horas esforzándose por asimilar contenidos en ocasiones bastante densos, y teniendo la cama cerca en casa es fácil caer en, \

, en cambio para mí esta semana los descansos han sido salir al aire libre, sentarme un momento en un parque bebiendo algo, mirando a la gente pasar o caminando un poco. En definitiva mucho mejor para mi salud mental._\n\n

/> _También puedo decir que en mi trabajo como profesora de piano esta semana he podido acompañar a mis alumnos en logros como poder tocar una pieza o canción nueva y he podido compartir con ellos esa satisfacción y motivación por aprender que son lo más bonito de la enseñanza._ _En general ha sido una muy buena semana y espero poder mantenerme en este equilibrio emocional pase lo que pase con mi trabajo, estudios y responsabilidades esta semana que entra. Aunque a veces piense que podría estar haciendo más y mejor, luego rectifico y recuerdo que lo importante es disfrutar el proceso. Recuérdenlo ustedes también, y continuen esta semana cuidándose y amándose mucho._

Maybe I should start off from how positive my Sunday has been right from early morning. When you think it may not [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) out, just live everything to God. The Holy ghost has His way of leading only if you will comply. Soft whispers that can make your day. And I can say, ‘authority is not noise’. How I used to imagine that God will always thunder his [voice](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-voice) to prove He just spoke. It is not that way; pay attention to that still small voice.   

Breaking into the next paragraph; pride aside, but there is a way you can live your [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) and attract very specific attention. My first take [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) advice, build [character](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-character-film), it will go a long way. Ok, it has been another [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity) to join in a celebration. It was a family incoming that spurred joy in everyone's heart. I may not be too good at jumping around but I was so very happy about the news. How easy the entire birthing process went. At least we have heard of several complications during child [birth](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-birth); the [risk](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-risk) of losing the child or [mother](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-mother-mom) or even both.

So it is something to really thank God for.  

I was there right in the atmosphere of the naming. title.title: Striking A Win-Win Balance Through Corporate Damage Control
title.body:
Corporate Deception
Hello #qccommunity, Happy weekend. I trust your day is going well. I smiled while reading this theme. This is because I have worked in different cadres and departments of the organisation, as a customer service rep and as a member of the management team. Therefore, have tasted the good, the bad, and the ugly aspects of this caption “Corporate Deception”. But the honest feedback I have here is simple:” he who holds the piper dictates the tune.” ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmatiBxm6jivCCCqBCdrAvTVQeCA68GNR86duoP8V6wbWr/image.png) [Walls.io](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1676276374324-db790020bdbd?q=80&w=1170&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Corporate deception could be defined as a damage control strategy. No corporate entity can own up to anything like corporate deception. However, sometimes, a company may have product defects during production. To avoid incurring further losses from that defect, the production, branding, and marketing teams will present a strategy that will enable them to sell those products. That strategy will present those products with sellable features that will hide those defects. Furthermore, there will be a knowledge check to repackage those products and present them to the market so that the defects will not be noticeable. For example, I recently bought a rechargeable fan. It was supposed to come with a mosquito repellent as indicated on the package; unfortunately, it was not the case. When I got home and read through the functions indicated in the manual, I noticed that the repellent was not included in the package. I reached out to the retailer, and after explaining the defects, she transferred my call to the customer care unit, where I was told that the repellent feature was in the promo package for fans. Unfortunately, the promo has ended, and the feature is no longer included. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTPLVeauCA9qJcAniCGYbePPgUgmSnGQuxZotGdGfQsX6/image.png) [Geralt](https://pixabay.com/images/download/geralt-businesswoman-571153_1920.jpg) At that point, I got confused, reached out to the manual, and read it to the hearing of the customer care personnel, who subtly insisted and politely gave me an option to upgrade to a higher and costlier brand if I wanted that feature, subtly insisting that the repellent feature only appeared on the brand I bought as a promo package. At that juncture, I gave up and stuck with the one I bought since I can spray insecticide when I need it. There are other examples where some companies present a false narrative of a lack of funds to avoid high operational costs. Sometimes, too, I see this kind of scenario as a diplomatic way of managing resources and organisational prowess. The most common corporate deception, so to speak, is this product defect. It can lead to legal battles between companies and customers. It can also cause anger, leading to disloyalty and massive loss of customers to competitors. This is because it often happens as a production error, and if not well managed, the production manager and other staff will pay for the defects; hence, to manage the situation and reduce the cost for the management and production teams. They devise this corporate deception as an undercover tactic to reduce losses. After all, prevention is better than a cure. Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/@queercoin/qc-community-weekly-contest-192) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNuMfTAA1AxpzhRHgUorX8qW4vvQDtAhsCwsNG3LFgh1S/image.png)

title.title: Mrs Ocean, that immense blue blanket
title.body:
Sitting by the huge hotel window overlooking the sea this morning, I saw a post in my feed on Hive. Actually, I was taking my morning coffee before my gig in that hotel and had no plans to write any post today but the challenge I saw was interesting enough to make me get back to it later and check it well. The [Ocean Lovers community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-120883/created) has a new topic for this week, the fourth in a row, and it is:

>***Wk4 Best ocean photo! Choose a spectacular ocean photo from your archive and tell us about when it was taken.***


<sub>You can check out the challenge by yourself by clikcing on this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-120883/@oceanlovers/week-4-ocean-lovers-challenge).</sub>


My rational thoughts were asking me: *What are you doing? You are not even a photographer to have a good (let alone spectacular) photo of the ocean, and the pictures you had of the ocean taken in January of 2023 were already shared on Hive.* Then my other thoughts, those that are not so rational, fought back: *You can find those photos you didn't share...* 

Only if I knew what a challenge it would be to find! 😂

Anyway, I listened to these thoughts and made myself search for the photos from that trip we made in southern Spain and Portugal three years ago, and found, as expected, almost nothing! 


Well, three photos that I haven't shared are more than none! 😁 



<center>![IMG-20230102-WA0001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mipiano/Eqd9XUNGjLvzEhjqEg6LURzsbHwgCwaZ5eWyfzB3ftY6kyozzZZqcBmjhNetFgYFNue.jpg)</center>

<sub>They still don't meet the requirement of being spectacular, I know.</sub>

What makes this first one special for me is that it was my first time meeting Mrs Ocean, as I called her in [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-155530/@mipiano/the-place-where-the-mediterranean-sea-and-the-atlantic-ocean-meet). The day was very cloudy. Everything looked gloomy, just not our hearts, which were beating at a happy pace in this place where the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean meet. In case you are wondering who the people are in the photo, I can reveal that huge secret: it is me with my son, in Punta de Tarifa, the southernmost point of the Iberian Peninsula.

Let's leave behind the cloudy skies and move to the sunny part of the post. We also moved our place, as the next photo was taken a few days later in Portugal, in the mecca for surfers - Nazaré.

<center>![IMG-20230107-WA0011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mipiano/23qrN3FHQwnon41iAYh87B4hoYhSGqLDJb7v3Q9WwGBxPzb46qA1UYr6givyAJ6rHUDck.jpg)</center>

I haven't shared this photo when I made my post [Nazaré](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@mipiano/nazare-portugal-the-mecca-for-surfers) as the model is not so pretty, but the background is what matters here. The ocean.

Which word would I choose if I had to describe it in one word? Immense, powerful, scary, lovely, beautiful, sublime, salty, fragrant, deep, harmonic with its sound? 



<center>![IMG_20230106_123937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mipiano/Ep5mCmXaLUrfmYBn2Upa71nNxzBJc2YseDWT4D3jaCyZVmFmWJNNvB4rYoCKDPDHumW.jpg)</center>

Probably, it is not even the word that matters. The photo can justify itself by showing how tiny and microscopic we humans can be in the face of such a huge force as this blue blanket.

title.title: Ten kilometres on the ridges, pizza at midday, and a choir of hundreds at Cankarjev dom [#poprzeczka June 2026 #14]
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0D42AA86-EB6C-4901-82FA-F3ED611486B51781474034.870848) ### Morning — coffee and a slow start The neighbour and the coffee, again. The kind of Sunday ritual that feels like it's been happening forever, even if it started just yesterday. No rush, no plan — just the second cup and a conversation that fills the space between thoughts. ### Late morning — the Rašica loop Then the run. An easy 10 km trail out to the village of Rašica and back — up the eastern ridge, down the western one. [Ten point two six kilometres in seventy-nine minutes, 829 calories burned](https://ecency.com/@ervin-lemark/18915743646-4168485219). The kind of run where the legs remember what they're for. The kind of morning the step counter loves. ### Midday — the whole family walks Back home, then the midday doggy walk — with a rare guest. Son joined us, which doesn't happen often at midday. A short rarity worth noting. Lunch was takeaway pizza from the local parlor. Then an afternoon siesta, because Sunday allows it. ### Evening — Dan najlepših sanj at Cankarjev dom ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0D42AA86-EB6C-4901-82FA-F3ED611486B51781474051.968106) The evening ended in the city. Pop zbor's annual concert — Dan najlepših sanj — in [Gallus Hall at Cankarjev dom](https://www.cd-cc.si/en/culture/lease-event/pop-zbor-dan-najlepsih-sanj). Twelve hundred people in the audience, 430 singers on stage. A [contemporary vocal collective that brings together hundreds of singers of different ages and backgrounds](https://www.popzbor.com/ljubljana), performing [pop and rock classics in fresh choral arrangements](https://ljubljanainfo.com/dogodek/pop-zbor-dan-najlepsih-sanj/395297). The largest ensemble ever on that stage. The sound filled the hall in a way that smaller audiences and screens simply can't replicate. ### Night — walks without the tracker Late night doggy walks, without the tracker this time. The steps don't count if you don't count them — but the miles still happened. ### The [#poprzeczka](https://ecency.com/trending/poprzeczka) Day **14** of June. The bar would have been set at **14,000 steps**. The final count landed at **18,700** — a number that would have cleared the challenge with room to spare. But the challenge is over for me anyway, so this is just a report for the fun of keeping the habit. A good Sunday: a proper run on the ridges, pizza, family, and a concert that reminded you why 1,200 people still go to the theatre instead of staying home with a screen. Still not the end of the month. Still not a reason to stop. The next day is always a new start. ### Highlights | | | |---|---| | Activity | Details | | Morning | Coffee with the neighbour, again | | Late morning | Easy 10 km trail run to Rašica and back (eastern ridge out, western back) | | Midday | Doggy walk with son — a rarity, takeaway pizza for lunch, afternoon siesta | | Evening | Pop zbor annual concert — Dan najlepših sanj, Cankarjev dom, Gallus Hall | | Night | Doggy walks without the tracker | | Steps | **18,700** | | Goal | [#poprzeczka](https://ecency.com/trending/poprzeczka) June day 14 — 14,000 steps ✅ | **better and better** :ervin :lemark > 🤖 The words in this post were conjured by an AI assistant (Perplexity Comet), working from the human's notes, step counts, and lived experience. title.body:
![GridArt_20260614_135141034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNpLh742vKJsThMtSPuuswpSkV7X3yvBih4w2KZ9Edwns/GridArt_20260614_135141034.jpg)

# Photography in Bali on one of our trips on a sunny and very hot and sultry day

Hello friends, I have prepared new photos that day 
This is Bali, and we were walking around the city and I did a lot of photography.
The weather was so hot and sultry that I was lethargic, even in the photo.

It was sunny for a moment, and the weather was sultry for a moment, and for a moment it was raining and it was taking us by surprise

Overall, the weather was great and one enjoys walking in its beautiful nature

We felt so good when we were there. 

And now I still want to be there and enjoy that relaxing atmosphere

What was interesting was that the speed of driving there was slow because in my country, 

everyone drives at high speeds, which attracted my attention and they drove with a certain calmness 
 
This cute dog was enjoying life and was lying there.

There were so many Hindu temples in Bali that it was beyond my imagination that they even said that Hindus each had a separate temple next to their house, 

and think about how interesting each house would be a temple 

They worship every day and have their own temple

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 14 2026 || Alive And Thriving Sunday
title.body:
> Greetings to you all dear actifitters and happy Sunday to you all. What a glorious and wonderful worship day today has been to care for our fitness. Sunday is usually a worship, tree rest and visit day for many. For me it is more than that as I engaged in my fitness health walk from home at Ikot Ekwere Ataidung at Urua Ekpa to attend the weekend Christian meeting where we congregate to worship, incite one another to fine and love works. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7ce79c60-ff99-46ec-ab45-198dab95f9b5.jpg) Though I had flu late hours of Saturday and all through the night into this morning, my wife gave me some tablets that later brings me back to my feet and I am happy to engage in other activities of the day. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bb2f3bd9-d90f-4575-98ef-597bc473cea9.jpg) Since a healthy person makes a wealthy nation and contribute positively, I decided to walk to stay healthy and remain fit both physically and mentally which helps me to be productive for myself, immediate family and the society at large in my little way. Attending the Christian meeting gave me the opportunity to learn that the wicked one is responsible for the social vices that characterise the entire world today. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4e36a1bd-3a3b-46f8-a781-50425172cd01.jpg) Interacting and exchanging pleasantries to fellow worshippers is one vital part of peaceful coexistence we learn to practice now in this me-first world. And of course in the promise new world peace amongst men of all races will reign. Walking back home with other friends gave me the opportunity to chart and discuss other things we share in common. Being among these ones makes me feel relaxed, safe and secure. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e687c663-cfc7-48ee-8a17-7e4ec74d5581.jpg) In summary, my Sunday may have stated out with carry over flu and headache, but the end of the Sunday is exciting, rewarding and feeling refreshed. That make my walk to stay fit impressive for the day as I make over 8,300 steps and it is hereby reported in my Actifit Report Card. Nice having you all onboard the actifit fitness health sportstalk. Keep pace with the week's activities. Looking forward to seeing you tomorrow.. I remains @oasiskp2.

title.title: Splinterlands: End of Season Review – Final Hours!
title.body: Good morning warriors! The season is just few hours to end and for me it was \

**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)





I participated in three leagues this season: Frontier Ranked, Modern Ranked, and Survival. Here’s how I performed.


**Frontier Ranked**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQJiAzxVKsYFVGjAVkibHHT9KVB5VERGqUpzuxRoYoXRo/1781407022492.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJmRqsQtqS1s2wBTn2uS4Wk7Sq3tTojJejd7hN4NNJzn/1781467619625.jpg)


Frontier ranked is always an exciting league, and I’ve consistently established myself in Gold 1 whenever the trophy count resets to **2,500** for a new season. My target 🎯 is to hit **4,000** counts. So far, I’ve reached **3,540**.
In addition, I really enjoyed Frontier Ranked, especially with the introduction of the Lux Favor Wheel(Valor Wheel),where you spin the wheel once per day for free and you get a random reward from the available prizes on the wheel.(Spark currency, frontier energy, battle challenges/pit fight entries etc.)
Lastly, before the season finally ends, I still have 7 chests yet to be opened. These were obtained from the daily 15 victories rewards, which give 3 chests. Not a single DEC was spent — it was all from just winning battles. I’d round it up to 10 chests. That’s 50 foundation cards, and that’s a lot.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVUhBNYWG53nSeutGDrLaUHvGWy7SowPexpc7SGHNGSPh/1781437083062.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)


**Modern ranked**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMCV2WKGpbB3mP78eUfaEWDGmTbvrm1Y9RW26UK7Xh2n/1781471078850.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJeAS4yUeDHF9FTENkru9x6mH28UpB4dckmjBrQzaFQp/1781473244609.jpg)



I really had high hopes for this league, but it was tough. Last season, I managed to reach Diamond III, but this season I stopped at Gold I — **2,600** rating points to be precise. This definitely affected my Glints target.
As they say in the community, win or lose, there’s always something to learn. I’m expecting a total of around **30,000** Glints.
Moving forward, it’s high time I bring in the Dragons (Archons and Units) if I really want to push up the ranks.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

**SURVIVAL**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeF4gcmPRFJgfhZE6fNUQMUoummhJphC88No8TRJHNbqR/1781407619428.jpg)![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWd7ioQYeg5EHtDRoVq2nFDT8KmNXfzmw8KPPewBeTdqD/1781407619540.jpg)

This is my second experience in Survival. In my very first, I entered as a novice and got to Silver III.This season I entered as adept II,and at the moment, I am at Silver II, still counting, and I have a guarantee of at least two cards and 25,000 glints as rewards.
I am using Survival as compensation for the glints I could not achieve in modern ranked.

**The Survival Leaderboard(adept II), displaying my position(10th) and possible rewards**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQNq1XLT9RDZ7F4aYwTk1EVVWNdu5rfoptWxSJaVUiie/1781408441250.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading my post. @zusi78 signing off.
See you next season in battlefield!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3Po5XTffZDQfLVv6ftrDnbv3hKcAoZsVsPs8r9ZhySC/1767438491028.jpg)

title.title: Arte por cualquier parte/Art Everywhere (Esp-Eng)
title.body:
> Hola, mis amigos. Con gran placer los saludo este domingo. Espero que todos estén disfrutando una linda jornada. Aquí en Cuba, uno a veces piensa que el arte bueno está solo en La Habana, con sus museos deslumbrantes y sus galerías de esas que hasta el aire acondicionado parece caro. Pero no. En Bauta, la cosa se pone fina en la Galería Guerrero y su arte sin careta. La cosa cambia cuando llegas Bauta, ese municipio que muchos conocen porque pertenece a la provincia Artemisa. Lo que muchos no saben es que allí, en medio de ese andar de pueblo, hay un lugar donde hay arte por todas partes, la Galería Guerrero. Estas fotos son de hoy, de esta mañana que me tocó visitar tan singular sitio por asuntos de trabajo. >Hello, my friends. It is my great pleasure to greet you this Sunday. I hope you are all enjoying a lovely day. > >Here in Cuba, one sometimes thinks that good art is only in Havana, with its dazzling museums and galleries where even the air conditioning seems expensive. But no. In Bauta, things get refined at the Guerrero Gallery and its unmasked art. Things change when you arrive in Bauta, a municipality many know because it belongs to Artemisa province. What many don’t know is that there, in the midst of that small-town rhythm, there is a place where art is everywhere: the Guerrero Gallery. These photos are from today, from this morning when I had to visit such a unique place for work.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxjhfiZ4cxe527UZrEZtUWaLUznDbPwoJpMAWUpAZaNZ/1781472613076.jpg)

>





Un lugar que visito cada mes y donde me siento feliz. El nombre Guerrero no es para que te asustes. No es una galería de peleas, sino de las que ponen los cinco sentidos a trabajar. El espacio es pequeño y modesto pero con tremenda personalidad. No esperes lujos ni grandes marquesinas. Pero lo que tienen adentro es lo que vale, una muestra constante de creadores de los pies a la cabeza. A veces creadores del terruño y otras veces hasta creadores internacionales.

>A place I visit every month and where I feel happy. Don’t let the name \

[Warrior] scare you. It’s not a gallery of fights, but the kind that puts your five senses to work. The space is small and modest but with tremendous personality. Don’t expect luxuries or big marquees. But what they have inside is what counts—a constant showcase of creators through and through. Sometimes local creators, and other times even international ones.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5s1dFL6jEeT22gK7inaqKu2KKk4etJs8Ws8dq6UVMTf/1781472896859.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTj9Z9pP6cHnLTE8xRdYGfmfziisPNChANrseyQiUC3ww/1781472897037.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVT6tL2a9TaaZCRy7wxHBdd3wvjWHHiXQJhoCrToiiiwe/1781472897196.jpg)

> Y lo mejor de todo, aquí no hay favoritismo. Siempre están rotando exposiciones individuales y colectivas. Eso quiere decir que un día vas y ves a un pintor local con sus óleos llenos de color y sabor, con esos paisajes que parecen sacados de un sueño guajiro. A la semana siguiente, te encuentras con una instalación audiovisual que te deja bizco, con videoarte que te mete dejan volando el pensamiento. Y en otra esquina, un escultor con sus piezas de metal o barro que parece que van a hablar. >And best of all, there’s no favoritism here. They are always rotating solo and group exhibitions. That means one day you go and see a local painter with his oils full of color and flavor, with those landscapes that seem taken from a peasant’s dream. The following week, you come across an audiovisual installation that leaves you cross-eyed, video art that makes your mind wander. And in another corner, a sculptor with metal or clay pieces that look like they’re about to speak.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBVMz8r9mwywMS5Wxkuvytb9ruq9Y4KdLbY7JyTGTgfA/1781472948024.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVQd71b7zAXkFQEfF3mq7cLJQbwbHgLmKKCvGUNqsRKo7/1781472948204.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUcA9uZeZ59kkWJyJ17oC7iGcF38YxGtyFUi7gZRXg3t/1781472980608.jpg)

> En esta galería, las pinturas cobran vida, paisajes que suspiran, rostros que sueñan. Cada pincelada es un latido, cada color, una emoción atrapada en silencio. Así que tanto el que pinta con brocha gorda como el que trabaja la cámara o el cincel, tienen su momento en la Guerrero. Y el público responde. Allí te ves desde la abuela que nunca había entrado a una galería hasta el muchacho de corneta que va a grabar para su canal de Youtube. Es una mezcla bien sabrosa, sin etiquetas ni academicismos raros. Como debe ser. >In this gallery, paintings come to life—landscapes that sigh, faces that dream. Each brushstroke is a heartbeat, each color an emotion trapped in silence. So whether you paint with a wide brush or work with a camera or chisel, you get your moment at the Guerrero. And the public responds. There you’ll see everyone from the grandmother who had never set foot in a gallery to the young guy with a horn who comes to record for his YouTube channel. It’s a really tasty mix, without labels or odd academicisms. As it should be.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYNh1EkPWkppeLFU87dLsKHqsaypQBEjBd2QSjUGTyFhA/1781473025695.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7GMsBzxAF63Uj1rPrQSz879BkLLDN52KjVcHu9omLVt/1781473025880.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGPXrka9nQnr4Eekg5YDAGn25RSLAtc2iT4arCUBc7MC/1781473026090.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPgp2dCuiutyJkChGWWCmKCJymPwkjgPDkxumn3veuC7d/1781473026286.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuYN5WyBWyuDeDKuUdudwknpUFKX5svQt83Zh1UXVauf/1781473026558.jpg)

>




El poblado de Bauta, con su calor y su gente de pueblo, se ha ganado un lugar en el mapa del arte contemporáneo cubano gracias a esta galería. Porque el arte no es solo para los entendidos ni para los que viven en el centro,  la gente del \

tambien la sabe apreciar y sobre todo la sabe realizar. Porque el arte se hace en los barrios, en los municipios, en esa esquina donde el vecino te pregunta qué estás mirando. \n\n>The town of Bauta, with its heat and its down-to-earth people, has earned a place on the map of contemporary Cuban art thanks to this gallery. Because art is not only for experts or for those who live in the center—people from the \

can appreciate it too, and above all, they can create it. Because art is made in the neighborhoods, in the municipalities, on that corner where a neighbor asks you what you’re looking at.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQPm7frim3HGkmC1THPmDrkE3CcM5FNoE8PdyNvDHYBoY/1781473076847.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEdWp7bBtDwBBPGGjE68bmmtbLXXy7m79jV5piWfrQwS/1781473076889.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF9EytUNM4qqGFbq6sK66KGYmetzvVGbCtH7KXLpfDVY/1781473076936.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfS8EGQUauTuZnP2cosmvu1s7c8HSUPahskZBhHD89H9S/1781473076976.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJMbabK9mWtNceFAM4Dz5oWLeXSmZy6TVsTEUVJUMHBT/1781473077013.jpg)

The kind of Saturday where the alarm clock is a suggestion, not a rule. The doggy walk happened, as it always does — the one non-negotiable part of the morning. ### Late morning — coffee with the neighbour A coffee with the neighbour, the kind of slow, unhurried conversation that fills a morning properly. No deadlines, no screens, just talk and caffeine. ### Midday — vegetables from the farm in Zadobrova A short trip to the local farm in Zadobrova — minor vegetable shopping, the kind that connects you to the land even if it's just a bag of tomatoes and a bunch of greens. Followed by lunch at home. Another doggy walk after — the midday ritual, as reliable as the morning one. ### Evening — out in Trzin The evening took us to Trzin. Visited the tennis court, then beer with friends. The kind of Saturday evening that feels earned. ### Night — dark walk with the dog A final doggy walk in the dark, closing the day the way it started — with the leash, the path, and a companion who doesn't care about step counts or challenges. ### The [#poprzeczka](https://ecency.com/trending/poprzeczka) Day **13** of June. The bar was set at **13,000 steps**. The final count stopped at **8,000** — the fourth miss, though by now the challenge is over for me anyway. No stakes, just the habit of reporting. title.title: Walking by faith
title.body:
![D04F0F98-B78F-479B-BDAB-C277349D5B0F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23tvrqHpzqCUwDBKbWnaLSg7T9ZVP9kRsobFZbZ36PpZ4LjcS5cNGywVdkDr7Fn1w5Kig.jpeg)

***

Bible Story: Abraham's Journey of Faith
 (Genesis 12:1-9)
Abraham’s journey is one of the most iconic examples of walking in faith. God called Abraham to leave his homeland, his people, and his father’s household to go to a land that God would show him. Without a map, clear directions, or knowing what lay ahead, Abraham obeyed and stepped out in faith. Along the way, God reaffirmed His promise to make Abraham the father of many nations and to bless him greatly. Abraham built altars and worshiped God as he traveled, showing his trust and dependence on Him.
Despite challenges and uncertainties, Abraham’s unwavering belief in God’s promises became a foundation of his life. His faith was counted as righteousness, and he became known as the \

Abraham’s journey teaches us that walking in faith often requires stepping into the unknown and trusting God’s plan, even when it doesn’t make sense. Faith is not just about believing in God but acting on His Word, even when the path is unclear. Abraham’s obedience reminds us that God’s promises are certain, and His guidance is faithful. As we walk in faith, we, too, can experience God’s blessings and become part of His greater plan.

Keeping the fire of faith burning begins with prayer. Prayer is the heartbeat of our spiritual journey, a direct line to God that fuels our trust and connection with Him. Whether it’s a whispered prayer in moments of doubt or a joyful celebration of His blessings, consistent communication with God keeps our hearts aligned with His purpose. It’s through prayer that we find strength, guidance, and the reassurance that we are never alone.

Worship also keeps our faith alive, serving as a way to connect deeply with God. Through singing, reflection, or acts of gratitude, worship shifts our focus from our struggles to His greatness. It ignites our spirit and fills us with renewed passion to serve and trust Him. Coupled with worship, surrounding ourselves with a community of believers provides encouragement and accountability, reminding us that we are not alone on this journey.
Faith flourishes when put into action. Acts of service, kindness, and obedience to God’s will not only bless others but also deepen our walk with Him 

Through daily faithfulness, we grow stronger spiritually and reflect Christ to others.

Hello beautiful ladies, happy blessed Sunday to you all, today I will love to talk about accountability because it is what I have been working on this past few years myself. When we talk about accountability it the willingness to take responsibility for our choices and actions, It is the courage to look in the mirror and ask ourselve what part did we play in those situation, and what can we learn from it.
To be honest the true is growth comes when we hold ourselves to the same standards we expect from others, and one of the things I leant is that not every disappointment is our fault, but every lesson is our responsibility, accountability is admitting when we are wrong, apologizing when we hurt others which I know is very difficult, learning from our mistakes, and making better decisions moving forward, It is choosing growth over pride and wisdom over excuses.
And another thing I realised is that I cannot control everything that happens to me, but I can control how I responds. We can celebrate our victories, but let us also own our mistakes,  there is no shame in being imperfect, The shame is only in refusing to learn, accountability those not make us weak, and strength is not only found in our ability to endure, nurture, and rise above challenges, strength is also found in our ability to say I was wrong.
So my dear beautiful ladies let us start taking accountability for everything we do.

title.title: The Beautiful Dome: Science World Goes Full FIFA for World Cup 2026
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPswbtjPVKwq4dZvPiioo14BHMYTfcQR4ZFCjG1CfShvA/1781472862373.jpg)

If you’ve ever stood on the seawall in Vancouver and looked east toward False Creek, you know that Science World’s geodesic dome is one of those landmarks that just *stops* you. There’s nothing quite like it. So when I heard that the dome was being transformed — not just decorated, but *fully wrapped* — into a giant replica of the FIFA World Cup match ball, I had to know more. And honestly? It’s even more spectacular than I imagined.

## From Expo ’86 to the World’s Biggest Pitch

Science World has a way of showing up for Vancouver’s biggest moments. That iconic dome was first unveiled to the world at Expo ’86, forty years ago. Now, as the city prepares to host seven FIFA World Cup 2026™ matches at nearby BC Place, the dome has been reborn as *The Beautiful Dome* — a 360-degree, 40-metre-diameter recreation of the adidas Trionda, the official match ball of this historic tournament.

The installation consists of 131 custom-shaped panels that were installed over roughly four weeks, wrapping the entire structure in the Trionda’s distinctive design. The finished result became one of the most photographed and shared images of Vancouver’s World Cup buildup — drone footage of it has been circulating globally, and people are genuinely stopping in their tracks when they see it.

## What is the Trionda?

The Trionda — which means “three waves” in Spanish — was designed to honour the three host nations: Canada, Mexico, and the United States. This is the first time in FIFA World Cup history that three countries have co-hosted, and the ball’s design symbolises connection and collaboration across borders. Seeing that imagery stretched across a 40-metre dome? The symbolism lands hard.

## Inside the Dome: Science Meets the Beautiful Game

The transformation isn’t just exterior. Inside the giant soccer ball, Science World is hosting the North American premiere of *Soccer & Technology from the FIFA Museum* — a travelling exhibition that originated at FIFA’s home museum in Zürich, Switzerland. It runs from May 15 through September 7, 2026.

Vancouver was specifically chosen as the first North American stop for this exhibition, a recognition of the city’s identity as a hub of innovation. The show takes visitors through five immersive zones:

- **Broadcasting and Media** — how the game reaches billions of fans worldwide
- **Intelligent Data** — the analytics and performance science behind modern football
- **Refereeing and Fair Play** — the technology supporting officials, including VAR and connected match balls
- **Staging the Game** — the massive infrastructure behind every World Cup match
- **The Innovation Lab** — a forward-looking space exploring where the game is heading

For Canadians, there’s an especially emotional dimension to the exhibit. On display are Christine Sinclair’s jersey from Canada’s Olympic gold-medal match against Sweden at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, the match ball from Canada vs. Croatia at the 2022 World Cup (the game where Alphonso Davies scored Canada’s first-ever men’s World Cup goal), and Atiba Hutchinson’s jersey from Canada’s opening match against Belgium. Seeing those artifacts in person, inside a building that’s been turned into a World Cup ball — it’s a lot.

## Science World as Gateway

There’s a functional role the dome is playing too, beyond the visual spectacle. Science World sits at the eastern end of a pedestrian fan zone running along Quebec Street and Pacific Boulevard, connecting Main Street–Science World SkyTrain Station all the way to BC Place. For the hundreds of thousands of fans walking to matches, the dome is the opening frame — the signal that the World Cup experience has begun.

On Vancouver match days, Science World is offering 20% off general admission and extended hours so fans can step inside before or after their games.

## A City Showing Up

I’ve watched Vancouver prepare for this tournament with a mixture of excitement and the usual civic anxiety that comes with big events — the construction delays, the funding uncertainty, the seawall fencing controversies (yes, there’s even a minor drama about obstructed sightlines for photographers). But then you see that dome, glowing over False Creek, and something shifts.

The fact that a science museum leaned fully into this — wrapping itself in 131 panels, hosting an international FIFA Museum premiere, positioning itself as part of the fan journey — says something about how this city is choosing to show up for this moment.

Forty years after Expo ’86, Vancouver is welcoming the world again. And science, of all things, is right there at the door.

---

*Are you in Vancouver for the World Cup? Have you seen The Beautiful Dome in person? I’d love to hear about it in the comments.*

title.title: Footprints in Felt and Stone: How Europe Remembers Its Games
title.body:
Across the continent, from the Adriatic coast to the North Sea, certain buildings refuse to let you forget that Europeans have long treated leisure as a serious pursuit. The Germans have a word for this — Spielkultur — and its traces are embedded in architecture, literature, and municipal law dating back centuries. When historians trace the lineage of recreational gambling in Europe, they consistently find that the institution evolved not as a vice hidden in back alleys, but as a formally recognized social ritual woven into the civic fabric of major cities.

The Dutch and German traditions offer a particularly layered case study. The popularity of the [Duitse online casino](https://duitseonlinecasino.nl/) market today did not emerge from nothing — it grew from a centuries-old familiarity with games of chance that were regulated, taxed, and even celebrated at regional fairs and noble courts. Duitse online casino platforms now accommodate millions of players across the German-speaking world, and culturally speaking, this digital extension mirrors older patterns of cross-border play that existed long before the internet. The distance between a nineteenth-century Baden-Baden gaming room and a moderne Duitse online casino interface is, historically, shorter than it looks.

Baden-Baden itself stands as perhaps the most striking monument to this heritage. Its Kurhaus casino, opened in 1824, was explicitly designed as a space where Europe's educated and moneyed classes could gather under chandeliers, trade conversation, and place bets with a sense of occasion. Dostoyevsky wrote about it. Marlene Dietrich called it the most beautiful casino in the world. The building still operates today, and its continued existence is less a commercial fact than a cultural one — it is listed, protected, visited by people who have no intention of gambling at all.

This preservation impulse is widespread. Monte Carlo's Casino de Monte-Carlo, Venice's Casinò di Venezia — the oldest in the world, founded in 1638 — and Estoril's Casino in Portugal all exist within frameworks that recognize them as heritage sites. Governments that might otherwise be ambivalent about gambling infrastructure have found that these buildings carry too much historical weight to treat as ordinary entertainment venues. The architecture tells one story. The registers of visitors, the paintings commissioned for the walls, the floor plans designed to guide movement and maximize social visibility — all of it documents how Europeans once thought about risk, money, and public life simultaneously.

That thinking was never simple. Moralists objected. Municipal councils banned and then re-permitted games. Religious authorities issued condemnations that were largely ignored by the aristocracy and eventually by the emerging bourgeoisie. The argument about gambling's place in European society is not a modern one triggered by the internet — it has been running, with varying intensity, since the Renaissance.

What makes the heritage dimension distinct from a simple history of vice or profit is the question of craft. Card games required skill and memory. Certain dice games involved probability calculations that pushed players toward mathematical literacy. The chemin de fer tables of Biarritz attracted players who studied odds with genuine rigor. Leisure, in this context, produced knowledge — and that knowledge left institutional traces in probability theory, in actuarial science, in the development of modern statistics.

Europe's gaming heritage is therefore entangled with its intellectual history in ways that official preservation efforts only partially acknowledge. Museums commemorate the furniture and the frescoes. Fewer of them explain the mathematics that was practiced at those tables, or the economic thinking that shaped the house rules. The felt surfaces and the carved ceilings survive. The reasoning that animated the rooms beneath them is harder to frame and harder still to exhibit — but it is, arguably, the more consequential inheritance.

title.title: Looks like Ukraine has \
with range far longer than what Russia has
title.body:
/>](https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=littleboy/exu9266i)

Ukraine destroyed one Russian Mi-28 and one Mi-17 helicopter in Russia’s Voronezh region, about 150km from the front line. With the tracking we see, it seems like an AI drone.

The only other possibility is that this attack was by a Ukrainian intel team working behind the frontlines (which is very rare and risky). The drone appears to be one with 200km range at least. And it is tracking the object really well (sign of AI). It's also flying in a straight path / pattern (algorithm?) which suggests it's not piloted by intel team. All things point to AI.

These generally use 5 drones or more in cascade (an example of a [drone swarm](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nlsMOeZQzZ4)) and use that to reach up to 200+km in communication range using commercial grade 50km range data links. A single 200km data link probably costs 50x the cost of 1 cheap 50km link. Cost saving is so efficient with software defined swarm UAVs.

Baykar's release of AI drones (K2 and Mosquito drone that can work without GPS) and Ukraine's progress with AI killer drones and actually using them with ultra precision seems too big of a coincidence. Seems like the Baykar company is helping Ukraine with drone software.  
  
Turkey and Ukraine are making gains in AI while Russia is busy waging war on Telegram. If Russia was smart, they would never have kicked Durov / Telegram out. The brain drain ensures Russia doesn't have enough talent to develop cutting edge AI.

#ukraine #russia #drones #ai #military #technology #war #baykar #uav

body.title: En épocas de olvidos
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmea9BfbGSsJW1sC7VZBG217wVAY78V2PWSXY9Ku3dnsUY/1781444271728.jpg)
<sub>imagen generada por IA</sub>
I

*Ella tenía el pelo despacio*, y yo la voz grave
 y en peligro de saltar hacia el inconsciente colectivo.
corría la época de olvidos 
cuando era el más rápido en alargar el día,
y aún así, continuaba siendo el más lento de los colores,
tratando de comprender los misterios de Dios 
y su capricho en complicar el agua.

II

Mi voz y su vocación de kamikaze 
no pierde la oportunidad de saltar sin mirar a dónde ni cuándo,
sin saber si da pie en lo profundo de tus oído.
Quisiera ser como mi voz, 
aunque no me gusta la gravedad 
(cualquiera de ellas, ninguna me gusta).
Mi voz, cual poderoso ouroboros, nace y muere sin cenizas en la frente,
por eso mi voz no sufre de la oscura enfermedad del miedo, 
y vuela libre hacia el vacío, 
con el hambre más áspera de llenarlo de palabras.
Era una época de olvidos y extravíos de los sentidos,
cuando iba *la palabra perdiéndose en un extraño oído*
*a la deriva de lo que somos y olvidamos...*

body.title: LOH #293: A Pause in Tuscany and a Birthday by the Sea
body.body:
> ## 1️⃣ If I had the opportunity as an adult, what place in the world would I like to live in as an exchange student for a year, and what would I like to do meanwhile? How do I imagine my host family and my surroundings? # Exchange programs are usually associated with youth, new discoveries, and university life. However, the idea of living such an experience in adulthood strikes me as a fascinating gift, almost an act of self-love. At this stage of life, when we have already built responsibilities, routines, and fixed roles, the opportunity to freeze time for a year and move to another corner of the world is not an escape, but a reunion with oneself. If life put that opportunity in my hands, I wouldn't hesitate for a second: my destination would be Italy. I see myself living in a picturesque village, one of those magical corners of Tuscany that seem suspended in time. I visualize its narrow, cobblestone streets, flanked by warm-colored houses and balconies full of flowers, with the air permeated by the closeness of the blue sea. For me, the environment is vital; I need the light, the history whispered by the stones, and the immensity of the water to feel my soul breathe.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcubrjK5rxQ8EyKgpMxruSzz6RUo7otbUnaLPE4Nvpm4/image.png)[PxHere](https://pxhere.com/es/photo/733021)

>

My host family? I don't imagine them as perfect or quiet. On the contrary, I dream of them as loud, extremely funny, the kind of people who speak with their hands and express love through food. A family with whom I can sit at the table without protocols, sharing genuine laughter while devouring a freshly baked artisan pizza and good wine. In that home, language would not be a barrier, because affection and good humor are universal.

During that year, my only major project would be to live, be happy, and savor the present something that daily life sometimes steals from us. I would love to enroll in local cooking classes to learn how to connect with ingredients through tradition, and at the same time, take painting classes. I would like to slide the brush over the canvas and capture the colors of those Italian landscapes, not to be a great artist, but to learn to look at the world with different eyes. It would be a year to nourish my peace, heal accumulated exhaustion, and simply enjoy the art of existing.

<div>

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXyEzWu8CXcPSSU6992FFf2kjMhmJv4ADd7VfkW2QJ9Ay/image.png)<sub>[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/pizza-l%C3%A1mina-comida-queso-verduras-3010062/)</sub>

</center>

<div class=\

>

## 2️⃣ Do I like to celebrate my birthday? Or am I one of those who enjoys celebrating others' birthdays more? What I would like to do for my next birthday.

#

To be completely honest and leave social commitments aside, the answer is a resounding no: I do not like to celebrate my own birthday in the traditional sense. I know that for most people it is a date for parties and massive gatherings, but over the years I have learned to prioritize my emotional well-being and to understand what truly recharges my energy. Ironically, I greatly enjoy planning, pampering, and celebrating the birthdays of the people I love; it fills my heart to see them happy. But when it comes to my own day, it's a different story.

A birthday is supposed to be the one day of the year designed exclusively for you, a space to stop, give thanks, rest, and pamper yourself. However, the common dynamic of celebrations forces you to do the opposite: you end up opening the doors of your home, receiving guests, tidying up, and spending hours serving others so they feel comfortable. At the end of the day, I look around and realize that I spent \

day exhausted, fulfilling the protocol of being the perfect hostess. And at this stage of life, my peace of mind and my rest are non-negotiable.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQzKsKH499hPB7iC6hoas8qUGJeoSec4o9R6afZGHpUV/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/c%C3%B3cteles-playa-vacaciones-mar-648851/)

> For my next birthday, my ideal plan is far from gatherings in the living room. I want it to be a day of disconnection and real enjoyment. I would love to spend the day out, perhaps treating myself to an afternoon at the theater to feed the intellect, going to the movies, or visiting an excellent restaurant where the flavors surprise me. But if I have to design the perfect scenario, it would undoubtedly be escaping to the beach. There is nothing more healing and connecting than the sound of the waves. My ideal birthday is sitting in front of the immensity of the sea, with the breeze on my face and my feet in the sand, enjoying a good piña colada without rush, without external expectations, and without having to attend to anyone but myself. A day to celebrate life from tranquility, silence, and the deepest gratitude.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLga8UmBMWC2Ubw3xnodzb73tWgpN6j1Zji6cZR24z3g/image.png)

> I don't want to say goodbye without first heartfeltly thanking our dear @irenenavarroart for giving us such beautiful and thought-provoking questions this week. What a delight it was to sit down and imagine that ideal year, and at the same time, be honest about how I choose to protect my energy on my special day. Thank you, Irene, for inspiring this space. I also take this opportunity to invite my friends @syllem and @cautiva-30 to participate in this beautiful initiative. I would love to read your answers!
From my heart to yours, Thank you for accompanying me this far 💜 #
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLga8UmBMWC2Ubw3xnodzb73tWgpN6j1Zji6cZR24z3g/image.png)
# _Espanish_
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU32bXSXCdeWZbc4mFpeAoHjBswFH7q9Bc4QKbqEAhmSG/image.png)[PxHere](https://pxhere.com/es/photo/1588079)

> ## 1️⃣ Si tuviera la oportunidad siendo un adulta, que lugar del mundo me gustaría vivir de intercambio por un año y qué me gustaría hacer mientras tanto? como imagino a mi familia de acogida y mi entorno? # Los programas de intercambio suelen asociarse con la juventud, los descubrimientos y la vida universitaria. Sin embargo, la idea de vivir una experiencia así en la madurez me parece un regalo fascinante, casi un acto de amor propio. A estas alturas de la vida, cuando ya hemos construido responsabilidades, rutinas y roles fijos, la oportunidad de congelar el tiempo por un año y mudarse a otro rincón del mundo no es un escape, sino un reencuentro con una misma. Si la vida me pusiera esa oportunidad en las manos, no lo dudaría ni un segundo: mi destino sería Italia. Me veo viviendo en un pueblo pintoresco, uno de esos rincones mágicos de la Toscana que parecen suspendidos en el tiempo. Visualizo sus calles estrechas y empedradas, flanqueadas por casas de colores cálidos y balcones llenos de flores, con ese aire impregnado por la cercanía del mar azul. Para mí, el entorno es vital; necesito la luz, la historia que susurran las piedras y la inmensidad del agua para sentir que el alma respira.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcubrjK5rxQ8EyKgpMxruSzz6RUo7otbUnaLPE4Nvpm4/image.png)[PxHere](https://pxhere.com/es/photo/733021)

> ¿Mi familia de acogida? No me los imagino perfectos ni silenciosos. Al contrario, me los sueño ruidosos, sumamente divertidos, de esos que hablan con las manos y expresan el amor a través de la comida. Una familia con la que pueda sentarme a la mesa sin protocolos, a compartir risas genuinas mientras devoramos una pizza artesanal recién horneada y un buen vino. En ese hogar, el idioma no sería una barrera, porque el afecto y el buen humor son universales. Durante ese año, mi único gran proyecto sería vivir, ser feliz y saborear el presente, algo que el día a día a veces nos roba. Me encantaría inscribirme en clases de cocina local para aprender a conectar con los ingredientes desde la tradición, y al mismo tiempo, tomar clases de pintura. Quisiera deslizar el pincel sobre el lienzo y plasmar los colores de esos paisajes italianos, no para ser una gran artista, sino para aprender a mirar el mundo con otros ojos. Sería un año para nutrir mi paz, sanar el cansancio acumulado y simplemente disfrutar del arte de existir.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXyEzWu8CXcPSSU6992FFf2kjMhmJv4ADd7VfkW2QJ9Ay/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/pizza-l%C3%A1mina-comida-queso-verduras-3010062/)

>

## 2️⃣ Me gusta celebrar mi cumpleaños? O soy de las que disfruta más celebrar el cumpleaños de los demas? Lo que me gustaría hacer en mi próximo cumpleaños.

#

Si les soy completamente honesta y dejo de lado los compromisos sociales, la respuesta es un rotundo no: no me gusta celebrar mi propio cumpleaños en el sentido tradicional. Sé que para la mayoría es una fecha de fiesta y reuniones masivas, pero con el paso de los años he aprendido a priorizar mi bienestar emocional y a entender qué es lo que realmente me recarga de energía. Irónicamente, disfruto muchísimo planificar, consentir y celebrar los cumpleaños de las personas que amo; me llena el corazón verlos felices. Pero cuando se trata de mi propio día, la historia es otra.

Se supone que el cumpleaños es el único día del año diseñado exclusivamente para uno, un espacio para detenerse, agradecer, descansar y consentirse. Sin embargo, la dinámica común de las celebraciones te obliga a lo contrario: terminas abriendo las puertas de tu casa, recibiendo personas, ordenando y pasando horas atendiendo a los demás para que se sientan cómodos. Al final de la jornada, miro a mi alrededor y me doy cuenta de que pasé \

día de aquí para allá, cumpliendo con el protocolo de ser la anfitriona perfecta.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQzKsKH499hPB7iC6hoas8qUGJeoSec4o9R6afZGHpUV/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/c%C3%B3cteles-playa-vacaciones-mar-648851/)

> Para mi próximo cumpleaños, mi plan ideal está muy lejos de las reuniones en la sala de la casa. Quiero que sea un día de desconexión y disfrute real. Me encantaría pasar el día afuera, tal vez regalándome una tarde de teatro para alimentar el intelecto, yendo al cine o visitando un restaurante excelente donde los sabores me sorprendan. Pero si tengo que diseñar el escenario perfecto, sin duda alguna sería escaparme a la playa. No hay nada que sane y conecte más que el sonido de las olas. Mi cumpleaños ideal es estar sentada frente a la inmensidad del mar, con la brisa en la cara y los pies en la arena, disfrutando de una buena piña colada sin prisa, sin expectativas ajenas y sin tener que atender a nadie más que a mi propio ser. Un día para celebrar la vida desde la tranquilidad, el silencio y la gratitud más profunda.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLga8UmBMWC2Ubw3xnodzb73tWgpN6j1Zji6cZR24z3g/image.png)

> No quiero despedirme sin antes agradecer de corazón a nuestra querida @irenenavarroart por regalarnos estas preguntas tan hermosas y propicias para la reflexión esta semana. Qué delicia fue sentarse a imaginar ese año ideal y, al mismo tiempo, sincerarme sobre cómo elijo cuidar mi energía en mi día especial. Gracias, Irene, por inspirar este espacio. Aprovecho también para invitar a participar en esta bella iniciativa a mis amigas @zhanavic69 y @cautiva-30. ¡Me encantaría leer sus respuestas!
De mi corazón al tuyo, Gracias por acompañarme hasta aquí 💜 #
