body.title: God's  blessings  makes Rich and adds no sorrow ...
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGnDKHg9YA9WRaeGM17Waa4RLhRnGW3j4T7n7rKudbuE/1781470050127.jpg)



one time I was with my barber and he narrated a story  of a woman who gave birth to triplet, according  to him the family  were struggling  financially  then boom three kids at once, at that point,  he asked me is that a blessing or something else?

my answer  was \

he's  own stand was that wasn't a blessing,  reason being that God knew and saw how these family are struggling to cater for themselves  then he gave them three kids at once, how will they be able to take care of these children with what exactly....


I told him in life our perspective  differs and it also really matters how we see and perceive things, I can see that as a blessing, meanwhile  he can see it as trouble  or a problem,  I then asked him is it a blessing , he answered yes than my stand was if its a blessing  then there are no sorrows attached to it, no matter how it seems at the moment, because God who gave them  that bundle of joy will in turn provide all that is required to take care of them.

it's  the heart he looks at, is it ready to accommodate?, does it have the capacity to enlarge?, then he will send it.


it's  like trying  to figure out  everything  before you move,  life isn't  built that way, When Abraham  was convinces  of God's  leading in his spirit,  he didn't  wait to get it all figured out, he moved  regardless,  that was faith in motion.


if at a point God's  blessing comes when we least expect it like the family that got a triplet  even tho the means wasn't there, whatever it is we're  doing he will bless it more, open doors through it , pouring more blessings that will takecare of it.


the blessings  of the lord makes rich and adds no sorrow, no matter the state of things  be rest assure he's  aware of it and is in control,  he won't allow it more than we can handle,  he's  God of the universe, all mighty and all knowing, trusting  him is all that matters.

At the next restart, I swam to the other ship with Guapo and checked the surrounding enemy troops via photo mode before climbing the ladder. After deactivating the alarm system, a failed stealth takedown on a sniper forced me into the water, which leaded to a second glitched infiltration attempt.

<div class=\

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZakSvGp9QzUSm3fuXjd8vYeKk6LcVRnYDfxFiRNJivw/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNsitQqZ8dZqJYXhBt5GdLDUy71rqAGjmQ8CtnB1j2HDQ/screenshot_2_.png) I decided to get to the other ship first at the next restart. So I swam there along with Guapo till I reached the ladder, cutting through the calm water as quietly as possible to avoid drawing early attention from the deck guards. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeC4PAXHjZhDrm6EWsyiFfybMyEuPSV9DsECfzaAp6xid/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQU26gaS15Q4A4yCwPQLspo1UtF5anAbANUVHqH4dda3R/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbHtASBGvAALFkkuaK9zpFmX1PAY6a9YXNNrTqGYTr2WQ/screenshot_5_.png) While I was climbing up the ship, I decided to check around using my photo mode, and when I did, I noticed the enemy troops were not so far from me. The camera tool gave me a clear, safe view of their positions without exposing my character. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsMQA9vqfcut1HtgKWSXZf8p3DxqBRZEvn8u9KUrZxHc/screenshot_6_.png) After climbing up on the deck, I ran ahead real fast and stopped to take cover and see if anyone noticed me, but no one did fortunately, allowing me to press my back against the metal crates and plan my next move. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNsgW6FHhKo8aRbBcj1n9s2Z9E8HghdY3QqE5TLChGoL/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNebqWwxEV8ZwucggLeRDfXKABM7xnoX4HeUmW61TFXbX/screenshot_8_.png) Then I decided to get to the back of the ship, where I found an alarm system that I deactivated after destroying a CCTV camera. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaZBiSjTgFvhJz9g2sjxFu8gqH7jXwYkttUZw1G3dh9qF/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc24SR4D6E326pWggAv2kzGfPGF7PwnL3EsHuWA4hBUC8/screenshot_10_.png) I went to the back to take care of the sniper quietly, but the sniper somehow caught me off guard, so I had to shoot him down and jump off the ship as more enemy soldiers were coming to get me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZvRtTE4QroE43Kjmk2xXwBuHBsqY3NVkUEvyAFPP9Znq/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3Rwfu5X7YzBb9zKow22TJhJzXwRWHsyc8Gq4pJJWom3/screenshot_12_.png) I swam around the ship to use the anchor to climb up on the front side quietly. I pulled myself up slowly, hoping to catch the patrolling guards completely off guard this time. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPfErbmxr82dP4eWqCcp3oK8Sz4aci1gFKnBGFQAqMbSZ/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUd1a8v8hMc3nriRtDq5nPn9AVXJnNSYqr3K1eDh343CG/screenshot_14_.png) But it seemed my luck was not going well still as some enemy soldiers started looking for me at the exact location where I was hiding. I held my breath behind the barrier as they closed in on my position. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmerASK4PDsapRR4HveyPGASDTEpdrFp6kQhn2pfQAwWaH/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWWJLGH46XgGUguPcprZGb3jQRmBFf7huiCNnN8Fw9M8g/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTo72oCJquhsS224kEPNSeEoYLukGq8eVZ6ibLiUPU71Q/screenshot_17_.png) When I thought I could stay hidden from them, they noticed me, so I tried to jump off the ship from the front side, but the game's glitch caught me again and I was burned down. How about we continue in another post? --- Thanks for reading my post.

title.title: Battle royale madness in knives out 🔥🔫 | @traveltour
title.body:
Hello hive gaming, how are you all? I hope you are well. Today I have a new game video for you.Knives Out suits players who want quick survival matches and flexible team play on mobile. You enter a wide battlefield, gather equipment, and make decisions that keep you in the fight until the end. Match pacing supports short sessions and longer play, while social features help you team up with friends when you prefer cooperative play. For those planning to download Knives Out, the game focuses on simple entry and clear objectives that center on staying alive and outlasting other players.

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-04-53-182_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTVy3KJT2SShq9XNxmLAdbnNaRX7aVfwChpdfWsj7MXSD/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-04-53-182_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-10-03-919_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby2ndfCZLFDKALiDSMDWK9a2BGcoaLED38eiwPFHgReh/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-10-03-919_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-15-52-129_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbSW4ET8P3mhc4BkLeePf9kGcbdsszwr7bfmdPstMF8jc/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-15-52-129_com.netease.ko.jpg)

You choose a flight path and pick your own landing spot, which lets you aim for quiet looting or early action. As a result, each match can play out differently depending on where you start and the routes you take.100-player survival matches and clear win condition.Each round brings together over 100 players in a single session. Only one player or squad remains at the end, which sets a simple goal that guides every decision. 

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-16-56-093_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNim5JrUb2gU4bB2cBBJEdqjvsKFYNsfA3Zs1mTGPMdmY/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-16-56-093_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-20-11-771_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRwCvPkev2EtC8sy6pz79V7bGhyk4aBYaHyCkNu6mS5xk/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-20-11-771_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-21-23-048_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSzcgmrsrsLhFmX3wN9iQxyvpPdTiXHWpseuLMsakitLp/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-21-23-048_com.netease.ko.jpg)

Knives Out makes it easy to squad up and rely on teamwork. You can meet new players in game, invite friends, and coordinate simple plans that cover scouting, revives, and positioning. Team communication and role splitting often decide close fights, so coordinated play can change a match flow quickly.Vehicle traversal for fast rotations and flanks.Sports cars and other vehicles help you cross long distances faster than running. As you move with a squad, vehicles support quick rotations to better ground or fast exits from risky areas. 

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-21-36-237_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6dSR4wdRsTjP3aGfC3QReiA9rs4BCbjyn7exajQGYJg/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-21-36-237_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-23-14-227_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSVbDmBmF9kB4ZyrPWfFbEvKks1DTzXW4vsmWD31nG9tn/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-23-14-227_com.netease.ko.jpg)

Service availability for Knives Out can vary by region. Some areas may have restrictions or limited access, and this includes periodic changes in specific countries such as India. Before installing, users should confirm that access and matchmaking are available in their location to avoid account or connection issues.Open the game and enter the lobby, then check settings for controls and graphics if needed. Select a match type and decide whether to queue solo or team up with friends, then start matchmaking. 

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-24-38-310_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSPejD7yyW8F9tdvbB9MEdYf79Q6Z77Z1SccMgq5me9V/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-24-38-310_com.netease.ko.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-26-57-065_com.netease.ko.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUEHjo7zhSnVranBhytmdFhLHJUrf5XWzkkkN73BQVyT4/Screenshot_2026-06-15-02-26-57-065_com.netease.ko.jpg)

When the flight begins, open the map and choose a landing spot that fits your plan for looting or early fights. Search nearby areas for weapons and supplies, then reposition as the match develops and opponents move. Use vehicles to rotate with your squad when distance is long, engage carefully, and aim to be the last team standing.

title.title: A Million Dollars, A Lifetime of Decisions
title.body: If I woke up tomorrow and won $1 million, there would be a quick shift in my mindset and for the better, other than what it would have been a decade ago. If you had asked me this question many years ago, I would have given you a simple answer telling you what my cravings are and what I would spend the money on, but times have changed, and each day, I am getting wiser mentally, emotionally, and otherwise, maybe because of responsibilities as a parent, just maybe, but to be honest, experience keeps teaching me life lessons, and I've learned that if I don't manage money wisely, it disappears within the twinkling of an eye. ![17814683881242772869835672888240.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/48SqDe9K3ptt2dS7ooVxULdqv2t4LDHZDn1vU8yhhN39RLFyAocgaN4N59Ztxu1rNt.png) ***** Winning $1 million would never make me quit my work; that would be so foolish of me. I won't also start living a reckless life, thinking that I have arrived; no, that money is counted and would someday vanish while I still exist in this life, hopefully starting all over again, so what is the need for having such privilege without making the most of it to secure the future of my family? I have sat down many times wishing for plenty of money for me and my family to secure a lifetime investment that wouldn't make my generation struggle so much financially....and Just a few days ago, I was speaking with my brother, and we talked about how my dad sold all his landed properties, including a house he built in the north, just to sponsor his half brother and other people in our community back then. ***** It was a kind gesture but with a wrong approach. imagine doing away with your secured real estate over the years!.., a cool asset many people are looking for today but are unable to secure one due to lack of funds. Then you throw yours away over charity. I don't know how it was for him back then, but he should have just given them money he had instead of such a decision. If those assets are here today, we the children, including our own children, will keep reaping from such investments. That's by the way, but one top investment I will do with the $1 million is a real estate investment, especially property in a strategic location. Secondly, I will keep a portion for my children's education, just enough to secure them with quality education without barriers, and for sure, education is another great investment we can think of. All these steps are to ensure that the money is working for me rather than spending it all on things that fade away. ***** How long the money you have can sustain you is what financial freedom is all about. Finally assisting my close family members would be an exciting thing to do with the money. Growing up, I see that as one of our family culture, each person being a shoulder for another to lean on, and when everyone is growing better financially, it becomes a win-win. Having said that, I would always encourage and practice financial assistance, but selling my asset to sponsor someone in school is not something I think I would do, just like my dad, except in health issues; I can consider that when life is at risk. Overall, there are other great things to do with such money that when I look around, I will be ever grateful to God for finding me worthy for such a win, but let's keep it on a low key until someday this wish comes into reality. This is my response to the iucontest for this round. Feel free to join in [here](https://peakd.com/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-634cceffd1172) ***image was created using chatgpt***

title.title: Three Inspiring Movies Worth Every Minute
title.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

It's a tiring day but I'm not skipping writing a post today so I'm going to be very brief with my thoughts on these movies. They are the movies that made my last week interesting with their beautiful and inspiring stories. I downloaded them randomly and they turned out to be worth it.

### **Unconditional Love (2012)**

![1001596629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23u6DmP5vMrGWEjYgzPSKxNgAQJhchwwrpoEdsxY71y5m24U5nWR3WpY7693YHB4ohMvG.jpg)

I think the title led me to download this one. One may think love is what many understand how to show but I don't consider that I know it well enough, especially the unconditional kind. So I got curious and surprisingly, it took me in a direction I least expected but it's well explained.

It's a story about a woman who lost the will to live after her husband died from a random act of violence. She decided to take her life but just when she is about to shoot herself, she witness a little girl get hit by a car and had to help her to the hospital. At the hospital, she meets her childhood best friend who shows her his world that changes her thoughts and gives her will to live.

I love the story more when I knew it's based on a true story, it has a bit of sad realistic end. **8/10**.

### **Where Hope Grows (2014)**

![1001596630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/48Y9Ajk6mQLwQSJTxUYYjJGy5JsAJaKKy5Lzd3Y3bmy87JcBrqaNvezZRnBu8rhKTP.jpg)

I saw a comment about this movie where someone said *\

*, it had me curious because I don't know much about the syndrome so I decided to see it. The movie is about a baseball player who his professional career was cut short, wasting away his life with drinks and neglecting his teenage daughter. Until he is awakened and inspired to live better when he gets a hug from a down syndrome, Produce who works at a local grocery store. Produce help those questioning life in the negative sense even though he had only himself. I think this story teaches acceptance in a deeper level, I learned that and more from the story 7/10. ### **Ordinary Angels (2024)** ![1001596622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23xKk2y2j1CLxsPwz58V6dQA2pZU7DsHpzhMz4HDESQEjrfbdUKro8kw13uADNud6wSTH.jpg) The title was so unrelated until it was so perfect for the story, it had a kinda slow and uninteresting start that it made me think so. I love how strong the characters playing the roles were, especially the female lead. And I also read that it's a story that is based on a true life story. It's a story about a hairdresser, a alcoholic, not on good terms with her son, who decided to help a father save his critically ill daughter by soliciting for help from the entire community. She learns about herself in the process as she is discouraged, left alone and misunderstood in her act of kindness even by the father of the child. The end scene of this movie was so heart warming and beautiful, had smiles all over. **8/10**. **Images used are from Imdb.**

title.title: HSBI letters draw (digital)
title.body:
>Sometimes I start drawing on paper and feel that my ideas capture exactly what I want to express; however, while the art on paper conveys certain feelings, there’s always something very different to convey in these digital drawings.

* * * HSBI ====

>What might easily look like a drawing or image created with artificial intelligence is not, even though its background and base were taken from elsewhere and it isn’t a photo I took with my own cell phone. The rest—the editing, text, and drawing—was done entirely by tapping my cell phone screen, drawing on it, outlining the text, and avoiding excessive effects so as not to detract from the aesthetic I wanted to preserve, since my intention was not for this to look like ordinary graffiti.

\n\n*

>Take a look to the steps;

\n\n

>Here’s the most important part: the background or base of our drawing is pretty straightforward. It’s easy to tell an illustrator to draw something on this wall, and the first thing that comes to mind is some graffiti letters.

\n\n*

>As you can easily see, I outlined these letters to give them a style that’s not quite lettering and not quite graffiti, but rather a texture and style distinct from the lettering typically used. However, I’m using an outline that can easily be applied using the spray technique to achieve a very smooth finish—and, above all, those fine, defined lines.

\n\n

>However, this entire process is done using an app on my Android phone called EPIK.

\n\n

></center>

* * *

*   Text translated by **DeepL**
    

* * *

For now, this is one of the ways I can channel that energy and creativity into art and my desire to create something tangible, even though I haven’t had the chance to paint a mural on a wall—which is my passion and what I love most. It’s been quite a while since I did my last mural; it’s been a while since I’ve brought color and energy to a wall. In recent months, I’ve been doing graffiti—yes, of course I have; I love doing graffiti. I really enjoy it a lot. However, we know that there’s graffiti done with a lot of love, heart, and much more soul and spirit—the kind of graffiti that engages with the space and shares a little bit of us with people, a snippet of history, and above all, instills culture. I thank everyone who made it to the end of my post; you already know that the best way to support me is by leaving a comment or simply reblogging this post.

*   🇻🇪

Was back out doing [The Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) today. Two sunny days in a row. The Crypto-Social artworks are starting to go now.

https://youtu.be/TG6zutoFVGo

But first, the video intro says thanks to PrettyBitsNBobs who promoted THE CAMDEN MARKET FREE ART MAN on [her Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/prettybitsnbobs/) soon after visiting the display and doing the \

/>See the interview in the YouTube video that starts around 35mins 52 secs, which I'll do a dedicated separate video about soon, as it's the most in depth we've gone into what the three crypto-social sites are that I've discovered through Ron Throop @ronthroop and am getting to learn about with a lot of help from @offgridlife also. Was a slow start at first, getting rid of this series of paintings but both an Ecency and a Steemit 12 inch LP were taken today. I don't think any Blurt ones have gone yet, which surprises me as I thought they'd be the most popular. So far the Ecency ones are the most popular. title.title: A weekend with \
celebration
title.body:
Someone would say that there is never enough celebrating and celebrating.
And I agree with that statement.

The last time I agreed that we almost always have few beautiful moments in life (because unfortunately we are separated from them by sad ones) was when I was listening to the story of relatives who were talking about two funerals and all the birthdays they celebrated in great company at a family celebration.
First birthdays were celebrated, eighty-fourth, twenty-sixth, eleventh...

And me?
I and my four friends, with whom I have been friends since elementary school and whom I have known for 45 years, had a great #weekend-experiences this weekend and celebrated the fiftieth birthday of the third fifty-year-old of the five of us..

That's why I wrote above this blurred photo that it weighs 5x50 years 🙂

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWs355m1cKYtBpskn3cDeGRastUWqAxFMDNKw1GTQgEJf/1781446759381.jpg)

He made a proper effort for his celebration, he chose a great house with a swimming pool, open bar, sound system with microphones and barbecue equipment...
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5pPwXsU12mBQF1tgCCadUM6R5gYQWMyEJVsQdTofo7W/1781456715313.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedcz396htKX1Y1bqVZpfXWLi2f2cHnfW6JEqQVUt1jJ4/1781456715586.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbDGEb9rJgcAQGePiSSiqsMaJmMWfB4nXL2M9mXqbdDR/1781456715658.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXYoT8EzJMx7syYAngfG5rdRQYGnRGhpC1bHeeN5oXkt/1781456753273.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbsPeJNBESDTv7ssGxG71R2xJzTq9ikLnto2pt6PEdTPb/1781468998984.jpg)

He hosted a select group, and we helped ourselves to excellent food and drink.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQTS7S4ukFnCkLDoUaFTv79wDpeQpwakWiUFHqhBgNjn7/1781446759331.jpg)

I will share with you some of the photos of the space, I have blurred our pictures, so that no one is scared by our beauty, under no circumstances will I share the shots and photos when we were singing or when individuals ended up in the pool, and in a few pictures you can see the selection of drinks, which is why I wrote that we overdid it 🙂

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbWrK8YJbc6paYwCQqtrjy2j8e5CHpC4By9EJvdbnTiwP/1781446737659.jpg)

The six of us drank four bottles of Chivas Regal whiskey 0.75l, and luckily one of our wives \

the tinsmith Jack Daniels, because he would have made fun of us.

Lest you think that this post is written by an alcoholic, I attend parties and birthdays when I don't even drink enough alcohol, but this weekend that was not the case.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc3GKYUeo4wv7yMSy4MpxBNUqry2NbVV6QwMovBM33w2F/1781456827597.jpg)

We drank for half of Saturday, prepared food, swam in the pool, sang, danced... and after an interesting night, and a busy tidying up of the space that we had to hand over by 10:00 in the morning, we sobered up for half of the Sunday morning in that work action.

Days like these, and celebrations of this and similar types, with more or less alcohol. they stay in our memory for a long time (if someone doesn't remember, ask the one who remembers 🙂) and serve to retell them for many years to come.

Things are heating up in the city and viewing parties are happening all over with events being held outdoors and indoors. One popular spot in the city is Granville Island, which is situated on the southern end of the Granville St. Bridge.

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23w2aPB7FTWGF7P64GQW2tyvhokhc31usjXFXftAB47WHbKXrxxRR42C3DWFE6HpBcDHW.jpg)</center>

I decided to swing by there and soak up the atmosphere. On my way across False Creek, I spotted the Aquabus sporting a large soccer ball on top.

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/244xo74Mu3m8JSGKNtAmqrkqcBMKi22AssuGsVVuJbahwkvcDdJpF4jTMRSrGSp6waxjJ.jpg)</center>

Inside the fenced off viewing zone, organizers placed many tables and chairs so that people can also enjoy the food and drink available. They also had table football throughout the grounds, as you can see in the following photo. 

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/245w4maVsYw4T7mAXt58jxD8M9R6HftdmvxtUmTrTagWhb2FgrGnK3ZmBFS7ZMyG6VWFM.jpg)</center>

Not wanting to let all this work go to waste, I decided to support the local food trucks and avail myself of these tasty ribs with macaroni and cheese.

<center>![WC Granville Ribs.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eq7MQbv7Q1LKxVKsPLFF9iyxKBQacWtNMiAwaVQ85Xa5ms9j9R3piv1oEZQ5sAcyJJR.jpg)</center>

The Granville st. bridge hovered over the viewing grounds like a protective sentinel.

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/243BRtWEQrPFSEYr4G5TUvWECnSwPsveJgrbzJmS7EfFes9EYPRYwEK3BoEsFHboq9XLm.jpg)</center>

Prior to the game, dancers put on a show with their lively brand of samba fusion.

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23wMcoj41UNiyS6V6pmVyVsvrsNFGRuMoFRWCVeoqj9n4UHTWMPYV1XdeG3LikERYeyNR.jpg)</center>

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23xVCzeFXNeXsBwztBU4Ffm2b8in734isKkaA831kWrhbsc3J3TdUUh2itYFFaWmuAFUt.jpg)</center>

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep9zdCgQ8wEmscBTiYTSbEEvcMQbzp3CFKL2ZdH2y3D95uU6drHbPVjEYh3PFCvd7Jx.jpg)</center>

The crowd cheered and booed, drank and booed, cheered and ate and clapped and drank and cheered and booed, then booed again and drunkenkly cheered, and so on.

<center>![Granville Viewing USvsPar08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/242hHcBJFm1CWdcEBmfUFtTj7eP1Y82GWP7a3yLbGNKSpVCJJWnaPrLhYJZM18Q5DDarM.jpg)</center>

Those drums are still banging in my head. The atmosphere was superb, and booing aside, everyone seemed to be having a good time. Thank you for joining the party.

title.title: Квиток у вічність: чи справді ми на порозі скасування старості?
title.body: >Ви коли-небудь замислювалися, чому ми сприймаємо старість як щось неминуче, майже як погоду за вікном? Нам кажуть: «це природний процес», «треба старіти гідно». Але що, якби я сказав вам, що ми нарешті навчилися бачити в цьому не закон природи, а лише складну технічну несправність, яку цілком реально полагодити? Сидячи сьогодні за монітором у 2026 році, я гортаю свіжі звіти з біотехнологічних лабораторій, і мурашки бігають по шкірі. Це не наукова фантастика, напхана в дешеві романи, це наша реальність, яка буквально розгортається на очах.

>Ще десять років тому ми мріяли про ліки від раку, а сьогодні ми говоримо про «біологічне безсмертя». Звучить зухвало, правда? Я часто ловлю себе на думці, що живу в епоху, яка перевершує будь-які антиутопії чи утопії минулого. Суть проста: ми перестали лікувати симптоми і почали зламувати код. Наші клітини мають власну пам'ять, власний «термін придатності», який ми тепер вчимося обнуляти. Це як перевстановлення операційної системи на комп’ютері, який почав гальмувати. Здається, людство нарешті зрозуміло, що біологія — це теж програмування, тільки замість нулів та одиниць тут ДНК та білки.

>Найбільше мене вражає історія з так званими «зомбі-клітинами». Ви напевно чули про сенолітики? Для тих, хто не в курсі — це спеціальний клас сполук, які знаходять в організмі клітини, що перестали ділитися, але відмовляються вмирати. Вони накопичуються роками, отруюючи все навколо запаленнями, роблячи нас слабкими та вразливими до хвороб. Коли я читаю про дослідження, де миші після очищення від цих клітин починали бігати швидше, ніж у молодості, і показували результати на 30% кращі за звичайних однолітків, я починаю думати про свій власний організм. Це не просто про «подовження життя», це про якість. Кому потрібна сотня років, якщо більшу частину часу ти проведеш у чергах до лікарів?

>Але тут починається найцікавіше — політика. Бо довголіття — це не лише про таблетки, це про геополітику. Подивіться на те, що відбувається навколо нас. Впливові люди світу, від лідерів держав до техно-магнатів, інвестують мільярди у власне омолодження. У 2026 році контроль над технологіями продовження життя стає новою ядерною зброєю. Той, хто першим отримає «ключі» до клітинної регенерації, буде диктувати умови гри на десятиліття вперед. Ми вступаємо в епоху, де питання «скільки ти проживеш» стає питанням національної безпеки. І, чесно кажучи, це лякає і захоплює водночас. Це своєрідні перегони, де фінішна стрічка постійно віддаляється, і ніхто не хоче бути тим, хто залишиться за бортом, коли еліксир молодості стане реальністю.

>І тут я повертаюся до нашого, українського контексту. Ми зараз проходимо через часи, коли виживання нації стоїть на першому місці. Але саме тому для нас так важливо не пропустити цей світовий тренд. Інвестиції в довголіття — це не про забаганки багатіїв, це про демографію. Якщо ми зможемо зробити так, щоб українці в 70 чи 80 років залишалися активними, працездатними та енергійними, це докорінно змінить наші економічні перспективи. Це шлях виходу з пастки, де старіння населення тягне країну на дно. Бачити свого дідуся, який у 80 років не просто сидить у кріслі, а веде активний спосіб життя завдяки сучасній медицині — це те майбутнє, за яке варто боротися.

>Я часто думаю про те, якою буде старість мого покоління. Ми, можливо, станемо останніми, хто сприймав смерть як обов'язкову фінальну зупинку, і першими, хто отримав шанс домовитися про відстрочку. Звісно, до справжнього безсмертя ще далеко, і, мабуть, повна відсутність смерті — це філософський абсурд. Але можливість жити 120 років у тілі 40-річного? Це вже інша розмова.

>На завершення хочу запитати у вас: якби ви мали можливість гарантовано прожити до 120 років, зберігаючи повну ясність розуму і фізичну форму, чи погодилися б ви на це, знаючи, що світ навколо кардинально зміниться і ви станете свідком подій, які ми зараз навіть не можемо уявити? Чи, можливо, смерть — це все-таки необхідний запобіжник, який не дає нам втратити сенс життя? Давайте поміркуємо про це, адже майбутнє вже тут, і воно вимагає від нас відповідей на незручні запитання.

title.title: Green Flood/ Let's Make a Collage Round 252
title.body:
>Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well. Here I’m participating in Round 252 of the community’s creative contest, “Let’s Make a Collage,” in which we’re given an image as a starting point to let our imaginations run wild and turn it into something completely different; for this round, we were given this image of an alleyway surrounded by building walls. I transformed it to create this scene that immerses us in the ocean and an ancient stone city. The alley’s gray asphalt disappeared long ago, buried beneath a soft, dense carpet of moss that now breathes to the rhythm of the ocean currents. Today, the water is so crystal-clear that it’s invisible; colorful fish swim peacefully from window to window. On the walls, exotic plants have learned to bloom beneath the sea, stretching their green leaves toward an emerald light filtering down from the surface. In the middle of this submerged corridor, a mermaid rests silently on the damp rocks. She is the guardian of the ruins... I used Photoshop CS5 Extended to create my collage; I hope you like it. Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

title.title: Freewriting Dailyprompt: what's in that chest?
title.body:
My boyfriend bought her a penchant, so when she came home, she hid it and she didn't want to wear it.

When it was time, she was about to go for that party, she wore it and she wanted to sneak out. When her mother caught her and asked her what is in that chest, she could not answer.

She lied that she bought it. Then they asked her where she got the money from. She could not answer also, until when her brother came and said that it was her boyfriend. She was stopped from going for the party and she became angry and she started crying inside.

They seized the penchant and told her that she was not going to wear it. But is it good for parents to look after their teenage daughter?
You know that? Not to be misled by a boy's surrender. Or was it the right decision taken by her mother? Because she was just protecting her daughter.

title.title: The Forgotten Public Art
title.body:
For seventy years, the University of Cambridge kept its secret tucked beneath the weeds. Students passed it daily, throwing an idle glance at it, but only the few privileged history students could tell what had inspired the bronze leg art bleaching the water surface. It was an art meant to honor the swimming clubs in the late 60s.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF1gDPNwL1vq34DS77ne4GpkLBHEQPv1rqaTY2KWReUX/1781465668880.jpg)

[Photo source](https://ecency.com/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tf44k5)

The pathway above the shallow stream was Roseline's favorite spot. She came there every evening to watch the reflection of the ripples—it was a place she found comfort after a busy and hectic day in school. Occasionally she glanced at the art of the diver in the shallow water and smiled. *Whoever had made the sculpture did a very bad job*, she thought, \

she mumbled. She was a swimmer, and she believed only a swimmer could make a better sculpture of a diver.\n\nEven though the art was meant to honor swimmers, its relevance seemed to fade with the passing of time. An art that was once a center of admiration suddenly became a forgotten piece of art—even though it was in the public, its history was gone with the swimming clubs in the 60s.

title.title: Bandelier and Valles Caldera, New Mexico. Day 3 of US Road Trip 2026: Taos - Albuquerque [ENG/POL].
title.body: >Valles Caldera National Monuments were the highlights of day 3 of my
>US Road Trip 2026. On our way there from
>Taos, we visited two other points of interest - Earthship Biotecture and
>Los Alamos. While you may guess what we saw in the latter, I bet the former sounds a bit mysterious. Read on to learn what
>New Mexico offers to the curious.\n\n[POL]
>Valles Caldera to dwa rezerwaty przyrody, które odwiedziliśmy trzeciego dnia naszej podróży po
>południowym zachodzie USA. Dzień zaczął się interesująco jeszcze zanim do nich dotarliśmy. Najpierw odwiedziliśmy tajemniczo brzmiące miejsce Earthship Biotecture niedaleko
>New Mexico nie jest pierwszym wyborem turystów, a oferuje wiele ciekawych miejsc.\n\n

/>
\n\n

>=====

Plan: US Road Trip 2026, Day 3

\n\nEach day of my
>April 2026 road trip had been designed to move down the planned route (a 15-days loop from
>Denver) and stop for hikes. \n\n[POL] Każdy dzień
>podróży był zaplanowany tak, aby przesuwać się po pętli (15 dni ze startem i metą w

>Taos to Albuquerque, NM (318km)

Hiking

We did two hikes in Bandelier and Valles Caldera: 1.
>Cerro la Jara Loop Trail (2,5km, flat easy) -

>Valles Caldera National Preserve

Earthship Biotecture

We started the day with a short drive to a curious place just north of

>Earthship Biotecture is a group of houses built from natural or recycled materials. The houses are self-sustainable and completely off-grid. They get energy from sun, use rain water and natural sewage disposal. The buildings are designed to keep warmth in winters and comfortable cool in hot

/>
\n\n[POL] Dzień rozpoczęliśmy od wizyty w ciekawym miejscu na północ od

>Earthship Biotecture to grupa budynków wzniesionych z naturalnych lub pozyskanych z recyklingu materiałów. Domy mają energię ze słońca a wodę z deszczu. Są zaprojektowane tak, aby zachowywać ciepło zimą i przyjemny chłód w czasie gorących letnich miesięcy
>Nowego Meksyku. Anglojęzyczni czytelnicy nie zrozumieją odniesienia do zespołu Perfect i utworu \
ale dla czytających ten paragraf zacytuję:\n\n> Kiedy ja chcę zielonym byćDom grzać słońcem i deszczówkę z chmur pićWtedy mnie dopada myślKto ma ochotęO świat lepszy się bić(za

/>

Los Alamos

Our route led south, following the flow of
>Rio Grande river and the ranges of southern
>Rockies. Before our two hikes, we visited another place of interest - The Manhattan Project site in
>Los Alamos.\n\n[POL] Nasza droga prowadziła na południe, wzdłuż biegu
>Gór Skalistych. Zanim dotrzemy do zaplanowanych trekkingów, zatrzymamy się w miejscu, gdzie zrealizowano Projekt Manhattan -

/>
\n\nManhattan Project's goal was to create the first American nuclear bomb. Led by Robert Oppenheimer (lead scientist) and gen. Leslie Richard Groves Jr. (military overseer), hundreds of scientist, engineers and workers from early 1943 to the summer of 1945 designed, built and tested nuclear bomb, code named Trinity. The test site was a desert in

>New Mexico.\n\n[POL] Projekt Manhattan został powołany w celu stworzenia pierwszej amerykańskiej bomby atomowej. Od początku 1943r do lata 1945, setki naukowców, inżynierów i pracowników trudziło się aby zaprojektować, zbudować i przetestować bombę nuklearną. Projekt był prowadzony przez Roberta Oppenheimera (od strony naukowej) oraz generała Leslie Richarda Groves'a (od strony wojskowej). Pierwsza bomba zdetonowana na pustyni w

/>

Bandelier National Monument

>Valles Caldera are a National Monument and National Preserve, respectively, in New Mexico. They are close to each other, making it easy to visit both on a single day. Both are within Jemez Mountains range, which forms the southernmost tip of

>Valles Caldera to dwa rezerwaty przyrody położone w Nowym Meksyku (w USA ochrona przyrody ma inną strukturę niż w Polsce. Amerykańskie nazwy 'National Monument / National Preserve' nie mają bezpośredniego przełożenia na naszą nomenklaturę; będę używał nazwy 'rezerwat przyrody'). Oba parki położone są w południowej części
>Gór Skalistych, w górach Jemez. Znajdują są blisko siebie, co sprawia, że bardzo łatwo można je połączyć w jednodniowej wycieczce.\n\n

/>
\n\nThe park was named after Adolph Bandelier, a Swiss emigrant, who dropped his banking career in Illinois for travels across the wilderness of

>Arizona and devoted his life to the first people of the American southwest. He befriended inhabitants of Cochiti Pueblo, who showed him the Frijoles Canyon, where Ancient Pueblans had dwelled.\n\n[POL] Park został nazwany imieniem Adolpha Bandelier, szwajcarskiego emigranta, który 'rzucił wszystko' (czyli pracę w bankowości) i spędził życie w

>Arizonie, dokumentując życierdzennych narodów amerykańskiego południowego zachodu. Zaprzyjaźnił się z mieszkańcami Cochiti Pueblo, którzy zaprowadzili go do Frijoles Canyon, gdzie mieszkali przodkowie narodów Pueblo.  \n\n

/>

Cliff Dwellings

Bandelier National Monument protects natural features like canyons and mesa. There is also rich human history recorded in the rocks. From 12th to 16th century Ancestral Pueblans used natural caverns eroded in volcanic tuff to make cliff dwellings. Rich volcanic soils provided good conditions for growing corn, beans, and squash. 'Pueblans' is group name given to the native nations of southwestern US, to distinguish them from nomad tribes ('pueblo' in Spanish means town or village). [POL] Bandelier National Monument chroni kaniony i płaskowyż (ang. 'canyon and mesa country'). Skały parku kryją także bogatą historię ludzi, którzy tu żyli. Od do XII do XVI wieku mieszkali tu rdzenni Amerykanie, zwani jako przodkowie narodów Pueblo (to zbiorcza nazwa, używana w stosunku do narodów osiadłych, mieszkających w osadach - od hiszpańskiego 'pueblo', czyli osada/wioska). Mieszkańcy wykorzystali naturalnie powstałe otwory w wulkanicznym tufie formującym skały kanionów, by wykuć w nich mniejsze i większe mieszkania. Bogate wulkaniczne ziemie tworzyły doskonałe warunki to uprawy kukurydzy, fasoli i dyni.

/>
\n\nI chose an easy but attractive

>Pueblo Loop Trail, which took us to the most interesting places in the Frijoles Canyon ('beans' canyon in Spanish), showcasing how ancient people lived there. Contemporary ladders allow to climb to the dwellings. Some caverns barely allow two people in, some are large and comfortable, with several 'rooms'.\n\n[POL] Wybrałem łatwy szlak

>Pueblo Loop Trail, który zaprowadził nas do najciekawszych miejsc kanionu Frijoles ('fasolki' z j. hiszpańskiego), pokazując jak żyli jego dawni mieszkańcy. Współczesne drabiny pozwalają na zaglądnięcie do wnętrza skalnych domostw. Niektóre są ciasne, mieszczą ledwie dwie osoby. Inne to obszerne pomieszczenia, z kilkoma 'pokojami'.\n\n

/>
Some caverns were large enough for construction of granaries or storage tanks. They were sealed and entrance was possible only via a roof opening. [POL] Niektóre skalne mieszkania były na tyle duże, że pozwalały na konstrukcje obszernych magazynów. Wejście do nich było możliwe tylko przez otwór w stropie.

/>

Valles Caldera National Preserve
>Valles Caldera are neighboring preserves, but show different aspects of southern

>Rockies. While Bandelier is a canyon and mesa country, Valles Caldera is the crater of an extinct volcano. One has to know what to expect to read the terrain correctly. Otherwise it simply looks like a large plain surrounded by low hills.\n\n[POL]
>Valles Caldera to sąsiadujące rezerwaty, ale pokazują różne aspekty topografii południowych

>Gór Skalistych. Podczas gdy Bandelier to kaniony i płaskowyż, Valles Caldera to krater wygasłego wulkanu. Warto wiedzieć, czego się spodziewać, bo w przeciwnym wypadku zobaczymy po prostu rozległą równinę otoczoną niskimi wzgórzami.\n\n

/>

Hiking on a volcano

The preserve protects ecosystems situated between 2400m and 3400m a.s.l. The main plan, Valle Grande, sits at 2650m a.s.l. Meaning, we hiked a flat terrain inside a volcano situated higher than the

>Poland!\n\n[POL] Rezerwat chroni ekosystemy położone pomiędzy 2400m a 3400m n.p.m. Główna kaldera, Valle Grande, znajduje się na 2650m n.p.m. Co znaczy, że chodziliśmy po płaskiej równinie w kraterze wulkanu a byliśmy wyżej niż

/>
\n\nOur hike was an easy loop around

>Cerro la Jara, a little lava hill, which stands out in the otherwise flat caldera. The hike was short and flat, but wind tried to raise the difficulty bar a bit. April at 2600m a.s.l. is still quite cool!\n\n[POL] Nasz trekking to lekki spacer wokół

>Cerro la Jara, niewielkiego wzgórza lawowego, które wyraźnie wystaje z płaskiej kaldery. Szlak był krótki i płaski, ale wiatr próbował trochę podnieść poprzeczkę trudności. Kwiecień na wysokości 2600m n.p.m. ciągle jest chłodny!\n\n

/>

Albuquerque

The day with Bandelier and Valles Caldera as the highlights, provided a lot of different landscapes and places - from human to volcano made. The final stop was
>Albuquerque, the most populous city of
>New Mexico (and also the biggest city on our route, outside of the starting/ending point of

>Denver).\n\n[POL] Dzień w którym głównymi atrakcjami były parki Bandelier i Valles Caldera, zaoferował nam mnóstwo wrażeń i różne scenerie. Od zbudowanych ręką ludzką po uformowane przez wulkan. Naszym końcowym przystankiem było
>New Mexico (a także całej naszej trasy, oprócz punktu startowego/końcowego czyli

/>
Despite so many places to visit and significant driving distance, we managed to carve out time for a walk in Albuquerque's old town. Nothing to impress Europeans, but considering the context of US 250 years of independence, Albuquerque founded in 1706, is old indeed. [POL] Pomimo bogatego programu i pokonanego dystansu, wieczorem starczyło nam czasu na spacer po starym mieście Albuquerque. 1706r. nie robi wrażenia na turyście z
>Będzina (prawa miejskie 1358r.), ale w kontekście 250-lecia niepodległości Stanów Zjednoczonych, Plaza Vieja w Albuquerque można uznać za stare miasto.\n\n

/>
\n\nThe night in Albuquerque ends - for now - the

>Rocky Mountains part of our trip (the southernmost tip of the long range is just north of the city). We will return to the Rockies at the end, but the main geographical protagonist of the following 8 days will be Colorado Plateau. \n\n[POL] Noc w Albuquerque kończy - na razie - podróż wzdłuż

>Gór Skalistych. Ten długi łańcuch górski kończy się tuż na północ od miasta. Wrócimy w te majestatyczne góry pod koniec wyprawy, ale przez kolejne 8 dni głównym bohaterem geograficznym będzie Płaskowyż Colorado.\n\n
>=====Next stage / następny odcinek: Albuquerque, NM => St Michaels, AZ Highlights / główne atrakcje: Petroglyphs National Monument and El Malpais National Monument.

title.title: FROM FRONT TO BACK... (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
title.body: ** is perhaps a somewhat strange title for a black and white street photography article, but the reason is simple: this afternoon I decided to dedicate myself to reviewing my archives from these last two weeks—the ones that have already run in June—and I did it starting with the most recent photos and going from there to the oldest ones. So, after all, the title in question has nothing to do with one of those strange stories of mine where I see dead people and go back in time or things like that 😂... So, please, I invite you to continue forward in this publication and enjoy my street photographs, my small visual stories, my way of understanding and recording my surroundings; all of this in black and white and for you here on #Hive...\n\n>**B**ueno, sí, la verdad es que \

es quizás un título un tanto extraño para un artículo de fotografía callejera en blanco y negro, pero el motivo es simple: hoy en la tarde decidí dedicarme a revisar mis archivos de estas últimas dos semanas—las que han corrido ya de junio—y lo hice comenzando por las fotos más recientes y yendo de allí hacia las más viejas. Así que, después de todo, el título en cuestión no tiene que ver con una de esas extrañas historias mías en las que veo gente muerta y regreso en el tiempo o cosas por el estilo 😂... Así que, por favor, les invito a que continúen adelante en esta publicación y disfruten de mis fotografías callejeras, de mis pequeñas historias visuales, de mi manera de entender y registrar mi entorno; todo esto en blanco y negro y para ustedes aquí en #Hive... ---- ![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23zm1NtaF8BT57CAaNwyHY5rXBWp7zTvRh8i3JhXQ6Zuar7sati9TpqE6GrWtXN6fB1NY.jpg) **📷 01 - Photo with Rafael's facade and that scooter... / Foto con la fachada de Rafael y esa scooter... ** ---- ![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xVPfx1gdg8mHfRPe5R8oZ1Bu3zmwCsqrC18uT8VaKzT4KXAse6huYfaX7yBBjcWt9JQ.jpg) **📷 05 - Man passing by looking where I was also looking... / Hombre que pasa mirando donde yo también miraba... ** ---- ![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tvg61Bpf5isaN5un7QFeiHDvEEgdBsg2gUPrAKryvnSDgVGaZ5RSBkMJBRRxvYvxdKw.jpg) **📷 06 - Corner with the Coca-Cola bottles that Simon drinks... / Rincón con las botellas de Coca Cola que bebe Simón... ** ---- ![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wMePMt1ySs1HiT29LKJNi8c8om7dxosQqezmRS4sJwhwqwcuLuHyNTSg4BGykh1G446.jpg) **📷 07 - title.body:
# LIMA STREET DIARIES: MELANCHOLY IN MOTION / MELANCOLÍA EN MOVIMIENTO [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>

![_DSC3587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eoe896Fg2LRirRHtzghEBSzds9S3SVfvQKPAUcJ59c6Y3sCNb9rV8gC1h45cDune652.jpg)

*“Sometimes, the street is the only mirror that understands how we feel.”*
*“A veces, la calle es el único espejo que entiende cómo nos sentimos.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

title.title: Movie Review: They Will Kill You
title.body: Today I took my time to read the first chapter of \

, and afterwards I decided to watch this movies as it has been on my Laptop for a week now.
They Will Kill You I was expecting a simple horror movie, but what I got was a mix of horror, action, dark comedy, and pure chaos. It is one of those films that keeps getting crazier as it moves forward, and you cannot stop because you want to see what is gonna happen next.

The story follows Asia, a woman trying to rebuild her life after prison.My attention was captured when I saw the first scene of a loving sister trying to save her blood younger sister from an abusve father.She did go to prison for attempted murder. She takes a housekeeping job in a luxury apartment building, only to discover that something is terribly wrong with the people living there even at the very first neight, they did not even give her a break. What starts as a normal job quickly turns into a fight for survival.

One thing I enjoyed was how unpredictable the movie was . Every time I thought I knew where the story was heading, it took another turn, every scene would want you to want to see what is next. The building itself almost feels like a character because it hides so many secrets. There is plenty of violence and gore, so this is definitely not a movie for viewers who prefer mild horror. A view's discretion should be advised.

Zazie Beetz did a great job carrying the film. Her character felt tough without being unrealistic, and she gave the movie a strong center even when things became completely wild. The action scenes were energetic and sometimes over-the-top, but they were entertaining enough to keep me watching from start to finish.

That said, the movie is not perfect. Some parts feel borrowed from other horror-action films, and a few jokes did not land for me. The story also focuses more on action than on developing its characters.

Overall, ***\

*** is a fun and fast-paced movie that does not take itself too seriously. If you enjoy horror mixed with action, strange cults, and plenty of bloody mayhem , and additionally some touch of humor, this is worth checking out.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DfD6-Gf9AeE
[Traile](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DfD6-Gf9AeE)

**My Rating: 7.5/10**

title.title: New Models Every Day, Same Old Promise of Easy Money
title.body:
Every day, a new AI model comes out. On social media, especially X and Twitter, people share endless automations, workflows, and setups. Every week, a new video claims that one model is better than all the others, or that a new mix of tools can run an entire business with almost no work.

The conversation moves so fast that it can feel like the technology changes overnight.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRkqM66nBFXAp3DerSgzpZGh4ArvU51Mc2BVBugz6jy9y/ionela-mat-aaliGXGXH9w-unsplash.jpg 
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash > At the same time, stories like the recent concerns about Anthropic's Claude Fable models remind us that building powerful AI is not just about ability. Questions about security, safety, and responsibility keep coming up with every big advance. As models get more powerful, the discussions around them get more complex too. But under all the excitement, much of what we see feels familiar. It reminds me of the e commerce boom, when every part of the internet was full of promises of easy success. There were endless courses, guides, and systems teaching people how to package tools and sell a dream. Today, many AI automations feel the same. A large part of this market is not creating something new. It is repackaging existing tools into another workflow, another template, or another promise of easy income. That does not mean automation is useless. Far from it. Automation can remove repetitive work, speed up processes, and help one person do tasks that once needed a whole team. The technology is real, and its value is real. But among all these automated systems, the people who keep creating lasting value are often the natural ones. They are the writers who develop their own voice, the artists who create their own style, the teachers who explain things clearly, and the builders who solve real problems. Tools can boost skill, but they rarely replace originality. As the AI race continues and new models show up almost daily, it is worth remembering this: technology changes fast, but human attention, trust, and creativity stay hard to automate. The tools may get better every month. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ratxd/new-models-every-day-same-old-promise-of-easy-money-gcw)

title.title: Shadow Hunters Ep3
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmay1dimvpUyuTXkneuu1kxRV9bMtwAP6Gd5aUsaf4aXEb/img_7959.jpg)

I wasn’t planning to take a photo that day. I was just passing through the kitchen when something caught my eye. The sunlight had found its way into the room and created a bold shadow across the floor. It was one of those random moments that makes you stop and look twice.

What fascinated me was how the shadow cut across the tiles so perfectly. The kitchen, which is usually busy and ordinary, suddenly looked like a piece of modern art. The warm brown tones of the floor glowed under the sunlight, while the dark shadow stretched across the room like it was telling its own story. It felt dramatic, yet peaceful at the same time.

The textured side of the kitchen island added even more character to the scene. The lines and patterns worked together with the shadow, creating an unexpected mix of shapes and textures. It was amazing how something as simple as sunlight could completely change the mood of a familiar space.

I think that’s what I love most about photography. Sometimes the best photos are not planned. They happen in everyday moments when you least expect them. You don’t need a fancy location or a special event. All it takes is noticing something interesting and being ready to capture it.

The shadow only lasted for a short while before the sun shifted and the scene changed. That made the moment feel even more special. It was a reminder that beauty can appear in the simplest places, even on a kitchen floor. When I saw the way the light and shadow worked together, it just felt right to snap the picture and preserve that fleeting moment forever.

#shadowhunters #weekend #amusing

title.title: Tenacidad | Tenacity
title.body:
> Saludos. En su última publicación para la comunidad @holos-lotus la amiga @damarysvibra nos [deja]( https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/proyeccion-y-autonomiaororforward-looking-and-self-reliance) un conjunto de interesantes reflexiones sobre la importancia de colaborar a mantener la salud y la autonomía de nuestros cuerpos, un tema que se vuelve vital a medida que vamos dejando atrás la juventud. Les comento… Hace pocos días escuchaba una entrevista donde la persona invitada no tenía ninguna duda en definir la felicidad como la presencia de salud. Aquella sentencia tan tajante en principio me sorprendió un poco, generalmente cuando se habla de felicidad se alude a otros contenidos, muchas veces ligados con la posesión de bienes materiales, logros profesionales, amorosos y cosas por el estilo, pero no es común asimilarla con la salud. La diferencia en esta ocasión quizá estaba en que la persona que pronunciaba la sentencia ya había sobrepasado largamente la cincuentena de la vida, en esa etapa la perspectiva ha cambiado y se le da mucho más importancia a los temas relacionados con el cuidado del cuerpo, lo que no siempre ocurre en los años juveniles.. El texto de Damarys me recordó una experiencia muy reciente que tuvo mi madre. Hace pocos días ella llegó a los noventa y un años, en todo ese tiempo siempre ha sido una persona muy activa, se ocupa de sus cosas y le gusta colaborar con los demás en todo lo que pueda.
![imagen2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc656PKmt9Jv6piUDqWTYUvhpiNNwTZjjYMVywcxAsSsC/imagen2.jpg)
Por eso se sintió muy mal cuando hace unos tres meses se fracturó el hombro izquierdo en una caída, nunca le había ocurrido nada parecido. Afortunadamente la lesión no fue tan grave como para llevarla a la sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, si tuvo que estar con el brazo inmóvil durante casi ocho semanas. En todo ese tiempo con el brazo recogido ella sintió que había perdido una buena parte de su autonomía. Le fue muy difícil aceptar que no podía hacer las cosas que formaban parte de su rutina, le parecía increíble que de la noche a la mañana no pudiera fregar un plato, hacer una arepa, o bañarse sola. Para todas esas actividades tenía que aceptar, muy a su pesar, la asistencia de mi hermano menor, que logró organizar su agenda para atender a mi madre. Por fortuna las cosas evolucionaron bastante bien, la fractura fue soldando sin problemas y a las ocho semanas el médico la mandó al proceso de rehabilitación para restablecer la movilidad y la fuerza del brazo. Como era de esperar las primeras fases de la rehabilitación fueron algo dolorosas, mi madre todos los días me hablaba de eso. Sin embargo, su meta era poder lograr la mayor funcionalidad de ese brazo lesionado. Todos los días en la mañana asistía con entusiasmo y fe a las sesiones de rehabilitación, y en las tardes y las noches hacía en la casa los ejercicios que podía. Luego de treinta sesiones de rehabilitación ya ha recuperado la funcionalidad en un ochenta por ciento. El poder hacer sus arepas, bañarse sola, y encargarse de la limpieza de la casa le ha levantado mucho el ánimo. Ella está convencida que en el mediano plazo ya tendrá el brazo bien recuperado, aunque sabe que debe estar pendiente de algunas cosas como no hacer fuerza en exceso y sobre todo evitar golpes fuertes. Con el paso del tiempo es inevitable que el cuerpo se desgaste, se va volviendo normal convivir con algunos achaques que nos fastidien la vida. Sin embargo, es mucho lo que podemos hacer para contribuir con nuestro bienestar, para ello es necesario un poco de constancia. Con disciplina podemos incorporar algunos hábitos que nos permitan mantener la fuerza, la flexibilidad y el equilibrio el mayor tiempo posible. Mientras más temprano nos pongamos con eso mayor será el beneficio a futuro, vale bien el esfuerzo que dediquemos a eso. Gracias por tu tiempo. Fuente de imágenes. [I]( https://pixabay.com/es/photos/gente-agua-bote-vietnam-amanecer-4159313/) [II]( https://pixabay.com/es/photos/salida-del-sol-amanecer-paisaje-9856375/). ![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) ![TITULO INGLES (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqP53G31Zc37Fu43sWAS3Vy1ChSr2D7s93rpXMoERYLy/TITULO%20INGLES%20(2).jpg)



Greetings. In her latest post for the @holos-lotus community, our friend @damarysvibra [shares]( https://peakd.com/hive -131951/@damarysvibra/proyeccion-y-autonomiaororforward-looking-and-self-reliance) a set of interesting reflections on the importance of working together to maintain the health and autonomy of our bodies, a topic that becomes vital as we leave our youth behind. Let me tell you… A few days ago, I was listening to an interview where the guest had no hesitation in defining happiness as the presence of health. That rather categorical statement surprised me a bit at first; generally, when people talk about happiness, they refer to other things—often linked to the possession of material goods, professional or romantic achievements, and the like—but it’s not common to equate it with health. The difference this time was perhaps that the person making the statement was well past fifty; at that stage, one’s perspective has shifted, and much greater importance is placed on matters related to taking care of one’s body—something that doesn’t always happen in one’s younger years. Damarys’s text reminded me of a very recent experience my mother had. A few days ago she turned ninety-one; throughout all that time she has always been a very active person, taking care of her own affairs and enjoying helping others in any way she can. That’s why she felt so bad when, about three months ago, she fractured her left shoulder in a fall—nothing like that had ever happened to her before. Fortunately, the injury wasn’t serious enough to require surgery. However, she did have to keep her arm immobilized for nearly eight weeks.
![imagen2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc656PKmt9Jv6piUDqWTYUvhpiNNwTZjjYMVywcxAsSsC/imagen2.jpg)
During that entire time with her arm in a sling, she felt she had lost a significant part of her independence. It was very difficult for her to accept that she couldn’t do the things that were part of her routine; it seemed unbelievable to her that, overnight, she couldn’t wash a dish, make an arepa, or bathe on her own. For all those activities, she had to accept, much to her regret, the help of my younger brother, who managed to reorganize his schedule to care for my mother. Fortunately, things went quite well; the fracture healed without complications, and after eight weeks, the doctor sent her to rehabilitation to restore her arm’s mobility and strength. As expected, the early stages of rehabilitation were somewhat painful; my mother talked to me about it every day. However, her goal was to regain as much function as possible in that injured arm. Every morning she attended her rehabilitation sessions with enthusiasm and faith, and in the afternoons and evenings she did whatever exercises she could at home. After thirty rehabilitation sessions, she has already regained eighty percent of her functionality. Being able to make her arepas, bathe on her own, and take care of cleaning the house has really lifted her spirits. She is convinced that in the medium term her arm will be fully recovered, although she knows she must be careful about certain things, such as not exerting excessive force and, above all, avoiding hard blows. As time goes by, it’s inevitable that the body wears down; it becomes normal to live with some aches and pains that make life a bit of a hassle. However, there’s a lot we can do to contribute to our well-being, and that requires a bit of consistency. title.title: THE WILD DARKNESS PT. 3: Improving the Campfire (Eng-Esp)
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRiPCWZEoV89MkL6R8X5ETL8VySn7hNWQYFZVpEdpQg3N/1781466999512.jpg)

# <center>THE WILD DARKNESS PT. III: Improving the Campfire</center>

---

<center>*English*</center>

<div style=\

> After repairing the ruins of light and clearing out the first dungeon, my immediate priority was to craft a pickaxe and head back into that cave. There was no point in moving forward without exploiting the resources I had left behind. I went back down there and successfully mined the stone and silver deposits I needed to build a decent fire pit and, eventually, a foundry to process metals. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQb2PMgvGL6CKMrT3YAyzdz8imUUSSpkRZAmM4Rt64YAb/1781466999594.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeXrKyroeT2o3ik6Ssi5ej9iG6tY6XZB7s9oqavgsC6md/1781466999676.jpg) During the mining mission, things got complicated. A malevolent shadow spawned and started chasing me. Because the darkness of the cave makes these entities stronger, running away from it was a bit harder than usual, but I managed to escape toward the surface without any major issues. Upon returning to the camp, I put those materials to work. I built the fire pit and a canopy tent to finally protect myself from the weather and the animals. Now, this camp actually looks like a base of operations and not an improvised barbecue setup. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYUUfnKquRAbwSz1yXEYSSNMT1Nyww3rPdMhFAvQc9TRm/1781466999743.jpg) As a secondary reward, simply for surviving 5 consecutive days, I managed to unlock the Warrior class. I will definitely use it in my next run, because the adventurer class is already falling a bit short, and besides, the warrior class must have new features and characteristics to discover. After eating something quick and going to sleep to recover stamina, I packed up the camp and headed toward the next level: the Strange Forest. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdg4orU2vjdvTPutsUWKN9r2R8GFgXG8gj6W5WVg1Tr2G/1781467025318.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ33gccfmr1v5X7U2bdRfhov6zU6UisEGALxS9HQaUeuU/1781467025400.jpg) The moment I stepped into this new zone, the sun began to set, forcing me to set up an improvised camp once again to shelter myself for the night. The monsters hiding inside the dungeons and the aggressive creatures that stalk at night will make this playthrough significantly harder from now on. But hey, at the end of the day, that’s what we are here for. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYF6Y3RRUV7s1CTpjAN1PtPXHiioudbzAVKpTcZqtfCzK/1781467025457.jpg) ---
*Español*

> Luego de reparar las ruinas de luz y superar la primera mazmorra, mi prioridad inmediata era armar un pico y volver a esa caverna. No tenía sentido seguir avanzando sin explotar los recursos que había dejado atrás. Fui hasta allá y logré minar con éxito los yacimientos de piedra y plata que me hacían falta para construir un foso de fuego decente y, eventualmente, una fundición para procesar los metales. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVmSFVRLNQ4WftxWb2DmcizYtSxSQH9gearoXNSawnoKB/1781467025523.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUs3hzaRg5bwDipPQuNxcRGsJNu5VLGhmwoa87sNU1kKn/1781467025601.jpg) Durante la misión de minería, las cosas se complicaron. Se me apareció una sombra maligna y empezó a perseguirme. Como la oscuridad de la cueva hace más fuertes a estas entidades, me costó un poco más de lo normal huir de ella, pero logré escapar hacia la superficie sin mayores problemas. Al regresar al campamento, puse a producir esos materiales. Construí el foso de fuego y un toldo para protegerme por fin del clima y de los animales. Ahora sí, este campamento parece una base de operaciones y no una barbacoa improvisada. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQLB4sLr4GSYY3oTV4qV7QcprDPhnx7aBWgCFM9GDP8A/1781467111055.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNnoXYT42itrDBUEiaK2owvbH7TmLqWTmedh2TeovWGc/1781467111145.jpg) Como recompensa secundaria, por el simple hecho de sobrevivir 5 días seguidos logré desbloquear la clase de Guerrero. Definitivamente la usaré en mi próxima partida, porque la clase de aventurero ya se está quedando un poco corta, además, la clase de guerrero debe tener nuevas features y características por descubrir. Luego de comer algo rápido e ir a dormir para recuperar estamina, me dispuse a recoger el campamento y me dirigí hacia el siguiente nivel: el Bosque Extraño. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2uN9t1ggdjTVrFXj82xTV7TFXy6SuWpjBRJe2uFzHcg/1781467111333.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSY7GpEpQFx65bGUxMYMKjWpnHt1e7pTg9d5oeLQWmrmg/1781467111377.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdt7NuWkNFL4V6fe36do81JGg9Z2b79fuDzBEfMFS1ZJA/1781467111453.jpg) Nada más al entrar a esta nueva zona, el sol empezó a ocultarse, obligándome a armar nuevamente un campamento improvisado para resguardarme por la noche. Los monstruos que se esconden en las mazmorras y las criaturas agresivas que acechan de noche harán que esta partida se ponga significativamente más difícil a partir de ahora. Pero bueno, al final del día, para eso estamos aquí. ---
| *From my infinite humbleness... / Desde mi infinita humildad...* | | :---: | | @noxys |

title.title: Forget War, Pandemics and Climate Change, Potholes are the real problem!
title.body:
While the news these days is dominated by one international crisis after another, and plenty of political drama at a national level, what really drives everyday people nuts is potholes.... 

And not just potholes, but a whole host of other mundane issues that hits closer to home. Broken pavements, overflowing bins, the fight for parking, traffic jams, anti-social behaviour—the basic stuff people rely on. All the small things that tell you whether your town is actually working or quietly falling apart.

Political journalists love to pick apart ideologies and leaders, but most people spend more time cursing the state of the roads outside their homes. It is, after all, this that see up close, day in day out. 

Local polling during the elections in fact informed us that roads and transport topped voters’ worries. And maybe this shouldn't surprise us: People don’t bump into MPs, but they drive on council roads, watch their rubbish get collected—or not—and see what’s happening to their parks and libraries.

If you want to know how people really feel about government, look at how those services run. Lately, a lot of people feel they’re not running at all.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23wX7qs6vpnQA8vqWQP5yjEPYiKQVNT8Mtqy9M6QbNVL7BB4iiL2Jhqr63U9FgcKrq25W.png)


### The problem....

In a nutshell it's 15 years of austerity for local councils - they've had massive cuts to their budget and massively rising costs for the treble whammy of adult social care, special education needs and emergency accommodation. 

And those three things together take up an enormous chunk of many local council's budgets... and that's with the standards of service being not that great at all, frankly. 

And this means less money to spend on everything else and so all council services get worse! 

Meanwhile, council tax keeps going up. It makes no sense to anyone paying it—why does more money buy worse services? Because those increases get swallowed by the basics: social care, and other mandatory costs no one’s figured out how to rein in. Councils charge more, but people get less. It’s political poison.

And swapping out one party for another at the town hall? That won’t fix it. The problems are baked in. Britain’s population is getting older, social care is still a massive headache, business rates don’t work, more kids need extra help, and housing shortages drive up temporary accommodation costs.

Unless those big things change, local councils stay stuck. More cuts, higher bills, services getting squeezed.

We basically need to the government, whatever government, to get on top of how to fund the basics so people's council tax can go back to paying for what matters to them on a day to day basis, and that means potholes filled and bins emptied.
