title.title: Why can't Kuro come up with an original idea?
title.body: ![](https://preview.redd.it/why-cant-kuro-come-up-with-an-original-idea-v0-hjwmzwc7d97h1.jpg?width=1080&crop=smart&auto=webp&s=9b1ee7d500c9b52285122ddce6b985c8340a5f19)\n\nHi guys! I am Inotia King a [youtuber](https://t.ly/we8Tl \
) and gamer who likes theorizing about the story. I actually cobbled together a list of some of my more important theories with respect to the game [Genshin Impact](https://t.ly/oe-Fc \

) that I have been basing all of my newer theories on. I'll be putting more of those up on Hive along with new stuff but if you're impatient I also archived all my theories [here.](https://t.ly/hQVT_ \

modeled after their previous game's main protagonist. Genshin's Unknown God looked unmistakably like Herrscher of the Void Kiana so Wuwa's Unknown God looked just like Lucia. Rover itself is a synonym for Traveler. (and Wanderer) Similarly, the \

was clearly based on Genshin's Moonchase Festival and related to the same real world holiday as well. The game's first regional expansion also happened to be a frost covered mountain (Dragonspine) and Kuro even named it Mt. Firmament after the false sky lore of Genshin that was based on the Gnostic Firmament. (right and there was even a dragon's form inlaid into these mountains though there was a lore reason for Dragonspine while Jue wasn't quite the same as the rocky dragon slope of Firmament) Finally you have the Fractsidus and their Overseers which is obviously lifted from Genshin's Fatui and the Harbingers. Scar is just Childe. His boss fight even has 3 stages where two of them are just him and the last is him in a mutated form. Phrolova is a little more interesting. She started out as just Signora but Signora was killed off and not made playable so Phrolova ended up turning into Columbina's original characterization later. However the rest of the lore during this time was only vaguely inspired by miHoYo's Hoyoverse and Kuro made its own interpretation of it where life is formed by sound waves or \

which is based on the Hoyoverse's fictional version of string theory but taken literally. Huanglong's story is totally removed from anything miHoYo made. It just wasn't a good story and players let Kuro know this. I was actually defending Kuro back then and offered some critiques.

Following Huanglong though, Rinascita is 100% based on Genshin. As the first new region released in the game's v2.0 major update, Rinascita is an isolated island nation cut off from the rest of Solaris-3 by hard to traverse waters due to the major antagonist who also serves as the god of the region, Leviathan. This is Inazuma, an isolated island nation cut off from the rest of Teyvat by hard to traverse waters due to the god of the region who serves as the major antagonist, the Raiden Shogun. However in order to not be 100% Inazuma, Rinascita is also designed around Fontaine's unique mechanics and culture. Fontaine is based on Industrial France and as the nation of Hydro, you can dive underwater throughout the nation. Rinascita is based on Renaissance Italy and as the nation of Aero, you can fly throughout the nation. Then you meet the first released character of the region, the daughter of a prominent family whose forward thinking runs afoul of the other two rivaling factions, one a religiously based group directly linked to the nation's god and another a political rival. She wields the power of the ice element and has an assistant that acts as a tour guide for the main character. So this is the Glacio/Cryo character Carlotta/Ayaka, prominent daughter of the Montellis/Yashiro Commission's Kamisato clan who rivals the Fisalias/Kanjou Commission and a subordinate organization to the ruling god Imperator/Raiden Shogun called the Order of the Deep/Tenryou (heaven's will) Commission. We are guided by her attendant Zani/Thoma.

And the rest of the game follows suit:

- Zani is designed around Arlecchino (Genshin) and Evelyn (Zenless) with a similar backstory to the latter. Her role in the story is a cross between Thoma (Inazuma inspired) and Clorinde (Fontaine inspired) as she looks after Carlotta (Ayaka and Furina respectively)
- Brant is a cross between Wriothesley and Navia and he brought us to Rinascita like Beidou did. As Wriothesley, he's the ship captain that saves the outcasted Fools sent on the Pilgrim's Sail (Meropide) and as Navia, he's their leader who runs his operation in a literal hole in the ground called the Fool's Elysium. (Poisson)
- There is also some element of Lyney in Brant but this applies more to Roccia who is his Lynette, a quiet girl with an attention for detail that she occasionally blurts out.
- Cantarella is very obviously an oversexed version of Kokomi who had been lusted after by Genshin players on her release. Cantarella has the same jellyfish motif, attacks with what looks like swimming animations while she floats in the air, her Fisalia family comes from an ancient civilization (Enkanomiya for Kokomi) and she's the current head of this family. (High Priestess) She also had to unfortunately work with the Fractsidus (Fatui) in order to realize her goal of freeing Rinascita (Watatsumi) from the tyranny of the Threnodian. (Shogunate) From even a meta sense, players believed Cantarella was the true Blessed Maiden which turned out to be false as Cartethyia was the \
true maiden. In Genshin, players thought Kokomi was the resurrected Hydro Dragon but Neuvillette turned out to be the \

true dragon.
- Cartethyia is actually unrelated to anything from Inazuma but instead is an amalgamation of Sumeru's Nahida and Fontaine's Furina. She was split in two by a god (Rukkhadevata to Nahida) where one of these pieces would be powerless while the other would retain her full divinity. (Furina and Focalors' Divinity) The one with the divinity became corrupted by the Threnodian who had assimilated the Sentinel Imperator. (Rukkhadevata corrupted by forbidden knowledge) In the end Imperator's (Rukkhadevata's) plan was to erase herself and the Threnodian (Abyssal forbidden knowledge) from existence. This would then free Cartethyia (Furina) from the burden of fate so she could live her own life.
- Ciaccona is a genderswapped Venti (players had claimed Venti looked like a girl) and Kazuha. (players joked that Kazuha was a better Anemo Archon than Venti) Ciaccona (Kazuha) can use a leaf as a musical instrument, senses things on the wind that others typically can't and is a bard by profession (Venti) but is a traveling bard. (Kazuha is a traveling ronin)
- The Carnevale is both the Irodori Festival that progressed Inazuma forward and the Sabzeruz Festival in Sumeru that celebrated Cartethyia (Nahida) rather than the Sentinel (Rukkhadevata) so it was opposed by the Order of the Deep. (Sages)
- The Inazuma and Sumeru theme of tradition over progression is core to Rinascita. Leviathan (Ei, sages) wanted to keep Rinascita (Inazuma, Sumeru) from changing so it had the Order of the Deep (Tenryou Commission, Akademiya) oppose any attempt at change.

Septimont diverges from Rinascita storywise despite it just being another piece of the region. Septimont takes the aesthetics of Fontaine's Petrichor (Rome) and story of Natlan. The gladiator contest is obviously the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame. The Hunt and High Tide over Sanguis Plateaus is just the Night Warden Wars.

- Lupa is Mualani, strong fighters who are meant to become heroic figures. They love to compete and are introduced as veteran fighters with many wins already under their belts.
- Mya is Kachina, underdog fighters who deeply desire to win for once. Mya (Kachina) was lulled by the Dark Tide (Abyss) when she died.
- Phrolova started off as Signora but then became more like the version of Columbina hinted about in Childe and Scaramouche's voicelines about her and her then single appearance in _Winter Night's Lazzo_. Basically she says strange things in a flighty tone and she looks like a damsel but this only hides her true monstrous self. However, her storyline plays out the Petrichor World Quest where she (Remus) has preserved her dead town (Remuria) in a Sonoro Sphere (Grand Symphony) intent on bringing them back to life. (preventing their death by the Fontaine flood prophecy)
- Adding to Phrolova, we have Fenrico (Boethius) and \

(Sybilla) who are blinded by their god's destructive plan because they foolishly believe it will save the people from the Dark Tide. (Great Prophecy) In the end, the real culprit behind Phrolova's act (Petrichor World Quest) was Triss (Sybilla) as the Grand Architect. (Grand Symphony)\n- Augusta is the most blatant clone of a Genshin character to date. She isn't even any different from Mavuika except for her very fake accent which was meant to be Greek but her VA is Scottish and doesn't know how to do a Greek accent unlike Zani's VA. Kuro attempted to make her mildly different by giving her the Havoc element instead of Fusion but she had a sun crown on her head (Pyro Archon) wields a massive broadsword (Claymore Character) is the Ephor (Archon) who leads her nation as the Hero of Heroes (leader of the Six Heroes of Natlan) and this is why the Dark Tide (Abyss) keeps whispering to her that she'll fail. Her death is even fated to happen and is a subplot to the story. There's also a section showcasing Augusta's (Mavuika's) childhood and aspirations to become Ephor. (Archon) Finally there is even a section of Act VIII where Augusta (Mavuika) and Rover (Traveler) embark on separate paths towards facing the False Sovereign (Gosoythoth) before they converge together to defeat it.\n- Iuno looks like Mona and has the ability to see fate like she does and because of this ability they both felt that fate could not be changed. Also because of this ability, Kuro was able to link Iuno to Natlan's Citlali. It was Iuno (Citlali) who foretells Augusta's (Mavuika's) fated death and means to stop it. However because Citlali doesn't have a plan for this as fate can't be changed, Kuro had to use Scara's changing of fate story instead so Iuno (Scara) erases herself from existence in order to nudge fate just enough. After that, Rover (Traveler) had to bring Iuno (Scara) back by showing her that she wasn't alone in her painful fate of people taking her for granted. (\

him) In the end, Iuno (Scara) is back but nobody remembers her and so her story going forward is detached from what we knew about her from before like her being the priestess. (Harbinger, Kunikuzushi)\n- These two acts run through Natlan's Acts III-V but the beginning of it is actually set in the Ochkanatlan World Quest. We start by entering a narrow mountain pass where fireballs rain from the sky. Tyranno (Evil Dragon) is a dinosaur (Saurian) and we chase it until the fated battle where Iuno (Cocouik) tells us it's actually the False Sovereign. (OchKan) Early in the following act, Kuro actually has Brant paraphrase the Natlan creed, \

)\n- The finale to Rinascita unravels a little as Kuro had exhausted most of the available content from Genshin. Therefore we got a rerun of the first ending to Rinascita where the enemy is once again Leviathan in the form of Fleurdelys and Cartethyia is once again in peril and \

However Kuro included the part where only Rinascitans are dreaming of sinking into an enormous, black ocean. (only Fontainians will dissolve into the Primordial Sea)\n- There was enough material left for Galbrena at least. She's somewhat like a genderswapped Genshin character except her look is also lifted from another character unlike Ciaccona whose look at least is original. Galbrena (Kinich) was attacked while traversing through ruins where she discovered a powerful TD (dragon) called Chimera (Ajaw) and by making a pact with him, they fight for humanity together. However when Galbrena (Kinich) dies, Chimera (Ajaw) will gain control over her body. They also have an antagonistic relationship with each other where Chimera (Ajaw) persistently tries to belittle Galbrena (Kinich) to bolster his own ego as \

(Almighty Dragonlord) Her look with the black shorts and exposed toned abs is Dehya's look, palette swapping from red to blue.

**Side Note:** Galbrena's weird Slavic accent though doesn't fit with Rinascita but then neither did Augusta's Scottish-Greek accent. These characters are friends so maybe they grew up in the Scottish/Russian part of the Greco-Roman Septimont? That is 100% Kuro original. miHoYo hasn't come up with a Scottish/Russian/Greco-Roman region yet though Nod-Krai which I previously said miHoYo adapted from Rinascita does come close, being Celtic/Baltic/Balkan/Slavic with just a little too much Persia.

Lahai-Roi is the third region for the game and therefore just like Rinascita, it is based on the next region for Genshin: Sumeru. Sumeru is divided into two specific areas the rainforest and the desert wasteland. Lahai-Roi is divided into underground forests and cities and the frozen wasteland on the surface. The main feature of Lahai-Roi is the Startorch Academy (Akademiya) and the students all carry a Cassette. (Akasha Terminal) The forest areas are inhabited by short rotund creatures created from the Exostrider (Dendro Archon) called Soliskins. (Aranara) And the Duskveil (Wall of Samiel) prevents the spread of Voidmatter (forbidden knowledge) from reaching Startorch Academy. (Akademiya) But in order not to be 100% Sumeru, it is also Genshin's Khaenri'ah, a technologically advanced underground nation with no patron god and based on the cold Nordic region. Kuro also copied over the Frostmoon Scions from Nod-Krai as the Roya, a tribal group who are the original inhabitants of the frostlands (Hyperboreans) and worship the artificial sun Helios. (false sky image of the Frost Moon)

- Lynae is interesting. She is based on the gyaru and so she takes on the look of Star Rail's Rappa with the skater movement style of Genshin's Xilonen along with the graffiti attack animations of both of them and then the biker chick of Zenless' Burnice. These 3 characters happened to be actively compared against each other by the miHoYo community. Personalitywise though Kuro didn't really hide that Lyn(ae) is just like Lyn(ey) since she was upbeat and gave the Rover (Traveler) a guided tour of Startorch Academy (Fontaine) but then it turned out she was working with the Fractsidus (Fatui) but was actually a merc from the New Federation. (Arlecchino's House of the Hearth a more benevolent branch of the Fatui) Once discovered, she desperately hopes to be accepted for who she is and not what she was. (Lyney and Lynette wanted to stay friends with the Traveler despite being Fatui)
- Mornye is another Columbina and she won't be the last. Phrolova was changed from Signora into the earliest form of Columbina. By Nod-Krai, Genshin had released Columbina but she was very different. Her story would become even more different later so Mornye represents the early phase of this new Nod-Krai Columbina. She's a meek and softspoken girl who is disabled because of her legs which makes her walk and run in a unique way. Columbina at this point was considered blind and she too walked and ran in a unique way but it wasn't explained why in any way other than that she was weak. Just like Columbina's story is related to the Scions, Mornye's Act II was related to the Roya. The traitor in the Roya reflects the traitor in the Scions, both of whom were disillusioned by their respective traditions which related to Mornye (researcher of Helios) and Columbina. (the goddess of the Frost Moon)
- Nod-Krai's Archon Quest had finished by the time Aemeath released but this wouldn't have been enough time to make use of the most recent material. Kuro really wanted to use the Columbina story arc and therefore Aemeath became the only character to have her story take shape across two acts. In Act III we have her introduction as the true Columbina clone. She's a ghostly presence who only meets with Rover and becomes deeply connected to them as the story progresses. Then when Aleph-1 (Dottore) poses an imminent threat to the region she sacrifices herself by entering a pathway into the past. Act V took place recently and was ample enough time to figure out how to use the rest of Columbina's story. In fact, Kuro took a clip from one of Genshin's cutscenes wholesale to use for Aemeath. You can see it in the header image at the top of this topic. Act V gives us the collection of all the Lahai-Roi (Nod-Krai) characters figuring out that Aemeath (Columbina) is still alive and where she is, in order to help Rover (Traveler) get her back. Aemeath (Columbina) also revives by first creating an Exoswarm body for herself (Luonnotar) that can anchor her soul. Actually Duskveil could also be related to Columbina since the Aemeath after her sacrifice used Duskveil (kuuvahki) to protect Lahai-Roi. (Nod-Krai) She also marked spots across the region that guided the group to where they needed to be and what they needed to do to stop Aleph-1. (Rerir and Dottore)
- Luuk is literally a doctor that has a shady past thus warranting some mistrust though the characters in game don't really show it. Just like Baizhu. They even have very similar personalities, tones, even their impassive expression.
- Sigrika is the final character Kuro uses elements of Columbina on. In this case, she's the chosen one (Moon Goddess) and everybody puts unnecessary pressure on her, believing she'd solve their problems. However she takes more cues from Nahida in that she internalized those expectations. They even used the Act V scene from Sumeru where Nahida (Sigrika) is trapped inside of a bubble separating her from the real world and she's questioning her worth while the Traveler (Rover) is pounding away on the bubble's wall to try and convince her of her strength. (Kuro also gave her Jahoda's wide assortment of anime expressions)
- Lucilla is the game's next Cantarella but she takes after Nod-Krai's Nefer what with being the one running things behind the scenes. And if that wasn't clear enough, Kuro gave her a Segue where Lucilla (Nefer) visits a dreamworld on purpose and it goes awry when the Fractsidus (Rerir) hijacks her visit to force her to relive her painful past which backfires when it doesn't work on her and instead she catches their rabbit. (Rerir)
- The sky over Solaris-3 is false and the Etheric Sea is up there. Rover was a member of an alien race from a distant planet who was summoned to save Solaris-3 and the Exostriders are the spaceships used by their Sentinels. The Exostrider crashed in Lahai-Roi. This was taken wholesale from Genshin's _A Space and Time For You_ where the false sky became a barrier against the Abyss outside of it and the Traveler was revealed to be an alien who was summoned as a Descender to save Teyvat and arrived by spaceship which crashed in Nod-Krai. The ship housed their homeworld's people as a DNA database. [(actually this is an example of copycat telephone because miHoYo took this idea from Squaresoft's Final Fantasy IX)](https://www.reddit.com/r/GenshinImpactLore/comments/1rbx598/prometheus\_again\_but\_with\_a\_terran\_twist/)

Besides Genshin though, Kuro didn't want to be caught only copying from one source so the following list is where it mixed things up with other sources like miHoYo's Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero but also other games like Atlus' Persona 3 and 4.

- Back in Lahai-Roi's Act III, Aemeath didn't have enough Columbina story to pad out hers so Kuro also gave her Cyrene from Star Rail. Aemeath (Cyrene as Mem) has Rover (Trailblazer) take her to several locations during their time together where she regains pieces of her memories. In order to prevent Aleph-1 (Irontomb) from posing an existential threat to the world (universe) but more importantly Rover (Trailblazer) she creates an intentional time loop and goes into the past to help the Exostrider reseal Aleph-1 and close the Stridergate. (set up an endless time loop, closing off Amphoreus forever which will prevent Irontomb's creation)
- Before Aemeath, Kuro also used Star Rail's Amphoreus story to create the NPC Avidius who is 100% Phainon right down to the cape. Avidius (Phainon) is set to become the Hero of Heroes (Deliverer) while Augusta (Mydei) the Ephor (King of Castrum Kremnos) is his rival though they are friends. In the end, Augusta (Mydei) had to give up being the Hero of Heroes (savior of Okhema) which passed on to Avidius. (Phainon)
- As Avidius is Phainon, his keeper was also taken from Amphoreus. Cristoforo (Lygus) manipulated and wrote Avidius' (Phainon's) entire life to prepare him to become Leviathan's (Irontomb's) vessel. Upon learning of this, Avidius (Phainon) swore to carve his own path in life. (and then Avidius died while Phainon fought across billions of reiterations of the world, defying Lygus each time despite knowing there wasn't any solution)
- Phrolova started out as Signora and then gained some early Columbina traits added to her in order to make her sympathetic enough to become playable. However Wuwa also copied elements from Persona 3 including Strega. Phrolova is also Chidori as both of them feared attachments more than death.
- Persona 4's overarching theme was also used twice. In Rinascita, the Ragunnesi (humanity) unconsciously desired to be fooled by Leviathan (Izanami) so it created the Paradise (TV World) based on what they wanted to believe in. However in order to exist in this realm, they must become infected by the Dark Tide. (become Shadows) In Lahai-Roi, Aemeath was intending to keep Rover in the dark about their past but Rover (Yu Narukami) explained that they needed to know the truth no matter how painful because even the sweetest of lies is still just a lie.
- Hiyuki actually bookended Act V with her Segue where she is a fictional miko because she wields a katana and her \

is just a bracelet with jingle bells. An example of a real miko in design, religious references, abilities, role, and tools would be Yae Miko from Genshin. The reason Hiyuki doesn't have much in common with a real miko is that she's actually based on all three of the currently released Zenless Zone Zero Void Hunters, none of whom are shrine maidens. She is a very powerful Glacio (Ice) swordswoman (Miyabi) that hails from a Japan-based region whose power comes from the Sentinels (Creator) which made her a target for the Fractsidus (Exaltists) who were hoping to turn her into the Threnodian's Resonator (Creator's Messenger) but she easily turned that around on them by quickly rejecting this potential future in a montage that showcased her swordsmanship. Her sword's name is even FrostBurn which is the Anomaly state Miyabi inflicts. Hiyuki (Yixuan) succeeded her older sister Gyokuro (Yijiang) as the next Miko of Flaming Sakura (High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit) after she was killed by overusing the Suzu (Qingming Sword) a power that comes from the Sentinels. (Creator) She uses her Shirotori (Qingming Bird) to assist her allies from afar. The Suzu (Qingmind Sword) works by sacrificing the user's potential futures (memories of the past) until there is nothing left and causes death.
- Denia didn't start off with any notable traits from an existing character but that all changed when Kuro released her Segue. She's an orphan with unique attributes (Yidhari) that attracted the attention of the Fractsidus (Exaltists) specifically the Grand Architect (Creator) as Nivora (Sarah) who used her as a conduit for Aleph-1. (Mysterious Town) There was even a horror section in that story where Denia (Yidhari with Phaethon's group) are chased by zombie puppet Nivoras like a cross between Slenderman and Resident Evil. (Wandering Hunter Ethereal and creepy little girl like a cross between Silent Hill and Resident Evil) This chase section is also reminiscent of the Death Shadow from the Persona games where as it approaches you can hear the sound of chains (Nivora puppets creaking footsteps) (Ah-deh footsteps that sound like Resident Evil's Nemesis) steadily approaching from behind. There's also the Abyss aura seen a few times in Genshin chase sections. But Denia was also slated to be the vessel of Aleph-1 (Creator) which changed her (Ye Shiyuan) into a version of her in a black outfit (Black Shiyuan) and now that she's fully embraced this side of her, she's intending to fight Aleph-1 (the Creator) on her own and separated from Rover/Sigrika/Startorch Academy. (Phaethon/Shunguang/Yunkui Summit)

**Side Note:** When it comes to Avidius, in Kuro's defense v2.7 came out about the same time as Star Rail's v3.4 where we would find out what became of Phainon. Therefore Kuro didn't have more than the Star Rail players to work with and back then the theory was that Phainon was just going to become a Lord Ravager. This is essentially what happened to Adivius only he \

this fate by dying lol

One thing I highly praise Genshin for is the use of real world references. Most games will use a term or element from a historical, cultural or religious source for the purposes of what it could be for their game. For example, Bahamut from the Final Fantasy franchise is a winged dragon but in reality, it's a fish. Similarly, Shiva isn't an attractive ice woman. Persona games have Personas all lifted from folklore across the world but usually don't share any abilities with those references unless they are ones Japan understands. To compare, we can relate references Wuwa made to those same references made by Genshin.

- The Grand Architect assumed the identity of Kharon when players arrive in an area called the River Styx. This is plainly lifted from Greek mythology. However since he's actually the Grand Architect, that's as far as this reference goes. On the other hand, Zenless has the character Trigger whose codename became Charon. She belonged to a team all named after the five rivers in Hades like Acheron and Lethe. Her original codename was Phlegethon also one of the rivers. Together they had formed Lyre Squad referencing the myth of Orpheus who traveled the underworld in a failed attempt to bring back his dead wife. This was the major theme of Trigger's Agent Story, being unable to let go of those who had died just like Orpheus couldn't let go of his wife. This caused suffering to Orpheus, Trigger and also the story's antagonist Grim Vulture. At the end of the story, Trigger assumes the name Charon in honor of her former squad and assumes the role as their guide through the underworld because the same incident that caused their deaths also gave Trigger her unique Ether Vision which lets her see Ether properties in objects like Ethereals who are essentially walking corpses. In other words, miHoYo used the mythology of the Greek underworld to explore their story, tying the real world references into how the characters bearing them relate to them. Kuro just created a version of the literal character without actually doing anything with it and since there isn't any known afterlife in the game, there won't be anything done with it.
- Hiyuki as a miko. She wears the miko outfit and she has bells. Ultimately, she's more related to a taijiya given she hunts supernatural enemy forces like the TDs and she dispatches them with a katana. Her bracelet bells are not a real shrine maiden's Suzu (though the word does mean bell) and there is nothing in Shintoism about using Suzu to sacrifice your future in any kind of ritual. On the other hand, Genshin's Yae Miko is 100% a miko. She too wears the outfit but she also serves as Guuji or head priestess at the Narukami Shrine which is a shrine preceded by a long winding path adorned in torii gates. This makes the shrine a reference to Japan's real world shrines to Inari, the most popular kami in the country. Inari is related to the kitsune in Japanese folklore sometimes even depicted as one. Yae Miko is a kitsune. Unlike Hiyuki, Yae wields a Gohei in battle and in her rituals at the shrine. A design choice was made by miHoYo that she is to date the only Catalyst Character who doesn't use the equipped Catalyst when she attacks but instead uses her Gohei. A Gohei is a vessel for a divine entity which gets channeled through the miko and is why while the common kanji for miko is 巫女, it was also once written as 神子 or child of the kami. This is Yae Miko's name. Yae's signature weapon is what a miko's Suzu Bell actually looks like and it makes further references as it's named Kagura's Verity. One ritual that miko use their Suzu Bells for is the Kagura Dance which was first performed by the kami Ame no Uzume, a kami who inspired the creation of the miko in Japanese culture. In mythology, Ame no Uzume is also the one who lures Amaterasu out from her self-imposed seclusion which had been destroying Japan. This relates to the Inazuma Archon Quest where Yae is the one who works out a plan to draw Ei out of her self-imposed seclusion in the Plane of Euthymia which was ruining Inazuma. Yae has a line about people being mirrors to reflect upon one's shortcomings and this line is in relation to Ei having secluded herself. It is a direct shoutout to how Ame no Uzume used her mirror Yata no Kagami to reflect on Amaterasu which convinced her to end her seclusion. Finally the region name itself, Inazuma means lightning in its capacity to infuse soil with nitrates thus \

fertilizing it for rice cultivation. Inari is the kami of rice cultivation.\n- Speaking of Japan-based regions, Kuro created Ashinohara for Wuwa along with the city of Honami. Honami is just a typical Japanese girl name just like Kuchiba, Chisa and Hiyuki. Ashinohara is a shortened version of Ashihara no Nakatsukuni which is just an ancient name for Japan. Worse, that Kuro chose this name makes it yet another case of copying miHoYo. Ashihara means land of reeds which is meant to say that Japan is a good place to cultivate rice. Like Inazuma. On top of that, the design of Honami is clearly just modern day Tokyo. At best, the central tower that should be Tokyo Tower was switched out for the fictional tower being affected by the Voidstorm that sent Honami into Voidspace. Compare that to Inazuma which is a nation of islands just like Japan that borders the \

nation of Liyue or China. Parts of Inazuma include Watatsumi which is based around Japan's Okinawa Prefecture specifically drawing attention to the Ryukyu Kingdom and Tsurumi which takes heavy inspiration from Hokkaido and the Ainu.\n- And to go a step further with naming, Hiyuki is Hiyuki because of the yuki part which means snow. Hiyuki is a Glacio character. Miyabi too is an Ice character and is also a typical Japanese girl name. However it has no relation to ice. Her surname on the other hand, Hoshimi is a non-standard version of a typical Japanese surname. Hoshimi is usually written as 星美 and 星宮. These names wouldn't really mean anything for Zenless or Miyabi so Miyabi's surname is written 星見 and this meaning can reference Miyabi's lineage as a descendant of Swordmaster. As Swordmaster was a first generation Void Hunter, she'd be working on behalf of the agents sent by the Imaginary Tree like the Traveler from Genshin. The Traveler and their sibling were depicted as shooting stars thus Swordmaster \

hoshi-mi.
- After Rinascita, the game went off into a Segue for Qiuyuan. This entire story plays out like a typical Chinese martial arts film from Hong Kong's heyday. Liyue is also designed around the film scene as it isn't actually based on any specific time period or region of China. This allows the region to mix designs from the Tang Dynasty (Ningguang) the Qing Dynasty (Qiqi) and even the western-influenced Republic era (Zhongli, Hu Tao) while showcasing traditional Chinese folklore like the yaksha, illuminated beasts and immortals alongside various regional cultures around the country like Sichuan spicy cuisine (Xiangling) southern Chinese architecture (Chenyu Vale) Inner Mongolian landscapes and music (Chasm) and natural landmarks like Zhangjiajie. (Huaguang Stone Forest) Wuwa's Huanglong doesn't share this design setup.

![](https://images.hive.blog/p/3auKdN6FdQE2iiW17bo7xtnLUAj4m3whUUyRTZSwow32zgGcDAv6DUXxPxSWa2?format=match&mode=fit&width=768)

Whew that was a long one. So why can't Kuro come up with an original story? The truth is they can and they have. It just wasn't good. Then possibly due to business pressure, Kuro made the conscious decision to work off of what worked already namely miHoYo. Over time especially with certain groups praising them for it, Kuro likely chose to keep copying and so their potential for original work has been left undeveloped.

Beyond that though, most developers aren't known for utilizing real world references to the extent that miHoYo has and so in that case, it's not surprising that Kuro hasn't either. Besides Hiyuki not relating to real miko in any way, anime depictions of Buddhist monks have never been realistic either and the anime trope of throwing ofuda talismans at enemies is not at all how they're used. Yojimbo might be a wandering samurai but Final Fantasy's predecessor to him, Odin doesn't have anything to do with the mythical Asian blade-cutting sword Zantetsuken especially since he uses a spear. Also Bahamut not Bismarck should be a whale and Bismarck should be a battleship. You don't typically get the miHoYo brand of a wasserburg city at the center of their German-based region of Mondstadt where the buildings are German design, the Church of Favonius is modeled after Germany's Cologne Cathedral and the nation is protected by an order of knights reminiscent of the Teutonic Knights of Germany's Holy Roman Empire period, headed by a Grand Master.

I personally would have liked to see Kuro stick with doing their own thing. The pyramids weren't built in a day so even if Huanglong's story wasn't the best, the devs could have gotten better over time. To offer an example, Hypergryph had long written a story for their own universe and now in Endfield, they've got a fully realized story which is pretty good and also has nothing to do with miHoYo. There's only two regions left for Wuthering Waves and it's likely we already know what they'll be like. Ashinohara is already known to be a place that is a closed off nation that's prejudiced against Resonators just like Inazuma. The New Federation will likely be a fire-themed doppleganger to Snezhnaya.

Verse of the Day | Sunday, June 14th
title.body:
John 4:7,10***

Today's verse reminds us that Jesus approaches people in the midst of their daily routine — in the most ordinary and common moments of life — and offers them something no well in the world can provide. The Samaritan woman came to draw water to quench a physical thirst, and found the only One who can quench the deepest thirst of the human soul.

That is why we must never underestimate everyday encounters or simple conversations. Jesus used a request as simple as asking for water to open a door toward eternity. Today He can also use any ordinary moment of our lives to offer us — or to offer others through us — the living water that never runs dry.

</br>

## Versículo del Día | Domingo 14 de Junio

> ***\

Juan 4:7,10***

El versículo del día nos recuerda que Jesús se acerca a las personas en medio de su rutina diaria — en los momentos más ordinarios y comunes de la vida — y les ofrece algo que ningún pozo del mundo puede dar. La mujer samaritana llegó a buscar agua para saciar una sed física, y encontró al único que puede saciar la sed más profunda del alma humana.

Es por eso que nunca debemos subestimar los encuentros cotidianos ni las conversaciones simples. Jesús usó una petición tan sencilla como pedir agua para abrir una puerta hacia la eternidad. Hoy también puede usar cualquier momento ordinario de nuestra vida para ofrecernos — o para ofrecerle a otros a través de nosotros — el agua viva que nunca se agota.

title.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=frankevor/bz2015vj

I flew toward an ancient shipwreck to recover batteries and a sensor for the gyrocompass, passing a familiar Sunwing landing site along the way. After retrieving a fully charged battery from a shore wreck, I dived into the ocean to search the submerged section, where patrolling machines forced a quick underwater escape.

<div class=\

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwo2uwavexD1THCxRBgwHz55TbreT8GE8CNj8b8McYh7/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV5yr2DTpzrioJhYiSZBZWGWB6KSJWR1UjxJNEABN8nVL/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTYXWxtTY32Xu1UxqYG7oh96Kr7isVchsQ86CnKhqsBMw/screenshot_3_.png) I had to get to an ancient shipwreck site that the navigators mentioned, so I could grab the batteries and the sensor they would need to make the gyrocompass work again. So I started riding out, pushing my mount into a steady sprint across the sweeping, overgrown valleys toward the distant coastline. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHGM9UmdSdihhPnM3m7AUGbzuaL4rgZVn7LRX1ZH3mUg/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaeWBpvKxv521Ui3LpEw2KoQ7uT33cg4fW2jLxYp6YGqB/screenshot_5_.png) On my way, I decided to mess up with some machines. So I was flying real low, and I even got some damage in this way, scraping against the dense canopy and drawing immediate fire from the alert hostile units stationed in the brush below. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNTXCjRqv7NVM5uPrAKxfkU1NBkhd3ZVGxufaxiJ92Px/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQc3QuhNX2K9RZ477WPSTZDGuf73hoK6n2PjEXiPVNVW9/screenshot_7_.png) Then I decided to stay on high ground because I didn't want to lose my mount. And I flew toward that big tower, but it looked like I was there before; that has a Sunwing landing site built into the upper scaffolding. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUw3XsLQ7TXEdPtus6eBU7TYvRzqb5nMW1Y22EfUB5h1Z/screenshot_8_.png) I reached the location and I found part of the shipwreck on the ocean, but it looked like it was not the one I was looking for. The rusted metal hull sat empty in the rolling surf without any sign of the salvaged electronic components. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYeu77uChkLqtwwXT6sZkR8Ej4k9ReXf7B4BMppGEWHF/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRE1gScUErjQCgJcH4WrXmQvRKfaSWXooS8qPk1KR4goD/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPztprntpv57ovgmie4J8HXR4EAKDVtGu9RfUWiNz2yxG/screenshot_11_.png) I started checking around, and I found another part of the shipwreck on the shore. So I flew there, but it looked like that shipwreck was guarded by a big machine; so I left my mount and jumped off to glide down quietly. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1f8UvAk8pQDvwwyTHUk6Fc9Z3oTnbvPhVh5mFTf8zsL/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMfu58pUBzN4MBxPZ1b1a69Yj4cyJr6hs6mCtJixHfTn/screenshot_13_.png) After landing there, I started checking around and I found a fully charged battery inside the shipwreck. And I also found an antenna that should have the sensor, but after examining it, it looked like the antenna was broken and no intact sensor unit was there. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUQpEDoKe5zMYw3xXWwchosEPuTepAZigxrBGdbLwXn8/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfD1kJYCW1PKuDuh6Cdt1ZFHDNy4TtuopdJsFH67Ts7Ci/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJMtwecF172m3hpy7pSjUo8y2xfNmojjgqRx6RiVYEPj/screenshot_16_.png) I decided to check the other part of the shipwreck on the ocean. So I flew there and I jumped on the shipwreck. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzTa5bGx9shawBLAuwNSVhvowgsMTcdyV4Wreq2y2HYC/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZvGVeAiSa3Wyk65JbD48Ua36bJydpDVi4SWtrHNH1CS8/screenshot_18_.png) But it looked like there could be some batteries and also the sensor unit around, but underwater. So I started diving and that's when I noticed there were some machines diving around that shipwreck as well, their glowing blue optics were cutting straight through the murky depths. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPuo6PgmPqhJMqx3kqKAD2CVvuqLNmRKUJUFeXrhzXNPL/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5PDLVHZhTVnBACD7Y1pHkGqD4wfWCJJa4wyUeArNbVS/screenshot_20_.png) One of the machines partially saw me from afar. So I decided to take cover, but it found me after searching thoroughly; so I had to start escaping it, kicking hard against the current to find an underwater cavern to break its direct line of sight. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU.

title.body:
Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) and Advanced Lipoxidation End Products (ALEs) are harmful, pro-inflammatory compounds that damage tissues and accelerate aging. They form via a complex web of non-enzymatic chemistry, the Maillard reaction and lipid peroxidation.

Here is how these chemical factors interact:

Sugars & Proteins (Maillard Reaction): Reducing sugars (like glucose or fructose) condense with the amino groups of proteins or fats to form unstable Schiff bases, which then rearrange into stable Amadori products before ultimately cross-linking into irreversible AGEs.

Fat, Oil & Lipoxidation: When fats and oils (lipids) undergo oxidation (often accelerated by heat or free radicals) they break down into highly reactive aldehydes and ketones (malondialdehyde, glyoxal). These intermediates rapidly attack proteins and DNA, forming Advanced Lipoxidation End Products (ALEs).

You can mitigate the production of these compounds by low-temperature cooking methods (steaming, poaching, boiling) and using acidic marinades (such as lemon or vinegar) which help halt advanced browning and AGE formation during food preparation.

..

Amadori Products (Ketoamines)

What it is: When the labile Schiff base undergoes a molecular rearrangement (the Amadori rearrangement), it becomes a stable ketoamine, commonly known as an Amadori product.

Reactivity: This step takes days to form. A classic clinical example of an Amadori product used as a diabetes biomarker is hemoglobin A1c. 

α-Dicarbonyls & Methylglyoxal

What it is: Amadori products do not just sit still; they oxidize and degrade over time into highly reactive intermediate molecules called α-dicarbonyls (deoxyglucosone, glyoxal). 

Methylglyoxal (MGO): This is one of the most potent α-dicarbonyls. It is a highly reactive by-product of glycolysis. MGO is up to 20,000 times more reactive than glucose, aggressively attacking adjacent proteins and lipids.

The End Result: AGEs

Ultimately, the accumulation of reactive α-dicarbonyls and MGO drives further cross-linking, leading to the irreversible formation of Advanced Glycation End-products (AGEs). AGEs cause stiffening of tissues, promote inflammation, and are heavily implicated in diabetic complications and aging. 

..

The Maillard reaction is a chemical process involving reducing sugars and amino acids that dictates both food browning (exogenous) and metabolic aging (endogenous). It forms Advanced Glycation End products (AGEs), which drive inflammation and oxidative stress through receptor interactions in the body.

How the Reaction WorksThe Maillard reaction is a non-enzymatic form of browning that typically occurs during cooking but also naturally within the body.

Initiation: Reducing sugars and amino acids or free amino groups (like in proteins and nucleic acids) condense to form an unstable Schiff base.

Propagation: These molecules rearrange into stable, reversible Amadori products (HbA1c).

Termination: Further dehydration, oxidation, and cross-linking form the irreversible structures known as AGEs.Exogenous vs. Endogenous Metabolism

Dietary (Exogenous) AGEs: When you eat heat-processed, fried, or roasted foods, your gut microbiota must metabolize these complex \

structures. While the gut microbiome efficiently degrades many of these products, a portion is absorbed into the bloodstream. The body metabolizes these by filtering them through the kidneys and excreting waste in the urine.

Biological (Endogenous) AGEs: Within the body, this reaction also occurs naturally. When proteins (like collagen) or lipids encounter sugars and reactive dicarbonyls over time, they slowly glycate. 

High blood sugar (hyperglycemia) and oxidative stress dramatically accelerate endogenous AGE production.

Pathological Impact: The AGE-RAGE Axis

Once AGEs accumulate in tissues or enter the bloodstream, they bind to RAGE (the Receptor for Advanced Glycation End products). 

This interaction initiates a vicious metabolic cycle:

Triggers the production of Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS).

Activates inflammatory pathways (like NF-κB).

Damages extracellular matrix proteins, leading to tissue stiffness and loss of elasticity.

This AGE-RAGE signaling is heavily implicated in the progression of age-related physiological decline, type 2 diabetes complications, neurodegenerative conditions, and chronic inflammation.

..

Methylglyoxal (MGO) is a highly reactive dicarbonyl byproduct of glucose metabolism (glycolysis). To prevent dicarbonyl stress—which damages proteins, lipids, and DNA. The glyoxalase system enzyme Glo1 (Glyoxalase I) acts as the rate-limiting step, converting MGO into harmless D-lactate to maintain cellular health.

The Detoxification Pathway

The glyoxalase system is the primary defense against MGO accumulation:

Binding: MGO binds non-enzymatically to the cellular antioxidant glutathione (GSH) to form a hemithioacetal.

Conversion (Glo1): The Glo1 enzyme catalyzes the conversion of this intermediate into S-d-lactoylglutathione.

Cleavage (Glo2): The enzyme Glyoxalase II (Glo2) breaks this down into D-lactate, recycling the glutathione back into the system.

Why Dicarbonyl Stress Matters

When glucose flux is high (like in diabetes) or cellular antioxidant defenses are depleted, Glo1 activity drops. This leads to a dangerous buildup of MGO, which triggers:

AGE formation: MGO acts as a precursor to toxic Advanced Glycation End-products (AGEs).

Cellular dysfunction: Leads to inflammation, microvascular damage, and accelerated cellular aging.

Malignancy: Tumors often rely on elevated glycolysis, and dicarbonyl stress can promote metastatic signaling pathways.

..

Epigenetic Modulation: AGEs have been shown to alter the expression of the receptor for AGEs (RAGE) by inducing the demethylation of its promoter region, leading to higher inflammation.

Methylglyoxal (MGO): A highly reactive precursor to AGEs. It disrupts one-carbon metabolism, altering cellular methylation and driving the hyper- or hypomethylation of genes associated with cancer and cell stress.

..

Dicarbonyl Stress: Results from an excess of reactive dicarbonyls (especially methylglyoxal) that bind to proteins and DNA to form Advanced Glycation End-products (AGEs). This is heavily linked to diabetes, obesity, and aging. 

Glyoxalase (Glo1): Glo1 is the body's primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. It is a zinc-dependent enzyme that relies on glutathione as an essential cofactor to neutralize toxic byproducts.

Scavengers: Molecules like pyridoxamine directly bind to and neutralize reactive dicarbonyl compounds before they cause tissue damage.

MGO Scavengers: Under conditions where Glo1 activity is compromised (e.g., aging, diabetes), MGO scavengers like pyridoxamine are used to chemically trap reactive dicarbonyls and neutralize them before they damage tissues.

Methylglyoxal (MGO) is a highly reactive byproduct of glucose metabolism. The glyoxalase system acts as the primary enzymatic defense against MGO toxicity. It functions by detoxifying MGO into a stable end-product, D-lactate, while relying on glyoxalase 1 (Glo1).

D-lactate Production: After Glo1 processes MGO, the second enzyme in the pathway (Glo2) breaks the compound down, ultimately yielding D-lactate.

..

Methyl Donors (-CH3):
Key Nutrients: 

Folate, Vitamin B9, Vitamin B12, Choline, Methionine

SAMe S-adenosylmethionine 
NAC N-acetylcysteine 
MSM methylsulfonylmethane
TMG Trimethylglycine
GSH Glutathione

Cofactors: Zinc and CopperZinc: Plays a vital role in upregulating glyoxalase 1 (the rate-limiting enzyme for MGO clearance) via the metal-responsive transcription factor pathway.Copper: Must be carefully balanced with zinc, as both are required for proper function of antioxidant enzymes like superoxide dismutase (SOD).

Remethylation Cycle: The transsulfuration pathway (for glutathione) and the remethylation cycle are deeply intertwined via folate and TMG (Trimethylglycine).

title.title: My Splinterlands Journey Day 5 Reaching a 7 Day Streak & Water Element Battles!
title.body:
​
​Hello Hive community!

​I am thrilled to share my Day 5 update with all of you. My journey in Splinterlands is moving forward steadily, and today came with some fantastic progression milestones.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3ZXfoEquoUmMi5GseBGJTTuHvg4cqGr6BLKBQf1G2ie/1781466546242.jpg)



​First and most importantly, I have officially hit a 7 day daily streak! As you can see in the first screenshot, reaching Day 7 has unlocked the Spark Bonus I, which gives me a sweet +10% bonus on earned Sparks. Consistency is definitely starting to pay off!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYv5UFfXW94BqgYKUVgexicjG467TfB5CuLpogTsGAHFJ/1781466580120.jpg)


​Right after that, I took my daily spin on the rewards wheel  and walked away with another +300 Sparks, plus a +30 Bonus Sparks reward thanks to my active multipliers.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRKC2VG23RwG2ruYEA8pBRjXc3rHLwYh21WLBdY37BzeX/1781466602175.jpg)


​When it came to the actual battles today, I decided to focus heavily on my Water element cards. In the team selection screen, you can see how I set up my grid, utilizing powerful choices like the Mystic Scaleweaver, Great Bear Druid, Saltwater Mage, and A'lan Musketeer.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdSXV3zc31GyzsDSaqGVEUt5sWVRzCFw5rb284aP9Q64R/1781466616769.jpg)



​This strategy worked out perfectly in the campaign layout match, allowing me to efficiently counter the enemy lineup. Thanks to these strategic placements, I successfully completed:
​Battle Challenge 1 Completed I cleared this battle stage and claimed my 200 token reward.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQaDwwc1y5T6aKgSvkPnajHpgycCb4Q8nvg1YgpxMTUc/1781466629169.jpg)


​Hitting that one week streak feels amazing, and I am excited to see how much further I can push my campaign rank in the coming days.

​Thank you so much to everyone for upvoting, commenting, and guiding me through this process! If you have any tactical advice for optimizing a Water element team grid, I would love to read it below.

​See you tomorrow for Day 6!

title.body:
>



Hola amigos, este es una entrada del fin de semana pasado, y es que, de vez en cuando con mi mamá, nos vamos al centro comercial a ver vidrieras, otros les llaman, pasear, vitrinear, marchar, jeje nosotras le llamamos cazar ofertas, pero, cuando estamos cortas económicamente, solo vamos a distraernos la vista y pasar un momento diferente y alejada de los quehaceres del hogar.
> Hello friends, this is a post from last weekend, and it's that, from time to time my mom and I go to the mall to look at shop windows, others call it strolling, window shopping, or just browsing, hehe we call it bargain hunting, but, when we're short on cash, we just go to distract our eyes and spend a different moment away from household chores.


![Brown Modern Furniture Store Trifold Brochure.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajgXR5oXnRhpeyUMfCurPXMiTgizdZaTuJAogz1mjoRD/Brown%20Modern%20Furniture%20Store%20Trifold%20Brochure.jpg)


El fin de semana pasado, ya teníamos la idea ir a pasear, pero no solo eso, sino también almorzar, ya que, debido a los problemas hidricos de la ciudad donde resido, Cumaná, queríamos alejarnos de la cocina y comer algo fuera de casa. 
> Last weekend, we already had the idea of ​​going for a walk, but not only that, but also having lunch, since, due to the water problems in the city where I live, Cumaná, we wanted to get away from the kitchen and eat something outside the house.

Le teníamos puesta la vista a Arturos desde hace un tiempo, así que, prácticamente fue nuestra primera opción, y nos ayudamos con cashea, que es una app para pagar en cuotas en Venezuela. Para probar de todo un poco, pedimos dos combos, el primero de alitas en bbq y otro de hamburguesa, muy deliciosos los dos, y no solo eso, sino que también pude pasar un momento bien agradable con mi mamá. 
> We'd had our eye on Arturo's for a while, so it was practically our first choice, and we used Cashea, an app for paying in installments in Venezuela. To try a little bit of everything, we ordered two combos: one with BBQ wings and the other with a burger. Both were delicious, and not only that, but I also got to spend a really nice time with my mom.



![IMG_20260606_144809.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUuTuzgoLm4Z5Pw1pEkMudeewVXZMzh2Ssxpihbt17o4U/IMG_20260606_144809.jpg)


Luego había que bajar la comida a como de lugar, jeje, nos dedicamos a pasear por varias tiendas. Descubrimos una nueva llamada Tío Ammy, que justo estos días tiene descuentos especiales por el Día del Padre. Aprovechando esta promoción, le compré a mi novio un pantalón jeans que estaba en apenas 4,90$, ¡una verdadera ganga! Por eso decidí llamar a esta entrada \

. \n> Then we had to work off the food somehow, haha, so we spent some time browsing several stores. We discovered a new one called Uncle Ammy, which was having special Father's Day discounts. Taking advantage of this promotion, I bought my boyfriend a pair of jeans that were only $4.90—a real bargain! That's why I decided to call this post \

![IMG-20260606-WA0101.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTvHKXKMp7RoDssDQzy996FNTcdiMAXoR6w7goGsKBKco/IMG-20260606-WA0101.jpg) Una de las cosas que más disfruto al pasear por las tiendas es la posibilidad de encontrar rebajas en prendas que realmente necesito. En Venezuela, no es ningún secreto que la ropa suele ser bastante costosa, así que, aprovechar estas oportunidades se ha convertido en una forma inteligente de ahorrar dinero sin sacrificar estilo ni calidad. > One of the things I enjoy most about shopping is finding discounts on clothes I really need. In Venezuela, it's no secret that clothing tends to be quite expensive, so taking advantage of these opportunities has become a smart way to save money without sacrificing style or quality. ![IMG-20260120-WA0056.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmceHXBhnzq8V2CnWLMrZwJgeu7nSvBv9tFykKsAb2ZPYJ/IMG-20260120-WA0056.jpg) Estas pequeñas aventuras de compra también hacen que el paseo sea más emocionante; no solo vas a mirar, sino a encontrar piezas a precios especiales y reducidos. Además, me da mucha satisfacción saber que aproveché bien el presupuesto y ayudé a mi novio a renovar su guardarropa sin gastar de más. > These little shopping adventures also make the trip more exciting; you're not just browsing, but finding pieces at special, reduced prices. Plus, it gives me a lot of satisfaction to know I made good use of the budget and helped my boyfriend refresh his wardrobe without overspending. ![IMG-20260124-WA0158.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVGUqZSdNkVvqz7Uc2mSMWHCFjU9WcTi5XFC7hWZynjAx/IMG-20260124-WA0158.jpg) Después mi mamá me invitó un helado de Parchita y mora que, estaba bien delicioso. Ya hemos conseguido nuestro lugar favorito de helados en el centro comercial de Tanto que lo hemos visitado. > Afterwards, my mom treated me to a passion fruit and blackberry ice cream, which was absolutely delicious. We've finally found our favorite ice cream place in the mall; we've been there so many times. ![IMG_20260606_165509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7NJHNVJhnB7zgmLCxmGPUB5s97FgDTcFVbYV3HrBusa/IMG_20260606_165509.jpg) En resumen, salir a caminar, comer algo con mi mamá y cazar ofertas se ha vuelto para nosotras una actividad placentera: disfruto del tiempo libre dedicándole tiempo de calidad a mi mamá y, al mismo tiempo, consigo prendas útiles a precios accesibles. Sin duda, seguiré explorando tiendas y sacando provecho de cada promoción que encuentre. > In short, going for walks, grabbing a bite to eat with my mom, and hunting for bargains has become a truly enjoyable activity for us: I enjoy spending quality time with my mom while also finding useful clothes at affordable prices. I'll definitely keep exploring stores and taking advantage of every sale I find. ![IMG_20260606_165518.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYQEEV8gKGhbkyjW9UitGyFy9qVjPvzpPMEXF1S221b7E/IMG_20260606_165518.jpg) ______ #familyandfriends Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. title.title: What Would I Do If I Won $1 Million Tomorrow?
title.body:
If I woke up tomorrow and found out I had won $1 million, I honestly think my first reaction would be shock. Like, the kind where you keep checking the message, refreshing  the account balance over and over just to be sure it’s real. Because It’s not something I ever really expect to happen in real life, so I imagine it would take a while to even process it properly.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbb4pPF4xjSTnwHvhxeX8SJkNJe9mnERbyKSQvz8wpcMA/1000230548.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/dollar-money-us-dollar-seem-funds-1294424/)
After the excitement settles a bit, I don’t think I would rush into spending anything. Money like that can disappear quickly if there is no plan available. So I would probably just sit with it for a while and think carefully about what actually matters most to me.

One thing I already know for sure is that my mom would come first. I didn’t come from a wealthy family, and she has had it hard, she have to work really hard for most of her life just to keep things going. She’s sacrificed a lot without ever complaining, and if I ever had the chance to change her life in a meaningful way, I wouldn’t hesitate. Making sure she is comfortable, stress-free, and able to enjoy life properly would be my biggest priority.

After that, I would start thinking about the future I’ve been dreaming about for a while now. I’ve always wanted to get into poultry farming and eventually build a frozen food business around it. It’s something I’ve thought about seriously, not just as an idea, but as a real direction I want to take in life. Having access to that kind of money would make it possible to actually start properly instead of just planning and postponing. I could invest in land, equipment, proper storage, and everything needed to build something sustainable.

At the same time, I would still be careful not to spend everything on one thing. I would set aside a good portion for savings and investments because financial stability is important to me. I don’t just want money for today, I want something that helps me keep growing and reach long-term financial goals. Having that kind of security would also take a lot of pressure off and give me room to take smarter risks.

I would also allow myself to enjoy a little part of it. Maybe travel a bit, experience new places, and just breathe for once without constantly worrying about expenses. But even that would be done in moderation, not extravagance.

But I will never forget to give back in small ways where I can. I know what it feels like to struggle, so even helping a few people or supporting something meaningful would matter to me. Winning $1 million wouldn’t just be about having money. For me, it would be about finally having the opportunity to take care of my mom, build the business I’ve been dreaming of, and create a future that feels stable instead of uncertain.

**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

title.body:
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTr56QLRpoEYGLYNcxzT11teYNESC7op4aeRaM65kWWNt/e463dbc2249926ea.jpg)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcF2v8aNohZ46SyZYN4Y1fpjkpeWPfWGuEkRuU7EH8QA/2feafe0132aab833.jpg)</center>

---

### 1959 Trabant P50 — The Icon of the East

The **Trabant P50** is one of the most remarkable cars ever produced — not for its performance, luxury, or beauty, but for what it represented. Built in East Germany by VEB Sachsenring Automobilwerke Zwickau, the Trabant (meaning “satellite” in German, a nod to Sputnik) was the people’s car of the Eastern Bloc, a symbol of communist-era motoring that would go on to become a cultural icon.

The P50 was the first generation of Trabant, produced from 1957 to 1962. It replaced the pre-war IFA F8 and was designed to be simple, affordable, and durable. In a country where car ownership was tightly controlled and waiting lists stretched for over a decade, the Trabant was more than just a car — it was a ticket to freedom (limited as it was).

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdR9XpZFjiK2LbV9x7AB6v7NEHLX3cfCdeUZAFMZN2Wuc/68624d413a4d3279.webp)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeh6FsBLQGz4dcXtLjs2pB9NFAXT6HzDypK4tfDK794Ki/4fa32022c6ace997.jpg)</center>

### The Body That Defied Convention

The most extraordinary thing about the Trabant was its body. While Western cars used steel panels, the Trabant’s body was made of **Duroplast** — a fiberglass-like material made from cotton waste (or even recycled rags) bonded with phenolic resin. It was strong, lightweight, and would never rust.

Duroplast was born out of necessity. East Germany lacked the steel production capacity to supply its automotive industry, but it had plenty of cotton waste from textile manufacturing. The result was a car body that was actually a composite material — decades before Western manufacturers adopted similar technology for cars like the Chevrolet Corvette and Smart Fortwo.

The downside? Duroplast was brittle and difficult to repair. A sharp impact could crack the body rather than dent it, and repairs required specialized skills. But in a country where cars were cherished possessions, owners learned to care for their Trabants with dedication.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU5H9nqzfovqAXrbryUBGUezCfwmvDZgPbjWszBDYnyG1/f863c9ee7f15742b.webp)</center>

### Under the Bonnet

The Trabant P50 was powered by a tiny two-stroke, two-cylinder engine — about as simple as an engine could be.

| Spec | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Engine | 499 cc two-stroke twin |
| Power | **18 hp** at 3,750 rpm |
| Torque | **29 lb-ft** at 2,750 rpm |
| Top Speed | ~90 km/h (56 mph) |
| 0–100 km/h | It didn’t (top speed was 90 km/h) |
| Transmission | 4-speed manual (no synchromesh on first gear) |
| Weight | ~620 kg (1,367 lbs) |
| Fuel | 2-stroke mix (petrol + oil) |

The two-stroke engine meant you had to mix oil with the petrol, and it produced a distinctive blue-ish exhaust smoke and that unforgettable buzzing sound — a bit like a chainsaw crossed with a lawnmower. The engine was mounted at the front, driving the front wheels — unusual for its era and class.

The P50 consumed about 6.5L/100km — not bad for its time — and could theoretically reach 90 km/h, though in practice you’d be lucky to hold 80 km/h on a good day with a tailwind.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWxyKxD7MsFrnrStLUpUyeGqgT8te2c7vU3sKWSkQDNEr/c80a707fdf780259.webp)</center>
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPNqR4WZGrcQnRHbcSSHeTvF3GboGU4pJtmtrCn9FtN4v/ecd861baf0e0fd00.jpg)</center>

### Life Behind the Wheel

Driving a Trabant was an experience. The suspension was basic — independent at the front with coil springs, and a solid axle with leaf springs at the rear. The steering was vague, the brakes were marginal (drum brakes all around), and the heater was a joke.

But none of that mattered to the millions of East Germans who waited years for the privilege of owning one. The Trabant represented mobility, independence, and status in a society where both were severely restricted. Trabant owners formed clubs, shared spare parts, and helped each other keep their beloved cars running.

The interior was spartan: a single speedometer, basic switchgear, and seats trimmed in synthetic leather. The car was available as a two-door saloon, a convertible, a estate (Kombi), and even a tiny pickup truck.

### The Trabant’s Legacy

The Trabant remained in production for over 30 years, from 1957 to 1991, with over 3 million units built. The P50 was succeeded by the 601 in 1964, which remained essentially unchanged (besides minor updates) until production ended.

When the Berlin Wall fell in 1989, the Trabant became a symbol of the reunification. Suddenly, East Germans could buy Western cars, and thousands of Trabants were abandoned on the streets — their owners having driven their last Trabant to a Western dealership and traded it in for a used Golf or Opel.

Today, the Trabant has undergone a remarkable transformation. From a symbol of communist deprivation, it has become a beloved classic with a devoted following. Trabant clubs exist worldwide, values are climbing, and the little Duroplast car is celebrated for its charm, simplicity, and place in history.

The Trabant even has a presence in South Africa — a small number were imported after the fall of the Berlin Wall as curiosities. They remain rare and distinctive sights on South African roads, cherished by owners who appreciate their unique place in automotive history.

### The P50 vs. Some Other Eastern Bloc Icons

| Car | Country | Engine | Power | Top Speed |
|-----|---------|--------|-------|-----------|
| Trabant P50 | East Germany | 499 cc 2-stroke twin | 18 hp | 90 km/h |
| Wartburg 311 | East Germany | 900 cc 3-cylinder 2-stroke | 37 hp | 110 km/h |
| Fiat 500 | Italy | 479 cc 2-cylinder | 13 hp | 85 km/h |
| VW Beetle | West Germany | 1.2L flat-four | 30 hp | 110 km/h |

---

*Sources:*
- [Wikipedia — Trabant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trabant)
- [Trabant History — Trabantwelt](https://www.trabantwelt.de/trabant-history.html)
- [Hemmings — Trabant Buyer’s Guide](https://www.hemmings.com/stories/article/trabant-601)
- [Silodrome — Trabant P50 History](https://silodrome.com/trabant-p50/)

---

*The Trabant is a car that divides opinion — some see it as a joke, others as a cherished piece of history. What do you think? Would you ever own a Trabant, or is there another unusual car from history that you’d love to try? Share your thoughts below!*

title.title: For Sumeru!
title.body:
https://youtu.be/HQTFLgce6r0

[Originally uploaded to Bilibili.tv](https://www.bilibili.tv/en/video/4799892847204864)

You know last time when we had to fight Dottore, the man had the power of the Trilune which meant he could control all aspects of the planet including the passage of time. Yeah he was pretty tough. We had to get lucky, play off his pride, get in one good shot against the Moon Marrows that had been giving him his power and then also revive the Trilune Goddess to reclaim her power and then whip the man six ways from Sunday.

This time he's just a wayward ghost that managed to turn himself into a glitch in the matrix. If we beat him as the god with full authority over the planet, what hope did he think he had this time? So anyway his moves are weak and he attacks slowly and the threat he poses is nil. And the funny thing is he's also the new Weekly Boss. The last Weekly Boss was his Trilune form and the difference is unmistakeable. This new version is so much easier to fight than the original. He had so many annoying little mechanics before and it got overwhelming very quickly. But this time? He's got one really dangerous move and you can stop it in its tracks very quickly. After that, he can't really do much. (even less so in this storymode version since you automatically heal if you do die but normally you'll come into this with a decent team)

The preceding sequence of fighting our way into Sumeru City though was awesome. These devs really know how to make fun combat sections and it was nice seeing the NPCs we'd gotten to know through older stories now fighting alongside us.

Afterwards though, it was a very drawn out hour long farewell section and they kinda made the story all about Collei since the story's bookended by her. She even delivers the last line which is all about letting go of her old self and moving forward as the new her, stronger and surrounded by friends. What did this have to do with the actual plot we just foiled though? I feel like Collei had a separate story that was just spliced into this one. You know what it's like? In the most recent Wuthering Waves story before the collaboration with Cyberpunk, they had Act V of Lahai-Roi and it was bookended by Hiyuki who also barely had anything to do with the main story. I wonder if this is Mihoyo copying off of Kuro. It'd be funny considering how much Kuro has already copied off of Mihoyo. Act V's main story was actually the plot to the Nod-Krai Archon Quest.

Anyway finally done with this. Now we just gotta wait for the update and Sandrone's resurrection story!

![](https://images.hive.blog/p/3auKdN6FdQE2iiW17bo7xtnLUAj4m3whUUyRTZSwow32zgGcDAv6DUXxPxSWa2?format=match&mode=fit&width=768)

And if you like discussing the storylines of games please click here to check out [Hive Gaming Theories!](https://hive.blog/trending/hive-157640)

title.title: The unseen
title.body:
<center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23xedWt2qTvd3T6GsniX7WkaYSvqyfXZ7b5EujTzsJKDR9Rsz5wnCRndXjnnNYf5apiSD.png)

</center>

<div class=text-justify>



Being happy doesn’t mean you have everything right now. In fact, that premise alone is completely invalid and unrealistic. Being happy means you’re grateful and appreciate everything you have. The people. Friends. Family. Memories. And even the most ordinary and common moments can be a source of gratitude. Those moments that make life beautiful. There will always be something else we desire. There will always be something else we want. But that thing, that object, that goal—when achieved—does not bring us the happiness we thought it would. 

Happiness actually begins when we stop looking for what we think we’re missing, or what is actually missing. Happiness begins when we start to appreciate what is present and what we have right now. 

That shift—that small shift within us—causes our frame of reference to change. It makes what we have take center stage. And what we don’t have, or what we think we might need, eventually becomes something that doesn’t occupy our thoughts as much. 



However, I don’t mean to say that we should be grateful simply for existing. It’s natural to want more, to long for something we don’t yet have in life—even if only for a moment. But that feeling, that search, shouldn’t be the focus of our lives. We shouldn’t make that search the center of our lives, neglecting everything else. 

The steps we’ve taken—which have brought us to where we are today, with the things we have—were only possible because of the choices and paths we’ve taken. Some of them we chose deliberately, and they were indeed paths that led us to success. But some, as is obvious, initially even took us away from what we considered essential. We thought that by taking that path, we’d be further along. 

A short while later, we even became aware of something we hadn’t been seeing—something that this setback allowed us to see.

title.title: Farewell to Spring -  Baharın Vedası  ( EN-TR)
title.body:
![IMG20260321152349.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVjXpCN7CTQNXr3LQUc3U1Bq7SExu9bF64xpgET2DzxR/IMG20260321152349.jpg) 

  ![IMG20260321150644.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmMMJ1wKao46L5MWMswBgpXdJzurGD6x2FG9WStWW4Li/IMG20260321150644.jpg) 

I took this picture by the lake during a moment of solitude. This is one of my favorite spots for finding peace. Because it's close to the city, I sometimes even come here after work. The colors of nature, preparing to emerge from spring, still look vibrant and bright. Look at the harmony of the colors here! In the foreground, the vibrant yellow flowers, immediately behind them the turquoise lake water, and the green woodlands surrounding the lake reveal all the beauty of nature.

>Bu resmi kendimle başbaka kaldığım bir zamanda göl kıyısında çektim. Burası benim huzur bulduğum noktalardan biri. Şehre yakın olduğu için bazen iş çıkışlarında bile bu göle geldiğim zamanlar oldu. Bahardan çıkmaya hazırlanan doğanın renkleri hala canlı ve parlak görünüyor. Buradaki renklerin uyumuna bakar mısınız? Önde canlı ve diri görünen sarı çiçekler hemen arkasında turkuaz rengini alan göl suyu ve gölün etrafını çevreleyen yeşil ormanlık alanlar doğanın tüm güzelliğini ortaya koymuş.



   ![IMG20260325180345.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdXH8ibFtsxjfsxFGThtjr1eRPD5igFJGxSGLb8WVp319/IMG20260325180345.jpg) 

In this picture, the calmness of the water and the reflections on its surface immediately catch the eye. There's something else that caught my attention in this image: nature preparing itself for summer... I noticed this more clearly as I approached the lake's edge. The water had begun to recede, revealing dry branches. As I walked further inland, colorful flowers displaying all the vibrancy of spring kept the lake alive. The lake's calm water seemed reluctant for summer to arrive. One side relived the traces of a bygone spring, while the other heralded the coming of summer.
  
>Bu resim karesinde de suyun sakinliği ve yüzeyinde oluşmuş yansımalar ilk bakışta hemen dikkat çekiyor. Bu resimde dikkatimi çeken başka bir şey daha var. O da doğanın kendini yaza hazırlıyor oluşu...Gölün kıyısına yaklaştıkça bunu daha iyi fark ettim. Sular artık çekilmeye başlamış. Kuru dallar ortaya çıkmış. Kıyıdan uzaklaşıp biraz içe doğru yürüdüğümde baharın tüm canlılığını sergileyen renkli çiçekler gölü canlı tutuyor. Gölün sakin suyu sanki yazın gelmesini hiç istemiyor. Bir taraf geçmiş baharın izlerini yaşarken diğer tarafta yazın geleceğinin habercisi oluyor. 

 ![IMG20260321142120.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAASqrxqmw32mbUFnipBiUj7rTyw3Sot86TuQVh3PaHj/IMG20260321142120.jpg) 

The lake's calm and quiet state captivates the eye for a long time. Its serene scenery allows me to stay here for hours. I find such rare views to soothe my mind. In our daily lives, we all inevitably experience stress. Perhaps unintentionally, we become a little tense. I saw an Instagram post where someone was standing in front of a beautiful view on their phone, addressing people. \

they were saying. Sometimes I wonder, when will we make time for ourselves? Even though we try, we can't seem to please ourselves. What do we do for ourselves?

>Gölün sakin ve sessiz hali uzun süre kendisine baktırıyor. Huzura davet eden manzarası sayesinde burada saatlerce kalabiliyorum. Böyle ender gördüğüm manzaralar karşısında beynimi dinlendiriyorum. Günlük yaşantı da hepimiz muhakkak stres altına giriyoruz. Belki de istemeden de olsa biraz geriliyoruz. Bir ıngtagram paylaşımında görmüştüm. Elinde telefon güzel manzaranın önünde insanlara sesleniyor. Kasmayın. Yorulmayın. Kendiniz çok değerlisiniz. Ne bu hırs böyle, yaşınız aldı başını gitti. Sürekli koşturmaca bırakın artık diyordu. Bazen bende düşünüyorum. Kendimize ne zaman vakit ayıracağız. Çabalasakta kendimizi beğendiremiyoruz. Kendimiz için ne yapıyoruz? 

 ![IMG20260321145257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVaAFGdytTB3FKUUV1sWwpeT1FZXzY3YJonXJhqVUkeSh/IMG20260321145257.jpg) 

  ![IMG20260321145247.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8PPDohaF1rZfUrFWr57ra6sgWcfKfBVxTDibZX3qp16/IMG20260321145247.jpg) 

   ![IMG20260130162416.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX785UYeyiQZCsJ6MZYtRSzTnHHmdqH9CmNpuXgqeRjTJ/IMG20260130162416.jpg) 

We've practically closed out spring. Antalya has made a swift start to summer. You wouldn't believe the beaches. Everyone seems eagerly waiting to swim in the sea. I don't know if you experience this too, but I have a different emotional state during seasonal transitions. The weather starts to warm up. The days get longer. People start going out much more without even realizing it. It's as if nature has awakened from its slumber, inviting people outdoors.

>Baharı artık kapattık sayılır. Yaza Antalya hızlı bir giriş yaptı. Sahilleri görseniz inanamazsınız. Herkes denize girmek için sabırsızlıkla bekliyormuş. Bilmiyorum sizde oluyor mu? Ben mevsimsel geçişlerde farklı bir duygu modu yaşıyorum. Hava ısınmaya başlıyor. Günler uzuyor. İnsan farkında olmadan çok fazla dışarı çıkmaya başlıyor. Sanki doğa uykusundan uyanmış, insanları dışarı davet ediyor. 

 ![IMG20260321151032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVx9e2y5jhNhDRZjWm19WjdCGDuUohz9GUNFgd2H8uTFs/IMG20260321151032.jpg) 

  ![IMG20260321145317.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf3Z8wpdGH3s3hdidTXDXsqH8c7vSRuXjKhbr45g6iXvf/IMG20260321145317.jpg) 

   ![IMG20260130162006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQA2ZcXyEr5TLBmfNRjAin4pCbccqsMNuHHcS9vkKr1Dj/IMG20260130162006.jpg) 

I become more introverted during the winter months. As soon as summer arrives, everyone starts making plans. Some are preparing for vacations. Some are dreaming of going to the beach and enjoying the sea. And some, including myself, are planning to camp and pitch a tent. Pay attention. People socialize more in the summer.

>Kış aylarında daha çok içe dönük biri oluyorum. Yaz gelir gelmez herkes planlar yapmaya başlıyor. Kimisi tatil hazırlıklarına giriyor. Kimisi sahil kenarına gidip, deniizn tadını çıkarmanın hayalini kuruyor. Bazıları da bu gruba bende giriyorum, kamp ve çadır kurmanın planlarını yapıyor. Dikkat edin. İnsanlar yazın daha çok sosyalleşiyor. 

  ![IMG20260321151336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaw7wunx41rtH8ZVt2Mc1nGPsWv3ZG1b7cs72qztwk88i/IMG20260321151336.jpg) 

   ![IMG20260321151345.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMHQ8v2835gsAy5m8goM7C5QiN1rytcFkbaK8X2o6DCG/IMG20260321151345.jpg) 


 ![IMG20260110114043.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWssQ8e54RAaRKRpHcEf5uqaJewD58v6iY6oeuDGqYDfL/IMG20260110114043.jpg) 

Yes, summer is busy and fast-paced for me too. But I much prefer spending time with myself and my thoughts. Whenever I get the chance, I spend hours in the forest, by the lake, and in the garden next to my house. That's why lake shores have always held a special place in my life.
>Yazın evet günler benim içinde hareketli ve hızlı geçiyor. Ama ben kendimle ve düşüncelerimle vakit geçirmeyi daha çok seviyorum. Fırsat buldukça ormana göl kıyısına ve evimin yan köşesinde bulunan bahçelik alanda saatlerce vakit geçiriyorum. İşte bu yüzden göl kıyıları benim hayatında her zaman özel bir yere sahip olmuştur.
