body.title: El FESTIVAL DE TANGO./ THE TANGO FESTIVAL.(EN/ES)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhieAUyKswMB6t267mGiAiHdtX644REHtZN6c6oB8if8/1781305190576.jpg)

Estimado Hiver...
Siempre me ha gustado el Tango y tengo el sueño de aprender a bailarlo alguna vez. Lo que nunca imaginé es que en mi país caribeño se ha estado realizando un festival que agrupa a los amantes del Tango, tanto cubanos como extranjeros. Por eso llegué con cierta expectativa a Habana Espacios Creativos, la sede escogida para realizar varias de las actividades del festival.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShCQJGV9ErCRkV5DiFr8XTQQWrKSj6KhzdJn6nVqZ51J/1781305373858.jpg)

Allí me encontré con el profesor Villafaña, quien me diera clases en la niñez. Gracias a él me enteré de este festival y también del concurso de artes visuales que se realizó en el marco del festival. Villafaña fue designado presidente del jurado de ese concurso y ese día también se había sumado con una muestra representantiva de su trabajo artístico.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNcPdVKewGF9d4cTcwT6u5EzaoGsb8WNKxnPnPYeqJ71/1781307625651.jpg)

El festival duró varios días, el día que les muestro fue concebida una exposición de la obra de artesanos y artistas, y llegaron muchos mostrando sobre mesas sus creaciones.Asi tuve la oportunidad de irlos conociendo y conversar con ellos en las mesas. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjSuP1c3TJaf9iUDp1VrXmx7dSV8U5E8gxXhhdbTBPA4/1781307505074.jpg)

Empecé el recorrido por esta mesa donde encontré una variada muestra de artesanías. Incluidas imágenes de Catrinas, muy celebradas en México y que precisamente estábamos en esa fecha del año.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWwu37MGpWnd9yv1c54pt37pRBnecKdQ9ofLbWtVNd4Kq/1781307505124.jpg)

Este colega con su amable sonrisa, tenía una muy creativa muestra de hojas caladas y otros objetos artesanales sobre la mesa. Y también a su lado una vitrina con esulturas de madera y materiales reiclados.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMV3wAL8AVXYHg4p25sACUfiahTRAEcWYUVXQ4we4Mnd/1781307505171.jpg)

También era el expositor de esta interesante muestra de pequeñas esculturas realizadas con materiales reciclados con formas realmente creativas y originales.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYKW3SPEaPhrvAHmpqJhQVjsADKHLWy1GYWqDDPv3zpa/1781307693340.jpg)

Al frente en otra mesa una muestra de collares pulsos y otras artesanías eran la propuesta de esta artesana, quien también me confesó ser una prácticante de la medicina natural.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmTY3VGmfHuV2ghRvLPT2R7vPNuFtntucmgDxLXkkZmj/1781307693452.jpg)

Precisamente a su lado izquierdo otra participante nos trajo una muestra de algunos productos naturales realizados de forma artesanal para el cuidado de la salud y la belleza.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSdYVi6UehAT3nd5aof8sRW4BxBoTCvWHD7ZY2VBzpBTZ/1781307693403.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgY741TbpZNDxBjS2CfhRCN5ACvtq8PLq81aGSMw6x2D/1781307693493.jpg)

Continuando el recorrido por las mesas, llegamos a esta propuesta artesanal que incluye ungüentos, cremas, bálsamos, velas con numerosos usos. Incluso también carteras y otras artesanías utilitarias y decorativas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZLxEDYhd5Qn4YDoKgjLyJ13wtfgDZLQ7XLCq9kjzK7o/1781307693534.jpg)

Eran varios los artistas que se sumaron a esta exposición. Aquí vemos a uno que gusta de la temática del rock, especialmente la imagen de las figuras emblematicas del rock de los años 60.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYvLTRsAWwEU2T4zcz1UFxu9KV8VG1KhdaxUWKhgAnak/1781307827891.jpg)

Allí estaba también la pintora Ismaray junto a una amiga presentando su colección de arte y artesanía.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQo9VwRyJb58Zp2zveVBadFdipjsdx3dvZ6wrMnYXHiCz/1781307827952.jpg)

Otra artista nos trajo una muestra de caricaturas y grabados sobre papel.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwL7htBgwJUJRDiHWyVRZ1gyKanSwK2PMPYzDpmuR5ix/1781307828031.jpg)

Algunos tuvieron la suerte de vender alguna obra, lo cual era la intención de esta exposición. Este artista presentaba esencialmente su obra de grabado sobre papel muy originales.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRn2aHxVz6rgAgS1FE6fsxmC3wHp6wj5MU3cnK8FcUdRZ/1781307828081.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefD6239gZ7316qhjB6QHKwcsXaDPks193MG1X4bdpFEu/1781307827993.jpg)

Lo muchachos de Ucronia merecen mención aparte. Se destacaron por una presentación muy bien concebida del diseño de su stand y de los productos que ofrecían. Todo en correspondencia  con la visualidad de su marca comercial.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYEGiqgwn26TXbY1nViL73mYJujW9h9AADpZFD7VLb9f/1781308023272.jpg)

Le pedí a esta colega que me mostrará la obra con la que estaba concursando en el evento de artes visuales sobre el Tango. No recuerdo su nombre, pero si que también hablamos de poesía y que al mostrarle las que he publicado en Hive me dió algunos sabios consejos.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX2SYx34zTV4CHuLeuUHbuiawF6MrzAjcwVUZLYqMwVFb/1781308023324.jpg)

Esta es la muestra que ella trajo de su trabajo. Temas muy cubanos realizados con una destacada técnica pictórica. Muy coloridos y bellamente dibujados.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZx8mZobpxH1w16bLvVrJAAdxuSW3DFCQH5gng39yAKoT/1781407187038.jpg)

Deje esta foto para el final. Aquí les presento a Leo, quien junto con su mujer (una bailarina de Tango)son los artifices de este festival de Tango, que ya tiene varias ediciones. Leo fue mi profesor de escultura cuando era pequeño y siempre me motivo su creatividad y su entusiasmo. Por eso cuando Villafaña me comentó que era Leo el promotor del evento no pude dejar participar con una escultura en el concurso de artes visuales dentro del festival de Tango. Pero eso se los contaré en otra publicación.

Como ven el día estuvo bien concurrido. En este lugar se celebro el evento nacional de los Hivers cubanos en el 2024. Y en esta ocasión también estuvo muy concurrido y participativo. Espero hayas disfrutado de este recorrido por el ambiente expositivo de un día en el Festival de Tango de la Habana.

Todas las imágenes son de mi autoría. Tomadas con mi celular Motog82.

Traducido al inglés usando el traductor de Google.




ENGLISH 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhieAUyKswMB6t267mGiAiHdtX644REHtZN6c6oB8if8/1781305190576.jpg)

Dear Hiver... I've always loved Tango and dreamed of learning to dance it someday. What I never imagined is that a festival has been taking place in my Caribbean country, bringing together Tango lovers, both Cuban and foreign. That's why I arrived at Habana Espacios Creativos, the venue chosen for several of the festival's activities, with a certain amount of anticipation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShCQJGV9ErCRkV5DiFr8XTQQWrKSj6KhzdJn6nVqZ51J/1781305373858.jpg)

There I ran into Professor Villafaña, who had taught me as a child. Thanks to him, I learned about this festival and also about the visual arts competition held as part of it. Villafaña was appointed president of the jury for that competition, and that day he had also participated with a representative sample of his artwork.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNcPdVKewGF9d4cTcwT6u5EzaoGsb8WNKxnPnPYeqJ71/1781307625651.jpg)

The festival lasted several days. On the day I'm showing you, there was an exhibition of the work of artisans and artists, and many arrived displaying their creations on tables. This gave me the opportunity to get to know them and talk with them at the tables.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjSuP1c3TJaf9iUDp1VrXmx7dSV8U5E8gxXhhdbTBPA4/1781307505074.jpg)

I began my tour at this table where I found a diverse display of handicrafts. These included images of Catrinas, a very popular figure in Mexico, and it was precisely that time of year.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWwu37MGpWnd9yv1c54pt37pRBnecKdQ9ofLbWtVNd4Kq/1781307505124.jpg)

This colleague, with his friendly smile, had a very creative display of cut-out leaves and other handcrafted objects on the table. Next to him was a display case with sculptures made of wood and recycled materials.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMV3wAL8AVXYHg4p25sACUfiahTRAEcWYUVXQ4we4Mnd/1781307505171.jpg)

He was also the exhibitor of this interesting display of small sculptures made with recycled materials in truly creative and original shapes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYKW3SPEaPhrvAHmpqJhQVjsADKHLWy1GYWqDDPv3zpa/1781307693340.jpg)

At the front, on another table, a display of necklaces, bracelets, and other handicrafts was the offering of this artisan, who also confessed to me that she was a practitioner of natural medicine.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmTY3VGmfHuV2ghRvLPT2R7vPNuFtntucmgDxLXkkZmj/1781307693452.jpg)

Right next to her left, another participant brought us a sample of some natural products made by hand for health and beauty care.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSdYVi6UehAT3nd5aof8sRW4BxBoTCvWHD7ZY2VBzpBTZ/1781307693403.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgY741TbpZNDxBjS2CfhRCN5ACvtq8PLq81aGSMw6x2D/1781307693493.jpg)

Continuing our tour of the tables, we arrive at this artisanal offering that includes ointments, creams, balms, and candles with numerous uses. It also includes wallets and other utilitarian and decorative crafts.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZLxEDYhd5Qn4YDoKgjLyJ13wtfgDZLQ7XLCq9kjzK7o/1781307693534.jpg)

Several artists contributed to this exhibition. Here we see one who enjoys the theme of rock, especially the image of iconic rock figures from the 1960s.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYvLTRsAWwEU2T4zcz1UFxu9KV8VG1KhdaxUWKhgAnak/1781307827891.jpg)

The painter Ismaray was also there with a friend, presenting her art and craft collection.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQo9VwRyJb58Zp2zveVBadFdipjsdx3dvZ6wrMnYXHiCz/1781307827952.jpg)

Another artist brought us a sample of caricatures and prints on paper.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwL7htBgwJUJRDiHWyVRZ1gyKanSwK2PMPYzDpmuR5ix/1781307828031.jpg)

Some were fortunate enough to sell a piece, which was the intention of this exhibition. This artist primarily presented his highly original prints on paper.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRn2aHxVz6rgAgS1FE6fsxmC3wHp6wj5MU3cnK8FcUdRZ/1781307828081.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefD6239gZ7316qhjB6QHKwcsXaDPks193MG1X4bdpFEu/1781307827993.jpg)

The Ucronia team deserves special mention. They stood out for their well-conceived presentation of their stand design and the products they offered, all in keeping with their brand's visual identity.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYEGiqgwn26TXbY1nViL73mYJujW9h9AADpZFD7VLb9f/1781308023272.jpg)

I asked this colleague to show me the piece she was submitting to the Tango visual arts competition. I don't remember her name, but I do remember that we also talked about poetry, and when I showed her the poems I'd published on Hive, she gave me some wise advice.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX2SYx34zTV4CHuLeuUHbuiawF6MrzAjcwVUZLYqMwVFb/1781308023324.jpg)

This is the sample of her work that she brought. Very Cuban themes executed with outstanding painting technique. Very colorful and beautifully drawn.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZx8mZobpxH1w16bLvVrJAAdxuSW3DFCQH5gng39yAKoT/1781407187038.jpg)

I saved this photo for last. Here's Leo, who, along with his wife (a tango dancer), is the mastermind behind this tango festival, which has been running for several years. Leo was my sculpture teacher when I was little, and his creativity and enthusiasm always inspired me. That's why, when Villafaña told me that Leo was the event's organizer, I couldn't pass up the opportunity to participate with a sculpture in the visual arts competition at the tango festival. But I'll tell you about that in another post.

As you can see, the day was quite busy. This venue hosted the Cuban Hivers National Event in 2024. And on this occasion, it was also very crowded and engaged. I hope you enjoyed this glimpse into the exhibition atmosphere of a day at the Havana Tango Festival. See you on the next adventure!

All images are my own. Taken with my Moto G82 phone. 

Translated into English using Google Translate.

body.title: Luz Verde [Esp-Eng]
body.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Luz Verde**, la agrupación de rock caraqueña que trasladó su centro de operaciones a Barcelona, España, consolidando una carrera internacional que incluye una nominación al Latin Grammy.

> We present the career of **Luz Verde**, the Caracas rock group that moved its operations base to Barcelona, Spain, consolidating an international career that includes a Latin Grammy nomination. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AK2D1GxrFJKN2hCxDhTqM9NrLL4Yt7cC2ELEDKKw4DxF2Ue8ArhREfi2e35ifdH.png) # Luz Verde: El rock caraqueño arraigado en Barcelona

>\n\nLa agrupación **Luz Verde** fue fundada en junio de 1995, emergiendo dentro de las propuestas del rock universitario caraqueño. Desde su presentación inicial en el **Teatro Nacional Juvenil**, la banda obtuvo el primer lugar en el **Festival Alma Mater Rock** (1996) y reconocimientos por música original en el festival de video **Viart**. Estas participaciones iniciales les permitieron trabajar con músicos del entorno nacional como **Carlos Moreán** y el extecladista de **Desorden Público**, **Francisco \

Díaz**, quienes produjeron sus primeros trabajos discográficos. En el año 2004, la banda tomó la decisión de trasladarse a Barcelona, España. En la capital catalana, la agrupación se integró a la actividad musical local, presentándose en salas como **Mephisto**, **Magic** y **Carretera 13**. En el contexto europeo, la banda modificó su sonido, estructurando una propuesta que fusionaba el rock de finales de la década de los 90 con una lírica de temática urbana, lo que les permitió establecer comunicación con el público local y con la diáspora latinoamericana. La actividad de **Luz Verde** en España se ha desarrollado mediante el lanzamiento de álbumes bajo sellos independientes. Uno de sus principales registros en la industria internacional ocurrió en el año 2014, cuando fueron nominados al **Latin Grammy** en la categoría de *Mejor Álbum de Rock* por su disco *El Final del Mundo Vol. 2: Nada es Imposible*. Este hecho documentó la capacidad de la producción de rock de origen venezolano para insertarse en los circuitos de premiación de la industria musical desde su base en el continente europeo. La trayectoria de **Luz Verde** abarca tres décadas de actividad continua. Su evolución abarca desde los festivales universitarios en Caracas hasta la participación en eventos de la industria internacional, registrándose como una referencia en el proceso de internacionalización del rock venezolano y en el desarrollo de proyectos musicales fuera de sus fronteras de origen. ------

> 


### Luz Verde: Caracas Rock Rooted in Barcelona

The group **Luz Verde** was founded in June 1995, emerging within the proposals of Caracas university rock. From their initial performance at the **Teatro Nacional Juvenil**, the band won first place at the **Festival Alma Mater Rock** (1996) and awards for original music at the **Viart** video festival. These early participations allowed them to work with musicians from the national scene such as **Carlos Moreán** and former **Desorden Público** keyboardist **Francisco \

Díaz**, who produced their first recording works. In 2004, the band made the decision to move to Barcelona, Spain. In the Catalan capital, the group integrated into the local musical activity, performing in venues such as **Mephisto**, **Magic**, and **Carretera 13**. In the European context, the band modified its sound, structuring a proposal that fused the rock of the late 90s with urban-themed lyrics, allowing them to establish communication with the local public and the Latin American diaspora. The activity of **Luz Verde** in Spain has developed through the release of albums under independent labels. One of their main milestones in the international industry occurred in 2014, when they were nominated for a **Latin Grammy** in the *Best Rock Album* category for their record *El Final del Mundo Vol. 2: Nada es Imposible*. This event documented the capacity of Venezuelan-born rock production to insert itself into the music industry award circuits from its base on the European continent. The career of **Luz Verde** encompasses three decades of continuous activity. Their evolution ranges from university festivals in Caracas to participation in international industry events, recording themselves as a reference in the internationalization process of Venezuelan rock and in the development of musical projects outside their borders of origin. #

body.title: Raíces de mar (Es/En)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9ZgXHjeQLvGjGXaQ7vrXEF2AwVSri4rLGbvmtdBBpCS/20260416_194346.jpg)


El mar ha sido siempre una presencia constante en mi vida, una especie de compañero silencioso que me ha acompañado desde mis primeros recuerdos. Nací con la suerte de vivir cerca del Malecón habanero, ese muro emblemático que no solo protege a la ciudad del oleaje, sino que también guarda las historias, los encuentros y las nostalgias de generaciones enteras. Crecer junto al Malecón significó tener el mar como escenario cotidiano: el sonido de las olas golpeando contra las piedras, el olor salobre que impregnaba las calles cercanas, y la brisa que refrescaba las tardes calurosas de La Habana. Esa cercanía me enseñó a mirar el mar no como un paisaje distante, sino como parte de mi identidad.
        
>The sea has always been a constant presence in my life, a sort of silent companion that has been with me since my earliest memories. I was lucky enough to be born near Havana’s Malecón, that iconic seawall which not only protects the city from the waves, but also holds the stories, encounters and nostalgia of entire generations. Growing up next to the Malecón meant having the sea as my everyday backdrop: the sound of the waves crashing against the rocks, the salty smell that permeated the nearby streets, and the breeze that cooled Havana’s hot afternoons. That closeness taught me to see the sea not as a distant landscape, but as part of my identity.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbHDFHgoQ5pmNtkUkFLmUT5LpLxrWaitQb5JHDdogyEw/20251007_100521.jpg)


El Malecón es mucho más que un muro frente al océano. Es un espacio de vida, de cultura, de encuentros. Allí aprendí que el mar puede ser compañía en la soledad, testigo de conversaciones íntimas y escenario de risas compartidas. Recuerdo cuando aprendí a montar bicicleta de pequeña, las charlas con mis amigas sentadas en el muro, las caminatas al atardecer, cuando el cielo se teñía de tonos anaranjados y el agua reflejaba esa paleta infinita de colores... En esos momentos, el mar parecía hablarme, recordándome que la vida, como las olas, tiene su propio ritmo: a veces calma, a veces turbulenta, pero siempre en movimiento. Esa enseñanza silenciosa me marcó profundamente.
        
>The Malecón is much more than just a seawall. It is a place of life, culture and connection. There, I learnt that the sea can be a companion in solitude, a witness to intimate conversations and a backdrop to shared laughter. I remember learning to ride a bike as a little girl, chatting with my friends whilst sitting on the wall, and walks at sunset, when the sky was tinged with orange hues and the water reflected that infinite palette of colours... In those moments, the sea seemed to speak to me, reminding me that life, like the waves, has its own rhythm: sometimes calm, sometimes turbulent, but always in motion. That silent lesson left a deep impression on me.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkKd6shsDUcBYA7ujbrDbSKqfHPPGBtGUY57D9eAEetQ/1774376216341.jpg)


Con el tiempo, mi vida me llevó a mudarme cerca de la playa, y esa transición fue como un regalo inesperado. Si el Malecón me enseñó a respetar la fuerza del mar y a convivir con su presencia urbana, la playa me mostró su lado más íntimo y natural. Aquí, el mar no está delimitado por un muro ni por la ciudad; se extiende libre, vasto, invitándome a sumergirme en él, a sentirlo de cerca. La arena bajo los pies, el sonido más suave de las olas rompiendo en la orilla, y la posibilidad de entrar en el agua y dejar que me envuelva, son experiencias que han profundizado aún más mi amor por el mar.
        
>Over time, life led me to move near the beach, and that transition felt like an unexpected gift. Whilst the Malecón taught me to respect the power of the sea and to live alongside its urban presence, the beach revealed its most intimate and natural side to me. Here, the sea is not bounded by a wall or by the city; it stretches out freely, vast, inviting me to immerse myself in it, to feel it up close. The sand beneath my feet, the gentle sound of the waves breaking on the shore, and the chance to step into the water and let it envelop me are experiences that have deepened my love for the sea even further.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAZr6o5uefUyQbAuKNimuSnuWC5X2FS2o4nCvfqad6ec/20260523_174944.jpg)


Vivir cerca de la playa significa despertar con el murmullo constante del océano, un recordatorio de que la naturaleza está viva y presente. Cada día, el mar me ofrece un espectáculo distinto: a veces tranquilo, como un espejo que refleja el cielo; otras veces inquieto, con olas que parecen querer devorar la costa. Esa diversidad me inspira y me conecta con algo más grande que yo misma. El mar me recuerda que todo cambia, que nada permanece igual, y que en esa transformación constante reside la belleza de la vida.
        
>Living near the beach means waking up to the constant murmur of the ocean, a reminder that nature is alive and present. Every day, the sea offers me a different spectacle: sometimes calm, like a mirror reflecting the sky; at other times restless, with waves that seem to want to devour the coast. That diversity inspires me and connects me to something greater than myself. The sea reminds me that everything changes, that nothing stays the same, and that in that constant transformation lies the beauty of life.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcrr8doHUERJt4nLc25aU1pWtdvftLBfDiZW5X4r8Uozg/20260518_103902.jpg)


Lo que más me gusta del mar es su capacidad de ser todo al mismo tiempo: fuerza y calma, misterio y claridad, distancia y cercanía. Es un espacio donde puedo reflexionar, donde las preocupaciones parecen diluirse con cada ola que se lleva la arena. En la playa, me siento parte de un ciclo natural, como si mi respiración se sincronizara con el vaivén del agua. Esa sensación de pertenencia es difícil de describir, pero profundamente real.
        
>What I love most about the sea is its ability to be everything at once: force and calm, mystery and clarity, distance and closeness. It is a place where I can reflect, where my worries seem to fade away with every wave that washes away the sand. On the beach, I feel part of a natural cycle, as if my breathing were in sync with the ebb and flow of the water. That sense of belonging is hard to describe, but deeply real.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS5QTHcoZe9iBSvjbYMUtgS9MSe9LvqXp46F9GXeuuLSu/20251231_162052.jpg)


Además, el mar ha sido siempre fuente de inspiración. Sus colores, sus sonidos, su inmensidad, despiertan en mí una creatividad que se refleja en mis pensamientos y en mis proyectos. Es imposible mirar el horizonte marino y no sentir que hay un mundo de posibilidades esperándome. El mar me invita a soñar, a imaginar, a proyectar. Y al mismo tiempo, me da paz: esa paz que solo se encuentra cuando uno se siente en casa, rodeado de lo que amas.
        
>What’s more, the sea has always been a source of inspiration. Its colours, its sounds, its vastness awaken a creativity within me that is reflected in my thoughts and my projects. It is impossible to look at the sea horizon and not feel that a world of possibilities awaits me. The sea invites me to dream, to imagine, to plan. And at the same time, it gives me peace: that peace which can only be found when one feels at home, surrounded by what one loves.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWP2mdEHmKjWdpbFNkdofa1dcYt9NHQZYfKNTAPVt3ns/20251205_212441.jpg)


En definitiva, mi amor por el mar no es solo un gusto pasajero, sino una conexión esencial con mi historia y mi presente. El Malecón me dio la primera lección de convivencia con el mar, enseñándome a verlo como parte de la ciudad y de mi vida. La playa, en cambio, me ha permitido descubrir su lado más íntimo y personal, como un refugio donde puedo ser yo misma, sin máscaras ni distracciones. En cada una de esas experiencias, he encontrado motivos para amarlo más, para respetarlo y para agradecer la suerte de tenerlo tan cerca, pues es, para mí, un espejo de la vida: inmenso, cambiante, misterioso, pero siempre lleno de belleza.
        
>Ultimately, my love for the sea is not merely a passing fancy, but an essential connection to my past and my present. The Malecón taught me my first lesson in living alongside the sea, showing me how to see it as part of the city and part of my life. The beach, on the other hand, has allowed me to discover its most intimate and personal side, as a refuge where I can be myself, without pretence or distractions. In each of these experiences, I have found reasons to love it more, to respect it and to be grateful for the good fortune of having it so close, for it is, to me, a mirror of life: immense, ever-changing, mysterious, yet always full of beauty.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaW1mDQfzcsWLNNFj3UQHE6aDK8QLjBxCnCrxp8ZZczbi/20260420_193754.jpg)

***Todas las fotos son de mi autoría***

body.title: ‎Real Madrid Snatch Cucurella from Chelsea in Major Summer Move
body.body:
‎The transfer window is in full swing, and one move that caught my attention is Marc Cucurella's switch from Chelsea to Real Madrid.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXxPrRkQFm5y6GGNNE4owD7PgFmNoP3YjCW3x7Y6TNBq6/chattanooga-tennessee-marc-cucurella-of-spain-poses-for-a-portrait-during-the-official-fifa.jpg 

‎
‎[Source](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/marc-cucurella)
‎
‎After four seasons in London, the Spanish left-back is heading back to Spain following an agreement between the two clubs. The deal is reportedly worth around £47.5 million, with add-ons that could push it beyond £50 million.
‎
‎To be honest, I didn't expect Chelsea to let him go this summer. While he wasn't always considered one of the club's biggest stars, he became a very important player over time. He brought energy, commitment, and experience to the team, especially during difficult periods when Chelsea struggled for consistency.
‎
‎What makes this transfer even more interesting is that several clubs were interested in signing him. Barcelona, Atletico Madrid, and Manchester City were all linked with the defender, but it seems Real Madrid was always his preferred destination. It's hard to blame him for choosing a club with Real Madrid's history and reputation.
‎
‎For Real Madrid, this looks like another strong piece of business. New manager Jose Mourinho appears determined to strengthen the squad quickly, and Cucurella was reportedly one of the players he really wanted. The club has already completed deals for Ibrahima Konate, Denzel Dumfries, and Bernardo Silva, so they are clearly not wasting any time preparing for the new season.
‎
‎From Chelsea's perspective, losing an experienced defender creates another challenge for incoming manager Xabi Alonso. Building a competitive squad is never easy, and replacing a player like Cucurella won't be simple. However, young defender Jorrel Hato could now have a bigger opportunity to establish himself as Chelsea's first-choice left-back.
‎
‎Another thing that makes this move interesting is that Cucurella had openly questioned some of Chelsea's decisions earlier this year. He spoke about the club's transfer policy and also commented on the departure of Enzo Maresca. Whether those comments played any role in his exit is something only the people inside the club truly know.
‎
‎For now, Cucurella remains focused on Spain's World Cup campaign. Once the tournament ends, he will officially begin a new chapter in Madrid.
‎
‎Personally, I think this move could work out well for both sides. Real Madrid get an experienced and reliable defender, while Chelsea receive funds they can use to continue reshaping their squad. The real test, of course, will come when the new season begins.
‎

body.title: Water lilies are blooming 🪷
body.body:
Water lilies are blooming.
Every year, around the same time—somewhere between mid-May and the end of June—water lilies bloom in the pond in the nearby park.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTRvmjtXykcBidiejfS7JWXE5CX9h1hLSjyKiR77prUtT/lok6.webp)

I usually don’t miss the chance to take some photos of them and then post them online.

The large, heart-shaped leaves of the white water lily (Nymphaea alba) float on the water. The beautiful white or pink flower (our region), with a multitude of yellow stamens, is up to 10 cm wide. It hides its thick root in the soft bottom beneath the water, from which it sends up leaves and flower stalks toward the water’s surface. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZytJR7bbquqTPuBLvygsR9qsnUWqGiCeFFisiKgPb65E/lok5.webp)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZe6T63m8JBZUo5jECahJw9HhuVS7M2cFofbMR1uY5qoZ/lok7.webp)

<center>📷 😎 📷</center>

The water lily is a poisonous aquatic plant. All parts of the plant—leaves, flowers, roots, and seeds—contain calcium oxalate and other toxic substances that can cause nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. In dogs and cats, they can also lead to more serious problems.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbKNfAGPjA5SScL2xxUyqj67zVD3ypXSaiAntTRHdfnmB/lok9.webp)

<center>📷 😎 📷</center>

Yesterday, in the stream that flows into this little lake, I also saw the first snake of the year, a dice snake (Natrix tessellata). It is non-venomous, lives near the water, is a very good swimmer, and hunts small fish. 
Summer is definitely here; the water is warm enough even for snakes.

body.body:
​FusionLayer

GPU-Powered Decentralized EVM Infrastructure

Mainnet Launch: 01-July-2026 00:00 UTC

More technical information, miner releases, and launch details will be announced in the coming weeks.

https://www.talkimg.com/images/2026/06/14/Urxq3c.jpg


What is FusionLayer?

FusionLayer is a decentralized EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain secured by GPU mining through the FusionHash Proof-of-Work algorithm.

Developers can deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications using familiar Ethereum tools while benefiting from a GPU-powered Proof-of-Work network.

The network is designed around a simple philosophy:

Keep mining accessible, decentralized, and GPU-focused.

FusionLayer prioritizes broad miner participation and aims to avoid the excessive centralization often associated with specialized mining hardware.
 

FusionHash

FusionHash is a GPU-focused Proof-of-Work algorithm derived from CryptoNight-GPU.

The algorithm combines memory-hard computation with data-dependent memory access patterns that favor general-purpose graphics processors.

Design Goals

• GPU-First Mining
• Broad Hardware Accessibility
• Increased ASIC Resistance
• Increased FPGA Resistance
• Decentralized Hashrate Distribution
• Long-Term Network Security

FusionHash is engineered to increase the complexity and cost of specialized mining hardware development while remaining efficient on consumer GPUs.

No Proof-of-Work algorithm can guarantee permanent ASIC resistance, however FusionHash is designed to significantly reduce the advantages of highly specialized hardware.
 

Network Highlights

• EVM Compatible
• GPU-Powered Proof-of-Work
• FusionHash Mining Algorithm
• 5 Second Block Time
• Memory-Hard Mining
• ASIC & FPGA Resistant Design
• Decentralized Network Security
• Smart Contract & dApp Platform
• EIP-1559 Fee Burning
 

Token & Emission Schedule

No Premine

body.title: Angelic keke drivers
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpjXVHXgosDPghC3oekbxPHXYk2Me2q4CQLK3PKJECB7/1781463048657.jpg)


Nothing is more frustrating than the feeling of looking for something, especially when you know where you left it.

I really abhor looking for things and i dont hide the disappointment in my face when i look for something.

I can't even remember how many times I've left something behind. 2025 was the worst and the best. 
I used this words because, i actually recovered everything i mistaken left behind.

January 10, 2025; the church that day was a little empty because most of our members had travelled back to their hometown. They church returns back to normal around 23rd.

That sunday the pastor asked that i both lead the prayer session and preach that day. It was unplanned. 
I mounted up to lead the prayer session. After thirty minutes, i was about rounding up the prayer. I made declarations and amongst everything i said there, i said \

The truth was that i wasnt careful to say those words and i believed it so dearly. 
2025 was filled with a lot of supernatural activities i couldnt explain.

So, on a beautiful sunday morning, i was asked to go get fuel for the geneartor because we didnt trust the NEPA light in Nigeria.

I pocketed my phone as i hailed a keke ride. After getting the fuel, on my way back, i had a lot of cash in hand, so i dropped my phone on the keke seat because i wanted to pocket the cash.

That was also the same time the keke ride was also dropping me in my destination. So, i totally forgot my phone on the seat as i paid the driver.

I did the necessary in church and after like thirty minutes i observed that my phone wasnt with me.
Since my home was close to the church i ran home to see if i had left it on my bed.

The church members knew i was a little bit unsettled. They helped by calling the phone and all of a sudden it was unreachable.

During the praise session, as the praise leader, i sang like nothing was even wrong. Twenty minutes after the praise session, during intercessory prayers, i noticed some activites at the back, as ine of the ushers was called out.

Immediately, she signalled for me and i quickly ran out. 
Guess what??????

It was the keke man, he came back to return the phone to me. He had suspected amongst all his passengers that it would belong to me.

That was how God saved me from early misfortune.

You woupd think i learnt my lesson from that, a week later, i also forgot another thing in another keke.

The funny thing about this things is that, I'm always about bringing out money and i would mistakenly leave my property in there.

I taught in a school. After classes had ended i decided to go home instead of waiting.
The last ride in the keke, i was also the only passenger remaining.
I had pocketed some cash, so i placed my wallet down to remove the cash from my pocket.
I paid the driver and got into the house. This happened atound 6pm.

By 10pm in the night,  i received a call. 
A part of me didnt want to pick the call because i thought to myself, \

Not knowing it was my savior. 

I picked the call and it was a keke man asking if i forgot my wallet.
Till then i hadnt even discovered i had lost the wallet.

So, i just said yes because i didnt see my wallet the place i normally placed it.
He told me he would return it for me the next day in front of my house.

The funny thing about this story was that, i forgot a piece of paper in the wallet. Till today i didnt know why i didn’t throw that piece of paper away.

In that paper was my phone number because i had just picked up a waybill two weeks before that incident.

Some will say coincidence, i say its God's help.

body.title: The Suitcase.
body.body:
This particular suitcase has been sitting at the bus terminal for two days now, and no one has come for it. 




I actually work at the bus terminal as an attendant and conductor. I help drivers to call out to potential passengers. Not only that, but I also help them to load their luggage and all. And for the past two days now, my eyes have always been on the suitcase; we didn't want to take it into the office since we're not sure of what's in it, and we couldn't check it out for the same reason too. We thought the owner would come by very soon for it.



![1001141238.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tkpM8s5FfqMsugZa5Af9YR1reHWELX6bDGrK4XbZDeQiZiQhbRA3X9VDm4rNxj2ZyHd.png)



By the third day, it was still there; my boss had to ask me to take it in so it wouldn't get stolen or something so that anytime the owner comes for it, we would give it out.




We all couldn't be so sure of how and why someone would forget their suitcase and not come around for it; even if he/she is not sure of where they misplaced it, they could at least go to the various places they knew they went to and ask for it.





It wasn't as if the suitcase was a fancy one; it looks a little bit old and tattered. Even still, we can't just throw it away.





By the end of the third day, my colleagues voiced out about it..




*\

* Lekan, the shortest guy amongst us, said.



*\

* My boss finally said after thinking for a few minutes.



Lekan moved close to it and unzipped it while the rest of us stretched out our necks from a short distance to catch a glimpse of what's inside.




Silence filled the room immediately it was opened. There was nothing worthwhile inside. No money, no wristwatch, no gold, no clothes, just some pieces of paper and envelopes. Some look new while some look yellowish and aged.



And one by one, everyone left the room and made their way home. But I wait behind, together with my boss.




He looked at the various envelopes and pieces of paper, picked one up, and read it. But because he's not really educated he asked that I come read it out to him.




So, I picked it up and read it, one after the other. The various envelopes and pieces of paper consist of letters and handwritten letters. It wasn't just any kind of letter, but love letters. Each was a response or reply to the other. Letters to and responses from lovers. That was what pulled me in, actually. It was like I was reading the love story of two people as they wrote letters to themselves right from when they were still friends, to when they were dating, to when they had misunderstandings, to when they argued, reconciled, married, and all, in short, the letter span through years.



![1001141239.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23vrtju7BGqzStjf2AqomKhdWP1rEUo9XP9TpFgyCHTGWDYxQDnpVcTEWJiGc5ak4sa7J.png)


Despite the various things the letters were about, one thing was obvious in them, and that was love. Their misunderstandings, vacations, arguments, honeymoon, loss of job, sickness, and all carried love inside of it.



The last letter I grabbed was from the woman. If it was obviously the last one written, it didn't get a response. It has the newest envelope as well, and with the date on the envelope, it was obvious it was written just a few months earlier.




That later mafe me lost balance, it was the shortest but it seems to be the heaviest.




*\

I stared at it for what looked like hours. It was my boss's voice that jolted me back to reality.



*\

* He said, looking a little bit down. I'm sure those words did something to him as well.




I made my way home that night thinking about the suitcase and its contents. The next day was a Sunday. It was my day off, but I decided to go to work and check the suitcase for anything, something it can be traced to.




As I got to the office, I met my boss already stepping out to load; I greeted him, sat down as if doing nothing, and stood up immediately; he went out to grab the suitcase.



I checked the contents again very well but couldn't find any address on the letters... How possible. As I was about to close the suitcase, I saw something along the suitcase lining. It was an address; it wasn't so clear, so I brought out my phone and turned on the torch to see it very well.





It wasn't that far away, so I quickly rushed out to my boss, who was about to start the car and zoom off, told him about it, and he asked me to go ahead and find the owner.



It wasn't far away from the bus terminal.



I grabbed the suitcase and took a bike to the address. I got there, knocked on the gate, and an old man answered me. I greeted him and was about to tell him my purpose for coming when his eyes landed on the suitcase and his countenance changed.



*\

* He said, almost shouting.



I didn't know what to do or say, so I just handed it over to him.



![1001141240.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2HUiJKb8yLGHGPwWDMqKrn5TqRfZZE1v7D7LQyAUV4WD7dBKtcqGXPZqgqVymaxAqP.png)



He offered me a cup of water, which I refused, but then he insisted, so I sat on the bench just beside the gate as he beckoned on a small boy of about 12 years to get me water. Maybe his grandchild... I can't say.



\

He said as he sat next to me.



Then he continued.



*\

* He said as tears filled his eyes.




I told him where the suitcase was found and how we expected the owner to come for it.



*\

As I left that day, I realized how valuable that suitcase was to him. It was his own treasure.



And sometimes the most valuable things cannot be bought. This is a piece of him, a piece of someone he loved, a piece of their heart. And I'm glad I was able to return it 




🌹

**Images are AI generated.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

body.title: Wokół półwyspu Snæfellsnes |15| Kerlingarfjall
body.body:
>Read this post on TravelFeed for the best experience
Lato w terenie '25 zakończyłam 4 października, wyprawą na kamienistą Kerlingarfjall. Obwąchiwałyśmy się od miesięcy, od czerwcowego wyjazdu w nieznane. Jej spękana bryła zrobiła na mnie piorunujące wrażenie.

/> Stwierdziłam wtedy, że na tę górkę nie będziemy się wspinać. Przewijała się jednak w tle przez całe lato. Gdziekolwiek byłam, bezwiednie szukałam jej wzrokiem. Obczajałam na Wikiloc, udając, że niczego nie knuję. To było jak oszukać przeznaczenie dwa i pół.  Szykowałam się już do snu zimowego, gdy jeden pogodny dzień pobudził mnie do ostatniego zrywu. Jak kończyć sezon, to z przytupem.

/>
Spoglądałam też na drugą stronę, na podłużny grzbiet Hafrafell. Przeszłam go w lipcu, bardzo fajna wycieczka. Zdjęcia można zobaczyć [tutaj](https://travelfeed.com/@astinmin/sheep-paths-of-snaefellsnes).

/>
Wspinając się wyżej obserwowałam kłęby chmur, sunące w moją stronę. Na szczęście na czas trafiłam do strefy fascynujących, kamiennych struktur, pełnej głębokich zakamarków.
/> Gdy przyszła na to pora, zanurkowałam w jeden z nich.
/> Doskonale osłonięta, przeczekałam gradobicie pochłaniając przy okazji prowiant. Martwiłam się odrobinę brakiem widoczności. Gdyby tak zostało, musiałabym zawrócić.
/> Spójrz, przejaśnia się. Możesz iść! - Rzekł mój nowy, skalny przyjaciel.

/> Cóż wam mogę więcej opowiedzieć, kiedy wszystko widać. Skały i kamienie, w przeróżnych formach. Kosmiczne spirale, rozbite pojazdy międzygwiezdne, ogon wieloryba, obłe wytłoczki, ciasteczka, sękacze, kły i pazury.
/> W końcu dotarłam na górę, ale raczej nie na najwyższy punkt całego masywu. Zapewne jest nim któryś z licznych, skalnych wyrostków. Pokręciłam się w ich pobliżu, oglądając świat poniżej.

/>
Super mi u niej było. Dopadła mnie krótka ulewa, ale skalni przyjaciele znowu pomogli, udostępniając kompaktową szczelinę.
/> Kamienny filar stoi na dzikim zboczu od strony nieużywanej drogi, tuż poniżej otwiera się przepaść. Widok na pole lawy jest piękny.

/> Drugą panią Kerling zauważyłam w przelocie, schodząc do pierwszej. To też całkiem spory i ładnie wyeksponowany kawałek skały. Sprawdziłam jadąc do domu - obie są dobrze widoczne z drogi. Trudno więc rozstrzygnąć, która z nich ma prawo do tytułu strażniczki przełęczy. Rozważam jeszcze jedną wycieczkę, żeby i ją odwiedzić.
/> Schodziłam inną trasą, odprowadzana przez kolejne skalne przekładańce. Podobny bałagan widziałam pod Hornem.
/> Mech niestrudzenie kolonizuje każde podłoże. W miejscach, w których rozpadające się skały naruszyły strukturę rośliny, widać jej fascynującą budowę i grubość.
/> U podnóża góry znalazłam oznaki jesieni. Drobne, żółte listki pośród młodzieńczego mchu i czerwone akcenty w kwiatowych kępkach. I to by było na tyle :)

/>
Kończę serię o wędrówkowym sezonie 2025. To był epicki czas i już wiem, że ciężko będzie mi go powtórzyć, nie tylko ze względu na warunki pogodowe. Każdy rok przynosi coś odmiennego, nowe odkrycia i decyzje. Nowe tematy do przemyślenia. Zobaczymy, jakie historie się z tego wysnują.  Jeśli na blogu za dużo gadam - islandzkie klimaty w pigułce czekają na moim świeżym Instagramie. Zapraszam :)

body.title: Una mañana de running y compañerismo
body.body: /> * * * Hoy por la mañana salí a realizar una ruta 7 km, una de esas que me gustan porque me permiten conectar conmigo mismo y disfrutar del paisaje. Mi objetivo principal era mantenerme en zona 2, esa intensidad cómoda donde el cuerpo trabaja pero sin agotarse, perfecta para mejorar la resistencia y cuidar las energías. La ruta que elegí la llamamos “El Saman”, y es bastante variada. Tiene varias cuestas que ponen a prueba las piernas y me recuerdan que no solo se trata de correr en línea recta, sino de adaptar el ritmo según el terreno. Cada subida viene acompañada de una bajada que me permite recuperar y preparar el siguiente esfuerzo. Me encanta esa sensación de que el cuerpo se adapta y responde, paso a paso. Cumplido mi objetivo de entrenamiento, decidí quedarme un rato para apoyar a unos compañeros que hoy participaron en un triatlón. Verlos darlo todo después de meses de preparación es realmente inspirador. El esfuerzo, la dedicación y el compañerismo que se vive en estas pruebas me recuerdan por qué amo este deporte. No solo es correr o nadar o pedalear, es formar parte de una comunidad que se impulsa mutuamente. Esta mañana ha sido un buen recordatorio de que el running es mucho más que entrenar; es compartir momentos, aprender de otros y celebrar cada pequeño logro. Ahora a seguir trabajando, pero siempre disfrutando del camino. * * *

/> * * * This morning I went out for a 7-km run—the kind I love because it lets me connect with myself and enjoy the scenery. My main goal was to stay in Zone 2, that comfortable intensity where your body is working but not getting exhausted, which is perfect for building endurance and conserving energy. The route I chose is called “El Saman,” and it’s quite varied. It has several hills that test my legs and remind me that it’s not just about running in a straight line, but about adapting my pace to the terrain. Every climb is followed by a descent that lets me recover and prepare for the next effort. I love that feeling of my body adapting and responding, step by step. Having met my training goal, I decided to stick around for a while to support some teammates who were competing in a triathlon today. Seeing them give it their all after months of preparation is truly inspiring. The effort, dedication, and camaraderie experienced in these events remind me why I love this sport. It’s not just about running or swimming or cycling; it’s about being part of a community that pushes each other forward. This morning was a good reminder that running is much more than just training; it’s about sharing moments, learning from others, and celebrating every small achievement. Now it’s time to keep working, but always enjoying the journey. * * *

Because that's what makes it sound disingenuous.  You end up with:

Whitehat: *Here's exactly what's wrong.*
Blackhat: *Oh, that's exactly what's wrong?  How interesting.*

In this video we explore a visual experiment in TouchDesigner where video is used to displace other video in real time, creating fluid and glitchy warping effects. We break down the node network step by step so you can follow along and build it yourself. A free TOX file is available to download so you can dive straight into the patch and start experimenting.

Although I originally wanted to use CHOP to TOPs to displace the videos, I ended up having a lot of fun doing it with video sources as well. I have also done a CHOP to TOPs glitch experiment which you can check out in my previous posts.

body.title: Could’ve stared at those layers forever. ⛰️⛰️⛰️ #monomad
body.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVV6mEkgAUheSQFMSjBYeBFzKjNEtnVrJYBbVqyvMScWF/img_5226.jpg)


Sometimes the hills look completely different, especially when all the layers behind each other appear so clear and visible. It creates such a beautiful view that it genuinely makes you want to stop for a while and just keep looking at them. The farther hills slowly fading into each other always make the whole scenery feel calm and endless somehow.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWrwmcYV22gEgrSXvFtRrnb4GaU2tsPPWARnnCzhJTx3G/img_5227.jpg)

>कई बार पहाड़ बिल्कुल अलग से लगते हैं, खासकर जब उनकी सारी परतें एक के पीछे एक इतनी साफ दिखाई देती हैं। ऐसा खूबसूरत दृश्य बन जाता है कि सच में मन करता है थोड़ी देर रुककर बस उन्हें देखते ही रहो। दूर वाले पहाड़ जब धीरे धीरे एक-दूसरे में घुलते हुए दिखाई देते हैं, तब पूरा नज़ारा बहुत शांत और अंतहीन सा लगता है।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6ztQ3jwiQuN2WS6QK9rQehqF8r1hW7qBZbfm5XPfoCF/img_5228.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPJEzSEJxAybjYoXBFCwYDr6vqVf9dSPFPFEJXAdW88fo/img_5229.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYq6BmPCvoa68RLw92TvASa1u1VYxz3TJsMEGccAr8NEr/img_5230.jpg)

Yesterday they looked like that again. I had already noticed the view from a distance while walking, but when I finally reached a slightly higher spot, the hills looked even prettier from there. Everything felt extra clear and well defined, so I thought I should take some pictures because the whole scene was looking really beautiful at that moment.

>कल भी पहाड़ कुछ ऐसे ही लग रहे थे। चलते हुए मैंने दूर से ही उस दृश्य को नोटिस कर लिया था, लेकिन जब मैं थोड़ी ऊँचाई वाली जगह पर पहुँची तो वहाँ से पहाड़ और भी ज़्यादा सुंदर लग रहे थे। सब कुछ इतना साफ और अलग अलग दिखाई दे रहा था कि मैंने सोचा तस्वीरें ले ही लेती हूँ, क्योंकि उस समय पूरा नज़ारा बहुत खूबसूरत लग रहा था।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9gkcCjqHkhD9SHF9yGotaFDhkrEpztDBfeR5xqkqRPF/img_5231.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTN73YQ2ZUAHRSp16wkk2uTiKvnyh4r5y4F6w5qmSxR1v/img_5232.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZg7ZQsHANaDRsj4C653mUaC1Cj8FDWWUG6E9Hd46Qd3c/img_5233.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKgiW7mWjKDiUuig81LKhXhjQPTMrePYx7bSTV5JB1Xc/img_5234.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPUor9s63Q4aejN9S6GyefxY2mbLvLBCm8FEMJ8Vhvrr/img_5235.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW2Kc2ZuJpSAGCfja3LD8a2cXAamfNaBg3KJi9C2k5J85/img_5236.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJSB37Z828nHzRKKuunXXgGEndxBkGGJn48wEepPUDdX/img_5237.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnNWreXdtBKUXuDAhr8knuj8TtSYtZBg174r6S36ggAC/img_5238.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQ6M2dkyod9vKZUrzTYKBwuVQX4phar6tRJLKPBBgaVd/img_5239.jpg)

They are technically the same hills that I keep posting again and again, but somehow the vibe never feels exactly the same. Sometimes the weather changes them, sometimes the light does, and sometimes it is just the mood of the moment that makes the view feel completely different even though the place is familiar.

> वैसे तो ये वही पहाड़ हैं जिन्हें मैं बार बार पोस्ट करती रहती हूँ, लेकिन पता नहीं क्यों हर बार उनकी vibe बिल्कुल अलग लगती है। कभी मौसम उन्हें बदल देता है, कभी रोशनी, और कभी बस उस पल एहसास ही पूरे दृश्य को अलग बना देता है, जबकि जगह वही जानी पहचानी होती है।


 That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

body.title: Recolte des framboises, Tanagra, opticien et plus
body.body:
![IMG_9291.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23wCLTgHn5TXP55PX8xA8FouTEva2oWqWhsyc3vKszB4MaLUrkw2zGd6vpwDC3KQ8beGh.jpeg)

Ouais ! De eerste potjes frambozenjam zijn weer gemaakt. Bart heeft met veel liefde en aandacht de framboosjes dagelijks geplukt en gespaard. Inmiddels heeft hij al zes potjes jam gemaakt en hij smaakt weer zalig. Heerlijk zo uit eigen tuin! We merken wel al dat nu dagelijks de oogst al wat minder wordt, dat loopt synchroon met de oplopende temperatuur.

#### Marché et opticien
![6EEEA6A7-A336-42C8-AF0F-4CF7C664C071_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AJms5hKnUPobWa2j2yAZFoirUcKJS1xKP5ujUCLtqfArGQbF3p4mogULvN728yW.jpg)
Vrijdag zag ik op onze markt dit grappige tafreeltje: het was best warm en deze twee verkoopsters 'schuilden' in hun busje voor de zon. Na de markt heb ik de moed bijeen geschraapt om bij de opticien in het dorp binnen te stappen. Ik merk al wat maanden dat ik door mijn inmiddels al acht jarige bril niet meer alles kan lezen. Dit is ook weer zo'n dingetje wat je voor de eerste keer moet doen in FR... een oogmeting. Ik vind dat best spannend, want als je de verkeerde antwoorden geeft, of als je iets niet begrijpt... dan krijg je misschien een compleet verkeerde bril aangemeten. 

Dus heb ik dat bij de dames van de opticien uitgelegd, dat ik het best spannend vind. Gelukkig namen ze alle tijd om de procedure in FR uit te leggen en de afspraak voor de oogmeting is komende vrijdag gepland. Ook vroegen ze of ik het franse alfabet ken, dat zou goed helpen. Dus nog even oefenen met de e en de j, dat zijn de twee letters waar je het snelst mee de mist in kan gaan: de e is \

en niet 'zje' (dat is de g).

Tegelijkertijd keek ik ook even bij de monturen die ze hebben hangen, en daar zitten volgens mij best leuke modelletjes bij. Dus: op naar komende vrijdag, dan gaan ze meten. Erg opgelucht liep ik bij de opticien weer naar buiten.

#### Tanagra
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23tSNKGRzJrDe41vNPuBffzF6m9VuxkVtd9n7vi2WnjFcYcKScJUMCvkb1UZdPWaLAF9e.png)
Bart heeft weer een uitgebreide blog geschreven, deze keer over Tanagra's. Ooit van gehoord? Nee? Wij ook niet en daar is een wereld over te leren, het was een heuse rage 150 jaar geleden! Lees het [hier](https://peakd.com/tanagra/@bartman67/de-tanagra-rage).

#### Laveuse de vitres
![4957C4CD-2042-4719-B1D1-79CA7CEA4DEA_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AKU4DM4EQcsNp2rjPQqZDrPT8fFjyzwSqUN3FNSL41iP9bWpah3yduCnTYDCCuD.jpg)
Nu Franck de schilder bijna klaar is, is het een mooi moment om alle ramen van de westgevel even de wassen. Dus ladder op, ladder af, buitenzijde, binnenzijde... Gelukkig gaat dat megasnel met de HaRa raamwisser, een tip die ik ooit van mijn vriendin Carola kreeg. Wát een handig ding is dat zeg! Het is de investering meer dan waard, ramen wassen wordt daardoor nog leuk, erg eenvoudig en streeploos. En nee, ik word niet gesponsord door HaRa.

#### Belastingdienst buitenland
![AFC0AC90-4076-41CE-884A-C5E9EA59CB26_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/Eqd81u3H2aoF8xrCs9w1yYP5v3QFLoH7QYFocBY6wKPRmQ1kpugsKCU4NzBmZMjFUvL.jpeg)

Maandag had ik om acht uur 's-ochtends een afspraak met iemand van de Belastingdienst, van de afdeling 'buitenland'. Ik had toch nog een paar vragen over het invullen van ons emigratieformulier, mede omdat de vragen op papier anders zijn dan online. Blijkbaar kan je daar gewoon een afspraak voor maken en dan word je keurig op tijd gebeld. Al mijn vragen kon ik stellen en heb uitgebreid antwoord gekregen. Met daarbij nog de mededeling van die medewerker dat het M-formulier sinds dit jaar veranderd is en dat niemand daar blij mee is (behalve degene die het bedacht heeft). Er schijnen ook fouten in te zitten... lekker handig. Hopelijk krijg ik na dit gesprek nu ook nog het laatste formulier per post toegestuurd, omdat het ze tot drie keer toe niet lukte om de juiste papieren toe te sturen. Voor de zekerheid heb ik ook maar meteen uitstel gevraagd bij deze medewerker. Want of het me lukt om die enorme stapel papier voor 1 juli aanstaande in Apeldoorn afgeleverd te krijgen... geen idee.

#### Illegale rave party Claret
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23tbrid939XhwF2gomdzKij69FA8sk5qemGX9CQp7dUupFojSY7MZXHiteF1EUxcnzGre.png)
*photo: ici.fr*
Vorig weekend lazen we dat er in de Hérault -ons buur-departement- een illegale rave party aan de gang was. Toen het net begonnen was, hadden we nog geen idee waar dit was, maar al gauw bleek dat het op nog geen twintig kilometer afstand van ons huis was buiten het dorp Claret.

Bij vlagen hoorden wij muziek, vooral als we aan het wandelen waren. Het waaide dus gewoon onze kant op. Nu viel het bij ons thuis wel mee, maar Renata -die net buiten het dorp woont- heeft het het hele weekend wel veel last van gehad.

Het begon vrijdagavond en er waren zo'n 2000 feestgangers op deze illegale rave party afgekomen. Het werd gehouden op een prive terrein van iemand -die dus van niets wist- midden in een kwetsbaar natuurgebied. Zelfs maandagochtend waren er nog zo'n 1000 mensen. Daarna keerde de rust weer terug. De franse autoriteiten buigen zich over het probleem van deze terugkerende illegale feesten. Ondanks een verbod worden ze toch her en der georganiseerd.

#### Vliegend hert / lucane
![FDEAF465-745F-4251-AD64-4423F29D7CFF_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AK56B4ZUBVFWHXyrQmx16yjX9scm574jeSmj34Sy3JBLnYswhtZpqM4c4iMu7Un.jpg)
Deze joekel kwamen we ook nog tegen tijdens een wandeling. Een mannetjes vliegend hert. Die wordt in FR ook wel 'cerf-volant' genoemd, althans het mannetje, maar dat zorgt tegelijk voor verwarring. Want een cerf-volant is ook een vlieger.

Dit kleurrijke rijtje gevels staat in het verlengde van onze straat - Rue Fondeville-:

![5CF00911-55E3-4E78-A9C5-8085F4099FAC_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/242Y84NxWWt1ugkQhGBQMhCfHGL2CBQ2aEBa1kePUESfjmnrcjEwnEzs2Fpn8MeHYrKv3.jpg)
Eind van de middag kwamen Helene -de vorige eigenaresse van ons huis- met haar zoon Felix, zijn vriendin AnneLise en hun pasgeboren dochtertje Simona op bezoek. Felix heeft tijdens de coronatijd ook in ons huis gewoond, en hij is altijd nieuwsgierig geweest hoe het huis door ons is ingericht en aangepast. Zijn vriendin had hun oude familiehuis nog nooit gezien, dus deden we even de 'grand tour'. AnneLise is architect en je zag meteen dat zij met heel andere ogen naar het huis kijkt, en dat haar dingen opvallen die vele anderen niet zien. Ondertussen vertelde Felix veel over zijn herinneringen aan het huis. Erg leuk om hen zo even te ontvangen en de kleine Simona te zien. Een mooi slot van de week. 

Morgen worden de laatste geschilderde luiken weer teruggehangen en wordt de steiger afgebroken, dan keert de rust weer even terug in huis!

body.title: World Cup Fever
body.body: World Cup is in full swing. We are a couple of days into the 2026 World Cup, and already there have been some surprising results. As always with the World Cup, it seems that, often in the news, they choose to focus on the drama off the pitch compared to on it, but for me, I love football and will just focus on the football.

>


I've decorated one of the walls in my room in the spirit of the World Cup. Unfortunately, I don't own any national team scarves, so I've had to get a little creative. Instead, I've put up a collection of football club scarves that I've picked up during my travels over the years. While they may not represent countries competing on the world stage, each scarf carries its own memories and stories from different places I've visited. I still have a couple of scarves left over and have scattered them around the room. As for the long term, maybe the wall chart will be taken down, but I like the scarves being on display; I may have to be more creative with them. As for shirts, I only have my Manchester United jersey, and I wear it during games and when I participate in football training at the university. Jerseys are overpriced anyway, but despite the cost, a friend has mentioned a classic jersey site to me, and I may look into that for picking up budget-friendly football merch. I hope to find something similar for the NFL too, as I would like to finally get something to rep the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Football unites the world, and with that, I wrap up this post. Thanks for reading.

body.title: The Responsibility of a Million Dollars
body.body:
at first I would sit down quietly, make sure it's for real and it's not a scam. I will be honest, at my age I do not have luxurious dreams. I don't need cars or apartments for myself. Because I have already got what I needed from  life and that is my lovely family. I have a beautiful wife and two wonderful daughters. I have learned that true happiness comes from family's security and peace of mind. 

I have lost my father when I very young and I grew up facing struggles and quickly learned how difficult life can be when a family does not have anyone to get support, we have struggled a lot financially and only thing we could do was to pray for better days in the future. Since then I have decided that I would never let my family face that crucial moment again. So, after receiving such big amount, the first thought would come into my mind is about my wife and my two young daughters. I would want to make sure they never have to worry about financial struggles even if I am not around in the future, no matter what happens I would not want to see them in any kind of difficulties in the future.

I would buy a small house for my family where they could feel safe and secure. As like every other parents I want the best for our children's future and provide the opportunities that I never had as a child. I would keep some funds in savings so they could follow their dreams without worrying about tuition fees or expenses in the future. It would bring happiness to know that their  future was secured, nothing else could give me such happiness. I would also take care of my wife, as she wanted to start a clothing business of her own. Moreover, she stood beside me through difficult times so I want to do something for her.  I know money could disappear quickly so I better invest most of the money wisely. My goal would not be to become richer but to create lasting security for the people I love. 

Finally, I would help the poor people. There are many beggars on the streets, I would try to provide them jobs so they can earn by their own. In addition,  I would open an restaurant where poor people could buy meals for (1 taka), I think making it free will be an insult to them. For that reason I want them to buy these foods with dignity and not feel ashamed.

Winning $1 million would be like a dream come true, my life would change for a good purpose, It would give me something every husband or father wants and that is to protect his family, provide opportunities for his children and sleep peacefully knowing their future is secure.

body.title: Travelogue, 45 Minutes On Board With Amazing Experiences And Views
body.body:
----
Many say that Sabang is cool, beautiful and very interesting to visit. And this is one of the reasons that makes me so curious to immediately arrive in Sabang, where I have shared several previous blogs that explain a little about my trip starting from the port.
----

![IMG-20260615-WA0029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzKDCkfjYxZUMLjHs9Zgb9ktsJ2W74W1yr9Gkqk8xJJq/IMG-20260615-WA0029.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Hello, my friends, wherever you are, as usual, I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to go about your daily activities smoothly. I hope you all have a wonderful day.

In this blog, I want to share some images of the continuation of my journey, still at Ulee Lheue Harbor, but this time I've already entered the boat area heading to Sabang Island.

So, please continue to follow my simple blog to see some of the images and views I saw while on the fast boat to Sabang Island.

![IMG-20260615-WA0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPozZKvztxVrm9fJaHecbWZABnfptS1WqSd6peVXQpQrN/IMG-20260615-WA0000.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRboYTDkP6xNtVTpaSBcpjcA1SPANwyAbGti8EUUdrozb/IMG-20260615-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLfrwfyU2cMXy4CTjkeZssiKfVhChQy9bjRWaPsKfk3p/IMG-20260615-WA0001.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6BjQTy9N7ogk4mden8wgitsDHeF1uj83YQuVgDCT1Pc/IMG-20260615-WA0004.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjJ5NBdoQ9zHh3ZuKncS59QhKUtWnGeuCXLApMWEqkXz/IMG-20260615-WA0002.jpg)

If you've been following my blog lately, in my previous two blogs, I shared some images of my activities before boarding the ship. I took a little time to explore the harbor area, capturing the blue sky, the harbor atmosphere, and the views I saw there.

After we got our tickets, we checked our boarding passes and prepared to board the ship to the island across the way. These are some of the images I took as we boarded the ship, which had docked at the harbor.

When I looked at my seat number, it was perfectly positioned right by the window, offering a direct view of the open sea. I felt fortunate to be able to capture some of the breathtaking views I saw during my journey for all of you in this beloved community.

![IMG-20260615-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNwJLRcAx7iC6cjZrypXQwd8FyfcCLXHqzJKfBGiyxkR/IMG-20260615-WA0007.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRSzT9Qd4H6vNJjgBAyfHWzBBKGBSfBXrpBbjViDkD3R4/IMG-20260615-WA0012.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZjrQ7LxkH5daRUVnEraXfYi1w9RkKvfsVhTauE1f6CQ7/IMG-20260615-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRP9oW6C9as7voPk7kre9za4A7N7X69vHKdhRDnsSjoCU/IMG-20260615-WA0011.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY5e3tCJ91yxrk2Sz42SaBdgK1RvQvgT3qXfgrsMgwhuE/IMG-20260615-WA0010.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdFneTUeHJuZzXLNEkqzGC4TAhWRDggrPhVEKuoij1vX/IMG-20260615-WA0006.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYz5Ar5brywsY8cTwNTa1binxu4paChkJFFsAnuSXUkSP/IMG-20260615-WA0008.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLfjLVrYkqFWSQPMUP16uMdzBFfvteXwNXh94rbRUcjF/IMG-20260615-WA0005.jpg)

As soon as the ship departed, I immediately went to the back deck to see the view provided on the ship, and the first thing I saw was a view of the harbor with weather that was so pleasing to the eye and also with the activity of one of the fast boats that started to move away and then disappeared, leaving our ship that had just departed.

![IMG-20260615-WA0020.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmULtAyrWDvydT7JT5ujcPSwKZbQEZWpKeWKo2t3tMTMht/IMG-20260615-WA0020.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeb3jZSXQ6qLeYEn7Na2vKPASBdtqfNBPG7WonTXkUrji/IMG-20260615-WA0021.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYaCHDpVuD9vFWX74sUtVtwCHRXG36msGL9RrNw22PGr4/IMG-20260615-WA0022.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWk3eUUgbeDTUEgLxznY85j315UpuFN8eZmuFgtdQfru1/IMG-20260615-WA0023.jpg)

Never getting bored, I came back again to take some pictures provided by Ulee Lheue Harbor with views that are very pleasing to the eye and these are some pictures that you can enjoy from the angle on the ship.

![IMG-20260615-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcqihfvTFMsdrQB5yeP33wCfUv3USzX4w4Aur2B2fHFwY/IMG-20260615-WA0018.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPciSSwC3paD26v4YR2BkdwaHmJeprKRJqiM43HG2ggLg/IMG-20260615-WA0017.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTS3876RMJXhS5rBRZDgYDr4hS16awdvktPBr9rZgKQEG/IMG-20260615-WA0019.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPiVa8Tzp8Rt15x61aAA3oXkKYBvGjJ5Uebfb5Rfn47n/IMG-20260615-WA0015.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWarLUEYwUgBvRxaLk2sE1cFU72S3TywYzVhWRJKCg8J8/IMG-20260615-WA0014.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZWK8WQe7PpnzijYYn2YWrKQ4Q4nTkK4xz86FT6mKdBSF/IMG-20260615-WA0016.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTaKVckm4oRWtwMF9Yu6NVB1Uo8CzmfFUtJmobBCxXDzQ/IMG-20260615-WA0013.jpg)

I felt so comfortable sitting in the chair I had found because it was close to the window where I could just pull the curtain a little, direct sunlight coming in which made me not hot but a little warm, but a little unfortunate because one of my friends was experiencing motion sickness during the trip so I had to go out of the seating area to the ship's deck again, and this time we headed to the side deck of the ship.

My friend...
45 minutes was a little shorter than we had to take the slow boat which took 2 hours, but because one of my friends was so miserable that he got motion sickness during the trip, making this trip a little difficult for him. In contrast, for me, I didn't feel any objection to the trip but instead I was very happy on this trip. On this deck area, I also could see the sea view that never gets boring.
In some of these pictures you can see the turquoise sea water, the blue sky, the hills that can be seen faintly from afar, and you can enjoy the view of fishermen fishing and other interesting things. You can't get this kind of view if you take a plane. For me, taking a boat to Sabang is a bonus, time to be quiet, time to chat with yourself, with peace and an extraordinary experience.

![IMG-20260615-WA0027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaaCPFkFZooS4DBsXyB37RKuCJJA5dQ7mum4f2EcL2Ltu/IMG-20260615-WA0027.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdX9fkGVL4PSLn3bnWL6bDk1SePYmXUkvgeFhdzHJmeVs/IMG-20260615-WA0025.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRwUjUVq8c1MWoHTn6xD5auDJqUzKy2KGU3tKuqrYruZ9/IMG-20260615-WA0026.jpg)

![IMG-20260615-WA0024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYnq3mmiUxdD9iDX4Ejs7JfYRkUwihkg2nfXWeukjg9J/IMG-20260615-WA0024.jpg)

And without realizing it, I finally arrived at Balohan Harbor, and it felt very different. In Ulee Lheue, I saw a very busy atmosphere and people very busy with their own activities. But in Balohan, the air was cooler, people were more relaxed, and time seemed to pass more slowly.

That concludes my experience and some photos of my trip on the fast boat to Sabang Island. Stay tuned for my next blog about my journey exploring Sabang Island.

Well, my friends, those are some of the photos and short writing from me on this blog. I hope you all enjoyed and were entertained by what I shared. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who took the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Leave your comments, support, and input, they mean a lot to me so I can create a better blog in the future. That's all for now. See you in my next blog.

body.title: COTONOU AT DUSK — WHEN THE SKY BECOMES A PAINTING
body.body:
There are evenings in Cotonou when the sky simply stops you in your tracks.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4Hvj21t22ucceTSA6Cxu2cGPZmGBNhmS5pbzP56AZTc/1781425377958.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQWvW1NxDcGdnE29Q5auwqpG6QSb14epmQgHpHXd7Pqi/1781425378137.jpg)

 You are on your motorcycle, navigating the familiar streets, the engine humming beneath you, the city alive with its usual rhythm of zémidjans, vendors and distant music and then, without warning, you look up.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamVtcoRsqaQDmLqBTJzULj5KJJJHbiH9U9ndTu4v6p89/1781425378350.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTx9Kny4biu6UZ35BgrvrDN6DFhYPVxdmVTErxm2EVMgm/1781425378462.jpg)
And the sky has caught fire.
Not the violent fire of anger, but the gentle, generous fire of a day that knows how to say goodbye with dignity. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcFvhhmc87AxXw3dHA5wTvWLCYEBMrnGqgWXtoUcsxGuW/1781425378607.jpg)

The clouds, heavy and dramatic, have soaked up every shade of rose, lavender, deep purple and burning orange, turning the entire atmosphere into a cathedral of color. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFj9u1bhtzcVrCoqkqSBZYk38hfbfaCWpNxzhyQqeoQb/1781425894891.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeyfhEQvf547rUtJZCo5he5ZnytjfvzVNgbsshQ3of5RQ/1781425895051.jpg)
The sun does not simply set here it melts slowly behind the rooftops and telephone poles of Cotonou, sending its last golden rays shooting across the horizon like arrows of light, while the city below begins to switch on its own constellation of headlights, traffic signals and shop signs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqNXnVXdgz8A1LkTJrUMbidRcuBRpq6RG8df66Q1jB33/1781425895160.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma1w7dV1EwwKacMfKF2ZBVmXdfuhhQCQng71RGd97Q8N5/1781425895286.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfzSRKmDoevPShHn8JFgnYmWow6VpjfQwJfsYaVyYWqP/1781425895387.jpg)
On the wide avenues, solar streetlights stand tall against the painted sky. A hotel glows softly in the distance. Motorcycles and cars trace lines of white and red light through the dusk.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbYok5snsJCEe3thHaGTyzbRKRBy4aBtV7Trf6yo7zRN/1781461810476.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeTCczqscCDqWfWMhcYSgpq6i7jzJY3Z5tQ4diBYJXGQK/1781461810761.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuuz7mHx7XmdeKiYLaBgmHk19U8n9jN4xrbCGk7cmhHj/1781461811088.jpg)

 Pedestrians walk quickly, silhouettes against the fading glow. A colorful mural catches the last light of the evening on a street corner, as if the city itself refuses to lose its color even as night approaches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVw6r78rxWyWBCcqPXcaTBpVBBdZVDBjcJCUhvPjQcVWu/1781461846141.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNR65Qi2BBZNfFUgPMFjQv97t5p36trCGnR9sVWvkz4CY/1781461846298.jpg)

body.body: >Hello friends of the Movies & TV Shows community! 🎬🍿 Today I want to share my thoughts about **Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender**, the new animated movie focused on Aang and his friends during their adult years. This long-awaited film continues the story of the original animated series and follows Team Avatar as they embark on a new adventure to protect peace and preserve the legacy of the Air Nomads. 🌎✨ The story centers on Aang discovering clues that could help save his culture from extinction while facing powerful new threats.

> One of the things that excited me the most was finally seeing Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, and Zuko as adults. 🥹❤️ For many fans, these characters were part of our childhood, so watching them grow, mature, and take on greater responsibilities feels very special. The movie expands the Avatar universe while maintaining the spirit that made the original series so beloved. 🌪️🔥💧🪨

> The animation is stunning and combines traditional 2D character animation with modern visual effects, creating an epic cinematic experience that honors the original style while feeling fresh and modern. 🎨✨ The adventure, action sequences, and emotional moments make the movie enjoyable for both longtime fans and newcomers.

> Personally, I really enjoyed this movie. 😊 What I loved the most was its message about preserving culture, protecting traditions, and never forgetting who we are. Aang's journey reminds us that our roots are important and that even when times change, our values and identity should remain strong. 💙🌍

></center>

Another lesson that stayed with me is that leadership is not about power but responsibility. 👑✨ Throughout the story, the characters demonstrate courage, friendship, sacrifice, and teamwork. They show that the greatest heroes are those who help others and continue fighting for peace even when the path becomes difficult.

For me, this film is much more than a nostalgic return. It is a beautiful continuation of one of the greatest animated universes ever created. 🐉🌪️🔥 I laughed, felt emotional, and enjoyed seeing how Team Avatar evolved over the years.

Thank you for reading my review! 🍿✨

body.title: Evolution Acceptance Is Now the Majority View in the U.S., Long-Term Data Shows
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTrrkmpYjRy96UW3MfHwNtPBPbuekwmvum9SUjnHNWbYo/image.png)
>[Photograph by jplenio](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-photo-of-group-people-standing-on-grass-aWDgqexSxA0)


Long-term surveys show that acceptance of evolution has steadily increased among Americans over time.

The study reviewed 35 years of national survey data collected between 1985 and 2020, demonstrating that Americans were roughly divided between accepting and rejecting evolution for much of the late 20th century (half accepting and half rejecting). However, over the years, acceptance increased and eventually became dominant at the end of the study.

According to researchers, the increase in acceptance is closely related to education and scientific literacy. Higher levels of education, especially among those with more exposure to science courses at the college level, corresponded with a greater acceptance of evolution. Religious fundamentalism remained the greatest predictor of rejection.

More recent survey data supports this increase in acceptance of evolution over time. A survey conducted by the Pew Research Center finds that about 82% of Americans now accept that humans evolved, some with the assistance of divine intervention. Only about 15% reject evolution altogether. Additionally, according to Gallup polls from 2024, the proportion of Americans that hold strictly creationist viewpoints has decreased to 37%, while the proportion of Americans that believe in evolution without divine intervention has increased to an all-time high rate of 24%.

These findings suggest that the majority of Americans now accept the theory of evolution regardless of how the theory is interpreted (e.g., where religious influences may come into play). Differences in opinion about how evolution works have emerged, whereas the majority of Americans now agree upon the occurrence of evolution.

References:
[Miller et al. (2022)](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/09636625211035919)
 [Pew Research (2025)](https://www.pewresearch.org/religion/2025/02/26/religious-and-spiritual-beliefs/)
[Gallup (2024)](https://news.gallup.com/poll/647594/majority-credits-god-humankind-not-creationism.aspx)

body.title: Історичні малюнки Де ля Фліза
body.body:
В першій половині ХІХ ст.  на українських землях вже активно записувались етнографічні відомості, багато з яких збереглись до нашого часу. 

Особливо важливі для нас є етнографічні замальовки Домініка П'єра Де ля Фліза, французького медика, який після російського полону і завершення війни 1812 року не захотів повертатися до Франції, а оселився на Київщині, де взяв шлюб з українкою і займався науковою роботою.

В своїх численних експедиціях Домінік змальовував селянський одяг з людей, намагаючись передати крій та орнаментику, взуття, головні убори та зачіски, кльори та прикраси. 

Саме до етнографічних описів українців Де ля Флізом найчастіше звертаються сучасні дослідники традиційної культури, бо людина описувала все правдиво, ще й доповнювала свої розповіді яскравими малюнками.
