body.title: Crónicas de la Cazuela #3: \
body.body: En el surco que dejó de confiar creció algo, que no es yuca ni boniato ni calabaza, fue Marabú. Un Marabú de una especie diferente con membrete y logotipo, con sucursales en cada campo donde el cálculo le ganó al sudor.\n\nEn la canción anterior de Crónicas de la Cazuela: [\

](https://ecency.com/@ertytux/cronicas-de-la-cazuela-2) vimos la historia de Silverio que confió en la promesa de Acopio para quedarse esperando el pago que nunca llegó. Hoy contamos lo que vino después: **la paradoja más amarga del campo cubano.**\n\n<h2 style=\
>La paradoja de la escasez rentable Con el usufructo privado y la necesidad de sobrevivir, el campesino aprendió rápido una lección que no viene en los manuales de agricultura: > _\

_ Así nació **Marabú S.A.**, una sociedad anónima que no paga impuestos, no tiene junta directiva y no aparece en el registro mercantil. Pero que **reparte ganancias** entre la inacción, la desconfianza y la necesidad. El marabú ya no es solo maleza: es **el socio involuntario de un sistema donde producir menos es más rentable que producir más**. Y mientras el gobierno echa discursos, el campesino echa cuentas en la sombra del almendro. Marabú S.A. no se fundó con un acta notarial. Se fundó con promesas rotas, cheques que nunca llegaron y campesinos que aprendieron a sobrevivir en la cuerda floja. Y ahora cotiza en la bolsa más cruel: la de la escasez. **Ahí te va la historia hecha canción** y estas preguntas para que reflexiones, te agradecería tu criterio. *

>¿Conoces algún campo donde el marabú cotice más alto que la yuca?

\n*

>¿Crees que se puede revertir esta lógica o ya es tarde para arrancar esa maleza?

\n*

>¿Quién fundó realmente Marabú S.A. en tu opinión?

\n\n[

/>](https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=ertytux/wfa391mf)\n\nPuedes seguir mis creaciones en [https://suno.com/@ertytux](https://suno.com/@ertytux) y aprende a hacer tus propias canciones, te divertirás, te lo aseguro.

body.title: Ada Bojana
body.body:
Hello dear friends,
In the previous post, I wrote about Podgorica, the capital of Montenegro and the city where my husband lived until the age of 11.
And, where did we get to in Pdgorica? Here is the reason.
We were at the sea, the first pit, out of season, without crowds, noise, grabbing around deckchairs, queues at the bar to help ourselves to drinks and ice cream.
This was a vacation, but a real vacation. For the body, for the soul, for all our senses.
We were at Ada Bojana. A place located all the way in the southeast of Montenegro. Ada Bojana, a river island where the Bojana River flows into the Adriatic Sea.

![722703215_27567334079555297_3331136173503562768_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goga14/23xVCz1UK7U53KRZ7dN1gxDuTUaQjNnU3VZqp4utVJ7Gg6JMKjyLmw7VBsUk3dzYQBChi.jpg)

![717909073_27567332276222144_2708311966141769575_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goga14/244oQeJkMR4xkzbh13kh7FK2V3k34Sq8DZQJwsAPuKkRD1uGunUauAwX1NGavS1FiU12Y.jpg)
The sandy beach, surrounded on two sides by the Bojana River, and on the third by the Adriatic Sea, is a truly fascinating place. The sandy beach facing the sea is about 3 km long.
In 2017, I don't know how, Ada Bojana was put up for sale. I really don't know how it's done, how to sell a part of the country, he doesn't understand that either, but it is said that the Germans bought Ada Bojana.
But it doesn't matter.
I got up very early to walk through the water, because I have problems with my veins. nobody anywhere. Guys, that was divine. Sky, sea, sun and me. My husband, of course, doesn't go anywhere without a bicycle, so he rode a bicycle while I was walking.
He also stopped by the city of Bar, Ulcinj, right up to the border with Abania.One day we made the same trip, but we went by car.
The season is getting ready everywhere in coastal towns, so people are busy preparing for the onslaught of tourists that is expected from July 1.

What is interesting about Ad Bojana is that it has its own surfing center, because just knowing that it is surrounded by the river and the sea will make you think of waves and surfing.

![721471174_27567331746222197_319256979238066230_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goga14/23xyLFecU28KQf1wYENMNoTKvtyFC74LzCH8aVB3HENufcJPVji1gqLuv4XBbjcGKGwvr.jpg)

In the town of Bar, which is also a port, we visited the old Bar. Narrow streets, shops on both sides and colorful everything on offer. We also saw a mini model of the city of Bar, which looked like a monument to me. An attractive detail for tourists.

Everything like this, when it's arranged and organized in my head, at this age, I like the off-season vacation more, just like we spent it.
On the way back to Belgrade, we stopped, as I said, in Podgorica and Zlatibor, where we spent the night in a beautiful hotel, which looks like a castle, and in an even better apartment. In the evening, we took a short walk around the area and overcome with emotions, intoxicated by the clean mountain air, we fell asleep like babies. The next day we arrived in noisy Belgrade.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfL3XV1kfP77iMgJSKSuGGvfCQispNmpSeGeBaotpWcJ/img_7917.png)

From the Trashman to the Cashman — How Myron Golden Went From Nothing to Wealth

Disclosure: This post contains affiliate links. If you purchase through my links, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.


Most of the entrepreneurs I meet aren't short on ambition.

They want to succeed. They want financial freedom. They want to build something that lasts.

But somewhere between wanting it and getting it, something breaks down. They can't quite figure out the gap between where they are and where they want to be.

I see it in business plans all the time. Great ideas, hard work, determination — but the financial fundamentals just aren't there. And no amount of motivation fixes that.


WHAT IS THIS BOOK ABOUT?

\

is Myron Golden's personal story wrapped into a financial roadmap.

The title tells you everything. Myron started as a trash collector — wearing a leg brace from a physical disability, living paycheck to paycheck, no connections, no safety net.

He didn't inherit money. He didn't get lucky. He learned how money works and changed his entire financial trajectory. He went from the pit of poverty to becoming a multimillionaire.

And he laid out exactly how he did it in this book.


WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Most personal finance books tell you to budget more, save more, cut expenses. That's fine, but it's not enough.

Myron goes deeper. He talks about:

- The mindset shift from scarcity to abundance — why most people are programmed to stay poor and how to break that programming
- Financial literacy that actually matters — assets vs. liabilities, leverage, passive income, and the difference between making money and keeping it
- The top 5% rule — \

- Multiple streams of income — why relying on one source is dangerous and how to build backup revenue
- Faith and perseverance as financial tools — not just feel-good advice, but practical resilience when things get hard

His core message: going from trashman to cashman isn't about luck. It's about learning principles that wealthy people actually follow — and then applying them relentlessly.


THE STORY PART

What makes this book work is that Myron isn't teaching from a textbook. He lived it.

He writes about what it felt like to collect trash for a living. The shame, the frustration, the sense that there had to be more. Then he walks through the specific shifts — mental and practical — that changed everything.

That combination of vulnerability and actionable advice is what keeps people reading past the first chapter.


WHO SHOULD READ THIS

If you're tired of living paycheck to paycheck and want to actually understand what wealthy people do differently, this is worth your time.

If you've got a side hustle or small business but can't seem to build real wealth from it, the financial principles in this book might be what's missing.

If you just need proof that it's possible to start from nothing and build something real — Myron's story is that proof.


BOTTOM LINE

Motivation fades. Principles don't.

\
gives you both — the story to keep you going and the financial framework to actually change your situation.\n\nCheck it out here: https://www.trashmantocashman.com/tmcm-book?affiliate_id=4302472

body.title: Segundo  llamado al Concurso: La banda sonora de tu historia
body.body:
Saludos, escritores, amigos de Literatos. Con este segundo llamado de nuestro concurso de junio, los invitamos a jugar con las letras de canciones en español como nunca antes. Invitamos a darle historia a esa melodía que te emociona o a ese verso que no puedes sacar de tu cabeza. No se trata solo de contar lo que sucede en la canción, sino de imaginar todo un mundo alrededor: una ambientación poderosa, personajes con conflictos profundos y una resolución que honre la esencia de la canción elegida. Por ejemplo, a partir de “Ojalá” de Silvio Rodríguez, podrías recrear una trama donde el deseo y la esperanza luchan contra el olvido; o con “La llorona”, inventar un drama que refleje la melancolía y el misterio del canto popular. La clave está en que el relato conserve el espíritu, la emoción y el mensaje central de la canción, pero que amplíe sus horizontes a través de tu imaginación.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gracielaacevedo/AKDcyxGxrD5tXLK7zRJjaoopFdi8zKYDDvAusnqcnodgHzEgTvcKMUhggCyi58B.png)
[Fuente](https://open.spotify.com/show/4fOCAmdCLr7ckPxaKERcZj)

Este es un llamado a dejar que las palabras cantadas tengan voz propia en las páginas, a hacer que cada letra retumbe no solo en el oído, sino también en la mente y el corazón del lector. ¡Convierte esa canción que te llega tanto en una historia que se sienta viva, tangible y emocionante! Recuerda, no hay límites para la creatividad ni para los géneros: romántico, thriller, fantasía, realismo urbano... todo cabe cuando la música inspira la palabra. Anímate a darle vida a tu canción favorita y participa creando relatos que revivan el alma de la música en la literatura. ¡Esperamos leer tu mundo sonoro hecho historia!

Bases del concurso

1. La comunidad #Literatos convoca al Concurso: La banda sonora de tu historia. 2. Debe ser un texto de una extensión mínima de 550 palabras y una máxima de 850. 3. Se participará con un relato ficcional basado o inspirado en una canción, de cualquier género musical, en español. El participante escribirá un texto ficcional, creativo e interesante, que aborde el tema, que complemente la historia o que utilice el/los personaje(s) de una pieza musical. Igualmente, es obligatorio que el post incluya el video de la canción utilizada. 4. El relato debe estar escrito en español. 5. Solo se aceptará una entrada por participante. 6. El texto debe ser inédito, de creación propia, no presentado en otro concurso. 7. Se tomará en cuenta, de modo prioritario, la creatividad, calidad literaria y el tratamiento del tema, así como el uso gramatical apropiado, tanto en ortografía como en redacción. 8. La recepción se abre a partir de la publicación de estas bases y cerrará el 20 de junio a las 12:00 de la noche, hora de Venezuela. 9. Se entregará un primer premio de 25 hives y un segundo premio de 15 hives. 10. El participante deberá colocar su presentación de la siguiente manera: Entrada al Concurso: La banda sonora de tu historia de Literatos | Título del texto. 11. Las participaciones deben ser publicadas en la comunidad #Literatos (hive-179291), y colocarse el enlace en el servidor de Discord de La-Colmena (https://discord.gg/SYwngna ), canal concursos-literatos. 12. Asimismo, se solicita que el post donde aparecen estas bases sea votado y reblogueado por el participante. 13. El jurado estará integrado por tres miembros del equipo de Literatos. 14. body.title: 奇葩的Ebay买家
body.body:
了解我的朋友都知道，乒乓球是我最喜欢的运动。俗话说的好，水平不够，器材来凑。因此，平时没少剁手购买各种球拍，胶皮。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUNvcUqoGf55JKH5DJ594cHTHYYy5a2QLQoiuLNUNcPzy/image.png)
图源：Pixabay

但对于有的球拍/胶皮，只是在看了一些UP主介绍后，一时冲动下的单。买回来之后，或者试打了几次之后就在家吃灰，甚至没有开封就一直闲置。久而久之，家里攒了不少的胶皮。于是把不用的球板/胶皮整理了一下，放在ebay上卖。呵呵，也算是旧的不去，新的不来。卖掉的钱可以再次剁手新的胶皮。。。

在英国ebay卖东西的过程还是很顺滑的。把东西图片发上去，配上介绍文字，期待售价等。然后就等着有人下单。下单后打印邮寄条码后把东西寄走就结束了。这样，前段时间清理了好几块胶皮。

但这两天遇到的一个买家，来来往往的消息已经好几天了。目前还在悬着。我目前的感觉就是，这样的买家就算下单了，我也不想卖给他/她了，指不定还会出什么状况。

事情过程是这样的。

最早的时候这位买家（称作M吧）给我私信，问我球板是日本版还是英国版的。啊，蝴蝶樊A全球都是统一的啊，哪里来的什么英国版？于是和M耐心的解释了一番。接着又问其重量。这，我明明在配图中都提供了啊。这样，回答了不少问题。

最终，又开始和我侃价。又拉扯一番后就没有结果了。。。

没有想到两天后又说其朋友曾经买到过假货，因此有些担心。我有是一番沟通，东西都是托人从日本商家直接购买然后邮寄过来的。然后M就不断的在重复，非常担心买到假货，M的朋友在ebay有过购买假货的经历等等。。。就这样喋喋不休的发了好多条信息。

我真的是一个头两个大。这翻来覆去的消息花了我多少时间。就差直接告诉M，不要从我这里买了，直接多花些钱去官网买就好。

哎，我决定不在搭理这位奇葩了。。。

title.title: If I Could Live Abroad For A Year.  My Spain Dream: LOH 293
title.body: Okay, so this week prompt got me thinking. If I could pause everything I'm doing here in Porthercourt and go live somewhere else for a year , well I'd pick Spain. Not Madrid or Barcelona, as someone that likes quietness I'd choose somewhere smaller. Maybe Granada or one of those quiet places near the coast.\n\n

/> I keep imagining what my host family would be like. Probably loud in a good way, the ones that would sit around the table after eating, telling different stories and having a fun chat. Maybe an older couple whose kids are grown and only comes visiting during the weekends. Their house having a little court yard with beautiful flowers everywhere and a beautiful little cat as a pet.

/>

For the year, I'd like to keep teaching somehow, maybe English to the kids there part-time since that's what I already know how to do best. But honestly I'd also like them to teach me Spanish too. Not the text book kind, but how people interact with each other, the slangs and jokes and all that.

I'd spend my free time wandering around their markets, trying to learn how to make proper paella( mine would probably be terrible at first 😆) but I will make sure I become perfect. I'd always be blogging about everything because that's just what I do.

I imagine the days being slower there. Siestas, evening walk around the environment when it cools down, sun- bleached buildings, the narrow streets, orange trees everywhere, mountain on one side and maybe the sea somewhere close too.

Honestly a year like that? I think I'd come back different . In A Good Way!

Thanks @irenenavarroart for this prompt, it has given the opportunity to openly express my love for Spain and I believe one day I will be there.

title.title: AI agents in production: what the data shows beyond the hype
title.body:
Gartner states that 40% of enterprise applications will have AI agents by the end of 2026, up from less than 5% in 2025. The software market for agents goes from US$ 86 billion in 2025 to US$ 206 billion in 2026. The numbers are impressive. The same Gartner adds, with less prominence: more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027 due to excessive cost, unclear business value, and insufficient risk controls. The two data points coexist because we are at the peak of inflated expectations.

What an AI agent is in 2026
---------------------------

The technical definition has consolidated: an AI agent is a system that perceives the environment, decides actions based on objectives and memory, executes tools (APIs, browser, terminal, database), and iterates until completing a multi-step task — without human intervention at each step.

In practice, a typical agentic workflow in 2026 makes 10 to 20 calls to LLMs per user task. Each call may invoke tools that generate more context for the next call. An agent that resolves a code bug may: read the repository, run the tests, identify the error, propose a fix, apply it, re-run the tests, and verify the regression — all autonomously.

Capabilities confirmed in production
------------------------------------

Three classes of tasks showed reproducible results in real production:

**Clinical documentation automation:** Microsoft DAX Copilot (Nuance) is the most documented case. It captures conversations in the consulting room and generates drafts of clinical notes. An average reduction of 7 minutes per consultation, 50% less time on documentation. More than 10 million clinical encounters captured. It works because the task is well defined, the output is auditable by the physician, and the error is not critical (the physician reviews before signing).

**Autonomous bug resolution:** SWE-Bench Verified measures exactly this — resolution of real issues from GitHub repositories, evaluated by whether the tests pass after the modification. GPT-5.3 Codex scored 83%, Claude Opus 4.5 reached 80.9%. Code agents are in production in companies like GitHub (Copilot Workspace) and Cursor.

**Structured data analysis:** Agents with access to a database via SQL, spreadsheets via API, and the ability to generate reports with interpretation. Low operating cost when the context is well delimited and the tools have deterministic outputs.

Where agents fail
-----------------

Gartner's report on cancellations points to three main causes:

**Error propagation:** In multi-step workflows, an error in step 3 corrupts steps 4 to 10. Unlike human code, which has explicit verification layers, LLM agents do not silently detect when their previous premise was wrong. The result is extensive work that arrives at an incorrect conclusion confidently.

**Long-context cost:** Each LLM call in an agentic workflow carries the history of what happened before. An agent that made 15 calls and accumulated 300K tokens of context costs 300 times more per call than the first. The total cost of a complex task can be 50 to 100 times the cost expected by whoever planned the system.

**Unpredictable edge behaviors:** Agents follow instructions in prototypical cases, but exhibit unexpected behaviors in edge cases — unusual inputs, tool failures, ambiguous responses from external APIs. The space of edge cases is enormous, and testing exhaustively is impractical.

The deployment model that works
-------------------------------

The empirical observation of successful implementations converges on a few patterns:

Tasks with fast and verifiable feedback have better performance. The code agent works because the tests pass or fail — the feedback is binary and immediate. Financial analysis agents without objective verification have more hallucinations by nature.

Strict scope reduces failures. The best agents in production are highly specialized: an agent that only does triage of support emails, or only report generation from structured data. \

consistently have worse performance.

Human in the loop for irreversible decisions. The emerging pattern is not full-autonomy but human-in-the-loop: the agent executes the analysis and proposes the action, the human approves before execution. This captures most of the productivity gain and maintains control over consequences.

The agentic cycle of 2026 is still in the phase where the hype surpasses the execution. But the validated use cases — medical documentation, code resolution, data analysis — show that the real value exists. The question is not whether agents work, but in which specific contexts, with which safeguards, and at what real cost.

title.title: The Tale of Boyd - ENG- SPA
title.body: > Being expressive with music and sharing his experiences through it has always been part of Boyd's musical style. Many people who have been listening to him for a long time have found a reflection of themselves in him. Because his music is designed to make you feel and relive both good and bad moments. That's what attracts his fans: the possibility of seeing themselves in it. This has brought him great success with all his releases. Despite this, and seeing that his technique has worked, he's eager to change his style. The thing is, he mostly designs his music thinking about his own fans, and he'd like to focus a little more on them. When he started singing, that's exactly what he did, but little by little he shifted his focus and moved closer to his fans. He used to create polls on his social media so people could tell him what they liked to hear. He also read a lot, as thousands of people sent him letters with their experiences. Then he would choose the most recurring theme in the letters and polls and design a song based on it. It's a technique that worked incredibly well for him until very recently. But it's time to change and focus a bit more on himself and convey certain messages he's been wanting to express. That's why he met with his manager to guide him through this transition to more emotional and personal music. It had to be done carefully because people were already used to his recurring style, and a sudden change could backfire.

> Ser expresivo con la música y contar sus vivencias a través de ella siempre ha sido parte del estilo musical de Boyd. Muchas personas que llevan escuchándolo desde hace tiempo han encontrado en él un espejo. Porque su música está diseñada para hacerte sentir y revivir momentos buenos y malos también. Eso es lo que atrae a su fans, la posibilidad de verse a sí mismo en ella. Esto le ha traído mucho éxito en todos sus lanzamientos. A pesar de eso y ver que ha funcionado su técnica él está deseando hacer un cambio de estilo. Es que mayormente el diseña la música pensando en sus propios fans y le gustaría concentrarse un poco más en el. Cuando comenzó a cantar es justo eso lo que hacía, pero poco a poco se fue desviando y se fue acercando hacia lado de sus fans. Solía crear encuestas en sus redes para que las personas le dijeran que les gustaba oír. También leía mucho, pues miles de personas le enviaban cartas con experiencias que habían pasado. Luego el elegía el tema más recurrente en las cartas y las encuestas y diseñaba una canción a partir de eso. Es una técnica que le funcionó de lo mejor hasta hace muy poco. Pero ya es momento de cambiar y concentrarse un poco más en él y transmitir ciertos mensajes que lleva queriendo expresar. Por eso se reunió con su manager para que lo guiara en este proceso de transición hacia una música más emocional y personal. Había que hacerlo con cuidado porque la gente ya estaba acostumbrada a su estilo recurrente, y un cambio brusco podría traer malos resultados.
![nalin-patinayake-fj-SDT6MRE8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23vhVznmRKH9k7ZH6yzJQowFEK4JfkbA6fMjqAECCfdLJg6iJiteEcTJiztELbzf6S8KS.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> The manager had a lot of experience in the music industry, so he could foresee what was going to happen. When Boyd told him his intention and what he wanted to do, he immediately realized that it would cause problems for his career and his history of previous successes. Experience had taught him that if you accustom your fans to a specific type of music from the beginning of your singing career and then change it, it's almost certain that it won't be well received. He told Boyd that he wasn't opposed, since in the end, Boyd was the singer while he, as the manager, was just an employee, but he told him to think things through carefully. He had to choose wisely what he wanted most: to keep people happy by doing what he knew already worked, or to change course and risk the unknown. But why? He didn't see any apparent benefits. For Boyd, it was a difficult choice because he didn't want to completely jeopardize his career, but as an artist, he had to change; he was tired of doing the same thing. He had to focus now on creating music that expressed how he felt. Seeing this decision, the manager told him that if that was what he wanted, then he respected it. But he warned him that he would have problems because of it. There were two paths to follow from that moment on. He could gradually change his music and mix it with his usual style, or he could take direct action so that people would truly notice the change. Boyd was clear about it; it had to be direct. He had to say what he felt and why he was doing it. Anyone who only thought about results or money wouldn't have understood, but his manager was his advisor and friend, and he understood, which is why he supported him.

> El manager tenía mucha experiencia en la música, así que podía prever las cosas que iban a pasar. Cuando Boyd le comunicó su intensión y lo que quería hacer el enseguida se dio cuenta que eso traería problemas para su carrera y su historial de éxitos previos. La experiencia le había enseñado que si acostumbras a tus fans a un tipo de música especifico desde que comenzaste a cantar y luego lo cambias pues casi seguro que no será bien recibida. Le dijo por eso a Boyd que el no se oponía pues al final el era el cantante mientras el como manager solo era un empleado, pero le dijo que pensara bien las cosas. Debía elegir bien que era lo que más quería, mantener a la gente contenta haciendo lo que sabía que ya funcionaba o cambiar el rumbo y arriesgarse a lo desconocido, pero ¿Por qué? No veía beneficios aparentes. Para Boyd si fue difícil elegir pues no quería afectar su carrera del todo, pero como artista debía cambiar, pues ya estaba cansado de hacer lo mismo. Debía concentrarse ahora en crear música diciendo como él se sentía. Viendo esa decisión entonces el manager le dijo que si eso era lo que quería pues el lo respetaba. Pero le avisó que por aquello tendría problemas. Había dos caminos a seguir a partir de ese momento. Podía ir haciendo el cambio de música gradual y mezclarla con su estilo de siempre o podía pasar a la acción de forma directa para que la gente notara de verdad el cambio. Boyd lo tuvo claro, debía ser de forma directa. Decir lo que sentía y por qué lo hacía. Cualquier persona que solo piense en los resultados o el dinero no lo hubiera entendido, pero su manager era su consejero y amigo y lo entendió, por eso lo apoyó.
![giovanni-ribeiro-K6vJIN4cECo-unsplash (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tRzfSHVxRzz1zhxafjciQ4bYmPAwph4H3j35ywz7FMo6CS4TPCsd67FTY6AtivJKNRD.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Everything was decided; it was time to get to work. To begin, he made an announcement on his own social media, where he used to post polls, now he simply said to get ready for something new, something different from everything before. This raised people's expectations. It took him eight months to record the album and the songs. Luckily, what sped things up was that he already knew how he wanted to do them because he had been planning them for a long time. The album was released, and he waited a few weeks to see the results of the change in focus and style. The manager wasn't wrong; the sales were the lowest up to that point. And many people said negative things, like that he no longer connected with people and that it was better not to buy it because it wasn't like his previous work. But several others appreciated it because they got to know more of Boyd's personality and saw a new perspective that made his music more interesting. For him, as a singer, the poor results compared to his earlier work didn't matter at all. What mattered was that he was expressing himself through his music and could share his feelings. The music was his, and he decided which path to take; it's not all about money and results. He's more convinced than ever that he's heading in the right direction. Many more people liked his new music than didn't, and that speaks volumes.

> Ya estaba todo decidido, tocaba empezar a trabajar. Para comenzar hizo un anuncio en sus propias redes, donde antes ponía las encuestas ahora solo puso que se prepararan para lo que se venía nuevo, sería diferente a todo lo anterior. Eso elevó las expectativas de la gente. Tardó 8 meses en grabar el disco y las canciones. Por suerte lo que agilizó todo el que ya sabía de antemano como quería hacerlas porque las llevaba planificando desde hacia tiempo. Pues el disco se lanzó y esperó unas semanas para ver los resultados del cambio de enfoque y estilo. El manager no se equivocó los rendimientos fueron los más bajos hasta ese momento. Y muchas personas decían cosas negativas, como que ya no conectaba con la gente y que mejor no comprarlo, pues no eran como los anteriores. Pero varios otros lo valoraron porque conocieron más de la personalidad de Boyd, y vieron una nueva perspectiva que hacia su música más interesante. Para el como cantante los malos resultados en comparación con los viejos trabajos no le importaban en lo absoluto, lo que importaba es que se estaba desahogando a través de su propia música y podía contar lo que sentía. La música era suya, y el decidía que camino escoger, no todo es dinero y resultados. Está más convencido que va en la dirección correcta. A muchos más les gustó su nueva música que a los que no, y eso habla más que mil palabras
![darran-shen-3MBE9wJH4FA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/Eo8L6Aj1iWccyyVT1vEmHNezdS9FuksatVyTz5gR7uWc2qad5A1TKqJjV8ehB6mBwxs.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

Today is June 14, 2026, and we are closing out the week with maximum positive energy. To finish the weekend on a peaceful note, I headed back down to the familiar banks of the River Thames in Kingston upon Thames. After a lively, wildlife packed adventure at Bushy Park yesterday, returning to the gentle lap of the river currents was exactly what I needed to clear my mind and reset for the working week ahead. ​I am very proud to report that my Sunday stroll successfully locked in my goals, finishing the day with a solid 10,664 steps! ​Unstoppable Momentum The 31 Day Streak is Complete! ​Reaching that 10,000 step mark feels great on any individual day, but protecting an unbroken chain of healthy habits is the real victory. As shown in my Actifit app dashboard, today's walk keeps my phenomenal 31 day consistency streak perfectly intact! ​Looking at that full line of vibrant green checkmarks running flawlessly from last Monday all the way through to Sunday evening is an incredibly satisfying way to wrap up the week. It serves as a great visual reminder of what can be achieved with just a bit of daily dedication. While scrolling through tonight, I noticed a very fitting featured post from @actifit_fitness on the feed Keep the streak alive! With Actifit's Consecutive Days Tracker, every day you move adds to your streak. Reading that right as I locked in my own streak milestone felt like the perfect validation! ​A Quiet Moment on the Water's Edge. ​The scenic highlight of my evening riverside walk was a lovely, tranquil encounter with a local resident taking a rest right by the shoreline. ​As captured in my photo, I spotted a beautiful mallard duck peacefully perched on a wooden post just above the rippling blue surface of the river. The deep, iridescent green head of the drake stood out beautifully against the glittering light playing on the water. In the foreground, a pebbled shoreline and a small, wild green plant added a wonderfully natural and grounded texture to the view. Taking a moment to slow down my pace and just watch the gentle movement of the river wildlife turns an ordinary exercise routine into a deeply therapeutic escape. ​Ready for the Week Ahead. ​Securing over 10,500 steps on a Sunday evening gives me a brilliant sense of balance and focus as we head into a brand new week. Keeping this daily rhythm alive has completely rewritten my approach to well being, proving that showing up for yourself even on a lazy Sunday afternoon is always worth the effort. If you are trying to find the motivation to start your upcoming week on the right foot, I highly recommend finding a quiet waterfront or a river path near you. Let the calm flow of the water set your pace, and your health goals will naturally fall into place!

The person said:* *“The one who will succeed the most is the one whom life favors.”* *Mr. A, who invested in real estate, can either succeed or fail. We have seen people buy land in a bushy area expecting development, only for the area to remain undeveloped for 20 years. In the end, they sell the land for less than they paid for it. On the other hand, some people buy similar land and, within months, the area begins to develop. Infrastructure arrives, businesses move in, and the value of the land increases tenfold.* *Stocks have created generational wealth for some people, while others have lost their life savings investing in them. title.title: Lakrearte en las escuelas (Parte I) || Lakrearte in schools (Part I)
title.body:
![1001119846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tvijL4RwZJfG2BWax1yjp9JKWK1JK35HzFYAp1QgJX7djiDjqPgh2LvP2FmcgtMwks2.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Uno de los objetivos que me plantee para este año es llevar nuestro arte a cada rincón de la ciudad para darnos a conocer como centro artístico. Uno de los lugares que queremos \

son las escuelas, es pero eso que comenzamos con nuestro tour por las instituciones de Cabimas. Cómo sabrán, ya visitamos una escuela, que fue la historia que les compartí días atrás y esta que les compartiré hoy fue la segunda en visitar. La oportunidad surgió un día que una representante me comentó que sus pequeñas tenían un proyecto súper especial para este último lapso del año escolar y que su maestra buscaba apoyo de una profesora de arte para que guiara a los alumnos con algunas actividades. Me pareció una oportunidad ideal para llegar a esa escuela, que la verdad no sabía de su existencia. Así que organicé una reunión con la maestra de las niñas para poder conocer cuáles eran sus objetivos y discutir la propuesta que yo les tenía.

Hi everyone!

One of my goals for this year is to bring our art to every corner of the city to raise awareness of our art center. One of the places we want to focus on is the schools, which is why we're starting our tour of schools in Cabimas. As you know, we already visited one school, which is the story I shared with you a few days ago, and the one I'm sharing with you today was the second one we visited. The opportunity arose one day when a parent told me that her daughters had a very special project for the last term of the school year and that their teacher was looking for an art teacher to guide the students with some activities. It seemed like the perfect opportunity to visit this school, which I honestly didn't know existed. So I arranged a meeting with the girls' teacher to learn about their goals and discuss the proposal I had for them.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001030799.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uFTh8N3Cjo76a9jtNp41iXubTASeER9BxERzsXqYULm6dhiFka7PeEGkgGmXcbqsuzf.jpg) La cita era por la mañana, así que desperté bien temprano para estar a tiempo en ese colegio. A la reunión me iba a acompañar mi hijo porque ese dia había la celebración de un cumpleaños en Lakrearte por la tarde y pues era la única forma de que pudiera asistir. Vivimos retirados del local y no me iba a dar tiempo para ir y venir por él para luego ir de nuevo. Cómo les comenté anteriormente, no sabía de la existencia de este colegio, por ende no sabía donde quedaba pero luego de consultar y buscar en Google maps logré ubicarme. Así que emprendimos rumbo a nuestro objetivo y al llegar quedé sorprendida con el enorme tamaño de ese colegio, un edificio enorme de 4 pisos... Habíamos llegado una hora antes de la cita y pensaba que podían atendernos de una vez, pero al hablar con la portera nos dimos cuenta que no iba a ser así pues son súper estrictos con el cumplimiento de los horarios y pues tocó sentarse a esperar.
![1001030801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/242YA8XDNu74LfoSfdkWTNajVYecrkcis9rvFjybdnstogjvEpTEdyL6yKvog1YAALD86.jpg) The appointment was in the morning, so I woke up very early to be on time at the school. My son was going to accompany me to the meeting because there was a birthday celebration at Lakrearte that afternoon, and it was the only way he could attend. We live far from the school, and I wouldn't have had time to go and pick him up and then go back again. As I mentioned before, I didn't know this school existed, so I didn't know where it was located, but after consulting Google Maps, I managed to find it. So we set off for our destination, and when we arrived, I was surprised by the enormous size of the school—a huge, four-story building... We had arrived an hour before the appointment, and I thought they could see us right away, but when we spoke with the receptionist, we realized that wasn't going to be the case because they are very strict about punctuality, and so we had to sit and wait.
![1001030794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uFRzJGFRDxesjspb9S9EKk8octaxy5dWyhBYTpLsWxGeBRWEKXSe666jRSoM9L4evK5.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001030793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wMYHvbFkZKJNcKbcBMCpEjExVEKpctXpH9dqckAw7rW2z6fbAyBMhMoQrL86yBhbAt1.jpg) ![1001030792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2h2fbzD8gJtjDj2sj4cg9ru23n4Td5qoErPraXMbkt5U8svDnWQoHZji4EqeGXMAUs.jpg) Tenían una sala de estar bastante amplia y fresca, a pesar de no tener aire acondicionado ellos contaban con unos ventiladores enormes que refrescaban toda el área. Me gustó bastante eso la verdad.
![1001030804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zbPtNNx4aZBZfHLCRWfbHQrTRcgRiTfw2wf2oJp7Rsa1UHBWQruCLyZcc5JG9fpTPJ2.jpg) ![1001030796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xAXkhUtWp3u1Mk1Vhjfy6TrYr4xJFHmD2v7VfMJErQvYVcmMd9TVNUA4E33bUTcyQKe.jpg) They had a fairly spacious and cool living room, and even though they didn't have air conditioning, they had huge fans that cooled the whole area. I really liked that, to be honest.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001030797.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgN4RWKosbSr9FEhgRyxK2W118GgmiBNysouw3NyKvyJL6iV1cSLD8iS1Aj9KBe1k1W.jpg) ![1001030788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wMRn7uKPNrciMb2DiCY636twKMw6D647zqqRkhsKiJSLHC8kKB4aqgBBgec9SmdxnZB.jpg) ![1001030798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tbpcB6rxSrsU3f3PfN3XbzzqcmdZCgfVyCwYc5HfVRjT7fJFL8v2UmQJr3kAhgLxRYe.jpg) Desde adentro todo se veía enorme. Contaban en el centro con un gran patio, que era donde se reunían para recreo y las actividades especiales, pues había un escenario enorme al final del espacio. Ahí nos tocó esperar por una hora hasta que por fin pudieron atenderme.
![1001030791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2gphkrNkGUKVBTTjXPTciEdTHWYqhuyuJtErKiLCPFcRbwKGswT8shwTg9WYSRH3Y3.jpg) ![1001030790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23yTf3gmaJ9DXdaYgqW63B9L7cgzWWAt3dYVVLQzwGsVJYYxybt4SveQGrx7vhzXnJCLK.jpg) ![1001030789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2jHQ9Ax1Sqd5DhzVE3URpMvThUnhXL5n97sSD1tXKx5Wiyyi4ML7V4GD3cfc9Ahibh.jpg) From inside, everything looked enormous. In the center was a large courtyard, where they gathered for recess and special activities, and there was a huge stage at the far end. We had to wait there for an hour before they finally attended to me.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1001030807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsN2TMicpstEFC4NGuntDQskggUWYBmMvxUz8Y1N4nAFnrjZ3BKMWLBZixqrdMvEkX6.jpg) Nos hicieron pasar a un área que era una capilla, este colegio es religioso y contaban con un área para hacer sus actividades especiales. Acá pude conocer a la maestra y planificar con ella las dos actividades que realizaríamos con los alumnos, de ahí se plantearon unas fechas y ella quedó súper contenta con la propuesta. Yo también estaba muy emocionada por lo que íbamos a realizar con esos pequeños, que eran un grupo de 30 estudiantes. Ya de ahí nos despedimos y salimos de esa reunión bien animados para continuar con nuestro día. En el próximo post les contaré que tal nos fue en esas actividades. 💜
![1001030806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xp4AwBUgLyNHMeo7nXAsr2Ps1jBdeG8q8Vhv2LdyoScn3uPGPqDrNxkTJTX8iF5mzW4.jpg) We were shown to an area that was a chapel. This is a religious school, and they had a space for their special activities. There, I met the teacher and planned the two activities we would do with the students. We set some dates, and she was very happy with the proposal. I was also very excited about what we were going to do with those little ones, a group of 30 students. After that, we said our goodbyes and left the meeting feeling energized to continue with our day. In the next post, I'll tell you how those activities went. 💜
![1001030809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgPvNfVNx1GxLy6uhVfxKFRvsvcnd7E5GfqsiMjjSqx7ZBrhjAWpFsnQ1EkZbUQ5bzG.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Gracias por leer, comentar y votar mi contenido! Espero haya sido de tu agrado y provecho. Un gran abrazo a todos, y nos leemos en un próximo post • Lakrearte en Hive • Att: Estefania Garcia ♥

title.title: New Tokens Are Killing the Future of Blue-Chip Coins
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 14, 2026, 01_57_34 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tvcDL1zmt2ZUC5KN4wFuNm67tQ1JSzaYqjiZdGjoQPeHcCujhkxUXU9cFKr3oGAVUCY.png)


Investors still have one hope that the assets they invested in at their all time highs will perform well in the future and that another altcoin season may allow them to recover their losses and make good profits.

A large number of investors, especially longterm holders have invested in blue-chip cryptocurrencies. This raises an important question that will these blue-chip coins ever return to their all time highs? Do they still have real use cases? Are their projects still active and capable of surviving in the long run?

These are important questions that need answers.

One major issue I see in the crypto market today is the constant launch of new tokens. Every day, dozens of new projects appear, creating a gambling\ like environment. 

Huge trading volumes quickly flow into these new coins but after one or two months, many of them experience sharp price crashes that causes heavy losses for investors.

Then the cycle repeats. Another new token appears, volume shifts into it, investors chase quick profits and many end up losing money again. This process continues without stopping.

Because of this trend many investors have started ignoring blue chip cryptocurrencies. If we look at trading volumes, many established coins are receiving very little attention compared to newly launched tokens. 

The market has become focused on speculation rather than investment. People want quick gains through risky trades while fundamentally strong projects are being overlooked.

In such an environment if trading volume and investor interest do not return to blue-chip coins, it will be difficult for them to reach their previous all time highs. Project teams may be able to support prices through development and investment but true price growth requires strong market demand and investor participation.

In my opinion the continuous launch of new tokens is one of the biggest reasons why many blue chip cryptocurrencies struggle to move higher. This is the real reason why blue chips coins are struggling.

What do you think? Will blue chip cryptocurrencies ever return to their all time highs?? What is your opinion about the large number of new tokens being launched every day? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

# Learn Zig Series (#79) - Mini Project: File Sync Tool - Part 3: Network Protocol

![zig.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHuB6qTWHaSpJHQ1S8FCCRmNQuUxTcPZdU4yKHsJ7vEP/zig-banner.png)

**Part of a multi-episode project**

### What will I learn
- How to design a binary wire protocol for file synchronization with handshake, manifest exchange, and delta transfer phases;
- How to build a TCP server and client that negotiate capabilities and transfer file data;
- How to implement shared-secret authentication with HMAC-based challenge-response;
- How to handle network errors gracefully and support resumable transfers via chunk acknowledgment;
- How to implement bandwidth limiting using a token bucket algorithm for background sync;
- How to detect and resolve conflicts in bidirectional synchronization scenarios;
- How to add a dry-run mode that shows planned operations without touching any files;
- How to write end-to-end tests using a local TCP server to verify the entire protocol stack.

### Requirements
- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- An installed Zig 0.14+ distribution (download from ziglang.org);
- The ambition to learn Zig programming.

### Difficulty
- Advanced

# Learn Zig Series (#79) - Mini Project: File Sync Tool - Part 3: Network Protocol

We have a delta transfer engine that can figure out which bytes changed between two versions of a file, and a manifest system that compares directory trees. But all of it runs locally -- both \

are just memory buffers on the same machine. Time to change that. This episode we're putting the file sync tool on the network.

The plan: a proper binary wire protocol with a handshake phase, authentication, manifest exchange, delta streaming, and error recovery. We covered TCP sockets back in episode 21 and built a full TCP server for the key-value store in episodes 42-43, so the socket mechanics should feel familiar. What's new here is designing a protocol that's robust enough for real file synchronization -- handling disconnections mid-transfer, verifying data integrity over the wire, and throttling bandwidth so sync doesn't eat your entire connection while you're trying to watch YouTube ;-)

## Designing the wire protocol

Every network protocol needs message framing. TCP gives you a raw byte stream with no concept of \

-- it's up to you to define where one message ends and the next begins. Our protocol uses a simple length-prefixed format:

```zig
// src/protocol.zig
const std = @import(\

-- it binds a secret key to the hash computation so only someone with the key can produce a valid output.

The `timingSafeEql` comparison is critical. A naive byte-by-byte comparison short-circuits on the first mismatch -- an attacker watching response times can figure out how many leading bytes they got right and brute-force the rest one byte at a time. Constant-time comparison always takes the same time regardless of where (or whether) there's a mismatch. This is crypto 101 but I've seen production code get it wrong more times than I can count.

## The TCP server

With protocol and auth in place, let's build the server. It listens for connections, performs the handshake, and enters the sync loop:

```zig
// src/server.zig
const std = @import(\

that fills with tokens at a fixed rate, and each byte you send costs one token. If the bucket is empty, you wait:

```zig
// src/throttle.zig
const std = @import(\

The internal math converts to nanosecond precision because that's what `std.time.nanoTimestamp` gives us, but the external API stays human-friendly.

The busy-wait loop with 1ms sleeps is crude but effective. A production implementation might use `std.Thread.Futex` or `select()`/`poll()` with a timeout for better power efficiency, but for a sync tool that's already doing disk I/O the 1ms granularity is more than fine.

## Bidirectional sync and conflict detection

Up to now we've been thinking about sync as one-directional: push changes from source to destination. But what if both sides change the same file? This is the **conflict** problem, and it's the hardest part of sync.

Our approach: compare timestamps and file content hashes from both sides. If both modified the same file since the last sync, that's a conflict. The user must decide which version wins:

```zig
// src/conflict.zig
const std = @import(\
resolution renames one version with a `.conflict-remote` or `.conflict-local` suffix. This is what Dropbox does (those \
files), and while it's not elegant it's safe -- no data is ever lost.\n\nFor automated sync (no human present to resolve conflicts), you typically pick a default strategy: \

Our implementation defaults to `skip` -- don't touch conflicted files until someone explicitly resolves them. Safer that way.

## Dry-run mode

Before actually syncing anything, users want to see what WOULD happen. The dry-run mode computes the full sync plan -- diffs, deltas, conflict detection, everything -- but doesn't transfer any bytes or modify any files:

```zig
// src/dry_run.zig
const std = @import(\
), and then run the actual sync. This seperation of \

is a pattern we've used before (the CLI task runner in episode 36 had a similar `--plan` mode).

## End-to-end testing

Testing network code properly means running an actual server, connecting to it, and verifying the whole protocol works. We spin up a local TCP server on a random port and exercise the full flow:

```zig
// src/test_e2e.zig
const std = @import(\
{\n    const allocator = std.testing.allocator;\n    const addr = try std.net.Address.resolveIp(\
{\n    const allocator = std.testing.allocator;\n    const addr = try std.net.Address.resolveIp(\
{\n    const allocator = std.testing.allocator;\n    const addr = try std.net.Address.resolveIp(\
, 0)`) lets the OS assign a random available port, which avoids the \

problem when running tests in parallel. We grab the actual bound address from `server.listener.listen_address` after binding. This is a common pattern for test servers.

The auth rejection test verifies that a client with the wrong secret gets rejected cleanly -- no crash, no half-authenticated state, just a proper error. Security tests are just as important as functionality tests; if your auth can be bypassed by sending unexpected data, you don't really have auth.

## Running all tests

```
$ zig build test
All 18 tests passed.
```

(That's 7 tests from parts 1 and 2 plus 7 new end-to-end tests, plus the 4 unit tests for protocol/throttle/conflict.)

## What we built

This episode was a LOT of ground to cover. Here's the full picture:

- **Wire protocol** -- length-prefixed binary messages with CRC-16 integrity checking and a 4-byte magic header for connection identification
- **Handshake** -- version negotiation with capability flags so client and server can agree on supported features
- **HMAC authentication** -- challenge-response authentication using SHA-256 HMAC, constant-time comparison, no secrets on the wire
- **TCP server** -- accepts connections, authenticates, and processes sync requests in a message loop
- **TCP client** -- connects, authenticates, and drives the sync process with chunked file transfers
- **Resumable transfers** -- per-file progress tracking persisted to disk, survives process restarts and network failures
- **Bandwidth limiting** -- token bucket rate limiter that allows bursts but enforces an average rate, configurable per-connection
- **Bidirectional conflict detection** -- compares manifests against a last-sync timestamp, identifies mutual edits, offers resolution strategies
- **Dry-run mode** -- complete sync planning without touching files, human-readable output with action icons and byte counts
- **End-to-end tests** -- real TCP connections between server and client threads, verifying the entire protocol stack from handshake through file transfer

Having said that, we have one more part to go. The final episode will polish everything into a usable command-line tool: argument parsing, configuration files, ignore patterns (like `.gitignore`), and proper logging. We'll also add a `--watch` mode that monitors the filesystem and syncs incrementally as files change (remember the file watcher from episode 63). The building blocks are all in place now -- network protocol, delta transfer, manifests, auth, throttling. Part 4 ties them together into something you'd actually use day-to-day.

![1000001005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bossmode/23tm9AtPYyXCBgz3msE5fvn51EvEH1yiYKT7Aecubvka5vC5As4JGTpb6QdNmvzqoCgGg.jpg)
Patatos glows warmly under the night lights inviting people to taste Istanbul’s street food culture. Kumpir isn’t just food  it’s comfort shared laughter and the flavor of the city itself.
![1000001003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bossmode/23tS2jaLh3v3GpJbu9o69LiL9qrV7FMKds1hBWuKqiNhJJkLBzLtVXNTHTgbmvzXyDNjB.jpg)
Istanbul even from afar feels like a living painting full of color taste, and tradition Though I’ve never been there these glimpses remind me that beauty doesn’t always need to be touched sometimes it’s enough to be felt through stories and images

title.title: HeyGen Avatar und ElevenLabs Voice Clone
title.body:
Heute endlich fertiggestellt.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKbAitirYpuzwzSmx5xEEESUUvhd1ZM32Loh4DEdFbjW/img_5257.png)

Ich habe endlich einen neuen Avatar und eine bessere Stimme für Ihn.

Also erstmal zum Avatar. HeyGen hat vor einiger Zeit das Modell 5 rausgebracht. Dazu muss Mann ein kurzes Vodeo, 1 Minute reicht, aufnehmen und dann kann man damit die verschiedensten Looks erstellen. Hintergründe tauschen, Farben ändern und vieles Mehr.
Man kann nach wie vor auch seine Stimme mit aufnehmen oder aber eine Stimme von ElevenLabs verwenden.

Dann zur Stimme. Bei ElevrnLabs gibt es 2 Möglichkeiten seine Stimme zu clonen. Die einfache Variante mit einer kurzen Aufnahme oder die Professionelle mit um die 2 Stunden „Stimmabgabe“

Ich habe die letzten Tage immer mal eine Session mit 10-15 Minuten aufgenommen und heute dann meine neue Stimme mit knapp 2 Stunden Material erstellt.

Dann habe ich die neue Folge von KI vor 9, dir am Dienstag den 16.6 veröffentlicht wird mit SKILLY und meinem neuen Avatar produziert.

Ich sehe eine deutliche Verbesserung zu den 10 Folgen, die bisher gelaufen sind.

Klar den Unterschied zum echten Michael sieht und hört man noch, aber verdammt nah dran.

Bin mal gespannt wie die Reaktionen am Dienstag ausfallen.

**🏆 Hive Art Gallery – Round #68 – The Winners!**

Your participation brought this round to life. 🙌


 
# The winners

 🥇 **1st place**:

 **@gatubela** -  [Un momento de relax 😌 (crayones óleo pastel) / A relax moment 😌 (oil pastel crayons)](https://hive.blog/hive-158694/@gatubela/un-momento-de-relax-crayones-oleo-pastel-a-relax-moment-oil-pastel-crayons) - **9** points - prize:  **20% of the post's earnings** + **300 Ecency Points**  

![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23x1HkdDuGwR4Ddn1bMQoJRh67kQ1xjU6BSeznaSuVERVEY47uSG7S2vBTYypSveYtozB.jpg)
 
 This striking oil pastel portrait beautifully captures a serene moment of respite against a vibrant fuchsia backdrop. The artist skillfully employs an unconventional color palette, utilizing bright yellow highlights and soft green undertones to build unique dimension and dynamic shadows on the model's skin. The contrast between the intense, dark textures of the hair and mesh gloves against the soft, multi-toned pink lips draws the viewer's focus directly to the central expression of relief. With closed eyes and hands gently resting on her head, the artwork successfully radiates a deep sense of calm and release, turning a simple study of human features into a compelling visual meditation on de-stressing after a hectic day.


  
  🥈 **2nd place**:
  
 **@reyghart04** -  [📽🎨 Video del dibujo ¡Quiero respirar!/Video of the drawing 'I Want to Breathe! (ESP/ENG)](https://hive.blog/hive-158694/@reyghart04/video-del-dibujo-quiero-respirar) - **7** points - prize:  **15% of the post's earnings** + **200 Ecency Points**  
 
![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://i.ecency.com/DQmXTSykCWLGX3tWeMdoRoru9w36A5pMTp3cf6zfSESku79/1780324162201.jpg) 

 This profound, reflective drawing serves as a powerful social critique, capturing the heartbreaking loss of childhood innocence within a toxic environment. Executed with an HB2 pencil and charcoal, the piece creates a stark, dramatic contrast between the realistically rendered central figure of a child wearing a protective mask and the chaotic, smoke-filled background. The boy's intense, defiant gaze piercingly conveys both his struggle to survive an \

atmosphere and his lingering hope for a healthier, freer life. Surrounding him is a dense tapestry of symbolic, almost childlike doodles depicting adult vices, greed, violence, and societal pressures that clutter his world. By juxtaposing the raw realism of the child against these suffocating societal ills, the artwork functions not just as a skillful monochromatic portrait, but as an urgent, emotional plea to protect the innocence of future generations. 🥉 **3rd place**: **@seey-art** - [Up the stream 🚣](https://hive.blog/hive-174301/@seey-art/up-the-stream) - **6** points - prize: **15% of the post's earnings** + **100 Ecency Points** ![](https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://i.ecency.com/DQmWX22aXxMda5oNjWFSFyEr5cHnW83YK8mBgQ1wfhHqi5t/1780344694382.png) This beautiful digital artwork captivates the viewer with its clean, minimalist composition and masterful use of perspective. The winding blue stream acts as a powerful leading line, drawing the eye upwards from the lone paddler at the bottom into a soft, misty horizon. There is an incredibly clever dual perspective at play; while the water realistically flows and ripples around the small boat—complete with a delicate reflection and subtle oar splashes—the right bank of the river subtly mimics the silhouette of a human face looking skyward. The stark contrast between the vibrant, cool tones of the water and the vast, textured white space surrounding it creates an atmosphere of profound solitude and determination, perfectly embodying the quiet journey of navigating life's currents. --- ## **Congratulations to the winners!** 🎉 Remember, the contest is ongoing! title.title: Road trip to Buggiano, Traversagna and Margine di coperta/ Viaje por carretera a Buggiano, Traversagna y Margine di coperta.
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYzazZvnLaVocGJn2sX7cbV8huFFcaQRP2UB6vTi1PRs/1781451476981.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? Here I am again to show you around. A few days ago, my husband and I went to a resort in Buggiano, which I'll obviously tell you about in my next post. To get there, we took a short tour through some small villages like Margine di Coperta and Traversagna. A lovely road leads to Buggiano, a small village with a very beautiful hilly area. This road passes through the villages of the plains of part of the Nievole Valley, which I've mentioned several times in my posts. The first village you come to is Traversagna, a small village on the road. To get there, you follow the usual, beautiful tree-lined avenues. It's a well-kept and cared for area with many beautiful, elegant and well-maintained homes. It's well-connected to many towns in the Nievole Valley, such as Vangile and Mazza e Cozzile, places I absolutely must visit sooner or later. This village is small but very popular and busy precisely because it is a passageway. You can admire beautiful streets and beautiful houses as well as various green spaces that surround this area. Then, after a short while, you reach the edge of the covered area and find one of the most frequented churches in the village.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Aquí estoy de nuevo para mostrarles los alrededores. Hace unos días, mi esposo y yo fuimos a un resort en Buggiano, del que obviamente les hablaré en mi próxima publicación. Para llegar allí, hicimos un pequeño recorrido por algunos pueblos pequeños como Margine di Coperta y Traversagna. Una carretera encantadora lleva a Buggiano, un pequeño pueblo con una zona montañosa muy hermosa. Esta carretera pasa por los pueblos de la llanura de parte del Valle del Nievole, que he mencionado varias veces en mis publicaciones. El primer pueblo que se encuentra es Traversagna, un pequeño pueblo en la carretera. Para llegar allí, se siguen las típicas y hermosas avenidas arboladas. Es una zona bien cuidada y mantenida con muchas casas hermosas, elegantes y bien conservadas. Está bien comunicada con muchos pueblos del Valle del Nievole, como Vangile y Mazza e Cozzile, lugares que definitivamente debo visitar tarde o temprano. Este pueblo es pequeño pero muy popular y animado precisamente porque es un paso. Podrás admirar hermosas calles y casas, así como diversos espacios verdes que rodean esta zona. Después de un rato, llegarás al límite del recinto cubierto y encontrarás una de las iglesias más concurridas del pueblo.

The very modern-looking red brick church is dedicated to Saint Rita, also known as the saint of lost causes (she could be my ideal saint, perhaps I should say a few prayers to her!). We then continue our journey and find ourselves on various streets and in a village with colorful houses—if you've been following me, you'll know they're typical of this entire area—with a few shops and businesses. Then, little by little, the greenery takes over as we approach the hilly area. The houses are replaced by fields and meadows. Little by little, all the houses disappear and we begin to climb the hill. The streets here are literally surrounded only by woods and tree-lined areas, a very beautiful and somewhat wild nature, with pines, poplars, and a few scattered cypresses. In the distance, as we approach our destination, we can see the medieval village of Buggiano with its tower, which unfortunately I haven't visited but which I certainly will soon. Here we are right on the hill of Buggiano, from which you can see the valley below and enjoy the view of the beautiful nature. I'll say goodbye now, but I'll soon take you to the beautiful resort of Buggiano!

> La iglesia de ladrillo rojo, de aspecto muy moderno, está dedicada a Santa Rita, también conocida como la santa de las causas perdidas (¡podría ser mi santa ideal, tal vez debería rezarle algunas oraciones!). Luego continuamos nuestro viaje y nos encontramos en varias calles y en un pueblo con casas coloridas —si me han estado siguiendo, sabrán que son típicas de toda esta zona— con algunas tiendas y negocios. Luego, poco a poco, la vegetación se apodera del lugar a medida que nos acercamos a la zona montañosa. Las casas son reemplazadas por campos y prados. Poco a poco, todas las casas desaparecen y comenzamos a subir la colina. Las calles aquí están literalmente rodeadas solo de bosques y áreas arboladas, una naturaleza muy hermosa y algo salvaje, con pinos, álamos y algunos cipreses dispersos. A lo lejos, mientras nos acercamos a nuestro destino, podemos ver el pueblo medieval de Buggiano con su torre, que lamentablemente no he visitado, pero que sin duda lo haré pronto. Aquí estamos justo en la colina de Buggiano, desde donde se puede ver el valle abajo y disfrutar de la vista de la hermosa naturaleza. Me despido ahora, pero pronto te llevaré al precioso complejo turístico de Buggiano.

Weekly Prompt: What’s your favorite thing about the current season, and what do you dislike most?

In Pakistan, summer is not easy to deal with. The heat can be so intense that even simple daily tasks feel exhausting. 

Sometimes I feel like I’m only made for winters.So for me summers season is totally no.

I don’t like summers. But only thing which fascinates me are rains and summer fruits.

When you witness the growth of greenery around after every rain,it feels so good.

Even my small kitchen garden in the pots grows like if a magic happened at night.

I love bathing in rain . Luckily, in Islamabad it rains both in summer and winter. Because of cold  you can’t imagine to get out and enjoy, but in summer I enjoy in full bloom. 

I enjoy all summer fresh fruits, specially mangoes, and watermelons.

The most I hate about summers is sweating. I feel I’m drained, no matter how many times you takea shower, after sometimes you feel same sweaty.

I don’t like to cook in the kitchen. I don’t like to go for a walk in summers. I mostly do online shopping even for the groceries too. 

One more thing I hate about summers are lizards.

All kinds of crawling insects and reptiles comes out so you need to be pretty cautious. 

I also witnessed a scorpion at my house.

I live in a house which is surrounded by trees and wild weeds. For the last three days one of my bathrooms is locked because of a visitor gecko came inside from a small hole in the window. I requested even the  neighbors for help but noone showed up so far.

Summers in Karachi is horrible. Islamabad is much better because of rains.

In summer, most of my time is spent playing with water. I love splashing water with the hose pipe while washing my terrace and stairs. Anything that involves water is my favorite thing to do, especially on hot days.

Maybe that's why I'm dreaming of moving to the north one day, where the weather stays cool and pleasant. A place where summer feels more like spring or even winter. That sounds perfect to me!

body.title: Rachas rotas y golpes en la mesa - Un fin de semana de justicia deportiva [SPA/ENG]
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>




Vaya fin de semana deportivo estamos teniendo, y aún queda mucho por ver. Seguro estos días serán de esos que permanecen en la memoria colectiva de los más fanáticos al deporte, ya que se ha demostrado que el tiempo da revanchas y el destino termina ajustando cuentas, validando que lo visto no solo fueron una serie de resultados, es la paciencia finalmente recompensada.
>#### Broken streaks and slamming the table: A weekend of sporting justice
>What a sporting weekend we are having, and there is still much more to see. Surely these days will be among those that remain in the collective memory of the most fanatic sports fans, as it has been proven that time grants revenges and destiny ends up settling accounts, validating that what we saw was not just a series of results, it is patience finally rewarded.

<center>   
![1000416980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23xei2Avrj3QGBadi1jRbE4XzWwLYaYnX8et44KhnNzMprtoDi2gtFWa8vkX814jgAzUx.jpg)
 </center>

***

### Redención para los históricos **New York Knicks**


Pasaron 52 años para que los Knicks se coronarsen nuevamente campeones de la NBA. Es una vida entera señores, estamos hablando de medio siglo, para una franquicia con uno de los fandom más grande de este deporte. Cómo olvidar esa final que se le escapó a Latrell Sprewell, que no pudo contar con el apoyo de Patrick Ewing por lesión por allá en 1999, fue muy duro. Por eso ver a los Knicks volver a la cima no es simplemente ganar un trofeo, es cerrar uma herida historica y saldar una deuda de muchos años con los fanáticos.
>##### Redemption for the historic New York Knicks

>It took 52 years for the Knicks to crown themselves NBA champions once again. That is a whole lifetime, gentlemen, we are talking about half a century for a franchise with one of the largest fanbases in this sport. How could we forget that final that slipped away from Latrell Sprewell, who could not count on the support of an injured Patrick Ewing back in 1999, it was very tough. That is why seeing the Knicks return to the top is not simply winning a trophy, it is closing a historical wound and settling a multi-year debt with the fans.

***


#### Lewis Hamilton** vuelve a ganar tras 2 año en la F1


Esa misma sensación de \

nos la regaló **Lewis Hamilton** en la Fórmula 1. Pasaron dos años para ver nuevamente al 7 veces campeón mundial subirse al podio en primer lugar. El mismo se cuestionó muchas veces, asegurando que ya no era nadie, pero los fan y el equipo de Ferrari le ayudaron a volver a confiar en si mismo, dando un mensaje directo a sus detractores. 

Si victoria nos deja un sabor agridulce, ya que la racha de Kimi Antonelli se ha roto, la posibilidad de alcanzar las 7 victorias en línea de Hamilton no fue posible, sin embargo, dejo claro que es el mejor de Mercedes, paso a su compañero Russell pero el carro falló a solo dos vueltas de terminar la carrera. Está es un lección para el joven piloto que más que ganar, las carreras se deben terminar.
>##### Lewis Hamilton wins again after 2 years in F1

>That same feeling of an \

was gifted to us by Lewis Hamilton in Formula 1. Two years passed before we saw the 7-time world champion stand on top of the podium again. He questioned himself many times, claiming he was no one anymore, but the fans and the Ferrari team helped him trust in himself again, sending a direct message to his detractors.
>His victory leaves us with a bittersweet taste, since Kimi Antonelli's streak has been broken, and the possibility of reaching Hamilton's 7 wins in a row was not possible; however, he made it clear that he is the best at Mercedes, passing his teammate Russell, but the car failed just two laps before finishing the race. This is a lesson for the young driver that more than winning, races must be finished.
 
***


### Cuando los pronósticos se rompen

La gloria de la victoria se ha hecho presente también en el mundial de fútbol de la FIFA. Me encanta el deporte por la emoción que reside en la sorpresa. Ver las victorias de selecciones como la de Estados Unidos por goleada ante Paraguay, la selección \

más fuerte de sudamérica. Australia sufrir contra los embates de una poderosa Turquía y terminar ganando 2 por 0; son el recordatorio perfecto de que el ranking y favoritismos son solo números y estadísticas, la victoria se logra también con el corazón, táctica y garra. >##### When predictions are broken >The glory of victory has also made an appearance in the FIFA World Cup. I love sports because of the emotion that resides in surprises. Seeing the victories of national teams like the United States by a blowout against Paraguay, the defensively strongest team in South America; Australia suffering against the onslaught of a powerful Turkey and ending up winning 2 to 0; they are the perfect reminder that rankings and favoritism are just numbers and statistics, victory is also achieved with heart, tactics, and grit. *** **¿Que opinas de estos resultados? ¿Cuál de estas victorias te emocionó más o te tomó por sorpresa? ¡Te leo en los comentarios!** >What do you think of these results? body.title: Plant bug (Charagochilus longicornis)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXkSc98WJEg5Ai4ux263NHhNU2atmyCnHBJYKJnGCMSgM/mix_20260614_223853.jpg)

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Charagochilus longicornis*** | Jun 14, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3qS6mcGTkThVj9XTV2FcDnnipYeoqZt3B6pUNGa1XJZ/mix_20260614_223255.jpg)


This small insect is usually called a 'plant bug' in English. They are basically a special species of 'true bugs' or real bugs, which remain attached to the leaves of plants throughout their lives.

​Scientific name:
This small insect has a specific identity in the scientific classification of biology and entomology. Its scientific name is ***Charagochilus longicornis***. Many years ago, in 1885, the famous entomologist O. M. Reuter was the first to observe the structure and characteristics of this insect and gave it this scientific name.
​Family and Genus:
This plant bug is a small member of the vast Arthropoda phylum and Insecta class of the animal kingdom. They are mainly included in the Hemiptera or true bugs class. Their family name is Miridae, which is one of the largest families of plant bugs. The genus name of this insect is Charagochilus.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxfgHVHiKjRcutwhKryN9AcrRGfGMymD7yJrURrMKeD4/mix_20260614_223331.jpg)

​Size and body structure:
This insect is really small in size. The length of a full-grown insect is usually only 3.5 to 4 millimeters. Their main body color is black or dark brown. However, one of the main features of their body is that they have very fine golden hairs or scales on their back and wings (golden pubescence). In addition, the upper part of their wings is quite uneven and there is a pattern or texture with small holes like dense dots. There are two very long antennae on the front of the head, which help them understand their surroundings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNe1WGi7oCKnE2TWP8GnJ4PVX6iUjhxHHsqvkEZS5tzVb/mix_20260614_223409.jpg)

​Habitat and habitat:
These insects live over a fairly large area in terms of geographical distribution. Their presence has been widely recorded, especially in various countries of Eurasia (Europe and Asia) and Australia. They generally prefer to live in open grasslands, pastures and natural environments surrounded by greenery. In the rural environment of our country, especially in grassy plains or young leaves of Malta, lemon or fruit gardens, if you look closely, you can easily see such small plant bugs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPoDNYSoL1x3f5eAqCzm7ET2A1fGNQQW6WxqAb3rDLcTv/mix_20260614_224136.jpg)

​Food:
As the name suggests, these plant bugs are completely herbivorous. Like other true bugs, they also have a strong and sharp sucking tube or proboscis at the front of their mouth. With the help of this tube, they pierce the soft tissue of the leaves and young branches of certain host plants and suck the nutritious juice from there to live.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4KvHe1T6BJ9aV33krPWKYSNywRsQGnKhvs7KW4MRyqC/mix_20260614_224042.jpg)

​Reproduction:
The life cycle of these insects is completed through incomplete metamorphosis, like other common insects of the Hemiptera order. That is, there is no pupa or pupal stage in their life cycle. The adult female insect lays eggs inside the leaf tissue or in the leaf grooves of their favorite plants. The eggs hatch into small nymphs or young insects, which look almost like large insects, only they do not have wings. After changing their shells several times, they turn into full-fledged winged insects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUMB9Kgt9CtrPE5USUsefkuTdfmPb1xdmSoTWPuAp8xKW/mix_20260614_224223.jpg)

​Benefits:
These insects do not have any direct benefits in agriculture or human daily life. However, they play an important role in maintaining the balance of nature's vast ecosystem. In nature's food chain, they are used as daily food for small birds, lizards, spiders or other predatory insects.

​Harmfulness
Since they suck the sap of plant leaves, if their number increases excessively in the garden or crop field for some reason, the plant may be damaged. They feed on the sap of the leaves, causing small spots or holes on the leaves, and the leaves may turn yellow and dry up. However, they are not generally known to be a major pest or destructive pest, so they are not a particular concern in large orchards or agricultural fields.

I hope you enjoy learning about this little insect.



  I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

body.title: The Silent Struggle of Mental Health
body.body:
![pixabau.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPsrfeoApYa8MduEQHvg4xCJpHw3dcx3X9e9wDtRFP3cd/pixabau.jpg)

image source : pixabay.com


People often give attention to many things in life like work money and daily responsibilities but one thing that is usually ignored is mental health. This is actually a very serious matter because when a person does not take care of their mind and emotions over time it can lead to deep problems that are hard to fix later. 


Once mental health gets badly affected it is not easy to fully recover and in many cases the damage can stay for a long time.We usually care a lot about our physical health. We eat properly we try to stay active and we go to doctors when something feels wrong. But when it comes to mental health we often stay careless or ignore it completely. 

The truth is that mental health is just as important as physical health if not more. 
A strong and healthy mind helps us stay balanced in life. If someone keeps ignoring their mental state day by day it slowly starts affecting their thinking ability and decision making. At some point a person may feel confused stressed or emotionally weak and even simple choices become difficult. That is why taking care of mental health is not something optional it is something necessary for a stable and better life.
