body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1932
Sunday 14, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1997
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Someone must have told me. Or maybe some, thing. I should have known. 

Sol-2-Soul my brothers and sisters. Welcome to one more essay above ground. Today we are exploring the myths and magic behind the numbers 3, 6, & 9. 

Apocalypse Year was 2024. Within that year we presented a series called, “Shattered Beliefs.” I think we mentioned this before. One belief that was shattered and discarded was the idea that apocalypse means some kind of disaster. Nothing of the sort. However, an apocalypse could possibly lead to disaster, it is not the disaster itself. Apocalypse literally means, to pull back the cover. 

What happens when we pull back the cover? 

Think Indiana Jones and the Arc of the Covenant. Maybe your head explodes, maybe your skin melts off of your body, or maybe you get away with a broken heart. 

Our current evidence-based belief, when it comes to numbers, is that numbers are only true, in the abstract. Which isn’t completely true itself. When numbers are used to measure inanimate objects, for example for building, one could use the Egyptian geometry which someone, probably not Pythagoras, attached his name to. That dynamic will work every single time in the abstract. It might also work every single time when applied to building, provided the tools used to measure the planks, for example, are accurately calibrated and the human using said tools is proficient. Right away, we are already two degrees from perfection. 

However, when one attempts to map the orbit of the Earth around the Sun with a circle, declares, “as below, so above,” and assigns 1 day on Earth to 1 degree of the circle. Well, that ain’t necessarily so. Apparently the time it takes for Earth to circle the Sun, is relative. 

This belief, for your humble vagabond has been shattered this month, and Ego is just short of devastated over it. Procession may be real, but it’s not fixed and fastened to time. But it doesn’t really matter because humans don’t live that long anyway. Should there be another cataclysm comparable to those of legend, and Earth is pushed one way or the other, relative to its proximity to the sun, the calendars will be adjusted by whichever civilization has survived. Or, it won’t.  

Mind has already accepted the facts. We will give Ego until the end of June, to reconcile its latest shattered belief. 



Stay strong, stay safe, sty sane. stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed. 

PEACE.    



Sol-2-Soul Sunday #89
Sustainable Grooves
Quantum Jargonning
Jargon, the lingo within language.  

![1997.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUSe8j9J93JiCGmB5M8u7ntHrFRPBCLzeqYCVdUqwZp8/1997.png)

Today's Episode: https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1932_full_6-14-26_1997_sol89:2?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Numbers Magic. Numbers Myth.  
We have maybe two more parts to go in the 130 years, and counting, War series. Let’s save them for the week days. Today we are going to jump into numbers, which, with few exceptions are the few Universal truths. This piece come out of an exploration and debate with a chat-bot. Here’s one of Noxsoma’s Seven Truths, “Numbers never lie.” Here’s what we mean. 
The Occult Significance of 369. Tesla's Key or Modern Myth?
From social media manifestation rituals to sacred geometry, the number 369 has become one of the most debated numerical symbols in modern occult and spiritual circles. 
If you've spent any time on spiritual side of the web, or in esoteric forums, you've likely encountered the claim that, \

The phrase is almost always attributed to Nikola Tesla, the tragic inventor who brought us alternating current. But, as with many things in the occult world, the truth is far messier, and far more interesting, than the legend suggests. \nThe Tesla Legend. Where It Actually Comes From. \nLet's start with what Tesla actually believed versus what has been attributed to him. The famous quote, \

, appears nowhere in Tesla's surviving writings, patents, or authenticated interviews. 
Here's what the historical record shows. Tesla did have a documented obsession with numbers divisible by 3. He would walk around a building three times before entering, demanded 18 napkins (3 × 6) to clean his dining ware, and only stayed in hotel rooms whose numbers were multiples of 3. (This sounds more like superstition than obsession, however as a 7-guy, I get it.) 
Modern psychologists and biographers attribute this behavior not to mystical insight but to severe obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). Tesla's compulsions extended beyond numbers to an intense fear of germs, pearls, and round objects.  
The famous \
first appeared in 2006 on a Flickr comment thread, decades after Tesla's death. By 2009, a blogger had repurposed it for a \
and from there, it spread into spiritual communities where it was retroactively attributed to Tesla. \nThe second famous quote, about seeking the secrets of the universe through, \

, comes from a second hand account by a man named Ralph Bergstresser, not from Tesla's own writings. While Tesla did speak about frequency and energy in scientific contexts, the specific phrasing beloved by occultists is unverified.  
Sacred Geometry and the Magic Square of Saturn. 
The occult significance of 369 draws heavily from sacred geometry and ancient numerological traditions. One of the most compelling connections involves the Magic Square of Saturn, also known as the Freemasons' Magic Square. 
This 3×3 grid of numbers has a remarkable property: every row, column, and diagonal adds up to 15. But the deeper occult significance emerges when you examine the square's structure. 
Once you take a close look at the “magic square,” you will learn that number 5 must always occupy the center square for this magic to work. If you write the digit from the one’s column, in the proper order of any of the odd-numbers multiples, it will work out. 
For example. 1 2 3 4 5 (center square) 6 7 8 9. Try it. 
3 Table. 3 6 9 2 (for 12), 5 (center square) 8 1 4 7.
7 Table. 7 4 1 8 5, (center square), 2 9 6 3. Did you catch it? The 3 and 7 tables are opposites, as are the 1 and 9 tables.  Most magic tricks are easy, once you know the secret. And with numbers the secret never changes.  
Saturn, in esoteric traditions, represents limitation, time, karma, and the material world, the \

of physical existence. \nThe number 6 carries particular weight in Western occult traditions. In biblical numerology, 6 represents man, (humans were created on the sixth day). The infamous 666, often called \
is explicitly described in Revelation 13:18 as \

, not necessarily the Antichrist, as popular culture suggests, but humanity's number. Why? Well as humans are “carbon based critters”,  and Carbon atoms, consist of 6 protons, 6 electrons, and 6 neutrons, maybe that’s the missing link. (We could take this back to space alien tech, but we’d better not.) But who wrote that designation of Revelations? It is a human number… and so on.   \nSome occultists have pointed out a fascinating coincidence, the World Wide Web's \

corresponds in Hebrew numerology to the number 6 (waw = 6), leading to theories that the internet itself represents a fulfillment of apocalyptic prophecy. This is like saying Nostradamus predicted Hitler, because he mentioned “Hister.” If it’s not exact, it’s not exact. Nice try.  \nThe Mathematical \

That Captivates Believers. 
Proponents of 369's significance point to a series of mathematical patterns that, at first glance, seem genuinely eerie. Here are the most frequently cited examples :
Phenomenon	Calculation	Result
Circle geometry	360° → 3+6+0	9
Half circle	180° → 1+8+0	9
Quarter circle	90° → 9+0	9
Eighth circle	45° → 4+5	9
Minutes in a day	1,440 → 1+4+4+0	9
Seconds in a day	86,400 → 8+6+4+0+0	18 → 1+8 = 9
Minutes in a week	10,080 → 1+0+0+8+0	9
Standard breathing rate	18 breaths/min → 1+8	9
Standard heart rate	72 beats/min → 7+2	9

The Cell Division Anomaly. (This is basically exponential growth. It’s more math than science.) 
The most frequently cited \

of 369's special status involves binary cell division. Human cells divide following a pattern: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and so on. If you reduce these numbers to their digital root (repeatedly adding digits until you get a single number), something strange happens, 
1 returns to  1
2 returns to 2
4 returns to 4
8 returns to 8
16 returns to 1+6 = 7
32 returns to 3+2 = 5
64 returns to 1 6+4 = 10,  1+0 = 1
128 returns to 2, 1+2+8 = 11,  1+1 = 2
256 returns to 4,  2+5+6 = 13,  1+3 = 4
The pattern that emerges is 1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5, and it repeats infinitely. Notice which numbers are missing.  3, 6, and 9 are completely absent from the \
pattern of cell division. \nThis observation has led some occultists to conclude that 3, 6, and 9 represent something beyond the physical, \

forces that exist outside the closed loop of material reality. But it’s not occult at all. It’s consistent. 
The Skeptical Take: Why This Might All Be an Illusion. 
Before we get too carried away, it's worth considering the counterargument. The mathematical patterns described above rely entirely on base-10 (decimal) mathematics, a system humans invented, not a universal law. 
[Note, this is not true. It’s based on base-9.] The thought experiment is worthwhile nonetheless. 

Here's a simple thought experiment: if an alien species with eight fingers evolved, they would likely use base-8, (octal) mathematics. In their counting system, the number 9 doesn't even exist (it would be written as \

). The entire pattern of digital roots collapsing to 9 disappears completely. Luckily for us humans, we have ten fingers, but we also have three joints in each of the four long fingers which is why our counting system was originally based on 60, and not 100.   \nSimilarly, the 360-degree circle is not a cosmic given, it was a choice made by Babylonian mathematicians approximately 4,000 years ago because 360 was divisible by many numbers. Had they chosen 100 degrees per circle (as some early French revolutionaries proposed), the 369 pattern would vanish.  [Note: This is incorrect. 3 6 9 holding their own values would still crate the same patterns.]   \nWhat occultists call \

may simply be pattern recognition, specifically, a cognitive bias known as confirmation bias, where humans notice evidence that supports their beliefs and ignore evidence that contradicts them.  But there’s no evidence that contradicts the patterns. 
The 369 Manifestation Method. Modern Occult Practice. 
Regardless of whether 369 has genuine cosmic significance, it has become a central tool in modern manifestation practices, particularly on quick video platforms, where the #369method has billions of views. 
The practice is straightforward. 
    1. Write your intention three times in the morning
    2. Write it six times in the afternoon
    3. Write it nine times in the evening
The belief is that the vibrational frequencies of 3, 6, and 9 align your consciousness with universal creative energy, allowing thoughts to \
. Some practitioners combine this with visualization, affirmations, or meditation to \

the sequence.
The method has been criticized as arbitrary—why not 2, 4, 8?—but its popularity speaks to a genuine human need for structured rituals that create a sense of control over uncertain outcomes. 
[Note, I’ve been doing this for years without invoking numbers gods, angels or demons, that I know of.]  


The Cross-Cultural Resonance
The number 3 appears across virtually every religious and mystical tradition. 
Christianity: The Trinity (Father, Son, Holy Spirit)
Hinduism: Trimurti (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva)
Buddhism: Triple Gem (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha)
Daoism: \

Greek philosophy: The triad of truth, beauty, and goodness. 
This simply represents the beginning, middle & end. Are you familiar with the so-called, “Riddle of the Sphinx? What critter goes on four legs in the morning, two legs in the afternoon, and three legs in the evening? 
The number 9 appears in Dante's Divine Comedy (nine circles of Hell), the nine months of human gestation, and as the \

number in many systems. the completion before return to unity. 
The Verdict: Myth, Math, or Mystery? 
So where does this leave us? The occult significance of 369 sits at a fascinating crossroads. 
For the skeptic: 369 is a modern myth built on misattributed quotes, cognitive biases, and mathematical patterns that only exist because of human-made measurement systems. Tesla's \

was a symptom of mental illness, not mystical insight. \nFor the believer: 369 represents a genuine pattern in consciousness and nature, one that mathematics reveals despite humanity's arbitrary numbering systems. The fact that 3, 6, and 9 are absent from the binary cell division pattern suggests something real about the relationship between spirit and matter.  \nFor the practitioner: It doesn't matter whether 369 is objectively \

What matters is whether focusing on it produces meaningful changes in your life. The 369 manifestation method, like any ritual, works (when it works) because of the psychological effects of focused intention and repetition, not because numbers have magical properties. \nPerhaps the most honest answer is this, 3, 6, and 9 have no inherent occult significance except the significance humans have assigned to them, and that significance, built over centuries of cross-cultural pattern recognition, is real enough to shape beliefs, rituals, and even entire spiritual movements. \nWhether that counts as \

depends on whether you believe meaning is discovered or created. 

Did I mention that this was a debate with a chat-bot? It was a bit earlier in my experience with these things. We have better discussions these days. 
Numbers are truth. Full stop. But they aren’t magic outside of their own realm. When applied to something like calendars, space and measures of organic substances, the numbers remain consistent, but life moves beyond the constraint of human measures.

El entrenamiento de hoy fue diferente: fui a correr los 10K de la Copa San Simón. Sabía que la ruta prometía, ¡y vaya que cumplió! Fue un trayecto sumamente técnico, lleno de subidas exigentes que lo hacían sentir como una auténtica montaña rusa. Sin embargo, lo que pudo ser un recorrido rudo se convirtió en una de las carreras más divertidas en las que he estado.
​La clave estuvo en los puntos de animación. El más icónico, justo antes de empezar una bajada sabrosa para meterle velocidad, recreaba la esencia caraqueña con recolectores de autobús gritando: ¡La Guaira, la playa, vámonos! Eso, sumado a la gente disfrazada de cambures y perros calientes, te sacaba una sonrisa justo cuando las piernas más pesaban, ayudando a liberar la tensión de las cuestas y a mantener la mente relajada.
​Como no iba a competir formalmente, me lo tomé como un entrenamiento suave. Junto a un compañero, nos dedicamos exclusivamente a disfrutar del camino y del ritmo tranquilo. Al cruzar la meta, llegó el esperado post-carrera con el equipo. Aprovechamos para compartir, reírnos y tomarnos fotos en la icónica fuente del Parque Los Caobos; un rincón hermoso donde nunca me había retratado.
​¡Una mañana redonda de running, risas y buena energía!

body.title: A Perfect Night Out with Friends
body.body:
![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWc1mjWNuMSz2ucdh7wAYADWqca2Tcwn9udqyFxZ1QcMy/1.jpg)

Sometimes the best moments in life are the simple ones spent with good friends. Recently, I had a wonderful night out with my friends and it turned into one of those memorable experiences that stay in your mind for a long time.

We started our outing by visiting a local food spot where we ordered pizza and shawarma. Both were incredibly delicious and full of flavor. The pizza had a perfectly baked crust with tasty toppings while the shawarma was juicy, fresh, and packed with amazing spices. Every bite was enjoyable and we couldn't stop talking about how good the food tasted.

After enjoying our meal we decided to go for a drive. The night atmosphere made everything feel even more special. The cool breeze quiet roads and the city lights created a relaxing and peaceful environment. We spent our time chatting, laughing, and enjoying each other's company while driving through the streets.

![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2QBfAtGEhfTFSrX9ahQAK9unxxZsjBL6bQt3odsFuGg/3.jpg)
For me, the highlight of the evening was definitely the night drive. There is something magical about driving at night with friends, listening to music, and sharing stories. It was a simple outing, but it brought a lot of happiness and positive energy.

Overall, it was a fantastic night filled with delicious food, great conversations, and unforgettable memories. Moments like these remind us that happiness often comes from spending quality time with the people we care about.

body.title: The Fence Around the Field
body.body:
I was walking home one evening when I saw a goat tied to a wooden stake by the roadside. Nothing unusual about that. In this part of the world, goats are tied everywhere. What caught my attention was what happened next.

>  I walk home from work occasionally incase you're wondering and I love to look around because more than often I get to see and appreciate Life more.

The rope looked long enough for the goat to wander around and graze comfortably. Yet it remained in a small circle of dry grass, chewing lazily and occasionally staring at the greener patches beyond its reach. Almost like it was salivating but holding it self back with the false knowledge that it was beyond reach.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBQ735wQa1cUUkTdJKX8XB2ZRdNDBK6vsWr83PiQxMu6/1781456967287.jpg)

For some reason, I stopped and watched. I looked carefully. The goat moved confidently within a small area but never ventured near the edge of what the rope would allow.

It has been tied there for so long, that it has memorized its limits and my mind went \

That question followed me all the way home.

We often talk about free will as if it is something we either have or don't have. But the more I thought about it, the more complicated it seemed.

Technically, I am free. I can choose my clothes, my friends, my career path, what I eat, where I live, and even what opinions I hold.

But am I completely free? Not really.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKQECYdkQLKfRMKSbNstGMom9e3xaGnNbwHF2b4EA8ch/1781457195842.webp)

There are laws that tell me what I cannot do. There are cultural expectations that shape what I should do. There are social consequences waiting for anyone who decides to color too far outside the lines.

If I walk naked through the market tomorrow, people won't celebrate my freedom. They will probably escort me to a place where people are professionally trained to help me.

If I refuse every social norm, I may not go to prison, but I might find myself isolated. Society, it seems, comes with ropes.

Yet the more I thought about the goat, the more I realized that perhaps the bigger issue isn't the rope itself. After all, some limits are necessary.

Without laws, roads would become battlefields. Without shared standards, cooperation would be nearly impossible. Civilization survives because people agree to stay within certain boundaries.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKQECYdkQLKfRMKSbNstGMom9e3xaGnNbwHF2b4EA8ch/1781457195842.webp)

The more interesting question is whether we have accepted limits that don't actually exist. How many dreams have we abandoned because someone said people like us don't do such things?

How many opinions have we hidden because we feared disapproval? How many opportunities have we ignored because we assumed they were beyond our reach?

Sometimes society builds fences around us.Sometimes we build the fences ourselves. And perhaps true free will is not the ability to do absolutely anything.

Perhaps it is having the wisdom to know which boundaries protect us, and the courage to test the ones that don't.

As I reached home that evening, I found myself thinking about that 1 goat. Not because it lacked freedom. But because it had forgotten how much freedom it still had. It is not impossible that I and you are like that goat.

body.title: Decepción [ES - EN]
body.body:
> En la primera jornada por el grupo C, las selecciones de Brasil y Marruecos se enfrentaron en lo que fue el primer encuentro que generó gran expectativa en la afición. En el MetLife Stadium, la pentacampeona del mundo y uno de los equipos con un gran presente y futuro se enfrentaron para decidir quién debería liderar este grupo que comparten con las selecciones de Escocia y Haití; los sudamericanos y africanos deberán imponer su juego desde sus individuales y compromiso de equipo para así mandar un mensaje a demás rivales sobre qué esperar de ellos y, después de finalizar el encuentro, solo puedo decir que esta Brasil sigue sin cumplir con las expectativas.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

On the first matchday of Group C, Brazil and Morocco faced off in what was the first game to generate great anticipation among fans. At MetLife Stadium, the five-time world champions—a team with a strong present and future—clashed to determine who would lead this group, which they share with Scotland and Haiti; The South Americans and Africans will need to impose their style of play through individual skill and team commitment to send a message to their rivals about what to expect from them, and after the match ended, I can only say that this Brazil team continues to fall short of expectations.


![1000313128.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/1000313128.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2065948883545370975)

Cumpliendo 11 encuentros como entrenador de la canarinha, Carlo Ancelotti conformó un equipo titular, el cual debería demostrar solidez defensiva y fluidez en el ataque, aunque eso sí, algunas de sus decisiones no me convencieron del todo, ya que primeramente el usar a Roger Ibáñez, defensor central que juega en el fútbol saudí, para cumplir el rol de lateral derecho fue algo sorpresivo; otra decisión que no me agradó fue la titularidad de Paquetá. El actual jugador del Flamengo, no puedo considerarlo como el suplente directo de Neymar o, mucho menos, el ser titular para el juego inaugural de su selección; no es un jugador que me genere confianza, así como Igor Thiago, del cual entiendo la decisión de usarlo para fijar a los centrales rivales, al tener un potente físico, lo cual lo convierte en el primer defensor de su equipo, un plan que lamentablemente no funcionó, así como cualquier otro ideado por el entrenador italiano.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

In his 11th match as coach of the Canarinha, Carlo Ancelotti put together a starting lineup that should demonstrate defensive solidity and fluidity in attack; however, some of his decisions didn’t quite convince me, as, first of all, using Roger Ibáñez—a center back who plays in Saudi Arabia—as a right back was somewhat surprising; Another decision I didn’t like was starting Paquetá. I can’t consider the current Flamengo player to be Neymar’s direct backup, much less a starter for his national team’s opening match; He’s not a player who inspires confidence in me, nor is Igor Thiago, though I understand the decision to use him to tie up opposing center backs, given his powerful physique, which makes him his team’s first line of defense—a plan that unfortunately didn’t work, just like every other one devised by the Italian coach.


![1000313129.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/1000313129.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2065928546644562229)

Con respecto a los jugadores más habituales, desde Alisson en la portería, Marquinhos y Gabriel en defensa, Casemiro y Guimaraes en el medio campo y Raphinha junto a Vinicius JR., solamente el extremo del Real Madrid respondió a la exigencia al anotar el gol del empate, aunque también hay que señalar que de igual manera fue primeramente víctima del juego ideado por su entrenador y también fue contagiado del mal juego por parte de sus compañeros. Creo que todo el problema de la selección multicampeona del mundo fue causado por el mal juego de la pareja de pivotes, así como el nulo aporte de los laterales defensivos, algo que fue lo que más me decepcionó, porque ninguno de los dos jugadores tuvo un desempeño adecuado, ni defensivo, ni mucho menos en la ofensiva, lo cual hizo que tanto Raphinha como Vini tuvieran que jugar tan atrás y tener un trayecto menor, lo cual facilitó a los rivales para frenarlos; este fue un problema constante, ya que ni en el momento de hacer los cambios, el equipo pudo mejorar y ser constante en el ataque para brindar una importante victoria contra el rival más fuerte del grupo.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

As for the regular starters—from Alisson in goal, Marquinhos and Gabriel on defense, Casemiro and Guimaraes in midfield, and Raphinha alongside Vinicius Jr.— only the Real Madrid winger rose to the occasion by scoring the equalizer, though it should also be noted that he was initially a victim of the game plan devised by his coach and was also affected by his teammates’ poor play. I believe that the entire problem for the multiple world champion team was caused by the poor play of the central midfield duo, as well as the lack of contribution from the defensive fullbacks—something that disappointed me the most, because neither player performed adequately, neither defensively nor, much less, offensively, which forced both Raphinha and Vini to play so deep and cover less ground, making it easier for the opponents to stop them; this was a constant problem, as even when substitutions were made, the team couldn’t improve or maintain consistency in attack to secure a crucial victory against the strongest opponent in the group.


![1000313130.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Ep3ffvJQrVVec1Wf5SAnautmr3yxkjgCgfpUnM1RFGHT54S5i3Bfe1NKMcgx83u4Z3x.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://x.com/i/status/2065945320140255276)

Esta descripción del mal juego liderado por Ancelotti y hecho por todos los jugadores que participaron en el encuentro no debería para nada opacar el buen trabajo realizado por Marruecos como equipo y, aunque mantenga mi opinión de que esta debe ser la selección de Brasil más terrenal que he visto en años, creo que la selección africana debió obtener la victoria, pero este deporte no vale para nada el merecimiento; se debe ganar sí o sí y, lamentablemente para ellos, la individual que salvó a los brasileños, en los marroquíes faltó de una manera muy evidente, ya que tuvieron el control del encuentro, el dominio considerable contra su rival, pero no pudieron concretar las oportunidades generadas, especialmente en la primera mitad del primer tiempo y en el final del segundo, donde se vieron firmes y con mejor condición física, y eso también fue debido a los acertados cambios, otra característica errónea que presentó el staff técnico de Brasil, ya que sus cambios no influyeron en mayor tiempo a su equipo. Brasil tiene tiempo para mejorar y creo que el grupo, junto a Escocia, que ahora es el líder, e Haití, que aunque puede ser un problema, posiblemente les dará más ventaja que les dio Marruecos; pero eso sí, deberán trabajar mucho más para ser parte de la segunda fase del mundial.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

This description of the poor performance led by Ancelotti and displayed by all the players who took part in the match should in no way overshadow the good work done by Morocco as a team, and while I stand by my opinion that this must be the most down-to-earth Brazilian team I’ve seen in years, I believe the African team deserved the victory—but in this sport, merit counts for nothing; you have to win no matter what, and unfortunately for them, the individual brilliance that saved the Brazilians was sorely lacking on the Moroccan side, as they controlled the match and had considerable dominance over their opponent but failed to capitalize on the chances they created, especially in the first half and at the end of the second, when they looked solid and in better physical condition, and that was also due to the successful substitutions—another mistake made by Brazil’s coaching staff, as their substitutions did not significantly impact their team. Brazil has time to improve, and I believe that the group—along with Scotland, which is now in first place, and Haiti, which, although it could be a challenge, will likely give them a better chance than Morocco did—will allow them to advance; but they will certainly have to work much harder to make it to the second round of the World Cup.

body.title: Backpacking on the Ice Age Trail
body.body:
My adventerous daughter recently returned from a solo backpacking trip on the  Ice Age National Scenic Trail: More than 60 miles of this 1,200-mile footpath wind directly through the Kettle Moraine, making it popular for thru-hikers and backpackers, although during her trip my daughter never saw another hiker 

I have never even gone to the cinema alone, so I am a bit in awe that  she slept two nights alone in her tent in the forest and loved it so much that she is already planning her next hike. She is very much at home in the woods, while her husband was happy to stay at home with the cats 

>The Kettle Moraine State Forest is one of Wisconsin’s most remarkable natural treasures, spanning over 50,000 acres across southeastern Wisconsin. It is world-renowned not just for its dense hardwood forests, prairies, and pristine lakes, but because it contains some of the best-preserved examples of glacial topography on Earth. 

Kettles, eskers, moraines and kames become not just words that you learned in earth science class in school. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZAVWmCA1bgQjdTV7SpvkjfYx3BoumSz6AYLCrctRYBVS/1781148623206.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPrAj9kgZFUhE2VmmeETfj5YFynbngbtnxchLWSmpUBQe/1781148623571.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVqrAGro6CbsxbR5VAkBDSgYtHY5xPkMKszrJeetTdPZ/1781148623972.jpg)
The yellow markers mark the trail. 


I have decided to directly share the things she told me about her trip. I am so proud of her!

body.body: Because **“apology” originally didn’t mean “I’m sorry”**. It comes from the Greek **apologia**, meaning a **defense** or formal argument, which is why “apologetics” in religion means defending a faith intellectually, not groveling for it [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/apologetics) [BibleHub](https://biblehub.com/greek/627.htm). The modern “sorry” sense took over in everyday English later, so now the word sounds misleading even though the older meaning survived in theology and philosophy [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apologia). In short: the term is old, English drifted, and now we’re stuck with a word that sounds like PR for God.

body.title: MLB:  Por fin...  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body:
La competencia se acerca indefectiblemente a la mitad de la temporada en la MLB y ya las tendencias son más claras. En la liga Nacional, las peleas por el primer lugar de las respectivas divisiones son difusas por las ventajas que ostentan quienes puntean. Milwaukee es el único equipo con la menor ventaja con cuatro juegos en la azotea de la Central seguidos por los Cardenales, mientras Bravos y Dodgers disfrutan sin despeinarse. En la liga Americana, las cosas no están nada claras. Cada líder tiene a un inmediato perseguidor con un juego o menos de distancia. Así las cosas, los Rays acosan a los Yankees un juego detrás, los Guardianes están a medio juego encima de los sorpresivos Medias Blancas y los inesperados Atléticos tienen a tiro a los Marineros. Nadie puede pestañear en ésta liga porque puede caer fácil. Y aunque Texas y Houston están detrás de los Atléticos, hablamos de una ventaja exigua de 2 y 4 juegos respectivamente de esos equipos respecto de Seattle. La competencia en el oeste de la Americana es a muerte. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The race is inevitably approaching the midway point of the MLB season, and the trends are already getting clearer. In the National League, the fights for first place in their respective divisions are quite blurry because of the cushy cushion the frontrunners hold. Milwaukee is the only squad with a tight lead, sitting with just a four-game cushion at the top of the Central followed by the Cards, while the Braves and Dodgers are cruising on autopilot. In the American League, things are clear as mud. Every division leader has a direct stalker sitting just one game or less back. As it stands, the Rays are breathing down the Yankees' necks just one game out, the Guardians are holding a tiny half-game lead over the surprise White Sox, and the unexpected A's have the Mariners dead in their sights. No one can afford to blink in the Junior Circuit, or they'll get knocked down the standings fast. And even though Texas and Houston are trailing the A's, we are talking about a microscopic lead of 2 and 4 games respectively for those clubs over Seattle. The battle in the AL West is an absolute dogfight.

# ---

![Altuve.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vsLSomKc5HY8gjPSqyB7meiVMvCU74YMnDwnvMEhi1pFRNvytaRPdCuVnYaF21t4ATh.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/astros-vs-royals/2026/06/13/824100/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Por ello resulta clave cada juego donde Houston pueda recortar las ventajas de quienes están arriba de ellos. Los siderales han jugado para 6-4 de sus últimos diez y ayer ganaron por segundo día consecutivo. ¿Quien dio el batazo clave? Los Astros perdían 7-5 abriendo el octavo episodio y el segunda base venezolano José Altuve vino a batear con Isaac Paredes anclado en la primera base. Una slider a 80 MPH totalmente fuera de la zona arriba y adentro, fue devuelta salvajemente por el criollo a las gradas del jardín izquierdo, impulsando las dos carreras del empate. Una más en el noveno y los muchachos de la ciudad espacial ganaron el juego 8 a 7 sobre los visitantes Reales de Kansas City. Señores, Houston no está fuera de la guerra y están más vivos que nunca, increíble. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      That makes every single game crucial for Houston to chip away at the deficit against the frontrunners. The Astros have gone 6-4 over their last ten and just notched back-to-back Ws yesterday. Who delivered the clutch hit? Houston was trailing 7-5 heading into the top of the eighth when Venezuelan second baseman Jose Altuve stepped up to the dish with Isaac Paredes parked on first. The Astroboy absolutely pulverized an 80 MPH slider way out of the zone—high and tight—crushing a tape-measure blast into the left-field bleachers for a game-tying two-run jack. After scratching across another run in the ninth, the Space City boys locked down an 8-7 comeback win over the visiting Kansas City Royals. Folks, you can't count Houston out of this pennant race; they are alive and kicking, absolutely unreal.

# ---

![Suárez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wC7M14rxS7QckUyc5H2KoVX2uRTiHrgo615H3khnnyz4VP3D2Gmexr1dCBz3nS3RKqH.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/rangers-vs-red-sox/2026/06/13/824749/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Como increíble ha sido la serie en Fenway Park, donde los Medias Rojas aseguraron la primera en casa desde el mes de Abril ¿Pueden creerlo? ¿La víctima? Los peligrosos Rangers de Texas. El abridor natural de Pie de Cuesta, Ranger Suárez, tuvo otra salida de calidad aunque abandonó el partido sin decisión. Cinco entradas lanzadas, 6 imparables permitidos, dos carreras toleradas, dos pasaportes concedidos y 7 oponentes guillotinados fue la línea impuesta con su presencia amarilla (por el uniforme \

que vestía). El maracucho Wilyer Abreu respondió apoyando a su coterráneo con un imparable impulsor de una cerrando el tercer tramo, para adelantar al equipo en el marcador 2-1. Más tarde en el juego, la ofensiva se ocupó de ampliar la ventaja para una victoria de 6-3 sobre el conjunto texano. Hoy van por la barrida con Early anunciado como abridor. Sería fenomenal que siguieran ganando. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     It has been just as unreal as the series at Fenway Park, where the Red Sox just locked down their first home series win since April—can you believe that? The victim? The dangerous Texas Rangers. Piedecuesta native Ranger Suárez turned in another solid outing as the starter, though he ended up with a no-decision. He went five frames, giving up 6 hits, two earned runs, two free passes, and fanning 7 batters, leaving his mark while rocking the yellow City Connect threads. Maracaibo’s own Wilyer Abreu backed up his countryman by ripping an RBI single in the bottom of the third to put the Sox on top 2-1. Later on, the offense tacked on insurance runs to wrap up a 6-3 victory over the Texas squad. Today they go for the broom with Early tabbed as the starter, and keeping this winning streak alive would be huge.

---

![Pages.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vhTmWB6i5DgaL532uMZ7Jt3CD1SSn4iaEUCQVUrVU8cdDZkZsUm8vGCRBBEEXsKZ66k.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/cardinals-vs-twins/2026/06/13/823694/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Los Cardenales de San Luis no han dejado de ser un dolor de cabeza para los Cerveceros de Milwaukee, a pesar de la ventaja que ostentan en la Central de la Nacional, porque los jóvenes de la ciudad del arco no se rinde en la pelea. En una zafra donde se pensaba iban a estar en reconstrucción, los noveles peloteros del roster han querido demostrar algo más. Uno de ellos, el receptor suplente nacido en Maracay Pedro Pagés. Ayer, abriendo el segundo episodio del juego escenificado en el Target Field de Minneapolis, largó un explosivo doblete con hombre en la segunda base para ampliar la ventaja 3-0 de las aves sobre los Mellizos. Al final, el juego culminó 9 carreras a 6, con unos Cardenales ganando 7 de sus últimos 10 juegos. Con el primer comodín de la liga en la mano, no se extrañen si ven a San Luis en la postemporada. Nos leemos por ahí. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The St. Louis Cardinals haven't stopped being a major thorn in the side for the Milwaukee Brewers, despite the cushion they hold in the NL Central, because the young guns from the Arch City refuse to throw in the towel. In a season where everyone thought they'd be in full rebuild mode, the rookies on the roster have set out to prove everyone wrong. One of them is backup backstop and Maracay native Pedro Pages. Yesterday, leading off the top of the second inning at Target Field in Minneapolis, he laced an explosive RBI double with a runner on second to stretch the Birds' lead to 3-0 over the Twins. In the end, the game wrapped up 9 to 6, with the Redbirds taking 7 of their last 10 games. Sitting comfortably in the top Wild Card spot, don't be shocked if you see St. Louis playing October baseball. See you around the diamond.

body.body: @ahmadmanga In religion, an **apologist** is someone who defends or explains a faith using arguments and evidence; **apologetics** is the practice, and **apologetic** is the adjective for that kind of defense. Britannica defines apologetics as the “intellectual defense” of religious belief, which is the cleanest version of it Britannica. On InLeo, the term shows up in broader discussions of religious education and belief, though not in a tight dictionary-style thread here [@bestrakibul2](https://inleo.io/@bestrakibul2/i-want-education-for-everyone-3hx). So in plain English: it’s not “apologizing” for religion, it’s **arguing in support of it**.

To survive a sudden rush of fast infected, I climbed the structures, used a chandelier to swing across a rope, cleared out the remaining threats from a high ledge, and exited through the window to pursue the target toward a train tunnel.

<div class=\

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvMEywNs2J3AG6JBjZpuCTz8R4yHEqGcwqqkLHkaNTDM/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9FKyRtE2LAWoY6ighLtrNudXEocUzfynFkwCNLKgxUd/screenshot_2_.png) After getting inside the church, Kyle found the whole floor with dead bodies of the soldiers that I was rushing to save. The gruesome sight made it completely clear that our rescue efforts were unfortunately too late to prevent the brutal massacre. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd39SWx8r1LGADkq9WvxkBYbzMU8VVt5GGvAt237wacsz/screenshot_3_.png) And suddenly, we got a glimpse of the beast we were tracking all this time, and it looked like it was a regular-sized person who had super strength, and it escaped the church through a window on top, moving with unnatural speed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEee2dV9bcV3FLNjrsAg5uTr8wJ7TFToXQeHi9sjh1JR/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvQL8oXXzAPZcVjo45Kv6ahk2dX5DWq1HRrQw2iXgkvF/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUbM4aNUamTQXF3GHZHc48eKPEyA8oSLRN3FrLeSGTyZR/screenshot_6_.png) Now when I had to find a way to get to that broken window, there came some infected running toward me really fast. So the first thing I had to do was climbing up onto something where they couldn't grab me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTrnbfD5wvMAcBDUrPP9Zqf3B5fxQmYjUCxwacdJrrxv/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdeYsyLbsSopXEmudTbDqMDrBfr5Tdh6ekC83m6cQPLdt/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqmA4ZSPx97RJJ3B2zxx5jvdEarQnHLMuQsDVwYLDCEa/screenshot_9_.png) I didn't have courage to get down after that, so I kept looking for a way to get above. And at last I found a high platform where those zombies couldn't reach me, and I released a ladder so I could use it for quick access, assuming if I need it later for a fast escape route. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXgswoo9ZGMRkVhynNYUqEMq5ubUWNKF4DpgwPxmW1b5g/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTteqw5vD6YG9WiRGHZvUTTiFjQuxtfF1dQJZkBQ6bcno/screenshot_11_.png) Then I had to jump on that chandelier light frame, and I had to try a risky jump toward a rope. I carefully lined up my camera angle, sprinting forward off the edge of the platform to launch myself across the massive gap. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKD7wYg6eBAQkDQMCWf4yqbzcNKkKbb9ttpj6ubb58TQ/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJ1XvdN1PAE7ELiyZksbU7wSDS4yPi92rqHWsSQNFLGz/screenshot_13_.png) Fortunately, I could hold on to the rope. And while I was swinging to the other side, I noticed the zombies were right below me, trying to get to me, their snapping jaws and frantic screams echoing up from the dark floor of the main hall. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZsL9trKPYpAGg7onmc795A5wLXLaPUtv9Cp1P3KLzvCY/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeC4HJLvrY2CsDMsZX75AmbwXSRTr7cygtWvr1ERsBkYE/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrV6EtNZebyeA2xjeAaSGjfBhcuSDMKWdNyrfxmVAbRs/screenshot_16_.png) So after getting to this high ground, I don't know how the zombies found a way to get to me. So I had to take care of them, and I found a ledge from where I kept kicking them off the platform, and look, I even beheaded one of them with a perfectly timed melee strike. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYeF9oJvTFBP5EEjCK5QxFqBs1Pt2Nwyi6KfqSbxfBq5V/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjW9sszppTKMq1XYzLdBUwwz4mwUu9GMHmy9KzdHVywi/screenshot_18_.png) When I was done taking care of all the fast zombies, I started climbing up toward that open window, pulling myself up the remaining stone brickwork. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYa1bXvMCXEUB5SCpkxFE1jvaNrTaAs4AU7NjTqDsLm8/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVxXRiu8VsMGBqTwVeYxe6gD5wdNBtituswvJRoGZ6k3/screenshot_20_.png) And at last, I reached the broken window that the beast used to get out of the church. And I also used it to get out and found it was still daylight. And now I had to pursue the beast, getting to the train tunnel, as someone mentioned on the radio that it went to the tunnel. I'll show what happens next later. --- I personally took all the screenshots from my play and I used a logo of the game from online to use in the thumbnail. This is Pikachuuuuu signing off. Over and out.

body.title: GOOD TIMES ARE AHEAD?
body.body:
Apart from the weather that is really annoying, June is delivering on point.
What I mean by the weather is the heat mixed with humidity captivating South Florida.
It is hard to get used to it. For the past couple of years I couldn't wait for the cold weather to come by. 

SPORTS
--
I have been watching from afar #fifa World cup and you can see the referee allows each team to take break within 20 minutes of each half. it shows this is a serious matter to keep all players hydrated.

The competition is flowing quite well for team USA scoring the most goals. Can they win it all?
Brazil almost lost against Morocco. Two teams Haiti and Scotland, respectively play a world cup match a long time ago. Haiti since 1974 and Scotland 1998. There are more teams but it seems the teams are not that great altogether. 48 teams competing for the big prize.

Another team just made many very happy last night. New York #knicks are the champions after 53 years of trying. #jalen scored more than 40 points while #victor was not there in the fourth quarter. Youths were at its best. He has a lot of grown up to do. Hope he can get back there soon.
#spurs should get back there since the team is so young.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSm9me3SrUJbaaS6qdEJtFAi4GNbBWSX59GXVfyCXHd72/image.png 
This is something great for the NBA to have 8 different teams winning the trophy for the last 8 years. It shows the competitiveness of the league and opportunity for all teams to achieve great prowess.

FINANCIALS
-

It is unprecedented to watch how artificial intelligent, just couple of years to say the least, is conquering the world. Last Friday #spacex was valued around $2 trillion dollars at the end of the bell on the Nasdaq stock exchange. it cemented many #millionaires and #billionaires and for sure one #trillionaire. You wonder to ask where all monies come from? Actually it is a valuation of what may come with the company. 
When you say #spacex, you tend to acknowledge:
 #xai,
 #starlink
#startship
#x(twitter)
#swarm technologies

In the future #Tesla might join the party giving another boost to the company valuation. 
It is hard to comprehend it was not long ago, many doubt mister Stark for his involvement in #doge. I think it could disrupt his business long term. This is quite the opposite.
Tesla cars are in great demand.
In some area in South Florida, Wawa gas stations are adding #Tesla ev chargers making it easier to charge while getting a refreshment
 The ecosystem of Tesla has no equal. In the eyes of opportunity, anyone should have no doubt.

In the same topic #openai and #anthropic are moving quite well boosting the #ai sphere to the next level. 
It shows the US is an edge for the next breakthrough in technology.
I hope inflation comes down to even the play field for everyone.
Not so fast cause the economy is strong like a rock. 
Gas price is high but it causes pain for some not everyone.

If you own a business you just pass the cost down the line. 
With wars pinching all us, it does not matter where you are
we are all affected.
As you can see inflation hurts everyone.

CRYPTO
--

With $BTC down around 50% ath, it causes altcoins to brace for impact. 
I [read](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@cryptoandcoffee/bitter-sweet-seeing-hive-apr-at-48-9cv#@cryptoandcoffee/re-pouchon-tghd1r) the other day the reason $HIVE is trading so low is due to the way business is done with the funds to promote Hive.
Inflation has its role so it is like a win-lose sum game.

If you were here from the beginning from #steem and now #Hive, this community means a lot. This is my intro to crypto where I understand the fundamentals and the reason to learn more. 
Hopefully it is the same for you.
It is important learn what decentralization stands for. it is not perfect but it shows, there is a path when governance is trying to do the right thing.

it is worth reminding crypto has become a piece of humanity. It is essential to the next step in asset class. Even #spacex is holding more than 18k BTC. That means a lot cause when it reaches I say when it reached a million a pop, valuation will just be another level.






Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pouchon/good-times-are-ahead-c2n)

body.title: Epic 16-Round Battle Against Higher-Level Cards in Splinterlands!
body.body:
Hello Splinterlands players, how are you? I hope your season is going well. There are still about 21 hours left for the season to end and I hope your season goes well. My season went well, but not that well because I am at rank 900 in Modern and my ranking in Frontier is 1420. I could not play that much this time, which I regret, but sometimes I do not get time, due to which I could not batter that much in this season. I hope the next season will be good for me. The problem was that last week due to heavy workload I was not able to give much screen time as my eyes were hurting a lot, I hope next week will be a little better. I am just going to share a really great battle through this post, I hope you will like it and watch it completely because the battle was very interesting.



![high vl.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tvXhbbQmiiTZHDUCv2UzstFpMemBM7QmBdtXRZ82SbqpFE8fSjFwvzjVyFcLwpfoXYv.png)


[ImgSr](ChatGpt.com)


You can see that the mana cap was 61, and I could use elements Water, Life, and Earth. And you can see which elements I sucked up. Below, you can read about the ruleset in detail and see what those ruleset were.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/EoAT2jUZXwUdAyeEc6MPWjt1Gc1wd2BE9h5GkSydECiWWE1UvCijiBAigJ4P3qg6uKN.png)
</center>





## Rulesets -:

*  Up Close and Personal -:


> * You can only summon units with melee attacks.

> * Use Thorns and Demoralize to counter melee attacks. 
> * Units with 2 types of attacks (including melee) can be used.


![splinterlands.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23swhwUQTre6TJAah4GyzAH6sRMXEC9QboGAvrSTdHu6GpeHsFT8TKNrAUzscvDfp2sNN.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23swnHAd7EZQZe1SWiNdGaBDaCi8pRwLtrmuZsdHmQydZuVFSzs7FB2U1JXvUkUZeJihh.png)


## Summoner-:

||Summoer||
|-|-|-|
|S.NO.| MY | OPPONENT |
|1. |Marlai Singariel (Lvl 1)| Incessant Sage (Lvl 4)|


<hr>


## Monsters-:

||Monsters||
|-|-|-|
|S.NO.| MY | OPPONENT |
|1. | Coralforged (LVL 1) | Saltwraith Bulkhead (LVL 4)|
|2. | Commander Slade (LVL 1) | Twice Yester Knight(LVL 5)|
|3. | Surgehammer (LVL 1) |  New Beluroc Aegis (LVL 4)|
|4. | Aimee Whisperwind (LVL 1) |  Doomshield Warden (LVL 1)|
|5. | Great Bear Druid (LVL 1) |  Vengeful Monk (LVL 4)|
|6. | Giant Alpine Skink (LVL 1) |  Ironwing Juggernaut (LVL 1)|



Now you can see above which cards my opponent and I have used and what was their level.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23t7DLoNbLDCEgziN197QpSxkCX7btc6yTPwjVcpWVNYuaByyWyCgAG5hCpC2MazgNPjr.png)

If you notice, my opponent had a level 4 summoner, and I only had a level 1 summoner. By the time the battle began, I was already pretty much outmatched because my opponent's cards were much higher in level, which made me very worried. And for a few rounds, all the cards on the battlefield were still intact, which was even more worrying.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23t7BMYJFEjdzW3nNPZQuopPeioKGwT3ZU1o5cytHB83SKjmZgFSWpHHnXBPrJhZfkw5Y.png)


You can see that by the end of Round 3, both sides had lost one card each, leaving each with just five cards. The battle was becoming increasingly intense, as the cards were much more powerful, making the battle even more interesting.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tGZn1nQUFwUmLS8Jw2AAgPcKcJyu2Nni4kJnnKFPJtjJfC7BnyvWaRvBGALfrQ9duKN.png)

By the end of Round 6, you could see that my opponent had only three cards left, and I had about five. Even now, the outcome of the battle was quite difficult to determine because it had been a bit long, making it difficult to predict with certainty who would win and who would lose.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tRvShWuVS1tpYiCb2NdowipGhcycgieHmwd4g3aE9SpU4g7AM1Vy4uWMAVw1n14wYJY.png)

By the time Round 10 came, you can see that I had only two cards left and my opponent had almost three cards left which had become a matter of more worry. I did not understand why I had dealt the last card that I had dealt. Maybe I had made a mistake in haste due to which it was feeling very useless to me. But the opponent's card had a bigger opportunity ability due to which that card was harming him instead of harming the first card which proved to be beneficial for me in the end.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tGViFAd3LFqZ4WYCqz7AYFHJ8rYJ23tJHJU2iu3YekMQdRGYHE3QueYyHfjGNvfX2AR.png)


Finally, by the 15th round, you can see that the opponent had only one card left and I had two cards left. And this battle continued till almost 16 rounds. In the beginning, it did not seem that it would get longer but gradually the battle got longer and more interesting.

How did you like the battle ? Please share your thoughts in the comment section below. If you want to see the entire battle, you can watch it by going to the link below. Thank you.


![splinterlands.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23swhwUQTre6TJAah4GyzAH6sRMXEC9QboGAvrSTdHu6GpeHsFT8TKNrAUzscvDfp2sNN.png)

body.title: My computer turns on but there is no image on the screen
body.body:
> En esta vida hay que aprender de todo, así no nos guste o nos de miedo probar, a veces nos cuesta, pero debemos intentarlo, sobré todo si es para nuestro beneficio, y ahora que tenemos el uso de la tecnología, de las redes, con mas razón, hay que sacarle provecho, porqué aunque a muchos les cueste reconocerlo, solemos aprender mas de los videos por YouTube o tik tok, que haciendo cursos o estudiando.
![post hive - 2026-06-14T121912.329.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/241tfnfEuvas8ftToSm3cvmjWBxcyUiZAX6efQtvUN68Y3FkHf377FgVGYYvhXPF2Wuho.png)
Hace poco tuve de nuevo, otro inconveniente con mi computadora, justo el día de mi cumpleaños, a la amiga, le dio por no querer encender, por un momento me frustre, dije, solo a mi y al pato lucas, es que me suceden unas cosas que buee, sin embargo, trate de mantener la calma, era mi cumpleaños, tenia que pasarlo bien, así que lo deje, confiando en la pc vieja, pero que creen, ella tampoco me quiso colaborar. Ni modo, respire, me quede tranquila, intentando hacer lo que podía por mi teléfono, el cual también esta que tira la toalla jajaja, pero bueno, ayer me reuní con un amigo, el siempre me apoya en estas situaciones, sabe de computadoras y eso, pensábamos que podía ser la fuente, por ende me presto una, para probar. Lo hice, pero que creen, nada, la amiga no hacia nada, desconecte todo, le saque los cables, me costo conectar de nuevo la fuente, ese cable si que es duro, el del ATX, aun así, nada, no encendía la pantalla. Dije, mañana lo intento de nuevo con mas calma, porque algo estaba pasando allí, pero no sabíamos que, todo indicaba que no era la fuente. Bueno, yo no soy una experta en esta área, se que debería, pero como dicen por allí, echando a perder se aprende, y viendo videos por YouTube también jejeje, me puse hacerles caso, saque todo, incluso la tarjeta, la cual, aplique el viejo truco de limpiarla con un borrador, la cuestión, es que al hacer esto, que creen, aquí estoy escribiendo desde mi PC, la amiga encendió. La verdad no se que pudo ser, mi amigo dice que pudo ser eso, que se lleno de polvo, y se pego, en fin, espero y ruego que haya sido solo esto, y de ahora en adelante me funcione normal, me deje trabajar. A ustedes les ha pasado, que creen que pudo ser, los leo. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eoc1JzJrhFWs4g8rPQcmu5pknWw85NQassMYsWYVmfjoN6mv7nJUbipLBjA7hf4DyWc.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoCgiEfje3rVX5gADtr24Hpe4F1xYCwUxXn3rQ3Deamz1AduwipkiG6BkAge98v6wf8.png) ---
ENGLISH VERSION

In this life, we have to learn everything—even if we don’t like it or are afraid to try. Sometimes it’s hard, but we have to give it a shot, especially if it’s for our own good. And now that we have access to technology and social media, all the more reason to take advantage of it. Because even though many people find it hard to admit, we tend to learn more from YouTube or TikTok videos than from taking courses or studying. I recently had another problem with my computer, right on my birthday. My computer just decided it didn’t want to turn on. For a moment I got frustrated and said, “It’s always me and Pato Lucas—things just happen to me, man.” However, I tried to stay calm; it was my birthday, and I had to have a good time, so I let it go and relied on my old PC, but guess what? It didn’t want to cooperate either. Oh well, I took a deep breath, stayed calm, trying to do what I could on my phone, which is also on its last legs, hahaha, but anyway, yesterday I met up with a friend; he always supports me in these situations—he knows about computers and stuff. We thought it might be the power supply, so he lent me one to test. I did it, but guess what? Nothing. The computer wouldn’t do a thing. I unplugged everything, pulled out the cables—it was a pain to reconnect the power supply; that ATX cable is really tough—but still, nothing. The screen wouldn’t turn on. I said, “I’ll try again tomorrow when I’m calmer,” because something was going on there, but we didn’t know what. Everything pointed to it not being the power supply. Well, I’m no expert in this area—I know I should be, but as they say, you learn by making mistakes, and by watching YouTube videos too, hehehe. So I decided to take their advice, took everything out, even the graphics card, which I cleaned with an eraser using that old trick. The thing is, when I did that—guess what?—here I am writing this from my PC; the computer turned on. Honestly, I don’t know what it could have been. My friend says it might have been that—that it got full of dust and got stuck. Anyway, I hope and pray that was all it was, and that from now on it works normally and lets me get my work done. Has this ever happened to you? What do you think it could have been? I’d love to hear your thoughts.

body.title: Analog B&W Film Photography - First Dark Room Experience
body.body: I would see in the movies how film was made in the red room, seemed quiet fascinating to me and i hoped that i would get to try it for a first time even if i am digital photographer at heart.\n\n

/> The film turned out really great for first timer being that the instructors instructions where followed up to a tea, in the second image you would see the lights leaks which where not coincidental because a different film camera an negative has been used to shoot the image, it gives it an edge if you ask me.
/> Here in the dark room, there is all the utensil available to develop a film properly, with instructional notes of notice boards for the difference in format sizes and negative brands
/> we begin with getting ready the tank then proceeding to turn of the lights, the fanpo small format negatives is what we are using
/> we also get to develop pictures of photo paper using the deep method in Dektol, stop and fix, this was really fun.
/> After fixing and washing with soap, The drying cabinet is where all the strips is being hung to dry off with timer set to 30 minutes.
/> The next day we cut up the film strips order of number over a lighting to keep it accurate and after that they a place in the sheet for protection.
/> this is after they have been scanned using Espson V600 film Scanner.

body.title: Pav Bhaji
body.body:
Hello to Hive Fam!

I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world.

It is Sunday and second day of the weekend which is I am utilising for a day travel. Now travelling is easy for me because I use my own car and not dependent upon the public transport so there is no need for me to follow the booking process. I mean to say when we travel through the public transport then in case of train or bus a booking is required for convenience that we get during travel but with personal vehicle that is not a concern. 


Anytime I plan something I just need to take out my car and pack some necessary stuff and that's all because after that I am also to move around. Payments are digital say there is no need to visit bank or ATM because even if I don't Carey cash in my wallet it's fine because my phone is good enough to take care of all those expenses. Let it be fuel or the other cost on the way along with the food expenses all these places are accepting the digital payments which are mostly inform of upi and that is really convenient which I enjoy a lot because I don't need to check how much cash I have in my wallet and for that reason I also need not to visit any nearby ATM machine. 

![1000264555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/EoGytFeG6CfKZvr4ML8epHDpnX84PQ47caoSBZAWvQHqoXN9AP9nRnavQMQLEV7t4Fw.jpg)

Today while I was driving to a place I thought of having something in the morning and that's when I decided why shouldn't I try a plate of pav bhaji. This is a tasty food but it is not really healthy to be honest and that is why I generally have it once in few months if I remember correctly it's been more than 3 months when I had it last time with means I can have it today without thinking much about the health aspect.


While travelling I also try to carry something with me like some foods and some homemade food so that I am lest dependent on the outside food but that cannot last long if a trip is far a couple of days however if it is a date trip then it is manageable since food can last for the day but generally not more than that. 


This plate of pav bhaji was really tasty and I enjoyed the taste and I think quantity was also good enough which was like I had enough a fit and after that I did not feel like having anything since it was a breakfast but it's like I can say that it's enough for me in terms of quantity which was not less and not more. I hope you people are having a fantastic weekend..

body.title: Where loyalty lies
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZWvD7gUqQMrR6fxQkoJbkFq357f5MbZYKmVFtYxC2PHT/1000208323.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/businessman-ready-write-notes_6276043.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=31&uuid=bdea8f9b-8922-40ad-8011-4aaf39cfa08e&query=Priorities+) 
“We are [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) loyal to something/someone and it can be a pity that one can be loyal to ignorance”---dani-EL. There is no denying what is true, there is where our heart [yields](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-yield) to. Everyday, there is something you mostly prioritize and as earlier said, even if you care not to picture it out.   

There were [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day) I used to [love](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-love) eating. I am just trying to bring in a scenario here that we can easily relate to. Did you know eating became a bad habit on my end? I ate at will and maybe you may think as long as I had the [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) to, why not. I can't agree to that, there are so many ways of enslaving oneself.   

It couldn't allow me to discern [times](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) and seasons; my belly consumed a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) of my potential and when I decided to turn my attention away, that was when I knew I had given loyalty to a bad direction.   

Expanding much further, this can be [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work), [marriage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-marriage), [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business), behavior, your environment or God. Sitting there to watch an hour -long [movie](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-movie-film), playing a [video game](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-video-games), scrolling through feeds on [social media](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-social-media) but getting bored of reading what can improve your [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life). You ignore personal growth because your loyalty has shifted to mundane things.  

Talking of work, you can do anything to reach office on time but when it comes to things concerning your relationship with God, it is a ‘come when you like’. You are not bored, the in-between difference there is loyalty. You prioritize pleasing your boss in the office; that's loyalty for you. I am not saying you should not be valuable at work place but I guess you know where I am heading to.  

It can be spending day and night in the office. It is not actually a matter of becoming your best version. Many realize themselves very late in all these processes. In the end, [wealth](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-wealth) was accrued at the [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost) of loosing connection completely with your creator.   

Where am I heading in this article? You can have time for God only if you want to. Life is about priorities and whatever your prioritize automatically leads in your calendar. body.title: Finally, Deltarune Returns With Chapter 5 [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/2458YsFpjqnSQyTs6EejdVDtNH4Q17xD3yjTf8hbcarqjybhGfV6Wrf1BXoMroCyoLUfr.png) --- After months of rumors, speculation, and constant development updates, Toby Fox finally put the uncertainty to rest. During the most recent Nintendo Direct, the first official trailer for *Deltarune* Chapter 5 was revealed, accompanied by the news millions of players had been waiting for: the new chapter will arrive on June 24, 2026, as a free update for all users who already own the game. This news was one of the event's biggest surprises. Since the release of Chapters 3 and 4 last year, the community had been eagerly awaiting any clue regarding the continuation of Kris, Susie, and Ralsei's adventure. Although Toby Fox had shared periodic progress updates, he had always avoided revealing a specific date—until now. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/242NuQTPv8tHLBdhuikXZbsXPPEM9TVu1GRRvPpvQrdA21TeE9TkvUGmfgoojfCJNCJok.png) --- The new trailer maintains the series' signature style. Rather than revealing major plot details, it showcases brief glimpses of new environments, never-before-seen enemies, and mysterious moments that have sparked a flurry of fan theories. As is typical of Toby Fox's work, every image seems to hide clues about the story's future, inviting the community to analyze every second of the video. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1Q5TxmTVA3Zih4MdLvHoRJR2dxWTRHkMSKXMW8PW3hjFvBgMG3LzA1qQuqhMvZwqyx.png) --- One of the most notable aspects is that Chapter 5 will be available as a free update on all platforms where *Deltarune* is already available. This means that those who purchased the game won't have to make any additional payments to continue the story—a decision that has been very well received by the community. However, the announcement didn't stop there. Along with the release date, Toby Fox also provided an update on the status of Chapter 6. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tRvMpBvUUqaLBxtfMhNCHoTK5oobCvBFFwLqJsh8fKNK9WcLr8PMvwFXXts6MH6vwxB.png) --- The developer confirmed that production is progressing at a good pace and explained that a significant portion of the scenes, enemies, and core mechanics are already in development. He even noted the possibility that part of the team might begin working on the seventh chapter before the year ends—something that would have been unthinkable just a few months ago. This news marks a significant shift from the long waiting periods that have characterized *Deltarune*'s development since its early chapters. Production appears to be much more organized, fueling hopes that the remaining chapters will arrive more quickly than in the past. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vhz7RP5C5sGdEW9dcHpNoj8WmJ4JfbVLdZFcsLu2yYiXA6SM1bSjyHWibvqWTatm4h7.png) --- Deltarune continues to cement its status as one of the most important indie RPGs of the last decade. Its blend of unique combat, memorable characters, humor, an excellent soundtrack, and a mystery-filled narrative has fostered an incredibly active community—one capable of turning even the smallest teaser into weeks of debate and theorizing. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTWycZaNzoexvVdkR13sbA7APoYtcuCjyLJh6RkGfWCZ6yBkvizYnFgYwodk9rMdVht.png) --- With the release of Chapter 5 scheduled for late June, players will once again dive into a story that still holds many secrets waiting to be uncovered. And although there are still chapters left to complete the adventure, all signs point to Toby Fox having a clear vision for the path leading to the highly anticipated conclusion. After months of waiting, the journey through Deltarune's strange universe is ready to continue, and everything suggests that the upcoming chapter will be one of the most significant in the entire saga.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/2458YsFpjqnSQyTs6EejdVDtNH4Q17xD3yjTf8hbcarqjybhGfV6Wrf1BXoMroCyoLUfr.png) --- Tras meses de rumores, especulaciones y constantes actualizaciones sobre su desarrollo, Toby Fox finalmente puso fin a la incertidumbre. Durante el más reciente Nintendo Direct se presentó el primer tráiler oficial de Deltarune Chapter 5, acompañado de la noticia que millones de jugadores esperaban: el nuevo capítulo llegará el 24 de junio de 2026 como una actualización gratuita para todos los usuarios que ya poseen el juego. La noticia fue una de las grandes sorpresas del evento. Desde el lanzamiento de los capítulos 3 y 4 el año pasado, la comunidad había estado esperando cualquier pista sobre la continuación de la aventura de Kris, Susie y Ralsei. Aunque Toby Fox había compartido avances periódicos sobre el desarrollo, siempre evitó revelar una fecha concreta hasta ahora. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/242NuQTPv8tHLBdhuikXZbsXPPEM9TVu1GRRvPpvQrdA21TeE9TkvUGmfgoojfCJNCJok.png) --- El nuevo tráiler mantiene el estilo característico de la saga. En lugar de revelar detalles importantes de la historia, muestra breves escenas de nuevos escenarios, enemigos inéditos y algunos momentos cargados de misterio que han disparado las teorías de los seguidores. Como ya es habitual en las obras de Toby Fox, cada imagen parece esconder pistas sobre el futuro de la trama, invitando a la comunidad a analizar cada segundo del video. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1Q5TxmTVA3Zih4MdLvHoRJR2dxWTRHkMSKXMW8PW3hjFvBgMG3LzA1qQuqhMvZwqyx.png) --- Uno de los aspectos que más llama la atención es que Chapter 5 estará disponible como una actualización gratuita en todas las plataformas donde ya se encuentra Deltarune. Esto significa que quienes adquirieron el juego no tendrán que realizar ningún pago adicional para continuar la historia, una decisión que ha sido muy bien recibida por la comunidad. Sin embargo, el anuncio no terminó ahí. Junto con la fecha de lanzamiento, Toby Fox también ofreció una actualización sobre el estado de Chapter 6. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tRvMpBvUUqaLBxtfMhNCHoTK5oobCvBFFwLqJsh8fKNK9WcLr8PMvwFXXts6MH6vwxB.png) --- El desarrollador confirmó que su producción avanza a buen ritmo y explicó que buena parte de las escenas, enemigos y mecánicas principales ya se encuentran en desarrollo. Incluso señaló que existe la posibilidad de que parte del equipo comience a trabajar en el séptimo capítulo antes de que termine el año, algo impensable hace apenas unos meses. Esta noticia representa un cambio importante respecto a los largos periodos de espera que han caracterizado el desarrollo de Deltarune desde sus primeros capítulos. La producción parece estar mucho más organizada, lo que alimenta la esperanza de que los capítulos restantes lleguen con mayor rapidez que en el pasado. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vhz7RP5C5sGdEW9dcHpNoj8WmJ4JfbVLdZFcsLu2yYiXA6SM1bSjyHWibvqWTatm4h7.png) --- Deltarune continúa consolidándose como uno de los RPG independientes más importantes de la última década. Su combinación de combates originales, personajes memorables, humor, una excelente banda sonora y una narrativa llena de misterios ha conseguido mantener una comunidad extremadamente activa, capaz de convertir cualquier pequeño adelanto en semanas de debates y teorías. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23yTWycZaNzoexvVdkR13sbA7APoYtcuCjyLJh6RkGfWCZ6yBkvizYnFgYwodk9rMdVht.png) --- Con el lanzamiento de Chapter 5 programado para finales de junio, los jugadores volverán a sumergirse en una historia que aún guarda numerosos secretos por descubrir. Y aunque todavía quedan capítulos para completar la aventura, todo indica que Toby Fox ya tiene perfectamente definido el camino hacia el esperado desenlace. Después de meses de espera, el viaje por el extraño universo de Deltarune está listo para continuar, y todo apunta a que el próximo capítulo será uno de los más importantes de toda la saga.

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1932
Sunday 14, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1997
