Jargon, the lingo within language.  

![1997.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUSe8j9J93JiCGmB5M8u7ntHrFRPBCLzeqYCVdUqwZp8/1997.png)

Today's Episode: https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1932_full_6-14-26_1997_sol89:2?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Numbers Magic. Numbers Myth.  
We have maybe two more parts to go in the 130 years, and counting, War series. Let’s save them for the week days. Today we are going to jump into numbers, which, with few exceptions are the few Universal truths. This piece come out of an exploration and debate with a chat-bot. Here’s one of Noxsoma’s Seven Truths, “Numbers never lie.” Here’s what we mean. 
The Occult Significance of 369. Tesla's Key or Modern Myth?
From social media manifestation rituals to sacred geometry, the number 369 has become one of the most debated numerical symbols in modern occult and spiritual circles. 
If you've spent any time on spiritual side of the web, or in esoteric forums, you've likely encountered the claim that, \

The phrase is almost always attributed to Nikola Tesla, the tragic inventor who brought us alternating current. But, as with many things in the occult world, the truth is far messier, and far more interesting, than the legend suggests. \nThe Tesla Legend. Where It Actually Comes From. \nLet's start with what Tesla actually believed versus what has been attributed to him. The famous quote, \

, appears nowhere in Tesla's surviving writings, patents, or authenticated interviews. 
Here's what the historical record shows. Tesla did have a documented obsession with numbers divisible by 3. He would walk around a building three times before entering, demanded 18 napkins (3 × 6) to clean his dining ware, and only stayed in hotel rooms whose numbers were multiples of 3. (This sounds more like superstition than obsession, however as a 7-guy, I get it.) 
Modern psychologists and biographers attribute this behavior not to mystical insight but to severe obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). Tesla's compulsions extended beyond numbers to an intense fear of germs, pearls, and round objects.  
The famous \
first appeared in 2006 on a Flickr comment thread, decades after Tesla's death. By 2009, a blogger had repurposed it for a \
and from there, it spread into spiritual communities where it was retroactively attributed to Tesla. \nThe second famous quote, about seeking the secrets of the universe through, \

, comes from a second hand account by a man named Ralph Bergstresser, not from Tesla's own writings. While Tesla did speak about frequency and energy in scientific contexts, the specific phrasing beloved by occultists is unverified.  
Sacred Geometry and the Magic Square of Saturn. 
The occult significance of 369 draws heavily from sacred geometry and ancient numerological traditions. One of the most compelling connections involves the Magic Square of Saturn, also known as the Freemasons' Magic Square. 
This 3×3 grid of numbers has a remarkable property: every row, column, and diagonal adds up to 15. But the deeper occult significance emerges when you examine the square's structure. 
Once you take a close look at the “magic square,” you will learn that number 5 must always occupy the center square for this magic to work. If you write the digit from the one’s column, in the proper order of any of the odd-numbers multiples, it will work out. 
For example. 1 2 3 4 5 (center square) 6 7 8 9. Try it. 
3 Table. 3 6 9 2 (for 12), 5 (center square) 8 1 4 7.
7 Table. 7 4 1 8 5, (center square), 2 9 6 3. Did you catch it? The 3 and 7 tables are opposites, as are the 1 and 9 tables.  Most magic tricks are easy, once you know the secret. And with numbers the secret never changes.  
Saturn, in esoteric traditions, represents limitation, time, karma, and the material world, the \

of physical existence. \nThe number 6 carries particular weight in Western occult traditions. In biblical numerology, 6 represents man, (humans were created on the sixth day). The infamous 666, often called \
is explicitly described in Revelation 13:18 as \

, not necessarily the Antichrist, as popular culture suggests, but humanity's number. Why? Well as humans are “carbon based critters”,  and Carbon atoms, consist of 6 protons, 6 electrons, and 6 neutrons, maybe that’s the missing link. (We could take this back to space alien tech, but we’d better not.) But who wrote that designation of Revelations? It is a human number… and so on.   \nSome occultists have pointed out a fascinating coincidence, the World Wide Web's \

corresponds in Hebrew numerology to the number 6 (waw = 6), leading to theories that the internet itself represents a fulfillment of apocalyptic prophecy. This is like saying Nostradamus predicted Hitler, because he mentioned “Hister.” If it’s not exact, it’s not exact. Nice try.  \nThe Mathematical \

That Captivates Believers. 
Proponents of 369's significance point to a series of mathematical patterns that, at first glance, seem genuinely eerie. Here are the most frequently cited examples :
Phenomenon	Calculation	Result
Circle geometry	360° → 3+6+0	9
Half circle	180° → 1+8+0	9
Quarter circle	90° → 9+0	9
Eighth circle	45° → 4+5	9
Minutes in a day	1,440 → 1+4+4+0	9
Seconds in a day	86,400 → 8+6+4+0+0	18 → 1+8 = 9
Minutes in a week	10,080 → 1+0+0+8+0	9
Standard breathing rate	18 breaths/min → 1+8	9
Standard heart rate	72 beats/min → 7+2	9

The Cell Division Anomaly. (This is basically exponential growth. It’s more math than science.) 
The most frequently cited \

of 369's special status involves binary cell division. Human cells divide following a pattern: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and so on. If you reduce these numbers to their digital root (repeatedly adding digits until you get a single number), something strange happens, 
1 returns to  1
2 returns to 2
4 returns to 4
8 returns to 8
16 returns to 1+6 = 7
32 returns to 3+2 = 5
64 returns to 1 6+4 = 10,  1+0 = 1
128 returns to 2, 1+2+8 = 11,  1+1 = 2
256 returns to 4,  2+5+6 = 13,  1+3 = 4
The pattern that emerges is 1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5, and it repeats infinitely. Notice which numbers are missing.  3, 6, and 9 are completely absent from the \
pattern of cell division. \nThis observation has led some occultists to conclude that 3, 6, and 9 represent something beyond the physical, \

forces that exist outside the closed loop of material reality. But it’s not occult at all. It’s consistent. 
The Skeptical Take: Why This Might All Be an Illusion. 
Before we get too carried away, it's worth considering the counterargument. The mathematical patterns described above rely entirely on base-10 (decimal) mathematics, a system humans invented, not a universal law. 
[Note, this is not true. It’s based on base-9.] The thought experiment is worthwhile nonetheless. 

Here's a simple thought experiment: if an alien species with eight fingers evolved, they would likely use base-8, (octal) mathematics. In their counting system, the number 9 doesn't even exist (it would be written as \

). The entire pattern of digital roots collapsing to 9 disappears completely. Luckily for us humans, we have ten fingers, but we also have three joints in each of the four long fingers which is why our counting system was originally based on 60, and not 100.   \nSimilarly, the 360-degree circle is not a cosmic given, it was a choice made by Babylonian mathematicians approximately 4,000 years ago because 360 was divisible by many numbers. Had they chosen 100 degrees per circle (as some early French revolutionaries proposed), the 369 pattern would vanish.  [Note: This is incorrect. 3 6 9 holding their own values would still crate the same patterns.]   \nWhat occultists call \

may simply be pattern recognition, specifically, a cognitive bias known as confirmation bias, where humans notice evidence that supports their beliefs and ignore evidence that contradicts them.  But there’s no evidence that contradicts the patterns. 
The 369 Manifestation Method. Modern Occult Practice. 
Regardless of whether 369 has genuine cosmic significance, it has become a central tool in modern manifestation practices, particularly on quick video platforms, where the #369method has billions of views. 
The practice is straightforward. 
    1. Write your intention three times in the morning
    2. Write it six times in the afternoon
    3. Write it nine times in the evening
The belief is that the vibrational frequencies of 3, 6, and 9 align your consciousness with universal creative energy, allowing thoughts to \
. Some practitioners combine this with visualization, affirmations, or meditation to \

the sequence.
The method has been criticized as arbitrary—why not 2, 4, 8?—but its popularity speaks to a genuine human need for structured rituals that create a sense of control over uncertain outcomes. 
[Note, I’ve been doing this for years without invoking numbers gods, angels or demons, that I know of.]  


The Cross-Cultural Resonance
The number 3 appears across virtually every religious and mystical tradition. 
Christianity: The Trinity (Father, Son, Holy Spirit)
Hinduism: Trimurti (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva)
Buddhism: Triple Gem (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha)
Daoism: \

Greek philosophy: The triad of truth, beauty, and goodness. 
This simply represents the beginning, middle & end. Are you familiar with the so-called, “Riddle of the Sphinx? What critter goes on four legs in the morning, two legs in the afternoon, and three legs in the evening? 
The number 9 appears in Dante's Divine Comedy (nine circles of Hell), the nine months of human gestation, and as the \

number in many systems. the completion before return to unity. 
The Verdict: Myth, Math, or Mystery? 
So where does this leave us? The occult significance of 369 sits at a fascinating crossroads. 
For the skeptic: 369 is a modern myth built on misattributed quotes, cognitive biases, and mathematical patterns that only exist because of human-made measurement systems. Tesla's \

was a symptom of mental illness, not mystical insight. \nFor the believer: 369 represents a genuine pattern in consciousness and nature, one that mathematics reveals despite humanity's arbitrary numbering systems. The fact that 3, 6, and 9 are absent from the binary cell division pattern suggests something real about the relationship between spirit and matter.  \nFor the practitioner: It doesn't matter whether 369 is objectively \

What matters is whether focusing on it produces meaningful changes in your life. The 369 manifestation method, like any ritual, works (when it works) because of the psychological effects of focused intention and repetition, not because numbers have magical properties. \nPerhaps the most honest answer is this, 3, 6, and 9 have no inherent occult significance except the significance humans have assigned to them, and that significance, built over centuries of cross-cultural pattern recognition, is real enough to shape beliefs, rituals, and even entire spiritual movements. \nWhether that counts as \

depends on whether you believe meaning is discovered or created. 

Did I mention that this was a debate with a chat-bot? It was a bit earlier in my experience with these things. We have better discussions these days. 
Numbers are truth. Full stop. But they aren’t magic outside of their own realm. When applied to something like calendars, space and measures of organic substances, the numbers remain consistent, but life moves beyond the constraint of human measures.

body.body: Forgiveness of sin is a great gift which Jesus have come to earth to give to us. Forgiveness is very necessary because everyone on earth is a sinner, and is only when we forgive one another, then peace can reign. Through faith, repentance, and God's mercy, sinners can receive pardon and a clean conscience. God's willingness to forgive demonstrates His love, compassion, and desire to save humanity.\nhttps://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=Sz8edaw6ICxRUTin\nThe forgiveness of sins was made possible through the sacrifice of Jesus Christ, who paid the penalty for sin on behalf of mankind. When a person sincerely confesses and turns away from sin, God promises to forgive and cleanse them from unrighteousness. Forgiveness not only brings peace with God but also encourages believers to forgive others as they have been forgiven.

body.title: #BeerSaturday - Hoppy Saturday!
body.body:
<center>
![beersaturday8 (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSURiLT4RAUWPiz4c58Q5kbUeb9x2FbUPPmVLW7D5vwE/beersaturday8%20(2).png)
</center>

467 weeks makes for a world-class beer gut!  Whether or not you have a 6-pack or a keg, you are welcome to join @detlev and the gang with your post about beer at https://hive.blog/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-467 | https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-467 | Have you tried New Hive yet? https://new.hive.blog/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-467

In this 467th edition, we are all about the hops.
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center> 
<center>
![potw.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNqKGbn37aNafn8sZCFDKchK3bUnqrPH7tCqvWC4QQqA7/potw.png)
</center> 
<center> ![IMG_9294.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf7bb3Fb1SedMMpD2MAh9MduHprv8nYSxf6e1KA8JWHFR/IMG_9294.jpg) 
</center> 
I am pivoting to the Shorty of the Week as I found another fantastic, limited run craft beer available in the rarer 355ml cans! I have enjoyed every beer from [Bandit Brewery](https://www.banditbrewery.ca) so I expoected this one to be another great one.  Especially excited for the Citra, Mosaic and Galaxy hops which are the ones we use ion the IPA we brew!  This was the perfect beer as far as I am concerned.  Hazy, sweel, bold and tropical are what I am after in a NEIPA and I almost wished this was a full pint can by the time I got to the bottom of it.
![beerologistapproved.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNgNnMcCKvgcGEA9cRmeFgGza8CydHE1eAYgtGtv2sqgU/beerologistapproved.png)
Another nice one from Bandit and we agree on the selection of hops!
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Badlands Select!
<center> ![IMG_9277.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT89jpFc1rtsDApWAJGEvYf5gdxTMwvGKKMWNeBgZi4v7/IMG_9277.jpg) </center> 
I have only recently discovered [Badlands Brewing Company](https://www.badlandsbrewing.ca/) through the new local beer shop.   I have featured them in recent #beersaturday editions because I keep going back looking for more and discovering new beers....not just IPAs!

This is a very interesting series to me as I am constantly alternating the hops in the beer we brew, looking for the best combination.  So, a whole series of single hop IPAs from a brewery I really enjoy gives me the perfect opportunity to appreciate each for their own flavour.
<center> ![IMG_9275.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPJTwtr2Dq7ZAQkKfaMr3GY61c58BqxuR1uw7dVa8Gs1/IMG_9275.jpg) 
</center>
You can see the beer is hazy and yellow which we aim for and the ABV is 6.5% which is pretty much the target of our IPAs.  I am quite familiar with many of the hops like Mocais, Citra, Galaxy, and the like.  We have started including Nelson Sauvin for its tart fruitiness but there are a bunch of New Zealand hops that are becoming the rage.

Nectaron is one I have tasted in a few recent IPAs but I wasn't sure exactly what brings to an IPA with other similar tropical fruit and citrus notes.  Tasting this one showed me exactly what Nectaron does when you use it as the flavour, bittering and hopstand parts of the brewing cycle.  Massive body and bold tropical citrus blast with a substantial dry bitterness at the end of each sip.  Damn good beer even if it wasn't consumed for educatiuonal purposes!

<center> ![IMG_9330.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWhSZGtdV32PTNDNegRfkp4acqkYbFyxVQv91YWhbiCGQ/IMG_9330.jpg) </center>

I must say my favourite of the lot was probably the Mosaic or Galaxy but nectaron is solid too.  I especially enjoyed the description of not only the hop, but the different harvest and reasoning behind selecting this particular hop!


<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>

# #BEERSaturday!

<center> ![the-truth-behind-ipas-v0-q3vsuui9tn311.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetWMdij9axBvCfHFcMaRszGrFJPbVnpcK3RctcFNx5ky/the-truth-behind-ipas-v0-q3vsuui9tn311.webp) </center> 
I gotta admit it is true.  Being a basic white guy may not be in vogue but I still give it my best effort.

Now it is time for you to join me, @detlev , and these other beerologists because there is always room for more beer bloggers at the Beer Saturday gathering.   Whether you perfer the Hive Blog front end or using @peakd, your links are  [www.peakd.com/@detlev/beersaturday-467](www.peakd.com//@detlev/beersaturday-467) | [new.hive.blog/@detlev/beersaturday-467](new.hive.blog/@detlev/beersaturday-467) to @detlev's post this week and I would encourage you to create a beer post of your own to join the fun.  As many hops as you can handle!
<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmV7cqxZ4tua1gdhToQexFqRnQxq5gPGqVQTfo15saHRRh/blockchainbeerologist2.png</center>

<center>https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcvVqhGMbF1KAHTn9Wh8FiRhmpAbiEuAKerVM7ugDnXfX/text16.png</center>

body.body:
>


<center>![1000744173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wCFsd7qycajPZrfjFP87HVNwdQUUjrPsYwUYSRi5bbRrTpcGb5R9Vho6FgU7TuaM8dE.jpg)</center>

***

#### <center>Nacho y el viaje a la isla</center>

# 

Hoy en la mañana Miguel se ha ido muy temprano a trabajar para la isla, un lugar rocoso y seco rodeado de mar, que está a una distancia de aproximadamente dos horas del puerto. Alla se quedará unas cuantas horas trabajando en una construcción. Los materiales y todo lo necesario se transporta  en botes. 
 
Nacho y Luz se quedan sentados sobre sus patas traseras, con la mirada fija en el bote, que cada vez se va haciendo mas pequeño, empujado por el motor que lo impulsa entre las olas del mar oscuro y un poco agitado. 
 
Miguel los observa mientras se aleja del puerto. Sus cuerpos parecen estátuas entre los pipotes de agua y combustible. Qué pensaran al verlo alejarse? Sus miradas son ansiosas ¿Tendrán la seguridad de que el regresará a buscarlos? 
 
Pero Nacho no tiene paciencia para esperar allí todo el día y en cuanto le da hambre corre hasta los puestos de alimentos y restaurantes donde llega a pedir comida. Luz, su madre, mas calmada y paciente lo sigue. La gente ya los conoce y les dan restos de pollo que es lo que mas se vende en esos locales y que a ellos les encanta. 
 
Después de darse un festín, caminan de regreso a la playa donde Luz se echa a descansar. Su pelaje blanco resplandece bajo el tibio sol. Su barriga llena, sube y baja con su respiración. Pero Nacho es muy inquieto. Quiere jugar, busca en la arena un palito, lo encuentra. Lo toma entre sus dientes y comienza a buscar una persona que se lo lance. Pero, la llegada del invierno ha alejado a los turistas. 
 
La playa está sola y en el agua fría solo flotan los botes de los pescadores, los pelícanos y una que otra gaviota. 
 
 
Pero Nacho no se da por vencido, camina al otro lado de la playa y alli encuentra unos  hombres que han terminado su jornada de pesca. Nacho los conoce como a todos los trabajadores del muelle y ellos a el. 
 
 
\

le habla un hombre bajo y corpulento. Nacho lo mira y le tira el palito a sus pies. El hombre le sonríe, agarra el palito y se lo lanza hacia el mar, como ha visto hacer a Miguel, pero no tan fuerte porque sabe que el agua está fría. Nacho entra chapoteando al agua, agarra el palito y sale corriendo a la arena seca donde se sacude violentamente, y busca con la mirada al pescador. Pero este se va alejando con sus compañeros. Está cansado, tiene hambre y sueño. Su jornada de trabajo ha terminado por ahora. Fueron varios días en altamar, alejado de su familia y van a  pesar lo que pescaron, para recibir su paga. Y Nacho se queda sin jugar. Con resignación camina por la arena hasta donde está Luz, quién levanta la cabeza cuando lo mira echarse a su lado. Allí descansa por un rato. Y mientras lo hace sueña. Sus patitas se mueven como si corriera hacia el mar. Y en un momento Luz y Nacho se despiertan, estiran sus patas y se levantan con sus orejas atentas, el viento que sopla hacia la costa les trae un olor entremezclado con el aroma del mar. Es  Miguel que está de regreso. Nacho seguida de Luz corren hasta el muelle. Ven el bote que se va acercando y esperan con una alegría que desborda sus corazones. body.title: Resident Evil: Zero [Let's Play] - 14 - Made of Leeches
body.body:
*That freaking Frog!!!!!!*

*We finally meet the mastermind, who's turned out to be a clone of James Marcus, one of Umbrella's founders, whose merged with his leeches and turned into a dark monsters!!*

-----

**Resident Evil: Zero** is a prequel to the Resident Evil series set right before the mansion incident. The game follows the new STARS member Rebecca and the wanted criminal Billy as they try to survive zombie outbreak! **RE0** features a Dual Protagonists system letting the player switch seamlessly between Rebecca and Billy. Most puzzles require coordination between the two characters.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb51ZWXX1A9cHzfW8XHHjkeTSo2BSUjSYerQZHauNLQzz/1000072766.webp 

 
I played RE trilogy for the PS1 when I was younger and the first Remake for a bit... But this is the first time I play **Zero.** As I played, I was surprised at how much this game adds to the lore, especially for Umbrella Corp. while still doing its own thing. There are fewer zombies in this game, instead there's a lot of Leeches and feral animals.

While I'd recommend this game to Resident Evil fans, I'm not too fond of how slow the game feels. Too much backtracking. Some Puzzles feel like too much filler, but I loved a few puzzles in my playthrough. I used a guide when I got stuck though... You can watch my playthrough below:

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | I want To Do God's Will But How Can I stop Doing Bad Things?
body.body:
>


https://youtu.be/kTJD6aYScLM?si=48svVE_Q1bfZ8imq



Many of us are sincere as Christians to do God's will, but we sometimes find ourselves doing something that is not good. This sometimes leads to feelings of sadness, disappointment and guilt. It has happened to me. At times, I knew the right thing to do, but at times, I had some of the wrong habits, attitudes or words. I wanted to obey God, but I didn't want to be not too easy. It takes faith, prayer, obedience, and God's assistance.

It is a lesson of the Bible that there is a conflict between the flesh and the desire to do what God wants. In Romans 7:19, Apostle Paul said, \

We see here that the devout servants of God can be in difficulty in doing what is good. But God is not by ourselves in this struggle. He provides us His direction in His Word and His Spirit.

The one experience I had was being humiliated to a severe extent. I knew it was God's will to forgive me but my mind kept going over what the person did to me. I was hurt and angry for many, many days. Each time I thought of it I wanted to cling to the bitterness that went along with it. But, after praying and reading the Bible, I recalled the words of Christ about forgiveness. All by itself I asked God to let me go of the bitterness little by little. This wasn't as easy as it sounds, but when we rely on God and follow His laws we can overcome the bad.

I can't stop doing bad things if I don't first see my weaknesses and if I don't be humble enough to cry out to God for help. Prayer is significant because it keeps me in touch with Him. Jesus said in John 15:5, \
I also need to be filled with God's word, otherwise I will be led away from sin. Psalm 119:11 - \
Wow! I can sense a story of resilience and transformation. The overall view is really beautiful! 😍

body.title: Birthdays. LOH. #293
body.body: I'm not much of a celebrator of my own birthday. Yes, I do get excited when the day is drawing near, but once the days comes, it feels like just another day. I do think one of the reasons I feel this way is because I usually don't get to do what I might have been imagining long before the day. Mainly because I didn't have the resources to fund the imagination. ![Snapchat-610027953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyinye-chi/23zGcDM3oZxNJwQBNUxckSLBfWn1S1bGPijsWmGg3TpnPVf9pSfgfiYa2w26qWBcxYjrB.jpg) For instance, last year, I thought to myself that I was going to get myself a new phone on my birthday, or within the week of my birthday. I was still a student then with almost no savings. I tried several things to make money so that I could fulfill that desire. As you might have guessed, none worked out. At least as I hoped or thought they would. So when the day came I just accepted the birthday wishes as normal greetings and moved on. If I'm able to get a good source of income before my next birthday, there are definitely lots of things I would love to do. The top of the list is to get a bigger and better apartment, and get it furnished. Either fully or to some reasonable extent. Another thing is to get myself a brand new phone with my own cash. And if the funds are enough, I'll throw a little part at my apartment and invite a few close friends and family. Because I will consider all those things as achievements. I do love celebrating other people on their birthdays. I mean, it give me great joy when I see birthday celebrants unboxing their gifts, or receiving their birthday surprises. It makes me really happy, especially if my gift is part of the gifts received by the celebrant. Birthdays are events I really enjoy, even though I'm sometimes indifferent about mine, for reasons already mentioned. I do like celebrating or seeing other people being celebrated. Thanks for stopping by my blog. See you soon. 🤗 ### peace out ✌️ ### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE.

body.title: AS I WRITE!
body.body:
Hello, great mind,

How are you today?

Share how your week has gone in the comment section.

While writing recently, I’ve realized there’s more to my potential than I previously believed. I used to underestimate my ability to write, but now I see that perfection isn't the starting point for harnessing one's talent.

As my friends say, \

Although I admire those who craft fictional, gothic, and captivating stories, I am committed to embracing my craft, exploring it, and growing within it.

Ultimately, I will continue to express my thoughts with the confidence and clarity of a crow passing a message.

Tomorrow, I will share insights gained from my interactions with people.

Thank you for reading. I look forward to connecting again tomorrow.

body.title: The Waking Plague rises from it's slumber. A Set Analysis
body.body:
![waking plague thumb.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGeMXiZMa4iSjPD6t3LHjAxdAnfnHDmWNtnVGHGQqgGU7HHmxZEcwec1e2oeVo3pMaw.png)

All images are taken from in game, edited myself, or taken from [here](https://portal.godsunchained.com/blog/new-expansion-the-waking-plague-collectors-guide) or [here](https://godsunchained.com/learn/cards?set=plague). Or they are sourced. 

# A Plague is Coming to Eucos


Greeting everyone and welcome to another gods unchained post, this time we are talking about the [upcoming set](https://portal.godsunchained.com/blog/new-expansion-the-waking-plague-collectors-guide) that releases tomorrow. It is only available through pack purchases and features 6 cards for each god and a spattering of about 9 neutrals. The cards themselves are fun and thematic, but I am still not a fan on focusing a whole archtype around using 1 card to survive or function at all indefinitely (never have been a fan of those sort of designs even outside of GU). I'm excited for a change to the meta and to see what comes from this absolutely mega strong expansion set. 

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/asdUlSehOlAAAAAC/captain-america-brave-new-world.gif)
[source](https://media.tenor.com/asdUlSehOlAAAAAC/captain-america-brave-new-world.gif)





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)

# The Cards: Shaking up the meta

These new cards that you can check out [here](https://godsunchained.com/learn/cards?set=plague) really will change the upcoming meta (if people decide to participate in owning and playing new cards). There are some fun designs in this set and not a single weak card outside of maybe the shitty neutral olympian. Overindulged Centurion is a terrible card and a poor excuse for order tech, hate to say it but that card is by far the worst in the set. This set revisits tempt fate and expands upon everborns for the most part. 

### Nature: Tempt fate and everborn


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23sx9azpCQHdb8jbaBKJSh5xGLHLwLS2ogpdFap6KgtEzAQYKd3z2hjyjE2Q4jDWuAGBJ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23uFHNtZghXfhWPuVxyMMrfjbNKVtv3S7YZwZgivhquFiwrhqpB7kj6pyVamrPZhrF4Vq.png)



These cards are all rather good, they have strong bodies for the mana and pretty strong effects. The everborn nature cards are rather strong and hinge on 1 relic in a previous set, but are still potentially going to be meta shaping in the future. 

Frothing pika is a 2/3 for 2 with tempt fate and no downside. To top it off it has a stacking effect if you play another tempt fate card. Overall a solid card, basically a more reliable of the fox. 

Attuned to the Biome is a very strong card and synergizes with a ton of existing tech for green. This card will be used in the upcoming meta, I guarantee it. Strong card, completely breaks nature out of it's mold in more ways than one.

Malicious Mangrove is a pretty fairly statted creature with multiple keywords. I would say this card is good overall, the regen is more a bonus and less a core feature. 

Lichen Mimic is an incredibly strong card within the everborn archtype and allows for a lot of crazy plays with cards that normally can't be duplicated. Very strong, will see some play.

My so called champion is a very interesting card that is a guaranteed tutor AND a removal for 4 mana. Neat, but not too strong compared to existing nature stuff but does exponentially stack on things. Strong. 

The maddening one is nuts, the effect is nuts. This card is honestly pretty crazy, the stats effect and enduring \

sortof aspect of it is really strong at potentially 5ish mana. Very strong. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)


### Deception: Juicey Toys

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/Eo22diT8jGJZc14AaKx7trMAHLFKYKcjV8W3awDFsbtnbqEbjcmvTe8yWbDjDxZHQKA.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/EoK4NpvDPPmp9kAHdVqSrLwqT4dJj4gMonEt6SzXqfizAmd5X73tuxQZoydzL5Ruspb.png)

Deception definitely got a few juicey toys this set. Schemes within schemes and \

are pretty obviously supposed to be used together potentially bringing a relic that removes the entire deck out in the very early game. There hasn't been much new relic removal printed outside of the new everborn card either. Thankfully GU has a lot of older relic removal cards I suppose. Most of these cards are self explanatory and provide either endless pressure (hooded figure), extra removals (double vision, sacrifices will be made), drawing (sacrifices will be made), or a weird combination of things (undercover insurgent). No matter which way you slice it deception got some toys to play with that are easy to slot in to various existing decks. Fun!



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)


### War: Branching out, and how

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tmBLERyhTGedVQhbHfEPQk8hmwsAXWeRNLZTSoNDNY63QMga2X2BD8bCxkWWEK2o7r8.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/EoCgcgiF8wJrAzRSMwcx5f2fN9rcM1YinfEsokTCtHd5bu3oDvtX2qnyzFnTUqPJM4W.png)

War gets a lot of interesting cards this set, all of them are pretty interesting designwise (strength aside). Pretty fun stuff. The new direction focuses on multitribal synergies, very into it a lot of existing cards make these additions to war strong indeed.

Sunbleached Gargoyle is a strong defender or attacker for 5 mana, will see a lot of play and generation via shards. Strong card

Consumed by battle is a card that benefits mixed builds, it will be interesting to see what the zoo players come up with to maximize the value from this one. Good card, needs to be built into.

Harnessed Antlion is a well statted 4 drop minion that pulls 3 cost spells from your deck. Seems pretty fucking good to me.

Ensnared chargers is a pretty crazy card that can wipe a board with one attack, very strong. Everborns for war are going bananas in this set. These cards are strong even outside of everborn. 

Brash freeman is a strong card, even at base it likely has at least 2 damage for it and whatever tribe your opponent controls and can stack beyond that based on how \

either of you are. Interesting card, very fun and potentially a strong effect if used right. Well designed. 

The garrison on the edge is a VERY interesting card that I personally find enjoyable and lore thematic. I imagine it's what stops the game ending 
9 mana drop (see later) that was printed for everborns. Pretty cool and a pretty strong card. There are a lot of structure specific removal cards in GU so I don't see this becoming a problem really, the immediate on play effect is pretty cool though for a stonks frontline body. Very strong.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)



### Death: Buffing old archtypes


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tvXqosazrHH516TBK987E1ppLNSK5oAxuuDJvXRAtgJYCXrKwqZwz4PbUU59cNsnzmq.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tSMvztvG9MPgQsK4Xs9tKsfLofHeQQmyvzd3MVbe9z2khymUDJNVEAYQbEhcMLoXjBQ.png)


Death got reinforcements for it's older archtypes and tribals like anubians (but they also received a late game everborn and a strange aggro nether focused around a more zooish sort of deck). They are all strong and utile and pretty obvious to interpret, but I'll be dropping a tier list later explaining in more detail a few of these cards and why they are strong if it's still too vague.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)


### Light: Irina BUFFED?!?!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/EoCgBDMrJu8TPAXbY9XQSFdMCTNJ51HGbchHt9bD2qV7eegFK9PMqTuGdJYE11uVWrQ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tmBC9N7QDdVMSty8FRv7DYYDuLaAvVHJhKbnFWQvKhT9Kpp5TR8kjt8cB3si7CtpETR.png) 

The legendary light has printed this set buffs Irina light (pretty crazy to think about). A lot of the other cards are actually pretty interesting and sortof require building into to really shine. Nothing is weak persay but it's less general use than light and luster etc. of of the past. Interesting and strong cards, the only one that might see a change is the leggy methinks. Overall I like these cards, they do interesting things in interesting archtypes. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)


### Mage: Everborn Supremacy? 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tSKwqcvV1oq4ZKgdS1zUUFT8JqCX8ZwZfUUqjkvDb18Yis5xtTyMi6zb9cYFmR1NTw5.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23vhq37iJNVx2LUwzEhSs1Xc5K3XW5kZ8BzfxhfwgauDkLCMKB5MuPFbg3yvW3ALt7nae.png)

Mage got a massive shot in the arm for it's everborn archtype, Pallas seems honestly insane (genuinely a game ending 6 drop if left unremoved for even a turn), and a lot of the other cards actually just seem strong and utile. Nothing particularly crazy, but everything else is well stated. The 3 mana obliterate spell that heals both gods is a unique addition to mage and will help against Blackfire fledgling, which GU is still struggling to deal with since print (like much of tides of fate). Giving mage an everborn that transforms an enemy also gives it a strong edge in mirrors (ie transforming an all consuming into a 4/1 is pretty devastating) 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)



# Neutrals: Everborn expansion and additional strong tribal cards


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23uFK2S89VXrm38HerxMTbgLjpyyqARG9uvp3Zvy7SDDENTAQSwrDTNScXYsuLpvgJSVK.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23u5tB9Y4PD9Y8QoJm7vo7dSBsAknejn8VLpaWkEj7gqYhJPeLTXSeqdYs2pXTxPdSH38.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/EoGw2Lbp7BSx8hSob2yWCPJwc7eBnkXSVXtB9SJ3aCitoeuZXPnYQoiZgANEreKQw11.png)

These neutrals are strong and many of them fit in whichever deck. The 1 mana 4/4 everborn is pretty damn good (in any deck honestly),entangling horde is a strong 5 drop (not as overpowered as previously thought but still, the great finality can end the game with manasurge 12 (not achievable for most gods) but is more likely to be delved than to be actually slotted into a deck. Mycellium bloom is a good card that offers sporo generation outside of the broken seal, not to be underestimated and seems like a perfect setup for entangling horde. Biomass reconditioner and unique tactician are tech cards. Biomass does the standard \
slot in everborns (everborns definitely have it all at this point), whereas unique tactician offers something that basically removes \

as a gameplay mechanic for low hp creatures like mayday or sporophytes. Interesting card indeed. The One Who Remembers card is quite fun and genuinely will be enjoyed by a few dragon players I know, good card for the right highland style deck or singleton. Reader of bones seems like a strong card in a deck featuring various tempt fate cards, without using it's ability 3/4 for 3 mana gets outstatted pretty quickly in GU. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoniusrex/23tGTQn8nKsNEtG1dgEEyXU5x5sKZdYKmt3Mh9oGnkKkyFLuDLPe6M2ntaF19JnCw3ZaS.png)

# Talking Tidbits: Let loose the plague

I will be making a tierlist the day of the set and posting it here shortly after, let me just say I think almost every card in this set is pretty damn good considering. There isn't a garbage card outside of Overindulged Centurion (who is pretty garbage and wont be run in any deck outside of shine maxxing). This set is going to completely change the meta (if anyone decides to actually buy new cards and use them), but we may just stay stuck in our shine sickness. Since the only method these cards can enter the meta is direct purchase and there is not a way to actually play to obtain the new cards, there is a high likelihood this set won't see high participation or meta proliferation. Not to mention there are only like 200 copies of broken seal so even if people wanted to only a couple hundred players could even use many of the new cards. It's going to be an interesting time in GU, and expect a very fun event tomorrow to kick off the launch. There is a lot of fun in store for you guys. 

Thanks for reading this post, hitting that like button, commenting, or whatever else it is you did. Hell even just not throwing your computer out the window after viewing this is a compliment in my book. I still enjoy playing GU and still look forward to new cards, but I am a bit hesitant about these design funnels that are being made. It's not unheard of, it's just pretty risky in a game like GU with a limited supply of cards. In something like hearthstone these design directions don't really matter because there would be an endless amount of broken seals for those who wish to craft them, GU doesn't have that. So it's a tough position to design around. Anyway, Rex signing off and I'll see you folks tomorrow partying like a squeak and dropping that tierlist.

body.title: Goethe und Schiller: Warum die Weimarer Klassik bis heute lebt
body.body:
# Goethe und Schiller: Warum die Weimarer Klassik bis heute lebt

![Goethe und Schiller: Warum die Weimarer Klassik bis heute lebt](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1619709516955-8dd7e2fb067a?crop=entropy&cs=tinysrgb&fit=max&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NDgzODF8MHwxfHJhbmRvbXx8fHx8fHx8fDE3ODE0NTQyMzB8&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=80&w=1080)

---

Johann Wolfgang von Goethe und Friedrich Schiller sind die wohl bekanntesten Namen der deutschen Literaturgeschichte. Ihre Freundschaft, ihre Werke und die kulturelle Blüte Weimars am Ende des 18. Jahrhunderts haben das deutsche Selbstverständnis geprägt wie kaum ein anderes Kapitel der Geschichte.

## Zwei gegensätzliche Genies

Goethe und Schiller hätten kaum unterschiedlicher sein können. Goethe, 1749 in Frankfurt geboren, war ein universaler Geist: Dichter, Naturforscher, Staatsmann, Kunsttheoretiker. Er schrieb mit Leichtigkeit und Fülle. Schiller, 1759 in Marbach geboren, war der leidenschaftlichere, kämpferischere Charakter - ein Poet der Freiheit und des moralischen Ideals, der sich die Anerkennung hart erkämpfen musste.

Ihr erstes Treffen 1788 war frostig. Erst 1794 begann durch einen Zufall eine Freundschaft, die zehn fruchtbare Jahre dauern sollte, bis Schillers früher Tod 1805 sie beendete. In dieser Dekade entstanden einige der bedeutendsten Werke der deutschen Literatur.

## Weimar als Kulturzentrum

Weimar, eine kleine Residenzstadt in Thüringen mit kaum mehr als 6.000 Einwohnern, wurde durch die Gunst der kunstsinnigen Herzogin Anna Amalia und ihres Sohnes Carl August zum kulturellen Mittelpunkt des deutschsprachigen Raums. Herder, Wieland, Goethe und Schiller versammelten sich hier.

Diese Konzentration von Talenten in einer kleinen Stadt ist historisch ungewöhnlich. Weimar wurde zum Synonym für die Weimarer Klassik - eine Epoche, die Humanismus, ästhetische Bildung und die Harmonie von Sinnlichkeit und Vernunft zum Ideal erhob.

## Die Werke

Goethe schrieb in dieser Zeit den zweiten Teil des \
- sein Lebenswerk, an dem er fast 60 Jahre arbeitete. \

- alle in wenigen Jahren.

Die gemeinsamen Balladen, die Xenien - satirische Epigramme gegen den Zeitgeist - und der intensive intellektuelle Austausch befruchteten beide. Die Freundschaft war produktiver Wettbewerb und gegenseitige Inspiration zugleich.

## Humanismus als Programm

Die Weimarer Klassik verstand sich nicht nur als ästhetisches, sondern als moralisches Programm. Die Bildung des Menschen zur freien, verantwortungsbewussten Persönlichkeit war das Ziel. Schillers Abhandlung \

legte dar, wie Kunst und Schönheit den Weg zur Freiheit ebnen können.

Dieser Humanismus beeinflusste das Bildungsideal des 19. Jahrhunderts fundamental. Das Gymnasium, das bis heute Schüler mit Goethe und Schiller vertraut macht, ist ein direktes Erbe dieser Epoche.

**Goethe und Schiller sind nicht nur Vergangenheit - ihre Fragen nach Freiheit, Verantwortung und dem Sinn des Lebens sind so aktuell wie je zuvor.**

---

*Dieser Beitrag wurde mit wissenschaftlichen Quellen erstellt.*

body.title: The Simulation, Source, and Breaking Free of the Matrix with Jeff Berwick
body.body:
by Outer Limits of Inner Truth Vigilante Edition on The Outer Limits of Inner Truth 
View my bio on Vigilante.TV: https://vigilante.tv/c/outerlimits [![The Simulation, Source, and Breaking Free of the Matrix with Jeff Berwick](https://vigilante.tv/lazy-static/previews/15777336-c0f2-4d3d-ae63-1cb05697e5eb.jpg)](https://vigilante.tv/w/j6M4CLSk7KbG74ChDMX3r2) 
 
 Jeff Berwick return to Outer Limits of Inner Truth to discuss simulation theory, the nature of consciousness, and what he believes happens to awareness after the body dies. Jeff lays out his core view that consciousness is the only thing that truly exists and that the physical world is best understood as a three dimensional video game we created for ourselves, an idea he uses to explain how a loving source could allow so much suffering inside its own creation. He walks through the reasoning that led him there, from questions about where the universe actually ends to the way a vivid dream feels completely real until you wake, and he connects all of it to the show’s running exploration of near death experiences, arguing that the so called matrix has levels and may continue even after death. Along the way he draws on his years of meditation and plant medicine and on the work of David Icke, including the unsettling notion that control oriented beings may operate in the spirit world as well.

From there Jeff turns to the systems of control he has written about for years as The Dollar Vigilante, describing central banking as a machine that runs on human fear and extracts value through currency itself, and positioning decentralized money like Monero as a way to starve that machine of power. He reads the turbulence of recent years, including the pandemic, as evidence of an old power structure losing its grip while a growing number of people wake up, and he frames fear as the real mechanism of control. The episode lands on a practical and almost meditative note, that hours of inner work and a genuine connection to source dissolve fear, and that once a person stops being afraid and starts living fully in the present, the system loses its leverage over them. He points listeners toward his writing at The Dollar Vigilante and his gatherings, Anarchapulco and Libertopia.

Website: https://dollarvigilante.com/

body.title: 面子和教育
body.body:
![1000028567-d0ddaa8053c2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/muwangxuan/lkt-mqdzlwxo-h8ffqk7z/1000028567-d0ddaa8053c2.webp)

![1000028566-a510e0ab4a63.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/muwangxuan/lkt-mqdzlwxo-h8ffqk7z/1000028566-a510e0ab4a63.webp)

![1000028565-46f1df403032.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/liketu/muwangxuan/lkt-mqdzlwxo-h8ffqk7z/1000028565-46f1df403032.webp)

我们总以为自己能比其他人，尤其是自己的长辈做的更好。
小时候的我们，看不惯父母的各种操作，为了几锄头的地和邻居大打出手。
为了让村里人看得起，贷款借钱都要盖房子，买车子。
表面日子红红火火，背地里其实早就入不敷出。
想起以前老师和我们讲的故事，就是类似那种晚清贵族子弟，为了出门不败露自己的日子窘迫，就用那种肥猪肉去抹自己的嘴皮子，造成一种今天又吃肉的感觉，但是可能今天吃的就是咸菜馒头。
记得小时候听故事的自己，还觉得好好笑，有必要嘛。
但是对比到村里人宁愿贷款借钱都要那个面子，好像我又释然了。
等到慢慢长大，忽然就开始佩服自己的父母或者爷爷奶奶辈。
觉得他们当初年纪轻轻就能盖房子，甚至还是青砖大院。
不禁升起一股一代不如一代的颓然之感。
或许，这就是我们的矛盾式亲子关系。
不仅仅是在外在的经济条件下。
哪怕是在内在的心理层面，也是如此。
我们总在想，当初父母的教育方式，我一定不要在让他出现在我后代身上。
比如留守儿童，比如忽略校园暴力，比如和子女不亲近等。
但是慢慢就发现，还得是霍元甲说的那句话有道理：当年父亲的拳，不够快，更不更狠！
我们总以为我们的教育方式能超越父辈，超越爷爷奶奶。
但却忘记了，每代人都在努力当好父母。
就好比大部分人的父母或许都会为了分家时的两间瓦房和几分地而吵的老死不相往来。
却总觉得以后自己教育的子女一定就不会这样，就能够相互帮衬。
是不是挺讽刺的。
回望历史，别说普通人，那些皇帝也没几个人敢说自己能教好自己子女吧。
李世民，天可汗，对吧，一个时代的主角，文韬武略，可谓在所有帝王里都是数一数二的存在，然后呢，太子李承乾是个什么下场？
汉武帝也是一样，晚期的巫蛊之祸，生生把太子刘据和卫子夫以及一大批的高级将领弄没了。
康熙的九子夺嫡就更不用说，从小看到大的清宫戏。
所以啊，我们和父母其实都差不多。
没有差那么多，也不会好太多。
我们总以为我们多读两年书，到时候就能比父母懂更多，但真不是的。
有人说，上帝在掷骰子，当然，上帝到底存不存在不知道，或许的确存在，但世界，的确是充满了随机性。
教育是一方面，但随机性，亦或者说命，真的又是另外一方面……
你觉得呢？

body.body:
Day 17 felt like one of those ordinary days that quietly gets the job done. Nothing dramatic happened today. No record-breaking step count, no extra-long workout, no sudden burst of motivation. Just a simple morning routine—walk, a bit of jogging, and some exercises to wake the body up. The kind of session I probably wouldn’t have thought twice about a month ago. The rest of the day unfolded naturally. A walk after lunch, another after dinner, and the usual daily activities kept me moving without really trying to force it. By the evening, I checked my tracker and saw 14k steps. What made me smile was realizing how different that feels now. Earlier in the challenge, I was always thinking about the number. Today, the movement happened first and the steps followed. I think that’s when a routine starts becoming a habit—when you stop negotiating with yourself and just do the thing. Day 17/30 complete ✅ What’s a habit you’ve stuck with long enough that it now feels automatic? #actifit #11kchallenge #day17 #dailymovement #walkandjog #keepgoing
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ghouse25/actifit-ghouse25-20260614t162047620z)_

# The Masked Garden: A Letter on Digital Shadows

>from Imgflip Meme Generator ## Prologue: The Wolf in Silk Clothing There is a particular danger in the digital age: the freedom to become anyone, to wear any face, to speak with any voice. The internet is not a town square. It is a masquerade ball held in a hall of mirrors. Some who smile at you through the screen wear masks crafted not of paper, but of intention. They butter your words with praise, sweeten your doubts with promises, and wrap their requests in the velvet of friendship. Be very careful. --- ## I. The Art of the Gentle Trap They do not come with threats. They come with compliments. *\
*\n\nThese are not kindnesses. They are hooks, baited with the sugar of validation. The hand that offers a coin may be the same hand that reaches for your dignity. The voice that whispers *\

* may be rehearsed, recycled, repurposed for a hundred others just like you.

Many old men pretend to be young. Many wolves dress in the wool of lambs. They play games—not with pieces on a board, but with hearts and hopes. They learn your dreams, your fears, your loneliness, and they use that knowledge not to lift you, but to lower your guard.

---

## II. The Currency of Compliance

Each small \

They do not want your trust. They want your silence.\n\nAnd once they have that silence, the price changes. The favor grows. The request darkens. The \

becomes a debt, and the debt becomes a chain.

## III. The Armor of Awareness

How do you walk through the masked ball without losing yourself?

**1. Trust the tremor in your spirit.**  
If a request feels heavy, if a compliment feels calculated, if a promise feels too sweet—pause. That unease is not weakness. It is wisdom whispering.

**2. Remember: real care does not rush.**  
Genuine friendship does not demand proof. Authentic opportunity does not require secrecy. If someone pressures you to act quickly, to keep secrets, to bypass your judgment—they are not building a bridge. They are digging a trap.

**3. Speak. Always speak.**  
Tell someone. A parent. A sibling. A teacher. A friend you trust. Say the words out loud: *\

* The moment you speak, the shadow loses power. Secrets thrive in silence; truth dissolves them.

**4. You are not a commodity.**  
Your image, your time, your trust—these are not products to be sold. They are pieces of your soul. No amount of money, no flood of flattery, is worth trading them away.

---

## IV. The Courage to Walk Away

It is not weak to walk away. It is not rude to say no. It is not unkind to protect yourself.

The person who truly cares for you will respect your boundaries. The person who does not will reveal themselves in their anger, their guilt-tripping, their sudden silence. Let that revelation be your compass.

You are not responsible for managing their disappointment. You are responsible for honoring your own worth.

---

## Epilogue: The Light You Carry

The digital world is vast, and not all who wander it are lost. There are genuine souls, true friendships, real opportunities. But they do not ask you to dim your light to find them.

Stay aware. Stay connected. Stay vocal.

And if ever you feel the tug of a hook disguised as a hand, remember:

> *The most powerful word you can speak is \

*  
> *The safest place you can stand is beside someone who loves you.*  
> *The truest freedom you can claim is the right to protect your own heart.*

Be careful. Be kind—to others, yes, but first to yourself.

And never, ever let anyone convince you that your safety is negotiable.

body.title: Signs and symptoms of oral cancer
body.body:
Hello everyone!!!
Namaste and greetings.

Oral cancer is a major health problem that can affect the lips, buccal mucosa, floor of mouth, tongue and palate. It it particularly common in south east Asian countries like India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan where the habit of chewing *paan masala* and *Gutkha* is high.

Although the late detection has a bad prognosis, early detection of these cancers helps to live a better and quality life in a cancer free state from early intervention.

**Common signs and symptoms of oral cancer**
a) A chronic non-healing ulcer: A persistent ulcer in the oral cavity may be an alarming sign of oral cancer. Any cancer that does not heal on its own within 2-3 weeks must seek medical attention and a biopsy for histopathological examination is must for confirmation.

b) Whitish or reddish patches: Also termed as leukoplakia and erythroplakia respectively, these lesions must me addressed accordingly and cautery fulguration followed by histopathological examination must be done as these lesions are pre- cancerous and have a high chance of undergoing malignant changes.

![Leukoplakiaaitor.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdc1QBaoWhEJXUuuh3fjeUxAiw98PR1baqgdA3zXfdH8E/Leukoplakiaaitor.jpg)
 Fig: Leukoplakia 
Credits : Wikimedia commons


![istockphoto-2208312981-1024x1024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNVyp3i8duowF1yenPpaPxAHKhyG2f3VTaNZberHC692G/istockphoto-2208312981-1024x1024.jpg)
Fig: erythroplakia 
Credits: Pixabay
c) Swelling in neck and oral cavity: If the lesions have spread to the regional lymph nodes, it may present as neck swelling. Also some cancers of oral cavity may present as a lump or swelling in the tongue, floor of mouth and the buccal mucosa.

![Cervical_lymphadenopathy_right_neck.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcm29P5KQbKoPp9SCxY1AuvcP2mQPnPw51TMLegF8cc6j/Cervical_lymphadenopathy_right_neck.png)
 Fig: cervical lymphadenopathy 
Credits : Wikimedia commons 

d) Painful swallowing: cancers of the hypopharyngeal regions and oropharynx may present as painful swallowing. If the painful swallowing is chronic, then a flexible nasopharyngolaryngoscopic examination followed by biopsy from the suspicious site should be done.

e) Unexplained bleeding: Persistent bleeding from the oral cavity without an obvious trauma may be suspicious and should be dealt accordingly.

f) Unexplained weight loss: Unintentional weight loss of more than 10% body weight within 6 months time interval is significant and prompts intervention.

body.title: El Loro Guaro – A very noisy visit |El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora
body.body:
![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23yJDwzJLEuyDkWsQdcCCLbmLi4FCZWAgmtErNTxxkefVGVw1ERFnEq3p7MzdQp12WsoS.jpg)

<div class=\

>

In English

Yellow-crowned Amazon (Amazona ochrocephala) On this occasion, the species that visited our balcony is a parrot, specifically a Yellow-crowned Amazon (also known as the Yellow-crowned Amazon, Yellow-fronted Amazon or, scientifically, as Amazona ochrocephala).

>

En Español

Saludos amigos de la comunidad de #AmazingNature, bienvenidos a mi blog, deseo que tengan un bonito Domingo familiar donde abunden los buenos momentos y la alegría de un nuevo día. Como lo he comentado en varias ocasiones, sobre una parte de la vista que tengo del Parque Nacional del Ávila y para mí es un privilegio para observar diferentes aves, por lo que hoy quiero compartir con ustedes.

Loro Guaro (Amazona ochrocephala)

En esta oportunidad la especie que visitó nuestro balcón, es un loro, específicamente un Loro Guaro (también conocido como Amazonas coroniamarilla, loro frentiamarillo o científicamente como Amazona ochrocephala. ![cautiva separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tmNGfDYBRVyp95Di1yvZXT1d5P5LhnFuedNh2tpWWUJhwr2ZG7v9BZhTfKrLXRPqAKo.jpg) ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23yJEA9EiKcPVKHknXeeDd1DEHNXakfUdLK3k5Ev3N68tkVjH1x9g5VPdGNHABeMwc5UY.jpg)

> It is a medium-sized South American bird (around 33 cm) that is very popular in Venezuela. It is characterised by its bright green plumage, a forehead with yellow or white spots, yellowish cheeks, a blue eye ring and orange markings on its wings.

Some interesting facts

This species of bird **is very social**, as they usually fly in pairs or large flocks. They have a great ability to communicate through various calls and vocalisations. Like many other species of parrots, **they can live for a very long time**, with an average lifespan of between 30 and 40 years. These species **inhabit tropical rainforests, woodlands and savannahs** from Colombia, through Venezuela, to Brazil and Peru. **Parrots frequently feed on tender shoots**—which include young leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds—in their natural environment; they consume the fruits and excrete the seeds at a distance or carry them attached to their feathers. As a result, they play a crucial role in **seed dispersal within the ecosystem**, as this prevents plants from competing with one another for light, water and nutrients, and helps to maintain biodiversity.

> Es un ave sudamericana de tamaño mediano (unos 33 cm) muy popular en Venezuela. Se caracteriza por su plumaje verde brillante, una frente con manchas amarillas o blancas, mejillas amarillentas, anillo ocular azul y detalles anaranjados en las alas.

Algunos datos curiosos

Esta especie de aves **son muy sociales**, ya que suelen volar en parejas o grandes bandadas. Tienen una gran capacidad para comunicarse mediante diversas llamadas y vocalizaciones. Como muchas otras especies de loros, **pueden llegar a ser muy longevos**, viviendo entre 30 y 40 años en promedio. Estas especies **habitan en selvas tropicales, bosques y sabanas** desde Colombia, pasando por Venezuela, hasta Brasil y Perú. **Los loros se alimentan frecuentemente de brotes tiernos**, que son hojas jóvenes, flores, frutas y semillas en su entorno natural, consumen los frutos y excretan las semillas a distancia o las transportan adheridas a sus plumas. Con ello su aporte es crucial para la **dispersión de semillas en el ecosistema**, ya que evita que las plantas compitan entre sí por la luz, el agua y los nutrientes, y ayuda a mantener la Bio diversidad. ![cautiva separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tmNGfDYBRVyp95Di1yvZXT1d5P5LhnFuedNh2tpWWUJhwr2ZG7v9BZhTfKrLXRPqAKo.jpg) ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wqik5GkTnQbCEwFJtNt2zgCSNYd2G4sFpjChUfLu95SNLNxzuz2VMuFFdqtq1TBSkGj.jpg)

> In this city, it is extremely common to see these parrots (and macaws) visiting the balconies and windows of flats in search of food or just out of curiosity. In this image, it can be identified by the following characteristics visible in the photo:

> En esta ciudad es sumamente común ver a estos loros (y a las guacamayas) visitando los balcones y ventanas de los apartamentos en busca de comida o curioseando. En esta imagen se puede identificar por las siguientes características visibles en la foto: ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23ywry52ba6FeTmwKJxXD1nyd7Yw15PqCPJReyEga82B4iByagC4rJU9enzyxsfvXYTUN.jpg)

> * **Mainly green plumage:** This is the base colour of its entire body. * **Yellow crown:** It has a very distinctive yellow patch on the top of its head (the forehead and crown). * **Dark beak:** Its beak is robust and greyish-dark in colour, typical of this species of Amazon parrot

> * **Plumaje principalmente verde:** Es el color base de todo su cuerpo. * **Corona amarilla:** Tiene una mancha amarilla muy distintiva en la parte superior de la cabeza (la frente y la corona). * **Pico oscuro:** Su pico es robusto y de un tono grisáceo/oscuro, típico de esta especie de amazona. ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xVK5SdqrMXeTFU346pC1nR6zDuSRRfnAxKjHLWTrzKzmRzxb2RfUijhZ2wCqsU9evYH.jpg)

>

Key distinguishing features:

* **-Yellow crown:** The yellow patch on its forehead and the top of its head stands out clearly against the green of its body. * **-White eye ring:** The area of bare white skin around its eye is clearly visible, a very typical feature of Amazon parrots. * **-Compact silhouette:** Its short, square tail is the unmistakable hallmark of this genus of parrots, distinguishing them completely from macaws or long-tailed parakeets.

>

Los detalles clave que lo caracterizan:

* **-La corona amarilla:** La mancha amarilla en su frente y parte superior de la cabeza resalta claramente contra el verde de su cuerpo. * **-Anillo ocular blanco:** Se alcanza a notar el área de piel blanca y desnuda alrededor de su ojo, un rasgo muy típico de las amazonas. * **-Silueta compacta:** Su cola corta y cuadrada es la firma inconfundible de este género de loros, diferenciándolos por completo de las guacamayas o los pericos de cola larga. ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wqkafy2KRq2NyYevRtQMWvBHkG2rNWEBPUV5TmKphTpLyQzzz3H4eaNfzWPNnoTWT4s.jpg)

> He seems to be quite at home on our balcony; it’s a real privilege to have visitors like this in my garden. To be honest, having a spot in our home where this brown-headed parrot chooses to stop and rest is, I think, a luxury you don’t find just anywhere in the world. So I think our balcony or garden has become the perfect stop for them as they fly across the city. Among other interesting facts about these new neighbours is that **they are loyal and monogamous**; these parrots form lifelong pairs. For example, when I was taking photos of one of these little friends with my phone, its mate arrived – I imagine it had been flying nearby or waiting for it in one of the leafy trees at the back of our garden. This confirms to me that they don’t go it alone. Here’s the perfect pair:

> Se ve que se siente bastante cómodo en nuestro balcón, es un gran privilegio tener estas visitas en mi jardín. La verdad es que tener un rincón en nuestra casa donde este Loro Guaro decida pararse a descansar, creo que es un lujo que no se vive en cualquier parte del mundo. Entonces creo que nuestro balcón o jardín se ha convertido en su parada perfecta mientras cruza la ciudad. Entre otros datos curiosos sobre estos nuevos vecinos, es que **Son fieles y monógamos**, estos loros forman parejas para toda la vida. Por ejemplo, cuando estaba capturando las imágenes con mi teléfono de uno de estos amiguitos, llegó su compañero o compañera, me imagino que estaba volando muy cerca o esperándolo en uno de los árbol frondoso que tenemos al fondo de nuestro entorno. Esto me confirma que no andan solos, Aquí les muestro a la pareja perfecta: ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (7).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23wWwKckz8g1eriH3B76vddWoJ186ZeEjm5bXaM4d6iAkuCce8X8bWEkfFj7dgnQTh9nJ.jpg)

> However, there is a fascinating detail in this photo, as we may be looking at two different species of parrot sharing the same space, or at least two individuals with very different features: * **The one at the bottom:** This is the same **Yellow-fronted Amazon** (*Amazona ochrocephala*) as in the previous photos, with its very distinctive and striking yellow forehead. * **The one above:** if you look closely at its head, you can’t see the yellow patch on its forehead; it appears completely green (or perhaps with a very slight bluish tinge on the crown, although the light doesn’t help much in making this out, and it might mean that it is a **Royal Parrot**. (*Amazona farinosa*), which is noticeably larger and a duller green, or a juvenile yellow-crowned macaw that has not yet developed the yellow plumage on its head. Receiving these visitors in the garden or on the balcony is always a magical moment, especially when it’s a pair; the fact that they’ve decided to perch there for the first time means that our space has given them complete confidence and security from the heights of the city.

> Sin embargo, hay un detalle fascinante en esta foto, ya que podríamos estar ante dos especies distintas de loros compartiendo el mismo espacio, o al menos dos individuos con rasgos muy diferentes: * **El de abajo:** Es el mismo **Loro Guaro** (*Amazona ochrocephala*) de las fotos anteriores, con su frente amarilla súper marcada y llamativa. * **El de arriba:** al mirar bien en su cabeza, no se le ve la mancha amarilla en la frente; se nota completamente verde (o quizás con una tonalidad azulada muy leve en la corona, aunque la luz no ayuda mucho para detallarlo y tal vez podría significar que es un **Loro Real**.(*Amazona farinosa*), que es notablemente más grande y de un verde más opaco, o un juvenil de loro guaro que aún no ha desarrollado el plumaje amarillo en su cabeza. Recibir estas visitas en el jardín o balcón siempre es un momento mágico, sobre todo cuando se trata de una pareja doble, que hayan decidido posarse ahí por primera vez significa que nuestro espacio les generó total confianza y seguridad desde las alturas de la ciudad. ![El Loro Guaro - Una visita muy sonora (8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23xKvGsMQa6H5fQwjaMQ6HCozcY5NwKCBWEvW52vnV4imXhVuaxVCc8DjHgSWkKKGQVsj.jpg) ![cautiva separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23tmNGfDYBRVyp95Di1yvZXT1d5P5LhnFuedNh2tpWWUJhwr2ZG7v9BZhTfKrLXRPqAKo.jpg)

> As this is their first time visiting our home, I’ll bear in mind a few useful tips to help them feel at ease and ensure this visit becomes a lovely routine: * **Provide a bowl of water:** More than food (as the city’s vegetation provides them with plenty of fruit and seeds), a heavy, sturdy container of fresh, clean water is a magnet for them, especially on hot days. * **Do not offer processed foods:** If I were ever to leave them anything, it should only be fresh fruit (bananas, papayas) or natural sunflower seeds. No foods containing salt or sugar, as these are very harmful to their digestive system. Being able to enjoy the moment and the loud calls they made when they announced their arrival was thrilling, and I want to be prepared, because if they like the place, it’s very likely they’ll start turning up early in the morning or late in the afternoon. The truth is, I was very lucky to manage to capture both of them in the same photo, and I hope this is the first of many visits. Thank you for reading.

> Ya que es la primera vez que llegan a nuestro hogar, tendré en cuenta unos datos útiles para que se sientan cómodos y este encuentro se convierta en una bonita rutina: * **Colocarle un recipiente con agua:** Más que comida (ya que la vegetación de la ciudad les da bastantes frutos y semillas), un envase pesado y firme con agua fresca y limpia es un imán para ellos, especialmente en los días calurosos. * **No ofrecer alimentos procesados:** Si alguna vez me animaría a dejarles algo, que sea sólo fruta fresca (cambur, lechosa) o semillas de girasol naturales. Nada de alimentos con sal o azúcar, ya que son muy dañinos para su sistema digestivo. Permitirnos disfrutar el momento y la vocalización sonora cuando avisaron que llegaron, fue emocionante y quiero preparme, porque si les gusta el lugar, es muy probable que empiecen a llegar temprano en la mañana o al final de la tarde, la verdad es que tuve mucha suerte al lograr capturar a ambos en la misma foto y ojalá sea la primera de muchas visitas. Gracias por su amable lectura. ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. > **Nos hemos convertido en una sociedad individualista y ese ha sido el origen de todos nuestros males.** Hace unas semanas escribía en mis notas para un post en Hive Blog: *nos hemos convertido en una sociedad individualista...* Había leído un post aquí que me hizo reflexionar sobre ello. Pero no escribí nada al respecto principalmente por falta de tiempo. Hasta que hoy veo un post en Threads de una mujer donde hablaba sobre cómo los abuelos dejaron de ser abuelos, así como la familia en general dejó de ser una red de apoyo. Si lo pensamos, siendo conscientes, todos los problemas que tenemos como sociedad vienen de un solo lugar: **El hogar.** También se puede ir más allá e investigar acerca de la vida de personas que fueron terribles e hicieron mucho daño. Con ello observaremos algo curioso: tuvieron una infancia terrible, padres ausentes, violencia y otros. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**We have become an individualistic society, and that has been the root of all our problems.** > >A few weeks ago, I wrote in my notes for a post on Hive Blog: *we have become an individualistic society...* > >I had read a post here that made me reflect on this. But I didn't write anything about it, mainly due to lack of time. Until today, when I saw a post on Threads by a woman who was talking about how grandparents stopped being grandparents, just as the family in general stopped being a support network. > >If we think about it consciously, all the problems we have as a society come from a single place: **The home.** > >We can also go further and investigate the lives of people who were terrible and caused a lot of harm. We will observe something curious: they had terrible childhoods, absent parents, violence, and other issues.
![photo_2026-06-14_12-05-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EpNor4wdQ7a231mkm2Q8D4c64jA5xB5NztRjvbfAvGFqkRwJiHm9Y8sh9h1vdra89ft.jpg)

, si tienes vicios o haces cosas malas que ven tus hijos, no vas a transmitir ningún mensaje positivo** Hace unos días escuchaba atentamente un problema. Una familia totalmente destruida, donde cada persona ha hecho locuras. Y la mayoría tiene vicios que han marcado su vida. También escuchaba sobre ello que en su familia sus padres enseñaron valores. El único problema es que eran valores de palabra nada más. Había mucha violencia en el hogar, así como también vicios como el alcohol. Así que me impresionó la forma en la que la persona estaba convencida de que solo bastaba con enseñar valores de la boca hacia afuera sin importar las acciones. Lo que me hace también pensar en que todo lo que sucedió en ese hogar durante la infancia de esas personas marcó de forma negativa su vida. Al punto de que hoy en día su vida es un desastre. Así pasa en muchos hogares a nivel mundial. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**At home it is not enough to \

, if you have vices or do bad things that your children see, you will not transmit any positive message** > >A few days ago I was listening carefully to a problem. A totally destroyed family, where each person has done crazy things. And the majority have vices that have marked their lives. > >He also heard about it that in his family his parents taught values. The only problem is that they were just word values. There was a lot of violence in the home, as well as vices such as alcohol. > >So I was impressed by the way the person was convinced that it was enough to just teach values ​​by word of mouth regardless of actions. > >Which also makes me think that everything that happened in that home during those people's childhood had a negative impact on their lives. To the point that today his life is a disaster. > >This is what happens in many homes around the world.
![photo_2026-06-14_12-05-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EoAc5AtPSfG5euCxCMVDmoXEe9zxWTQWLzNYvKjVmKue6n13NHkRwuprrGG6FSTMHoe.jpg)

>

**También vemos cómo la familia deja de ser la red de apoyo**

Cuando suceden este tipo de situaciones, se ven familias fragmentadas. 

Hijos en un lugar del mundo, en diversos estados, el núcleo familiar se separa. Pero no solo ello, sino que también se olvidan por completo de sus familiares. 

Esto es aún más común hoy en día. Vivimos en una sociedad individualista donde se ha fomentado el *\

*. Con ello se quita la responsabilidad del padre, así como del núcleo familiar en general. El resultado de ese desastre y egoísmo es lo que vemos en Latinoamérica: mujeres criando solas a sus hijos. Con ojeras que muestran cómo se sienten por dentro. Cansadas, solas, sin ayuda ni apoyo de nadie. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**We also see how the family ceases to be a support network.** > >When these kinds of situations occur, we see families fragmented. > >Children scattered across the world, in different states, the family unit is separated. But not only that, they also completely forget about their relatives. > >This is even more common today. We live in an individualistic society where the idea that \

has been fostered. > >This removes the responsibility of the father, as well as that of the family unit in general. > >The result of this disaster and selfishness is what we see in Latin America: women raising their children alone. With dark circles under their eyes that show how they feel inside. Tired, alone, without help or support from anyone.
![photo_2026-06-14_12-05-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EoChZjR9HdCGcvRqrPkaJiM7vdiEHYLd24513KVRLxSEZV4jxFzF6miz5mvHQdzfgKJ.jpg)

> **Entonces, ¿cómo esperamos que existan cambios positivos en la sociedad si no actuamos como COMUNIDAD?** Los seres humanos somos seres sociables, no podemos aislarnos porque esto afecta nuestra mente. + [Podemos leer más sobre ello en: The Brain’s Need for Social Connection de la web Mental Health Center](https://www-mentalhealthctr-com.translate.goog/how-social-isolation-affects-mental-and-cognitive-health/?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=es&_x_tr_pto=tc) Entonces, si así de grave es para nuestra mente el aislamiento social, *¿qué tan grave lo es para una madre, un padre e hijos que no tienen red de apoyo?* Sí, hay padres que han estado solos con sus hijos y hacen todo lo posible para lograrlo. Pero hay otros a los que les cuesta mucho más. Incluso, a esos que pudieron solos, puedo apostar a que hubiese sido excelente que tuviesen una red de apoyo. Sobre ello he estado leyendo un interesante artículo que hoy (además del artículo anterior) también quiero compartir contigo: [La importancia de la red de apoyo siendo mamá soltera de la web Club mamas y papas](https://clubmamasypapas.com/contenidos/post/la-importancia-de-la-red-de-apoyo-siendo-mama-soltera) Lo primero que me llamó la atención sobre este tema del que te comento es que en una búsqueda simple en Google hay pocos artículos relacionados con el tema. Incluso, tienes que buscar arduamente. *¿Por qué se habla poco de esto si es tan importante para la sociedad?* Quizás no quieren que se hable de ello. No lo sé. Lo que sí sé es que este artículo basado en la experiencia de una mujer te puede hacer ver lo que sucede cuando se cría sola a un hijo, así como también lo importante que es la red de apoyo para la crianza del futuro de la sociedad, *nuestros niños*. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**So, how can we expect positive changes in society if we don't act as a COMMUNITY?** > >Human beings are social beings; we cannot isolate ourselves because this affects our minds. > >+ [You can read more about this in: The Brain’s Need for Social Connection from the Mental Health Center website](https://www-mentalhealthctr-com.translate.goog/how-social-isolation-affects-mental-and-cognitive-health/?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=es&_x_tr_pto=tc) > >So, if social isolation is this serious for our minds, *how serious is it for a mother, a father, and children who don't have a support network?* > >Yes, there are parents who have been alone with their children and do everything they can to cope. But there are others who find it much more difficult. Even for those who managed on their own, I'd bet it would have been excellent if they'd had a support network. > >I've been reading an interesting article on this topic that I also want to share with you today (in addition to the previous article): [The Importance of a Support Network for Single Mothers from the Club Mamas y Papas website](https://clubmamasypapas.com/contenidos/post/la-importancia-de-la-red-de-apoyo-siendo-mama-soltera) > >The first thing that struck me about this topic is that a simple Google search reveals very few articles related to it. You really have to search extensively. > >*Why is this so rarely discussed if it's so important to society?* > >Perhaps they don't want it to be talked about. I don't know. What I do know is that this article, based on a woman's experience, can show you what happens when you raise a child alone, as well as how important a support network is for raising the future of society, *our children*.
![photo_2026-06-14_12-05-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EpT4gT1RJYJU96UBZineBAEsjxRyQJ4XmC1ygR24UXqcVtPjhveV83jQH89HSSwNEps.jpg)

> **Debemos eliminar el pensamiento individualista** Creo que es sumamente necesario eliminar de nuestras mentes así como de las generaciones que se están criando para el futuro en este momento el pensamiento individualista.
