body.title: De un pequeño regalo a una gran bendición: La historia de nuestra cosecha de cambur manzano 🍌
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1bjzPTPkVVHraRsNZWoK61dGK2F6FBHtwmvLrasKA7G/1781453261440.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZQdpbeNSC6RgugBAXRBLRRLoDWipn2f5thwGvvanfa5U/1781452499072.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbFWeBfJDyDM88nGCgfBVs9pBiTm2aeC3MeemUKzVotV2/1781452499308.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTTd4FkVvK2bmo2c8zsqHt8T6UsfBULn2khvdSULzM7z/1781452499599.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW4b6PNYaCyGfHPiYR6HiBve13uMyXkS1bsu2T9KPfoWc/1781452499754.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma2itKiiqCQzz26H6WsihDDQ4C67XbpXfxbnfE5zKiBtr/1781452499892.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU6BXBgwh1rkGs8y43V1AjNQMHprDuRiwPvm1iHCaVWYZ/1781452556467.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNn8tiQHvhYwugTb55hV6LgPtY4EhhsvSbwDNE6yYvdzd/1781452556630.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPHsKsbQKHZA2oyFF6FokHHsWqEYXMXmy8byieFaEymA/1781452556760.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd7jRXEQHaJ5e6z7PEg4DnV1kdnbsSeNRFRtEggWJs1eW/1781452556897.jpg)

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>

¡El tiempo de Dios es perfecto y la naturaleza siempre premia la paciencia! Hoy quiero compartirles el hermoso proceso de este racimo de cambures manzanos que hoy por fin disfrutamos en casa.

Todo comenzó cuando me regalaron una pequeña planta. La sembré con muchísimo amor y la cuidaba todos los días, pero al principio me di cuenta de que no crecía. No me rendí: la aboné, le puse más atención y, poco a poco, empezó a tomar fuerza hasta que por fin floreció y nos dio su fruto. El peso era tanto que la mata casi se cae por falta de fuerza, ¡pero aguantó!

👦🏻 Una lección de paciencia para mi pequeño
Mi hijo estaba superinquieto. Cada vez que salía al patio me decía que cortara el racimo, pero aproveché el momento para enseñarle una gran lección de vida: hay que saber esperar para que las cosas salgan bien y tengan un sabor verdaderamente sabroso.

Cuando llegó el momento correcto, cortamos el racimo y lo pusimos a madurar. ¡El resultado final no pudo ser mejor! Obtuvimos unos cambures manzanos deliciosos.

Mi hijo los ha aprovechado al máximo: hemos hecho batidos deliciosos, los comemos bien fríos y, por supuesto, no nos quedamos con todo. Decidimos compartir una parte con nuestros vecinos, porque es hermoso dar un poco de lo que Dios y la naturaleza nos regalan.

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>

“Dar de gracia lo que por gracia se recibió.” ❤️

📸 Fotografías de mi autoría.

Cuéntenme, ¿qué es lo que más les gusta preparar cuando tienen cambures frescos en casa?, los leeré en los comentarios. 👇

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1bjzPTPkVVHraRsNZWoK61dGK2F6FBHtwmvLrasKA7G/1781452842269.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZQdpbeNSC6RgugBAXRBLRRLoDWipn2f5thwGvvanfa5U/1781452895850.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbFWeBfJDyDM88nGCgfBVs9pBiTm2aeC3MeemUKzVotV2/1781452896055.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTTd4FkVvK2bmo2c8zsqHt8T6UsfBULn2khvdSULzM7z/1781452896299.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW4b6PNYaCyGfHPiYR6HiBve13uMyXkS1bsu2T9KPfoWc/1781452896478.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma2itKiiqCQzz26H6WsihDDQ4C67XbpXfxbnfE5zKiBtr/1781452896615.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNn8tiQHvhYwugTb55hV6LgPtY4EhhsvSbwDNE6yYvdzd/1781452960887.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU6BXBgwh1rkGs8y43V1AjNQMHprDuRiwPvm1iHCaVWYZ/1781452961068.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPHsKsbQKHZA2oyFF6FokHHsWqEYXMXmy8byieFaEymA/1781452961299.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd7jRXEQHaJ5e6z7PEg4DnV1kdnbsSeNRFRtEggWJs1eW/1781452961436.jpg)

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>

God’s timing is perfect, and nature always rewards patience! Today, I want to share the beautiful journey of this bunch of cambures manzanos (apple bananas) that we are finally enjoying at home.

It all started when someone gifted me a small plant. I planted it with so much love and cared for it every day, but at first, I noticed it wasn't growing. I didn't give up: I fertilized it, gave it extra attention, and little by little, it grew strong until it finally bloomed and gave us its fruit. The bunch was so heavy that the tree almost fell over from the weight, but it held on!

👦🏻 A Lesson in Patience for My Little One
My son was super impatient. Every time he went out to the backyard, he would tell me to cut the bunch down. But I used that moment to teach him a great life lesson: we must learn to wait so that things turn out right and get that truly delicious flavor.

When the right time came, we cut the bunch and let them ripen. The final result couldn't have been better! We got the most delicious, sweet apple bananas.

My son has enjoyed them to the fullest: we’ve made delicious smoothies, eaten them nice and cold, and, of course, we didn't keep them all to ourselves. We decided to share some with our neighbors, because it’s beautiful to give back a little of what God and nature gift us.

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>


Freely we have received, freely we give.” ❤️

📸 Photos taken by me.

Tell me, what’s your favorite thing to make when you have fresh bananas at home? 👇

<center>🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿✨🌿🌸🌿</center>

In the grand, sweeping tapestry of existence, every thread is placed with intention. We all walk this earth carrying a quiet, unspoken mission. We are here for a reason, woven into the fabric of time for a purpose that often eludes us.

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《续弦夫人被团宠》（程宇峰x李靖也）
body.body:
![IMG_3316.jpeg](https://s2.loli.net/2025/12/26/ftLRslami6ONFIx.jpg)

短剧里看过挺多男主收养孩子，女主嫁过去做伪继母的。刷到这部真继母的剧还被评论区预警，我倒是觉得没啥感觉。关键男女主还是生面孔，妥妥就打开看啦。

从剧情的角度来说，女主跟男主属于先婚后爱主打一个随缘。她是现代穿越过去的，平生最大的愿望就是躺平做咸鱼。没想到被后来的继子摆了一道，不得不嫁给男主。

男主是京城的权臣，想嫁给他的人很多。女主成婚后也成了京中女子的眼中钉肉中刺，加上还有个杠精继子。一时间女主的婚后生活相当热闹，她也需要各种斗智斗勇。

在同继子和恶毒女配斗智斗勇的同时，男主也在她身上看到了出色的管家能力、教育善待两个幼子的耐心以及哄得了祖母驯服得了府内仆役们的本事，不知不觉爱上了。

故事的最后女主配男主解决了种种朝堂风波，最后收获了圆满。故事完整度挺好的，唯一美中不足的是我发现穿越剧的主角感觉都很接受留下来，没想过没现代的嘛？

从演员的角度来说，两个主角我之前都没看过他们的剧。他们的颜值和演技还是不错的，我特别喜欢女主的人设——既来之则安之，既然到了这个位置就好好做人/事。

总的来说，这部剧还挺精彩的，可以一看。


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物

如果你喜欢我的文章，欢迎留言与我交流

body.title: Przewrotna czerwcowa pogoda - My Actifit Report Card: June 14 2026
body.body:
## The unpredictable June weather


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXrUG1VjnWCL3uwtDNByVCDND4MQa2qcxHpwrMUhprR99/a00.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUWtYk1qRxT5tu5hyCtf89ddoakkyQWUZSD3oXhKmpTqe/a0.jpg)



The morning brought cold, windy, and rainy temperatures; it was barely 10 degrees Celsius, and there was no sign of change. However, the sun appeared in the afternoon, and I struggled to choose my wardrobe. I applied the old adage, \

and I wasn't wrong.\n>Poranek przyniósł zimo, wiatr i deszcz, było ledwie 10 stopni i nic nie zapowiadało zmian. Jednak po południu pojawiło się słońce i miałem problem z dobraniem garderoby. Wdrożyłem w życie znane przysłowie \

i się nie pomyliłem. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7Tinb5ySWyPp3Yh3mVDyTT2qcvdEgXV9zcUGs1RvfUv/a01.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas8qPm69sn6GhZhgc2zzVor4wjwTxGM3WzMqEqnk3pXb/a02.jpg) The nice weather appeared for an hour, then a cold shower came from the sky, which many people hadn't expected, and they marched in shorts and T-shirts. I grabbed a raincoat, a warm fleece, and an umbrella—a good move. This dynamic weather lasted all afternoon—sun, rain, wind. >Ładna pogoda pojawiła się na godzinkę, po czym przyszedł zimny prysznic z nieba, którego wiele osób się nie spodziewało i maszerowało w krótkich spodenkach i koszulka t-shirt. Wziąłem sobie kurtkę przeciwdeszczową, ciepły polar i parasol - to był dobry ruch. Taka dynamiczna pogoda trwała całe popołudnie - słońce, deszcz, wiatr. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUREbJ8P7nnywdm2YRR1vZqTXCdBebJngBh8v9RjZpgjN/a03.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaQi9HBfZfuQNcbhbZf4N2Md72kLg9D7fMS1roAdS1ZQp/a04.jpg) Of course, I fed the birds, and the sparrows and tits arrived. The rest of us went away for the weekend. But that's all well and good; maybe tomorrow will be better. >Ptaszki oczywiście nakarmiłem, przyleciały wróble i sikorki. Reszta gdzieś wybyła na weekend. Ale dobre i to, może jutro będzie lepiej. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpA6EjN4wHTkFXAUzzrQAt5eSWfuKdhy5iFi1z6pqBQq/a05.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ15eKCQuMyCXUhpZvuumUN2fnCF29cdygkjgFKXDF4Lr/a06.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYMSYUbsgzsSTKcSMxvCCkwdJFT2y1wpyGFnZHZynszf/ptaki.png)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@marianomariano/actifit-marianomariano-20260614t160006093z)_

This veil will be the light of my grave..* 
`O daughter of Eve, have you ever thought?`

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dabb9f38-bcf1-4821-a73a-d7e6b53067dc.jpg)
Which dress will accompany us in the solitude of the grave?
Expensive pairs, branded makeup, all the styles of beauty__ will all be buried in the dust.
*But that veil..*
The one who saved our modesty in the world.. which we wore for the pleasure of the Lord.. that same veil will become a shade of mercy for us in the grave.
Hazrat Fatima (RA) had said: *\

body.title: Hola, Hive Pets
body.body:
> Hoy quiero presentarles oficialmente a Percy, mi cachorro Cocker Spaniel, quien en muy poco tiempo se ha convertido en el verdadero rey de la casa. Desde que llegó, la tranquilidad desapareció por completo. Percy es un perrito muy curioso, inquieto y travieso. Tiene un talento especial para encontrar cualquier cosa que no debería morder y convertirla inmediatamente en su juguete favorito. Aunque, si soy sincera, sus víctimas preferidas siguen siendo mis manos, que reciben constantemente pequeños ataques llenos de energía.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4dvWg7mMaGZ1usAb7jfXi8crDZHSJjFNysZxwGs3A9D/1781359005224.jpg)
Pero detrás de toda esa hiperactividad se esconde un cachorro increíblemente cariñoso. Le encanta estar acompañado y siempre busca la compañía de algún miembro de la familia. Dormir solo definitivamente no es una opción para él; prefiere sentirse cerca de nosotros, ya sea para jugar, descansar o simplemente recibir mimos. Lo que más me llama la atención es cómo puede tener dos personalidades tan diferentes. Un momento está corriendo por toda la casa, investigando cada rincón y buscando alguna nueva travesura, y al siguiente está profundamente dormido en su cama, como si nunca hubiera estado causando caos unos minutos antes. A pesar de todas sus locuras, Percy ha llenado nuestro hogar de alegría, risas y mucho amor. Es imposible imaginar la casa sin verlo corretear de un lado a otro o buscar atención de todos los que estamos cerca. Algunas fotos de Percy durante sus actividades favoritas: Mordiendo sus juguetes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuXs8iCuJZqrbJusnY5tawJ3vaWAKxZGcwLBD61de61b/1781358899371.jpg)
Intentando alcanzar cosas que no debería.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRsYzZk1Gd38CcJjXcJxsZEwz9bnpooYpoxxHjCxzhpDK/1781358918723.jpg)
Durmiendo plácidamente después de gastar toda su energía.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSXgDcQ9JXz5mwGefizRkraqYmnXwVZr9PdNytnBXpoM8/1781358937208.jpg)
Imágenes de mi galería

A new fruit I saw, I did not know the name of this fruit before, it is Soursop fruit, these fruits look like leaves. Last week I went for a walk in a hill and saw many such fruit trees. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc8AJSKZmK3bdygp93p4bmKEtCEo16wCVCbdGDThHgm4b/1781451838758.jpg)| |-| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCxZEwXcP89nTV7NFMuDn91EPVhy4a7Pt36YT5sXu7Fn/1781451769903.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXKVcYYYABhYzqm5963jFZGA8qfjSZYPgzFXBwYDUpLr/1781451769979.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ2jHAkmk33TSHvW68u7m1y1WVgXmZDyS5VyoRXMF3Ea6/1781451770052.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvif5MjdUjEqwU2HZ5dw387rjgPAJHrrgu54hR8BV5Cp/1781451770117.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSE8Wnuu2JnHfEzvMVo1EYZFTXqGK1qvCc2124LWVrmAF/1781451770208.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRVr9mGJdzUjW82WhVGhfK7W3tseqAVzPwSi5BLPDZ8C/1781451838818.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGkSWvatpNomjQZLHjkJoiXMS7jNUiP5vEDSRRbmgiuw/1781451838902.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVnAJD5NPcUvHjEmXFA5b1oxHbtE8UKiK7JEpQ9N3cbc/1781451838973.jpg) I didn't know if they can be eaten, but I collected the pictures of this fruit and then learned about the fruit. They are available in some countries of the Asian continent, such as Malaysia, Indonesia, India, China, Pakistan, etc. This fruit is gaining popularity. However, I have never seen these fruits in Bangladesh before, but they may be there now. However, I cannot say how the fruits are eaten because I have never eaten them. They turn yellow when they ripen. When I was young, the color of this body is like the green leaves of a tree. Besides, there are small cuts on it. They are quite large in size. Darse cuenta de que hay gente que se juntan solo para hablar mal de ti o difamarte puede doler, pero en realidad es el reconocimiento más justo a tu persona. 

La gente no arma complot contra alguien que no brilla o que no tiene algo que ofrecer. 

Si se necesita crear chismes y buscar aliados para intentar invalidarte, es porque tu luz le resulta demasiado cegadora y saben que, uno a uno, no podrían contigo. 

La envidia siempre necesita refuerzos, porque es débil por naturaleza, pero la autenticidad se vale por sí sola. 

No te sientas menos por ser el blanco de atencion, incluso de la mal intencionada;.

Siente orgullo de saber que tu sola existencia tiene tanto poder que les obliga a juntar sus miserables criterios para intentar alcanzarte, y es porque tu fortaleza es real y mucho más grande de lo que te has atrevido a mostrar y ellos lo saben.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXES7F7m8eDDjp94zayGyUEN5iemnXmQgdHVhzgC9G4Zw/1781452256754.jpg)

ENGLISH

Realizing that there are people who get together only to speak badly of you or to slander you can hurt, but in reality, it's the fairest recognition of your person.

People don't plot against someone who doesn't shine or who has nothing to offer.

If they need to create gossip and seek allies to try to invalidate you, it's because your light is too blinding for them, and they know that, one on one, they couldn't handle you.

Envy always needs reinforcements, because it's weak by nature, but authenticity stands on its own.

Don't feel lesser for being the center of attention, even of ill-intentioned attention.

Be proud to know that your very existence has so much power that it forces them to gather their miserable criteria to try to reach you, and it's because your strength is real and much greater than you've dared to show — and they know it.

body.body: <center>[John Williams - Fan Network](https://jwfan.com/john-williams-disclosure-day-2026-all-we-know-so-far/)</center>\nThe fusion between image (whether still or moving) and sound is, without a doubt, one of the most beautiful things in the **Seventh Art**. The power of this combination (when done well, of course) can unleash an inexplicable \
in those who are immersed in a cinematic experience. Here, we are faced with a magnificent work done by the \

of sound, **John Williams**; proving what I am trying to say.\nAt the ripe **old age** of **94**, he works once again alongside another legend in the history of cinema, **Steven Spielberg** (who for the fifth time is working with a theme involving intelligent life outside planet Earth, but always with a different approach between each project), and together... They create a stupendous \

right before our eyes (and ears). If you want my review of the movie - *totally spoiler-free* - just click on the link in this [post]().\nMusically speaking, one of the strongest points of ***Disclosure Day*** is precisely its symphonic melody, which is extremely well orchestrated and conducted; not only by Williams himself... But also, by the duo formed by **Randy Kerbert** and **William Ross**. The weight of their work has a magnificent (almost hypnotic) force, and manages to intensify the movie completely whenever the soundtrack is present. Here is an extra \

within this great adventure.\nThroughout **15** totally immersive **songs** (and almost **65 minutes** of duration), the audience witnesses a true musical work of art, which literally holds our hands and throws us into the movie itself (which obviously makes more sense when the experience between these two arts is done in a unified way). However, it does so with very interesting levels of subtlety. The musical approach here is more restrained, without big explosions... But very special.\nEven with a simpler construction, this album achieves immense weight in its conception because it is its context that makes everything more relevant within the movie itself (music and movement are always connected). The narrative thread here is to have the music \

a feeling of wonder (which is blended through different layers) on the people in the face of the entire plot that is being built (both on and off the screen).
Williams' long (and beautiful) career has already built a legacy that also serves as an inspiration for those who want to follow in this same type of artistic segment within cinema, reminding us that admiring soundtrack compositions is something we should do more frequently, with care and attention. I personally always do this, but this art needs to be better appreciated by those who care more about images and less about sounds.
Technically speaking, the soundtrack was recorded with a (live) orchestra conducted by Williams himself, and this work became even more iconic because it is nothing less than the **30th collaboration** between him and Spielberg (by the way, it is worth emphasizing here that it was Spielberg himself who insisted that his friend do the soundtrack... even though Williams suggested that another professional do it). I was sincerely dazzled by such a touching work.
Soon (and most likely because of his advanced age), Williams will retire; however, I still hope to see him working on a few more films (preferably Spielberg movies, by the way) and delivering increasingly stunning works (even if it is very redundant to say this... after all, everything he touches turns to gold) within skillfully executed orchestral lines that favor a nostalgia that is strong, but sensitive.
---
<center>**CRÍTICA DE DISCO: “Disclouse Day” (2026) - John Williams**</center>
La fusión entre imagen (ya sea fija o en movimiento) y sonido es, sin duda, una de las mayores bellezas del **Séptimo Arte**. El poder de esta combinación (cuando se realiza bien, por supuesto) puede desatar una inexplicable oleada de emociones en quienes se sumergen en una experiencia cinematográfica. Aquí nos encontramos ante una magnífica obra del maestro del sonido, **John Williams**, que demuestra lo que quiero decir.
A sus **94 años**, vuelve a colaborar con otra leyenda del cine, **Steven Spielberg** (quien, por quinta vez, aborda un tema relacionado con la vida inteligente fuera de la Tierra, aunque siempre con un enfoque diferente en cada proyecto), y juntos... crean un estupendo truco de magia ante nuestros ojos (y oídos). Si quieres leer mi reseña de la película, sin spoilers, haz clic en el enlace de esta [publicación]().
Musicalmente hablando, uno de los puntos fuertes de ***El Día de la Revelación*** es precisamente su melodía sinfónica, magníficamente orquestada y dirigida; no solo por el propio Williams... Sino también, por el dúo formado por **Randy Kerbert** y **William Ross**. La fuerza de su trabajo es magnífica (casi hipnótica) y logra intensificar la película por completo cada vez que suena la banda sonora. Es un “personaje” más dentro de esta gran aventura.
A lo largo de **15 canciones** totalmente envolventes (y casi **65 minutos** de duración), el público presencia una verdadera obra de arte musical que literalmente nos toma de la mano y nos sumerge en la película (lo cual, obviamente, cobra más sentido cuando la experiencia entre estas dos artes se realiza de forma unificada). Sin embargo, lo hace con una sutileza muy interesante. El enfoque musical aquí es más contenido, sin grandes explosiones... Pero muy especial.
Incluso con una estructura más sencilla, este álbum alcanza una inmensa relevancia en su concepción, ya que es su contexto el que otorga mayor importancia a la película (música y movimiento siempre están conectados). El hilo conductor narrativo consiste en que la música \

una sensación de asombro (que se entrelaza a través de diferentes capas) en los espectadores, en medio de la trama que se desarrolla (tanto dentro como fuera de la pantalla). La larga (y brillante) trayectoria de Williams ya ha forjado un legado que sirve de inspiración para quienes desean seguir este mismo camino artístico en el cine, recordándonos que apreciar las composiciones de bandas sonoras es algo que deberíamos hacer con más frecuencia, con atención y dedicación. Personalmente, siempre lo hago, pero este arte necesita ser mejor valorado por quienes se centran más en las imágenes que en el sonido. Técnicamente hablando, la banda sonora se grabó con una orquesta (en vivo) dirigida por el propio Williams, y esta obra se volvió aún más icónica por ser nada menos que la **trigésima colaboración** entre él y Spielberg (por cierto, cabe destacar que fue el propio Spielberg quien insistió en que su amigo compusiera la banda sonora... aunque Williams sugirió que lo hiciera otro profesional). Me cautivó profundamente esta conmovedora obra. Pronto (y muy probablemente debido a su avanzada edad), Williams se retirará; sin embargo, aún espero verlo trabajando en algunas películas más (preferiblemente de Spielberg, por cierto) y creando obras cada vez más impresionantes (aunque suene redundante decirlo... al fin y al cabo, todo lo que toca se convierte en oro) con líneas orquestales magistralmente ejecutadas que evocan una nostalgia intensa pero sensible. ---
**CRÍTICA DE ÁLBUM: “Disclouse Day” (2026) - John Williams**
A fusão entre imagem (seja ela estática ou em movimento) e som, é sem a menor sombra de dúvidas, uma das coisas mais lindas da **Sétima Arte**. O poder dessa combinação (quando bem feita, é claro) pode desencadear uma inexplicável “onda de sentimentos” naquelas pessoas que estão imersas dentro de uma experiência cinematográfica. Aqui, estamos diante de um trabalho magnífico feito pelo “mago” do som **John Williams**; provando o que eu estou querendo afirmar. No alto dos seus **94 anos**, ele trabalha mais uma vez ao lado de uma outra lenda na história do cinema, **Steven Spielberg** (que pela quinta vez trabalha com uma temática envolvendo vida inteligente fora do planeta Terra, mas sempre com a abordagem diferenciada entre cada projeto), e juntos... Eles criam um estupendo “truque de mágica” bem diante dos nossos olhos (e ouvidos). Se quiser meu review sobre o filme - *totalmente sem spoilers* - basta clicar no link deste [post](). Musicalmente falando, um dos pontos mais fortes de ***Dia D*** é justamente à sua melodia sinfônica que é extremamente bem orquestrada e conduzida; não apenas pelo próprio Williams... Mas também, pela dupla formada por **Randy Kerbert** e **William Ross**. O peso do trabalho deles tem uma força magnífica (quase hipnotizante), e consegue intensificar o filme por completo sempre que a trilha sonora se faz presente. Eis aqui um “personagem” extra dentro dessa ótima aventura. Ao longo de **15 músicas** totalmente imersivas (e quase **65 minutos** de duração), o público testemunha uma verdadeira obra de arte musicada, que literalmente segura nossas mãos e nos jogam dentro do próprio filme (que obviamente faz mais sentido quando a experiência entre essas duas artes é feita de maneira unificada). No entanto, faz isso com níveis de sutileza bem interessantes. A abordagem musical aqui é mais contida, sem grandes explosões... Mas muito especial. Mesmo trazendo uma construção mais simples, esse álbum consegue imensamente pesado da sua concepção porque é o contexto dele que faz tudo se tornar mais relevante dentro do próprio filme (música e movimento estão sempre conectados). O fio narrativo aqui é fazer a música “imprimir” um sentimento de deslumbramento (que é mesclado por diferentes camadas) das pessoas diante de toda a trama que vai sendo construída (tanto dentro quanto fora das telas). A longínqua (e belíssima) carreira de Williams já construiu um legado que funciona também como uma inspiração para quem quer seguir nesse mesmo tipo de segmento artístico dentro do cinema, nos lembrando que admirar composições de trilhas sonoras é algo que devemos fazer com mais frequência, carinho e atenção. Eu particularmente sempre faço isso, mas é preciso que essa arte seja melhor apreciada com quem se importa mais com imagens e menos com os sons. Tecnicamente falando, a trilha sonora foi gravada com uma orquestra (ao vivo) conduzida pelo próprio Williams, e esse trabalho se tornou ainda mais icônico porque não é nada menos do que a **30ª colaboração** entre ele e Spielberg (aliás, vale à pena enfatizar aqui que foi o próprio Spielberg quem insistiu para que o amigo fizesse a trilha sonora... mesmo Wiliams sugerindo que outro profissional a fizesse). Eu sinceramente fiquei deslumbrado com um trabalho tão tocante. Em breve (e muito provavelmente por causa da sua idade avançada), Williams se aposente; porém, espero ainda poder vê-lo trabalhando em mais alguns filmes (preferencialmente em filmes do Spielberg, aliás) e nos entregando trabalhos cada vez mais estarrecedores (mesmo que seja muito redundante falar isso... afinal, tudo o que ele toca se transforma em ouro) dentro de linhas orquestrais habilmente executadas que favorecem uma nostalgia que é forte, mas sensível. body.body:
> Hello foodies, qué tal su fin de semana? Hoy por aquí amanecimos con ganas de desayunar algo rico, así que decidí preparar empanadas de pescado, pero como pueden ver, en lugar de eso terminé preparando unas deliciosas **rosquitas de pescado** tomando la idea de mi querida amiga @yris89 quien en nuestras conversaciones matutinas me había hablado de ellas varias veces y hoy por dicha lo recordé justo antes de comenzar a cocinar y aquí estamos!
Hello foodies, how was your weekend? We woke up here today craving a tasty breakfast, so I decided to make fish pasties, but as you can see, instead I ended up making some delicious fish fritters, taking inspiration from my dear friend @yris89, who had mentioned them to me several times during our morning chats. Luckily, I remembered them just before I started cooking, and here we are!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtsBJUg8qnYgME7JcfRC9F51d7XCmDKbmFCWKGEzrEam/1781452086350.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) La verdad no sé cómo no se me había ocurrido antes esta preparación ya que muchísimas veces he preparado bolitas de queso y de pescado, pero nunca había preparado rosquitas y creo que definitivamente estas me gustaron muchísimo más que las bolitas, y lo mejor de todo es que necesitas menos aceite que el que usarías tanto para las bolitas como para las empanadas, además se cocinan súper rápido y son muy sencillas de hacer por lo que para mí es una receta 10/10. Por otro lado son ideales para desayunar o cenar, también para ofrecerlos en alguna celebración o compartir familiar y para la merienda de los peques en el colegio, así que como ven tienen que guardar esta receta.
To be honest, I don’t know why I hadn’t thought of this before, as I’ve made cheese and fish balls loads of times, but I’d never made rings before, and I think I definitely liked these much more than the balls. Best of all, you need less oil than you would for either the balls or the fritters; they cook super-quickly and are very simple to make, so for me it’s a 10/10 recipe. What’s more, they’re ideal for breakfast or dinner, as well as for serving at a celebration or family get-together, and for the kids’ school snacks, so as you can see, you really must save this recipe.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBCn7rsxohcmxkJwRfQc7o1dimA4BxKSz8Wdnx3jt96g/1781451902105.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 2 tazas de pescado guisado 2 tazas de masa de harina de maíz precocido Aceite
2 cups of stewed fish 2 cups of pre-cooked cornflour dough Oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Para esta preparación decidí agregar a la masa un toque dulzón, tal cual como si fuese a preparar empanadas, porque sí, aquí en oriente las empanadas son dulcitas y ni les cuento lo deliciosas que quedan, así que decidí darle ese toque especial a las rosquitas. Por otro lado, el guiso de pescado es de **cachua**, ya que es el favorito de mis hijos, de hecho lo prefieren sobre la raya y el chucho, así que es el que generalmente preparamos en casa y lo que hice fue agregar el pescado a la masa e incorporar todo muy bien. Tomen en cuenta que el guiso no debe tener mucho líquido, de hecho yo dejé que este se secara casi por completo para no ablandar demasiado la masa, pero si esto sucede, solo deben agregar un poco más de harina y problema resuelto.
For this recipe, I decided to add a touch of sweetness to the dough, just as I would when making empanadas, because, well, here in the east, empanadas are sweet, and I can’t even begin to tell you how delicious they are, so I decided to give these doughnuts that special touch. As for the fish stew, it’s made with **cachua**, as it’s my children’s favourite; in fact, they prefer it to skate and dogfish, so that’s what we usually make at home. What I did was add the fish to the dough and mix everything together thoroughly. Bear in mind that the stew shouldn’t have too much liquid; in fact, I let it dry out almost completely so as not to make the dough too soft, but if this does happen, just add a little more flour and the problem is solved.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZcQrn4rE19nHEJP1nZbimay7mRotcrxUo2BvEcEfwqed/1781451466419.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Lista la masa es el momento de preparar las rosquitas y para esto solo tomamos una pequeña porción de masa, hacemos un rollito, luego unimos las puntas y listo, están listas para freírlas.
Once the dough is ready, it’s time to shape the doughnuts. To do this, simply take a small piece of dough, roll it into a small tube, then pinch the ends together – and that’s it, they’re ready to fry.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNhiSgXFCVU44dpKnUcU9CP9UDpT2fDYPozsevMDssQaE/1781451466566.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En mi caso como no quería utilizar mucho aceite usé un caldero pequeño y tampoco coloqué demasiado aceite como para cubrirlas, sino lo suficiente para cocinar por cada lado y a medida que se hacia necesario agregaba un poco más. Lo que hacemos es que una vez nuestro aceite esté caliente agregamos las rosquitas y freímos por ambos lados hasta que estén doradas, dejamos escurrir sobre papel absorbente y listo.
In my case, as I didn’t want to use too much oil, I used a small saucepan and didn’t add enough oil to cover them, just enough to cook them on each side; I added a little more as and when needed. What we do is, once the oil is hot, we add the doughnuts and fry them on both sides until they’re golden brown, then leave them to drain on kitchen paper, and that’s it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNykg8Y7twsLniuQVveFSE4zEHYXQ2F1GVT75hQnsiw7t/1781451466730.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYxqRKufMpC7sCPgo1iW6ivytKEwd7gBD4fZTdEH5DLi/1781451466235.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4tRBcnnt8jWWHGoUkuHFhaWeYgVxCqxiteBtShzapTR/1781451466880.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) La verdad es que son muy fáciles de hacer y las pueden preparar con lo que deseen, de hecho, yo dividí la masa e hice de queso y pescado, pero sin dudas las favoritas fueron las de pescado, y también las puedes con pollo, carne molida, sardinas en lata y muchas cosas más así que es bastante versátil y seguramente en tus fiestas van a causar sensación.
The truth is, they’re really easy to make and you can fill them with whatever you like. In fact, I divided the dough and made some with cheese and some with fish, but the fish ones were definitely the favourites. You can also make them with chicken, minced beef, tinned sardines and lots of other things, so they’re quite versatile and are sure to be a hit at your parties.
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera⁰⁰/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

body.title: Privacy as Pace: The Right to Be Slow
body.body:
## The Speed of Exposure

The standard defense of privacy goes something like this: *I have something to hide, and hiding it from bad actors protects me.* This is a reasonable argument. It has produced good law, strong encryption, and useful technical tools. But it misses something. Privacy is not only about concealment. It is about **tempo**.

Consider what happens when a social platform shows you to new people — an algorithm decides who sees you, in what context, at what pace. It optimizes for engagement, which is a proxy for speed: faster responses, faster sharing, faster intimacy. The platform profits from accelerated revelation. Your privacy erodes not because someone broke in, but because the default pace of the environment is much faster than you would naturally choose.

This is the insight that connects privacy to the Polish word *wolno*: slowly. You have the right to be slow. You have the right to reveal yourself at a pace you choose, in a sequence you determine, to an audience you select. Privacy, understood this way, is not about secrets. It is about **tempo control**.

## What Speed Demands

Speed is not neutral. Fast systems demand continuous availability, instant response, immediate disclosure. When everything is fast, slowness becomes suspicious. The person who takes three days to reply to an email appears evasive. The service that doesn't track your behavior appears to be hiding something. The website without an infinite scroll feels broken.

Speed creates pressure toward transparency. If you are always on, always responsive, always visible, there is no room for the private person who exists between the public presentations. Continuous surveillance is not just about data collection — it is about eliminating the spaces where you could have been different from what you appeared to be. Privacy, then, is the preservation of those spaces: the right to be inconsistent across time, to be becoming something rather than fixed as something.

The fast internet has no patience for *becoming*. It captures you in a moment and indexes you there. Your old tweets, your early writing, your photographs from a decade ago — the archive is instant, the retrieval is fast, the decontextualization is automatic. You cannot outrun the record by changing; you can only hope the algorithm loses interest.

## Wolno: The Dual Permission

*Wolno* in Polish carries two meanings simultaneously: *it is allowed* and *slowly*. This is not a linguistic accident to be explained away. It is a pointer toward something structural. Permission and pace are related. When you are truly permitted to do something — permitted without anxiety, without surveillance, without the pressure of judgment — you naturally slow down. The rushed action is often the anxious action, performed under observation.

Think of the difference between signing a document you have been told to sign quickly and signing one you are given time to read. The second situation is permission in a deeper sense — not just legal permission, but epistemic permission to understand what you are agreeing to. Speed is a technique of capture. Slowness is a technique of sovereignty.

Privacy understood as pace is the right to take time. To consider before disclosing. To withhold not out of deception but out of the dignity of deliberation. The private person is not the secretive person — they are the *deliberate* person, who chooses the moment and manner of revelation rather than having it extracted by a system optimized to extract.

## The Architecture of Pace

Consider what a privacy-respecting technology looks like, understood through the lens of pace. It does not demand real-time location. It does not require your phone number, your date of birth, your relationship status. It does not suggest people you know based on your contact list, which it read without quite asking. It does not surface your past activity to remind you of who you were. It does not optimize for the frequency of your visits.

A privacy-respecting system is one that lets you arrive slowly, reveal gradually, and withdraw without consequence. This is rare. Most systems are engineered for capture: they want you to give more, stay longer, disclose further. The business model requires acceleration. The human need — for pace, for selective revelation, for the dignity of not being known entirely and instantly — is treated as friction to be eliminated.

Friction is sometimes the feature. A locked door is friction. A waiting period is friction. An inbox that does not push notifications is friction. Each of these frictions is a pause in which you can make a decision. Remove all friction and you remove all decision. The smooth system is the one that has already decided for you.

## Digital Minimalism as Speed Reduction

Digital minimalism is sometimes framed as deprivation — fewer apps, less connectivity, reduced access. This framing accepts the speed paradigm: more is faster is better, so less is slower is worse. But the minimalist practice is better understood as pace selection. You are choosing which streams of information and demand to join, and at what cadence.

A person who checks email once per day has not reduced their information intake dramatically. They have changed its pace. They have taken the decisions about when to receive and when to respond away from the system and kept them for themselves. This is privacy in the temporal dimension: the choice of when you become available, when you disclose your current attention, when you become legible to the systems that want to know where you are.

The right to disconnect is the right to disappear from the fast stream temporarily, to become invisible to it, to exist at a pace it cannot track. This is not the privacy of secrets. It is the privacy of *absence* — the radical choice to be, for a period, nowhere on the network map.

## The Slow Revelation

There is a mode of intimacy that only works slowly. You cannot accelerate it without destroying it. Trust builds over encounters, over time, over the accumulation of evidence that the other person remains consistent when observed and unobserved. The fast internet does not support this mode. It supports profiles, which are static summaries. It supports impressions, which are immediate. It does not support the slow discovery of another person across years.

WOLNO, as a philosophy, has a preference for this slower mode. The site itself loads without urgency. There is nothing here demanding your click, your reaction, your immediate disclosure of whether you found this useful. You can read slowly, think, return, or not return. The site will not notice. It will not record that you paused on this paragraph, calculate a sentiment score, and adjust what it shows you next time based on predicted engagement.

This is a tiny thing. But tiny things at scale are architecture. A site that does not track your reading pace respects your pace as sovereign. A site that does is not respecting you — it is studying you, in order to more effectively capture your future attention.

## Tempo as Right

The right to be slow is not in any constitution. It is not enforced by any law. It must be claimed, technically, practically, moment by moment. It is claimed by the person who chooses not to respond immediately, who takes time before posting, who reads without being read in return, who inhabits the digital space without leaving a behavioral trace.

The surveillance economy wants your data in real-time, wants the continuous signal, wants the flow. Privacy-as-pace is the interruption of that flow. It is the choice to buffer, to delay, to exist on the other side of a wait-state that the fast system finds intolerable.

*Wolno* — slowly, it is allowed — applies to your own disclosure. You are permitted to be slow. You are permitted to reveal yourself gradually, selectively, deliberately. You are permitted to be, for now, still loading.

> *The private person is not the one who has something to hide. They are the one who insists on choosing the moment and manner of being known. This choice — the pace of revelation — is the irreducible core of privacy.*

![Privacy as Pace: The Right to Be Slow](https://776f6c6e6f.org/og/cover-wolno-1.png)

body.title: WHERE EVERY ALLEY TELLS A STORY
body.body:
![Kopia – Beyond the route.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xVXYPYA5bn3XBgLhnquVGCmtVNAKJdGWwRverFEH8fZoowosYHm13RYpgnrKxCpTW8V.jpg)

Today I would like to take you on another trip through the charming town of PIZZO, which I have already featured on my profile before. As some of you may already know, I visited this place together with my sister and a friend. While they were still fast asleep, I decided to get up a little earlier and wander through the streets of this beautiful town at my own pace, hoping to discover some of its hidden corners.

To be honest, I was hoping for the beautiful light of the golden hour. Unfortunately, that morning was quite cloudy and the sun barely showed itself at all. But as the saying goes, you have to make the best of what you have. After all, we can choose where to go, but we cannot choose the weather.

I think that most people visiting PIZZO focus mainly on the coastline, the beautiful sea views, or the famous Murat Castle. I, on the other hand, wanted to take a closer look at the everyday life of the town's residents. Personally, I believe that places like these have a unique atmosphere of their own. Sometimes all it takes is turning into a side street to discover corners that never make it into travel guides.



>Dzisiaj zapraszam was na kolejną wycieczkę po urokliwym miasteczku PIZZO, które miałam już okazję publikować na moim profilu. Jak już wiecie, na tę wycieczkę wybrałam się razem ze swoją siostrą oraz koleżanką. Kiedy one jeszcze smacznie spały, ja postanowiłam wstać trochę wcześniej, aby na spokojnie pobuszować po uliczkach tego jakże urokliwego miasteczka i odkryć nieco jego ukrytych zakątków.
>
>Szczerze mówiąc, liczyłam na piękne światło złotej godziny. Tego dnia jednak niebo było całkowicie zachmurzone, a słońce praktycznie w ogóle się nie pokazało. Ale jak to się mówi — jak się nie ma, co się lubi, to się lubi, co się ma. Pogody przecież nie wybieramy.
>
>Myślę, że większość osób odwiedzających PIZZO skupia swoją uwagę przede wszystkim na wybrzeżu, malowniczych widokach na morze czy słynnym zamku Murata. Ja natomiast chciałam zajrzeć nieco głębiej i zobaczyć, jak wygląda codzienne życie mieszkańców tego miasteczka. Osobiście uważam, że właśnie takie miejsca mają w sobie najwięcej charakteru. Często wystarczy skręcić w boczną uliczkę, żeby odkryć zakątki, których nie znajdziemy w żadnym przewodniku.

![20260417_061739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vsJAErfqqzGZH65q1m2VhVUNzwjzpjEpvSor4vdJoLV3hwHPR5Wo9g91hWkEt6L7wr1.jpg)

![20260417_061956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23uFPqUHmfXdNrYo56hD2yn3zHQawyY3cnEC7kMM2AMHqpKNkmekYfN4WTQeCHBBVau6X.jpg)


Around every corner and bend, I came across old townhouses, balconies and homes decorated with flowers, all bearing the marks of time and countless years of history. The only thing missing was the classic Italian laundry hanging between the buildings — somehow I expected to see it at least once during my walk. :)

>Za każdym rogiem i zakrętem czekały stare kamienice, balkony i domy przyozdobione kwiatami, nadszarpnięte już dosyć mocno zębem czasu. Brakowało mi jedynie typowo włoskiego wywieszonego prania. :)

![20260417_061437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wWpHgB74kLSxtBRwxyhcuNbf1e4hBhyD8XPaF42gprRePAnXeRSVernmnQ3XBs5JqyY.jpg)

![20260417_061851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23uFRhVZZCYbxKCPW19hTUsdJMNg5g5ujWXPDmABL1aU4hjGGwNttZBQe9EbkxoveVQYY.jpg)


![20260417_062152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/EoK5mqKpejdQvgdLDzbY2LRQmk78mXCvmvNY77yehoxQ6qnqoFnsPMpqvJSUoJuSg57.jpg)


What also amazed me was the way the entire town is built. The houses stand incredibly close to one another, and the passages between them are often surprisingly narrow, as you can see in my photos. Another thing I quickly noticed was that there seemed to be stairs everywhere. No matter which direction I went, sooner or later I found myself either climbing up or heading down another flight of steps. Every now and then I came across a flat stretch of road, but it was almost guaranteed that another staircase or at least some kind of uphill climb was waiting just around the corner. After a while, I started to suspect that the residents of PIZZO don't really need a gym membership. A simple trip to the local shop is probably enough to count as their daily workout. 😄

>Niesamowite jest również to, w jaki sposób zbudowane jest całe miasteczko. Domy są budowane bardzo blisko siebie. Przejścia między nimi są naprawdę bardzo wąskie, co można zobaczyć na moich zdjęciach. I na każdym kroku czają się również schody. Raz po raz natrafiałam na płaski kawałek drogi, jednak pewniakiem było, że za chwilę pojawią się kolejne schody albo następne wzniesienie. Po takim spacerze zaczęłam podejrzewać, że mieszkańcy PIZZO nie potrzebują żadnej siłowni. Wystarczy im zwykła droga do sklepu, żeby zaliczyć codzienny trening. 😄

![20260417_060437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ynUbV9teV2c4yjEpUvDcJxUE6RB531DDj4WBVjtebXXPM7tL29i1PeQeMJynKWC74Y1.jpg)

![20260417_061756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wgDhaU66HDahCdr91zjGgmtxCrJ2ZSu5Vj2FYT4aMpQqcBAY1XgX764Gt23QjqmkQpC.jpg)

Getting up early definitely paid off. The town was still asleep, which meant I could wander through its streets and take photos without crowds of tourists — exactly the way I like it. As an added bonus, I didn't have my sister and my friend rushing me along. :D I could take my time, soak up the atmosphere of the place and search for interesting compositions at my own pace.

>Wczesna pobudka zdecydowanie mnie wynagrodziła. Miasto, miasteczko jeszcze spało i dzięki temu mogłam robić zdjęcia bez tłumów, czyli dokładnie tak, jak lubię. Dodatkowo nie miałam nad sobą żadnych poganiaczy w postaci siostry i koleżanki. Mogłam na spokojnie chłonąć atmosferę tego miejsca i poszukiwać fajnych kadrów.

![20260417_061446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23x15FbZWVwMZiRvgJpSVcjuT8nMeVbF9Y5moEfkWccqMH5ZWH26vMcDYQYVtwQMSkx55.jpg)

![20260417_061627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wgKLJHPMU8qJJFEiQDNY6KjpydSfXymiJjbeXsuv3kXhzembUMtmysgrvFxMpHKw4tR.jpg)

I really enjoy photographing places like these. In my opinion, they can often tell us far more about a country and the lives of its residents than many famous tourist attractions ever could. While landmarks show us what a place is known for, ordinary streets, balconies, stairways and hidden corners reveal what everyday life actually looks like.

>Bardzo lubię fotografować takie miejsca. Potrafią one powiedzieć dużo więcej o danym kraju i życiu mieszkańców, aniżeli niejedna atrakcja turystyczna.

![20260417_061636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23x14cYBk8bgbJeCiGu6iY9jB2DeRVemMqGCeuwVzAT33968CcEEH5HPAfpegH3Kgiqyo.jpg)

![20260417_061729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/Eokc5sWJtibav7HQnUU69mK22cW2R2gsviPStKySVNZeKBAtZ81972mFiscnvNx4tBi.jpg)

Stay tuned, because this is not the end of our visit to PIZZO yet. More photos and stories from this charming corner of Calabria will be appearing on my blog very soon!

>Pozostańcie ze mną na bieżąco, ponieważ to jeszcze nie koniec naszej wizyty w PIZZO. Wkrótce na blogu pojawi się więcej zdjęć i kolejne historie z tego urokliwego zakątka Kalabrii!

<div class=text-justify>

*I need time to figure myself out.*

Harris stared into his third glass of whiskey as the bar crowded that night. His girlfriend's text had come unexpectedly at the same time when his department manager informed him that his promotion had gone to his colleague.

He sighed and took a sip, grimacing as his throat burned. It seemed life had spent the entire month kicking him in the teeth from different corners.

“The whiskey's not doing it for ya?” A young woman in a green sweater slid into the empty stool beside him.

He frowned. “Excuse me?”

She signaled the bartender for a glass of scotch then smiled at him. She was beautiful, her eyes brown and glowing. “You've been glaring at your drink. I assumed the two of you were fighting or something.” Then she chuckled. Harris liked the sound of it and smiled in return.

“Not a bad guess,” he said. 

She extended a hand. “I'm Amanda.” 

He shook it. “Harris. Where did you come from?”

She shrugged. “I just came in, glanced at the counter and saw you. Now tell me why you look like someone just cancelled Christmas.”

He laughed and felt a little light. “I don't even know you.”

“That's what makes me perfect. If you tell your problems to a friend or family, they worry and interfere. But to a stranger,” she placed a hand on her chest and tilted her head slightly to the side with a smile, \

title.title: Everyone just wants to be seen
title.body: Wondering often what makes you a good teacher, and more importantly, a good person. How do you add to a person's day rather than give away. I've been noticing, from the \

which is the awkward across position up at the top of the class so everyone doesn't need to crane necks too much, it's been such a pleasure noticing how easy it is to make people happy. To notice them, how far that goes, and how unexpected, the pleasure of a hello, of being acknowledged. Someone comes in with their heavy belly, their ills and their aches, their sorrow and their quiet. Or, conversely, their joys. The upcoming trip, the jokiness, the pulling a silly face, and watching to see if anyone saw you, and is calling you out on your sneaky. It's such an interesting exchange. Noticing and being noticed.

>


We tend to have these notions and ideas of what's expected from us. How to behave, what others expect us to say. Patterns. Boxes. Only problem is, they're so unbearably narrow. Like, I'm not supposed to talk about all the ways in which life is weird or perhaps unpleasant at this moment. Or all the ways in which I'm changing.

As anyone who's opened my blogs in the past six months now, I talk about that...too much (perhaps). So try to bring this in the encounters in my life both on and off the mat.

A whispered, are you okay?

Means more than all the pretty perfect lessons I'll probably never learn how to teach.

Are we just lonely? 

I ask myself often.

I don't think so. I think it's just a vital part of our system, how we regulate. We need social interaction and observation. We need, above all, to be first noticed and then perceived. The spark of being looked at, or entertained. It's why flirting's so fun. And so dangerous. It taps into that essential need, and the more we suppress that need, the more trouble that spells, you know?

I don't flirt with people in my class, of course. Though, of course, I mostly teach women, and every interaction with women is, in its own strange way, a flirt. A dance. The brush of a hand, a carefully curated and chosen outfit being noticed. The expression of concentration as you're trying hard to hold together the mask, but it's slipping. 

People are fascinating, intoxicating creatures.

There's things that bug me that I don't talk about.

Like how everyone's got their eyes in the ground all the time. I'm not necessarily talking about phones, though that, also. We're buried in our screens out of embarrassment, fear, addiction. What if...I get seen today?

Not to say I don't do the same sometimes. I guess we all are guilty of it.

But more, the looking away. The not meeting stranger's eyes for fear of making it weird, of being misunderstood, or found strange. What a delight it is, though, isn't it. To be found strange.

Another thing I don't get is how we tend to sexualize everything. Naturally, sex is a big, glorious, fun part of life, or at least should be. But being observed, seen, acknowledged, or at times even touched is so much more than being a sexual object in the eye of others. Dance taught me a lot about that, and I miss it keenly at times, when I feel my world growing a tad small. High time I danced again. Sometime.

I saw this gorgeous girl the other day. She was punky and devil-may-care and reminded me of me. And she *was* buried in her phone, but not for avoiding others. With this huge smile on her face, this laugh, this \
face. What a pleasure. To have been around and awake enough to have noticed that.

OK啊，今天也算赶完了很多任务，可以喘口气了，昨天的四级，今天现场验收完电路实验，下午补了作业，至少下周有个端午，端午再说吧。
 
这个实验也太折磨人了，当初接电路的时候没考虑这么多，所以连的很密集，时不时元器件就碰到一起短路了，今天验收的时候第一次就短路了没有图像，后面调整了某个部位，总算给我本地验收完毕了。
 
同班一个女生好久没弄出来，借了我的电路——可我的电路好像也只是“一次性”的，又耗了半天，我都不知道前一秒还正常的路线换个电脑就不行了，又是反相，又是重叠，又是短路的，各种毛病都露了一手，接回我的电路又行了——难不成这玩意还认主？
 
闲了就睡觉，一个小时不多就两个小时，下午实在熬不住了，在图书馆月亮椅上睡了一个多小时，姿势不太舒服，下次换个更平整的地方，但精神清爽了，完成了下午的任务。
 
晚上报名看了电影社的《蓝色大门》，24年前的台湾电影，据说很适合夏天看，很清爽浪漫青春老少皆宜。好吧，我还是太保守了，我不太能接受他们的感情，两个女生我非常无法理解共情。
林月珍对张士豪的爱太痴太疯狂了，连垃圾都捡，还有为什么一定要让好友背黑锅以表达自己呢？孟克柔为什么拿张士豪和体育老师试验自己的性取向呢——也许行吧——反正我不能接受，对别人也太不负责了。张士豪这个角色我很喜欢，很符合我对青春的想象，活泼自由洒脱腼腆，作为朋友或男友都挺可靠的。说不上喜欢讨厌吧，这部电影，打发时间挺美好的。

title.title: $1,000,000 is a lot of money in Naira
title.body:
People say that money budgeted is money already spent, and that's very true. Also, if someone isn't expecting money but already has a lot of things in mind to settle whenever money comes, it also looks like a budget has already been made. The only difference is that, in this case, there is no idea where the money will come from.

I'm among the people who already have a lot of financial needs waiting for money to arrive.

If I won $1,000,000 tomorrow, I wouldn't have to think twice before I started executing all my plans.

While many people often dismiss the idea of $1,000,000 as not being enough money, this amount is huge for me. When converted to my local currency, it becomes an even bigger amount.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPkNceiJA1r2aJUMCkw95sEcq5sMYMDvJWrsr9ecq6TgQ/1002243703.jpg)


The first thing I would do is either buy or build a house. Living in a rented apartment in my current city is almost like working for landlords. House rent is very expensive these days, and I really want to get off that hook in my life. I want to own my own house and my own store. I want to be free from the lifestyle of working hard only to hand over a large portion of my income to landlords. I also want to be free from the stress of landlords suddenly deciding to evict everyone from their property for no good reason.

**Switch to Solar:**

Many times, I've sat down and calculated how much I spend on fuel every week, and it always humbles my bank account. I've had plans to switch to solar power for my business so that I won't have to spend money on fuel anymore. If I could save the amount I spend on fuel every year, I would be able to use it for something more tangible. Switching to solar with the nature of my business will cost a lot, but this money would make it possible without putting me under any financial pressure.

**Would the Remaining Money Be Enough to Establish a Fuel Station?**

Oh yes, if the remaining money would be enough to establish a fuel station, I would love to have one to my name while hiring staff to run the business. It would serve as another source of income and help secure my financial future. Having a fuel station alongside my other investments would be a dream come true, and it would give me the opportunity to create jobs for other people as well.

Thanks for reading.

title.title: I Am Still One of The OG in Small Mana Cap Battle
title.body:
![image by Open AI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23w2a7FwxBSjoQQqfmQD1v4n7S5UdVvWcTBkReS85HJZidpAeCxrjPdAuZch9Ks7DrhvV.png)

Hello Summoners

We just finished a brawl, and I could say that I was happy because I did not lose the small mana cap battle. I have been doing that for weeks so I think It is a legit for me to brag about myself being an OG for Small Mana Cap battles.

One of those battles was in my last Brawl. It was a 13 mana cap battles and I had a hunch that it was a good opportunity to deploy a Quora Towershead and bulldozed everyone there. However... I did not have Quora Towershead in Gold Foil. You know, I am a gold foil brawl players without Quora Towershead lol.

So like it or not, my goal was simple... preparing to counter that Quora Towershead for myself. If I thought it was a great meta, so did my opponent...

#### The Battle

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tGXrZsekqUS3wioZr3VnEARK8Z4NDn8BXtFwfH4DijSnt4FKNxdKXEM1QjjN2cBUrbf.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_vPime3hU1xAr9BT1i0a0?ref=dewabrata)

This was the battle we have been talking about. One Quora Towershead vs 4 Small units, and the sad thing was Quora Towershead was the opponent in this battle.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbKJz3FcjTm79TtbCyLW5wpsu8WmHTtAzxPmiHErG7noD4TS23WzKC9t1CdHFuzPVro.png

I tried to exploit the Equalizer modifiers on that battles, by employing as many opponent as I could. However there were two main points that keep bothering me.
1. Quora Towershead had 12 health points. Every round she will recover herself with her healing ability, and the rate of her recovery was 4 health point per round. Unless I deployed a line up with more than 4 damage per round, my team could not win that battle.
2. Quora Towershead had a basic 2 melee damage and 2 magic damage. I did not know what summoner they would bring, but atleast my tank in the line up should able to heal up 4 health point a round. She had a bloodlust ability, a kill would buff her up and that would be the beginning of my lose.

So I gambled everything on a unit that was one of the most decisive in small mana cap battle, Halfling Refugee!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23vrpj8Lc34Qbp4jTG2D31Pk5jicV34DpZAYyxBBPvDSFJqXfcRdhQct82F2VnkjyZ6ix.png

He had 3 melee damage, and that was the most decisive factor in this battle. I understood that time that Weary ability could become an ass, it could make my unit exhausted when it had to make the most crucial move. So this move was not a guarantee one, RNG could ruin my plan.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eo44pUmHfvinwyPt4tbktdSsyyiKsu8myPC6yQffuV5tNheDxommk1Km7L1s9jUPEP1.png

However that was not the case because what I had worried before, did not happen. My Halfling Refugee made moves in the first two round and then we managed to finish of Quora Towershead. I was a one sided victory but I knew RNG was being nice to my team. Else it could be a long long long rounds for this battle.

At least with this battle, it is not an empty talk if I say you are better careful if you meet me in small mana cap battles, I am dangerous lol. What do you think about this, do you think I am lucky because RNG being nice to me? or Do you think Quora Towershead was not a good choice due to that Equalizer modifiers? Feel free to agree and disagree here, you can share your thought below.

That's all I want to share today. Thanks for reading and see you on Splinterlands battle!

---


![https://splinterlands.com?ref=dewabrata](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbH2XfEqZJAFKMvoBTZG6B1pBkH9XJz79EpLXCGCCHvNVgeBbigFfqAtfmeowZ49T85.gif)


Thank you for visiting my Splinterlands post here, don't forget to leave your comments and feedback below

body.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (305-308)
body.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nI'm using the term \
to refer to a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nI'm using the term \

to refer to a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way.\n\nThis batch contains photos spanning from the late 1950s to the early 1980s. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. The photographer seems to have been from Lansing, Michigan and many of the photos are from there. I think I've identified the photographer, see <a href = \

>this post for more details. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. All of the photos in this set were taken in the mid 1960s (1965 and 1966 specifically) and they were all most likely taken in Michigan. The first two photos are dated September 1966 and feature a kid's 7th birthday party (if I'm counting the candles correctly). The third photo has a handwritten date of December 25th, 1965. However, this looks more like a New Year's Eve party than Christmas Day so perhaps this was really taken on December 31st. I believe the ring above the table says \
which I am guessing refers to <a href = \
>this. The last photo was taken in October 1965 and shows some people making what appear to be decorative fall themed baskets.

>

See the previous post in this series
>here. \n\nThe entire batch that has been scanned and uploaded so far can also be found

body.body: It's the Hollywood way. Write by committee and keep something going for as long as the money rolls in whether it's any good or not. But it means things with potential that aren't an instant hit get dropped with no proper ending (the Babylon 5 spinoff Crusade, and Caprica being prime examples).\n\nI prefer the old British way, where a series would often be written by one or two people and only last for a couple of seasons at most. It forced the writers to really focus on doing their best work. It's amazing how few episodes there really were of classics like Dad's Army, Fawlty Towers, Reginal Perrin, Yes Minister etc.

body.title: Guild Brawl is a very important and exciting part of the Splinterlands game
body.body:
> Guild Brawl is a very important and exciting part of the Splinterlands game world. Every member of the guild tries to take the guild forward with their best performance. Recently, another guild brawl ended. The moment of collecting the rewards or prizes received at the end of the brawl is always quite exciting. Although the amount of tokens or merits I received from this brawl was a little less than before, each merit is still very valuable for the progress of the game. Today I will share with you how I used these merits and what new cards I was able to collect through pack opening. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW32hJj1Kw2PLJDF6EdRqYdWTEcr3H478xLPccH1awFRd/1781450852750.jpg) I earned about 6,500 merit tokens from this guild brawl, which was a little less than I expected. However, there is no alternative to patience in Splinterlands. With these obtained merits, I decided to buy packs directly and also buy some boosters or stones to improve the quality of the cards. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvbEnHGjzRK4CtHuZgVjTcS6WFWcPrkNqPpKvC6Tv9yK/1781450706783.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1apHnWPNgGkYVxS8oCTYSVQMTPeJ5M6Wgrxw3Vb7B1e/1781450716618.jpg) First, I went to the guild store and purchased 3 gladius cases at 2,000 merit each. This cost me a total of 6,000 merit. Then, to increase my chances of getting gold foil and legendary cards when opening the gladius cases, I decided to buy some blood stones and power stones. After getting the guild lodge discount (10% off), I collected 15 blood stones for 810 merit and 15 power stones for 1,080 merit. The main purpose of using these stones is to double my chances of getting rare or very powerful cards from the pack. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtU6kUbEdwWSVx9BgYPbnSRKYuB8cTswjHdAZdUaKDyQ/1781450729569.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTzesxFkSjr9i7xcctC6STkUUVAQQaK43mc2coaqjGrmt/1781450729620.jpg) After completing all the preparations, I decided to open the packs. As soon as I opened the first pack, some very cool cards were added to my collection. The cards found in the first pack are: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPNUjL5sR8kqK3kR3pSQfNU6rRNZ16rnJjnnFe4hh9vdp/1781450739971.jpg) 1. Hugo Strongsword: This is a Common card of the Life element, which is quite effective for defense. 2. Isgald Vorst: This card of the Water element is known for its aggressive play. 3. Whistling Damon: A Common card of the Death element. 4. Edith Emberstar: This is a very powerful Epic card of the Dragon element. Its attractive mana and attack power can turn the tide of the battle. 5. Alfredo: This is a Rare card and the most exciting thing is that it is available in the Gold Foil version. Gold Foil cards have the advantage of additional collection power and bonus reward. I am quite satisfied with getting Epic and Gold Foil Rare cards in the first pack. Then I focused on opening the second pack. The results of the second pack were also quite balanced. The cards I got in this pack are mentioned below: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5mGh9KZNWDBp7GPgxPXriRaAVk6DhceQPYutRiv5Y15/1781450760159.jpg) 1. Whistling Damon: This card of the Death element was found again. It will be useful for leveling up the card. 2. Katrelba Gobson: A very popular and powerful card of the Earth element. Its double strike and sneak ability are capable of destroying the opponent's back row cards quickly. 3. Bertrol Gobson: This is also a great card of the Earth element. 4. Hugo Strongsword: The Hugo card of the Life element was found again in this pack. 5. Orella Abadon: This rare card of the Fire element is quite popular because of its sneak ability. This card plays a very effective role in low mana battles. Finally, I open my third and final pack. The last pack also contains some useful cards: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZV7j2eTnrwPCJYZTgyZBSAW5fFmXeJ4zWLyVPJfAgMKH/1781450782012.jpg) 1. Bertrol Gobson: This Earth element card has been added to the collection again. 2. Relenor Cleaver: This Water element rare card is very powerful and has high health. It works great on defense. 3. Krash Wanderford: A common Fire element card with good speed. 4. Witch of Warwick: A common Death element magic card, useful in low mana combat. 5. Helmet Kharafax: A 2 mana common Life element card, mainly used for damage absorption on the frontline. Gladiator cards are essentially Soulbound, meaning they cannot be sold or transferred. However, these cards are of immense importance in Guild Brawls and Special Battles. Especially with the 'Are You Not Entertained?' modifier, a Gladiator card can be used in normal ranked matches, which greatly increases the chances of winning. Although the amount of merit obtained from this Brawl was relatively low, the cards obtained from the 3 packs will help strengthen my deck. Especially getting the Gold Foil Rare card 'Alfredo' and the Epic card 'Edith Emberstar' was a good experience for me. I am ending here today with the goal of performing better in the next Brawls and hoping to collect better cards. Thank you all. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

body.title: Zcash Facing a Crisis Between Fatal Code Bug and Strict Regulations
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRDRCHGtFZL5WoiyfenaaFETqh1se9hwGHMPh7RAHtUZE/1000014066.png 

​The crypto market has just been hit by a massive storm targeting one of the legendary privacy coins, Zcash or ZEC. For traders tracking the market lately, the $ZEC chart shows extreme volatility that definitely pumps up the adrenaline. Two major hits landed back to back, starting from a fatal internal code issue up to external pressure from government regulations.

​The first blow came from a highly sensitive discovery. An artificial intelligence, Claude AI, managed to find a critical vulnerability inside the Zcash system. This bug was extremely dangerous because it allowed unlimited minting of ZEC illegally. Making matters worse, this fatal flaw had been sitting undetected for 4 years before it was finally patched on June 1st. As soon as news about this leak broke, it triggered mass panic in the market, causing the ZEC coin price to collapse and crash up to 48% in a short window.

​The market had barely caught its breath from that negative sentiment when the second blow landed from the regulatory side. The Philippines government through their SEC took an aggressive move by completely banning all privacy focused cryptocurrencies, including Zcash and Monero. They restricted these coins from being traded on licensed official exchanges. On top of that, they flagged 7 unauthorized platforms including dYdX. This regulatory ban clearly chokes Zcash liquidity in the Southeast Asian region.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXSb62SEpPQfdfSGhkGmq6RsG83LsN8aNmZ6piAboQGAK/1000013977.png 


​Looking at the panic in the spot market, the derivatives market reacted with incredibly high volatility. The long short ratio data for Zcash shows that the majority of traders are currently leaning toward short positions. On Binance, the account long short ratio sits at 0.717 while top traders are at 0.7001. A similar bearish sentiment is seen on OKX with a print of 0.88. This indicates that bearish sentiment is heavily dominating the minds of market participants.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWK3ZGFAYUNXJmSLeaTgrBvN1Hqm9WqzRPj1gNzrwP1j9/1000013988.png 


​Due to this wild price action, liquidation data recorded massive numbers. Within just a 24 hour period, total positions getting rekt reached $2.02M. Interestingly, out of that total liquidation, long positions wiped out amounted to $793.80K, while short positions got blasted even harder, reaching $1.23M. This happened because after the severe crash, the market experienced wild unexpected bounces, wiping out over leveraged positions on both sides.
​In terms of trading volume across futures and spot, Binance still holds full control as the largest liquidity pool, clocking in a massive $716.08M, followed by LBank at $291.23M and OKX at $277.20M.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVp9UTMCQkFXstDGfDepRrMhYtTXuWkqFh1MffCngUXF5/1000014000.png 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeciTKbPXz5x4UkrdB9bxATDrrBaEphDAbyBBdGz3xcoN/1000013999.png 


​If we break down the Zcash daily chart against the US Dollar, it is obvious that the market structure suffered severe damage after getting rejected at the strong resistance zone around $700.00. The sharp drop from the bug news left behind a massive empty space, commonly known as a Fair Value Gap (FVG) on the daily timeframe.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNQFDAJPd2AJqP9TtqENoZurfvkxRqCiwn5HrPMMB4arv/1000014007.jpg 


​Right now, the ZEC price is holding and trying to consolidate inside the gray box on smaller timeframes like the 1H, moving between a minor resistance at $520.00 and a solid support around $350.00. Looking at the overall trend and the heavy selling pressure, the price is highly likely to face another rejection or correction after partially filling that FVG, before dropping lower to test the crucial support level at $250.00.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPg9DGT1dxzzPTApHrqziLh9bqbstirPAq4ubdkgE1aeq/1000014008.jpg 


# My Opinion
​Looking at the complicated situation Zcash is in, I have a pretty critical view on this, but I still try to spot opportunities from an objective trader standpoint.

​Fundamentally, the fact that an unlimited minting vulnerability could slip through the cracks for 4 years undetected is a massive red flag. In the crypto world, trust in the code is everything. When a premier privacy coin turns out to have a loophole that big, the developers reputation and the project's decentralization level are heavily questioned. Combine that with the ban from the Philippines, and this could easily trigger a domino effect for other countries that have always disliked privacy coins due to money tracking issues. So for the long haul, ZEC is dealing with a serious crisis of trust.

​On the bright side, there are two interesting takeaways we can grab. First, the bug was caught by Claude AI. This proves that integrating AI into Web3 can serve as a powerful auditing tool to clean up bugs in the future before malicious hackers exploit them. Second, from a trading perspective, back to back bad news like this creates the exact high volatility that scalpers and day traders absolutely love. The Fair Value Gap left behind on the daily chart acts as a highly valid liquidity magnet. The crypto market has memory, and that empty FVG space will likely get filled sooner or later, even if it is just a temporary bounce before defining the next real direction.

​To wrap it up, for long term investing, Zcash still has a lot to prove to win back trust while fighting a suffocating regulatory narrative. But for short to medium term trading, the current volatile setup provides a massive playground to bag some profits from the price bounces by exploiting that FVG area. Keep an eye on risk management and do not just jump in without a clear setup confirmation.

body.title: Scrobble.life
body.body:
This week I said it's time to check out scrobble.life and see how it works. The platform is not new, has been functional and available for everyone with Keychain for some time, but I've been focused on other things and had no time till this week. 

So on Tuesday, the 9th, I logged in and started to look around. My initial plan was to write movie reviews, but after some time I had to realize this plan has to wait a little for different reasons, but nothing is lost as I started scrobbling music instead. I'm among the lucky ones as I can listen to music or documentaries while charting and sitting on my hands, waiting for price to get to my area of business, so scrobble.life is perfect for me. 

Not long ago I got my first automated activity card from the platform, which was a surprise as I had no idea this exists, but it was nice to see my activity, not that I was gunning for a prize or a place on the leaderboard. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikahfit/23tbH2VGoesCCDPYuY1FoWjqiv5a7F3QXq4VHDiKDf76p8HpoSG8rNYM9ccAa9ymrJBk5.png)
[](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@hscr-isrc/recap-erikah-2026-w24)

They are still at the beginning, so opportunities to leave a mark, a footprint on the platform and help build it, are plenty. What I like the most is the opportunity to tie your name to a tune, a video, a movie, if you scrobble it first. Now obviously I'm not going to play music or videos all day, but it's nice to see what I contributed with. 

The truth is, the music and entertainment industry is huge, we all have different taste and can widen the offer every single day by adding what we like. 

With this occasion I updated my playlist as well, which was much needed and met a bunch of new artists that I'm going to check out soon. 

There are still a lot to learn, I need to build my playlist on scrobble.life, which successfully deleted the other day, in the process of figuring out how it works. Also need to see how I can rate songs, videos, movies and actually write reviews.

Next week I'm going to add more, during work hours, when I'm at my desk. 

Disclaimer: No, I'm not paid to shill the platform, just wanted to put my experience on paper or blockchain in this particular case 😜
