body.title: Thrift Diaries: Steal or Fail?
body.body:
>

![kaapoy edit kani na lang.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/Eo8UDCRGuRMPDhHBYrWUHknn2i5MepMPecHpQG8ffNDUQcQFfn51ox4R4T2YKZpntmW.png)

I already mentioned in my recent blogs that I’ve been too busy for the past months, so busy that I’ve touched a lot of grass. Last year, I spent most of my time in front of the screen, and even on holidays, I barely went out. That ‘not-going-out’ doesn’t only limit me to hanging out with other people, but it also includes me using the orange app as an alternative to real-time buying. With that, I spent a considerable amount of time using online shopping applications just to buy stuff, and when I say ‘considerable’, it’s quite long really, like almost an hour just to verify if the product is really good or if the seller’s really legit. Anyway, since I don’t have time for that way back the past months, I made my way back to my roots. I’m undeniably frugal—stingy at some point– so once I’m buying something, I’m really opting... most of the time, for the cheapest.

![IMG_20260614_225223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EpNnxK1XevKsG28XgwSS2eWwQazMpNpteks1UvACt84DbAHAFqrv8y2hPSafFUb9k3d.jpg)

<center><sub>[*Source*](https://share.google/1ZXJxMavbZ2ZwmeXq)</sub></center>

And that’s why I mostly find myself in thrift or surplus shops, because why not? The vast array of things is a relaxation for my eyes, so for those months, several trips to those shops became a breather for me. A breather… in a way, those trips became a distraction from those really tough and demanding days. Ok, ok, before I get sentimental, I’ll not stray further from what I’m going to share today, and that will be my ratings on the stuff I’ve bought from those shops, so for the first stop, it will be the stuff I bought from [JSK Houseware Trading Korean Surplus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kdoy3CMJ4W5ApxSZ7).

---

- **Mini Stickers**

![IMG_20260614_224423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EoEqvW8TWVp8QZDtNM5FGigb34uULqavgMUxA2XAvUePPbgRcRExdF1jqVHBUMEbr5E.jpg)


It looks cute, but the color was too tame for me. I remember picking it because I like how cute it is, and apparently, I had an art project vision for it, yet until now I haven’t used it :(

>Rating: 7/10

- **Book Holder**

![IMG_20260614_224437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EoGzRFwBdkU2Syc9V9i1uk1QAHunCRFqvc7GyTjdDRU7k3xhQGfeyZMMaopmbJFVzNJ.jpg)

I was hesitant about buying it because I don’t think it can hold any books, but anyway, my curiosity got the better of me, so I bought it, and unlike the stickers, I was able to use it. It can hold 3 to 4 books depending on how thick the book is.

>Rating: 9/10

- **Mechanical Pencil Lead**

![IMG_20260614_224508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EonnWEXkrUrLGWEE3XKWivrrNYCMC5FZjsaN2XNAYa6vKFh1mbMcdD9wrGQ2xC3SVct.jpg)

This was pretty much a steal for me at first because, in just ₱20 ($0.33), I was able to buy four of them. But upon putting them on my mechanical pen, I found it easy to break, and when I tried using it, it isn’t that visible. It’s not really a problem tho, because I definitely can use it whenever I’m sketching, yet I kinda expected it to be better.

>Rating: 8/10

- **Schedule Marker**

![IMG_20260614_224525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/Eo4DRFuiaREXFHuSAMDxuybaWvNKcSxs1Zpq761P1UQzALdoeCETSp4JwaG66QoDmKL.jpg)


This was definitely a steal through and through because I knew I can use it, especially at that time where our research is really in its peak and I need some sticker markers that would mark the parts we need to revise or retain. With all the academic demands I’m handling at that time, my mind definitely has a small capacity for all the stuff, so those markers are a lot of help, really.

>Rating: 10/10

- **Mini Smiley Diary**

<div class=\

> ![IMG_20260614_224611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EpGQmhg7SsjSvdsncoQD3gEdGrHLtnYXbJarLFYXjZxZJEveKibEbWiasteVGFHTFDc.jpg) Green is definitely my favorite color, so I didn’t hesitate to buy it when I saw it. I haven’t used it, but the print inside is already tempting me to do so. I love how simple it looks outside and how classy the print inside it looks, so I definitely see it as a steal! >Rating: 10/10 - **Colorful Clips**

> ![IMG_20260614_224642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EoGvZAuD5fbWst4oAZcRS5pAKBJxptxHy9cusvN6gqnZS8mnUJTx87dd7BhLzRUzsXx.jpg) The clips’ colors definitely caught my eye, so I was determined to buy them. I was able to use most of them by now; there are definitely a lot more of them than the ones I was able to catch in cam now. Definitely worth it :) >Rating: 10/10 - **Sticker Sets**

> ![IMG_20260614_224714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridgette/EoeDss3J74iVjJGquKwoPqKqJjRAVLPpGo7Psxih2L2NcYx95ocrHnZtYA6ZrQPZajD.jpg) There’s a lot of them! So, when I saw them, I know I can use them for some art projects. The cover pages on one of my sketchbooks are still pretty barren, so one of these days, I’m gonna use them to style those. >Rating: 9/10 --- And that would be for our first wave of thrift ratings; the second one will be for the items I bought from another surplus shop and that would be for the next thrift diary because trust me, there are definitely a lot more of them! So, see you then and hope y'all enjoyed your weekend. --- *Aside from the one that has a source, all of the other pictures used are mine.*

body.title: A Meaningful Day at the Daycare Meeting and Motherhood Seminar
body.body:
![Red and Beige Vintage Moment Recap Photo Album Scrapbook (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48UHrf5YsZP2yXLMSmv5xq2k2VVAukd7cyQ6iUvjLdQQ14MKMqGMRnS47eNQ1huZHy.jpg)

A night before the event, my daughter's daycare teacher sent me a message reminding parents about a meeting and motherhood seminar at the daycare center scheduled for 8:00 AM. My four-year-old daughter was very excited, so we woke up early, got ready, and arrived at the school around 8:15 AM.

![IMG_20260610_083749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tmKicvP4xwDNT4sCanPwLxA2HSg6opnhHHu2iTTHckzn8saCEZauwLjKu3mFNsiM9Sx.jpg)

When we got there, however, there were still very few people around. Since we had some time to wait, I spent the morning playing with my daughter. We enjoyed our little bonding moment while waiting for the other parents and organizers to arrive. Around 9:00 AM, more parents, teachers, and barangay officials started coming in. I couldn't help but laugh and think, \

The meeting was scheduled for 8:00 AM, but most people arrived an hour later.

![IMG_20260610_083831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ywoLwWP3mHqqET9r6qMYCWrjoCECSyvVsjq9fM4bw4RGVcuWMNtBWXJuf8jCZtsYMQ8.jpg)

Unfortunately, the program did not officially begin until around 10:00 AM. By then, my daughter was already tired from waiting. She still had a little energy left when the program started, but I knew she was getting restless. Since only a few parents had arrived, I decided to call my husband and ask him to pick her up and bring her home. Thankfully, he was available to help.

Once my daughter was home, I was able to focus on the seminar. The first topic was time management, especially for mothers. The speaker emphasized the importance of using our time efficiently and effectively by listing down our daily tasks and priorities. During one activity, I was chosen to share my thoughts with the group. It reminded me how demanding motherhood can be. Being a mother is a full-time responsibility with no day off, but it is also one of the most precious and rewarding jobs in the world.

![IMG_20260610_090010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vi2AU59iF6GK66XFBfbQAqAu2KkRA4nL6oktb55aAnsT2YmzeCVdUQwG3MfsmYaYDwp.jpg)


![IMG_20260610_090000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqpwe88goS6mcndhqXhxjGgbLEZbXBpLd9RoDYbQsYqF6pn9RwPSqCPCzfk2ZJJvKhf.jpg)


The next topic discussed habits that consume too much of our time. When it was my turn to speak, I shared that sometimes we become too focused on work and earning income. While financial stability is important, we must also remember to spend quality time with our families. Our children grow up quickly, and family bonding should never be neglected. 

![IMG_20260610_103817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/24243wcweUkbXyXRLfTHEudA1kPu6giELWRbr9YtE4aVjvSEQ4oZCSXhPtbKH52RfVXXo.jpg)


![IMG_20260610_103809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ydEPTg2zLsMRYY4q7pHmodF8uPM4BGmnDFwskB4Czmjiuf4LFxcyyc9TFby8uzKCRg7.jpg)


![IMG_20260610_151107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wX7iWK1T4AwoiPM28dvXQoqFjr5yMQ7prMAFxFBLaDEb9s25VC7NU2XSyfHJJhwbr9E.jpg)

The final topic was about finances. I realized that every family has different circumstances. Some families earn modest incomes but are able to save and invest wisely. Others may earn more but also have greater expenses. There is no single formula for success because every family's situation is unique. The more important we are striving and do what we can to give what are the needs of our family. 

![IMG_20260610_114628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xydoBZ5bWrxdEbbWYowM8H3JPxB7zvx8C1uRNt91M3ST3yGGwDGz1k7EWE4ctx1ahP3.jpg)

![IMG_20260610_151118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/243fzhfsZWfD6bjqxPJaf757JznxcEJ7WxbwPwSKYm4o8hQa22um7GHipANpAoMHNARPd.jpg)

Overall, the seminar gave me valuable insights about motherhood, time management, and family priorities. It was a beautiful experience that reminded me to value both my responsibilities and the precious moments I share with my family. Sometimes I forgot what is my purpose and this is a best moment because it refreshes my point view in life. 

![IMG_20260610_152944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xybj7TW4EmpU9idqgrXuWZKpcpRRoD2Fn81W3PdJiXG819rcox7gCTZqZwLMkovw5LN.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture, edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

body.title: Very Impressive Business Concept
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://cdn.24.co.za/files/Cms/General/d/13087/4c18d70ef6db4fda8c945134d6ccbe45.jpeg)

How often do you see a business concept and say that is smart and you also know it will do very well. This is very rare that you come across something that is so different yet so simple that it will just work.  Catering to the masses needs is where the money is made.

Skubu is a new retail store that has opened in South Africa within the last 12 months and the concept is very different to your normal type of shop. Skubu is a combination of 3 African languages (Zulu, Xhosa and Ndebele) and means bucket or container.

I am not often impressed by business concepts and this is one that is definitely well thought out and benefits the consumer. The owner has a saying  “It’s expensive to be poor. The more I understood it, the more I fell in love with solving it.” This is very true because if you think about it the smaller packages in the shops are always more expensive than the bigger packages of the same items.

Skubu requires customers to bring in their own containers which saves on packaging and as a result you are only paying for the item and not the packaging. The owner and brains behind this concept is an industrial engineer and was the one who developed the dispensary machines that allow the customer pay for what they can afford.

The Skubu owner has worked in the informal shopping sector and obviously saw the problem millions are faced with daily making choices due to their lack of finances. The idea that someone could get a little bit of everything catering to their budget is what he has created.


If you can only afford R10 worth of sugar or R50 of cooking oil because that is your budget for the month then most shops would not fit your budgetary requirements and you would have to do without certain items. This type of dispensing machine shop allows you to work according to your budget and saving on whatever you are purchasing by as much as 60%.

The consumer receives a card before shopping where they load up a Skubu card and purchase what they need by inputting the values per item that they can afford and then dispense that product into the containers they have bought with them.

The biggest obstacle to overcome getting this type of retail concept off the ground would be the special type of dispensing machines. Being an industrial engineer is where the owners specialty came into it's own being able to achieve this.

If you think that the bulk of the population is earning a R350 monthly grant for being unemployed purchasing a loaf of bread daily is out of reach let alone purchasing any other type of food or cleaning products. The R350 is nothing and is roughly worth $20 so this is a big problem. Turning the R350 into a R500 value through purchasing products smartly is what Skubu offers and why the concept is so clever.

The retail outlet would not need many staff members as each machine is online informing of how much product has been sold and what is left in each machine. Filling the machines is the only work required and that would be done at the back of store out of view. The investment and overheads are the machines that weigh and dispense the exact amounts according to payment. 

As a business for Africa this is ideal and if I lived in another African country I would be investigating this concept even further. If you do not work with the poor then you do not know what their needs are and the owner has hit exactly what is needed.

links.body:

This is a central teaching which any believer shouldn't neglect, it is very important to obey the person who created you. It means trusting God, following His commands, and submitting our lives to His guidance even when we do not fully understand His plans. Jesus Christ is the perfect example of obedience, as He willingly followed the Father's will throughout His life. Through obedience, believers demonstrate their love for God and strengthen their relationship with Him.

We must know that being obedient it usually brings peace, love and blessings to our lifes. While obedience may sometimes require sacrifice and perseverance, God promises to guide and support those who faithfully follow Him. By studying His Word, praying regularly, and relying on the Holy Spirit, Christians can learn to walk in obedience and fulfill God's purpose for their lives.

links.body: <div class=\

>

![#161.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2423qQnyajLUGMRBJd82x4hTFjoHsP97kkLpAETBXqDfG5hTZ152xZTPaL3Adg7K7w5W1.png)

Zaplanowałem sobie w głowie, że sobota będzie „rowerowa” – wszystko to w związku z poprawą pogody w Belgii i końcem deszczowego tygodnia. Jak zwykle żona miała nieco inne plany: dla niej priorytetem były zakupy, ponieważ wciąż brakowało nam kilku rzeczy przed zbliżającym się urlopem w Polsce. Kiedy zakupowe szaleństwo dobiegło końca, mogłem wreszcie przystąpić do realizacji mojego rowerowego planu.

> ***[ENG] I had planned in my head that Saturday would be a \

—all thanks to the improving weather in Belgium and the end of a rainy week. As usual, my wife had slightly different plans; for her, the priority was shopping, as we were still missing a few things before our upcoming vacation to Poland. Once the shopping spree finally ended, I could get down to business with my cycling plan.*** ![IMG_5484-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23yJCXf6AAcS6DsXto5kvzSMGsvjJjTjtBG8Y5ai1XWJBDqXqBbq8ArJfXFr7YQsQnCpF.jpg) ![IMG_5489-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ycwFudED9KZMivuGJdytpVjso1SL2Tm5AFizQ3fcpTCsjSEzKAk1hhf29EoXPu5ubPJ.jpg) Na zakupach zyskałem czapeczkę kolarską – dostałem ją w prezencie przy okazji kupna piwa. Miałem już wcześniej podobną czapeczkę, ale nie przypadła mi do gustu; była delikatnie za ciasna i zaledwie kilka minut noszenia powodowało ból głowy. Dlatego zwykle zadowalałem się chustami pod kask. O dziwo, ta darowana czapeczka sprawdziła się bardzo dobrze i nic mnie nie uciskało. Inną nowością był dla mnie specjalny krem na otarcia kolarskie. Wcześniej z niego nie korzystałem, choć tyłek czasami bolał po dłuższej jeździe. Wczoraj się posmarowałem, ale po około 50 kilometrach ból i tak powrócił, więc sam nie wiem, jak to z tymi specyfikami jest. > ***[ENG] During the shopping trip, I scored a cycling cap—it was a freebie that came with a beer purchase. I’d had a similar cap before but didn't care for it; it was slightly too tight, and just a few minutes on my head would trigger a headache. Because of that, I usually settled for bandanas under my helmet. Surprisingly, this gift cap worked out really well and didn't pinch at all. Another novelty for me was using a chamois cream. I had never used it before, even though my backside would occasionally ache after a longer ride. Yesterday I applied it, but after about 50 kilometers, the soreness returned anyway, so I’m not quite sure what to make of it.*** ![IMG_5498-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23uFTrCEgWc2Tjk4nHGXmDmPcCFnHbMX53teEHFGTnntSNZA6VZhzXi5hBRpfB3s2gERz.jpg) ![IMG_5502-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ynKkFtTWCPPAGHQDxJ7QpH4oYUgdnVmJ13pZxehwjaivxJTw1t2TRG81vSC23pRsv5h.jpg) Jeżeli chodzi o trasę, jak zwykle nie miałem konkretnego, wcześniej ułożonego planu. Zacząłem od jazdy w stronę Le Rœulx i dalej do Mignault, a później była to już pełna improwizacja. Przez chwilę straciłem nawet orientację w terenie, ale gdy przekroczyłem Kanał Centrum, odzyskałem rezon. Skierowałem się w stronę La Louvière, ale okazało się, że wjechałem tam od zupełnie nieznanej mi strony. To był najwyższy czas, by wyznaczyć w nawigacji drogę powrotną do domu. > ***[ENG] As for the route, as usual, I didn't have a concrete, pre-planned itinerary. I started by riding toward Le Rœulx and on to Mignault, and after that, it was pure improvisation. For a moment, I actually lost my bearings, but as soon as I crossed the Canal du Centre, I regained my orientation. I headed toward La Louvière but realized I had entered the town from a completely unfamiliar side. It was high time to punch the route back home into my navigation.*** ![IMG_5512-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vhyeXdRuqgLHMKdPnNDFyDwWHiG4CKwmkeoaASWge35YFhBxeN9yfaQK95MQsZQZN8z.jpg) ![IMG_5526-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23ynUJmQVZL9h5YMNZWcxVTGSSwSrej3EfoxU9n12wnLtUWtqSQAeL5cGNSJEayPZz1dP.jpg) Podobnie jak w przypadku tradycyjnych nawigacji samochodowych, wskazaniami komputera rowerowego nie zawsze można kierować się na ślepo. Kilka razy nawigacja prowadziła mnie na zamknięte lub prywatne drogi, gdzie nie było przejazdu. Wtedy konieczna była własna orientacja w terenie, z czym na szczęście nie mam problemu w dobrze mi znanych okolicach. Sporo jeździłem po drogach publicznych, dzięki czemu mogłem w pełni sprawdzić zachowanie radaru TR201 od Ravemen. Sprawdził się bardzo dobrze. > ***[ENG] Just like with traditional car GPS systems, you can't always follow the computer's prompts blindly. A few times, the navigation guided me toward closed or private roads where there was no right of way. In those moments, I had to rely on my own map-reading skills, which isn't an issue for me around these familiar parts. I spent a lot of time on open public roads, so I could thoroughly test the performance of the Ravemen TR201 radar. It performed incredibly well.*** ![IMG_5534-edited.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2423kpiVB689SD57Cy3PoGeFZUCLgJ5YhLfhQVU21px4eFCh8xSYrAN4fQc6AzrieKxcD.jpg) ![bike_ride_card.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKus9fj7W38Dfor6VBuWtQG9z2Unj7Xm64ohcpgsRzpLUskyjmEV5jESxbTMj9z.jpg) ---

Hello. Cent's 16th liquidity pool is now active. As of today, we have created the CENT/SPS liquidity pool. We have started the LP reward distribution period in the pool for one year. For starters, we have added 1000 SPS and 4120 DEC as LP rewards. As previously announced, we are not distributing CENT tokens in Cent pools other than those included in the Stablecoin Study. More LP rewards will be added to the pool.

![sps.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anadolu/23t76kXsnWL2jbaJrbJBhySxR9G1r388uLd3aDQw2P11qztR6WZAQFre1XuuMhuNuaRKy.png)

SPS is the governance token for the Splinterlands game. The token allows players to participate in decision-making processes and perform in-game transactions. SPS is one of the tokens with the highest transaction volume in Hive-Engine. There are 22 SPS liquidity pools.

Note: Which token would you like to see more of added to the Cent/Sps liquidity pool as an LP reward? SPS or DEC? Please let us know in the comments below.

I have added some liquidity to the pool to enable swap transactions and ensure a healthy price formation between the two tokens. I will also be performing swap transactions in the pool for a while. As liquidity in the pool increases, I will gradually withdraw the liquidity I have provided. Follow @centtoken for more data and reports. See you soon.

![sps lp.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anadolu/23w28j4vfbmtrNAR3JNKJ9qY2PstkiVm2HnS8hiuVLSrHGv6u8ziGMii33e4JCevsHdHw.png)

links.title: ¿Se debe decir si son adoptados o no?
links.body:
<center> 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsp633QpBn7Myze72zP7UkrnXr79mFxKDHnkk2rSgw5M576cjyMc4wAyhNT1Ac8Pjis.png)

</center>
<div class=\

> Desde mi punto de vista personal pienso que si, pero esta la otra parte que luego los que si lo fueron quieren saber quienes son sus padres biologicos y es aquí donde se pone como dificil la cosa, porque eso pasa a ser como un secreto algo que no se puede decir, ya que cuando la persona que da su hijo en adopcion queda en ese acuerdo que ellos en niungun momento deben saber quienes lo adoptan, como tampoco buscarlos, como todo lo contrario. Pienso como dije que si se deberia decir, pero claro habria que buscar ayuda profesional que ayude con este tema, porque no se sabe la reaccion de los hijos adoptados, hay que saber a que edad es conveniente hacerlo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/48XfEYhReMFa1MLgg71sKUckXhnLYYrXncpmxtaBsZocUxyBucZCWdkr1sw3C7YYYz.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/psic%C3%B3logo-psicoanalista-ni%C3%B1a-mujer-6008048/)

> Porque se llegara algun momento en cuestiones de salud, se necesita saber la compatibilidad si hay un caso de donacion, como tambien es mejor decirlo antes de que se entere por otro lado o de que manera lo haga. En una adopcion se debe estar inmersa toda la familia, a veces los hacen porque la mama en este caso no puede concebir, pero despues de que adoptaron, la mama salio embarazada, entonces se ven las diferencias geneticas del hermano adoptado con el que si es hijo biologico.

> O tambien cuando son no adoptados pero si cuando un hijo es criado por otro padre que no fue el biologico, como fue mi caso. Si mi mama me tuvo, soy la mayor, pero nunca se caso con mi padre biologico, con el paso del tiempo, como a los 4 años de edad ya yo tenia como algo de conocimiento y me dijeron quien era mi papa biologico, al que conocia solo en fotos o por alguna llamada que mi abuela me llevaba a hacerla. Mi mama se casa, mi padre adoptivo si es asi, me reconocio, me dio su apellido no es mi padrastro de paso palabra que no me gusta, pero si fue mi papa, hasta el dia de su muerte, el acepto a mi mama conmigo. Luego tuve mas hermanos, 4 mas, segui siendo la mayor, hasta que un dia que no recuerdo, uno de mis hermanos el mayor de los varones, yo tendria como 12 años y el como 7 u 8 años, me dijo:**ya sabemos que no eres hija de mi papa, pero te quiero.** ¿Quien se lo dijo?¿Cuando? En verdad no se, si fue como una sorpresa que me lo dijera, pero esta bien que lo supieran.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/245ccibdfYEtqB434MunbVRnbg5FNAsh2Sa86affzH1LKjyQ3EeXt1YnwLf2nZve784JQ.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/familia-atardecer-campo-retrato-7157276/)

> Hay diferentes casos o de adopciones, cuando son niños que quedan solos porque los padres fallecieron en algun accidente, porque lo dieron por que son menores de edad, que es mejor a hacerle algun daño, pero es algo que se debe pensar muy bien. Porque la otra parte es de aquellos que lo saben y lo dicen con algun grado maldad, de malicia, que puede causar daños psicologicos a la final. Esto lo pense porque lo veo muy a menudo en casos de la vida real en programas de television, que es un debate: se dice o no se dice. Y cerca de mi casa hubo un caso en que la mama dio su hijo en adopcion pero en un trato directo con las personas como se dice con todos los papeles. Hoy en dia aunque siempre el supo quienes fue su mama, los padres adoptivos fallecieron y su hijo vive en la casa de ellos hoy en dia. Es mejor decir las cosas cuando se crea el momento prudente de hacerlo, antes de que lo digan otros con malicia.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23wX5MBGretwZXyLXXwv2GiJKBp7obrpSQosRrWw3qBDA3KUX7VoRARG8AGTiRZxYtGkM.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/adoptar-adopci%C3%B3n-adoptado-5339743/) Aunque lo de adoptar no es algo tan facil, porque hay que cumplir varios requisitos, pueden ser desde bebes, hasta adolescentes, de hecho hay muchos artistas que han adoptado niños, como es el caso de Angelina Jolie. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23wC7LZ5aTqRgudrFoXMpTL4cS1AhtTJbAA6yhBj6FYySUyxovVq7cevZL2tva19ZpMSH.png) [](https://www.univision.com/famosos/hijos-angelina-jolie-quienes-donde-cuando-adopto-biologicos-brad-pitt-fotos)

> Contenido propio, traducido con la app DeepL.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23z7fUxN9hsnf5bzVgj64rU74PCh8dmMRc9a4ZcTgi93cosMQchrBxFShDQQJgE9zDj6k.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsp633QpBn7Myze72zP7UkrnXr79mFxKDHnkk2rSgw5M576cjyMc4wAyhNT1Ac8Pjis.png)

> From my personal point of view, I think so, but there’s the other side of the issue: those who were adopted want to know who their biological parents are, and that’s where things get difficult, because it becomes a secret—something that can’t be revealed. This is because when a person gives their child up for adoption, they agree that the child must never find out who adopted them, nor should they seek them out—quite the opposite. As I said, I think it should be revealed, but of course, professional help would be needed to navigate this issue, because you never know how the adopted children will react; you have to know at what age it’s appropriate to do so.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/48XfEYhReMFa1MLgg71sKUckXhnLYYrXncpmxtaBsZocUxyBucZCWdkr1sw3C7YYYz.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/psic%C3%B3logo-psicoanalista-ni%C3%B1a-mujer-6008048/)

> Because there may come a time when health issues arise, it’s necessary to know about compatibility in the event of a donation. It’s also better to tell them before they find out from someone else or in some other way. In an adoption, the whole family must be involved. Sometimes they adopt because the mother in this case cannot conceive, but after they adopted, the mother became pregnant, so you see the genetic differences between the adopted sibling and the biological child.

> Or even when they aren’t adopted, but when a child is raised by a father who isn’t the biological one, as was my case. If my mom had me—I’m the oldest—but she never married my biological father, as time went on, around age 4, I already had some understanding, and they told me who my biological dad was, whom I only knew from photos or from the occasional phone call my grandmother would take me to make. My mom got married; my adoptive father—if that’s the right term—recognized me and gave me his last name. He wasn’t my stepfather—by the way, I don’t like that word—but he was my dad, right up until the day he died. He accepted my mom and me. Then I had more siblings—four more—and I remained the oldest, until one day—I don’t remember when—one of my brothers, the oldest of the boys, when I was about 12 and he was about 7 or 8, told me: **“We already know you’re not my dad’s daughter, but I love you.”** Who told him? When? I really don’t know. It was kind of a surprise when he told me, but it’s okay that they knew.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/245ccibdfYEtqB434MunbVRnbg5FNAsh2Sa86affzH1LKjyQ3EeXt1YnwLf2nZve784JQ.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/familia-atardecer-campo-retrato-7157276/)

> There are different cases of adoption, such as when children are left alone because their parents died in an accident, or because they were given up since they are minors—which is better than causing them harm—but it’s something that must be thought through very carefully. Because the other side consists of those who know this and say it with a degree of malice or spite, which can ultimately cause psychological harm. I thought about this because I see it very often in real-life cases on TV shows, where it’s a debate: should you tell them or not? And near my house, there was a case where the mother gave her son up for adoption, but it was a direct arrangement with the people involved, with all the paperwork in order. Today, although he always knew who his mother was, the adoptive parents have passed away, and their son lives in their house now. It’s better to say things when you feel the time is right, before others say them with malice.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23wX5MBGretwZXyLXXwv2GiJKBp7obrpSQosRrWw3qBDA3KUX7VoRARG8AGTiRZxYtGkM.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/adoptar-adopci%C3%B3n-adoptado-5339743/) Although adoption isn’t that easy, because you have to meet several requirements, the children can range from babies to teenagers. In fact, many artists have adopted children, as is the case with Angelina Jolie. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23wC7LZ5aTqRgudrFoXMpTL4cS1AhtTJbAA6yhBj6FYySUyxovVq7cevZL2tva19ZpMSH.png) [](https://www.univision.com/famosos/hijos-angelina-jolie-quienes-donde-cuando-adopto-biologicos-brad-pitt-fotos)

> Original content, translated using the DeepL app.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23ydQz4vkUWhD7SD1cR8oH6m3NnjUmtdKAfmnS8jGVatgrgo7Z8L7JHnVRr92UPX3hRJ9.png)

links.title: Les Sortides a Borsa més Importants de la Història als Estats Units
links.body:
**Les Sortides a Borsa més Importants de la Història als Estats Units**

Les sortides a borsa (Initial Public Offerings o IPOs) han estat moments clau en el desenvolupament econòmic dels Estats Units. Representen no només la recaptació de capital massiva per a les empreses, sinó també l’entrada d’inversors particulars al creixement de companyies icòniques. Des de gegants tecnològics fins a recuperacions industrials, aquí repassem algunes de les més destacades per volum recaptat, impacte de mercat i rellevància històrica.

### SpaceX (2026): El rècord absolut
El 2026, SpaceX de Elon Musk va protagonitzar la sortida a borsa més gran de la història, recaptant aproximadament **75 mil milions de dòlars** a Nasdaq amb una valoració que va superar els 1,7 bilions de dòlars. Aquesta operació no només va marcar un abans i un després en el sector aeroespacial, sinó que va generar milers de nous milionaris entre els empleats i va consolidar el paper de les empreses privades en l’exploració espacial.

### Alibaba (2014): El gegant xinès a Wall Street
Tot i ser una empresa xinesa, la seva cotització a la borsa de Nova York va recaptar **uns 21.800 milions de dòlars**, convertint-se durant anys en la IPO més gran als EUA. Va destacar per l’interès global en el comerç electrònic i va obrir la porta a més llistats internacionals.

### Visa (2008): Estabilitat en temps de crisi
En plena crisi financera global del 2008, Visa va recaptar prop de **17.900 milions de dòlars**. Va ser un senyal de confiança en el sector de pagaments i ha esdevingut una de les empreses més valuoses del món en serveis financers. La seva IPO va demostrar que fins i tot en moments difícils, companyies sòlides poden atraure inversors.

### Meta (Facebook, 2012): L’explosió de les xarxes socials
Facebook (ara Meta Platforms) va recaptar **uns 16.000 milions de dòlars** amb una valoració inicial superior als 100.000 milions. Malgrat un inici volàtil, va simbolitzar l’arribada de les xarxes socials a l’elit borsària i va pavimentar el camí per a altres gegants tecnològics.

### Altres IPOs històriques destacades
- **General Motors (2010)**: Després de la fallida i rescat governamental, va recaptar uns **15.800 milions de dòlars**, representant la recuperació de la indústria automobilística americana.
- **Uber (2019)**: Va recaptar més de **8.000 milions de dòlars** i va revolucionar la percepció de les empreses de l’economia col·laborativa (gig economy).
- **Rivian (2021)** i altres com Airbnb o Snowflake han marcat tendències en mobilitat elèctrica i cloud computing.

### Tendències actuals
El mercat d’IPOs als EUA continua sent un baròmetre de la innovació. El 2025-2026 ha vist un repunt amb focus en intel·ligència artificial, espai i sostenibilitat. Les IPOs tecnològiques dominen per volum i interès inversor, tot i la volatilitat provocada per tipus d’interès i regulacions.

Les sortides a borsa no només financen el creixement empresarial, sinó que democratitzen l’accés a oportunitats d’inversió i impulsen l’economia. Amb nous actors com empreses d’IA a l’horitzó, el futur promet més operacions èpiques a Wall Street. Invertir en IPOs requereix cautela, però la història demostra que moltes d’aquestes companyies han redefinit indústries senceres.

links.title: Water of the Womb...
links.body:
Over 20 years later, and there is still yet to be any accountability taken, let alone an apology given. 
--------------------

It breaks my heart that my mother still cannot address the heinous acts her father committed against us -- her children -- or ask for forgiveness for how she reacted.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNrjj6Wqjb2V6yRQW6Y3maKWTehfjCk44sdBox5DyVJzh/1781449194155.jpg) **(My mother, grandmother, and youngest daughter)**

After the abuse was revealed, my mother immediately denied the allegations and abandoned us for a number of years. By the time I did see her again, she had the ingenious idea to take me to where my grandfather was staying and acted like everything was fine, then invalidated the experiences I endured to her then-boyfriend at the time. 

I was 19 when I ceased contact with her; several years later, I reached out of my own accord to at least inform my mother that she was now a grandma. Her greatest wish had finally been granted, and I held onto the childish belief that things could be different. 

They weren't. 
--------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsbsjrk13uhPgsFDwN3xM8GK8w6rVesBoV7D2vXqzosc/1781449439654.jpg)

My grandmother, the widow of my abuser who also chose not to believe me, is now claiming she \

and is suicidal. I tried reaching out 3 times, to nothing but Left On Read. 

The grandmother who cares more about her little dog than she does her great-grandchildren. The grandmother who never cared that I was suicidal. 

My mother, who chose to be in an abusive marriage, which also contributed to my depression and suicidal thoughts at 13-years-old, somehow idiotically chooses to believe that her invalidation of my mental health means we're on the same playing field. 

All so SHE DOESN'T HAVE TO ADDRESS WHAT HER FATHER DID. \

Isn't it funny how she can address that abuse made her suicidal, BUT NOT HER 13-YEAR-OLD DAUGHTER??
----------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRdgANEv2MgF4nVp4gdzHkYmnkBSYQRMY89UHFF9uSU7k/1781449467196.jpg)

The same woman who, on the day of my miscarriage delivery,  showed up with A MAN I HAD NEVER MET BEFORE to watch our two children, KNOWING the experiences I had with men I KNEW, let alone the ones I DIDN'T. What if THAT man had abused MY children?! Holy shit...

20 years later -- not one apology.
--------------------

God tells us not to look back; I only wished I had known this before reaching out to my mother...

Our last conversation was May 12th. Our daughter's birthday is tomorrow. Not a single message. So, no more. 
---------------------

<HR>

<div class=\

> Recostado sobre cama de 90x190 cm observo una pintura que hice de 20x43 cm, pero no por mucho tiempo, tan solo 4 minutos y 36 segundos, por de pronto empiezo a recordar como mezcle las tintas para dar esos colores. Primero moje la opalina holandesa en un recipiente con 258 mililitros de agua, luego la puse a escurrir sobre una base plana de PVC por 3 minutos 57 segundos para que penetrara un poco pero sin dejar de estar mojada. Sobre esa opalina deje caer 28 gotas pintura acrílica negra y 18 de pintura acrílica amarilla, lo deje reposar por 1 minuto y 37 segundos y luego lo sumergí en un recipiente con apenas 4 mililitros de agua. Deje caer otras 20 gotas de tinta china negra observando como se hacían 20 estrellas que flotaban y empezaban a mezclarse unas con otras hasta dar una forma entre todas ellas en solo 5 minutos y 22 segundos. Saque la pieza de opalina holandesa y la puse al sol intenso por 2 horas, 15 minutos y 37 segundos jaja, estaba toda torcida. La puse entre dos lozas de 50x60 centímetros por 3 días, 12 horas, 25 minutos y 45 segundos. Al final quedó un fondo bastante interesante. Ahora solo tenía que pintar la vela...
Lying on a 90x190 cm bed, I look at a 20x43 cm painting I made, but not for long, just 4 minutes and 36 seconds. I immediately begin to recall how I mixed the inks to achieve those colors. First, I soaked the Dutch opal paper in a container with 258 milliliters of water, then let it drain on a flat PVC surface for 3 minutes and 57 seconds so the paint would penetrate slightly while still remaining damp. Onto the opal paper, I placed 28 drops of black acrylic paint and 18 drops of yellow acrylic paint, let it sit for 1 minute and 37 seconds, and then submerged it in a container with just 4 milliliters of water. I added another 20 drops of black India ink, watching as 20 stars formed, floating and beginning to blend together until they combined to create a shape in just 5 minutes and 22 seconds. I took the piece of Dutch opal glass and put it in direct sunlight for 2 hours, 15 minutes, and 37 seconds, haha, it was all warped. I placed it between two 50x60 cm tiles for 3 days, 12 hours, 25 minutes, and 45 seconds. In the end, it made a pretty interesting background. Now I just had to paint the candle...

> ![IMG20260614155600~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQjNA5chpZ2ypFwGvoon1bEbx5Zzxz91eYm4KT16yw4eB/IMG20260614155600~2.jpg) Today I completed a very important and technical task at City Bank. I am sharing that experience with you. ![IMG20260614142849~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPmPAXYFFPRKzvDDgQR9VEwEqYT5smVFQfk8hvpN5CZsf/IMG20260614142849~2.jpg) Today I went to work at a self-service terminal of City Bank. It was a 25 model rare access machine of City Bank, which usually has to be maintained and operated from behind. The machine was experiencing some mechanical complications for quite some time. After detailed examination, I found out that the main problem was in the presenter SNT and pick module. This is a very sensitive part of the ATM or CRM machine, which works to process and deliver cash properly. ![IMG20260614140510~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYX97FiyjX4Rphpk8gem3QsSQmEb1uLZiHBGfgvQ86SWb/IMG20260614140510~2.jpg) After identifying the problem, I immediately sent a requisition for the necessary parts as per our official process. New and fresh presenter and pick modules were brought from the office with requisition. After receiving the parts, I very carefully removed the old damaged parts and installed the new modules. ![IMG20260614140501~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQc5EZXUGP394Kd3u89PEmEWHrRMrDGJia289webFxRki/IMG20260614140501~2.jpg) After fitting all the parts properly, I restarted the machine. Then I completed several test transactions. What is very pleasing is that each transaction was completed smoothly without any errors. After replacing the hardware, the machine is now fully operational and ready for customer service. This feeling of bringing a big machine back to life by solving technical complications is different. There is a different kind of mental satisfaction when you can successfully complete any challenging task. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

一大早就下起小雨来，飞翔队有个队员说，今天下雨，那活动取消了，结果队长说，现在小了，等我们坐地铁过去时，可能就不会下了，我决定今天活动 如期进行，结果他发了一张单车的图片，说是一定要出去玩玩，出去找快乐，他说之前报名的，你们愿意去，就去，不愿意去的，我也没有意见。

他还说风雨无阻，看到这个队长的行为，真的让人佩服，能免费的组织大学周末出去散散心，还能持之以恒，真的很不错，本来我也报了名，不过，看到下雨，我又不去了，想着还在家陪着孩子和老公，尽管欢欢上午去上课，可是我在家还是可以做好吃的。

他们到地铁站，我给请了假，后来就拉着老公去凤山跳健身操了，因为有点小雨，路上的人特别的少，我想雨天，还是不要到处跑得好，他们是去江边玩的，真的还是怕在路上摔倒就不好了。

在凤山我们跳了40分钟，后来又围着山走了一圈， 雨不是特别的大，还挺舒服的，回家到，欢欢都起来了，我挺开心的， 这样可以看着他去补课了，不过，今天他还晚了十分钟，硬是说把一个作业完成，我也是服了他，去上课了，还要做作业，无语，不管怎么样，他还是去上课了，这也是很不错的，所以我没有批评他了。

中午时他们拍了亮照回，两百多的人，只去了七个 也不错，到了晚上我又去钱大妈了，买了好多的水果，发现最近自己特别的爱吃水果，一下五十元就没有，不过，买了很多的回来，特别的是羊角密，我买了好几个，听说可以有利于睡免，而且含糖低，那肯定多买些。

The #SaturdaySavers programme run with huge dedication and commitment by @shanibeer came to an end with the close of 2025.

Here's a screenshot of last week's progress;


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/EpVGMDVngLDbyUrceZ4HzEq8DXMJxDcQi9s1bQ6xTjDVWZBiS3x6NXJXbca2xtbZNJi.png)






![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)

### How Did The Week Go ? ###

With the HIVE price being so low at present, it's definitely hard to keep the mojo going ! This is combined with summer being a time when I've got a lot of real life things going on, so my posting rate has been pretty poor for the last little while.

But I've kept up with curation, and been putting effort into the comments I make and discussions I get involved in. It's interesting to see that the rewards I'm getting for comments are almost the same as those I get from author rewards !

One thing that did happen this week is that the Hive Debt percentage tripped over the 26% mark, topping out at nearly 27% before dropping back today to 25.45%.

This is over my personal risk appetite in terms of proximity to the 30% haircut level, so I've pulled all my HBD out of savings and created a trade in HiveDex to convert it all to liquid HIVE if the price drops to a certain point. I'll get lots of HIVE, which should generate enough revenue through curation etc to offset the HBD interest I'll be losing.

If the Hive Debt percentage drops to consistently under 24%, then I'll happily put the HBD back in savings; it's all about risk management. I still haven't found anyone who can understands the haircut rule clearly enough to explain to me if losses created by it are permanent or revert if the debt level drops !

That's all for now.... have great weeks everyone, and keep posting and curating ! I still reckon Hive is the best Web3 place to be, and it's certainly the one with the most potential 😁

links.title: No matter what happens in life, never forget to smile. My Actifit Report Card: June 13 2026
links.body: <div class=\

>\n\nAssalamu Alaikum. I hope everyone is well and healthy. I am well by the grace of Allah. Today I want to share my feelings with you about a topic that can give us new strength in every difficult moment of our lives. The topic is— \

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/84bf6ee3-8bdb-4b9b-ab4d-2c539fc4fe2a.jpg) Life is never the same. Sometimes happiness comes, sometimes sadness. Sometimes we are overwhelmed by the joy of success, and sometimes we are broken by the weight of failure. But I think that being able to keep your smile in any situation in life is a very great quality. Because laughter is not just an expression on the face, it is a reflection of the strength within a person. Many times we have to face situations when it seems that everything is over. The pressure of people around us, the environment or reality weakens us mentally. If we can laugh at that time, then we can give our mind new courage. A sincere smile reduces our inner fear, frustration and fatigue to a great extent. I personally believe that laughter increases people's confidence. When we face a problem with a smile, the problem seems a little easier. Laughter gives us positive thoughts and inspires us to move forward. This positive attitude is very important to overcome the difficult paths of life. Another thing is that our laughter can become a light of hope not only for ourselves, but also for the people around us. Many times, a small smile from us can make someone else feel better, can ease their pain to some extent. Therefore, the power of laughter should never be underestimated. Finally, I would like to say that no matter how many obstacles and dangers come in life, we should never forget to laugh. links.title: Historia de mi perrita
links.body:
<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRv8CM4D9sqoHz9UAjvFgqk4RNSnwdrouzwZnLkvev6Gm/1781447806941.jpg)

</center>

*** 
 
<div class=\

> Esta es mi perrita Penny, la niña de la casa. Tiene 5 años y, desde q nació ha sido una parte muy especial de mi familia. Su historia comenzó de una manera triste, porque su mamá falleció durante el parto. Desde ese momento, su vida dependió completamente de mi y el amor que pudiera recibir. Era apenas una bebé indefensa, tan pequeña y frágil que parecía imposible imaginar que algún día se convertiría en la perrita fuerte, alegre y llena de vida que es hoy.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTr4rxvKFQYezokMB8zdj2Vfvmc5NyH3yhKVByUJU12YS/1781448148675.jpg)
Cuando la recibí , estaba muy flaquita y delicada. Como no podía alimentarse de su mamá, tuve que darle fórmula en un biberón. Fueron días de mucho esfuerzo, dedicación y preocupación. Había que alimentarla con frecuencia y vigilar que estuviera bien. Cada toma de fórmula era un pequeño paso hacia adelante, y cada día que pasaba era una victoria. Poco a poco comenzó a ganar peso, a verse más fuerte y a demostrar las ganas de vivir que siempre la han caracterizado.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuxHqJ3RxBGC59qEJshqeAK3yDqrHBCuex6Wus2UbmPn/1781448225008.jpg)
Desde muy pequeña desarrolló un vínculo especial conmigo. Tal vez porque fui quien la alimentó y cuidó desde q nació . Lo cierto es que nuestra conexión se hizo cada vez más fuerte. Ella no era simplemente una mascota; se convirtió en una compañera inseparable, en un miembro más de la familia y en una fuente constante de alegría.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxfTVCRekmaUBRJZm9puN4na2wqztNQh9CxiccjhoED8/1781448669791.jpg)
Con el paso de los meses, aquella cachorrita débil y pequeña fue creciendo. Empezó a correr por toda la casa, a jugar con todo lo que encontraba y a llenar cada rincón de energía. Su personalidad alegre y cariñosa conquistó a todos
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmCYZeyYWbvcsj7vyngBpABAE9wiqqRDqUkcPr6o5cfZ/1781448727947.jpg)
Hoy, con sus 5 años de edad, sigue siendo la niña de la casa, la consentida . Aunque ya no es aquella bebé que cabía en mis manos, para mí siempre será mi bebé . Es una perrita inteligente, noble y muy leal . Le encanta estar cerca de las personas que quiere, es muy protectora y un poco celosa
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahR2kuqjgNQguRDMzqAubg6jtumpgGNi5skEPZyjPCML/1781448436977.jpg)
Su llegada fue lo mejor q le pasó a mi familia . Nos mostró el valor de la paciencia, la responsabilidad y el compromiso. También nos recordó que el amor puede transformar vidas. Gracias a los cuidados que recibió desde sus primeros días, logró salir adelante y convertirse en una perrita sana y feliz Sin dudas ella es la alegría de la casa, la compañera fiel que siempre está presente y un ejemplo de fortaleza y amor. Después de todo lo que pasó al comienzo de su vida, verla crecer y ser feliz es uno de los regalos más hermosos que la vida me ha dado.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnPoxpvnNPdQr3U3VU6MqG5BUCMi1jYRoSAJTV5GCCmz/1781448515111.jpg)

links.title: Llama 4 and DeepSeek V4: open source has truly reached the frontier
links.body: In April 2026, Meta launched Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick — the first natively and genuinely multimodal open source models, with a Mixture of Experts architecture, and the largest context window ever available in any model: 10 million tokens in Scout. In the same month, DeepSeek launched V4 with 1.6 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active — the largest open source model in history in terms of total parameters. The 2024 thesis — \

— had to be revised.

Llama 4: the Meta family
------------------------

Llama 4 arrived with two models available and a third in development.

The **Scout** has 17 billion active parameters and 16 experts (109B total). The 10 million token context window is the most impressive figure of the launch — equivalent to processing an entire research library, a company's complete code repository, or several years of meeting transcripts in a single call. It fits on one H100 GPU with INT4 quantization. It is multimodal by default: it processes text, image, audio, and video.

The **Maverick** uses the same 17B active parameters but with 128 experts and 400 billion total parameters. The context is 1 million tokens. On LMArena — a blind comparison of human preferences — it scored an Elo of 1,417, surpassing GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash. GPQA Diamond: 69.8%.

The **Behemoth**, with 288 billion active parameters and an estimated 2 trillion total, was announced to be in training in April 2025. As of April 2026, it has not yet been publicly released — instabilities in MoE routing at scale have been reported as a factor in the delay.

**License:** The Llama 4 Community License allows commercial use for organizations with fewer than 700 million monthly active users. Attribution is mandatory. Use of vision capabilities is restricted for entities domiciled in the European Union.

DeepSeek V4: the frontier at open cost
--------------------------------------

DeepSeek V4 represents DeepSeek's greatest technical ambition to date. The V4-Pro has 1.6 trillion total parameters with 49 billion active per inference — an activation ratio of only 3%, the most efficient in the industry. The V4-Flash uses 284 billion total with 13 billion active.

The main architectural innovation is Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA): tokens are compressed into summary representations, and each new token attends only to the top-k most relevant ones instead of the entire sequence. This allows a context of 1 million tokens with manageable memory consumption. The V4-Pro-Max scored 80.6% on SWE-Bench Verified — the highest score ever recorded in autonomous bug resolution in real code.

**Price and license:** V4-Flash at US$ 0.14/M input tokens; V4-Pro at US$ 1.74/M. Both under MIT or Apache 2.0 — completely free for commercial use, modification, and redistribution. V4 was trained on Huawei Ascend hardware instead of NVIDIA GPUs, demonstrating that dependence on American infrastructure can be circumvented.

Qwen 3.5: Alibaba's bet
-----------------------

Alibaba entered 2026 with Qwen 3.5-397B, an MoE model with 17 billion active parameters and 512 experts. The native context is 262 thousand tokens with extension to 1 million. The model surpasses GPT-5.2 on IFBench — the instruction-following benchmark — with 76.5 vs. 75.4. Qwen3.5-9B (only 9B parameters) surpasses GPT-OSS-120B on GPQA Diamond: 81.7% vs. 71.5%.

The license is Apache 2.0, with the only restriction being an approval process for operators with more than 100 million monthly users.

What changed in open source competitiveness
-------------------------------------------

The difference between open source and closed models is now more nuanced than \

On pure mathematics benchmarks (AIME), DeepSeek V3.2 scores 96.0% — comparable to GPT-5.2. In instruction following, Qwen 3.5 surpasses OpenAI's proprietary models. In cost per self-hosted inference, the advantage is 10 to 100 times versus closed APIs.

The gap persists in complex agentic tasks (benchmarks like Terminal-Bench and SWE-Bench Pro), in security and alignment (open source models have less public validation), and in advanced multimodality (native video is still limited in the open ecosystem).

The strategic implication for technology managers is clear: for high-volume workloads, regulated privacy, or deep vertical customization, self-hosting frontier open source models has gone from an experimental option to a concretely competitive alternative.

links.body:
🏆 Tired of soulless Football Managers? Try KickoffBoss — it's free and you get matches every day  
I've been playing KickoffBoss for a while now — a browser football management game, no downloads, no pay-to-win.  
It's a free online football manager where you're both the coach and the president of your club. Sounds simple, but it goes deep:  
⚽ What you actually manage:  
Detailed tactics (mentality, formations with experience-based bonuses, individual positioning)  
Transfer market with players from real managers — not bots  
Youth academy, training center, scouts, stadium  
A Youth League to develop your club's future stars  
National leagues, cups and international tournaments  
💰 The most interesting detail: The game's economy uses currencies with real-world value. Every cent spent by players is reinvested back into the game's economy — it doesn't go straight into the company's pockets. You can actually earn real money playing, if you're good enough.  
The part that really surprised me — the real economy:  
In most online games, when players buy advantages, the money goes directly to the company. KickoffBoss works differently — part of those purchases goes into a special fund called the Partners Fund, with 1,000,000 shares available to buy and sell. On the 1st and 15th of every month, the fund's total balance is automatically distributed to all shareholders based on how many shares they hold. You can use your share to improve your club or simply cash it out.  
Recruiting — and here's why this post exists:  
Any manager can recruit other users by sharing their recruitment link. If a new manager registers through your link, they're linked to you permanently (or until you sell that \

on the market). In return, you earn 10% when they top up their account, 10% of league victory bonuses, 10% of end-of-season bonuses and 10% of cup bonuses.  
In other words, bringing friends in literally benefits your in-game account.  
📅 28-day seasons, with division promotions, rivalries against real managers and progressive club development.  
I'm currently in the Portuguese A league and we need more players — leagues are so much better when there are more human managers. If you're into FM, Hattrick, or any browser manager, this is genuinely worth trying.  
Why try it now?  
✅ Free, browser-based, no downloads  
✅ Real economy — you can earn actual money  
👉 Register here: [https://kickoffboss.com/footballgame/speedtuning](https://kickoffboss.com/footballgame/speedtuning)  
If you have any questions about getting started, message me directly in the game!

💰 O detalhe mais interessante: A economia do jogo usa moedas com valor real. Cada cêntimo gasto por jogadores é reinvestido na economia do próprio jogo — não vai direto para os bolsos da empresa. Dá para ganhar dinheiro real a jogar, se fores bom.

links.title: Worldbuilding Weekend Prompt #163 - Heroes
links.body:
Welcome to the next in an ongoing series of writing prompts in the Worldbuilding community ! 

I'm aiming to post one of these each Sunday. They aren't a replacement for the excellent daily prompts from @worldbuilding they're just an extra opportunity if you have a writing itch you want to scratch. 😀

![Potionsa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23tH5eLPaqvcPDdq9FKF6CjccpPyvVFqJoiULatXRyUqxSDkFDgaM1SSaR9yTRi5wLn9h.jpg)
*Image generated by AI in Wombo.art*</center>

The prompt this week is - **Heroes**

*Everyone has heroes - every civilisation, ever culture, ever nation and every person. Tell me a story of a hero from your setting !*

*Who is the hero ? Where did they come from, their origin and background ? What did they do to start their legend ? How did they sustain it ? Are they still alive, or a myth from ancient times ? How much of their legend is true, and how much of it is subsequent embellishment, allegory or downright lies ? How does their nation or civilisation see them, and how is their heroism used or abused by the state ? What happened to them - how did the story end ?*


![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


Just to add a bit of spice to things, the two entries I most like (and are linked in comments to this post, so I can find them !) that are posted by **midnight (GMT) next Saturday** will each get a prize of **one Hive SBI**.  

This link will take you to the FAQ where you can read more about [Hive SBI](https://ecency.com/hive-189312/@steembasicincome/hive-sbi) - it's a project I thoroughly support because it gives both the donor and winner a steady trickle of passive income paid out in the form of upvotes on posts.

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


**Guidelines**

I stole these guidelines straight from @worldbuilding prompts (I hope that's okay !), I couldn't have written them any better myself....

* Prompt replies may be anything! Art, game assets, stories, worldbuilding details, fake wiki entries, maps... whatever you want to create!
* Please ensure you reply to this post with a link to your reply
* Posting in or cross-posting to the Worldbuilding community is highly encouraged
* Use the hashtag #worldbuilding
* Prompt replies can be any length.
* AI images to illustrate your posts are fine, as long as they are credited to whichever software you used to make them
* Posts using AI to create the text are not acceptable; these prompts (and community) are a way to expand and have fun with human imagination, and I firmly believe AI will never be able to replicate the human spark.

Some other neat communities for writing that you might want to check out are:

* [Freewriters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-161155)
* [Scholar and Scribe](https://ecency.com/created/hive-199275)
* [Tabletop / DND](https://ecency.com/created/hive-189497)
* [The Ink Well](https://ecency.com/created/hive-170798)

It can be a lot of fun to mix and match our prompts with some of these other community prompts.

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)

links.title: 🔥Puro Fuego en la Caja de Bateo! La Armada Cubana Destroza la MLB (Semana del 7 al 13 de Junio, 2026)
links.body:
¡Hola, comunidad de **Ecency**! El verano ya se siente con fuerza en las Grandes Ligas y la representación cubana está quemando las maderas a un ritmo de locura. Entramos de lleno al mes de junio de 2026 y los peloteros de la isla no solo están cumpliendo, sino que están asumiendo roles protagónicos absolutos en la lucha por los boletos de postemporada.

Esta semana nos dejó momentos históricos que quedarán grabados en los libros de récords de las Mayores. Saquen su café, acomódense y repasemos cómo le fue a los nuestros en este trepidante septenario.

---

## 🏆 El MVP de la Semana: Yordan Álvarez (Houston Astros)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHK4EYNFokX8Uk6L2UersRnV1Q8d1LYZqUQF3x35kfUM/img_20260607_160603_699.jpg)

> **\

.**

No hay debate posible. El gigante de Las Tunas firmó una semana antológica y el viernes 12 de junio tocó el cielo con las manos en el Kauffman Stadium frente a los Reales de Kansas City.
Récord Histórico en un Solo Inning: 2 HR + 6 RBI

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSxYr9vFJ84wZZcwKCi58YQKJkAWn7UMmjW8CPPyRhUvU/img_20260510_084957_618.jpg)

Yordan destrozó la historia al convertirse en el **primer jugador en toda la existencia de la MLB** en conectar un cuadrangular de múltiples carreras y un Grand Slam en la mismísima **primera entrada** de un juego. Empató una marca de franquicia con 6 impulsadas en un solo episodio y terminó la jornada de 5-3.

Gracias a este despliegue de poder salvaje, Álvarez escaló hasta la cima de las Grandes Ligas con una línea ofensiva de miedo en lo que va de campaña:

* **Promedio al Bate:** .327 (Cuarto en toda la MLB)
* **Liderato de Jonrones:** 23 vuelacercas (peleando la cima absoluta del negocio)
* **Porcentaje de Embasarse (OBP):** .435
* **OPS:** Un bestial 1.093 que lo consolida como el bateador más temido de la Gran Carpa.

---

## 🚀 Reporte Ofensivo: Consistencia y Destellos de Poder

### Yandy Díaz (Tampa Bay Rays)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXn9G2twgePU4gZkTSL6P5wZoCRJQi4XA6TffGAhbuubm/img_20260510_085000_982.jpg)

El inicialista de los Rays sigue siendo una máquina de chocar la bola y ponerse en base. Esta semana ratificó por qué es uno de los bateadores más difíciles de ponchar en el negocio. Su consistencia lo mantiene en la élite con un promedio global de **.325** y un porcentaje de embasarse de **.402**. Si Tampa quiere pelear el durísimo Este de la Americana, Yandy es el motor indiscutible.

### Miguel Vargas (Chicago White Sox)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTa8xXqvndEY266qCxBiaqmNPjUer8EN81jSKyPe7pe7C/img_20260614_103151_294.jpg)

El joven infielder está viviendo un renacer ofensivo vistiendo la camiseta del sur de Chicago. Su producción de carreras anotadas ha sido fundamental para su equipo, metiéndose esta semana en el Top 5 de toda la MLB con **50 carreras anotadas**. Su disciplina en el plato y madurez están dando los frutos que tanto se esperaban.

### Randy Arozarena (Seattle Mariners)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYfChWBrAkS9LYwTtoguCbRzWdZD1dbd2BBXMFu3HQRmk/img_20260418_155314_884.jpg)

Adaptado por completo a su nueva realidad en el Noroeste con los Marineros, Randy sigue demostrando que es un jugador de momentos importantes. Aunque el equipo tuvo desafíos en su última serie frente a Washington, Arozarena se mantiene con un sólido promedio de **.291** esta temporada, sumando 18 dobletes en lo que va de año y aportando esa chispa eléctrica tanto en las almohadillas como en las praderas.

---

## ⚾ El Termómetro desde la Lomita

El pitcheo cubano tuvo una semana de contrastes, enfocada principalmente en los roles de máxima presión: los relevistas tardíos.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeutwjvp9TNaYbCBBxWeCn6HTKfgfSF37oKvm4NAjT3JM/img_20260502_230932_404.jpg)

* **Raisel Iglesias (Atlanta Braves):** Se mantiene intratable cuando la pizarra aprieta en el noveno inning. Su control sigue siendo de cirujano, permitiendo asegurar triunfos clave para unos Bravos que no le pierden pisada a los Filis.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU67cd56j9auastBm4dFmFETehvmAdEVjzzrXV1RkXtSJ/img_20260502_230923_093.jpg)

* **Aroldis Chapman (Boston Red Sox):** El \

sigue desafiando las leyes del tiempo en Boston. Aunque ha tenido algunas salidas con boletos de más, su capacidad para rozar las tres cifras en el radar sigue rescatando momentos de alta tensión.

---

## 💬 Conclusión y Debate

La armada cubana en la MLB está demostrando en este 2026 un nivel de madurez impresionante. Lo de Yordan Álvarez ya raya en lo legendario, perfilándose seriamente como un candidato de peso para el Jugador Más Valioso de la Liga Americana si mantiene este ritmo de destrucción masiva.

Ahora les toca a ustedes, comunidad de Ecency: ¿Creen que Yordan Álvarez logrará llevarse la corona de jonrones al terminar la temporada regular? ¿Qué otro pelotero cubano consideran que merece más atención por lo hecho esta semana?

links.body:
![mcth.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23xVF8NTQ2tRxscM3zv3y7WzBknYjhXxttT5ovBQYzopnZee6tbPmzSPAgZBHT5cCGXQC.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 50 minor chests from batch 1 before the season ends. And I will make sure to use alchemy potions to double my chances of getting gold cards.

One more time, I didn't get any epic or legendary, but I did get 3 rare cards and a lot of common ones. I also got 3 legendary potions and 2 alchemy potions. In addition, I got 2 common scrolls and a lot of merits. Finally, I got 3 energy and 6 entries for the weekly fortune draw.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo6DFBrSZ7qfix6KqxkDR14ZiEwXZDUTWNW5JAUkhhmAgH5rk2oMf2GCvygMoccag16.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=2b5358cc194347b794e60666d608c13bb144b372&ref=langice)</center>

---

Finally, my elemental Coralforged is at level 10, where it learned the Shield ability, so it will take 50% less damage from physical attacks (melee and ranged). I like to use this unit in the first position and Commander Slade in the second, so that the latter can attack thanks to the flank ability.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tbGjZNV6WRj27G77JfP7sfNZFezqGfqToNM1YG4Qa39DmmUKVk5dZzQf7rmfqE1VFyC.png)

---

And, my djinn Oshannus Unmade is also at the max level, where it learned the Lookout ability, so its adjacent units will take 1 less damage from opportunity, snipe or sneak attacks. Additionally, enemy ambush attacks will be reduced by 50%.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRvE9PGbc1fw1WrxdiQTywuJ5Yh8tFWCYAhDfokpx12bXQzycKhw7vRtpF1uqfwPCB2.png)

---

Currently, this is my collection of common regular conclave arcana reward cards. For now, I have nine of them at the max level; and only three at level 9 (very close to leveling up). It's only a matter of time before this collection reachs its full potential, which is incredible. I hope to get gold and legendary cards next time, and I wish you the same. As always, have fun playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wMQD2E8sxv2fExWvgRp1V2Kiruqc2etX6odepBhCMcB8cruW26jWYY7J29q56g8kXmz.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

links.title: Relato: Entre la esperanza y la realidad
links.body: ![Hive Banners 2026 (78).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48GCB2EQhCdqi7PqfCHjdqqkobvpsm5wjHqC4qYonELWzdu1Hbxnje6imVcjjou4GX.png) **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/naturaleza-flores-oscuro-verano-19724457/)**

> Sentada en uno de los maceteros del patio central del hospital, Alicia respiró hondamente un par de veces.

El miedo estaba internados en el corazón junto con la tristeza. Su abuela había sufrido un derrame leve, pero lo suficientemente dañino para dejarla conectada a una máquina para alimentarla.

Los pronósticos no eran nada alentadores. A sus 88 años, la abuela Bruna había tenido una vida complicada, entre una infancia en medio de la pobreza y una vida adulta con sus complicaciones.

Lo del derrame fue el epítome de una serie de tensiones que surgieron en casa a lo largo de todo un año lleno de conflictos feroces entre sus hijos, agregando a ello el hecho de que tenía qué desocupar la casa a finales de julio, y la crisis financiera.

Alicia en ese momento sentía que la ansiedad estaba por las nubes, con el pecho muy encogido y aferrándose a la esperanza de que, contra toro pronóstico, su abuela al menos pudiera salir bien de ese cuadro.

Pero su madre y sus tíos dudaban. Alicia sentía que no podía darse ese lujo, no después de todo lo que Bruna hizo por ella. La anciana había luchado mucho en vida; no podía rendirse ahora.

No. La esperanza se aferraba a ella. Rezaba a Dios por su salud. Le rogaba que sus últimos años fueran felices, en paz, sin conflictos. Que estuviera bien, que se diera lo mejor para ella.

Pero también sabía que debía prepararse mentalmente por si las circunstancias resultarán lo contrario. Tendría que empezar a movilizarse por su futuro y por el de su madre, quien padecía de esquizofrenia.

Sintió que las lágrimas se le caían apenas se sentaba en los asientos fuera del pabellón. El médico había dicho que sería necesario intubarla, pues estaba evolucionando a peor y estaban adelantándose así a un paro respiratorio. El sangrado no ha aumentado disminuido. Había quedado igual. Que solo habría que esperar a ver qué sucede.

El dolor era insoportable. La esperanza, a pesar de todo, estaba ahí. Se aferraba a ella como nunca, y sin embargo sabía que quizás sería un hasta siempre.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48GgTH3bVrpU2deKJnBCBbBUqaE4LUQy5PcyqgUfWnoGhxWmz9BfxVz4YRoqgDJ4Pu.gif

links.body: It’s fascinating how you’ve managed to capture the essence of a day by the sea. Your account is a practical lesson: the ability to accept that our surroundings don’t always go our way—be it the cold, the clouds or the state of the waves—and yet still find complete satisfaction in what is within our reach. That transition from expectation to the enjoyment of simple things, such as a walk or discovering a little detail in the sand, is what truly enriches life. Thank you for reminding me that happiness does not lie in the perfection of the plan, but in the attitude with which we embrace each moment. I’m glad you’ve found that perfect balance.

>\n<h3><a href=\

>THE SPORTING SPIRIT
by George Orwell
Now that the brief visit of the Dynamo football team has come to an end, it is possible to say publicly what many thinking people were saying privately before the Dynamos ever arrived. That is, that sport is an unfailing cause of ill-will, and that if such a visit as this had any effect at all on Anglo-Soviet relations, it could only be to make them slightly worse than before.

Even the newspapers have been unable to conceal the fact that at least two of the four matches played led to much bad feeling. At the Arsenal match, I am told by someone who was there, a British and a Russian player came to blows and the crowd booed the referee. The Glasgow match, someone else informs me, was simply a free-for-all from the start. And then there was the controversy, typical of our nationalistic age, about the composition of the Arsenal team. Was it really an all-England team, as claimed by the Russians, or merely a league team, as claimed by the British? And did the Dynamos end their tour abruptly in order to avoid playing an all-England team? As usual, everyone answers these questions according to his political predilections. Not quite everyone, however. I noted with interest, as an instance of the vicious passions that football provokes, that the sporting correspondent of the russophile News Chronicle took the anti-Russian line and maintained that Arsenal was not an all-England team. No doubt the controversy will continue to echo for years in the footnotes of history books. Meanwhile the result of the Dynamos’ tour, in so far as it has had any result, will have been to create fresh animosity on both sides.

And how could it be otherwise? I am always amazed when I hear people saying that sport creates goodwill between the nations, and that if only the common peoples of the world could meet one another at football or cricket, they would have no inclination to meet on the battlefield. Even if one didn’t know from concrete examples (the 1936 Olympic Games, for instance) that international sporting contests lead to orgies of hatred, one could deduce it from general principles.

Nearly all the sports practised nowadays are competitive. You play to win, and the game has little meaning unless you do your utmost to win. On the village green, where you pick up sides and no feeling of local patriotism is involved, it is possible to play simply for the fun and exercise: but as soon as the question of prestige arises, as soon as you feel that you and some larger unit will be disgraced if you lose, the most savage combative instincts are aroused. Anyone who has played even in a school football match knows this. At the international level sport is frankly mimic warfare. But the significant thing is not the behaviour of the players but the attitude of the spectators: and, behind the spectators, of the nations who work themselves into furies over these absurd contests, and seriously believe – at any rate for short periods – that running, jumping and kicking a ball are tests of national virtue.

Even a leisurely game like cricket, demanding grace rather than strength, can cause much ill-will, as we saw in the controversy over body-line bowling and over the rough tactics of the Australian team that visited England in 1921. Football, a game in which everyone gets hurt and every nation has its own style of play which seems unfair to foreigners, is far worse. Worst of all is boxing. One of the most horrible sights in the world is a fight between white and coloured boxers before a mixed audience. But a boxing audience is always disgusting, and the behaviour of the women, in particular, is such that the army, I believe, does not allow them to attend its contests. At any rate, two or three years ago, when Home Guards and regular troops were holding a boxing tournament, I was placed on guard at the door of the hall, with orders to keep the women out.

In England, the obsession with sport is bad enough, but even fiercer passions are aroused in young countries where games playing and nationalism are both recent developments. In countries like India or Burma, it is necessary at football matches to have strong cordons of police to keep the crowd from invading the field. In Burma, I have seen the supporters of one side break through the police and disable the goalkeeper of the opposing side at a critical moment. The first big football match that was played in Spain about fifteen years ago led to an uncontrollable riot. As soon as strong feelings of rivalry are aroused, the notion of playing the game according to the rules always vanishes. People want to see one side on top and the other side humiliated, and they forget that victory gained through cheating or through the intervention of the crowd is meaningless. Even when the spectators don’t intervene physically they try to influence the game by cheering their own side and ‘rattling’ opposing players with boos and insults. Serious sport has nothing to do with fair play. It is bound up with hatred, jealousy, boastfulness, disregard of all rules and sadistic pleasure in witnessing violence: in other words it is war minus the shooting.

Instead of blah-blahing about the clean, healthy rivalry of the football field and the great part played by the Olympic Games in bringing the nations together, it is more useful to inquire how and why this modern cult of sport arose. Most of the games we now play are of ancient origin, but sport does not seem to have been taken very seriously between Roman times and the nineteenth century. Even in the English public schools the games cult did not start till the later part of the last century. Dr Arnold, generally regarded as the founder of the modern public school, looked on games as simply a waste of time. Then, chiefly in England and the United States, games were built up into a heavily-financed activity, capable of attracting vast crowds and rousing savage passions, and the infection spread from country to country. It is the most violently combative sports, football and boxing, that have spread the widest. There cannot be much doubt that the whole thing is bound up with the rise of nationalism – that is, with the lunatic modern habit of identifying oneself with large power units and seeing everything in terms of competitive prestige. Also, organised games are more likely to flourish in urban communities where the average human being lives a sedentary or at least a confined life, and does not get much opportunity for creative labour. In a rustic community a boy or young man works off a good deal of his surplus energy by walking, swimming, snowballing, climbing trees, riding horses, and by various sports involving cruelty to animals, such as fishing, cock-fighting and ferreting for rats. In a big town one must indulge in group activities if one wants an outlet for one’s physical strength or for one’s sadistic impulses. Games are taken seriously in London and New York, and they were taken seriously in Rome and Byzantium: in the Middle Ages they were played, and probably played with much physical brutality, but they were not mixed up with politics nor a cause of group hatreds.

If you wanted to add to the vast fund of ill-will existing in the world at this moment, you could hardly do it better than by a series of football matches between Jews and Arabs, Germans and Czechs, Indians and British, Russians and Poles, and Italians and Jugoslavs, each match to be watched by a mixed audience of 100,000 spectators. I do not, of course, suggest that sport is one of the main causes of international rivalry; big-scale sport is itself, I think, merely another effect of the causes that have produced nationalism. Still, you do make things worse by sending forth a team of eleven men, labelled as national champions, to do battle against some rival team, and allowing it to be felt on all sides that whichever nation is defeated will ‘lose face’.

I hope, therefore, that we shan’t follow up the visit of the Dynamos by sending a British team to the USSR. If we must do so, then let us send a second-rate team which is sure to be beaten and cannot be claimed to represent Britain as a whole. There are quite enough real causes of trouble already, and we need not add to them by encouraging young men to kick each other on the shins amid the roars of infuriated spectators.

Tribune, 14th December 1945

Сад кад је кратка посета фудбалског тима Динамо завршена, могуће је јавно рећи оно што су многи мислећи људи говорили приватно пре него што су Динамовци уопште стигли.
