Чак ни новине нису могле да сакрију чињеницу да су најмање две од четири одигране утакмице водиле великом огорчењу. На утакмици с Арсеналом, рекао ми је неко ко је био тамо, британски и руски играч су се потукли, а публика је звиждала судији. У Глазгову, кажу, била је просто слободна туча од самог почетка. А јавила се и контроверза, типична за наше националистичко доба, о саставу Арсенала. Је ли то заиста био тим Енглеске репрезентације, како су тврдили Руси, или тек лигашки тим, како су тврдили Британци? И да ли су Динамовци нагло завршили турнеју како би избегли да играју против репрезентативног тима Енглеске? Као и обично, свако на ово одговара према својим политичким склоностима. Ипак, не баш сви. Са занимањем сам приметио, као пример злобних фудбалских страсти, да је спортски дописник русофилског Њуз Хроникла заузео антируски став и тврдио да Арсенал није репрезентација Енглеске. Нема сумње да ће контроверза годинама одјекивати у фуснотама историјских књига. У међувремену, резултат турнеје Динамоваца, уколико је имала икакав резултат, био је стварање новог непријатељства на обе стране.

А како би могло бити другачије? Увек ме задиви кад чујем људе како говоре да спорт ствара разумевање међу народима и кад би се обични људи света могли сусрести на фудбалу или крикету не би имали потребу да се срећу на бојном пољу. Чак и ако не знате конкретне примере (рецимо Олимпијске игре 1936.) како међународна спортска такмичења доводе до оргија мржње, то можете закључити из општих принципа.

Готово сви данашњи спортови су такмичарске природе. Играте да победите, и игра има мало смисла уколико не дате све од себе да победите. На сеоској ливади, где само одаберете стране и где није присутан локалпатриотизам, могуће је играти једноставно за забаву и вежбу; али чим се постави питање престижа, чим осетите да ћете ви и нека већа заједница бити осрамоћени ако изгубите, буде се најдивљији борбени инстинкти. То зна свако ко је играо фудбалску утакмицу, чак и у школи. На међународном нивоу спорт је отворено опонашање ратовања. Али ту није значајно понашање играча, већ однос посматрача и, преко посматрача, нација које се доводе до беснила због тих апсурдних такмичења и озбиљно верују – барем кратко време – да је ударање лопте и трчање и скакање за њом доказ националне врлине.

Чак и опуштена игра попут крикета, која захтева грациозност, а не снагу, може изазвати много огорчења, као што смо видели у контроверзи око поделе лопте и грубе тактике аустралијског тима који је посетио Енглеску 1921. Фудбал, игра у којој сви бивају повређени и свака нација има свој стил игре који странцима делује неправедно, далеко је гора. Најгори је бокс. Један од најстрашнијих призора на свету је борба између белих и обојених боксера пред мешовитом публиком. Али боксерска публика је увек одвратна, а понашање жена, посебно, је такво да им војска, верујем, не дозвољава да посећују такмичења. У сваком случају, пре две или три године, кад су Домобрани и редовне трупе одржавали боксерски турнир, постављен сам за стражара на вратима сале, с наређењем да не пуштам жене.

У Енглеској је опсесија спортом довољно лоша, али још жешће страсти буде се у младим земљама где су игре и национализам новији развој. У земљама попут Индије или Бурме, на фудбалским утакмицама неопходно је имати јаке кордоне полиције како би се спречило да гомила упадне на терен. У Бурми сам видео како навијачи једне стране пробијају кордон и онеспособљавају противничког голмана у критичном тренутку. Прва велика фудбалска утакмица одиграна у Шпанији пре око петнаест година довела је до неконтролисаних нереда. Чим нарасту јака осећања ривалства, идеја о игрању по правилима увек нестаје. Људи желе да виде једну страну на врху а другу понижену и заборављају да је победа стечена варањем или упадом масе бесмислена. Чак и кад не интервенишу физички, гледаоци покушавају да утичу на игру бодрењем своје стране и «збуњивањем» противничких играча урлањем и увредама. Врхунски спорт нема никакве везе с поштеном игром. Он је повезан с мржњом, завишћу, хвалисањем, непоштовањем правила и садистичким уживањем у насиљу: другим речима, то је рат без пуцњаве.

Уместо брбљања о чистом и здравом супарништву на фудбалском пољу и великој улози коју имају Олимпијске игре у зближавању нација, корисније је испитати како се и зашто појавио модерни култ спорта. Већина данашњих спортова је древног порекла, али изгледа да спорт нико није схватао озбиљно у раздобљу од римског доба до деветнаестог века. Чак ни у енглеским јавним школама култ игара није настао све до краја прошлог века. Др. Арнолд, који је сматран оснивачем модерних јавних школа, сматрао је спорт једноставно губљењем времена. Онда је, углавном у Енглеској и Сједињеним Америчким Државама, спорт постао богато финансирана активност која је могла привући огромне масе и изазвати дивље страсти, а зараза се ширила од земље до земље. Највише су се проширили најгрубљи борилачки спортови – фудбал и бокс. Нема сумње да је све то уско повезано с растом национализма – то јест, с лудачком модерном навиком поистовећивања с великим и моћним заједницама и посматрањем свега у смислу такмичарског престижа. Такође, организоване игре пре ће процветати у урбаним заједницама у којима просечан човек углавном седи и има скучену слободу живљења, без много прилике за стваралачки рад. У сеоским заједницама дечак или младић потроши добар део вишка енергије шетајући, пливајући, грудвајући се, пењући се на дрвеће, јашући коње, а и различитим спортовима који укључују окрутност према животињама, као што су пецање, борбе петлова и хватање пацова. Ако у великом граду желите да изразите физичку снагу или садистичке импулсе, морате се приклонити групним делатностима. Игре се схватају озбиљно у Лондону и Њујорку, а схватане су озбиљно и у Риму и Византији: у средњем веку било је игара, и то вероватно с много физичке бруталности, али оне нису биле помешане с политиком нити су биле узрок групних мржњи.

Ако бисте желели да додате огромну количину злобе која постоји у свету у овом тренутку, тешко да бисте то могли боље учинити него серијом фудбалских утакмица између Јевреја и Арапа, Немаца и Чеха, Индијаца и Британаца, Руса и Пољака, Италијана и Југословена, с тим да сваку утакмицу прати мешовита публика од 100.000 гледалаца. Наравно, не сугеришем да је спорт један од главних узрока међународног ривалства; велики спорт је сам по себи, мислим, само још један ефекат узрока који су произвели национализам. Ипак, ствари само погоршавате шаљући екипу од једанаест играча, с ореолом националног шампиона, да се бори против неке супарничке екипе, дозвољавајући при том осећање да ће поражена нација «изгубити образ».

Надам се, дакле, да након посете Динамоваца нећемо послати британски тим у СССР. Ако већ морамо, онда хајде да пошаљемо другоразредни тим који ће сигурно бити поражен и за који се не може тврдити да представља Британију у целини. Већ постоји довољно стварних узрока недаћа па их не треба повећавати храбрењем младића да се међусобно ударају по цеваницама уз урлање разјарених гледалаца.

links.title: Un año lejos de casa… y un cumpleaños que se acerca. Ladies of Hive Community Contest #293. [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
🇪🇸 En Español

* * *

Un año lejos de casa… y un cumpleaños que se acerca
---------------------------------------------------

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive

Las preguntas de esta semana me hicieron pensar en dos cosas muy diferentes: la experiencia de vivir en otro lugar y la manera en que celebramos el paso del tiempo.

### Si pudieras vivir un año de intercambio siendo adulta, ¿dónde te gustaría vivir y cómo imaginas esa experiencia?

Los programas de intercambio son muy conocidos en muchas partes del mundo, especialmente entre estudiantes. Sin embargo, en Cuba no es una práctica tan común como suele verse en películas o series.

Sí hemos tenido estudiantes extranjeros que vienen a estudiar aquí, y en ocasiones algunos terminan desarrollando amistades cercanas con familias cubanas que los ayudan durante su estancia. Pero la idea de pasar un año viviendo con una familia anfitriona como parte de un intercambio cultural no es algo que forme parte de mi realidad cotidiana.

Quizás por eso la pregunta me resultó tan interesante.

Si tuviera la oportunidad de vivir una experiencia así durante un año, elegiría España.

No solamente por el idioma, que facilitaría la adaptación, sino porque siempre me ha parecido un lugar donde conviven historia, tradición y modernidad de una manera muy especial.

Me gustaría recorrer ciudades, conocer museos, caminar por barrios antiguos, descubrir costumbres locales y observar cómo transcurre la vida diaria de las personas más allá de los lugares turísticos.

También me gustaría aprovechar ese tiempo para leer más, escribir más y aprender todo lo posible sobre la cultura del lugar.

Imagino una familia anfitriona sencilla y acogedora, de esas que disfrutan las conversaciones durante la cena y que consideran la mesa un espacio para compartir historias y experiencias.

Creo que lo más valioso de una experiencia así no sería visitar lugares famosos, sino aprender a mirar el mundo desde otra perspectiva durante un tiempo.

Y quizás también descubrir cosas nuevas sobre mí misma.

* * *

### ¿Te gusta celebrar tu propio cumpleaños?


---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc7v16kgrge5UU7LrkwtwaPuswfmAieHt56uehj8BZhsF/elkaaaaaaa_company_3016615_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/birthday-company-candles-smiles-3016615/)

--

Sí, me gusta celebrar mi cumpleaños.

No porque me guste ser el centro de atención, sino porque siempre lo he visto como una oportunidad para compartir con las personas que quiero.

Además, me gusta recibir mensajes, llamadas y muestras de cariño de familiares y amigos. Son pequeños gestos que hacen sentir que uno ocupa un lugar importante en la vida de otras personas.

Y precisamente esta pregunta llega en un momento curioso.

Si todo va bien, el próximo 19 de junio cumpliré 26 años.

Será un cumpleaños especial porque será el primero que celebre en mi actual centro de trabajo junto a este nuevo equipo de compañeros.

Y aunque nadie me ha dicho nada directamente, he escuchado algunas conversaciones sueltas y ciertas preguntas sospechosamente discretas que me hacen pensar que podrían estar preparando algo.

No sé si será cierto o no.

Pero debo admitir que la idea me emociona.

Más allá de cualquier regalo o celebración, siempre es bonito sentir que las personas con las que compartimos nuestros días desean que tengamos un momento feliz.

Y creo que esa es una de las mejores cosas que tienen los cumpleaños.

Nos recuerdan que el tiempo pasa, sí.

Pero también nos recuerdan los vínculos que hemos construido en el camino.

* * *

Gracias por leer

Un abrazo sincero para todas

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue hecha con DeepL Translate.

* * *

🇬🇧 In English

* * *

A Year Away From Home... and a Birthday That Is Approaching
-----------------------------------------------------------

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community

This week's questions made me think about two very different things: the experience of living somewhere else and the way we celebrate the passing of time.

### If you could live abroad for a year as an adult, where would you choose to go and what would that experience be like?

Exchange programs are very popular in many parts of the world, especially among students. However, in Cuba this is not something as common as it often appears in movies or television shows.

We have had foreign students come to study here, and sometimes they develop close friendships with Cuban families who help them during their stay. But the idea of spending a year living with a host family as part of a cultural exchange is not something that is part of my everyday reality.

Perhaps that is why I found this question so interesting.

If I had the opportunity to live such an experience for a year, I would choose Spain.

Not only because of the language, which would make adaptation easier, but also because it has always seemed like a place where history, tradition, and modern life coexist in a very special way.

I would love to explore cities, visit museums, walk through historic neighborhoods, discover local customs, and observe daily life beyond the typical tourist attractions.

I would also like to use that time to read more, write more, and learn as much as possible about the culture around me.

I imagine a warm and welcoming host family, the kind that enjoys long conversations around the dinner table and sees meals as an opportunity to share stories and experiences.

I think the most valuable part of such an experience would not be visiting famous places.

It would be learning to see the world from a different perspective for a while.

And perhaps discovering new things about myself as well.

* * *

### Do you enjoy celebrating your own birthday?

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc7v16kgrge5UU7LrkwtwaPuswfmAieHt56uehj8BZhsF/elkaaaaaaa_company_3016615_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/birthday-company-candles-smiles-3016615/)

--

Yes, I do.

Not because I enjoy being the center of attention, but because I see birthdays as an opportunity to spend time with the people I care about.

I also enjoy receiving messages, phone calls, and expressions of affection from friends and family. They are small gestures that remind us that we hold a place in the lives of others.

And this question arrives at a rather interesting moment.

If everything goes as planned, I will turn 26 on June 19.

It will be a special birthday because it will be the first one I celebrate at my current workplace with this new team of colleagues.

Although nobody has told me anything directly, I have overheard a few conversations and noticed some suspiciously discreet questions that make me think they might be planning something.

I do not know if that is really the case.

But I have to admit that the idea makes me happy.

Beyond gifts or celebrations, it is always nice to feel that the people with whom we share our days want us to have a happy moment.

And I think that is one of the best things about birthdays.

They remind us that time passes, yes.

But they also remind us of the connections we have built along the way.

* * *

Thank you for reading

A sincere hug to all

links.title: What would I do if I won $1 million tomorrow?
links.body: <div class=\

>




If I woke up tomorrow, and found out that I won $1 million, my first thought would likely be, \
followed by \

no, no, no, no, no, no, how did this happen? I would have to wait a couple moments to be certain that it was real. If I can win that much, it will be a game-changer for me and will open the doors for opportunities that I never thought about. ![1001614730.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/23yJJhHiFdXL7MKF58g1GbsvNpAqkiMxmL6R1uX9Air5sFxH4awDy3guBiN2RrMLJZBQi.png) First, I'd pray thanks to God. I feel like everything good comes from Him; if I could get such a blessing, I would be so grateful. Once I would take my time and not rush into making decisions. One of the common pitfalls is that many people begin spending money when they suddenly have a lot of it. I would want to be prudent with the money and put it to good uses that would be of lasting value. Helping my family would be one of my number one priorities. We know people around us who have sacrificed so much for our well being and I would want to make their life easier. I would make sure my parents and close family members were at ease and not burdened with financial problems. If I could see that my loved ones live happier lives, it would definitely make me happy. I would also spend a good amount of the money on the investment. Rather than blow all my money on fancy purchases, I'd try to develop income-generating opportunities that would generate cash for decades. I would be interested in investing in business, real estate and other ventures with long term potential. My intent would not be solely to get rich, but to be able to stay rich in the future. Another area I would focus would be on education. Education is one of the most valuable things that one can have. I would use some of these funds to further my education and acquire skills that would be beneficial to me in personal and professional development. I would also be willing to give others education when I can because with education, lives can change. I would also want to do some projects that would help people to get opportunities. There are many wonderful people who don't have the resources or support. I would love to give back to others and help them achieve their goals by supporting youth and inspiring creativity if I could. I'd rather spend money on myself, but being able to make a positive difference in peoples' lives would be more fulfilling. Well, I would set aside some money to have fun. I would want to go traveling, see different cultures and visit places I only see in pictures and videos. Traveling will help me to learn new things and know more about the outside world. But I would do this responsibly, with a reasonable budget. I would also put aside some of the funds for emergencies and future needs. Financial security is important, and having a financial safety net would give you some peace of mind. It's never easy to plan for the future, but smart planning now could help avoid problems later. If I would win $1 million, it would be a tremendous blessing, but I think value is in the uses that are made of money. It wouldn't be a matter of displaying wealth or being a spendthrift. It would be about being better, helping my family, investing, helping others, and making a difference to a better future. I would be pleasantly amazed to have $1 million from winning the lottery tomorrow, and I'd hope it would be a blessing as well as a burden to spend wisely and with a purpose. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@julie100/what-would-i-do-if-i-won-1-million-tomorrow-4g3)

links.title: Today's tour is Jamuna Bridge and Jamuna River.
links.body:
https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=dmann/7icmmkrn

Hello, dear friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well, everyone is healthy and you all stay healthy. I wish you all the best. I am also well. My heart is cheerful. Especially today, I am very happy to be able to travel. My heart is very peaceful. Dear friends, who loves to travel, I will share my experience with you today, Insha Allah.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBosLhJMk92MgnsbgrQMkyLDMkDbhH9HtFDTC11BX794/1781446073897.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMrSmbX8wKwfedps7CS4MbFWNvQdnwf4hpFAbGjnahUD/1781446074026.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYb2AztbdJrSaXXKGezri1H9QYxkZjNQ23YHKvxVKEZET/1781446074177.jpg)

Friends, every person loves to travel and definitely loves to visit their favorite places and today we have come to visit such a peaceful place from a far away place where it takes us about two hours to go. Anyway, two hours seems like two minutes. Today we had a lot of fun, we walked around, ate and drank. It felt like we had come to a dreamland. But no, that was not my dream. I have come here in reality to see these scenes. So, friends, we left our home for that desired destination. First, we took a battery-operated rickshaw to the bus stand where a large number of buses were already waiting to go to our desired Jamuna Bridge.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTsnPbLxhvaQdZFuVu6G3ez8s5evQbmikQruyVBq4BHW4/1781446099095.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFgcEBERLdvySjvThwujSU44RLAe8rbyrQnHLLGMQEBv/1781446099224.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR6Zz7nqtUqA8NLCRWRqmjMWydgZSJzTwPuGnvkKJLUGv/1781446099389.jpg)

So we went to the bus stand and took a bus, that is, we got into a bus. From there, each of us was charged 100 taka. The bus was very nice and the seats were very nice. We chose this bus to go there. So we got into the bus without delay. Although it was very hot, we saw a fan inside the bus and sat down on it so that the heat would be a little less. In a few minutes, the bus started moving and we started to feel more happy. The bus was moving and our minds were filled with joy and happiness because in a short time, we would reach that place and enjoy the view of the river, the view of the boats on the river bank and how people earn their living there. Our minds danced with joy just thinking about it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTKzgmn1KT3xFsAowbM1neJQPLd4cAbnKhuE2hpbYMXmN/1781446124605.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUyGQdfsG7EH5ffzGdbqENuPAMoMocdSbNXE7RSbhjxo/1781446124810.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYc2ENueoxCSZKb4Yo6PM5rfjodEmhiECKqaqsuwzYFzK/1781446124936.jpg)

So friends, we were going by bus and the views around it were to double our joy because the green fields were blooming all around the road as if the beautiful beauty of the village was blooming. The green trees and fields were calling us and welcoming us. We also seemed to merge with the call of nature. We were united in reading the hidden beauty of nature and enjoying this beauty. But we were almost at our desired place, the largest bridge of our country, the Jamuna Bridge. When this Jamuna Bridge was inaugurated, it was known as the 11th child in the world, but even then, since there were several other bridges, its position was a little behind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcT1f8ebYC2CejcAeDYurXoEHNUK7HqDDX4CR4ZYbq1yV/1781446140247.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPkadjS3xn9v4paWSTWwB37ppmSMba4PMcMCF4C5MevpR/1781446140380.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeK1iSUaQPhvTdT9hidkfNzEQbPqFegg1LQfyZ1KbEiBJ/1781446140497.jpg)

So friends, today we are going to see those scenes, the view of the Yamuna River and the view of the Yamuna Bridge, but our road is ending in a very short time and we think we will reach it in a very short time because it seemed as if that bridge and that beautiful beauty of the river were waiting for us. So we got off the bus, had some cold food like sugarcane juice, then some tea, and with the help of a band, we went along the river. Those beautiful scenes kept appearing before our eyes again and again. Friends, do you like to travel like this? If you do, of course you can tell us through your comments because I like traveling, that's why I have presented this video for you today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFgcEBERLdvySjvThwujSU44RLAe8rbyrQnHLLGMQEBv/1781446159723.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDUNXfcJmtSc4VvPZY5gSu2jxFBxW4ZXayz58ggRw3ZT/1781446159905.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMrSmbX8wKwfedps7CS4MbFWNvQdnwf4hpFAbGjnahUD/1781446160025.jpg)

Dear friends, how did you like my travel video today? You must give your important feedback so that in the future I can present you with better and more interesting videos of higher quality. I am saying goodbye to everyone by thanking everyone and requesting them to watch my video. May everyone be well and healthy. May Allah Hafez protect you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYb2AztbdJrSaXXKGezri1H9QYxkZjNQ23YHKvxVKEZET/1781446228306.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTsnPbLxhvaQdZFuVu6G3ez8s5evQbmikQruyVBq4BHW4/1781446228437.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYc2ENueoxCSZKb4Yo6PM5rfjodEmhiECKqaqsuwzYFzK/1781446228569.jpg)

links.title: El Blockazo
links.body: <div class=\

>\n\n​Joseph sentía que cargaba con un trofeo, no con un chocolate. Sus dos manos apenas alcanzaban para sostener el paquete gigante del Blockazo de Cofler. Un kilo entero de chocolate con maní. Envoltorio amarillo, letras grandes y un eslogan que le tocaba el alma: \

.

​Estaba parado en el pasillo de dulces del supermercado, con los ojos fijos en su papá, que venía arrastrando el carrito con cara de estar pensando en la cuenta de la luz. Joseph sabía que no podías pedir algo así a la ligera. Necesitaba una estrategia, un argumento infalible.

<center>
![1000691330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/23ywyLPHKfEKmfyf7NMMaUj2yNkRhfqEEqBMHrCif4XZn12kV51k91N6NBVaXqiBCbs3w.jpg)</center>


​—Pa... —dijo Joseph, usando su tono más maduro y calculador—. Mirá esto.
​Su papá frenó el carrito, miró el paquete, miró a Joseph por encima de los anteojos y soltó una risita.
—¿Qué es eso, Joseph? ¿Un ladrillo para construir una casa? Dejá eso ahí, nos va a dar diabetes de solo mirarlo.

​—No, escuchame —insistió Joseph, dándole un paso al frente para que viera bien el diseño del chocolate grabado en el envase—. No es para comerlo hoy. Pensalo como una inversión. El viernes es el partido inaugural del Mundial. Jugamos el primer partido.

​Su papá se cruzó de brazos, pero con una media sonrisa. Ya sabía por dónde venía la mano.

—¿Y qué tiene que ver el Mundial con un kilo de chocolate?

​—Tiene todo que ver —argumentó Joseph con total seriedad—. Los nervios del debut, papá. Vos te ponés re loco con los tiros libres. Mamá se va a la cocina porque no quiere mirar. Si compramos este Blockazo, lo ponemos en el centro de la mesa ratona. Cada vez que nos dé un ataque de nervios, en vez de comernos las uñas, le pegamos un tarascón al chocolate. Nos dura para todo el partido, posta. Además, mirá... dice \

. Trae suerte, es cabala. ​El papá se quedó mirando el paquete amarillo. Es verdad que se venía el Mundial y la adrenalina ya se sentía en la calle. Miró los ojos bien abiertos de Joseph detrás de sus lentes, sosteniendo semejante monstruo de chocolate con un entusiasmo que no le cabía en el cuerpo. ​—Un kilo, Joseph... Es una guasada —dijo el papá, pero ya estaba estirando la mano para agarrarlo y pesar el paquete—. Che, pesa en serio esto. ​—¡Te lo juro! Rinde un montón. Dale, pá, lo compramos hoy y prometo que no lo tocamos hasta que el árbitro toque el silbato el viernes. ​El papá lo miró un segundo más, suspiró con una sonrisa y lo tiró adentro del carrito, justo arriba de los fideos. —Bueno, pero si nos quedamos afuera en primera ronda, te comés el chocolate solo por mufa. ​—¡Olvidate, somos locales! —festejó Joseph, metiendo un salto en medio del pasillo. ​Esa noche, el Blockazo fue directo a la alacena más alta. Joseph lo mira todos los días cuando vuelve del colegio. Falta poco para el viernes, y el chocolate gigante ya es parte del equipo.

**Foto(s) tomada(s) con mi smartphone Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.** ![SeparadorSteemit10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/MGmK4oZF-Separador-Steemit-10.png) ![20200113_094257.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vgalue/ADBBL526-20200113_094257.png)

links.title: Building a Better Future with One Million Dollars
links.body:
In the event that I wake up one morning and come to the realisation that I've won a million dollars, I'd be thrilled, super excited and filled with joy, and that's because of the fact that having such a huge amount of money will transform my life and that of my family, change our story for good and create a huge gap between me and poverty if we manage the money well. One million dollars is a very huge amount of money, and in a country like mine, it's an amount that can literally make poverty a thing of the past in your family generation if wisely invested and managed. ![1000566900.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23t7DYqs4EWe357gQVu1aXrFJ9ev6DWTGSE62BuxaTJVYdAeFtYj2wbB4Wcu76BSZMaEF.png) The above statement is said because I believe a million dollars is a life-changing amount; if converted to my country's local currency, naira, that'll be about one billion three hundred and fifty million naira. If I were to win that, I'd need to pinch myself at least ten times throughout that day to be certain I'm not dreaming and the universe isn't playing a prank on me. Now, talking about what I'll do when I win such an amount? Will I quit my job or continue working despite having such a huge amount? I'd like to say I won't quit my job, at least not immediately, and the reason is so I won't stop working out of comfort but keep spending till I exhaust the whole amount of money. Having such a huge amount of money needs serious deliberations on what to do and how to do it. So after going through critical thinking, there are things I'll certainly do that already came to mind. One of such things is starting a business, although at the moment I don't have any in mind, but I know when we get to that bridge, we'll cross it. I'd also invest heavily in my wife's business, which is building her a fashion house and stocking the place with lots of equipment and fashion tools that make her service delivery exceptional, fast and easy. Another thing I'd be doing is investing in the stock market and different businesses I know have a bright future, and also I'd be building my dream house. I'd want my family to live a happy and comfortable life, so building a house of my dreams that's stocked with all necessary home appliances would be a nice thing to do. That's about all I'll do when I have such a huge amount of money, but like I said, the first priority and most important is investment in business and an ideal that'll help me sustain and multiply what I have so that my lineage will never know struggles again. *** All photos are taken and edited on canva. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/building-a-better-future-with-one-million-dollars-ery)

links.title: Catching Up with Keto Meal Photos - by Sunscape
links.body:
![foodiesbeehive-pork-ribs-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKRhx6vjjXnzzyq8cNQREtsCiT9WFA8jmvx7FQCwtD2h/foodiesbeehive-pork-ribs-2.jpg)

I don't know how time goes by so quickly before I catch up with editing photos for postings.  Then they sit in the cue, waiting to be shared with all of you.  Do any of you have a hard time finding enough time to get it all done?


![foodiesbeehive-porkloin-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf5qNx2JDpxzbpL4jcWMC78k4xzCxpUCekNVgnLKNYNmG/foodiesbeehive-porkloin-1.jpg)

Last fall, I processed some of my Zucchini into syrup/jam.  It makes a nice glaze for chicken or pork.  On this day, I used it on pork ribs for that night's dinner.


![foodiesbeehive-ribs-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVcFXtFDhjDT1WrkxVScttWApDPWSQNx4wfNvH9hrh5s8/foodiesbeehive-ribs-1.jpg)

I always simmer my pork ribs before putting them into the air fryer to finish them. This glaze is perfect in my opinion, and a favorite now.  


![foodiesbeehive-ribs-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVqgRdz9vuYjDj7jKhc4hb8Yua3LdM32au22qifPsXbB5/foodiesbeehive-ribs-2.jpg)

It only takes about 12 minutes to get a nice browning on the ribs in the air fryer.  


![foodiesbeehive-pork-ribs-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHpq6ffNBjMpx8tqd38GnEXAeb1FveLhKMx4Jx98CQs1/foodiesbeehive-pork-ribs-1.jpg)

For the sides, I made a spinach salad with radish and Feta cheese.  Plus, I had my favorite Grandma's Coleslaw too.  Hubby asked for some cranberry sauce, and I had a tablespoon of it as well.

It is sometimes a challenge for me to avoid carbohydrates while following a Keto diet.  


![foodiesbeehive-salad.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5kCnVWsNfNBcgUtLZ6FAsmirANgkgvb1xZTMXwCLpoh/foodiesbeehive-salad.jpg)

I do eat a lot of salads, even with that, I still seem to have stalled with dropping weight. 


![chickpea salad.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeKS2xhsK78dZtBTrGE4WKfKZFa9oY5YsoWjRW1VuwZqH/chickpea%20salad.jpg)

I made a large batch of chickpea salad, and that became my side dish for meals.  It's a nice salad, and very filling too. 


![silverbloggers-salad.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTNRvYQLRtdajsLfAymirgk5zXeFiSUNnZ6EgnaSNAQg9/silverbloggers-salad.jpg)

I'm going to focus on avocado, greens, and sardines for lunch this week.  Hopefully, that will put me back into ketosis.  Eating high-fat meals is supposed to help me to burn off fat rather than store it.  

![keto lunch.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma78DdwU93RaCt5CaxKETxeKfNEGWvksfGS2nmRoy4zGM/keto%20lunch.jpg)

Living with an Italian husband makes it a bit tough to stay away from carbs, especially at dinner time.  He loves pasta, bread, and cookies, lol.

![foodiesbeehive-sauce.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbqA6MPWPupFaxM1mptinC5e7UwQ5o4STbFewNFCchMJa/foodiesbeehive-sauce.jpg)

I made a large kettle of spaghetti sauce and put most of it in the freezer.  That night we had spaghetti with meatballs, and of course, garlic bread. 

![foodiesbeehive-spagetti-dinner.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQjLea6CwgTTWbqfVXYzkU74ZfZazmNUwfZVmb7bBjSEW/foodiesbeehive-spagetti-dinner.jpg)

Dang, it was so good! The following day, I only ate salads since I indulged in so many carbs.


![keto-salad (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQHKt41AMTRvzTSXaJ1xPqvydFzZf3ybrUuuzqHT8784/keto-salad%20(1).jpg)

I put a little tuna fish on the salad for lunch, which helped me fill up until dinner that night.  


![foodiesbeehive-keto-salad.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQ1LcvVmWENYXjwRKM84QCDPqwHzmcg6e8M7pqBm69GL/foodiesbeehive-keto-salad.jpg)

With this salad, I had a leftover chicken breast in the fridge, so I cut that up and tossed it on the salad for dinner.  

This week, I'm determined to behave myself by eating a lot of veggies, salads, and sardines, and get myself back on track with #intermittent #fasting too.  I found I was getting hungry earlier in the morning, when I normally don't eat until 1:30 p.m. I'm sure that is one of the reasons for the scale not going down....sigh.

Well, at least I used some of my edited photos today.  Perhaps tomorrow I will use a few more. 

![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

links.title: Thoughts On Emergency Tutor Requests
links.body: Hi there. In this education post, I share my thoughts on emergency or short notice tutoring requests. Recently, I have had a few offers to take on a few math students. These two students had different scenarios but both want a short term math tutor to prepare them for a final exam. One was at risk of failing and the other older student wanted a few sessions for Grade 12 Data Management (Intro Probability and Statistics.)
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source   ## Short Term Mindset --- Requests for tutors are typically at a high when a test or exam is near. It could be worth it for some households to hire someone to get tough questions answered before a test. There may be one session or a few sessions before a test. Students will vary in skill level, attitude, work ethic and learning ability. Some students learn faster than others and some may need more time. A high performing student may not need many sessions for good test preparations. A struggling student may need more sessions than requested to do well in the course.
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source   ## The Tutoring May Be Too Late --- The student offer I had where the student is at risk in failing the course did not go through. My availability did not match their Thursday request for short notice tutoring over Saturday and Sunday. I was told that this student had around a 58% average before the upcoming test. It is not known what the student knows, doesn't know and if he does any math homework. Expecting an A grade from a D+ average is not realistic. Two one hour sessions may help in covering some concepts. If the student's number sense and algebra skills are not great, then two weekend sessions is likely not good enough for the student to be proficient enough for a math test. In a few cases, I think parents could be a problem for a student's learning. The parents themselves may think that cramming works but it does not most of the time. Building skills over a long period time and long term thinking does not exist with some parents. If a student has a few problems to go over then it is okay to have a few sessions to clarify topics before a test. Students that have deeper issues or have not done much work are likely not too benefit too much from short notice tutoring sessions. Too much time has passed.
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

links.title: MCGI Topic Review | Is praying enough to get closer to God.
links.body: <div class=\

>


https://youtu.be/vSX-kqrVyf4?si=megGeUY2Op2zSTZ_



One of the most beautiful gifts that God has given to us is prayer. I can pray and talk to God, pour out my heart, share my concerns and give thanks to God for His blessings. Prayer helps me to feel connected because I know that God is always present, He is always listening. The Bible tells us to pray without ceasing (1 Thessalonians 5:17). This shows how important prayer is in the life of every believer.

But I feel that praying by itself does not take one nearer to God. The health of the relationship with God is not only in the talking to Him, but in listening to Him and obeying Him. God speaks to us through His word. Whenever I read the Bible, I get to know more about His character, His promises, and what He expects of me. The Bible is saying \
(James 4:8). There are many dimensions in which we must come close to God.\n\nI have also learned that I need to be obedient. Jesus said, \

(John 14:15). If I keep His commands and do all I can to act in His ways, then I get closer to Him. Faith, obedience, love and a desire to do what God would have us do enrich prayer. I pray, but sometimes I don't feel close to God. It is in those times when I feel that I must look at my heart, read the Word of God more, and spend more time pondering His goodness. Prayer is the gateway and a close relationship with God is built through prayer, bible study, obedience and faithfulness. Thus prayer is crucial but prayer alone is not sufficient. I will only get closer to God if I seek him with my whole heart each day. “Seek me, and ye shall find me, if ye seek me with all your heart.” Jeremiah 29:13.

links.title: Sapien Loop 3 – Part One
links.body:
Hi Everyone,

![Sapien_Loop_3_Part_1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVfVcRD9tPzeqbs18eVXiZrEp3jbxmL.gif)

Part One jumps straight back into the story where Sapien Loop 2 left off. Orcilla has woken up from her coma inside the wreckage of a crashed vehicle. She finds her sister, who has been badly injured. It does not take long for her to start recovering rapidly. They continue on their journey to find Flint, who they believe will take them back to the Downs Region. Instead, they encounter a dissident group from the underground world. It does not take them long to form an alliance to help each other.

Tiberius remains as the puppet leader for Maskameera and August. He is unhappy about this arrangement. He attempts to gain full control over Sapey. Through the Jennifer chip in Tiberius’ head, Maskameera and August are aware of his plans. They are able to easily thwart his efforts. However, they still need to keep him motivated. To satisfy him, he is granted the title of Emperor. Just like that, an Empire has emerged.

[Sapien Loop 3 - Part 1: The World Has Grown and Chapter 1: Surviving the Wreckage](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-1-surviving-the-wreckage)

Orcilla helps Yassmay out of the wrecked vehicle. They continue their journey to find Flint. On the way, they encounter a different group of underground Linap.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 2: Underground Guests](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-2-underground-guests)

Orcilla and Yassmay have dinner with the High Philosopher of the underground cult. It does not take them long to form a potentially mutually beneficial alliance.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 3: Learning New Ways to Fly](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-3-learning-new-ways-to-fly)

Julio, the mentor of the High Philosopher, takes Orcilla and Yassmay back to the surface to demonstrate their special winged suits.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 4: Lessons from the Loops](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-4-lessons-from-the-loops)

The next day, Orcilla and Yassmay join the High Philosopher for breakfast. The High Philosopher tells them the story of the loops taking them back to the very first loop and how everything began.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 5: Back to Downs](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-5-back-to-downs)

Cecil has arrived back in the Downs Region with Daily, who is badly injured from the crash. Miro is furious that he did not retrieve Orcilla and Yassmay’s bodies from the wreckage.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 6: My Hell](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-6-my-hell)

Demadrian wakes up in an alternative past. He is confronted by his own creations who attempt to terrorise and force him into madness.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 7: Waking Up to a New World](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-7-waking-up-to-a-new-world)

The frozen Alset woke up from their surgery and treatment. Most of their memories are restored, and they can remember each other again. They are also forced to confront a recent tragedy.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 8: The Funeral](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-8-the-funeral)

It is the day of Jenna’s funeral. The Alset family and Benny express their sorrow for her loss. Tiberius uses the funeral to further incriminate his enemies.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 9: It’s Not What It Seems](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-9-it-s-not-what-it-seems)

Duffo orders Daily to be arrested based on Vulay’s confession at the funeral service. Yassmay and Eugene investigate Polly’s suspicious behaviour.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 10: Time to Sleuth](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-10-time-to-sleuth)

Eugene is determined to find the truth. He teams up with Yassmay to prove Daily’s innocence. Yassmay uses her mind voice device like a lie detector.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 11: He’s on Fire!](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-11-he-s-on-fire)

Tiberius believes he has identified all those who are controlling him through Jennifer. He plans to capture and eliminate them in one swoop, thus freeing him from their control. 

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 12: The Bounce Back](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-12-the-bounce-back)

Tiberius is devastated after his attempts to free himself from Maskameera, August, and Lily fail miserably. Maskameera visits him in an attempt to raise his spirits and give him something that will keep him motivated. Tiberius is able to persuade her to push for him to be declared Emperor of Sapey.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 13: Behind the Scenes](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-13-behind-the-scenes)

Eugene continues his investigation. He interviews Lily to find out more about Polly and Jennifer. Flint visits the cult’s underground city to retrieve Orcilla and Yassmay.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 14: The Coronation](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-14-the-coronation)

Tiberius is to be crowned Sapey’s first Emperor. The coronation is a huge event, attracting all in Sapey. The official crowning occurs in the House of Divine Knowledge temple. Tiberius ends the coronation with a controversial announcement that infuriates Maskameera. While everyone is distracted by the coronation, the Hat Lady attempts to rescue Demadrian.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 15: Bringing the Food](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-15-bringing-the-food)

Team foodies are introduced. Their job is to bring food to the West Camp. However, they encounter several problems that hinder their progress. Luckily, they make a new friend who is willing to help them.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 16: Fooling Me Fooling You](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-16-fooling-me-fooling-you)

The Hat Lady was captured while rescuing Demadrian. Tiberius confronts her, but she uses this opportunity to escape. Tiberius calls an emergency meeting to discuss his security concerns. He also uses this meeting to create his executive council.

[Sapien Loop 3: Chapter 17: Friends Not Food](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@captainhive/sapien-loop-3-chapter-17-friends-not-food)

The executive council meets to discuss amending existing laws. They are in agreement regarding the first few law changes, but arguments breakout out over the final law, which had been made by Eugene after the fall of Sapey. This creates a rift between Maskameera and Colin.

-----

## The Sapien Loop Series

![Loop_Series.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uFHJ6RctoaR7JdX6JCqpxxZqfbR1uEmwbcd6NoJfaiCzK5S3sGDs5tFqqvNGY7ouzYh.gif)

I am writing a trilogy of books titled Sapien Loop. The first in the series is [Sapien Loop: End of an Era](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CSF3TTVF) and the second is [Sapien Loop: Frozen in Time](https://www.amazon.com/Sapien-Loop-2-Frozen-Time-ebook/dp/B0DSWKGXX3). I published both of these books as ebooks on Amazon, and I have posted completed chapters to my @captainhive account. I anticipate publishing the third book in early 2027. I expect to title this book Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide. In 2025, I plan to write short stories about some of the characters and their adventures. I will post these to my @captainhive over the course of the year.

## Brief Summary of Sapien Loop: End of an Era

<center>![Sapien_Loop_Full_Hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23zGebDBwFPpB2PMXWTHr428cPjoJbzCFpWmGn1aJSFQreBA9aboCEQK6LUQK1X2xGW21.gif)</center>

This story is based on the fictional planet Sapia and its sole country, Sapey. Sapey is portrayed as a form of utopia for all its citizens. No poverty. No war. Almost no crime. Opportunities for all.

This was enough for most citizens, but not all. In one of the small regions, some of the citizens had become discontent. They felt something important was missing in their lives. Their discontent did not go unnoticed. Some of the Sapey elite wanted to weaponise this discontent to gain more power. This created more chaos than they anticipated. This led to further widespread social unrest.

On top of the chaos, ambition and greed provoked another enemy. This enemy was on a mission to settle both new and old scores.

## Brief Summary of Sapien Loop: Frozen in Time

![Sapien_Loop_2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uQJt3boCwrJj4ViDQL1SJTiJ3bTX3AMwAvGktY4ybQ6eTZqU23Y1Fzwg68Rvat9MiV7.gif)

This story is based six years after the original story. The Downs Region is still suffering from a serious health crisis caused by the contaminated water. The main characters are desperately trying to find a cure for the illness that has been caused by the water. 

One of the main characters has discovered frozen humanoids in hidden chambers. It appears they have been frozen for a long time. These chambers connect to a vast network of tunnels. While exploring the tunnels, one of the frozen humanoids disappears. It appears he has been stolen. 

The story takes a step back in time to tell the story of the frozen humanoids. How and why were they frozen? This part of the story also explains the fall of ancient Sapey and the birth of the Sapiens. Can those from the past be able to coexist with those from the present? 

## Hive: Future of Social Media
 
<center>![Hive_Social_1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23tm96bQUYSEwtpU7PHnXP8Fjqn3JtUYpHHKRWVvqVv7aoA2CgZbcoEsXGuCUFgpSWEmn.gif)</center>
 
## Spectrumecons on the **Hive Blockchain**

links.title: You'll be grateful you monitored the market.
links.body:
![file_00000000d1bc71f4bd53efcdcc04cd73.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcHgmT25BiEoK6tei4NfGUcpUU6cwfU3VuG93jmy8dL2G/file_00000000d1bc71f4bd53efcdcc04cd73.png)



<hr>


BTC is sitting at 64k, but a few days ago it dumped to 59k and a lot of people thought it might dump freely till it hit 48k or something, but I thought it was too soon, and since I'm speculating that we're going to bottom in early Q4, I felt we weren't going to bleed too fast and hit the 52 to 55k range, I just didn't think so, guess what? 


> I was right. 

At 64k now, I think we've seen a price recovery from the 59k range. This price recovery isn't necessary a great thing, to me, it's a proof that the market is going to do some back and forth in price movement before finally bottoms at that 45 to 52k range. 


This is what I like to call a slow bleed. In reality slow bleed is typical of a negative market: you've think the price is stable only for it to dump, recover and start dumping again. Basically it's just like a *\

* situation.


 Irrespective of a whether the BTC price is pumping or dumping, the most important thing is to look at the whether it's a bear or a bull market.


 However over 90% of people don't do this. Short term prices have made people misjudge market prices, and honestly no one can escape this unless you do not even EXPECT to become financially free with crypto. 


It's not like BTC will make anyone financially free anyway. The only reason we're always analyzing BTC is because it's the it's the easiest asset to analyse, so instead of predicting whether HYPE or ETH will pump *(which comes with a lot of uncertainty)* it's just easier to look at the chart and previous behaviors of the BTC Price movement across timelines and years and then use them to predict other *less-certain* assets. 




 However the market is changing, and 2022 to 2025 was an indication of the change and we can no longer count on other crypto (alts) to do the same price movement that we saw from 2013 to 2021. 


Infact it's impossible now, and this is the reality we are currently faced with. This is also me talking from the experience of 2025. We all thought the market would do some very good pump in late 2025 as we expected, but it didn't, we expect BTC to at least do a x3 and hit 180k but it only topped at 120k. 


 > A solid X3 investment 


Not bad at all, but then it underperformed and this is the point. At the moment we can always do our analyses, the market will definitely move when we expect it to, but is it actually going to clock those numbers that we speculate? No. This is the bottom line. 


The market will do what it wants, and all we can do is to just keep studying patterns, as this will help us to at least score a 70% prediction on what the market is supposed to do, or how its supposed to behave. 


This is how or why I think that 2026 will be another slow bleed year for BTC, and then we stop dumping. As much as this sounds horrible, it's actually a period where people can accumulate.



 64k is not a favourable price to buy BTC when you can actually wait to buy it at 52k, and probably sell at 195k in late 2028, or better still put that money in some other great assets, including our very own Hive. The whole essence of this post is to highlight that Paying attention to the market now might be worth it, even though it doesn't look like it.



 These are periods that just keep paying attention, and for me, seeing BTC at 64k proved something today: I think I'm beginning to look at the whole crypto and blockchain thingy without sentiment.

links.body:

|-|-|

<div class=\
><div class=\

>¡Hey! ¿Cómo están, amigos de Hiverun? Espero que todos estén muy bien. Por fin llegó el momento de compartir después de tantos días sin correr debido a una lesión de tobillo grado 1, casi llegando a grado 2, porque hay algunos síntomas que sí tuve de grado 2; prácticamente estuve al borde de dejar de correr durante 2 o 3 meses. Después de 3 semanas tomando desinflamatorio y poniéndome hielo, el día miércoles por la tarde, decidí arriesgarme un poco, correr 5 km a un ritmo suave, sin necesidad de ir tan rápido.\n\n
><div class=\

>Hey! How are you all doing, Hiverun friends? I hope you’re all doing really well. The time has finally come to share my story after so many days off running due to a grade 1 ankle injury – which almost turned into a grade 2, as I did experience some symptoms typical of a grade 2 injury; I was practically on the verge of having to stop running for two or three months. After 3 weeks of taking anti-inflammatories and icing it, on Wednesday afternoon, I decided to take a bit of a risk and run 5 km at a gentle pace, without needing to go too fast. ---
![1001075258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tRv4ykLFQp5VA9nCi5TZzVn3fmZb1DXZf6sYtDdqo7bbpyzceUyDP4LNuMtUEzBavet.jpg)
| |-| ---
![1001075260.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tRxRsYNAt2dsrTdob7cD8mivjvMqwefB12kKCLAaqRZe9B7UjCwsf43y2B2wHDvc1JQ.jpg)
|
![1001075262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23wBZcdkyLNtWSqxed83CEajbrSFvFRqubL8bRHBDqcRYNjqH3m3mxQNurBCfb9CztdMt.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
><div class=\

>Primeramente, para ver cómo estaba mi tendón, lo recomendable eran 2 o 3 km máximo; sin embargo, me arriesgué a correr más, pero con cuidado, fijándome muy bien en las calles y pisando muy suave, ya que correr genera más tensión y fuerza en el tobillo izquierdo que se está recuperando. La carrera se sintió bastante bien, a pesar de no poder ir rápido, porque mi lesión no me dejaba; me sentí muy satisfecho luego de casi un mes sin correr. La vuelta la realicé en 34 minutos; hubo momentos en que tomé aire porque la respiración no la controlaba bien.\n\n
><div class=\

>Firstly, to see how my tendon was holding up, the recommendation was to run a maximum of 2 or 3 km; however, I took the risk of running further, but carefully, keeping a close eye on the road and landing very softly, as running puts more strain and pressure on my left ankle, which is still recovering. The run felt quite good, despite not being able to go fast, as my injury wouldn’t let me; I felt very satisfied after almost a month without running. I completed the lap in 34 minutes; there were moments when I had to catch my breath because I wasn’t controlling my breathing properly. ---
![1001068823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23wWs69NwHVAGT2GoWMvQTKvtNqQcUYrzD94T3dq9hPWv7HNYu2cJWjmbSMT9CtCwiYXc.jpg)
|
![1001068826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23wMWJFNDNDrA3Du2tP5VYhvg1RSyn8mE35nzosb2BW8bpJeLRRkaQwAX5mAhd94oCwhM.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1001068827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23xedt5EHEs2Pn1FaPPqwrdyLeFdM11m8kyvLY6TNV65dumKmtbe7yACDsn9Ry4eLsFnk.jpg)
|
![1001068847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23ryvDTrisewdhHQEpZsR1HyqUHssGiG3SHs6GBi7eoZWGM78MSqdMAaErZbkp6hmXwsR.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
><div class=\

>Era como si hubiera perdido un porcentaje de mi resistencia, jaja. El ritmo fue por encima de 6 minutos el kilómetro; hubo ciertos momentos en que mi velocidad subió, pero fue momentáneo, quizás por la costumbre de carreras anteriores. Cuídense mucho, muchachos; estar lesionado no es muy cómodo, aparte que dejas de entrenar para mantener reposo. Puedo decir que por fin regresaré a la pista a correr, escuchando mi cuerpo y teniendo cuidado de ahora en adelante.
><div class=\

>It was as if I’d lost some of my stamina, haha. My pace was over 6 minutes per kilometre; there were certain moments when my speed picked up, but it was only momentary, perhaps due to the habit from previous races. Take good care of yourselves, lads; being injured isn’t much fun, not to mention that you have to stop training to rest. I can say that I’ll finally be back on the track running, listening to my body and taking care from now on. ---
![1001068862.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23zbMcABqhZVCZy4xouYwuoS4MLuGE3fKqkwpBxsbZcsuVwqtVraW8mHMhEEL2Fprf2J9.jpg)
|
![1001068865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23ywoLr3bjkLnp8rcJVRXGv9ZeBhbVxVUNWAnGf5LuoKLJHYXhNkMPtxqBjrdremrrkno.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1001068866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23xKnLvAG6ps3vEbPZ39tSE2FucUnXXhaDpwVngz9u12HbCEkoVxpQ4mZeBoLyDDyWChL.jpg)
|
![1001068891.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/245mnE2h95UiLX9ifemKrBh9STrrPdzLvxr2zuYMk7yLYySPKd6UKwPBo4qDdxGNNBek3.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
><div class=\
>Sin más nada que acotar gente, muchas gracias por haberse tomado el tiempo de ver mi post y nos vemos en otra publicación soy @zgaetano.\n\n
><div class=\
> Without further ado people, thank you very much for taking the time to see my post and I'll see you in another post I'm @zgaetano. ---

links.title: My Phone For 9 Years
links.body:
![Copy of Copy of Copy of Copy of Copy of Sugared Donut.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eonk2CRhHY1jKA6FpAJgPBDR6aZ2H9hbn841p1P9XvKDU1bcFbQSZ7EUUc9K4krLzb7.gif)


<div class = text-justify>


Hello, how are you? I have something precious to share with you, and I wanted to create a tribute blog about it, so that whenever I return to Hive, I can revisit these memories.

My phone is still working these days because the battery is removable, so I can buy a replacement anytime. It is funny to think that my family changes their phone many time I am still stuck with this phone for about 8 years now.

But sometimes it is time to change, and an upgrade is needed to happen, and I have this mindset that if an important app is not going to support my phone's OS, that is my sign to upgrade my phone. One reason that I don't want to upgrade is the quality of the camera, still clear as ever. Not a surprise because the phone name literally means \
which focuses more on photos or videos.\n\nI think I now believe \

because I don't like pressuring myself into buying something, and I will regret it later. LOL -----
Let Me Show You What Years of Using a Phone Look Like
> ![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/241tUpR8v8LnMNfN1FQ8CpMTM7RqAovw64Dim3rCYmKUXbWKiWnXtRyEPNXbLCENdgefh.JPG)

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/242NjP24vuTC7cx8DcmLneL6LJQvJfetmVBhzirxdNTe3G7Ss4PsErSDG1gMNCAwWMPg6.JPG) So the very first phone that I saved up for 3 months of hunger, no concert, no hanging out with friends, and just pure existing in my college year. Asus was a big thing before, and I, with my keypad phone, needed to be upgraded, and when I needed something, I did my research first, and I saw this ------
> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23yJAAjZGzPA7wkoAhVYf5vCN81ApXu1HJmqU34YHGBGcgE8UiDce6yFaqkNrbkvVZxNT.JPG)

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23xAaCRqaWT43qEYm4DpdZH6tYG7TWFhdJ1mPLYCe4mZRzgDMVc9mBjvdMKjzoGQ68hcW.JPG) YouTube and Messenger are two of the most important apps for me, and Messenger is where I use to communicate with my family, friends, and most of the people literally. My OS is Marshmallow, so it makes sense LOL. ----
> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23wMQ4jvqGhhSoHRN9t6ikRfTktXAQXbmhiw1sAB5UWe34vzrTyr47YZp21JafCNNPA3A.JPG)

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/242DA93jYFWRnEQrzox9JuyRn2AEfs3UNuyBsbzXyQzRd7ithohosE687szWUt1E5Rakt.JPG)

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23x14iF5WubvCQWwdZ65DqRu1uVUKMHhYA78ALipDArLbcciwbt681JJ23xViZnw86we2.JPG)

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/23xVJweGvtMsL2Ymaiaa6An9jxpmnyFtPcLnrgEues8m57qaciMrYuttVhbSovEyXtMHj.JPG)

Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))

links.title: Der Witz des Tages 😄 | Sonntag, 14. Juni 2026
links.body:
---

## 😂 Der Witz des Tages

> **Ein Beamter stirbt und kommt in den Himmel. Petrus führt ihn herum und zeigt ihm verschiedene Unterkünfte. 'Hier wohnen die Ärzte in schönen Häusern. Dort die Lehrer in gemütlichen Wohnungen.' Plötzlich sieht der Beamte einen prächtigen Palast. 'Wow! Wer wohnt denn da?' fragt er begeistert. Petrus antwortet: 'Das ist das Haus von einem Taxifahrer.' Der Beamter ist empört: 'Moment! Ich war mein ganzes Leben lang Beamter und habe hart gearbeitet! Warum bekommt ein Taxifahrer einen Palast und ich nur eine kleine Wohnung?' Petrus erklärt: 'Nun, hier im Himmel belohnen wir nach Resultaten. Wenn Sie gearbeitet haben, haben die Leute geschlafen. Wenn der Taxifahrer gefahren ist, haben die Leute gebetet!'**

<center>

![Witz des Tages](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1774751000568-243811a1dbb2?crop=entropy&cs=tinysrgb&fit=max&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NDgzODF8MHwxfHJhbmRvbXx8fHx8fHx8fDE3ODE0NDY1OTl8&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=80&w=1080)

*Foto: [Bee](https://unsplash.com/@bee_bee_bee) via Unsplash*

</center>

---

**Hab einen fantastischen Tag! Morgen wartet schon der nächste Lacher!** 😄

links.title: The Mystery Hidden Inside
links.body: In life, we sometimes come across secrets that heighten our curiosity. When we see a closed chest a question instinctively comes to mind \

This very question leads us toward exploration and discovery. 

Every chest hides a story within it. Sometimes it holds valuable treasure sometimes old memories and sometimes secrets that reveal themselves over time. It is this mystery that always keeps humans curious. 

If we think of life as a chest countless opportunities and experiences lie hidden inside it. Some come in the form of happiness while others give us the courage to face difficulties. Every new day is like a new chest with something unique waiting for us inside. 

Sometimes we overthink about something but the reality turns out to be far more interesting. That’s why the desire to learn about the unknown is part of human nature. This very desire forms the foundation of progress and knowledge. 

Ultimately, \
is not just a question but a symbol of hope, curiosity, and discovery. At every turn in life some new secret awaits us and the journey of uncovering it is what makes life beautiful.\n\n

下雨又碰上周日可能是最幸福的日子了，又不用上班，又可以直接睡大觉，而且天气还凉。
下了雨之后，周围没有那么燥热。非常的凉快，所以睡起觉来也舒服。
早上起床已经是睡到了8:35。感觉非常的爽。好久没有这么痛快的睡一觉了。

今天还是像往常一样削了铅笔之后来画画。这次是在网上找的图片。
也就是画了一只蜗牛。但这一次画的形态像福寿螺的样子多一些。
虽然画的时间并不长，也就是画了半个多小时。但终究还是画成型了。

相比起以前，我好像也画过几次的蜗牛。这一次并不算是成功的。
因为之前我有画过几次蜗牛。所以也做了一些对比。但这次真的是画的很糟糕。
这次已经不能算是画蜗牛，顶多算是一个福寿螺。很难看，真的。

我今天晚上把这几次画的蜗牛图片重新找出来一下。原来我之前画过了四次。
来看一下。下面的这张蜗牛是第一次画蜗牛的效果。

![mmexport1781445700320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/EpT82HVoiLdsaM23H3ku8Thrv75ZoyzjC9yipXKGgmw6SYxeWD5vBb6kikx7oKXuHPy.jpg)
下面的这一张是第二次画的效果。
![mmexport1781445679669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/EogQktLwc7q835sbY71EfG2HM73pZsGCw8PpEhaQZs1KvH15zYVsJvKFzSTpLh4DAMT.jpg)
这一张是第三次画的。
![mmexport1781445614776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23xerZFdBRzTD6d4PMG3QQMW25HTpTPXBBSHeo8SA8hbvZAygKBR7wkmbjdAaUkXs1Dwn.jpg)
这是第四次画的效果，可以说是每一次都是在后退。一次不如一次。
![mmexport1781445435641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/Eos3AaC6M8WcGZhdmgPKM6Gfu6ByqWmsiRAGMiCCN72GFsi4NAUj37A5EiKtud9sM1S.jpg)
包括今天画的感觉更加的糟糕。比上第四次还更加的糟糕。
也不知道是不是年纪大了，集中不了精神。反正就是越画越回去了。

## Hoy mi domingo musical. [JAŸ-Z - Empire State Of Mind ft. Alicia Keys](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=thzHDR0PSB0)
#
<div class=\

> Hoy en mi domingo musical y nuevamente deje que la playlist eligiera con cuál canción empezaría mi día y creo que la pego del techo porque esta canción cuando la escuche por allá por el 2009 me gusto mucho y de inmediato la incluí en mi lista de reproducción, y como no incluir a mis amigos como lo es mi pana JAŸ-Z y mi amiga Alicia Keys, como todos ustedes saben para mí los cantantes que me gusta, son mis amigos personales, porque muchas veces están allí conmigo y con solo escucharles me hacen el día para bien propio. Así que hoy le traigo a todos ustedes un éxito genial y lo digo no solo por sus acordes musicales también lo digo por la letra de la canción que para mí es como una oda a la superación y darle un realce a las oportunidades de la vida, para mí la letra de esta canción como lo es Empire State Of Mind deja mucho lo que expresa JAŸ-Z y el coro de Alicia Keys, me hace tener un grandioso domingo musical. Ese junte es una vaina seria. JAY-Z se lanza unas barras brutales contándonos cómo salió de abajo en Brooklyn hasta coronar en lo más alto, mientras que Alicia nos eriza la piel con ese coro con un piquete de soul y R&B que te hace sentir que te puedes comer el mundo, esa mezcla de esos dos ritmos hip-hop con el piano, creo que son una combinación perfecta, y es que se convirtió en un gran himno indiscutible de Nueva York, sé que ganó dos premios, es un tema que no pasa de moda y para mi justo hoy domingo es como si te inyecta una energía demasiado brutal para arrancar la semana con la mente ganadora. >Descargo de responsabilidad: >El enlace de vídeo que comparto no es mío, sólo estoy compartiendo el enlace al vídeo del propietario del copyright. And how could I not include my friends, such as my pal JAY-Z and my friend Alicia Keys? As you all know, for me, the singers I like are my personal friends because many times they are there with me, and just by listening to them, they make my day for my own good. So today I bring to all of you a great hit, and I say this not only because of its musical chords, I also say it because of the lyrics of the song which for me is like an ode to self-improvement and highlighting life's opportunities. For me, the lyrics of this song like Empire State Of Mind leave a lot in what JAY-Z expresses, and Alicia Keys' chorus makes me have a grand musical Sunday. That link-up is serious business. links.title: I’d Move Tomorrow.. Under These Conditions | Ladies of Hive Contest #293
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbnWU6m8NTdxhQp75ci4tPhfPZKPBD5XADBMPaYkjqre9/pasted_1781445527030.jpg)


If I could do an exchange year as an adult, I don’t think I’d choose a fancy city.

No thank you. I am already tired.

I would choose a small town somewhere warm, where people still greet each other, the coffee is strong, and someone’s grandmother knows my full life story before I have even unpacked my bag.

My host family would be loud, kind, and very concerned about whether I have eaten.

I would say, “Yes, thank you, I ate.”

They would say, “That is not food,” and put another plate in front of me.

Honestly, that sounds perfect.

For one year, I would like to live slowly.

I would help in the kitchen, walk around the neighbourhood, learn the language badly, and probably say something completely wrong at least once a day.

But that is fine. At this age, dignity is overrated.

I think the best part of an adult exchange year would not be the place.

It would be feeling like part of a family again.

Being teased a little.
Being fed too much.
Being corrected with love.
Being reminded that home is not always where you were born.

Sometimes home is where someone shouts from the kitchen:

“Come eat before it gets cold!”

——-
Image is mine. Sun setting on an another day of promise.

links.title: Nice gift for dad.//Lindo regalo para papá.
links.body:
<center>![vjhgj.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23ynUX9LRXLXgMS6JMvQDoinmA7pYWWBLBDHsePP5m7TbpNkW2CmU2iH69GWjdDoMh1vb.jpg)</center>

![vjhgj.jpg](image-9-vjhgj.jpg)
Hello, my dear creative friends! I hope you're all doing well. Father's Day is almost here, and since we're in the midst of the World Cup, I'm sharing a great idea to pamper Dad. It's a different, original, and, above all, very easy way to make a special gift. The best part is that we'll only need a few materials. We know that dads love soccer and that on their special day they just want to relax and have fun. This project is ideal for them, since the finished container is multifunctional: it can be used as a pencil holder, to store car keys, or cash. Plus, it's such a simple craft that kids can help decorate it. I love creating easy, quick, and inexpensive projects so that everyone can enjoy the process in a fun way. So pay close attention to the materials and the tutorial!

>Hola, mis queridos amigos creativos. Espero que se encuentren muy bien. Ya casi llega el Día del Padre y, como estamos en plena fiesta mundialista, les comparto una idea genial para consentir a papá. Se trata de una forma distinta, original y, sobre todo, muy fácil de elaborar un empaque especial. Lo mejor de todo es que usaremos pocos materiales.Sabemos que a los papás les encanta el fútbol y que en su día solo quieren pasarla relajados y alegres. Este proyecto es ideal para ellos, ya que el contenedor final es multifuncional: puede servir como portalápices, para guardar las llaves del coche o el dinero en efectivo. Además, es una manualidad tan sencilla que los niños pueden ayudar a decorarlo.Me fascina crear proyectos fáciles, rápidos y económicos para que disfruten el proceso de forma divertida. ¡Así que presten mucha atención a los materiales y al tutorial!

Materials:
A plastic container (a cup will do).
Cellophane or tissue paper
Watercolors
A paintbrush
Adhesive tape
A graphite pencil
Scissors
A black marker
Twine
A sheet of white paper

>Materiales:
Un envase plástico puede ser un vaso.
Papel celofán o papel seda
Acuarelas
Un pincel
Cinta adhesiva
Un lápiz de grafito
Tijeras
Un marcador color negro
Pabilo
Una hoja blanca



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/EoiX7hVgw5ioqPJ1bVBUT3keCQw8hkQFbVqsdJZf6e8GcRJjG85yihVLDhWBofujXNk.png)

<center>Step by step - Paso a paso</center>


![FotoJet - 2026-06-13T161005.858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23y8ufD8ynYE8wi9bY4t94tznQtfgKUiqrTHgQRQzycKj6mu88erJ8qyaXC88q4giukZQ.jpg)

We make a soccer ball out of the white sheet of paper and cut it out.

>Con la hoja blanca hacemos un balón de futbol y lo recortamos.


![FotoJet - 2026-06-13T161143.411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wgMyfyKbzMwNa69aLeviFxNEJFPhP29LUU2JT1VKFsYJG6JcPKUykxue7Vz3SqFT1Yq.jpg)

We painted the container with green watercolor as if it were grass.

>Con la acuarela verde pintamos el envase como si fuese un césped.


![FotoJet - 2026-06-13T161313.453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23x16f69WDMQ5SDXzC1pHqDgETFFarPmvbv7D9aw4fSA3kLJPJAB7rzqmMMfHqKYWQrdH.jpg)

Then we painted the sky with light blue watercolor and then attached the ball with adhesive tape.

>Luego con la acuarela celeste pintamos el cielo para luego pegar el balón con la cinta adhesiva.


![FotoJet - 2026-06-13T161513.463.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vi5jnt4esAs2FZAtKHBNfvBwVtP4DhuY5XY1LMFDJKKbUbHWFx1cHuEKPLujV8ar2rE.jpg)

We wrap the gift with the twine and cellophane or tissue paper and put it in the container.

>Con el pabilo y el papel celofán o papel seda envolvemos el regalo y lo introducimos en el envase.


![FotoJet - 2026-06-13T161637.866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/Eptb4Jh9RycAQUNVhCiMoZCsmY7cmsy7Jd1QodNGweBh1rycgZ6tWQxWDSAyiPCyZ7N.jpg)

Dad can use the container as a pencil holder

Papá puede utilizar el envase como portalápices.


![8aff840d-da3d-4f52-bcd7-8b6449e3ecc1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/243M4pRxhADxdku2UChzmsYGU8YwryV3UZ4K51ckxvx9ncqKWUqvVo2MDZvRYPcfPSHsA.jpg)

links.title: La canción de la banda 17 - Historia [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
Finalmente, llegó la noche y la Banda 17 se reunió junto a Richard Stone y todo su equipo técnico, donde nadie quería perderse ese momento del estreno de la canción. Michelle no podía dejar de mirar el reloj, Lucas revisaba constantemente la página del canal, Tomás caminaba de un lado a otro y uno de los técnicos anunció —Faltan treinta segundos— todos quedaron en silencio y los minutos fueron pasando. De pronto, la pantalla cambió y Lucas gritó —¡Ya está publicada! — todos comenzaron a aplaudir y se acercaron a la pantalla mientras el video comenzaba a reproducirse por primera vez, ese fue momento especial para la Banda 17. Mientras observaban los primeros minutos del estreno, las visitas comenzaron a aumentar y las reproducciones, además comentarios también empezaron a llegar desde diferentes lugares del mundo. >Finally, the night arrived, and Banda 17 gathered with Richard Stone and his entire technical team—no one wanted to miss the song’s premiere. Michelle couldn’t stop checking her watch, Lucas kept refreshing the channel’s page, Tomás paced back and forth, and one of the technicians announced, “Thirty seconds to go.” Everyone fell silent as the minutes ticked by. # >Suddenly, the screen changed, and Lucas shouted, “It’s up!” Everyone began to clap and gathered around the screen as the video began to play for the first time—that was a special moment for Banda 17. As they watched the first few minutes of the premiere, the number of views began to rise, and comments also started coming in from different parts of the world. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmasF9BcfyYaYaZ8oe31mpgwTtMZwKUfBQUCzVof9ZmVn2/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-persona-rojo-jugando-9223026/) Michelle leía cada mensaje, Tomás observaba la pantalla sin creer lo que estaba pasando. Lucas tomó una captura de los primeros números para guardarla como recuerdo y una vez más el teléfono de Richard Stone vibró, de inmediato Michelle pregunto —¿Ahora qué pasó? — resultó ser un mensaje de risignstar que decía que estaban impresionados con el trabajo que hicieron y que la canción superó sus expectativas. Esa fue la segunda noticia más importante de la noche, mientras que las reproducciones seguían aumentando y el nombre de la Banda 17 comenzaba a circular entre cada vez más personas. Richard observó la pantalla llena de números y sonrió y dijo —Disfruten este momento, porque esta es su primera canción— todos se rieron, pero sin que ellos lo supieran, entre los miles de espectadores que escuchaban la canción, se encontraba una persona muy importante que le interesó el trabajo de la Banda 17 y podría cambiar el destino del grupo. >Michelle read each message, while Tomás stared at the screen, unable to believe what was happening. Lucas took a screenshot of the first few numbers to save as a keepsake, and once again Richard Stone’s phone vibrated. Michelle immediately asked, “What happened now?” It turned out to be a message from risignstar saying they were impressed with the work they’d done and that the song had exceeded their expectations. # >That was the second most important news of the night, while the views kept rising and the name Banda 17 began to spread among more and more people. Richard looked at the screen full of numbers, smiled, and said, “Enjoy this moment, because this is your first song.” Everyone laughed, but unbeknownst to them, among the thousands of listeners tuning in to the song was a very important person who took an interest in Banda 17’s work and could change the group’s fate. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTpkLT11R2oAWZd5VBeQnQ5LyPbXwaJZVdPrZiyxZ3kJY/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/lapiz-guitarra-naturaleza-muerta-vista-superior-7802291/)

links.title: When the Shadows of the Trees Fell on the Wall 木々の影が壁に映った時  [English and Japanese]
links.body:
![IMG_5344.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZ75paGNm5oduf7HuVQbeE8uSHCG2k79VdCuFxejTW1J/IMG_5344.jpeg)
### When the Shadows of the Trees Fell on the Wall
#
I usually work from early morning until noon, then again in the afternoon, and sometimes at night. My work desk gets different kinds of sunlight depending on the time of day. Sometimes I need to close the blinds because the sunlight is too bright for my online camera. On the other hand, I sometimes need to let the sunlight in because the room is too dark for online meetings. Even though I’m sitting inside, I can feel the movement of the sun throughout the day. It’s such a cool feeling, as if I’m working on the sun’s schedule. Sometimes, I even feel like there’s no ceiling above my head.

When I wake up very early, before sunrise, I wait for the sunshine while getting ready for work. As I prepare, the sunlight gradually fills my room. I sometimes text my mother while my morning is still very quiet. By then, she is probably cooking and getting ready for dinner. We can connect for a little while before I start work.

![IMG_5345.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcw4Psiffhtehu79ZEdBwBtFaQX1TAoA7Nw9vM4gqLrZ2/IMG_5345.jpeg)

This moment reminds me of the famous poem “Morning Relay.” It was written by one of Japan’s most talented and beloved poets, Shuntarō Tanikawa, who passed away a few years ago.

Junichiro Tanizaki (1886–1965) was one of Japan’s most celebrated novelists. His works explore beauty, desire, human relationships, and the contrast between traditional Japanese culture and modern influences.

Morning Relay is a poem that imagines morning being passed from one place to another like a relay race around the world. It expresses the interconnectedness of people across different countries and conveys a sense of hope, continuity, and shared humanity.

![IMG_5346.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeHko943raA4NUsRhw2k9cpLSFhQPiQG6vf3Wg5og9Aza/IMG_5346.jpeg)

Yes, I often remember this poem whenever I become aware of the time differences around the world. It is such a beautiful poem, especially in the way it captures the feeling of time passing.

One morning, while I was having breakfast, I noticed the shadows of trees on the wall, cast through the east-facing window of my house. The gentle morning sunlight was falling on the sakura artwork hanging on the wall. I loved that moment. I took a picture of it, and once again, it reminded me of “Morning Relay.”

Japanese 日本語

![IMG_5344.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZ75paGNm5oduf7HuVQbeE8uSHCG2k79VdCuFxejTW1J/IMG_5344.jpeg)
### 木々の影が壁に映った時
#

普段、早朝から昼まで働き、その後また午後に、時には夜にも仕事をします。デスクには時間帯によってさまざまな光が差し込みます。オンラインの時のカメラには明るすぎるため、ブラインドを閉めなければならないこともあります。一方で、部屋が暗すぎるため、太陽の光を取り入れなければならないこともあります。こんなふうに室内にいても、太陽の動きを感じることができます。それはとてもおもしろい感覚で、まるで太陽のスケジュールに合わせて働いているようです。時には、頭上に天井がないように感じることさえあります。

とても早い朝、日の出前に起きると、仕事の準備をしながら朝日を待ちます。準備をしているうちに、少しずつ部屋に朝日が入ってきます。静かな朝の時間に、母にメッセージを送ることもあります。その頃、母は夕食の準備をしているかもしれません。仕事が始まる前に、少しの間つながることができます。

![IMG_5345.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcw4Psiffhtehu79ZEdBwBtFaQX1TAoA7Nw9vM4gqLrZ2/IMG_5345.jpeg)

この瞬間は、有名な詩「朝のリレー」を思い出させます。この詩は、とても才能ある日本でも人気の高い詩人・小説家の詩で、数年前に亡くなった人物によって書かれました。谷川俊太郎の詩です。

> 谷川俊太郎（１９３１–２０２４）は、日本で最も著名な詩人の一人で、その作品は美しさ、愛、人間関係、そして伝統的な日本文化と現代の価値観の対比を探求しています。

「朝のリレー」は、朝がリレー競走のように世界中を巡っていく様子を想像した詩です。異なる国に暮らす人々のつながりや、希望、連続性、そして人類の共有された時間感覚を表現しているのだそうです。

![IMG_5346.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeHko943raA4NUsRhw2k9cpLSFhQPiQG6vf3Wg5og9Aza/IMG_5346.jpeg)

私は、世界の時差を意識するときによくこの詩を思い出します。時間の感覚をとても美しく表現している詩だなぁと思います。

ある朝、朝食をとっているとき、東側の窓から差し込む光で、壁に木々の影が映っていることに気づきました。そのやわらかい朝の光が、壁にかかっている桜のアートに当たっていました。その瞬間がとてもいいなと感じました。写真に撮りながら、また「朝のリレー」を思い出しました。

Thank you for reading!
