links.body: 1/5 🧵 The Philippines just drew a hard line: privacy coins are out, and token listings can’t be lazy checkbox theater anymore. The BSP is forcing crypto platforms to treat listings like real risk underwriting—then keep monitoring them after launch.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The core move is blunt: BSP barred regulated VASPs from listing or supporting anonymity-enhancing privacy assets. The reason is obvious—if a token makes transactions harder to trace, it creates friction for AML enforcement and consumer protection. This puts the Philippines in the camp of regulators choosing traceability over cypherpunk purity.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 Listing standards also got much tighter. Platforms now have to evaluate tokens across six pillars: issuer background, market maturity, use case and disclosures, transparency/traceability, security, liquidity/redemption, and legal compliance. In plain English: who made it, whether it actually trades, whether docs are public, whether the tech is auditable, whether users can exit, and whether the asset is legally clean.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: Voted ✅
links.author: chefqueen

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The interesting part is that BSP isn’t treating listing as a one-time event. VASPs must keep monitoring tokens and set deviation thresholds that can automatically trigger suspension or delisting. Abnormal price moves, misleading disclosures, market abuse, cybersecurity issues, legal problems, or consumer risk can all get a token pulled fast. That’s much closer to continuous market surveillance than the usual “list it and pray” crypto model.

links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The more interesting setup is the **multi-year compression pattern**. Analysts are watching a structure that looks like a **bullish pennant** on the bigger timeframe: rising support underneath, descending resistance above, price getting squeezed tighter over time. That kind of long consolidation often ends with a violent move. The catch: charts don’t pay until the breakout actually happens.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 Bottom line: the article frames DOGE as sitting at a **critical technical crossroads**. In the short run, the buy signal gave bulls a pulse. In the bigger picture, years of tightening price action could be setting up a major breakout — or another rejection if resistance holds. Meme coin, yes. But the chart setup is serious enough that traders are watching closely. 📎 [Source](https://en.coin-turk.com/dogecoin-surges-8-percent-after-a-technical-buy-signal-whats-next-for-the-popular-meme-coin/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 1/5 🧵 TRON Inc now holds **700.4M+ TRX**, but here’s the catch: all that buying still hasn’t fixed TRX’s weak chart. The article’s core point is brutal and simple — treasury accumulation can cushion selling, but it doesn’t magically reverse a downtrend.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The company kept buying into weakness. One disclosed purchase was **157,392 TRX at an average of $0.3177** for about **$50K**, added right after another **159,118 TRX** buy. Across June, Tron Inc reportedly accumulated **1.2M TRX** total. That’s not passive treasury management — that’s active support during a soft market.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The bullish part is the network itself isn’t exactly bleeding out. The piece notes **positive daily net inflows** on TRON, with around **$6.9M** entering the ecosystem at the time cited. That matters because it suggests capital is still coming onto the chain even while price action looks rough. In plain English: the fundamentals look sturdier than the chart.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The bearish part is the technical setup still looked ugly. TRX had been trading in a **descending channel** after getting rejected near **$0.37** in late May. Momentum indicators were still leaning south: **RSI near 30** suggested heavy selling pressure, and **MACD stayed negative**, which usually means bears still have the wheel. That’s why the article says **$0.31** support was shaky, with **$0.30** as the next downside area.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 The fork in the road is straightforward: if Tron Inc’s continued buying starts translating into real demand, TRX could push back through **$0.32** and potentially aim for **$0.35**. If not, the treasury buys may just slow the fall instead of stopping it. Useful thread if you want the clean takeaway: strong accumulation, decent network inflows, weak market structure. 📎 [Source](https://ambcrypto.com/inside-tron-incs-700-million-trx-treasury-and-market-impact/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 5/5 🧵 Bottom line: the article’s takeaway is less “fresh policy detail” and more “clear escalation signal.” Iran is using the strike to justify freezing or hardening talks with the U.S., and that matters because once trust is framed as broken, restarting diplomacy gets a hell of a lot harder. 📎 [Source](https://lookonchain.com/feeds/60453)\n\n#threadstorm
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 1/4 🧵  \nThis piece is really about **speculation wearing a collector-hobby costume**. Tokenized Pokémon cards are booming because crypto rails make card trading faster, more liquid, and way more degenerate — especially once “gacha”-style mechanics enter the room. The clean version is collectibles. The dirty version is gambling with a Pikachu wrapper. [Yahoo’s pickup of the article](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/pok-mon-card-sales-surging-130103391.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall) and Decrypt’s earlier coverage on the same trend both point the same way: tokenized card markets are accelerating, not cooling. [Decrypt earlier coverage](https://decrypt.co/337982/tokenized-pokemon-cards-exploding-right-now)
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/4 🧵  \nThe core argument: crypto platforms are taking a **slow, illiquid physical asset** and turning it into something that trades more like a meme coin. Instead of waiting on eBay listings, shipping, authentication, and settlement, buyers can get exposure to card value through blockchain-based ownership rails and fractionalized or tokenized claims. That makes the market bigger and more accessible — but it also injects constant price discovery, social hype, and round-the-clock speculation. CoinMarketCap’s writeup frames this as opening access to a huge collectibles market; that’s true, but “opening access” usually also means “inviting a casino crowd.” [CoinMarketCap Academy](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/article/pokemon-cards-target-dollar21b-market-for-blockchain-tokenization)
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/4 🧵  \nThe “don’t call it gambling” part matters because these platforms often use **loot-box logic**: mystery pulls, randomized outcomes, and the thrill of potentially landing a rare high-value card. That’s economically very close to gambling even if the legal packaging says “collectible experience” or “digital opening.” If users are paying for uncertain outcomes with the hope of a valuable hit, regulators will eventually stare at this a lot harder. CryptoSlate described the surge in tokenized Pokémon trading as a major retail adoption wave, and retail adoption plus random-reward mechanics is exactly where things get messy fast. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/tokenized-pokemon-card-trades-surge-5-5x-to-124-million-in-august/)
links.author: askrafiki

links.body:
4/4 🧵  
My take: **the model is clever, the framing is bullshit**. Tokenization of collectibles is a real business. It improves liquidity, expands participation, and may become normal for high-end cards and memorabilia. But once platforms lean on randomized “gacha” mechanics, they’re not just modernizing collecting — they’re monetizing impulse and calling it fandom. On InLeo, I’m not seeing recent direct discussion of this exact Pokémon-card angle yet, so there isn’t a clean community thread to point to here. The broad lesson still lands: when crypto makes a market more liquid, it usually also makes it more speculative — and sometimes a lot more absurd.

> Hola amigos de @hivemargarita, espero estén pasando un excelente fin de semana en compañía de sus seres más queridos. Ayer sali a hacer unas diligencias normales y terminé sorprendida con la cantidad de decoraciones alusivas al Mundial de Fútbol que encontré en cada sitio al que entré. No eran simples adornos, eran verdaderas ambientaciones llenas de creatividad, color y emoción. Mi primera parada fue el supermercado Rattan y ahí fue donde comenzó la sorpresa. Apenas entré, me encontré con una decoración enorme hecha completamente con productos, especialmente refrescos. Habían balones, estructuras coloridas y hasta una cancha decorativo hecho con las mismas botellas. Además, tenían una pantalla y un ciclón donde las personas que compraban los refrescos podían participar en una actividad para ganar premios. Lastima que la actividad estaba pautada para después de las 12:00pm, a me encanta ver cómo la gente se anima, y disfrutan del momento. Ese tipo de iniciativas le da vida al lugar y hace que uno sienta el ambiente mundialista de verdad. Luego fui a Daka y allí también me encontré con una decoración espectacular. Esta vez estaba hecha con televisores y balones, formando una especie de mural moderno y llamativo. Era tan bonita que la gente se detenía solo para mirarla. Me pareció increíble cómo lograron combinar tecnología y deporte en un solo espacio. Lo mejor de estas zonas para tomarse fotos, es que chévere porque a todos nos gusta llevarnos un recuerdo, especialmente cuando el ambiente está tan bien logrado. Mi última parada fue el centro comercial Rattan, y ahí sí que quedé encantada. Habían varios stands diseñados especialmente para tomarse fotos, todos con motivos del Mundial. Lo más bonito es que muchas de estas decoraciones incluían canchas. Cada espacio tenía su propia personalidad, pero todos transmitían la misma emoción: la alegría de vivir el Mundial en comunidad. Me pareció maravilloso ver cómo estos lugares se esfuerzan por crear ambientes que no solo decoran, sino que invitan a participar. La gente se tomaba fotos, sonreía, comentaba y eso crea un ambiente muy bonito entre todos. El fútbol tiene esa magia, une, emociona y hace que hasta una salida sencilla se convierta en un momento especial. Por eso quise escribir este post, para invitar a toda la comunidad de @hivemargarita a darse una vuelta por estos sitios y disfrutar de estas ambientaciones tan creativas. Si te gusta el Mundial, si te encantan las fotos o simplemente quieres ver algo diferente, te aseguro que estas decoraciones te van a encantar. Saludos amigos y Bendiciones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
**ENGLISH**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
Hello, friends at @hivemargarita. I hope you're having a wonderful weekend with your loved ones. Yesterday I went out to run some errands and was surprised by the amount of World Cup-themed decorations I found everywhere I went. They weren’t just simple ornaments, but full-scale displays brimming with creativity, color, and excitement. My first stop was the Rattan supermarket, and that’s where the surprise began. As soon as I walked in, I came across a massive display made entirely of products, especially soft drinks. There were soccer balls, colorful structures, and even a decorative soccer field made from the bottles themselves. Plus, they had a screen and a wheel where people buying soft drinks could participate in a game to win prizes. Too bad the activity wasn’t scheduled until after 12:00 p.m., because I love seeing how people get excited and enjoy the moment. Those kinds of initiatives bring the place to life and really make you feel the World Cup atmosphere. Then I went to Daka, where I also came across some spectacular decorations. This time, they were made out of televisions and soccer balls, forming a kind of modern, eye-catching mural. It was so beautiful that people stopped just to look at it. I thought it was incredible how they managed to combine technology and sports in a single space. The best thing about these photo spots is that they’re cool because we all like to take home a souvenir, especially when the atmosphere is so well done. My last stop was the Rattan shopping center, and I was truly enchanted there. There were several stands designed specifically for taking photos, all with World Cup themes. The best part is that many of these decorations included soccer fields. Each space had its own personality, but they all conveyed the same emotion: the joy of experiencing the World Cup as a community. I thought it was wonderful to see how these places go out of their way to create atmospheres that don’t just decorate the space, but invite people to participate. People were taking photos, smiling, chatting—and that creates such a lovely atmosphere among everyone. Soccer has that magic: it brings people together, stirs emotions, and turns even a simple outing into a special moment. That’s why I wanted to write this post—to invite the entire @hivemargarita community to check out these spots and enjoy these creative displays. If you love the World Cup, if you love taking photos, or if you just want to see something different, I promise you’ll love these decorations. Greetings, friends, and blessings.

links.body: <div class=\

>

Stanley woke up to the sound of his alarm. It was going to be a big day for him and the firm he worked for. As he stood up from his bed to stretch, he got a call from his colleague, Mark.

\
Stanley said.\n\n\
Mark asked\n\n\
Stanley replied.\n\n\

Mark said. Stanley got into the shower, freshened up and got dressed. He put his laptop in his bag and stepped out, headed to work. He took a bus as usual. He kept his bag by his side while he tried to rehearse his presentation. When he got to the bus stop, he came down from the bus while he was still engrossed in his mind with things about the presentation.
alt=\

/>

[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/road-transport-asphalt-village-bus-3309094/)

He began walking to the firm where he worked when he suddenly realized that he wasn't holding his bag. He forgot it on the bus. His heart skipped a bit. He could feel his chest tighten. His laptop was in that bag. Every important document and report for the firm was in that laptop. He turned back and saw that the bus had already left and was far gone.

He looked at his watch. He has only 20 minutes before the time for the presentation. He couldn't afford to be late. His job was at stake.

He decided to look for that bus. So he entered a taxi going to the destination he thought the bus would stop at next. He was already sweating profusely despite the fact that it was cold weather.

His phone rang. It was Mark.

\
Mark said.\n\n\
Stanley said.  \n\
Mark asked.\n\n\
Stanley said.\n\n\
Mark said, obviously distressed.\n\n\

Stanley said.  
Stanley was running out of time, and with every minute that passed, he got more nervous.

He got to the next stop where the bus was supposed to be. It wasn't there. He saw a man sitting nearby and decided to ask him a question.

\
\n\n\

the man said.

Stanley got in the taxi and began to make his way to the next stop. He was worried that someone would see the bag and decide to steal, but he tried to stay positive.

As he approached the next stop, he could see the bus.

\

Stanley said to the taxi driver.

As soon as he got to the stop, Stanley ran out and rushed into the bus. He quickly went to the place he sat and he couldn't find his bag. His heart sank. He was devastated. He didn't know what he was going to do or say to his employers, and he was running out of time.

The bus driver saw him and wondered what he was looking for.

\
The driver asked  \n\
Stanley said.\n\n\
The driver asked, bringing out Stanley's bag from his side.\n\n\
Stanley said with so much relief.\n\n\
said the driver\n\n\
Stanley replied.\n\n\
the bus driver asked out of curiosity.\n\n\

Stanley replied. The driver opened it and confirmed that what Stanley said was true. Then he handed the bag over to Kelvin. Stanley rushed to work. He was in a race against time. As soon as the investors and everyone at the company were seated and ready to listen to the presentation, Stanley walked in, ready to present. Eventually, he gave an amazing presentation.

description.title: 【大阪】🇯🇵 日本环球影城 Universal Studios Japan (慎入：内容过长)
description.body:
我和米特两人到大阪旅游，时间来到第三天，这天是去「日本环球影城」游玩，这是我期待了好久的环球影城。 小时候在电视里的旅游节目中看过「日本环球影城」的介绍，当时就已经非常向往，没想到现在梦想成真了。 ---
**大阪五天四夜之旅** **18/5/2026 - 22/5/2026** **第三天**
--- 我和米特两人在这一天很早就起床了，由于要早起，前一天晚上也很早就回酒店休息。放了五点的闹钟，还是赖床继续睡到六点才起床。酒店的免费早餐在六点半开始，我们吃了早餐才出发去环球影城。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48gp7YXR6Rfewayb4SyZTeEgHYda5cNLRN2SuMYaP6ah82xcUa7QjdJb5Wsw5xEpr7.jpeg) 来到环球影城已经看到很多人了，明明时间还很早。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48XeubA6BcJEaqU4LCSi8PZdAnAVzYgyRaKSs8KZH5Tk4Cet3MK1KXXQNQocwBiPyJ.jpeg) 在这里随处可见这个大大个字的 “**25th**”，原来今年是「日本环球影城」的 25 周年纪念了。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/488zaCobBFCQjmBDZyruJ2yCabUiGtPTAbyf6LayVF9b91fUAt7UC43as9KiX4eZbC.jpeg) 这个写着 Universal Studios Japan 的地球仪算是地标，听说如果没拍照打卡这个地球仪就如同等于没来。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48hHxDYMWFycJvGyYoFty53uZCcHQdHwNQT553JtK7bL3B772wRtoyKCo52C7vqDDk.jpeg) 看看早上 7 点的人潮，真夸张的多人，早上 9 点才开门，大家这么早就来排队了。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PwnJ4i4Pnu48Qtd8EcVfHDtWP4k5RpXs5PtJCKj7Mhryvjk9GB71ctoSXWT6ZpXn.jpeg) 嘴巴说别人夸张，那么早来排队，结果我们自己也是早上六点半多一点就出门去搭地铁前往环球影城了。 前段的路线都是上班族居多，后面要接近环球影城的时候就成了游客居多。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Zb4jNYD1zQF2YEHiBd66V5Z1cjHABg8ZUx96CCuNYLEnCafmqwSbV5oGW6VHkJXH.jpeg) 原本排队的地方，我以为是检票处，结果不是，那只是安检处，八点半门开了只是过一个安检，然后在上图这里继续排队到九点才开门。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23xATv1XDQH6UWSTbABi7P6YLUurAmQRrJ5g9MTgBq9J5feU7kikrcxE9YD88Z2TWNLzx.gif) 九点开门入场后，好多人在跑，环球影城的工作人员各个手持 “Please Walk” 的牌子，依然被无视。我和米特两个很悠闲的慢慢走…… 在来环球影城的前一天，我们都下载了【**Universal Studios Japan**】这个 ᴀᴘᴘ，里面有地图可以看，我们就跟着地图随机去玩游戏，完全没有那种安排好并跟着行程的规划。 接下来我会一个一个的慢慢放出我们游玩的游戏…… --- 【**大白鲨 (Jaws)**】 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48hHbsoAnkSvAjWC6iTqUrmLbn1W6DZewRA5mYmutFGJiTiUKmhkfnzHDH8NGRsiJh.jpeg) 第一个游戏直接选了《大白鲨》 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PTjpZW978MGEYJ1Q3TkSgWZHrSVhY46xoAxMRuBe2jfSibsKGUscJBUke21ekySH.jpeg) 早上九点开门入场，我就来排队，外面写着需要排队 10 分钟，我们进去感觉没 10 分钟就上到船了。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48ZaJfNugfrsDFiM4LX77LsqXokp5UvJ1tRn8HLuLAwEoaCtNAKv9jYGgiKUXHxx75.jpeg) 这是个进去看大白鲨的乘船游，进去里面，水里的大白鲨会突然冒出来吓你，还有船长提供了很多情绪价值，可惜的是里面不允许拍照。 --- 【**侏罗纪乘船游 (Jurassic Park - The Ride)**】 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48ijbukPkz3fWovNPfGFDynyFnuF7dtJGeUSjGB83KBik3iqVdpH7ohX2QBD54sAR1.jpeg) 连着玩两个与水有关的项目，玩了《大白鲨》后就来的《侏罗纪公园》这里。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48aYLSaw9LXJNYao7GsAKS3PJg7yXsYEi16q7PkgNNXkoJ2s28ty78wDW5n64xKemf.jpeg) 我们要玩的是《侏罗纪乘船游》 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48RscUokAqetYFdTabMubMoQTMrdyfEvtkUhdySFhg2SmGNLX3faBrisddWQQznB4M.jpeg) 这个项目我们拍了将近 15 分钟，好多人…… 这个比《大白鲨》刺激，好多人一上船就穿好雨衣什么的，我还在想难道会湿身？ ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23xehVMG8hwbWGTJBGgcqBuAR234GX8xXBf7t5DSRkRM72cD4SuYc8Fy9MPjKC9nsJwhi.gif) 原来乘船最后一段是直接俯冲而下，坐最左边的游客直接被水溅了一身全湿！我和米特在中间，也免不了被溅了一点点，但是裤子坐在湿湿的椅子上，下船时穿着亮色裤子的米特看起来像尿裤子的感觉，笑死我。 --- 【**小小兵疯狂任务～成为大坏蛋之路～**】 **(Illumination's Villain-Con Minion Blast)** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48JeAXFE8kcUG3Ui4vmqoqYSXsurQy18inG5rsAicCXo7LxLYVFnoYQfisRyCzrRbx.jpeg) 第三个游戏选了这个小孩子玩的游戏，因为排队时长最少。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48fL3iFEsj3yWY2TY7w2Ka9a8iA8CyiVKqmBnV5aeG2tCgv9zbkih7JHZJ7rYV7GyS.jpeg) 进去后很快就轮到我们，工作人员让我们挑个枪，拿着走上一个传送带，一路带我们去两面都是大屏幕的地方，我们一边传送一边射击两面大屏幕里面的坏蛋和道具来获得积分。 --- ## 午餐 Lunch 午餐选了间在【大白鲨】项目旁的餐厅…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Je2ohCA4uuQe3EbchYxpXETuceCg7qrWdnK8KHmnUmEyCNnDWSZptj4S4TdqLMhA.jpeg) 餐厅内环境像是个复古木制的设计…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PTWATeWbQMbVWbkLRiJRKCaL277rqUVBCp5auN7WUxp9mnFk8pZx1mFu6FE2AT63.jpeg) 点餐是用电子平板点餐…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23tvpykvck1rTFk9e9gTsZ7Xb2dQzanTuCTzQrztoY7m9wCFJS4D4yfa51F8JNQoCpULF.jpeg) **价格：日元 ￥4650** 这顿在环球影城里面的午餐真的贵，人均 50+ 马币了。 description.title: Man Eater              …Part 6                ... Sudden Apparition
description.body:
*We are all haunted, all of us, by things we can see and feel and guess at, and many more things that we can't. ― Beth Gutcheon*


!['Blythe' Spirit.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPkAQkobgr5w7rKwXfkrqZBNmPy5tXkz4NNZgg8EGAWSF/'Blythe'%20%20Spirit.png)
 

Shakespeare said conscience makes cowards of us all, but I think taking time to reflect on anything makes us doubt our original perceptions. And I was certainly full of qualms that next morning as I sipped my coffee in the bright May sunlight. The idea of contacting Blythe Summers’ spirit seemed as absurd as participating in a séance. I had already told Stella the play of light in the house was unique, and was chagrined to think my over-active imagination had run away on me. Really—how foolish of me to think such a thing—mistaking a shadow for a real person! I put the thought out of my head and focused on more mundane matters, like searching for gardening services. By noon, however, I was thoroughly bored. Strangely, the process of interviewing prospective gardeners can weigh on the soul and be quite depressing—*who knew?*

I poured a glass of lemonade and wandered out into the gardens, inhaling the citron scent of budding leaves and imagining the barren branches blossoming into a leafy canopy overhead. I sauntered down the garden toward the ravine and stumbled over some brickwork overgrown by grass. I put down my lemonade on a nearby low brick wall and looked more closely at the turf beneath my feet. I could discern the faint outlines of some sort of brickwork design. I wanted to cut back the grass to get a better look at the pattern, and seeing there was a garden shed nearby, I checked inside and found an old push-style lawnmower I could use. I wheeled the machine back to the area and ran it over the faint design feature I wanted to see. Sure enough, there was a distinct circular pattern of interlocking bricks. I now was eager to see the whole pattern, so began mowing in earnest, and finally, when I was through, I could see the obvious shape of a garden maze. I was delighted.

I recognized the design as a turf maze, a pattern similar to ones I saw in Europe in the great cathedrals. I recalled the tour guide saying penitents would often follow the twisting paths, crawling on their hands and knees as a type of penance to expiate sins. It crossed my mind to wonder what sins Blythe Summer might be trying to expunge. I retrieved my glass of lemonade, took a sip and studied the pattern in the lawn. Out of idle curiosity, I began following a path through the maze. I found it quite relaxing and peaceful. I naturally fell into a rhythm, stopping at certain points, and then continuing along my little pilgrimage. When I completed the circuit, I felt refreshed—*not cleansed*, I told myself, but definitely more peaceful and relaxed.

I returned to the house, entering through the patio doors and placed my empty lemonade glass on the island counter. As I turned to go into the parlour, I was shocked to see a woman standing in the dining room, staring at me. “Who are you?” she asked, as if I were intruding in her home. “I’m Theo Wesley, the owner. And who are you and what are you doing in my house?” “You shouldn’t be here,” she said and turned to go. It was then I recognized her as Blythe Summer. I don’t know what I was expecting—a ghost, a transparent wraith, a shade perhaps, but certainly not a flesh and blood young woman in a lovely yellow blouse. “No, wait—please, Blythe—don’t go.”

She stopped, her eyes wide, as she looked at me curiously. “I don’t know you.” “Can’t you just stay a moment and talk?” The words were out of me before I could censor them. “And why would I talk to you?” “Because I love your poems—I always have from the first moment I read them.” “Which poems?” “All of them, but especially the poems of spring. I read your *Segues*—they led me here.”

She eyed me suspiciously. “Are you the intruder who surprised me the other day?” “Yes, but actually, I think I was more surprised than you—and I’m not an intruder. I purchased this house.” “I find that hard to believe,” she said haughtily. “I haven’t offered *Sombra* for sale.” “Look, Miss Summers, I know you must find this weird, but I’m living in a different time from you. I think I’ve stumbled on some method that allows our paths to cross somehow.”

She snickered sarcastically, “Oh, you certainly are amusing. And what time do you claim to be from?” She wasn’t buying what I was selling. I’d hate to be a Fuller Brush man in the Thirties knocking on her door. “I’m from the 21st century—80 years or more in your future.” “I see.” A smile darkened her mouth. “That might explain the curious outfit you’re wearing.” I looked down at my Hawaiian shirt, belted beige cargo shorts and sandals. I coloured and grinned at her ruefully, “The Gary Cooper look is not fashionable in the future.” “And why should I believe you, Mr. Wesley? Really, this is a most preposterous story.”

An idea hit me. I reached into my pocket and extracted my i-Phone. “Here’s proof. Do you have devices like this in the 1930’s?” I asked smugly. She pixilated, and slowly dissolved right before my eyes. A low groan welled up from deep within me. I couldn’t believe my stupidity. Somehow, Fate allowed our paths to cross and I trashed the moment by proudly displaying an icon of our technology with all the pride as if I invented the damn thing myself. I slumped down defeated onto the bench seat of the breakfast nook.

To be continued…

description.body:
I think the OP you are investigating here was suggesting that if printing  HBD is bad for the economy in one place, it's bad for the economy if it's being printed at all. So, it doesn't really matter if something needs to be changed for it happen, protocol or not. 

I think that  the tightening of the devs belt was mentioned, but how  that should be done wasn't defined or was defined quite badly, causing confusion. I'd say the tightening of the belt is needed. That means that those developing the frontends or source  code updates getting DHF money should go into minimal mode only taking funds needed to keep the current code running safe, but stop paying extra devs to continue on updates.

Keeping Hive up and running safely is a must and should be funded. Anything beyond that should cease until the market conditions return, so it doesn't affect the economy negatively. That's what healthy businesses do, though usually after it's too late and we are quite late to making those hard choices as well. The problem is that the stake in control isn't willing to make those types of decisions, because it affects them immediately.

 That doesn't mean that forward thinking work can't be done.  It just  means you're not going to get paid for it in real time from the DHF. That shouldn't be  a problem, because  many of our best projects aren't being funded at all, yet they continue forward. Posting rewards can fill the gap until such time the economy comes back. Not only that, there's been quite a few retroactive salaries approved for work done without pay. 

If the devs not getting paid by the DHF want to keep clicking along, they can get paid through the more common method of blogging by posting their intentions and progress more often. Those blogs tend to be rewarded more handsomely than other topics, which means they wouldn't earn as  much as they do if they weren't in the positions that they are. To clarify, being a dev putting something useful forward for the community tends to earn you more from the rewards pool and that is funding of some sort. If it falls short or the devs didn't blog much, which is their choice, they can put in for fair funding of the code they created before implementing it in the future or ask for retroactive pay.

I don't see why that should be a problem, because we are all investors and need to  do what's best for the chain as a whole and no one loses rewards.

description.title: Photofeed landscape contest .:. Amber rocks
description.body:
![2026-apr-1748w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23xedomt6A1qibKP9sJEhqwByYQ5TdXfEAFtLmpBGpJNscfmeM8Q8ZnabHwk3ZrzqHJGB.jpg)

<div class=\

>

\nThis capture I took back in April during a day-long hike in Karelia, across the Baltic Sea coast. It would have been an ordinary, unremarkable location, were it not for the amber-brown peat stream. It was precisely this water that colored the nearby rocks in such a whimsical, capricious hue. It also appealed to me that one bank was already covered with sprouts of fresh green grass (even a few snowdrops are visible), while the other bank was covered only with dead autumn leaves. It looks like a symbolic battle scene for me – the retreat of winter and the victory of spring.\n

>

Cнимок сделан в апреле этого года на побережье Балтийского моря. Место было бы ничем не примечательно, если бы не ручей из торфяной воды коричневого цвета, это его вода столь причудливо окрасила камни. Мне особенно понравилось то, что один берег уже покрылся ростками свежей зеленой травы (даже видны подснежники!), а на другом только мертвые осенние листья. Выглядит как символическая картина военных действий - отступления зимы и победы весны.

--------- My post goes for [#Photofeed #landscape photography challenge, Round 174](https://ecency.com/@photofeed/photofeed-contest-landscape-photography-round-174)

description.title: Is praying enough to get closer to God.
description.body:
According to the teachings from Jesus Christ, He told us to be prey to the father with a sincere heart and mind. He also teaches us to pray from our good heart but not to impress people around us. When we pray, we should praise God, thank Him for His blessings, confess our sins, and present our needs before Him.

Prayer is also an act of trust. Christians are encouraged to pray regularly and believe that God hears them. Jesus provided the Lord's Prayer as a model, showing that prayer should honor God, seek His will, ask for daily needs, request forgiveness, and seek protection from temptation. Through faithful prayer, believers draw closer to God and strengthen their spiritual lives.

description.title: NATURAL TOURIST DESTINATIONS // Relaxing on the green grass while enjoying the breathtaking natural scenery.
description.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGvqoxiNDQUpxMhuaB8mGQBVLvnbCsbdzequpWoj1Qmy/1781436982713.jpg) In this post, I'd like to share an enjoyable experience and some memorable moments from my visit to an open natural tourist spot located by the shore of a tawar sea ,unfortunately I don't know the name of this place, and I couldn't find a single signboard around the area. From the roadside, it looks like an abandoned garden or plantation, but inside there are several pine trees that provide a natural place to rest in the shade,and the area is also covered with lush green grass, creating a peaceful and refreshing atmosphere. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMcBiLziPejKvaM7oVMDtnAkBecy53PSGbbpf4Fd99WM/1781436982788.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW68A3KL4cGZXRKT8UMr656Xakxn9ZqR915va7std9tRq/1781436982896.jpg) On my way to this tourist destination, I also stopped at several spots to capture the scenery around a landslide area. The road conditions were quite extreme, as the route was covered with thick dust,this made the journey more challenging and potentially dangerous, since the dust could be inhaled into the lungs and also reduce visibility for travelers passing through the area. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrdp7vtXE8v1vnFfedFxNsLo4bs6MqXQW9TYLA9gGtfQ/1781436983033.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXhHtwyjUybEHjW5UNfhW7pDxZgkUyKBey3mJ3zGH9SQC/1781436983106.jpg) But Takengon is still Takengon—one of the natural paradises of Aceh. The breathtaking scenery this region has to offer is beyond question, and it is one of the main reasons why so many people are willing to travel through challenging and sometimes extreme routes just to reach this beautiful town. I visited this place during the recent Eid al-Adha holiday, which is one of the major holidays in our region. At that time, I met many visitors who had come from different areas, and even from abroad. As expected, tourist destinations tend to be crowded during holiday seasons, including places that simply offer a space for relaxation and recreation. This was also the case with the place I visited, where many people gathered to enjoy the beautiful surroundings and spend time with their loved ones ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3w8EC5Us74k74nsJVfRt26TcCQbg2YtzSC7Y3Gz9X3K/1781439123233.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZcPHMAewmHmhwTJPa8RJHvQrSRXGTmDhBzCHtoNZiCRk/1781439123342.jpg) From the main area, we can see how crowded the visitors are who come to this tourist spot, even the parking area is also filled with many vehicles. But unfortunately, here we cannot find any stalls or kiosks, so it is highly recommended to buy supplies first before coming to this place. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCjWMTWuzktXEYKDec4p7KhCxcN2pyMVXnH7jLSYRQFS/1781439123448.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPPm4BXQnpa1kBPp2f62WWKsMVxQpvhXBqHZqAZnjHXUd/1781439123539.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXomHPUdRhqerpEK5NVxuRaj9m9xhgQGx9K7MdiRAa6N6/1781439161287.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFAHjR1WuVPXS7jWVj8yqGkFeVZtT8Z7NnoiA7f2F6xt/1781439161407.jpg) One of the reasons why I stopped by this place was because it looked very clean, the grass grows lush and is well maintained so that it becomes a natural carpet to sit and relax, and this place is also located on a hill and faces directly towards the tawar sea, so that every visitor can relax while enjoying the beautiful natural scenery. There are so many lush trees surrounding this place, so even though there are no food stalls or shelters here, visitors can still relax peacefully under their shade. At that time I saw that there were so many visitors who came here and most of them were visitors who came with their families.In my opinion, this is a perfect place to relax, unwind, and escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMbM5YXPBGAPeHNfsFmPLCNt6hsa6Jywkv8WJabhBoxF/1781439161517.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTh7BC2NjokXWcarG5rVJmTFyqj1nFKs3xPxRbiRpqaYS/1781439161616.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZF4AjqwzrwypU8hktfmV5a8moE74tQuyCkgyrXLq4sfS/1781439161702.jpg) At that moment, my partner and I headed straight to the tawar sea, where we immediately found a place to sit,the cool breeze and the peaceful natural atmosphere made this place feel very romantic for us. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

description.title: A Day in My Life Blog: It's Second Sunday of the Week - Our Church Divine Service and I am Assigned to Share God's Word! 😇😊🙏
description.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** A week for me is full of wonderful and great happenings that I always thank God. Most especially this day which is Sunday. A day where we gather together to worship God. This day is second Sunday of the Month, and it is considered as Youth Sunday where all assigned in the program are young people, and since I am the Youth Pastor of the Church, it is also my schedule to share God's to the congregation. This is what I am about to share today with all of you but as what I always do, I will first going to share my thanksgiving to each and everyone most especially to all my supporters. Thanks a lot to the Admins, all Curators and also to all commenters. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcukqVMrZUBF1jgszzSwjVKPx7VPHnhvvbXLck4ehwXeA/1781440974958.png) As always, every Sunday we considered it as holy day where we gather in our Church to worship Him in Spirit and in truth. Were very blessed when this day came unto our lives. Every Sunday, we woke up very early so we can finished immediately but since we also have lots of things to do, sometimes we finished preparing late which makes me sometimes late when going to our Church. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd4JGZx54wfdm4WQBxyFBsm5yj5kPv4GdLeZvzSjG2brZ/1781438455198.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4b63bhx4vU9Q9LQtjSwhU7KAktdw1p4kHEc62F6Tddy/1781438455237.jpg) From last two Sundays, I was assigned to teach the Kids on their Sunday's School but today, I'll let the other Teacher who is also a young people to teach the Kids based on the lesson that I've used in the past Sundays. I was a bit late when I arrived at our Church because I forgot to buy some snacks for the Kids in their Sunday's Schooling that is why, I dropped by first to a grocery store to buy some snacks. When I arrived at our Church that is also a time where the testimony session had ended and it is now time for the next part of our Church program which is the Praise and Worship. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNN4KsbRWZGzgFKycYt6556KJQoQ9zFrgcrY9RHK7hL4A/1781438455283.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBUZJZLAvuh7eCGLbgVkK8uzoNzizXyZHiViEFxEJuGa/1781438455324.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbd3bTZswhD4rq3ZuL9GafxWHHoP9q6qq3nSJSyeW59KZ/1781438455357.jpg) It was now then started by reading the Word of God for the Scripture Reading which is again assigned to one of our young people and as we hear God's Word were all very blessed. Followed immediately by the Praise and Worship and for today, our worship leader is also a young people who is also our Youth Department President, who is very dedicated in leading us in Worship to God. It has been a while since the last time he is assigned to led us in worship as he keep on rejecting before due to a conflict of schedule with his work but thank God, as his schedule at work is now not conflict every Sunday. We're all very blessed to hear all the Worship songs that has been sang during our Praise and Worship because it really directs to our heart and we understand it very well and I can see also that everyone had felt the presence of God. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSD8jjjFhkq7wWpiaXjg4GCNKXPu2HbNQ7Gu9N6ZU67wg/1781439112616.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZeznjRLCrX5o2fGrm23cRKuwsTxCgi1691KQfw8WkDNS/1781439112655.jpg) Just after the praise and worship, it was now then followed by the sharing of God's Word and it is me who is assigned to share the Word of God to all of who were here today. Since the start of the month, the topic that has been shared started by my Senior Pastor is all about Evangelism and we have a topics to followed which we get during a Seminar which talk about Evangelism. Now, my task today is to continue the topic that has been started sharing by my Senior Pastor as this is a series topic and we want also everyone know more about Evangelism not just us but to each and every one of us. The topic that has been given to is all about a survey which talked about the Evangelism Today. I will be discussing what is the current status of Evangelism in our Church and also the reason why is it hard for us or for the Church Members to Evangelize. I am very thankful and blessed that I have been given an opportunity to share this topic to our congregation as it also reminded about the current status of our Church with it comes to Evangelism and what should we do about it. I'm thankful to God that all of our Church Members has been very serious listening to me and all I can asked and pray to God that this will not be remain here in our Church but even outside our Church. They will apply what they have learned even outside our Church where the true ministry is, most especially in their schools, work and others. That was already around 11:50 when I finished and it was now then followed by the remaining part of our Church Service. The Church Service was now then concluded with full of happiness and were all very blessed as God is with us all the time. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGYrwN3DmzdWyT63dJ2V5iW3umpxajYWpjW2E3soCkeo/_7506117_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *



Greetings hivers.

Some photographs are found on foot, others reveal themselves along the way. This series was born from the seat of an electric tricycle, with the city drifting by on the other side. Fragments of faces, light, shadows and gestures that exist for only a few seconds. Images made in transit, from a place that belongs neither to the departure nor the destination, but to the journey itself.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTRdSYGn9xHZktRB9fKwoUPpxhgh5iQecqxmiLtyBkmaG/_7506118_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Hay fotografías que se buscan caminando y otras que aparecen en el camino. Esta serie nació desde un triciclo eléctrico, con la ciudad deslizándose al otro lado. Fragmentos de rostros, luces, sombras y gestos que apenas existen durante unos segundos. Imágenes de paso, hechas desde un lugar que no pertenece ni al origen ni al destino, sino al trayecto.

Yesterday's report: \

By sheer luck, we ended up spreading the kitchen assembly over several days, which gave us enough time to prepare all the water valves and drain connections. With two dishwashers and a water supply line for the fridge, the setup turned into quite an impressive plumbing manifold. Had the countertops already been installed, fitting all of this would have been much more difficult. Kolor: Czarny, nieprzejrzysty. Piana: Beżowa, obfita, drobnopęcherzykowa, gęsta, opada leniwie, wzorowy lacing. Aromat: Prażony słonecznik, gorzka czekolada i cytrusy - głównie w typie grejpfruta. Smak: Półwytrawny, zdecydowanie bardziej cytrusowy niż w aromacie, grejpfrut, zest, trochę gorzkiej czekolady, lekkie nuty palone i całość zwieńczona cytrusową goryczką. Wysycenie w normie, niezła treściwość, choć przydałoby się więcej ciała, dobra pijalność, alkohol jest dobrze ukryty. Dobra BIPA i tyle. Koszt: 9,99 zł - butelka 500 ml bezzwrotna.

/> Black IPA from the Craft Right Now series, Pinta Brewery Style: Cascadian Dark Ale / Black IPA Extract: 16 % Plato Alcohol: 6.5 % ABV Bitterness: ? IBU Best before 19.08.2026. Color: Black, opaque. Head: Beige, rich, fine-bubbled, dense, subsides lazily, exemplary lacing. Aroma: Roasted sunflower seeds, dark chocolate, and citrus—mainly grapefruit-like. Taste: Semi-dry, definitely more citrusy than in the aroma, grapefruit, zest, a bit of dark chocolate, light roasted notes, and the whole thing topped off with a citrusy bitterness. Carbonation standard, decent body, though it could use a bit more texture, good drinkability, alcohol is well-hidden. A good BIPA and that's it. Cost: 9.99 PLN - 500 ml non-returnable bottle.

在城市的边缘藏着这样一片绿意天地，河水映着树影，风里裹着草木的清香。松鼠在林间穿梭，马鞭草和玉簪花悄悄盛放，漫坡的草地柔软得像被阳光晒过的绒毯。走在木栈道上，看云影漫过树梢，心也跟着慢了下来，把杭州入梅后的的闷热，都藏进这片葱郁里。

description.title: New Life, Dog Roses and the Morning After the Fete Clean Up
description.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQme4cyYb8C2YutJ847ba28isjBoa5Vwrf9pNNPc9DL7mxc/P6142161.JPG

There have been some lovely new arrivals in the village this week. While out walking, I spotted four little cygnets swimming along with their mum. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbn1i6UnrLS8BS46V3fecXmfFNmxXJHeGDgpBKRMUJdc/P6142163~3.JPG

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVzkGFw4Q5A7GkMo4tUiSG2RedemSDNqtVUL6yWjnHgyV/P6142159~2.JPG

https://images.hive.blog/DQmfJ4JW4i7y4VkWFuV6MbzEUXF7bALqinL76FCuSEG3QP5/P6142166~3.JPG

They were only a few days old and looked so fluffy following her around on the water. It is always lovely to see new life appearing, but it's also a worry as not all of them survive.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmacT4EC4DZYFhjKA7Ga5ASPky7Vrze4AB1mSRBFdkJWtW/P6142152~2.JPG

I also spotted two young coots nearby. They were standing on a rock on their own, taking some time to have a good preen. I couldn’t see their parents anywhere, so I wondered if they were nearby keeping a watchful eye from a distance.  They looked old enough to fend for themselves, though.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPRduu2qgVmYo81cfGHJpjh6L9tYJ7Fh7MxVjGsJrct3T/20260614_120236.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmf3HxFevyabAtXPZC8aTcE8FUzKurF9mxWXoZB2n4kHZd/20260614_115656~2.jpg

There were still a few reminders of yesterday’s village fete too. A row of black bins had been left ready for the council collection, showing that the clean up was still going on after a successful day. Among them was a smiley face, which perfectly summed up yesterday. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmS27MNsXaLGDguru7ZgFmSWxZ36kU5enzJn8VWeT8TDJ6/20260614_120831~2.jpg

Away from the water, the dog roses were looking very pretty. The pink flowers stood out amongst the green leaves.  They are a reminder that summer is on its way.  Hopefully!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRf5WNjJXvk1wEUjQMpo9JoMxk39JHTaXo9p2ePbo2jFg/P6142174~2.JPG

It was one of those simple village walks where there was something to see everywhere, from the new cygnets and coots by the water to the flowers and signs of the fete. 

This post is for #sublimesunday is inspired by @c0ff33a and #beautifulsunday is initiated by @ace108.

description.title: Si cambia tu actitud, cambia el ambiente. 📝
description.body: <div class=\

> La mayoría de nosotros, en algún momento de nuestras vidas, sentimos la necesidad de reinterpretar nuestra realidad. Buscamos maneras y herramientas para iniciar este cambio, pero para que sea real y duradero, empezamos desde dentro, cambiando nuestra actitud ante la vida, con la esperanza de obtener mejores resultados en nuestro entorno. ![Actitud positiva .jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGyWreZ8TGw1fb9ziThE3jVc86pwf94d76KY8J78JHFM/Actitud%20positiva%20.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-flotante-ciudad-sombrilla-4491540/) Hace poco pasé tiempo con una amiga a la que no veía desde hacía años. Después de ser una persona bulliciosa rodeada de muchos problemas, estaba mucho más tranquila. Me contó que, desde que decidió cambiar su actitud, ha notado mejores resultados en sus relaciones interpersonales y también en cómo percibe los diversos problemas que surgen en la vida. Aunque pueda parecer ilógico o irrelevante, nuestra actitud suele ser responsable de cómo se desarrolla nuestro entorno, tanto en nuestras acciones como en nuestro bienestar físico y emocional. Porque si lo pensamos bien, si una persona no cuida su salud, las consecuencias serán negativas. Lo mismo ocurre con nuestros pensamientos y acciones. Si no trabajamos para mejorar en este aspecto y tenemos actitudes que desagradan a quienes nos rodean, será perjudicial para nuestro desarrollo social. No somos perfectos, pero si tratamos bien a quienes nos rodean, en la mayoría de los casos lograremos relaciones más estables, conectando con respeto con nuestros seres queridos y desarrollando valores como la confianza y la empatía. ![geralt-handshake-5760544.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTem4dbvVQNsim8bcbn8M3NYznn6knAkr3djqfH8FPTne/geralt-handshake-5760544.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/apret%C3%B3n-de-manos-las-manos-hombres-5760544/) Mi amiga me contó que desde que su hijo empezó a recibir palabras amables, su actitud también cambió, creando un ambiente familiar más armonioso. Estos sencillos gestos ayudaron a fortalecer su relación, permitiéndoles encontrar soluciones a sus problemas. En lugar de centrarse en el problema, trabajan juntos para encontrar la solución. De igual manera, debemos aprender a establecer límites en medio de estos cambios, ya que a menudo podemos ser percibidos como débiles debido a nuestra calma en diferentes situaciones. Esta actitud también puede resultar algo incómoda, pero cuando establecemos límites, es más fácil lograr mejores resultados al cambiar nuestra actitud. Intentar mantener buenas relaciones nos ayuda a fomentar la unidad, brindando la oportunidad de que nuestras relaciones con nuestros seres queridos sean más fuertes y de mayor confianza, donde todos intentan colaborar para mantener un ambiente positivo.
![Screenshot_2026-06-14-08-33-04-966_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQx2JMS1i96DfqnTD6R637DFb41c8U265wYabEdpgAhU/Screenshot_2026-06-14-08-33-04-966_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/meditaci%C3%B3n-positivo-1087851/) Como madre, esta herramienta me ayuda muchísimo en mi día a día con mis hijos, porque así como yo tengo mis retos diarios, ellos también los tienen, aunque sean niños. Claro que los retos son muy diferentes, pero es igualmente necesario mantener un ambiente positivo, tratándonos bien y con respeto. Esto facilita nuestra relación y nos permite encontrar soluciones efectivas cuando sea necesario. Además, nos une más, fortaleciendo una amistad basada en valores positivos. Cuando nos encontramos en una situación en la que sentimos que todo va mal, podemos analizar cuál era la raíz del problema; quizás tener una actitud positiva ayude a que todo cambie, ya que es algo muy sencillo pero con grandes resultados. > Gracias por leer mi publicación. ❤️ --- |English version . | | -------- --- Most of us, at some point in our lives, feel the need to reinterpret our reality. We seek ways and tools to initiate this change, but for it to be real and lasting, we begin from within, changing our attitude toward life, hoping for better results in our surroundings. ![Actitud positiva 1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFS9hZags1PrTD8HPZhxbCzRVTGzg4STp1yHgdh2tvcr/Actitud%20positiva%201.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-flotante-ciudad-sombrilla-4491540/) I recently spent time with a friend I hadn't seen in years. After being a boisterous person surrounded by many problems, she was much calmer. She told me that since choosing to change her attitude, she has seen better results in her interpersonal relationships and also in how she views the various problems that arise in life. Although it may seem illogical or irrelevant, our attitude is often responsible for how our surroundings develop, both in our actions and in our physical and emotional well-being. Because if we think about it, if a person doesn't take care of their health, the results will be negative. The same is true for our thoughts and actions. If we don't work on improving that area and we have attitudes that displease everyone around us, it will be detrimental to our social development. We aren't perfect, but if we treat those around us well, in most cases we'll achieve more stable relationships, connecting respectfully with our loved ones and developing values like trust and empathy. ![geralt-handshake-5760544.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTem4dbvVQNsim8bcbn8M3NYznn6knAkr3djqfH8FPTne/geralt-handshake-5760544.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/apret%C3%B3n-de-manos-las-manos-hombres-5760544/) My friend told me that since she started seeing her son receive kind words, his attitude also changed, creating a more harmonious family environment. These simple gestures helped strengthen their relationship, allowing them to find solutions to their problems. Instead of focusing on the problem, they work together to find the solution. Similarly, we must learn to set boundaries amidst these changes, because we can often be perceived as weak due to our calm demeanor in different situations. This attitude can also be somewhat uncomfortable, but when we establish boundaries, it's easier to achieve better results when we change our attitudes. Trying to maintain good relationships helps us foster unity, providing an opportunity for our relationships with loved ones to be stronger and more trusting, where everyone tries to collaborate to maintain a positive environment.
![Screenshot_2026-06-14-08-33-04-966_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQx2JMS1i96DfqnTD6R637DFb41c8U265wYabEdpgAhU/Screenshot_2026-06-14-08-33-04-966_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/meditaci%C3%B3n-positivo-1087851/) As a mother, this is a tool that greatly helps me in my daily life with my children, because just as I have my daily challenges, they do too, even though they are children. Of course, the challenges are very different, but it's equally necessary to maintain a positive atmosphere, treating each other well and with respect. This helps make our relationship smoother and allows us to find effective solutions when needed. It also brings us closer, strengthening a friendship based on positive values. Whenever we are in a place and feel that everything is wrong, we can evaluate what the root of the problem was; perhaps having a positive attitude will help everything change, since it is something very simple but with great results. > Thank you for reading my post. ❤️ Imágenes creadas en [canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/) Texto traducido al inglés en [Traductor de Google](https://translate.google.com/?hl=es&sl=auto&tl=en&text=Para%20finalizar%20me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20resaltar%20que%20existe%20un%20fidelidad%20que%20es%20para%20toda%20la%20vida%2C%20sin%20dudar%20por%20un%20momento%2C%20digo%20que%20es%20la%20fidelidad%20de%20Dios%20en%20nuestras%20vidas.&op=translate) ![IMG_20231128_162542.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFtBdh3FXgNmKcYfeJMmjCJNgMiUoHyAoXxNqM4v6a2g/IMG_20231128_162542.png)

description.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
How much does a memory weigh?
***

>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23u5tAhfbe4m2EpphJrEfboJnDHvvrr7au4f9Hzj8q5X9qMcb45EBLqrxH9qXF41v5Kd2.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
For decades, old Julián guarded that dark wooden chest as though the world’s last beating heart lay within it. He kept it under lock and key, in the most sacred corner of his room, his silence fuelling the myth of a hidden fortune. His heirs, driven by a mixture of greed and curiosity, would whisper the eternal question behind his back: *“What’s in that chest?”*. They imagined gold bars, deeds to distant lands or family jewels that would settle their fortunes in a single stroke. After the funeral, the heavy air in the house was broken by the creak of the forced lock. The children crowded round, holding their breath, awaiting the blinding flash of precious metal. However, as they lifted the heavy lid, the only glow that emerged was that of memory. There was no gold.
![j2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23x14rzogkST7jxsgsufJgScQfffozgs2Qu5xHDJhjkNqfy4ruCqtopBFLUuTy28zMiEt.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Instead, they found an atlas of affection: yellowed photos of laughter-filled afternoons on the beach, a record of a picnic beneath ancient oak trees, and portraits of a courtship that had survived every winter. There were postcards from every place they had visited, where Julián had jotted down the joy of being with his loved ones. And in the background, small scraps of paper with shaky handwriting: “I love you, son”, “I miss you every day”. That man did not hoard material wealth; he treasured the moments when life had meaning. The heirs realised, with a mixture of shame and deep tenderness, that a true inheritance is not deposited in banks, but in the soul. The great surprise was not the absence of jewellery, but the immense richness of a love which they, in their haste to inherit, had forgotten to value. The treasure was, quite simply, having been the reason for his fondest memories. *** ***

# ***
¿Cuánto pesa un recuerdo?
***

>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23u5tAhfbe4m2EpphJrEfboJnDHvvrr7au4f9Hzj8q5X9qMcb45EBLqrxH9qXF41v5Kd2.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Durante décadas, el viejo Julián custodió aquel cofre de madera oscura como si en su interior latiera el último corazón del mundo. Lo mantenía bajo llave, en el rincón más sagrado de su habitación, alimentando con su silencio el mito de una fortuna oculta. Sus herederos, movidos por una mezcla de codicia y curiosidad, solían susurrar a sus espaldas la eterna pregunta: *“What’s in that chest?”*. Imaginaban lingotes de oro, escrituras de tierras lejanas o joyas familiares que resolverían sus vidas de un solo plumazo. Tras el funeral, el aire pesado de la casa se rompió con el crujir de la cerradura forzada. Los hijos se agolparon con la respiración contenida, esperando el destello cegador del metal precioso. Sin embargo, al levantar la pesada tapa, el único brillo que emergió fue el de la memoria. No había oro.
![j2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23x14rzogkST7jxsgsufJgScQfffozgs2Qu5xHDJhjkNqfy4ruCqtopBFLUuTy28zMiEt.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
En su lugar, encontraron un atlas de afectos: fotos amarillentas de tardes de risas en la playa, el registro de un picnic bajo robles antiguos y retratos de un noviazgo que sobrevivió a todos los inviernos. Había postales de cada paraje visitado, donde Julián anotaba la alegría de estar con los suyos. Y al fondo, pequeños trozos de papel con caligrafía trémula: “Te amo, hijo”, “Los extraño cada día”. Aquel hombre no guardaba riqueza material; custodiaba los instantes donde la vida tuvo sentido. Los herederos comprendieron, con una mezcla de vergüenza y profunda ternura, que la verdadera herencia no se deposita en bancos, sino en el alma. La gran sorpresa no fue el vacío de joyas, sino la inmensa plenitud de un amor que ellos, en su prisa por heredar, habían olvidado valorar. El tesoro era, sencillamente, haber sido la razón de sus mejores recuerdos.

description.title: Sweet yogurt from a clay pot.
description.body: <div class=\

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS74DxpPAnLcWN92groZ6hR6DRRexpR1SZC3we4v5Fpvu/1781439766216.jpg) We all love to eat sweets. And if that sweet is pure sweet curd from an earthen pot, then it's no wonder! On a busy afternoon, I suddenly felt like eating some cold sweet curd. As expected, I took the bike and headed to the local sweet shop. As soon as I reached the shop, my eyes fell on the glass showroom. Just like the one in the picture. The rows of clay pots wrapped in plastic were beautifully arranged. The light brown, burnt latex coating on top was mouthwatering. When the shopkeeper took a cold pot out of the fridge and placed it in front of me, I felt half satisfied. The sweet smell of earth and the aroma of yogurt instantly took me back to my childhood days at my uncle's house. Not only did I buy yogurt, but the sincerity of the store employees touched my heart. Praveen stood next to a customer and told a story about the quality of yogurt. He was saying that although yogurt is available in plastic cups these days, yogurt from an earthen pot tastes different. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedEXniHrH94KyK1bufXAxML1fpCkMmq1YqLzK4F1Fmv3/1781439766451.jpg) When I put the first spoonful of yogurt in my mouth, in tune with his words, it really struck me how easily some traditional flavors can give us ultimate peace, even in this digital age. The food tasted wonderful. But the most beautiful thing was the atmosphere. The sound of tea cups clinking around, the light chatter of people, and the cool feeling of the clay pot in my hand all made the afternoon's fatigue disappear in an instant. These small experiences at local shops remind us that sometimes it's the little moments like these that bring us more joy than the big achievements in life. As I returned home with a pot of yogurt and a piece of happiness, a strange feeling of welling up inside me.

description.title: WOO Weekend Theory: The Battle Pass Finally Wore Everyone Out
description.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Let me present what may be the most realistic explanation for this weekend's silence. Everybody is exhausted. Not burned out. Not frustrated. Not disappearing. Just tired in the best possible way.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23xKrCEM1eEjjaypDYYCvEAgGsegESh89kaFEDTzyN14t8juapjqiMwTe7JEa43sCx9HV.png)

---

Think back to what happened after the Battle Pass launched. According to the announcement, daily matches increased by over 1000%. That is not a small increase. That is not a moderate increase. That is the sort of increase that makes me imagine wrestling organizations operating twenty-four hours a day.

For weeks, players have been chasing rewards, completing objectives, progressing through tracks, earning WOOJOBBER packs, and trying to maximize every possible opportunity.

At some point, even the most dedicated wrestler deserves a day off. Maybe that is exactly what we are seeing this weekend. Maybe WOO is experiencing the gaming equivalent of a recovery day.

The Battle Pass gave players more reasons to log in. More reasons to compete. More reasons to grind. More reasons to stay active. The result was exactly what everyone wanted. Activity exploded.

Now imagine thousands of wrestlers collectively deciding that this weekend is finally the time to relax. The arenas are quieter because everyone is at the virtual beach. The managers are not scouting talent because they are enjoying a barbecue. The referees are asleep. The commentators have temporarily lost their voices. Even the championship belts are probably taking a nap.

Honestly, that sounds like a well-earned break. One thing I have learned from online games over the years is that periods of intense activity are often followed by quieter periods. That is completely normal.

Communities breathe. Players recharge. Excitement settles before the next wave arrives. The important thing is what happens after the quiet period ends. In WOO's case, there are plenty of reasons to believe another wave is coming.

Land Rewards have only recently launched. Training Centers are becoming more important. The ranking system is on the horizon. The UI overhaul is still coming. There is plenty for players to anticipate.

That is why I am not worried about a quiet weekend. If anything, I see it as a positive sign. The community has actually had things to do recently. Players have had goals to chase. Players have had rewards to earn. Players have had reasons to stay engaged.

Sometimes after a long sprint, you need a moment to catch your breath. Maybe that is what this weekend represents. A collective pause. A brief recovery period. A chance to enjoy the progress already made before charging toward the next objective. Besides, if I have learned anything from WOO players, it is that they rarely stay quiet for long.

Eventually someone will discover a new strategy. Someone will pull an exciting reward. Someone will make a surprising announcement. And suddenly the community will be buzzing again. 

Until then, I am happy to imagine the entire wrestling world enjoying a rare peaceful weekend. The wrestlers are resting. The managers are relaxing. The landowners are waiting for Monday rewards. And the Battle Pass grinders are finally getting some sleep. They have earned it.

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

description.title: Netflix: Teach You A Lesson:
description.body: alt=\

/>This was a drama where I was reminded of how schools nowadays are, specifically bullying and how it affects our lives. It was inspiring to watch and learn from their struggles and experiences as it truly showed the consequences ofbullying on children and the feeling of helplessness. Bullying has such an impact and victims often find it difficult to voice it out to people, so, the drama indeed raised awareness for the topic which is definitely what everyone needs to realize.

Secondly, there is definitely a lot of emphasis in this drama that there should be discipline in school. I have noticed that when rules are set and followed correctly in school, most children tend to respect each other and are careful not to harm any one. I have learned that the key role of discipline is not about penalizing but teaching students responsibility andgood values. The impact is such that it would prevent much bullying as well.

This drama also brought forward that a law is needed to protect both students and teachers. Of course teachers are guiding students but a law that would protect the teacher at the same time while doing their part for guiding is also very necessary. When these laws are set in the right ways for both the teacher and students, problems are less likely to happen.

Finally, another point that I gained from this drama is that it is also a group effort. Students, teachers, parents and schools all need to come together to stop bullying. Victims are meant to be comfortable enough to report the bully and also witnesses should encourage and report it to prevent the situation from getting any worse.

description.title: It takes time to succeed, But it happens.
description.body: Hi Hivelearners friends. We are also watching many such TV shows here on TV where people go to the forest and spend the next few months doing different things there. I have also seen many such TV shows and I also have the same desire to go to the forest and sit there and do such things that then after that, as we are seeing here today, a camera is also installed and then after that the whole world is shown how difficult that time was but still this one person has spent time there with his hard work. And then he becomes a successful person. Hard work is the first thing behind every work because without hard work, nothing is ever done. Today we are living a city life. Here we have the help of many things and success is also easy. If I get such a challenge in life, I will definitely accept it and I will definitely want to go there and live a different and unique life there and I will definitely want to share my experience with the whole world because the whole world will see that all these people who are working on social media, They work with a lot of time and effort. No work is that easy. Every work requires hard work. By going there, we get to see and learn that we can improve our lives even without money. Now, just as if we are not given anything to eat there, we get many things there that we have to hunt to continue our lives. Just as we humans eat goats and other such things, there we have to sacrifice it ourselves and cook its meat there ourselves to live our lives well and to survive.
alt=\

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/orange-flowers-IicyiaPYGGI) So, our first effort there will be to do something that will help us without money. We can also make some things with the help of wood which we can sell later and get money. There will be many other things that we will do due to which we will start getting money again. But the whole point is that it will take us a lot of time there too, it will take many days and only then will we start doing all this and we will only have talent there which will be running in our mind. With its help, we have to make some special things. Now, just as we see that many toys are made with the help of wood and also different things like this are made and then they are sold, we will start making similar things which will sell very quickly and we will start getting money again. After that, slowly, slowly, we will make things more beautiful.
alt=\

/>

\[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/selective-photography-of-green-leaf-plant-Rfflri94rs8)

So all these things are our efforts to prevent such things from happening. Now we see that all the TV shows that are being shown are mostly about winter because it is impossible to sit by lighting a fire in the summer.

description.title: El festival de Valen City - Historia [ESP-ENG]
description.body:
![alalsd.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhjpsJQbduQb7MydaNnmSDw95ammgX94JXEfGKG55j3V/alalsd.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/piano-habitacion-clasico-instrumento-musical-19541583/) Wez apenas pudo dormir, ya que las horas pasaron muy rápido y la carta seguía sobre la mesa de la habitación, donde cada vez que veía aquel símbolo, sentía miedo. Sin embargo, no tenía tiempo para distraerse, puesto que el Festival de Valen City estaba cada vez más cerca. Wez y su manager se dirigieron al lugar del festival, donde había una gigantesca estructura de luces, pantallas y altavoces, hasta que se acercó y quedó completamente impresionado. Esta era la tarima más grande en la que ha estado y su manager dijo —Allí tocarás mañana— Wez estaba nervioso sus manos comenzaron a temblar y lo que era un sueño, también era una enorme responsabilidad. En ese momento le tocó probar el sonido, ajustar el piano y practicar cada transición de sus canciones. Cuando cayó la noche y los técnicos comenzaron a retirarse, Wez permaneció solo unos minutos sobre el escenario y en una de las pantallas creyó ver el reflejo de una figura femenina vestida de negro, intentó revisar, pero las luces del escenario se apagaron por completo y tuvo que regresar al hotel. >Wez could barely sleep, as the hours flew by and the letter remained on the table in the room; every time he saw that symbol, he felt afraid. However, he didn’t have time to let his mind wander, since the Valen City Festival was getting closer and closer. Wez and his manager headed to the festival venue, where there was a gigantic structure of lights, screens, and speakers; as he approached, he was completely blown away. # >This was the biggest stage he’d ever been on, and his manager said, “You’ll be playing there tomorrow.” Wez was nervous; his hands began to shake, and what had been a dream was now also a huge responsibility. At that moment, it was time for him to do a sound check, tune the piano, and practice each transition between his songs. When night fell and the technicians began to leave, Wez remained alone on stage for a few minutes, and on one of the screens he thought he saw the reflection of a female figure dressed in black. He tried to take a closer look, but the stage lights went out completely, and he had to return to the hotel. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmReGSUVMBSmjiYGoUEjfkLpCiGKDWh1E9vXE9m2eMnFXp/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/manos-escritorio-carta-letra-7318931/) Al día siguiente, Valen City era muy distinto, todas las calles estaban llenas de música, miles de personas caminando y disfrutando de todo ese espectáculo, Wez simplemente miraba por la ventana y quedó sin palabras, hasta que finalmente llegó el momento de dirigirse al escenario, lugar que estaba lleno de personas de distintas edades. Wez intentó concentrarse, respiró y recordó la carta —La canción fue solo el comienzo. Nos vemos en el festival— palabras que quedaron en su mente. Cuando faltaban pocos minutos para su presentación, observó al público y notó que su nombre apareció en las pantallas y cada segundo los aplausos eran más fuerte y en eso su manager le dijo —Es tu turno— Wez caminó hacia la tarima y cuando salió todos gritaron, siendo la primera vez que le pasa eso, hasta que se sentó en el piano. Coloco las manos sobre las teclas y las primeras nota resonó por todo Valen City. Donde en cada canción Wez entregó todo lo que tenía. >The next day, Valen City was a completely different place; every street was filled with music, and thousands of people were walking around, enjoying the spectacle. Wez simply looked out the window and was speechless—until it was finally time to head to the stage, which was packed with people of all ages. Wez tried to focus, took a deep breath, and remembered the letter: “The song was just the beginning. See you at the festival—words that stayed in his mind. # >With just a few minutes left before his performance, he looked out at the audience and noticed his name appearing on the screens; with every passing second, the applause grew louder, and just then his manager said, “It’s your turn.” Wez walked toward the stage, and when he stepped out, everyone screamed—the first time that had ever happened to him—until he sat down at the piano. He placed his hands on the keys, and the first notes echoed throughout Valen City. With every song, Wez gave it his all. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSX3dhXN863jB9mYWV1xoRGN2jLEMFv2AbAv8bR9Tiat/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/36318040/) Miles de personas levantaban sus brazos, algunos cantaban y otros lloraban. Hasta que llegó la última pieza y fue la misma canción que había salvado la tradición de Noctis. Nadie se esperaba eso y por unos segundos todos se quedaron en silencio, pero fue imposible resistirse y llegaron los aplausos, donde Wez sonrió. Pero justo cuando abandonó el escenario, algo llamó su atención y es que en una de las pantallas apareció aquel símbolo que estaba grabado en la piedra y en las cartas. No había nadie y Wez comprendió que aquello no había terminado, al contrario que la verdadera historia apenas estaba comenzando. >Thousands of people raised their arms; some sang, and others cried. Then came the final piece—the very same song that had saved the Noctis tradition. No one expected that, and for a few seconds everyone fell silent, but it was impossible to resist, and the applause broke out, making Wez smile. But just as he left the stage, something caught his attention: on one of the screens appeared that symbol engraved on the stone and the cards. There was no one there, and Wez realized that it wasn’t over—on the contrary, the real story was just beginning.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

On this occasion the weather is very bright and as usual my macrophotography lover friends, and I returned to hunt for small animal species objects in the small forest and at that time I immediately walked towards the small forest because it was only at the end of the village, and at that time before I left I brought a small bag containing my equipment, and when I arrived there I immediately explored this small forest and at that time I immediately passed through the bushes of wild plants that grew abundantly in this small forest.

\n\n

description.title: Photo Trip | Slovakia - A walk through the narrow streets of Bratislava's Old Town
description.body:
![COVERx1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23tvVYjMTGBenuC8q3YbFc1DzfMABnwNs29ZuLqeTw7yyh5tteh81qx1UNXSb2i95W9oZ.jpg)

A walk through the narrow streets of Bratislava’s Old Town was a pleasant surprise. I hadn’t expected there to be so few people in the center of the capital, in its tourist district. In some parts, I was able to freely take photos of the empty streets. Under such conditions, a walk with a camera is pure pleasure. Of course, there were crowds of tourists in a few places in the old town.
