description.title: Sistema de Riego con Máquinas de Pivot Central Eléctrico. Algo Interesante. Inicio/Irrigation System with Electric Center Pivot Machines. Something Interesting. Home
description.body:
Vamos a comenzar con un nuevo proyecto, en este caso, un sistema de riego utilizando Máquinas de Pivot Central Eléctrico para regar hortalizas y cultivos varios. Serán un total de 9 máquinas. Mi trabajo es así. Terminamos uno y ya tenemos un nuevo proyecto esperando, incluso, muchas veces, sin terminar lo que estamos haciendo ya nos espera un nuevo servico.

**¿Qué es una máquina de pivot?**

Básicamente, una máquina de pivot, es una técnica de riego que se basa en una tubería aérea con extensiones sobre ruedas (llamadas torres, cada una con un motorreductor que impulsa las ruedas), tiene un centro que va fijo mientras va rotando en círculo. Al hacer ese giro, mediante extensiones con microaspersores, va regando el cultivo.

 Es una técnica de riego que pertenece al grupo de riego localizado, es costosa pero altamente eficiente, incluso para aplicar fertilizantes, herbicidas y otros productos.
Estas máquinas ya se comercializan por piezas para ensamblarlas. En un proyecto, que es nuestro caso, lo que se hace es comúnmente es:

1-Seleccionar el área de ubicación, que debe ser llana y con las pendientes exigidas por el fabricante. Además el tamaño mínimo será de 13.42 hectáreas con un radio de 206 m. Mientras que la más grande será de 78.5 hectáreas y 500 m de radio.

2-Haremos el régimen de riego: importantísimo: Aquí según el cultivo que vamos a regar (ya se nos fijó para cada área), se definirá cuánta agua demandará la máquina, la velocidad con que va a rotar y el tiempo que debe demorar en dar una vuelta completa para aplicar una dosis efectiva de agua al cultivo.

3-Ubicaremos la fuente de abasto y con ello, vamos a trazar y calcular la red de tuberías y su diámetro y definiremos así las características del equipo de bombeo que necesitaremos.

4-Otros aspectos no menos importantes, estableceremos el terraplén de parqueo de la máquina y los anclajes para protegerla en casos de huracanes.

5-Realizaremos finalmente un listado de materiales necesarios para su montaje, la memoria descriptiva y el presupuesto. El presupuesto es de gran importancia, con este valor el cliente generalmente solicita los créditos bancarios para pagar la inversión, así que tenemos que ser lo más precisos posible.

En la imagen que les comparto, se aprecian ya las 9 máquinas posicionadas por tamaño, resaltadas en color azul claro(cyan). Para ello, utilizamos el AutoCad Civil 3D, trabajando sobre una base cartográfica que se me entregó para realizar mi proyecto.

Espero disfruten este trabajo al igual que yo. Hasta la próxima.

---------------------------------------------------------

​We are going to start a new project, in this case, an irrigation system using Electric Center Pivot Machines to irrigate vegetables and various crops. There will be a total of 9 machines. That's how my job is. We finish one and already have a new project waiting, even, many times, without finishing what we are doing, a new job is already waiting for us.

**What is a pivot machine?**

​Basically, a pivot machine is an irrigation technique based on an aerial pipeline with extensions on wheels (called towers, each with a gear motor that drives the wheels); it has a fixed center while it rotates in a circle. By making that turn, through extensions with micro-sprinklers, it irrigates the crop.

​It is an irrigation technique that belongs to the localized irrigation group, it is expensive but highly efficient, even for applying fertilizers, herbicides, and other products. These machines are already marketed in parts for assembly. In a project, which is our case, what is commonly done is:

​1-Select the location area, which must be flat and with the slopes required by the manufacturer. Additionally, the minimum size will be 13.42 hectares with a radius of 206 m. Meanwhile, the largest will be 78.5 hectares and a 500 m radius.

​2-We will establish the irrigation schedule: very important: Here, according to the crop we are going to irrigate (which has already been set for each area), we will define how much water the machine will demand, the speed at which it will rotate, and the time it should take to complete a full turn to apply an effective dose of water to the crop.

​3-We will locate the water supply source and, with that, we will trace and calculate the pipeline network and its diameter, thus defining the characteristics of the pumping equipment we will need.

​4-Other no less important aspects, we will establish the parking embankment for the machine and the anchors to protect it in case of hurricanes.

​5-Finally, we will create a list of materials required for its assembly, the descriptive memory, and the budget. The budget is of great importance; with this value, the client generally applies for bank loans to pay for the investment, so we have to be as precise as possible.

In the image I am sharing with you, you can already see the 9 machines positioned by size, highlighted in light blue (cyan). For this, we used AutoCAD Civil 3D, working on a cartographic base that was provided to me to carry out my project

​I hope you enjoy this work as much as I do. Until next time.

description.title: SpaceX、美股和比特币
description.body:
大家都在关心SpaceX，都在抢SpaceX！不过随着其成功上市，也算告一段落。倒是有时间来分析这三者之间的关联。**这是一个涉及金融、科技和政策的多维度话题。**

![spacex.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1781438022872-zt9p6.jpg)
（来源：新出行）


SpaceX、美股和比特币三者之间形成了复杂的**马斯克三角**关联，这种联系通过资金流动、情绪传导和宏观共振三个维度相互影响。


## 一、SpaceX对美股的影响：史上最大IPO的虹吸效应
### 1. 直接冲击：流动性虹吸与板块洗牌
SpaceX于2026年6月12日上市，募资规模高达750-862.5亿美元，创下全球IPO历史纪录。这种\

上市产生了显著的**资金虹吸效应**：

- **抽干IPO市场流动性**：其募资额相当于2025年全美IPO市场总和，导致同期其他中小型科技股IPO大概率破发
- **航天板块大清洗**：上市首日，维珍银河暴跌31.76%，Rocket Lab、Intuitive Machines等概念股普遍跌幅超10%——资金从\
小票集中转向\
SpaceX\n- **指数被动调仓冲击**：纳斯达克推出\

新规，SpaceX可能在上市后第5和第15个交易日就被纳入纳指100。届时被动基金（追踪纳指的ETF）将被迫减持苹果、微软等现有重仓股以腾出配置空间，引发技术性回调

### 2. 结构性影响：科技股权重再平衡
美国教师联合会曾致信SEC，警告SpaceX以1.75万亿美元估值快速纳入指数，将迫使180万成员的养老金\

高估值股票，危及退休安全。这揭示了当前美股高估值环境下，**指数化投资的系统性风险**。

## 二、三者的交叉影响：三角传导模型
```
        SpaceX上市
           ↓
    ① 虹吸美股流动性 → 科技股/中小盘承压
           ↓
    ② 纳入纳指100 → 被动基金调仓 → 苹果/微软等权重下降
           ↓
    ③ 马斯克情绪外溢 → 特斯拉波动 → 加密市场情绪联动
           ↓
    ④ 比特币作为\

→ 随纳指同步波动
```

### 具体场景推演：

| 场景 | SpaceX | 美股 | 比特币 |
|------|--------|------|--------|
| **SpaceX技术突破/星舰成功** | 股价上涨 | 航天板块分化（龙头涨、小票跌）；纳指情绪提振 | 马斯克光环外溢，可能跟涨 |
| **SpaceX纳入纳指100** | 被动买盘稳定 | 现有科技股权重被稀释，短期回调 | 随纳指调整而波动 |
| **美联储降息周期** | 高估值容忍度提升 | 科技股普涨 | 作为\

涨幅可能更大 |
| **地缘危机/流动性紧缩** | 估值承压 | 科技股抛售 | 暴跌（比科技股跌得更狠） |
| **马斯克政策言论（如支持加密）** | 间接影响 | 特斯拉波动 | 直接情绪驱动 |

---

## 三、2026年的关键变量

1. **SpaceX的指数纳入进度**：若按\
在第5个交易日纳入纳指100，将触发数百亿美元被动资金调仓，对美股科技板块造成结构性冲击\n\n2. **AI巨头IPO竞争**：OpenAI、Anthropic也在2026年递交IPO申请，与SpaceX形成\
竞争，进一步分流市场资金\n\n3. **比特币的定位危机**：随着与科技股相关性固化，比特币面临\
——如果它只是\

，投资者不如直接买纳指ETF，因为科技股至少产生营收和盈利


## 小结
SpaceX、美股和比特币的联系本质上是**\

**的三重共振：

- **SpaceX**作为新上市的超级资产，通过虹吸效应和指数纳入改变美股资金结构和板块格局；
- **美股科技股**作为核心风险资产，其波动通过机构化渠道直接传导至比特币；
- **比特币**则因机构化丧失独立性，沦为\
，与纳指高度同步，失去\
的避险功能。\n\n在这个框架下，**马斯克是关键的扰动因子**，他的商业成功、政策立场甚至社交媒体言论，都可能同时在三个市场引发连锁反应。对于投资者而言，这意味着需要建立**跨资产类别的联动风控意识**，而非孤立看待单一市场。

description.body:
Good Morning Lions,

Robert Kiyosaki doesn't mince words. The guy who wrote the book on getting rich — literally — is telling millions of followers that holding cash is a losing move. Bitcoin and Ethereum are the answer. And honestly, the timing's interesting because we're watching the macro setup shift in real time.

Overnight BTC broke through $64.5K on the back of the strongest ETF inflows we've seen in a month, paired with genuine geopolitical relief. The Iran-US nuclear accord is 75-85% done. This resets how capital flows when uncertainty drops. Frozen assets worth $24 billion are about to move. That kind of liquidity event doesn't happen quietly.

What gets me is the divergence. On one side, you've got institutional money trickling in through spot ETFs. On the other, regulators are tightening the screws on stablecoins — the UK just boarded a sanctioned Russian tanker and found the crew was getting paid in USDT. Same asset class, two completely different narratives playing out at once. To me that's the real market signal: crypto's too big to ignore *and* too risky to leave unregulated. We're in the messy middle, and that's where the volatility lives.

description.title: The LLM price war: how tokens became 280 times cheaper
description.body:
At the beginning of 2024, using GPT-4 Turbo cost US$ 60 per million input tokens. In June 2026, models with equivalent or superior performance cost US$ 0.14 per million (DeepSeek V4 Flash) or are completely free with self-hosting (Llama 4, DeepSeek R2). The price drop in two years is 280-fold — one of the fastest technological deflations ever observed in any software market.

How the deflation happened
--------------------------

Three forces combined to drive down prices.

The first was architectural efficiency. The Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture made it possible to train models with 400 billion to 1 trillion total parameters while activating only 5-15% of those parameters per inference. An MoE model with 400B total parameters and 17B active costs approximately the same for inference as a dense 17B model — but carries the knowledge of a much larger model. DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, and Meta adopted this architecture almost universally.

The second was Chinese competition. DeepSeek demonstrated in January 2025 that it was possible to train a frontier model for less than 6 million dollars — against estimates of 100 million or more for comparable models from OpenAI and Google. With radically lower training costs, DeepSeek prices its API at US$ 0.14/US$ 0.28 per million tokens (input/output), forcing all competitors to respond.

The third was open source. When Llama 4, DeepSeek R2, and Qwen 3.5 are made available for free with licenses that allow commercial use, the pressure on proprietary models is structural. A company that can self-host a model of comparable quality for US$ 0.0002 per 1,000 tokens has little incentive to pay US$ 0.12.

The price map in 2026
---------------------

The current market is divided into four tiers:

**Ultra-cheap (< US$ 0.50/M input):** DeepSeek V4 Flash (US$ 0.14), Gemini 3 Flash (US$ 0.50), GPT-4.1 Nano (US$ 0.10), Mistral Small (US$ 0.10). For classification tasks, simple summarization, structured extraction, and direct answers at scale.

**Mid-tier (US$ 1.00-3.00/M input):** DeepSeek V4 Pro (US$ 1.74), Grok 4.3 (US$ 1.25), Gemini 3.5 Flash (US$ 1.50), GPT-5 original (US$ 1.25), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (US$ 3.00). For medium-complexity tasks, quality content generation, document analysis.

**Premium (US$ 3.00-10.00/M input):** Gemini 3.1 Pro (US$ 2.00), Claude Opus 4.7 (US$ 5.00), GPT-5.5 (US$ 5.00). For frontier reasoning, medical/legal/scientific use cases where quality is critical.

**Ultra-premium:** GPT-5.5 Pro (US$ 30.00/M input), Claude Opus 4.8 Fast Mode (US$ 10.00). For pipelines where each generated token has high economic value.

**Open source (infrastructure cost only):** Llama 4 Scout/Maverick, DeepSeek R2, Qwen 3.5-397B, Gemma 4-31B, Mistral Large 3.

The paradox: total spending rose
--------------------------------

Despite the 280-fold drop in cost per token, companies' total spending on LLMs grew 320% in the same period. The explanation is the increase in consumption: agentic workflows make 10-20 LLM calls per user task, RAG architectures inflate the context with reference documents, and continuous monitoring systems keep models active 24 hours.

The logic is analogous to that of cheap electricity: when the marginal cost falls, consumption increases more than proportionally. The \
decreased, but the \

rose.

Intelligent routing: the companies' response
--------------------------------------------

The pattern that emerged for cost management at scale is routing by complexity. The common heuristic: 70-80% of queries go to ultra-cheap models (Flash, Nano), 15-20% to mid-tier when there is more demanding analysis or generation, and 5-10% to premium only when frontier reasoning is necessary.

Automatic routing tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, and BoltAI classify the complexity of the query before routing it, reducing production costs by 60-80% without perceptible degradation in quality for the end user.

What comes next
---------------

Market projections indicate that today's mid-tier models will cost less than US$ 0.10 per million tokens by the end of 2027. Premium frontier models should stabilize between US$ 1-3. Self-hosting via open source models will be economically competitive with APIs for any company processing more than 1 billion tokens per month.

The risk is consolidation: a sustained price war benefits those with lower marginal infrastructure costs. Google (proprietary TPUs), Amazon (Trainium), and Microsoft (Azure scale) have structural advantages over independent labs. The next phase of the price war may be decided not by model architecture, but by datacenter cost.

description.title: Sintiendo la brisa del Golfo: Un recorrido por El Monumento, Cumaná[Esp-Eng]
description.body:
![1000508152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/242Y7hDDtR6Jw48kWvWsvESAAPWBTBpf14eAnPJDUsEAvhJ8BtaTt6vqq1AbNRA5SeMdZ.jpg)






<div class=text-justify> 
<div class=\

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**
 
¡Feliz domingo, compañeros viajeros de todo el mundo! Es un placer compartirles un nuevo recorrido por la zona de El Monumento. Este monumento se encuentra en la avenida perimetral del Cacique Maraguey, a lo largo de la franja costera de Cumaná. Este espacio cuenta con áreas recreativas, aparatos de ejercicio y un hermoso mirador frente al mar. Se extiende por varios kilómetros y ofrece un paisaje precioso, senderos, bancos y un mural de letras gigantes que forman la frase \

.\n\nA lo largo del recorrido, verán postes, rocas en la playa y un sendero de muros azules distribuidos a lo largo de este paseo marítimo. Comencé mi caminata en el sector Los Mangles y continué hasta el monumento \

, que es un paseo marítimo con superficie de concreto y excelentes vistas al mar. Está rodeado de árboles, incluyendo manglares, y ofrece una hermosa vista del paisaje marino. Este lugar es popular por la mañana, por la tarde y por la noche, donde muchas familias aprovechan para hacer ejercicio y para que los niños se diviertan.

>

**<center>ENGLISH</center>**
 
Happy Sunday, fellow travelers from around the world! It's a pleasure to share a new tour of the El Monumento area. This monument is located on the Cacique Maraguey perimeter avenue along the Cumaná coastal strip. This space features recreational areas, exercise equipment, and a beautiful oceanfront viewpoint. It stretches for several kilometers and boasts beautiful scenery, walkways, benches, and a mural of giant letters spelling out \
\n\nAlong the way, you'll see posts, rocks along the beach, and a path of blue walls distributed along this walkway. I began my walk in the Los Mangles sector and continued to the \

monument, which is an aerobic promenade with a concrete surface and excellent ocean views. Surrounding it are trees, including mangroves, and a beautiful view of the seascape. This place is popular in the morning, afternoon, and evening, where many families take advantage of the opportunity to exercise and for children to have some fun and recreation. ![YAC (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqQPVwwC3zHzVhv6BbTrbhdNCYfRbfd1Laq93y19zkVBVMZNxokEZgGvpMvynstn8Mh.jpeg) ![YAC (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqUdKL5Nfp6NAbkzUhQ1HVPfB62YAmuRnjuPeiLs99Qsn1Py2nydbjJCjfFCebmm3eU.jpeg) ![YAC (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqUdvhWmnDbMEnqdwJySpLWQBmkjmtQ5waCPA99aignkEqk7Eft9Kf3mP4CZHurmcPF.jpeg) ![YAC (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqFsx1Sjf7e5wb5qfnjG6c8VfkWb19rJ6V9jFhbXMJSJooDgzPCon1NZPZ1t7gRAUzs.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

>


En el centro se encuentra un mural de letras gigantes: blancas, con un corazón rojo, y la palabra \

escrita en varios tonos de azul con un patrón ondulado. Detrás de este mural, se puede ver la playa y parte de la península de Araya. El suelo está pintado con franjas amarillas, azules, rojas y beige. También hay una pared gris con una placa que describe las características del monumento. A continuación, se ven las farolas; tienen una curiosa forma triangular y luces LED a ambos lados. La pared azul en el borde es un mirador, formado por un muro grueso y varias columnas intercaladas. También sirve como banco para quienes disfrutan contemplando el paisaje marino. Más adelante, se aprecian las paredes o bancos ubicados en la orilla de la playa, muy cerca del sendero rocoso. También se ven las pasarelas de hormigón que conducen al centro del monumento. En general, la zona recreativa se distribuye en este espacio, donde convergen el monumento de letras, las máquinas de ejercicio y un espacio para que los niños monten en bicicleta. Luego tenemos otra vista del mural de Yohana Cumaná. Los colores son visibles en el suelo. Tiene tres escalones ovalados y una hermosa vista del mar y las nubes al fondo.

>

 
In the center is a mural of giant letters: white, with a red heart, and the word \

spelled out in various shades of blue in a wave-like pattern. Behind this mural, you can see the beach and part of the Araya Peninsula. The floor is painted with stripes of yellow, blue, red, and beige. There is also a gray wall with a plaque describing the monument's features. Next, you can see the lampposts; they have a rather curious triangular shape, and on either side are LED lights. The blue wall at the edge is a lookout point, formed by a thick wall and several interspersed columns. This also serves as a bench for those who enjoy watching the seascape. Continuing, we have a view of the walls or benches located on the beach edge, very close to the rocky path. Also, the concrete walkways that lead to the center of the monument. In general, the recreational area is distributed in this space, and the monument of letters, the exercise machines, and a space for children to ride bicycles converge here. Then we have another view of the Yohana Cumaná mural. The colors are visible on the floor. It has three oval-shaped steps and a beautiful view of the sea and the clouds in the background. ![YAC (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep7v1ygybk1T4aqz2j7evsCgBgK37QPsAhVvPdwtc4647CwAbEPTWMVgDFvV5NN6PvG.jpeg) ![YAC (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EppM9gFne3qEG5eMnWYQTpbHaAMSbPDqY5gmAew6ucRVhU2TbzfNS6uRg52ryB54hPd.jpeg) ![YAC (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq9TuPzoVcmGT13D1gujCKZanur6AGcZMUKKphCNVZMqt2cVszBMJtZLy312tCuW8ZE.jpeg) ![YAC (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpxrGG1ChaYSehEuhsLogom84aRBCjWEZqkqctA1i5vUzHqGvk6y47L9MdZA9gnFEjk.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Avanzando, vemos el pedestal donde se ubicaba la placa, las coloridas franjas en el suelo y, a continuación, una vista de la playa, el paseo rocoso y, al fondo, los monumentos situados a lo largo de este tramo de la franja costera. También vemos una vista desde la zona de manglares, desde donde se aprecia la playa, el paseo y las farolas que iluminan esta parte de la ciudad. Finalmente, una vista parcial de la avenida perimetral, los complejos residenciales y las curiosas farolas situadas en el sendero. Su forma es realmente curiosa; de cerca, se asemejan a la figura de un hombre haciendo ejercicio. Siempre me he preguntado por qué tienen esa forma, aunque desconozco la respuesta. Sin embargo, estoy seguro de que constituyen un elemento atractivo en el sendero. Es muy raro ver una farola con esta forma y tres bombillas: una en la parte superior y las otras dos a cada lado. Visitar esta zona de la ciudad siempre es gratificante, ya que me permite conectar con la naturaleza y contemplar el hermoso paisaje marino. Es relajante disfrutar de la brisa fresca mientras se aprecia la inmensidad y la belleza del mar. Gracias por acompañarme en esta fascinante aventura.

> Moving forward, we see the pedestal where the plaque was located, the colorful stripes on the ground, and then a view of the beach, the rock walkway, and in the background, the monuments located along this stretch of the coastal strip. We also see a view from the mangrove area, where we can appreciate the beach, the walkway, and the lampposts that illuminate this part of the city. Finally, a partial view of the perimeter avenue, the residential complexes, and the curious lampposts located on the walking path. Their shape is indeed curious; up close, they resemble the figure of a man exercising. I've always wondered why they have that shape, although I don't know the answer. I am certain, however, that they constitute an attractive element on the walking path. It's very rare to see a lamppost with this shape and three light bulbs—one at the top and the other two on each side. Visiting this area of the city is always rewarding, as it allows me to connect with nature and contemplate the beautiful seascape. It's relaxing to enjoy the cool breeze while appreciating the immensity and beauty of the sea. Thank you for joining me on this fascinating adventure. ![YAC (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpVCcmJs2MDUk5LJb2wU1LiC8F4ppQLJ5qvzV71THVpBPy7AsvzB9FbWwdwKrfDLib1.jpeg) ![YAC (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqfGNaQp8gnn1mqZHNShr3EWpyTpe3vbwsyhTPEaqwDG53qPHWJt1jyg6tSDSVspSfF.jpeg) ![YAC (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqNF7isdCW71BgSDMXAk8XFjQR2coSy4rfFBTgfz1ffnrrDoVg6Lmv3RWkcYPmWMTAG.jpeg) ![YAC (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EqFsuB1GppQhShCc26jXgaUH2r6zQVdNHdvgQhfAHRVb6ezWALBA2fmRfhG8GD5WJwD.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.47946 lat -64.17618 long d3scr)

[Sell Xbox?]
Although this is a rumor, I wouldn't be surprised if Microsoft was seriously planning this. These people have some really strange ideas, and Xbox isn't making as much money as it used to. The new CEO's actions could be aimed at improving the situation and increasing the company's value before selling it. This would be very bad news for gamers, because competition helps everyone.
https://gamerant.com/microsoft-sell-xbox/

[Xbox Showcase]
I apologize that the news in this review will be a bit late. For this reason, I won't address the entire Nintendo and Xbox event, because it's pointless – you've already seen it. The next news roundup might suffer a bit, but then it'll be okay.

We were shown 17 new games. As for me, I'm just waiting for the DLC for Doom TDA, Senua 3, Spyro: A Realm Beyond, and Valor Mortis.
https://gamerant.com/xbox-game-pass-2026-showcase-full-list/

[Xbox Exclusives]
Matt Booty, one of the people responsible for the game's content, said that each case will be considered individually. I assume the most popular titles will be released on all possible platforms to avoid losing money. I hope this situation continues.
https://gamerant.com/xbox-console-exclusivity-explained/

[Persona 6]
We were shown the game during the event; you can add it to your wishlist. Persona 4 Revival Locks will be released in February 2027.
https://gamerant.com/persona-6-announcement/

https://gamerant.com/persona-4-revival-release-date-xbox-game-pass/

[Senua 3]
The game will be released on all consoles in 2027.
https://gamerant.com/hellblade-3-senua-trailer/

[Metro 2039]
Oh yeah, I'm still waiting for Metro xD. The game will debut in February 2027.
https://gamerant.com/metro-2039-gameplay-trailer/

[Spyro]
We were shown the next installment in the purple dragon's adventures. We got a short gameplay video recorded on PC, a CGI video, and information that the game will be released on PC, PS5, and Xbox.
https://gamerant.com/new-spyro-game-2026-leaks/

https://gamerant.com/spyro-realm-beyond-flying/

[Crash Bandicoot]
Apparently, a new installment of the iconic game is in the works.
https://gamerant.com/new-crash-bandicoot-game-2026-leak/

[Fable]
The developers were so confident and confident about GTA (just like Duke Nukem was confident about Quake 1), and now the release has been postponed. Besides, Marvel's Agent Peggy Carter will be the protagonist's adversary. 
https://gamerant.com/fable-release-date-trailer-hayley-atwell-jack-of-blades/

https://gamerant.com/fable-premium-collectors-edition-ce-content-jack-blades/

We also got a demo.
https://gamerant.com/fable-gameplay-demo/

https://gamerant.com/fable-romance-options/

[Clockwork Revolution]
The game will debut in 2027 and will be an Xbox exclusive.
https://gamerant.com/clockwork-revolution-xbox-exclusive/

[Gears of War]
Release date: October 6th of this year. The creator of the first installment criticized the sequel. The game will not be available on PS5.
https://gamerant.com/gears-of-war-e-day-release-date-gameplay-trailer/

https://gamerant.com/gears-war-e-day-comments-cliffyb/

https://gamerant.com/gears-war-games-xbox-exclusive-playstation-trick/

The Collector's Edition will cost $300.

A Gamerant editor shared his impressions of the game.

The 2023 game is getting a sequel. 
https://gamerant.com/underrated-2023-soulslike-is-officially-getting-a-sequel/

The game will be available on Game Pass on day 1.
https://gamerant.com/xbox-game-pass-day-one-games-2027-bad-magpie/

The next event will take place on June 30th.

Nintendo showed off its new controller colors.

If you own the new Donkey Kong, you'll be able to play as the Mario brothers.
https://gamerant.com/donkey-kong-bananza-super-mario-event-dlc/

We've received an announcement of the first paid DLC. We also learned about plans for further add-ons, both paid and free.

The game's release will be delayed and will not be available until 2027.

The game will be released on September 17th of this year. 
https://gamerant.com/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-special-edition-release-date/

The trilogy will be available on Nintendo Switch 2.
https://gamerant.com/xenoblade-chronicles-switch-2-games/

https://gamerant.com/xenoblade-switch-2-genesis/

[Ocarina of Time]
The teaser doesn't say much, but it doesn't need to. Nintendo can't just ruin this. Fans have been waiting for a remake of the old Zelda as long as fans of FF7. While I'm not a Nintendo fan, I'll buy the console just for this game.
https://gamerant.com/legend-zelda-ocarina-time-remake-switch-2/

Link's shield will also change. 
https://gamerant.com/zelda-ocarina-time-remake-hylian-shield-changes-botw-totk/

[Shutting Down Games]

https://gamerant.com/square-enix-games-shutting-down-kingdom-hearts-cloud-versions/

EA will shut down Grid Legends on September 11th.
https://gamerant.com/ea-game-shutting-down-grid-legends-servers/

[UbiSoft]
The French company, in turn, shut down two studios, laying off 400 employees.
https://gamerant.com/ubisoft-winnipeg-studio-shut-down/

[Blade]
Apparently, the game is still being worked on, but to be honest... I don't really believe it's true. Where does this approach come from? The film has been in development for a very long time, and it was probably Kevin Feigi's grand plan to make a film and a game at roughly the same time. Just like they did when we were kids. The film will likely go nowhere, as Marvel is saving its own ass after nearly a decade of slandering its fans.
https://gamerant.com/marvel-blade-canceled-rumor/

[Tekken 8]
Another well-known creator is leaving Tekken 8. It seems there are problems within the company... In fact, for as long as I can remember, I've associated Bandai-Namco with a rather toxic corporation. I hope Kouhei Ikada delivers equally good games.
https://gamerant.com/tekken-8-director-kouhei-ikada-bandai-namco/

[New CDPR Game]
We still don't know the big details about this project, but the company is looking for an employee to temporarily work in their Warsaw office as an Engineering Director. https://gamerant.com/new-cd-projekt-red-game-ip/

[Cronos]
Speaking of the Polish game, we'll be able to play the DLC this fall.
https://gamerant.com/cronos-lazarus-dlc-reveal-trailer/

[Paramount Games]
We've received a package of information about games produced by companies belonging to the Skydance-Paramount conglomerate. A game based on a canceled Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles product has been announced (it's an adaptation of the famous comic book. The film was supposed to be rated 18+; I posted a teaser a few months ago in my news roundup).
https://variety.com/2026/gaming/news/paramount-games-studio-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-star-trek-1236770679/

The Marvel game has been delayed until 2027. According to one of the developers, the game's build is playable but requires some polishing. Due to the small team, this is expected to last until 2027.
https://gamerant.com/marvel-1943-rise-of-hydra-release-delay-2027/

The Avatar RPG has been canceled. Not cool, I was waiting for this :(.
https://gamerant.com/avatar-last-airbender-game-rpg-canceled/

[Guild Wars]
This was one of the strongest announcements of the year. I remember when Guild Wars 1 and 2 were supposed to compete with World of Warcraft (yes, the games were different, yes, the developers sometimes said different things, but some of us remember when they were). The game will be released on PS5 and PC.

Good morning, friends.

As I’ve already told you, it’s very easy for me these days to reach emblematic places with just a few steps. This time it was Plaza Vieja’s turn. I took the opportunity to snap these selfies you see here. It had been a while since I felt this good despite all the blackouts and other inconveniences we Cubans are going through.  

I still haven’t received a reply from the job interview, and I fear maybe they never will. Anyway, I’ll wait a little longer. In the meantime, I keep giving my all at the other two jobs I have for now. This weekend it was my turn to work at the sales stand.  

Happy Sunday to everyone!

description.title: Turpentine forest greenhoods : June 13 2026
description.body:
A quiet day - spent the morning doing investing stuff on a clear blue sky day. Was a bit late going out for a walk. Went by the tennis club to socialise with the guys there. Do not often do that - feels like a safe place to be. Shoulder is a bit sore from pickle ball last week - chat and not play ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dfd550ea-0899-4c03-91d5-86ac92cde9e3.jpg) This shot caught my eye. Autumn colours, the chimney and the features along the roof crown. Warding off evil spirits ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/08c8d075-b49c-4d69-8389-d58fa62c498f.jpg) Walked to Richmond Park to check on nodding greenhood buds seen last week - one now budding - moving along this week ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b1cfb0f9-ac31-4d41-a03e-0bffc0410393.jpg) The park is one of the remaining remnant turpentine forests in Sydney. It does struggle sandwiched below the fertiliser and weed killer houses Mushroom staircase ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f9c7ac6e-9cf7-411b-95f0-d4e7e6525942.jpg) A few more spikes on the top side of the track where firet saw these a few years ago ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8d3324cc-9376-4af4-9167-83dd5d7814a4.jpg) Bud forming - will there be openers? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8c57642e-ed51-434e-aaa5-ca8e3949e143.jpg) Mushroom was a bit hidden - good detail across the ribs ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c7fe196d-625f-46f1-99fa-dfc4badda96a.jpg) Maybe the same type - not as well developed ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7a7f0a22-75f8-4f06-9877-0925dc90ae2e.jpg) Did find nodding greenhoods flowering lower down than previous times. Seeds have.come doen with the water flow. And a lot more plants. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5020dea9-fccc-447c-949c-0956e23b3641.jpg) Not the best photos in low light - obe is showing an insect caught inside the helmet and another showing pollonia - the yellow spot ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/52899c74-6184-42fe-bc9a-e0a687755a84.jpg) Purple crucifix orchids on the way home - no car in driveway - popped in for a shot ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/695ea40b-a2fe-4397-99f5-774b22ed1c53.jpg) Not often see a purple one - got one at home that needs a new home to get to flowering. Maybe tomorrow ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/16fc7c8d-9222-45bc-a5f3-138d28792cf9.jpg) Back to the theme - autumn colours and a few chimneys ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a9085e83-9473-44f1-8b53-d6d6e3c05436.jpg) Another chimney shot with a twinge of autumn ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0a0fabfa-3a84-4ff2-9c87-d14efe07bee1.jpg) Got a train replacement buses weekend. This is the trackwork at our local station. Stopped at shops on the way home Made a few bucks on horse-racing My wife cooked dinner - a Mongolian beef dinner cooked in slow cooker. Worked well. All I had to do was cook the rice

description.title: What Really Matters
description.body:
Life is too short, and I do not know why people always make it difficult. How I wish we could all learn from a dead body. The funny thing about life is that once we are dead, we will not even remember all that we did in this world, whether good or bad. Imagine that every dead body is the same. There is no rich dead body or poor dead body. Once you are dead, you will simply be referred to as a dead body, not a professor’s dead body or a president’s dead body.

None of our achievements will follow us to the grave. The only things that truly matter are the good deeds we have done and the lives we have touched positively. If we constantly reflected on this, many of us would probably shun evil. However, human beings are quick to forget. When we attend funerals and see how a dead body is buried, we often become sober, repentant, and reminded of how meaningless worldly pursuits can be. Yet, after a while, we forget and return to our normal lives, continuing in the same manner as before.

One of the issues we have in the world today is that globalization, despite its benefits, has its disadvantages. Many unwanted influences have crept into societies that were once peaceful. Religion is also one of the challenges we face. Imagine a religion that teaches that the more you kill for your god, the greater your reward in heaven. What kind of brainwashed ideology is that? It is sad that no one truly knows what happens after death. If we did, perhaps it would call many of us to a position of repentance and reflection.

Religion has caused conflicts, sometimes even more than tribalism. We really need to learn how to live in peace with our fellow human beings. Why are we killing one another for money that we cannot take with us or for positions that will one day be occupied by someone else, even someone not yet born? Why do people always say, “Do you know who I am?” as if they are God? Life will move on without us regardless of how powerful we think we are. The people who are remembered most are often those who sacrificed their lives for meaningful change and positive transformation. Since we are all going to die one day, we should be willing to speak the truth.

Another issue we have is politics. The saying that politics is dirty is often true. It is difficult to be involved in politics without getting your hands dirty, whether directly or indirectly. In our country, many leaders have questionable pasts, yet they still find their way into positions of power. Some people even seek political office to protect themselves from accountability for past actions. It is unfortunate that in a country like ours, it is difficult for someone without a political godfather to rise to leadership.

Politics is supposed to be a platform through which people choose leaders who will govern and make decisions on their behalf. However, what do we often see? Stomach infrastructure, personal interests, and the pursuit of wealth seem to matter more than service. Since we only live once, many people become willing to do anything to achieve their ambitions, whether right or wrong. Sadly, this is part of human nature.

The same thing applies to life in general. Wherever there are human beings, there will be disagreements, crises, and confusion. The truth is that no one can please everyone. Nevertheless, we should do our best to make a positive impact that people can genuinely feel.

People say Hive is decentralized, but those with the largest stakes still hold significant influence over the affairs of the blockchain. Although anyone can increase their stake through investment, what about those who accumulated thousands of coins with relatively little effort? Influence often comes from wealth, and acquiring wealth is not easy. Many things happen behind the scenes before people become wealthy. I can understand why some people are willing to do almost anything to get money. No one is entirely selfless; many people simply pursue what benefits them. I have seen this reality in many places. It is just the nature of the world we live in.

If you ask a child today what they want to become, many will simply tell you they want to make a lot of money, not necessarily solve problems or contribute to society.

We need to be human first before anything else. Being human means being responsible, doing what is right, and contributing positively to the betterment of humanity.

description.title: Brasil 1-1 Marruecos: el partidazo que no defraudó y el golazo de Vinícius que salvó a la Canarinha
description.body:
Che gente hermosa, ya arrancó el Grupo C y qué partido nos regalaron Brasil y Marruecos en el MetLife Stadium. 80.663 personas en Nueva Jersey, sol abrasador, y un duelo de potencia contra potencia que terminó en empate 1-1. Y te digo algo: Marruecos mereció más. te juro.

Mira, yo siempre digo que Brasil con la camiseta pesa, pero anoche no me gustó nada lo que vi de la Canarinha de Ancelotti. Arrancaron dormidos. Marruecos les ganó la posesión en el primer tiempo, les cortó todos los circuitos, los tuvo metidos atrás. Y cuando parecía que el partido se les iba a hacer largo, llegó el golpe...

**0-1: Saibari (21')** — Brahim Díaz filtró un pase milimétrico, Saibari la picó por encima de Alisson. Golazo. Marruecos se lo merecía, venía siendo superior. Y mirá que Casemiro e Ibañez intentaron cerrar, pero la jugada fue perfecta.

Pero cuando todos pensaban que Brasil se iba al descanso perdiendo, apareció **Vinícius Júnior**. Y no cualquier aparición. Minuto 32: recibe por izquierda, engancha para adentro y saca un latigazo cruzado al palo más lejano de Bono. IMPOSIBLE para cualquier arquero del mundo. Gol de otro planeta. 1-1 y partido nuevo.

El segundo tiempo fue de ida y vuelta. Marruecos tuvo las más claras (12 remates totales contra 6 de Brasil). Alisson salvó a su selección con dos tapadas increíbles en el descuento. Y Brasil... Brasil no encontró la fórmula para lastimar a una defensa marroquí que fue un muro.

**Datos que te dejo:**
- xG: Brasil 0.85 — Marruecos 1.22
- Remates: 6 vs 12
- Posesión: 54% vs 46% (aunque al inicio Marruecos tuvo 72%!)
- Amarillas: Casemiro, Ibañez
- Árbitro: Slavko Vinčić (Eslovenia)

**Lo que viene:**
- Brasil vs Haití — viernes en Philadelphia
- Marruecos vs Escocia — viernes en Boston

Mirá, yo como paraguayo veo a Brasil y no sé si reírme o preocuparme. Porque si la Albirroja no pudo contra USA (y ellos que juegan bien eh), este Brasil no asusta. Ancelotti tiene mucho que ajustar. Sin Neymar, el equipo no tiene creación. Vinícius es un fenómeno pero solo no puede.

Y Marruecos... confirmó que lo de Qatar 2022 no fue casualidad. Tienen equipo, tienen juego, tienen actitud. Mohamed Ouahbi armó un equipazo. Yo los veo pasando de grupo sin problemas.

**Ahora quiero saber qué opinan ustedes...**

🇧🇷 ¿Te parece que Brasil llega lejos en este Mundial o se va a quedar en el camino?
🇲🇦 ¿Marruecos puede repetir semifinales como en 2022?
🔥 ¿Vinícius hoy es el mejor jugador de Brasil sin Neymar?

Dejá tu comentario, vamos a discutir. Dale Paraguay! 🇵🇾🇵🇾🇵🇾

description.title: A stolen sunbeam [EN/PT]
description.body: \n\n<div class=\

> Mimi is my neighbor's cat and the archenemy of my dog, Margot. They do not get along very well for obvious reasons, and Mimi has the curious habit of enjoying her precious sunshine very close to where Margot also likes to soak up the morning sun. As you can see in the photos, the sunlight chooses a small patch of the backyard to shine on and, well, sometimes things get out of control. A ray of sunshine has never been so fiercely contested around here, especially during winter. Mimi, although she is not exclusively ours, is very dear to us, just like our neighbor, who is a very kind elderly lady. Mimi is her companion since she lives alone and, just as Mimi visits us regularly, we also make a point of stopping by to chat with our neighbor whenever we can. But, well, mornings have taken on a very special meaning for pets everywhere, and it is quite interesting to see how they seem to have an almost instinctive pleasure in simply staying there and enjoying that little moment. These photos were taken this week when I was coming back from the gym and, at that moment, since I had left the doors closed before going out, Margot, my dog, was still inside the house. So Mimi made the most of those last moments of sunshine before Margot showed up around there! ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFFKDohFuVtQJzV8A4dhNXbBL7WC96C73MZRaG5Pn1Aw/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdZnfHSZQ2qbBP82u6vYEEyVYpR5gUXka5EtzdKR5z2zq/image.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYwjr3HNayX5UzGbABp7R5apNYbr6441ugm8daoxTr6uj/image.png) Mimi é a gata da minha vizinha e a arqui-inimiga da minha cadela, a Margot. Elas não se dão muito bem por motivos óbvios, e Mimi tem a curiosa mania de pegar seu precioso sol bem perto de onde a Margot também gosta de aproveitar o sol pela manhã. Como é perceptível pelas fotos, o sol escolhe um pequeno pedaço do quintal para bater e, bem, às vezes as coisas saem do controle. Um raio de sol nunca foi tão disputado por aqui, principalmente no inverno. A Mimi, apesar de não ser exclusivamente nossa, é muito querida, assim como nossa vizinha, que é uma senhorinha muito gente boa. Mimi é sua companhia, já que ela mora sozinha e, assim como a Mimi nos visita periodicamente, nós também fazemos questão de sempre parar para conversar um pouco com nossa vizinha. Empatia é algo que cultivamos por aqui. Mas, bem, as manhãs têm tido um significado bem especial para os pets de todos os lugares e é bem interessante ver como eles têm um prazer quase instintivo de ficar ali apenas curtindo aquele pedaço de momento. Estas fotos foram tiradas esta semana, quando eu voltava da academia e, nesse momento, como eu deixei as portas fechadas ao sair, a Margot, minha cachorra, ainda estava em casa. Então, Mimi aproveitou bem esses últimos momentos de sol antes que a Margot chegasse por ali!

description.title: San Diego, One Ordinary Day at a Time
description.body: ![IMG_20231026_084656263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23ywmBzygdSbPBTR9ocbMQ5DodNJFjTM1Zro14ZSXTsXSFbNF6H89MLc9PMumAM6gZubc.jpg)\n\n*

>Have you ever wondered what your city looks like when nobody is trying to impress anyone? I mean the rhythm it experiences every single day. Something close to being omnipresent, able to capture different corners of an urban landscape exactly as they are. No poses, no dramatic lighting, no editing tricks. Just you, the subject, and a story built from ordinary life. I know it sounds as if I am inventing a philosophy out of thin air, but that is not the case. In fact, when I took these photographs, my only intention was to preserve another ordinary day in San Diego, my city. Nothing extraordinary was supposed to happen. I simply wanted to document what already existed before it disappeared into the routine of another forgotten day.

*\n\n*

>Every day I walk past places that are visually fascinating, and every day I ignore them. I always tell myself the same thing: one of these days I will come back and take some photos. Then life happens, and I never do. This time was different. Almost like a small epiphany, I suddenly began collecting fragments of stories through my camera. Not grand stories. Not historic moments. Just tiny pieces of daily life that normally go unnoticed. A sidewalk, a street corner, a building, a tree. Things I have seen hundreds of times without truly seeing them.

* ![6676885681_d3cdccee3e_b.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zRy2CqJ9zLq6ETaxwmorwmVmXj6nrKLk4gNCqLKzWLynzoQkswdx8bpes3GrqxeEaGZ.jpg) ![20251205_083754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23w2gc9SXoYZ9kUMCa4SvBX1162373UDQ57kmA1KXTWDos7DP6j81Aiv5ACNgUAbMHE8C.jpg) ![20251205_090157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xAM9cTLtWj4CNhuZKEs2hLc1MAvfTMu3cDHs285PQDHVQ7KeR5GToATyLK2KL8LKGNv.jpg) ![20251111_061323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wgBY9sq1TQsAs9BpRfrVzJKeMn3f2zA1UQNshi2ujUiwRj5bgsZtSQRLuJfyLUGBbeV.jpg) *

>I found abandoned cars that have been sitting in the same place for decades, somehow surviving the passing of time, weather, and neglect. Strangely enough, they look beautiful against the contrast of the streets and the surrounding landscape. I photographed the only airplane I have seen crossing the daytime sky above my neighborhood in what feels like more than a year. There were streets, dawns, and buildings carrying stories from the past, stories that remain untold while waiting for an uncertain future. None of these subjects are spectacular on their own, but together they form a portrait of a city simply existing. Sometimes that is more interesting than any monument or tourist attraction.

*\n\n*

>There is nostalgia in these photographs, of course, but there is also something else. A small tribute to the concrete, asphalt, and familiar scenery that helped shape my life. These are the streets, avenues, parks, and sidewalks I have walked since childhood. Places that witnessed my evolution long before I ever thought about documenting them. Photography has always fascinated me because, at its core, it is an act of preservation. The true subject of every photograph is the past. Whether it is a casual selfie or a Pulitzer Prize-winning image, both ultimately serve the same purpose: preserving a moment that will never exist again in exactly the same way.

* ![20250929_172202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23w2B7qvioGpkgGNtP6XqHC97ZJVt7XNHdK6rFdrMHbfviHTVgEX8AoyguEM3R1RHzfct.jpg) ![20250929_173506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xKhpLoPsjHMnENQFYnjXGWeuYVaf2XXy6wEVg8shVAgWaf3Rgb5x4aDHY7yjQiVs7xc.jpg) ![20250929_173035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EoprtGffv9wQCKjgwn831d2BWvcrpLvSGEzWjHGk4p3T9xdmTwX1sCwHSaP5T46VZ8D.jpg) ![20250903_163649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/244KP6o8tryCm3P2Km6qy8Z8XWZxy4vhCH917Ck88ndy88nbNPtKkYX52Vx7XerDRNhaP.jpg) ![20250903_164037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/242DUpCsWSQ5B3aVxA5odVL5uWXpdyLwV4hPyRWLSno5k5qDbma6kC2YcbzHiHymUtnMq.jpg) ![20250903_163543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EoyPZ5264tsR8eRYp9b1dddEPreWYuSG7tFugL5oz27QpQwycXvfY6SreBzoR8UDipC.jpg) ![IMG_20250826_142751_354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/2449N55gpRoVTbAYec5QqGG5H9TUec5RK7FhHubF9FRct4Ai9eU2SXTH6dHRqR9xqcWwD.jpg) ![IMG_20250826_142739_635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zkEQbYFHqTG4Msqf4CPThuULdK24iAc72e3pxW8bUA91eoGwyWQ5Rv5NAqXby3XxFth.jpg) *

>San Diego is my home, my neighborhood, my small corner of the world. A piece of me exists here as well, reflected in these images and in the unique perspective every person brings when deciding to press the shutter button. Capturing the rhythm of everyday life, the way a city breathes and moves through its routines, became the true purpose of this photo set. It is also, I suppose, a quiet declaration of affection for the place where I live. The funny thing is that whenever I set out to photograph my city, I often end up discovering things about myself instead. I begin exploring streets and buildings, only to find memories, emotions, and reflections I did not know were still there. All of that, simply because I stopped walking for a moment and decided to take a photograph.

* ![IMG_20250216_171007_774 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wC9nk3mbFKUdNNoQfcDboBGxXdtfz847y4dTMsGTGgnBibipmqaRcWD9a2d8Fm8FZjH.jpg) ![20250106_173201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tbkb1QyJHEgYRg587wTxNXhTF6bbzv4FUQwkzD2mpocUskZxxgyiiZSo7L3x3AcxnR7.jpg) ![20250106_172921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23vsHwnrbYZyRTs7qfkQEPf7ussfmwNpgmXwas38jQQ3YAoeRgraaCtQ4TxVKbibXxEQp.jpg) ![20250103_182719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23uFMgZAdbpC5kket33w1wuzqvAejx6STuvWwoX3cXfpzuQLpp92mFYsnf68U79dqobqB.jpg) ![20250103_181844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wgD6s4F7Y4Cgwh7ZDxvrimGow7zHzXgFRp9bK3EivYCXLitwegFfypbRAMvFKbqWop1.jpg) ![IMG_20241005_110405_918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/EogNkFJzLC3ukaWzmuq6JAwyscuhuYg5N3QK1bsKe2DsWSJiemZnbqRSJP1HFzAv1re.jpg) ***

description.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/22046829/pexels-photo-22046829.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/22046829/pexels-photo-22046829.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

## El otro día venía pensando justamente en esto. A veces la vida te lleva a lugares donde no esperabas estar y de repente un versículo cobra sentido de una manera que no habías visto antes.

> Así que no temas, porque yo estoy contigo; no te angusties, porque yo soy tu Dios. Te fortaleceré y te ayudaré; te sostendré con mi diestra victoriosa.

Isaías 41:10

##### A veces nos preocupamos tanto por el futuro que nos olvidamos de vivir el presente. Y Dios está en el presente, no en el futuro que todavía no existe ni en el pasado que ya pasó. El es un Dios del ahora.

##### Dios trabaja en lo invisible. Mientras nosotros medimos resultados, números, progreso visible, El está haciendo cosas en el silencio que después se van a ver. Pero hay que confiar en ese proceso que no vemos.

##### No sé cómo terminar esto sin sonar a frase hecha. Pero la verdad es que la vida con Dios es eso: una búsqueda constante, un caminar que no termina, un aprendizaje que dura toda la vida. Y eso está bueno.

> Así que, el que piensa estar firme, mire que no caiga.

1 Corintios 10:12

##### No hace falta tener todas las respuestas. Alcanza con dar un paso a la vez, sabiendo que El va delante. El resto se va a ir aclarando en el camino.

*****
*******

*Eso es todo por hoy. Espero que esto te sirva tanto como me sirvió a mí al escribirlo. Que tengas buena semana.*

description.title: Living simply with family and eating simple Thai food.
description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeE6TNHePMjF5wjABD7bVr67ziQeYrNsCZ9hCB5JtzZ6C/1781431011828.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. My wife and I didn't go anywhere again this Sunday. We're enjoying a peaceful time at home, looking after our granddaughter and my autistic son. Taking care of my autistic son has left me with back and leg aches for days. Because of this, I've been mostly indoors, except for a quick walk in the garden. In this rainy season saves me from having to take care of my home garden too much. And I'm planning to apply organic fertilizer to the vegetables and fruits in the next 1-2 days. Today, so I have no other activities except taking care of my autistic son. And my wife is busy with housework and cooking. But I'm more focused on our meal today than on her housework. We keep our breakfast simple as always, we have fresh cow's milk and bread. For other meals, my wife cooks stir-fried minced chicken with holy basil and a fried egg over rice for our lunch and dinner. Of course we have holy basil, bird's eye chilli and yardlong beans in our home garden, so she picked them fresh from the home garden. But we bought the carrots and onions from the fresh market.

The atmosphere of picking vegetables in the home garden.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYN43pn7mzXrLDvxiEU3A1F9oPWXm2Tot1UxD1HJyAQk/1781431011873.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd88Jq65coaYpKMdi6bMuA82JrnHdY2R5oGnHusMmG5Mu/1781431012084.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVDpbssDqaCM254JQthnudxzqnLCy5WYC8Xs5BRsFrguD/1781431012173.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZY7SVPYjxRzC44wGfeuqYiXG3L68SAxP9ohoHgWEktzQ/1781431011969.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeBaCgY6EoLjPag63DLERCXY4kG8nP1b3DrRFXcteFHeZ/1781431170428.jpg)

For this Thai food is quick and easy to cook because of the ready-made sauce for this dish, And using this ready-made sauce guarantees a consistent and delicious taste every time. There are many brands of ready-made sauces. For those who like spicy food, you can add chili peppers. Cooking time, come see my wife stir-fry minced chicken with holy basil. description.body: <div class=\

> Hello, dear friends at @MoviesTvShows Greetings and blessings. Today I’m here to tell you about a story in which friendship and love play a major role—especially when the two clash and force you to ask which one should prevail, even if that means sadness and misunderstandings. A wise decision and courage can change everything. The show is Imposible Wedding. --- ![Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-041.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EppNzuKN3FnceUCszQ8ieZbjDPZo8BBVmydyQuN9s7PMJeftqJgkXVWF9fQkznimaZs.webp) [Source](https://drama.fandom.com/es/wiki/Wedding_Impossible?file=Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-04.jpg) ---

>Lee Do Han (Kim Do-wan) is a man whose sexual orientation has caused him problems since high school—until Na Ah-jung (Jeon Jong-seo), a woman who becomes his best friend and defends him against anyone, even going so far as to pretend to be his girlfriend, changes his life and helps him feel more confident in himself, at least until he finishes his studies. But as adults, things become more complicated, since Do Han is the heir to a prestigious company; however, in order to take the reins, he must marry according to his grandfather’s wishes. Although Do Han doesn’t care, his brother Lee Ji-han (Moon Sang-min) has fought for this so that his brother can have the authority he needs. --- ![Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-012.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wXNbnxZVWgRF7EFxbhGYJKYoXPEacegsf6m36p4R98wGP9eDRaMskjHoE4SnTi8iS7B.webp) [Source](https://drama.fandom.com/es/wiki/Wedding_Impossible?file=Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-01.jpg) ---

> But it’s difficult because they won’t let her be who she really is, so the only way out she sees is to marry her best friend—just as when they were young and she pretended to be her girlfriend, now she needs them to get married and at least stay married for a while until she can resolve her issues with her family and they’ll let her be free. For Na Ah Jung, that’s no problem, because her life hasn’t really been all that great. She’s an actress but has only had small roles; she isn’t getting very far in her career, and besides, she doesn’t have a boyfriend or anything like that. At first, it seems like a good idea since she’d not only be helping her best friend, but he also offered to pay her, so there’s no problem with it. --- ![Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-053.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoyTpmQ5ebu7gWzS9fQGjnAPPxTG8pjWMEqoHi89VdyX929WhR1zZLr9kaDTNG5wGfo.webp) [Source](https://drama.fandom.com/es/wiki/Wedding_Impossible?file=Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-05.jpg) ---

> Until Na An Jung gets caught up in the arguments with her future brother-in-law, Ji Han, she falls in love with him just as he has fallen in love with her, which complicates the situation. It’s understood that she would only marry him in a contract marriage—a charade with her best friend to support him and keep his sexual orientation a secret. For her grandfather, it was imperative that no one find out, as it would damage his company’s reputation. Although Ji Han doesn’t care about that, he doesn’t want his brother to keep running away and stop being who he really is. This is made more complicated because Do Han is afraid; he prefers to run away and hide who he really is, even if that means hurting his own friend and brother. But will he change his mind? P.S. It will be a decision that only he can make, and it will change the course of his destiny in this love-friendship triangle that has emerged. --- ![Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-064.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/Eqb28HDCckfsRDUK6T4jJzNxsauTnorq6SqwTugPJw5Zryb844SKzv3iuUnFErNQse7.webp) [Source](https://drama.fandom.com/es/wiki/Wedding_Impossible?file=Wedding_Impossible-tvN-2024-06.jpg) ---

# ***Hey food lover friends!***

*Welcome to my video blog. I hope you are all doing well. I am trying to spend quality time enjoying delicious and tasty food. Warm good afternoon greetings from Bangladesh. Afternoon is a great time to enjoy the taste of good food. After a busy day, a delicious meal brings satisfaction and comfort to the mind. Likewise, we are naturally drawn to attractive and appetizing foods. We often feel that our favorite dishes become even more appealing the more we enjoy them.*
![1000052937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumaiya777/23yTr11mY1jUjf1BAH6m7kDT4N3vXwtSsw8tpMi69bFCPYzGXBKn7iyrHHvGTQxpLWavw.jpg)

I spend most of my time at educational institutions. Therefore, whenever I get the chance, I try to cook good food for my family. Even after a busy day, I often feel very tired, but I am the one in my family who takes care of everyone's needs and well-being*

![1000052923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sumaiya777/23wMaCLacvyixpYPfY86m15vJgSRme23hmEz7jgFGvqxgAPRshDohQn6aXAHivAE7v8J7.jpg)

*I always try to serve delicious and nutritious food to my family. Today, I made caramel pudding for them. Pudding is a wonderful dessert that combines several nutritious ingredients together. Since the weather is extremely hot these days, our bodies lose fluids and nutrients through sweating. Also, eating too many boiled eggs during very hot weather may cause discomfort for some people. ## DEDICATION

BBH INCEPTION - 25TH NOV 2020
BBH RELEASE PRICE TODAY: 0.01299 HIVE

## SUNDAY MORNING - NOT A LOT TO REPORT.

Thinking about this sickness i have, I bet it was Covid. The biggest symptom was the amount of rest/sleep I been needing for almost a week now. I think I went to bed around 8pm last night. And I slept untill 6:30am when Chase wanted or needed to go out side. Then I managed to get a little more rest till 8AM when he wanted to go out again.

 We are now at Received:  36,882 HP up FROM 36,880 HP in delegation from yesterday. Whoop Whoop. Keep it coming people. Lets aim for 200K :)

614 awesome fracking sauce days as a witness we managed to get into 61st place. What a battle this is. What a battle this is. Up to 459 supporters. 459 supporters, did you read that. That is Awesome Fracking Sauce. Nothing wrong with that But I want more, I want to keep growing fast, moving up the charts fast. Business mindset people.. Now the hard part begins. Getting the word out to more people.

I know we will keep moving up the charts. ***The higher we are, the more Hive income there is, and the higher Drip Day payouts will get. Remember that. That is what is important. ***

This morning we are in 61st at 9,168,038 in support. Yesterday we were at 9,163,786  HP in support. To get into 60th place we need another in 405,827  support . Yesterday we needed 410.210  in support. We need a lot of little or some big support to come in. Tell the world.


## WHITE PAPER FOR THE BBH PROJECT

Here it is, the updated [THE BBH PROJECT WHITE PAPER.](https://peakd.com/bbh/@bbhstrategy/bbhstrategy-the-bbh-project-updated-white-paper)

## CURATION TRAIL

No new members to the [Curation Trail](https://peakd.com/hive-155221/@bradleyarrow/joining-a-curation-trail-updated) over in the last 24 hours. But I did spend time last evening updating things as I been slack with the trail.


The new goal of 800 members by the end of 2026.

What is the point of a curation trail and why should I join?

Any post that I up vote, everyone that is upto 451 possible upvotes.

When you join the trail you can set your trail vote to what ever you want. Even if you set the up vote to 0.01. Imagine if we had 1,000 people in the trail that would be 10.00 to the post. Fantastic stuff. A little difference can end up making a giant difference to a Hiver.

That being said, we do have 451 members, I know not all are active, some have passed, but the majority of use are still here.

Imagine if we could get 100 people doing just 1 blog post about the curation trail. Do you think the membership would go up quickly?

Give it a shot, the more, the better for everyone.

And if you are following the trail please support our witness. @thebbhproject. 

## DRIP DAY 

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.
If you own 1,000 or more BBH tokens you get a drip of swap.hive and TOOFUCKEH.
If you own 5,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive and the PIMP token, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER and CTP Tokens.
If you own 10,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive, PIMP, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER, CTP, and LEO tokens.

If you stake 20,000 or more BBHO tokens you get a drip of swap.btc, and ALIVE tokens
If you stake 5,000 or more BBHO tokens you got a drip of ALIVE tokens.

All just for owning BBH. There are two ways you can get BBH. First you can buy them from the open market. I use TribalDex myself.

Or they can be tipped to you. The great part about BBH tipping is that when you tip a token to someone else you do not loose any of your own. There is a central pool that supplies them.

And a third way to get BBH would be people gift them to you. There was an update to the tipping bot. If you now tip 1 BBH you get 1 BBH also. How facking awesome is that.

And now a forth way to get BBH with the BBH Miner.
 

## BBH RELEASE PRICE

I now set the release price of BBH to the markets daily. It is an open market so sometimes you can pick up deals when others are selling cheaper than my set price. The goal is to have 1 BBH = 1 Satoshi. I do a bit of math and get the price. If Bitcoin is stronger than Hive then the price of one BBH goes up and if Hive is strong than Bitcoin then the price goes down.

## BBH AND BBHO TOKEN DIFFERENCE
It seems some people are still confused. So I am putting this section into my daily post.

BBH token was my first token. It is a tipping bot and a passive income token. You only need to hold it, hold 10 or more to get a drip on drip day(below).

BBHO token is the native token of The BBH Project Tribe. The same as LEO is the native token of InLeo.

description.title: A lovely walk...
description.body:
...and Mother nature once again played a trick on us.
![068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/244Up5KB4dzY7qwb24p7cTcTYYmZYCr8nqnJPdn4vyiUkbF73HvjhWZ7nHiLFGYHoZQJm.jpg)

There was no wind when we left our place, and as soon as we arrived here suddenly a breeze started to come alive. I thought it would be a golden opportunity to get some reflections on the dam, but the breeze had a different idea, nevertheless I could still get some beautiful landscape shots. The Vergelegen Wine Estate is a historical wine farm, but since the olden days the farm was expanded into offering many alternative activities. 

They have a superb five-star rating for taking care of nature and wildlife and they offer an ideal venue to visit when you arrive in South Africa. Great restaurants, great food, great wines, and a range of adventures exist on the farm. It is also a photographer's paradise, and that's why we often visit the farm as it is also crammed with birdlife. So, to all the tourists out there, make sure to put a visit to this iconic farm on your bucket list.  

Now let's look at the pictures and imagine that you are walking with us. 
![069.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/244UtJd5GpbHAozakHYhUyprEXXCLyBUJzEtzH8ZMRws2XK75HqP3uBPJAw86CEPZHpfn.JPG)

A lovely wooden walkway was erected across the dam, and it offers some magical views as you will see below. 
![065.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23vYctQCnpnSvKMqKjnNHYLJLhLRh76rcVVGAXHSWmBvzFuSLHZEKbFTyK2UJsUmoUJtS.JPG)

![066.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243WMjhy8asrTqNrhb9Nf5RkEvFZ7frMrrKD3ny3yMwBCvKeJHyYWkSUzTb1Cw2VxxrC7.JPG)

Let's have a look at the mountains as there were some weird clouds hanging about. 
![056.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/241Er7a7RpYnVHUKs1GxQ6MhT4WkeYEcvqEGtXntn8NJAWB6zt4heRovKy6NQszoBCMUV.JPG)

![057.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqqtR96F7eEeasUxneVeyUejoAvD97BRXxhMs2PLbxyPqs5gFA5X65huEtEHtzy1KqX.JPG)

![063.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23qrDwkwz9DyrGET4zxfXBHFamDcHQzsPNgvtUSCFQamBscdyhuECKftGxNVqnbS3MiDA.JPG)

Did I tell you that there were some weird clouds present?
![092.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EnYPXygwYS4MKmaEXemHZpDn6bagmVLLtUEP5ZWTmG12Weypu8mgr9Qxh1qCrhvy54e.JPG)

Suddenly, a stream of clouds flowed in on the picture below. 
![044.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EptazbSy9DRcMfTYE2xoCw5nMZmNH72VeD3XUHAiHZG44VVUi6JnX2peTgmXTXZvoQq.JPG)

Just an easy Sunday read as the views were astounding and it is such a pleasure to take a walk here. They also have a museum on the farm that is stocked with historical photos and there are many other selective areas such as a prizewinning rose garden and a camellia forest that also has won many awards, as it is one of the few in the world. For those that are hungry, there are two excellent restaurants on the farm with great food and of course great wines to accompany the meals. 

Security is tight on the farm, and so it is a safe place for visitors. Most of the farms in the area were started 100 or more years ago, and they all have long histories. There are apple farms, citrus farms, and many other productive farms all over the place. One can even be taken on a tour of the winelands that stops at many other farms that offer wine and olive tasting experiences. So, there you have it and we hope to see some of the tourists visiting the farms. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

Hola amigos de Hive, hoy les quiero compartir una presentación muy especial titulada Entre Barranca y Barranca, una hermosa pieza del folklor compuesta por Ángel Jiménez. En esta oportunidad, tengo el honor de interpretar este tema en el tono de Do mayor, contando con el magistral acompañamiento de fondo del maestro Ramón Páez en el arpa, cuya ejecución impecable le aporta una magia única y resalta la esencia de nuestras tradiciones. Con esta participación me uno formalmente al Festival de Música Tradicional VDC en su semana número 46, un espacio maravilloso que se ha convertido en una ventana fundamental para enaltecer la identidad de nuestra tierra y conectar a tantos creadores que mantenemos viva la pasión por nuestras raíces musicales. Para mí es una verdadera alegría poder sumarme a esta iniciativa y regalarles un pedacito de mi arte, el cual preparo siempre con muchísimo cariño y dedicación para toda esta hermosa comunidad que día a día nos apoya y nos impulsa a seguir adelante con cada proyecto musical. Como siempre, no quiero despedirme sin antes expresarles mi más profundo agradecimiento por tomarse el valioso tiempo de escucharme, valorar mi trabajo y dejar sus hermosos comentarios que tanto me motivan a mejorar y a seguir trayendo contenido a esta plataforma. Espero que este bonito tema sea de su total agrado y que disfruten de esta interpretación llanera tanto como yo disfruté preparándola y grabándola para todos ustedes. Les envío un abrazo enorme, cargado de las mejores energías, bendiciones y mucho éxito en sus respectivas publicaciones. Hasta la próxima oportunidad, se despide con el cariño de siempre su gran amiga @Yoxibeth🎵🔥

description.title: 大吉大利，今晚吃鸡
description.body:
昨天刚带娃吃完李先生牛肉面大王，今天娃和我说想吃开封菜(KFC)啦。哎，这KFC从小吃到大，吃遍全国，怎么还没腻歪呢？

![20260614_123100.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXyJFdBXRpJzqspuqsDaHSkwXzeiNfN9fJs9CJmxZX1DL/20260614_123100.jpg)

说起来，我曾经也是一个开封菜的忠实粉丝，曾和朋友夸下海口，就算是天天吃开封菜，吃上半年我也不带腻歪的。

现在回想起来，那时候真是幼稚，天天吃，大概吃两三天就会腻歪得不得了吧？倒是现在每个月粘儿子的光，吃上一两次，还算刚刚好吧。

怎么说呢，就和那些各种面条一样，天天吃觉得腻歪，偶尔吃一次，还觉得挺好吃的，要是好久没吃的话，还觉得挺想念的，哈哈哈，真是没辙了。

既然儿子想吃，就带他去吃好了，但是媳妇一直视开封菜为垃圾食品，不屑一顾，宁愿在家吃剩饭剩菜也不肯去吃（回想一下，几乎每次吃开封菜都是我和儿子去，哈哈）。

既然她不去，我和儿子就溜达去开封菜好了，这样可以锻炼身体、晒太阳（预防近视），又可以省油钱和停车费，何乐而不为呢？

愈发觉得自己真是一个省钱小能手，是一个超级大聪明，哈哈哈。


我们常走的小路，非常喜欢这条路，四时风景都很美。
![20260614_120613.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZSXm1mFwmBTdF1KcVDD7C1Y51XLp6FBQXAvpMj16oiD/20260614_120613.jpg)

好多年前，这条路曾是早市，乱糟糟的，现在干干净净，清清爽爽。
![20260614_120720.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbkzLDkoyHiUSQQ8g6vb51Pvcja4u7vN8A8FWWvYUsR8Q/20260614_120720.jpg)

很喜欢路对面的几个小别墅，有钱真好呀
![20260614_120924.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGGDpR7LW7vZ33ngqp3oTnhR7Ub7oNJ3zLmi6FjhZ8wZ/20260614_120924.jpg)

到了二环桥下，等红绿灯
![20260614_121121.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT4szB3EnAHW5XfdypR283CAGyP8n8X4XYVo5D8LQHHcx/20260614_121121.jpg)

路边的小花园，往年打理得都很好，今年差了点意思哦
![20260614_121239.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf9Npv7bahtnU55PLCijedGDojK4Sd7SgAoRmoXBfnVMd/20260614_121239.jpg)

不过相比走在马路旁吸油烟，走在林间小路还是很舒服的
![20260614_121431.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbiijgobFvxz56zax9wFYZKLP3xnkMR8KxZJD2xhr5VsK/20260614_121431.jpg)

有些居民在围栏外边种植上好看的花朵，如百合、玉簪等，懒得凑近去拍啦
![20260614_121544.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyM34D2jq1qrbqfQkpG8X6skRG9n9EUGYEBubFdZjcmj/20260614_121544.jpg)

穿过这片松树林，就是开封菜啦
![20260614_121738.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQUA4wdoK7MSSxUtqepXmFPsSZqyQgbnATo2T1uTnuo4/20260614_121738.jpg)

点了好大好大一堆，汉堡、薯条、鸡块、红豆派、可乐都有，猜猜我们能吃光不？
![20260614_122929.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmePtELCKzhJ2SXBH23Rwc6pPDnZ5jMdUZqynEDDgxhn9j/20260614_122929.jpg)

儿子的大汉堡🍔
![20260614_123100.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXyJFdBXRpJzqspuqsDaHSkwXzeiNfN9fJs9CJmxZX1DL/20260614_123100.jpg)

可乐在网上被人叫做肥宅快乐水，明知道不健康，可是就是喜欢啊
![20260614_123105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVej5kZfXWXkRU6yf3hEMPMkWGaPDBQsksnXJNE8QszEM/20260614_123105.jpg)

剩了好几个汉堡，哈哈，留着给儿子做早餐
![20260614_124552.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRckWL4kjhyDcYNi1RTY81Yafri3zSHgXZPh3HevNsTB/20260614_124552.jpg)

吃饱喝足，回家喽，园区里的梨树，硕果累累呀。
![20260614_130818.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVgi5zBTnAdfMhjv3DA5JK2tDfZgQxp9P3eqkc7u719e4/20260614_130818.jpg)

哦，对了，明明是中午出去吃得开封菜，为啥标题叫大吉大利今晚吃鸡呢？

话说手机APP点餐时，我突然注意到有一个香焗纸包鸡，一看就是很美味的样子，想点一份又怕自己吃不动。

于是等我们吃完午餐，我又下单了一份香焗纸包鸡，打包拿回家，等晚餐一家三口一起分享。没错，大吉大利，今晚吃鸡哦！

description.title: SpaceX Just IPO'd at a $2 Trillion Valuation — Should You Chase It?
description.body: alt=\

/>

SpaceX debuted on the Nasdaq on June 12 to extraordinary demand. Against a $75 billion fundraising target, orders reached $250 billion. The stock priced at $135, opened at $150, and closed at $161.11 — a 19% first-day gain — pushing the market cap to $2.1 trillion. By any measure, one of the most anticipated listings in market history.  
The numbers behind the company are harder to square with the valuation. SpaceX posted a $4.9 billion loss in 2025 and burned another $4.3 billion in Q1 2026. Of its three business lines — rocket launches, Starlink satellite services, and AI — only Starlink is currently profitable, with 10.3 million subscribers and roughly 10,000 satellites in orbit. The stock trades at around 100x revenues, a multiple that makes even Google and Meta's IPO valuations look modest by comparison.  
Analyst targets range dramatically: New Street Research sees $165, implying upside from the offer price. Morningstar puts fair value at $63 — a 53% discount to IPO.  
The historical data on IPOs adds another layer of caution. Research by economist Jay Ritter shows that US IPOs have underperformed the market by an average of 21% in the three years following listing. First-day gains tend to benefit those who got in at the offer price, not buyers in the open market.  
**What We Think**  
SpaceX's long-term potential is real — but the opening frenzy is exactly when patience tends to pay. Most analysts recommend waiting at least six months to see how cash burn, capital needs, and execution develop before taking a position.

Proper rest, balanced eating, and physical care are ways believers can responsibly steward the life God has given them.\nhttps://youtu.be/s6AVBwmtmkU?si=6dliG1BTrBEGERDj\nBiblical health also includes spiritual and emotional well-being. description.title: An Unexpected Puppy in Our Home
description.body:
Last May 27, something unexpected happened in our home. We did not really plan to have another pet, especially a puppy. Living in an area where floods are common, having an indoor dog was never part of our plans. We already have many things to think about every day, so adding another responsibility was not expected.

![1647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23yd1vQeThteHMHSKmrRhATFYDdbdU4rW4RfPYnfLbr8pBjRvyPqrvZe4ydF96SBg7AbD.jpg)

When my husband told my daughter to get the dog, she misunderstood what he said. She thought it was going to be a *cooked dog dish.* 😅 When she looked and saw a small puppy instead, she became very excited. I still remember how happy she was that day.

<div class=\
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23uQjyE7WmTctsANuZUBAEJgKgEKWpAgeZge4nbLz97vb5ELrG8FGxMqoLBmewKkvTWBU.jpg\n\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wWnHcUV8o1u5cUo6P4xLaWgCwLzG3VJuUsv5f5w1D3r7of4rjZzWAgEsdmP76gWxnbc.jpg\n\n
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23tGZw56omWnb79u3RE78MtmFeDLE958gjQStertHMGdTv33Evj2Gd81tj1qFmwfPPn95.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23u5tnqxCoetcL4PdXReo6sC6KsEY8BRceiDxa46W4hTgDsmfGpAgxEv5bCfGZESoGzPY.jpg The first thing she did was give him a bath. After that she carefully dried him and carried him around like a baby. Everyone in the house wanted to hold him. We were all smiling because he was so small and cute.
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23u5bfrbcc86CDwvgWPNPWPQsvNPkhE4ovxNhvZkbnq1xK7JZgmwdGJR9vZv6sQ5tK3p4.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23xyTNdF3eHyzYvxdcV2Cgci4Xm9Z3SvKQtYuJywYpuiqxLBD6VWJUv3CHv9aHccCTVDq.jpg ##### We decided to name him Max. At first it was *Bruno* while my husband wants to call him *Tanggol! Means to protect or protection.* So in the end his name was **Max Tanggol** we'll just used it as a surname.
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23xp4iFLBeEUqGkSbTMwXpcYCUowGRMxdHG2tNNYuUSK7r5RtWs55o8CY7DGojcHMxSK7.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wgHuV7eRHAZV7UeoSgk4FqsF5Q9PpC9hSWHrP7AKXyaRCwWzku13XvCM8en9zoAgxXr.jpg ![1658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23w2ieFzLL2pVdDghczV9CriGjYvEjZPqZk2SzrkUXHvv1u49uVvFsKhuHrpMZ89GPK4G.jpg) From the very first day, Max quickly became part of our family. We hugged him, played with him, and took many pictures. One of our photos together even became my profile picture because I was so happy to have him. Others kept saying that he looked like a Golden Retriever, although we are not really sure about his breed.
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wX5gxm1qU1segnB4gC6KLgK5ZUKauZCu9yDHDvG21o3FbhFu1SgmDxcCJn5LAvQEaUP.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wMaSkTbTWEU6qKTNker1QgYo5wEfEgfk3MoyNXRyD47SaLGWrp4ZegnHyvPaRFZq9ec.jpg Since he was still very young, I wanted to make sure he had good food. I usually prepare his meals by shredding fish or meat into very small pieces. Sometimes I also mix a little crushed vegetables with his food. Preparing food for him takes extra time, but I do not really mind.
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23uQpUzvcB7EBjTDosVjJBJYg63MoLes7j4L5fD5QUtaxmbuo4bA9ufg7pTkCGFgisEkJ.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23u5xWuWarmok2D7wjMJuxv7tLmndoLHfWa7kN6YiSYikW1S5h7S1caAT3en9rq2BMXhA.jpg To be honest, having an indoor puppy is not always easy. There are times when I have to clean after him again and again. Anyone who has raised a puppy will probably understand what I mean. Sometimes I laugh because I feel like I have another baby in the house.
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23x159quRtAKVxMphKtN2z922iziL7NWzPBq5SoSsKA83hcyfwqZ2QmpoPuyG86AcL1uP.jpg\n\n

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23wqkacZin55sEirqrwGebo1EtRJJZHFHZ398RJ3jf6BSRd1fHfnFPK5e5bkbaxrCvK4d.jpg Even with all the extra work, Max brought something very special to our family. He brought laughter, excitement, and happiness that we did not expect. The house feels more alive because of him. Every day there is something funny or cute that he does. We never planned to have a puppy, but sometimes the best things come when we are not expecting them. Max may have arrived unexpectedly, but he already became an important part of our family. *To be continued...* *Thank you for reading my post* *@usagigallardo015*
