description.title: Garden Update
description.body:
### Are you ready for a garden update? Well here it comes. 

![20260606_192328~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23tmHaNZLXWnhBtAXxjnR29nwHAptnwtJzwde4FmVA13FdHYu713wzuGxTk8mb5D4Xjcq.jpg)

The hostas in the backyard are now out in full force. Every year we plant more hostas in the burm back there and its really starting to fill out nicely. We typically get free hostas and a few other types of perennials from various family members and split them in their gardens and bring them home to plant in the fall. We often buy a few each year as well. 

![20260601_200753~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eo6LKhw8P5HAQdkURon1pyRGGa4ZRbFGfht4XH76fqob5arzE94fbYhehAVKtiZN8D8.jpg)

There is quite the variety of hosta back there now, with probably at least 10 or more different versions of them. They are all different sizes and colors, but there's not a lot of rhyme or reason to the way that we planted them. Now that its filling up back there I think we need more variety of plants and some more colorful flowers to make it more interesting to look at.

![20260601_200718~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoGxybH5KqpDNskxaRNXsKHCom7zv6A1YYBoETdVs662dizwba5pHY4GdnuRobuTkTv.jpg)

There are a few other plants other than hostas but not many. 

![20260601_200740~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoiVfH3LowP3JXFF8FH7A78s1KvwqFTWjbysvs7twPiYDf2JuLEeoQc34ZSdKfaf8TM.jpg)

We have one pink bleeding heart that was planted by the previous owners. 

![20260601_200728~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoGxWQKEGoJ3JSG65V1LkEQXrnFp1GFbWM1cnH2esZ2TFPp6ABMhRkg6SgCmUbMqud1.jpg)

I like it when its in bloom but the flowers don't last very long. Maybe a week or two if we are lucky. 

![20260601_200653~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoGxRbjWe4PuZoukJWtnw9d76syxPGtguiGQ5uQW6qBvuzLaLkiLkapgaoHypzdjrAU.jpg)

Similarly we have a hot pink peony shrub that was also planted by the previous owner.

![20260601_200708~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eos1kKwH2HSLzPSXJCUxYiSsiEcnXRC3jK5Kwa3fxdVKvnMNeHmdPW65fHokHXZAgAu.jpg)

Our back yard is almost full shade with all of the trees blocking the sun and peonies like full sun, so it doesn't do well back there at all. 

![20260606_192342~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EokdXDuWkbRSLjcz7BUCaNy61BRGf1wNRAJWZGvN6KacC4VB9Yuzcpt5zkpckpQy882.jpg)

It literally flowers for 3 days and then dies. I don't think that it gets enough sun to sustain it really. 

![20260606_192311~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wWtoT5vXuNMip9mdjdaPCVoyeiSVBwGWgYNC2emRu3oP6WHLKk9kmtFR5Lwo26WSzEk.jpg)

My wife bought a new white peony year year and planted it in a spot that gets a lot more sun. I'm curious if it will do better there.  

![20260601_200643~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoEqZRDLCEYniqJhisg56L7TNYUxY4vvqExr2EEHtwHU4LabcXuGN69y87t7cTgK57v.jpg)

My wife loves allium and we have a few of those that she bought from the Netherlands, along with some tulips a while back. They bloomed for a while also but are done now. 

We have a few other perennial plants that spread back there, like Solomons Seal but they don't stand out enough to take a good photo of them. 

![20260607_160806~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/Eos1GovA7LrVX9VdtHAfM7RYSm6zgtmHEyDMgQfL6xMJmrQgbR7FDrkQtoKB217xbhd.jpg)

As for our front deck we have our geraniums that we try an propagate each year. We always lose a few over the winter, but a lot of them survived this year. They aren't very full so we will see how they do over the summer. To be honest I don't know if saving them is actually worth it. 

![20260607_160724~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoiWF2Nx6Xm5nza5t3rrZNTfZPBhGjCYS114Ue9b6RBcMvLPitkoJvHgxHhXtiuMcSG.jpg)

I think that we only do it because the previous owner was good at it and had some of these plants for like 10 years or more. Its hard to just let them die after he kept them alove for so long. They have been getting more and more scraggley for us each year though so it does seem that we are slowly killing them off. I guess we will keep the tradition alive until they are all gone? 

![20260607_160746~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/EoK5tR8Tkvk1X5KNWJLNsdH9LjDvFP9J4ft4aq9d3G7JBnKpQpTnuZtDaeKx4LKDXuM.jpg)

We also buy ferns each year from a family member who knows a place that sells these massive suckers for super cheap. They are probably 2-3x larger then most that we see around. They provide a good amount of privacy for us from our neighbors. \

Thats a saying, right?  

#### Well thats it for my garden update. Thanks for reading.

description.body:
![1000492057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wqnNGW3ovRMDvELRDoRTgD76xPgqoHJr67eR9wvvU9M9RZjEzd98uJMt8x1hx8gjV2T.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

> Desde niño siempre fui bastante tímido, al punto de no gustarme ni que las personas me fijaran mucho la vista, y aunque ya eso es tema superado, aun cuando hago fotos en la calle, evito llamar mucho la atención; pasar desapercibido es mi mayor estrategia.

> Ever since I was a child, I’ve always been quite shy—to the point where I didn’t even like it when people looked at me too much. And although I’ve gotten past that now, even when I take photos on the street, I still try to avoid drawing too much attention to myself; going unnoticed is my main strategy. ![1000492058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000492058.jpg)

> En La Habana, bien temprano en la mañana, que es la hora que me gusta salir, la gente suele estar en sus asuntos y no se fija tanto en el fotógrafo, pero a medida que el día avanza, ahí comienza la curiosidad hacia el chico con la cámara.

> In Havana, early in the morning—which is when I like to go out—people are usually minding their own business and don’t pay much attention to the photographer, but as the day goes on, that’s when curiosity about the guy with the camera starts to kick in. ![1000492060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000492060.jpg)
> Recuerdo una señora que hace poco me decía, o más bien me interrogaba, por qué y para quién hacía esas fotos; nada, que lo quería saber todo la señora.

> I remember a woman who recently asked me—or rather, grilled me—about why and for whom I was taking those photos; she just wanted to know everything. ![1000492059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000492059.jpg)

• • •
![1000492056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wC5QiDuKD1x2PL84Psp8FRnJEzYi855xMvq5CVgz7Ky5kqufuWYHkM4XF33i3wN2fjc.jpg)
> Y así voy explorando todos los rincones de la ciudad, o una parte de ella, porque hay otros lugares a los que solo no me atrevería a ir nunca.

> And so I go exploring every corner of the city—or at least part of it—because there are other places I’d never dare to go alone. ![1000492061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000492061.jpg)
> Se me ocurre una pregunta: ¿cuál es tu estrategia cuando fotografías en la calle? ¿Prefieres hacerte notar o pasar desapercibido como yo?

> A question comes to mind: What’s your strategy when you’re shooting on the street? Do you prefer to stand out or go unnoticed like me?

description.body: <div class=\
> <div class=\

> ![1000653506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKrH4G5C1rSW9sg7Cr7rEKSwquQfrqnXJ9H2Zw347t75iaVEAkz5oTthcAqQ1RMdhKW.jpg) *** *** *** Hi my friends, lovers of fresh drinks all over the world, today I will make a very refreshing drink, especially since this drink is often served as takjil during the month of Ramadan, this drink is famous for being sweet, savory and creamy. But this time I made my version without the sweet one because I don't like drinks that are too sweet.Because lately I've been reducing sugar. So, if you want to reduce sugar or reduce sweet things, you can try making my version. ![1000653507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EorzocjNy4KQwxjeHmcq8uGQYPwhqRU6WRk6podh8VfQCmGvA24biaqSit6TTgioE9Y.jpg) First of all, what is needed is fresh avocados. It just so happens that there are lots of avocados at home. My husband brought home avocados from the cold city of Takengon. Takengon is famous for having lots of avocados there. So, instead of leaving the avocado in the fridge, I tried to process it into my own version of a drink. ![1000653509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EokdeKWCYgx93gXqEXQYoZjh4yrCnEiUaN4iXWUfQgtr9QcPSGcs4etuduZxHUMyiQD.jpg) without adding sugar or sweetened condensed milk I only use Bear band milk or what is usually called healthy pure milk which is known to be very healthy for our bodies, Apart from bear milk, I also added jelly without sugar. Previously I had cooked jelly without sugar,and don't forget I also added that this cheese is famous for having lots of fiber in it and can make us full for longer |![1000653516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiX8nnKbbQcya3udXxu2YceqYAuBnsCpJohmXZVRSt3VxK6GNEkAVCJkb9CBtX1gXr.jpg)|![1000653515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK7MMGofAVf5FSFjfFrNEU6VRFPpLRUNk5Z6GDBfcfTbHH6bGXSMNZEsnybdJ1ikBB.jpg) |-|-| The ingredients in it are very healthy and fresh in my opinion, so if you are curious about the recipe for a healthy version of the drink, in my opinion, just follow the recipe that I will share below. *** ###
materials used
### *** ![1000653489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ywnkEtrNsyee8oDEReUvNQj7pAowp6BZBmfFTnwm25fAXWPAVyBg9YpH7CTBpFnbk7m.jpg) ***
**one ripe avocado, one bear's milk, 1 tablespoon of cheaset, enough jelly**
*** ###
manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First I took the chiased seeds then I added water and waited until the chiased seeds expanded |![1000653490.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopssbSufma67XX23C6GQLHWE5bUE2rJsnLRrc5LGwC1bHpfzFxuDJxpudWUdeTNhJs.jpg)|![1000653491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowHZuL9qsa6hV6Azpe192grC6C3pS6kgYUR3qztQ3RT9giCQKLdNqQyAAA3frMzvap.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Next, I opened the avocado, then I took the avocado flesh, then I put it in the blender. I also put in the bear milk. |![1000653493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xL31EshtL6dwMxgCtxgjf5oM4N24G2UwzUs7sFE6KnK2Amnqd8CBwAkYw3uePUh2uVt.jpg)|![1000653494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xVVQ3Vhv2kaVF1QMyyM5EM7qwMg8BUxqSie396ShQQKfabte9QTBWRKU3kR8csqPD3e.jpg) |-|-| |![1000653495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMiipnZU9XAaWtuMaAwFwMmKV8RNhbWjCmwEiabkFUscUuPebjw9GY57Auc5pGJr746.jpg)|![1000653496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK6H6nKBFKDRFgS6AQBffV7Hyecx6nZHHDo6ReMjbGAso69eMq6YZW3V8onQpoRxKc.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next, I blended the avocado so it wasn't too crushed. After that, I put it in a larger glass and added ice cubes and jelly. |![1000653497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoAbFCcqgQ5g1Q8dhkxLtQ3X6JgSRBvhRycphq2GscpbNEM2jfgwQduFJ2oiC5j6idc.jpg)|![1000653498.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqeDQRq4DLuwTN3nB8QF2JwLfnepyHPiP9J73jqDsH5aKQXNF9zoDxVW3HvXU5s2ESs.jpg) |-|-| |![1000653499.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yJC1F1rMsKWaLFXsGse13rnZLRPrrh1CGqW2SaBAQQbt1AgYffnohqs855JmLueYVkV.jpg)|![1000653500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK6G7nH3xViobFo391sMdMx8k5NtdSke2XrHMfjq4Q8Fv7vGZSWgt5arowsmvHYAgf.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Four**
*** Finally, I added the chia seeds when the Ceased had fully expanded. |![1000653501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep3epg4N7YgqwYpyhzdLnhzYSYDjXponU5vSEA9efbmRT2hEG9csZSBGYguViH4KeJP.jpg)|![1000653502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyNUbxuQvB1Qxu56kLQc7CCBpEZqHzKuqycNB149nT85t53S3pMbDe7Bd3rf28Hp9w.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000653508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopsvnSuV21NqVbxT5QgLqopTDbwCtGUPk1RRL9g28sdqSmbkbBoo1nXSQWJkYcj1uG.jpg) This is the result of my refreshing drink, it's ready, with this low calorie version it can be drunk by anyone who is on a diet program, because as you can see, all the ingredients are healthy, I didn't add any sweetener. |![1000653518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopsWCz2u6A1NTwsoXvokRGKLbJWD449dqF8sJRRmYdGLenn8Z74mEPfGaxP2dA2zT4.jpg)|![1000653514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep5ncEnLZtmBVSyorF8QSps6z91HwCvFtoxCu3AA7iorKQWyBfcwZVwAkJs7TqZnma2.jpg)|![1000653517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonnWG4MRCFGxMB9EqVnTxwGn1KDmAtTjv8rA9KFQKzk6fPsoCNVaqnCzkjkMiATqNZ.jpg) |-|-|-| The drink tastes very fresh and creamy from the bear's milk. While not too sweet, it's enough to keep me feeling refreshed and full for longer. So, if you are on a diet, this Chia Seed avocado ice is very suitable for those of you who are reducing calories in your body. ![1000653519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou98XcZNVLeQRoWLLjeQohV6BRqFnN2RFkF7q14jQFcnNrGHJPZGxK4em8xjq9kgji.jpg) ![1000653504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKrHQTJsmLto669a7YAPgTTjNXreC86bvsXZtSnYMYZXsfc3YbVD2dG6mhJheZL444v.jpg) *** *** *** ###

description.title: Co kryje się „pod maską” iGamingu?
description.body:
Branża rozrywki cyfrowej przeszła w ciągu ostatniej dekady transformację, która całkowicie zmieniła sposób, w jaki postrzegamy interakcję z platformami online. To, co niegdyś sprowadzało się do prostych skryptów o niskiej rozdzielczości, dziś stanowi potężny ekosystem technologiczny, w którym matematyka wyższa spotyka się z najbardziej zaawansowaną inżynierią oprogramowania. Współczesny iGaming to segment, który nie tylko dostarcza emocji, ale przede wszystkim wyznacza standardy w dziedzinie cyberbezpieczeństwa oraz przejrzystości finansowej dla całego internetu.  
Dla świadomego użytkownika w 2026 roku kluczowym wyzwaniem stała się umiejętność odróżnienia platform premium od tych, które nie spełniają rygorystycznych standardów rynkowych. Wybór odpowiedniego miejsca do rozrywki przestał być kwestią przypadku, a stał się procesem wymagającym merytorycznej weryfikacji. W zalewie ofert marketingowych, rzetelna informacja i twarde dane techniczne stały się najsilniejszą kartą w ręku gracza. Aby mądrze nawigować po tym dynamicznym rynku, niezbędne jest korzystanie z profesjonalnych baz wiedzy. Na stronie [www.top-casino-online.pl](https://top-casino-online.pl) można znaleźć szczegółowe audyty techniczne i zestawienia, które pozwalają na chłodno ocenić parametry takie jak uczciwość algorytmów RNG czy realną wypłacalność operatorów. Taka edukacja rynkowa jest dziś fundamentem bezpiecznej zabawy w cyfrowym świecie.  
**Fundamenty Zaufania: RNG i certyfikacja**  
Sercem każdej legalnej platformy rozrywkowej jest system RNG (Random Number Generator). Jest to skomplikowany algorytm kryptograficzny, który gwarantuje, że wynik każdego spinu czy rozdania karty jest całkowicie niezależny i niemożliwy do zmanipulowania. Renomowane firmy nie proszą użytkownika o wiarę na słowo – zamiast tego poddają swoje systemy regularnym audytom przeprowadzanym przez niezależne laboratoria, takie jak eCOGRA czy iTech Labs.  
Przejrzystość w publikowaniu wyników tych testów jest dziś najprostszym certyfikatem wiarygodności marki. Świadomy gracz patrzy nie na banery, ale na certyfikaty w stopce strony.  
**Matematyka jako gwarancja uczciwości (RTP)**  
Równie ważnym parametrem technicznym jest wskaźnik RTP (Return to Player). Informuje on o teoretycznym zwrocie środków dla społeczności graczy w długim terminie. W 2026 roku standardem dla platform klasy premium są tytuły oferujące RTP na poziomie 96-98%. Zrozumienie tego wskaźnika, w połączeniu z analizą zmienności (volatility), pozwala na lepsze zarządzanie budżetem i dopasowanie dynamiki gry do własnych preferencji, co jest kluczowe dla zachowania kontroli i czerpania autentycznej satysfakcji.  
**Rewolucja Fintech: Szybkość i bezpieczeństwo płatności**  
Szybkość operacyjna operatora – od depozytu BLIK-iem po wypłatę na konto – jest dziś traktowana jako ostateczny dowód na jego stabilność finansową. W dobie płatności natychmiastowych nikt nie chce już czekać trzech dni roboczych na zaksięgowanie swoich środków. Integracja z nowoczesnymi systemami fintech oraz wykorzystanie technologii blockchain pozwala na procesowanie transakcji w czasie rzeczywistym. Jeśli platforma potrafi wypłacić wygraną w mniej niż 15 minut, wysyła jasny sygnał: „posiadamy wysoką płynność i gramy uczciwie”.  
**Odpowiedzialna Gra w dobie AI  
**Największym przełomem ostatnich lat jest wdrożenie Sztucznej Inteligencji (AI) w systemy ochrony gracza. Nowoczesne algorytmy monitorują wzorce zachowań w czasie rzeczywistym, potrafiąc wykryć anomalie mogące świadczyć o utracie kontroli nad grą. Proaktywne sugestie przerw czy automatyczne limity to standardy, które sprawiają, że iGaming staje się bezpieczniejszym i bardziej etycznym sektorem rozrywki.  
**Podsumowanie**  
Wybór sprawdzonej, licencjonowanej platformy to inwestycja w święty spokój. iGaming w 2026 roku to triumf technologii, designu i przejrzystości. Korzystając z merytorycznych recenzji, sprawdzając parametry techniczne i kierując się zasadami odpowiedzialnej gry, możemy cieszyć się rozrywką na najwyższym światowym poziomie. Pamiętajmy: w cyfrowym świecie wiedza to najsilniejszy „buff” w każdej rozgrywce.

description.title: Mutton dumpukt or slow cooked steamed mutton
description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmajtjzjxT9bGiqJmWuoMGR6R648wy9KURGD6HBQb984wv/1781433089107.jpg)
Hello hi everyone how are you greetings to all of you and welcome to my another recipe blog . I hope you guys all are well and enjoying Sunday with delicious food . As usual today I am also here for a new recipe also for creative-sunday in @hivelearners . Mutton is my favourite meat so today Sunday so I thought to cook it in special and different style . I cooked **Mutton dumpukt or you can called slow cooked steamed mutton** . Hope you will like . So let's start the process .

**Ingredients**

One kg mutton with bone

Onions 

Two garlic bulb

Two small pieces of ginger 

Three tomato 

Green chillies as your taste 

**Spices**

Oil

Black pepper 

Salt 

Two glass water 

Turmeric 

Cumin seeds 

**Process**

First I took out mutton from the fridge then washed under water . It's already cleaned and washed well then I stored in the fridge . I took clay pot for more taste . Slow cooked mutton cooked very delicious in the clay pot .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRUFfV3rCB12uBX5NX71WHUiAUzN8njvvKmHoDqiSNvja/1781433730040.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZs7Px9oxTngoZCCm7hLb3DQxmgwqgrz5gdQDfs6Cdb6/1781433769919.jpg)
Now I started to layers mutton ingredients and spices in the clay pot . I put first mutton pieces then onions and garlic . At second layer I again put mutton pieces tomato and green chillies .


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcD7AM7JJ8qM1Mi159aE6k7WQMTi3ki66p74xdorRb9Jt/1781433868572.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzx6Jf8CNuWjeTMW1ZYG6B9BfjUbFdSBPYJPRoax9pEJ/1781433882236.jpg)

At the last step I spread oil half cup salt black pepper red chilli and turmeric . Then added two glass water covered with lid of po . I covered lid with flour so steam could not come out .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYG8CNQYh938fg22SBsx6xBDHgBSwGCQYQ7dvpAJHFV8W/1781434023575.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQZFortKnDuX5Dta1jjYFd3tDgQ2xgPBsDHZ9df7JsYG/1781434037379.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFR5coqsBoNqPetABCQSi56VjcsGjQTxMzkKsjqmaLw1/1781434069170.jpg)
 I put on slow flame one and half hour . Mutton cooked in the steam very well . So I opened it after required time . And mutton dumpukt is ready for serving . I mashed tomato and took out ginger garlic pieces .


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLxiU2Rggf5NtWGcedAHKwSXvaGbnuVZPXWiydxcs2Rv/1781434167210.jpg)

**Final look**


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU7ZmFa8v6GgxEwW3aXAuUhyJuaN6GJz3WYjCSGLuFGs7/1781434186797.jpg)

We enjoyed it with naan 🫓 . Don't forget also giving me feedback and good reviews on my recipe . It's also very healthy and tasty recipe that I  cooked and many times . See you soon . Bye bye .

description.title: З 12 червня в країнах ЄС почав діяти Пакт про міграцію та притулок.
description.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRNX5RrSMAPKgbVuukeKtFgp5gbp3rBye7G8nb6F1fxp2/image)

Особи, які нелегально перетнули кордон ЄС або подали заяву на притулок, проходитимуть єдину перевірку: встановлення особи, перевірку безпеки, стану здоров’я та вразливості.

Для частини заявників запроваджується прискорений розгляд на кордоні, зокрема для громадян країн, які ЄС вважає безпечними, або заяв із низькими шансами на схвалення.

Оновлена система Eurodac збиратиме більше біометричних даних для підтвердження особи та виявлення повторних заяв у різних країнах.

Країни, які зазнають найбільшого міграційного навантаження, отримуватимуть підтримку від інших держав ЄС — через переселення шукачів притулку, фінансову чи практичну допомогу.

Для українців суттєвих змін немає: механізм тимчасового захисту залишається чинним і не скасовується новим пактом.

[INFA UA](https://t.me/INFA_U_A)

description.title: THE LOST JOURNAL
description.body:
Hello everyone you're welcome to my blog today.

 It was on a rainy day when Sam I've lost the door to his small bookshop for the very last time in over 20 years this shop had sat quietly at the owner of sapele Street squeeze in between a hospital and a tailor shop it was never one of the biggest business places in town but it was he is every shelf every book. 
He puts the keys right inside his pocket and looks through the glass for the very last time goodbye old friend he whispered. 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma1fif11vH7DvfzdmwjLFDeVqQ6J21WPDgjYEbB5cUmZ2/61764.png 


Majority of the books had already been packed and moved out the shelves to almost empty the world looks strange the bear and lonely without the colorful posters and the hand recommendations written on them. 

Has returned to live something by the corner caught his eye it was a leather envelope a notebook rested on top of the window psalm from she was certain he hadn't been there earlier so he went to unlock the door and steps back in the lord cared for there was no name on it so some open it carefully expecting to find an address or a phone number or any sort of identity on it but instead he found just a single sentence written on the first page of the book.

If you ever find this do not throw it away sounds stepped back a bit and blinks that was very unusual he sleeps to the next page the handwriting was not neat and steady but it read my name is Annabelle if you are reading this then I probably forgot this book somewhere some smiled Annabelle. 

The next few pages contained random thoughts observations sketches drawings of trees coffee cups crochet dresses strangers at the park the beautiful tree in the park.

On the 5th page he found a particular entry in the abuse today are made a guy named Daniel he laughed at my terrible jokes I hope to see him again and I will continue page after page she told his story of Daniel. 


She told a story about their first date their favorite things to do their first coffee together long walks by the river moving lights small arguments big dreams without realizing it some sat down and started within everything about Annabelle outside the rain became heavier the notebook felt like a diary was like a conversation that had happened in someone's life then all of the sudden the tone changed Annabelle became sick the doctor have been running a lot of tests some smelled a lot of entries came the truth letter appeared unable was done with cancer she kept on battling with it and writing it down in every word . Hoping it would feel less real the more she writes. 

The order pages included the hospital visit the fear in her eyes the hope the setback moments of encouragement from family moments of despair yes all through it Annabelle kept writing not about the illness alone but about Daniel how he still laughed at her jokes how he assisted on feeding the birds and the park how he made every friend with the nurses he met as her hospital bed how he somehow comforted everybody around her. 


At some point the hand looks very shaky she's wrote today Daniel told me something he said people don't disappear completely every act of kindness they do lives a Max somewhere the next entry was just three words I would miss him 

Un slowly he closed the notebook for a moment the bookstore felt very quiet the way that softly against the windows and the roof he checks the back cover of the book for any contact but there was nothing there just one final notes at the end. 


It's red if this not to book ever gets to you I'd love to have it back but it it can't find its way back to me maybe it's can remind me that someone needs to hold on to the people they love. 


Farm began to think about his own life reflecting over the book you just went through the bookstore had consumed a lot of his time he lost touch with old friends he couldn't keep up with friendships and relationship there was always one shipment or another one beautiful customer to attend to somehow the years just went by the notebook felt behavior than usual to his hands the next morning .Some placed a handwritten sign on the bookstore window he wrote a leather book found ask inside.

He hopes that someone whom you about the book will come for it he would be handing over the building to the new owner but he showed hopes that the owner of the note would come before then the first and second day passed without any success on the third day the last day for sam be at the office.
A lady walks in grants in the rain the earth are you Annabelle she faded yes and asked of all the gift required about the memories about cancer. 


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbmz39DNAUbFPD3ktuAE2wY1Ks1G7kdiMpC3LdKpVmz5b/61765.png 



When is the time for Annabelle to leave she stood up and sleeps the book into her jacket then she thinks some he said thank you for what to say thank you for leaving it behind I thought I lost it totally then she worked out into the night.

Not every lost item is truly lost sometimes we leave something behind for the person who needs them most to find them and learn from them. 


Thank you for stopping by my blog

description.body:
# Sublime and Beautiful Sunday a few of the flowers in Haskell Gardens This post is for #SublimeSunday, which is inspired by @c0ff33a and #BeautifulSunday is initiated by @ace108. Good Morning, I hope your weekend is going well. Today, I will share a few shots from a visit to Haskell Gardens here in New Bedford, MA. These were taken on the recent photo walk with a group called the Fall River New Bedford Artists collaborative, and I both had fun and got plenty of cool shots, including these, which I will share today But first, a little bit about the gardens The late Allen C. Haskell, a lifelong New Bedford resident and famed horticulturist, assembled these six acres—the site of a traditional New England-style common, beautiful historic gardens, and one of the oldest homes in the city—over more than 30 years. Today, it’s a public park and an unlikely botanical respite, blooming in the heart of New Bedford. Its is now managed by a group called the Trustees who manage a few parks and sights in the area. Since its a post for both Sublime and beautiful Sunday, I thought some lovely flowers would fit well Now I am no expert of flowers but I do believe this lovely flower is a Rhododendron, but I could well be wrong, feel free to correct me if that's the case
![flowers haskell (4 of 4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48Pw28K56kcyVwFGy7exJ9z4YXyeBtGHSK3EvP4HdrvnqbW2UA9ycHvxxPj9GWqK9r.jpg) **Sony A7iv 53mm F8 1/80 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48Pw28K56kcyVwFGy7exJ9z4YXyeBtGHSK3EvP4HdrvnqbW2UA9ycHvxxPj9GWqK9r.jpg)**

I do remember when I looked them up, this next one is an Allium, but to me I always think of them as sturburst or fiework flowers, and it's probably my favorite flower that I saw that day
![flowers haskell (3 of 4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23u5zbLtupLakZndMKAWuHMeuNqVq8J76Wc65P1QiKQa83nhkQAkTC8G3KGChvNEAYha3.jpg) **Sony A7iv 60mm F5.6 1/320 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23u5zbLtupLakZndMKAWuHMeuNqVq8J76Wc65P1QiKQa83nhkQAkTC8G3KGChvNEAYha3.jpg)**

Now this next one, I had to look up it is a Clematis lanuginosa, and it blooms twice once in Spring and again in summer
![flowers haskell (2 of 4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/EogLt2ms2zoicmcSgAoaKyUx1ieDB3gRTZHmbQoCaKgBRhx6WrHW7BBRuLYdDqyL9u6.jpg) **Sony A7iv 45mm F5.6 1/320 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/EogLt2ms2zoicmcSgAoaKyUx1ieDB3gRTZHmbQoCaKgBRhx6WrHW7BBRuLYdDqyL9u6.jpg)**

description.body:

‎Jerusalem was initially a place meant for the presence of God to dwell in. Back before Jesus descended to the earth people built temples for God to dwell in them. Jerusalem was considered as a dwelling place for His presence, a house where prayers would ascend sincerely to Him. It was supposed to be a sacred place of worship and communion with God.
‎
‎Yet over time, the heart of worship was replaced with selfish interests and desires. What God designed as a house of prayer was turned into a place of corruption. This made Him to declare in Matthew 21:13, “My house shall be called a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of thieves.\

body.title: Go 10K HP !?!
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tv4ZphDsA9k7rA2UYkAn6kUt4SGuiSZE5GKqSyDKcQouQPTQAousnzu2urvCovy5xdK.png)


### 🚀 Progress Log — HP Goals & GLYPH Project

Greetings dear readers,

Even if, realistically, not many people actually read my posts, it doesn’t really matter. What matters is moving forward, staying consistent, and continuing to build step by step, no matter the visibility.

Today, I’m continuing my journey with a small personal win: I managed to add **250 HP** to my Hive Power. It might not seem like much at first, but every step counts in this progression.

My current goal is clear: reaching **10,000 HP**.  
That’s my first big milestone — a solid foundation for what comes next.

I now have **343 HP left** to reach it.  
So yeah… saying “only 343 left” sounds close… but at my current pace, it’s still going to take some time, patience, and consistency.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23t7572xgGDhfJ6nZtUAmx67qDmyhRLJwGCxCyktUXGdyPifgpzFY3yoq4heUgmFUGBjo.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tv6DJ7KMdHUb9r9jh3pvho5Z7caQmXFLHmqTDTL2sLZbnaLgy8UvzNWJ4G5eS6dh98T.png)

---

### 🔁 GLYPH Goal & Automation

At the same time, I’m continuing to recover my **GLYPH tokens**, as I mentioned yesterday.  
The goal is simple: relaunch a project around this token, but this time with a more refined and structured approach.

The long-term objective is for everything to be **fully managed by my curation bot**, once it becomes stable and autonomous enough to run on its own.

Thanks to everyone who supported this small project by holding GLYPH 🙏  
Even if things evolve, your support is still an important foundation.

Current stats:

- **Total supply:** 660.69030015  
- **My holdings:** 422.02345977  

My next target is to reach at least **600 GLYPH** in my personal wallet.  
That’s when I’ll launch a bigger, more serious, and more sustainable project.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23t7FAnvMAEMKiGjLotcyucthx9XgpmUMcuFJjsGn25SjQcfXPMtQG4VLDcBLn2xF8AkS.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tGZdqbsAocPsixrxnovfqeqFsyJR3YZZZNjW8P5thA73iPhpJfvyLSYaYVNhCsKusmb.png)

---

### 📊 Other Goals & Strategy

At the same time, my other goals are progressing as well, and they will help fund part of my future **GLYPH accumulation** as well as my **Hive Power growth**.

Good news:  
👉 The account **@benef.bbho** has finally reached the **20K BBHO** I was aiming for. Goal achieved ✅

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tRvShp423p554pbFcaZMbaEqU87LFp2PXLJACGhyAeFt3MHeBXBoK1mknxv4x2Tsjms.png)

---

The account **@benef.alive** is also getting close to its goal, with nearly **60K ALIVE and HEARTBEAT**.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/48FiCpwk7jtAyzeDZJ1Wzi5Nr1CAGRto56ef1QUYXvaLMYKU1iP8BhS42AuYP7PSjA.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23swkNjMDYRVjnJaJ9NfijYoh3L7xDJ2GapMThkwBLbRajwkZ5KniedyYFRm53njvFnca.png)

---

### 🎯 Refocus & Vision

For now, I’ve decided to focus mainly on these two accounts.

I’m going to gradually stop the others, empty them, and simplify everything.  
I tested a lot of things, sometimes all over the place, and I clearly spread myself too thin.

The result:
- Some accounts aren’t progressing  
- They don’t generate anything  
- And most importantly, they take time and energy  

But it’s not wasted time.  
It helped me learn a lot about automation, test ideas, and understand what works… and what doesn’t.

Now it’s time for a more efficient approach:

👉 Focus on **3 or 4 tokens maximum**  
👉 Optimize their use  
👉 And eventually create **real value for the GLYPH token**

---

The journey is still long, but much clearer now .

Let’s keep moving forward 🚀

---

With all that said , I wish you an excellent day and a great end to your weekend. If you get the chance, make sure to rest well before heading into your work week or whatever you have planned . Anyway , have a great day .

description.title: Breakfast at Row Authentic Indian Cuisine
description.body:
The place where I grew up is called Ipoh, it's a small city at the northern part of peninsular Malaysia, belongs to the state of Perak. There's a lot of story goes with the name itself, let alone the history of how Chinese, Indians and the Malays come together. I'm just going to skip ahead a few chapter and tell you I grew up in the heavily Indian influenced environment.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWn9jpDuVHeLb5T2ucZaisiRNg6WD9hb5VydTVGjPqnu/1781396468575.jpg)

Row is the name of the restaurant. If you're going to search for the restaurant in Google Maps, you're gonna have to search for \

. Pardon the restaurant review of 3.8 ⭐ and below are my honest review:

1. Restaurant environment ⭐ 
2. Staff attentiveness ⭐ ⭐ 
3. Food quality ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ 
4. Price ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ 
5. Accessibility ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ 

Let's do the math, 17 o 25 is 3.4 ⭐ wait 😂😂😂 my review gives even lesser stars. Statistically I think it makes total sense.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5UuigUjvY3XRNgEQo5wmm2pdDmNNYpj6DMFzq825bSS/1781396468660.jpg)

I knew this place for donkey years. This was one of those place that my dad usually took me for a quick bite when my mom look other ways. My dad has his fair bit of heart condition, so he's actually has a strict curfew on his diet, whatever he's trying to eat, my mom will make a comment about anything and everything 🤣

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSHaEyQEyeRVAwfentgmucDPaBT9xLgaZ4HwyJ5hD8EE/1781396468739.jpg)

Home minister got herself a plate of fried flat rice noodle. In Ipoh the Cantonese town, we call it Hor Fun, other than that the rest of the south east Asia call this flat noodle Kueh Teow. Technically, we referring to he same noodle, it's just different accent. One of the hardest part to fry a perfect flat noodle is, since it's flat, it can easily stick. To unstick it, the trick is to add oil in between. Now we know adding oil would make food way more slimmy and tasted one kind. Any good Hor Fun chef know, cranking up the stove to the max, high heat stir fry the Hor Fun so we don't need too much oil to unstick it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsTQLZHEc6ChcqWqbvmB4UoZtNi12rsMkSxKcJYexe1j/1781396468818.jpg)

I've got myself a set of Puri (or Poree depending on which part of India pronounce it). The flour they mixed is a little different than the one we had in Kuala Lumpur. It's plain, but it doesn't taste like nothing. It's brings the rice fragrant to life. Couple with the Dhal (pea puree) brothe, this dish totally brings me back to 40 years ago. It felt just like yesterday when my dad was still here bringing me to this place for chapati and curry chicken.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd6D6xJQ8MrC6CobDWvzuwPc88pBVRBGQVjV7C1fW9QV6/1781396468887.jpg)

Both of us ordered a Teh Tarik (pulled milk tea, one way to froth the tea with bubbles so it tasted more creamy and less hot) to complete our old time old taste Indian breakfast. The bill was rather epic, I haven't been hearing anything less than 10 for many years now, let alone breakfast for two. We settled the breakfast for 8.70(probably less than $2).

---

Some of the bad feedback relate to the environment. The place is clean, but you don't expect air conditioning for $2 breakfast for 2. The staff are actually foreigner. So, gotta be patient. Not every Tamil, Dixon, and Harianto are Malaysian born Indian. They are doing their best to serve me and serve you, don't need to give them the nasty stare down. The lady boss is preparing your roti cenai patiently, one piece by one piece, may be that's how they maintain high standard food. If you're in a hurry, come early next time. Many of the Google review mentioned they always told customer there's a 30 minutes wait, that's called manage expectation 🤣 we got our food by 20 minutes, I think I should call them miracle workers!

description.body: This morning my friend called me and said, \
. I said, \

He came to me at about 1 PM and we went together. We talked in the car and I found out that we were going to Myay Pon Monastery. Halfway through, we bought some Lychee fruit from a roadside fruit stand. 

![IMG_20260613_150035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/EqYu9YgsYEUWpirLmoaxdxuXTsNuQWHviRai4MeRwqs3VroWKB3ABHebt2Q9CQHSKNL.jpg)

It was my first time to visit Myay Pon Monastery. We drove for about 45 minutes to reach Myay Pon Monastery. Myay Pon Monastery is located in a remote and peaceful village. I saw some very big trees inside the monastery and wondered how old they were. How many years did it take for them to grow to be so big? My friend came to pray at this Monastery. My friend believes that praying at the shrine in Myay Pon Monastery will fulfill your prayers. So I prayed for my mother's health.

body.title: Sopas: A Warm Comfort Food Perfect for the Rainy Season
body.body:
***Rainy days often bring a cool breeze, the sound of falling rain on rooftops, and a natural craving for something warm, creamy, and comforting. In many Filipino households, one of the most loved dishes during this season is Sopas. This creamy chicken macaroni soup is not only filling and delicious but also brings a sense of comfort and nostalgia. It is often associated with family bonding, quiet afternoons at home, and the simple joy of eating something warm while listening to the rain.***

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/48RPtASC9yt8LXZDHPfpNMZmGfAZkx9GNyBHu9jQ8staxK66Vg76ZfZuCsi3yLinnU.jpg)

***Sopas is a versatile dish that can be prepared in many ways, but its basic version includes simple ingredients that are easy to find in the kitchen. Despite its simplicity, it delivers a rich and satisfying flavor that makes it a rainy-season favorite.
Ingredients***

	To prepare a comforting pot of Sopas, you will need the following ingredients:
Cooking oil
Onion (chopped)
Garlic (minced)
Pepper (ground or crushed)
Chicken (chopped into small pieces)
Shells or pasta (commonly elbow macaroni or shell pasta)
Evaporated milk
**Vegetables:**
Carrot (diced or sliced into small cubes)
Cabbage (shredded or chopped)
Sayote (chayote, peeled and diced)
Water (for boiling and simmering)

*These ingredients come together to create a creamy, savory soup that is both nutritious and comforting. The combination of chicken, vegetables, and milk gives Sopas its distinct richness, while the pasta makes it hearty and filling.*

	Procedure
*Making Sopas is a simple process, but it requires patience and attention to properly layer flavors. Each step contributes to the dish's final comforting taste.*

Start by heating a small amount of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, add the minced garlic. Sauté the garlic until it becomes fragrant and slightly golden. This step is important because it builds the aromatic base of the soup. After the garlic is ready, add the chopped onion. Cook the onion until it becomes soft and translucent, releasing its natural sweetness into the oil.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EouA9pWEzQ2RmBz71ssvECQ7YcVMCNXBN8xigkQu6BHE1185gjWkvjcVyV8WKcSbXLY.jpg)

Next, add the chopped chicken pieces to the pot. Stir and cook the chicken until it changes color and becomes lightly browned. This allows the chicken to absorb the flavors of garlic and onion, creating a deeper, richer soup. Sprinkle a little ground pepper at this stage to enhance the flavor.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoeGpfiEMd8zgfLqmnECHXXDNTngyQZEvBT4XumpmkmDExdHA3WRFAVRXR3xM2TxB33.jpg)

Once the chicken is slightly cooked, add the shell pasta or macaroni. Stir everything together until the pasta begins to absorb the flavors of the sautéed ingredients. Then pour in enough water to cover the mixture. Boil it, then cook the pasta until it's soft and tender.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eokf5ytDoPocJT6ujsMMUEwWygJxyDnT7zqzJyGtYGs1j3L4RVzHxo3c96t4kS235wn.jpg)

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eos2qek6T5ipYEYuY1XcRU3iLGtJeuPTwjQ7pFKSJGo6aXWq6Xvragj5bHox1K54prA.jpg)

When the pasta and chicken are almost fully cooked, pour in the evaporated milk. Stir gently as the milk blends with the broth, turning it into a creamy, smooth mixture. The evaporated milk gives Sopas its signature richness, making it perfect for cold, rainy weather.

Once the milk has been fully incorporated, add the vegetables. Put in the diced carrots first, as they take a bit longer to cook. Then add the sayote and shredded cabbage. These vegetables not only add color to the dish but also provide freshness and nutrients that balance the soup's creaminess. Let everything simmer until the vegetables are tender but still slightly crisp, ensuring they do not overcook.

Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning if necessary. You may add more pepper or a pinch of salt, depending on your preference. Let it simmer for a few more minutes so all the flavors blend perfectly.

Once done, turn off the heat and let the Sopas rest for a short while before serving. Serve it hot in bowls, and enjoy its creamy warmth especially on a cold, rainy day.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EokfWYhdNxtHbCHyDTbPQYTLXLXX7C5swCJuk898KDr1GrARyfUrXu5jmtvq6B9Pnaf.jpg)

	A Comforting Rainy-Day Meal

Sopas is more than just food; it is comfort in a bowl. During rainy days, when the weather feels heavy and the skies are gray, a warm serving of Sopas can instantly lift the mood. The creamy broth, tender chicken, soft pasta, and fresh vegetables create a balance of flavors and textures that is both satisfying and soothing.

It is also a dish that brings people together. Whether shared with family during merienda or served as a simple dinner at home, Sopas reminds us of the warmth of togetherness even when the weather outside is cold and gloomy.
In every spoonful, there is comfort, nourishment, and a feeling of home. That is why Sopas remains a timeless favorite, especially during the rainy season in the Philippines.

Das vorangegangene Übersichtsbild [Anm.: Siehe Bildbeschreibung zu `watermarked_img_13679890381982431029.png`] verdeutlicht bereits, dass die Charttechnik maßgeblich auf **menschlicher Psychologie und Herdenverhalten** beruht. Dieses Phänomen ist jedoch keineswegs neu. Die Geschichte, seit wann Menschen Kursverläufe aufzeichnen und diese nutzen, lässt sich in einer klaren historischen Zeitleiste zusammenfassen:

## Die historische Entwicklung der Charttechnik

### 17. Jahrhundert: Die Geburtsstunde in Europa

* **Ab ca. 1600 (Amsterdam):** Mit der Gründung der Amsterdamer Börse (erste offizielle Börse der Welt) beginnen Händler, Preise von Hand aufzuzeichnen, um Muster in den Schwankungen der *Niederländischen Ostindien-Kompanie* zu erkennen.
* **1688:** Joseph de la Vega veröffentlicht mit *„Confusion de Confusiones“* das erste Buch über Börsenpraktiken. Er beschreibt darin bereits, dass Märkte oft unberechenbar und von der irrationalen Psychologie der Händler getrieben sind.

### 18. Jahrhundert: Die Erfindung der Candlesticks (Asien)

* **Ab ca. 1750 (Japan):** Der legendäre Reishändler **Homma Munehisa** analysiert die Preise am Reis-Terminmarkt in Osaka. Er erkennt, dass die Psychologie der Händler den Preis massiv beeinflusst.
* Er erfindet die **Candlestick-Charts** (Kerzencharts), die heute noch auf jedem Trading-Bildschirm Standard sind, um Eröffnungs-, Höchst-, Tiefst- und Schlusskurse auf einen Blick zu sehen.

### Spätes 19. Jahrhundert: Das Fundament des Westens

* **1880er / 1890er Jahre (USA):** **Charles Dow** (Gründer des *Wall Street Journal*) entwickelt die **Dow-Theorie**. Er stellt fest, dass sich Aktienmärkte in Trends (Primär-, Sekundär- und Minor-Trends) bewegen. Seine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für die moderne technische Analyse im westlichen Raum.

### 20. Jahrhundert: Etablierung und die Psychologie der Masse

* **1920er & 1930er Jahre:** Pioniere wie Ralph Nelson Elliott (Elliott-Wellen-Theorie) und Richard Wyckoff entwickeln komplexe Systeme, die auf der Annahme basieren, dass sich die emotionale Massenpsychologie der Marktteilnehmer in sich ständig wiederholenden Mustern im Chart äußert.
* **1948:** Robert D. Edwards und John Magee veröffentlichen das Buch *„Technical Analysis of Stock Trends“*. Es gilt bis heute als die „Bibel“ der Charttechnik und definierte klassische Formationen wie die *Kopf-Schulter-Formationen* oder *Dreiecke*.
* **1980er Jahre:** Die westliche Finanzwelt „entdeckt“ die alten japanischen Candlestick-Charts wieder und kombiniert sie mit westlichen Methoden.

### Ab den 1990ern bis heute: Die digitale Revolution

* **1990er Jahre:** Mit der massenhaften Verbreitung von Computern und dem Internet müssen Charts nicht mehr mühsam auf Millimeterpapier gezeichnet werden. Mathematische Indikatoren (wie *RSI, MACD* oder *Bollinger Bänder*) lassen sich nun in Echtzeit berechnen.
* **Heute (2026):** Die Charttechnik erfährt eine Verschiebung. Da Algorithmen und KI-gestützte Handelssysteme einen riesigen Teil des Marktvolumens ausmachen, scannen Computer die Charts im Millisekundentakt nach genau diesen historischen Mustern. Dadurch wird die Charttechnik zu einer noch stärkeren **selbsterfüllenden Prophezeiung**: Weil Computer und Menschen dieselben Marken (Unterstützung, Widerstand) sehen und darauf reagieren, funktionieren sie.

body.title: Marrying after the death of a spouse, is it allowed by the bible?
body.body:
https://youtu.be/5OYmS8syUlo?si=jNnIrjQjwe3_Mfss

The bond that exists in marriage is only valid while the two persons involved are still alive. The moment either of them is dead the person alive is relieved of that bond. There is no area in the Bible where we are told not to remarry after the death of a spouse.
‎
‎If the partner of the deceased decides that he or she does not want to remarry then it is acceptable. But if peradventure they decide to remarry then there is absolutely nothing wrong with it. It is not considered as sin. God wouldn't hold it against such an individual if he or she decides to take that decision.
‎
‎Death of a spouse is quite an unfortunate incident, but it shouldn't prevent or deny the spouse of the deceased a happy life. We are bound to face obstacles of various kinds in life but this doesn't mean we can't keep moving forward in life. Whatever that life brings our way it does not stop life from going on.
‎
‎‭**Ecclesiastes 9:5 KJV‬**
‎_For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten._
‎
‎The living has no business with the dead. It is not out of place to remarry after the death of a spouse.

body.title: Who Really Fears the Future
body.body:
There is a strange numbness that settles over a person after enough exposure to wars and propaganda. The headlines blur together, the outrage cycles repeat, and after a while it feels as though nothing has truly happened and nothing more will happen either. Life continues in its quiet loop: people fearing for their own existence, and in turn fearing whatever disturbances might threaten that existence, whether it is rising prices, shifting weather patterns, or some other looming concern. The mind grows tired of reacting, and what was once alarming slowly becomes background noise.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXLQmZi5ah2FUZMXViEcf3ne9zcGm1GsAD4Y9JiwoH1fQ/hadija-9cgMKmZyhH0-unsplash.jpg 

Climate change sits right in the middle of this fatigue. Some dismiss it as exaggeration or a hoax, while others point to scientific data and warn of consequences already underway. For many ordinary people, the debate itself feels distant, almost irrelevant, because whatever the truth turns out to be, it may not significantly alter their own lives or even the lives of their children within a timeframe that feels real to them. And yet there are small, undeniable signs: the air feels heavier, the smog lingers longer, visibility drops on certain days. Whether one calls it a hoax or a slow moving crisis, the lived experience of breathing that air does not change.

What stands out most is who actually carries the weight of these fears. It is not the governments, institutions, or policymakers who feel the daily anxiety of rising costs or worsening air quality. It is ordinary people, the ones least equipped to influence the systems responsible, who absorb the stress, adapt their habits, and quietly wonder how much worse things might get. The disconnect between those making decisions and those living with the consequences is perhaps the truest source of this numbness: not indifference to the world's problems, but exhaustion from facing them without any real sense of control.

body.title: Tropical Botanica — A Digital Watercolor Journey 🌸
body.body:
When I sit down to create, I always find myself drawn to the quiet beauty of nature. There is something deeply calming about flowers — the way petals curl, the way leaves catch light, the way colors blend from one shade to another without warning.

This piece, Tropical Botanica, came from that feeling. I wanted to capture the lush richness of tropical flowers — vibrant yet soft, detailed yet dreamy.

The color palette moves through warm corals, soft pinks, and deep greens, balanced with touches of gold that give the piece an almost vintage botanical illustration feel.

I hope this brings a little peace and beauty to your day. 🌿

Created with AI image generation assistance | Creative direction by @waqasmajor4

body.title: 10 years to finish a Space game 🚀
body.body: It's not often I go look for things that had enough time to curate before being released... especially on web2... but this one got my attention the moment I saw \

in development.

And after a few screenshots, I checked a couple of videos, and decided to give it a shot...

It has now been a few weeks since I have been playing it... and given it has been a while I haven't had such fun on a web2 game... I thought about making a story about it to remind me in the future of the old days.

I know many might not enjoy these slow paced indie style games, but for me, this is like recalling old memories.

Something with meaning, because in this game, things can have meaning. Like in many other games... yes, but this one speaks to me from the heart of the old times. Things used to be simple, but also not just next next next, and with different challenges to play, while still very enjoyable.

# Space Heaven is one of them...

Looks like this game was developed by a small 3-person team in Finland called Bugbyte. And even if it was 6-years in early access, to finally call it \

must have been an amazing taste.

Recall that many games on Hive follow this kind of pattern (or followed, until the AI came), so people sometimes get surprised about it when in the real world, the same things also exist.

# Right, let's go, the story of The Mammoth!
*(note, it was only I was already deep in the game that I recalled about doing this, so you won't see much from the beginning... also that makes you go play and support the game, so it all aligns)*

The idea with this post is to get you some context, even if I had mingled two snaps about it already down here:

https://peakd.com/hive-124838/@forkyishere/re-peaksnaps-tgglc8

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23t752E3FvmHTnBUpUpzppTQqJYCgTEH9CDMnjSGfYAWttK2sNZvBQyrMD2QnFVXeNeHA.png)

Then I won't continue posting in this long format about it any further, and instead I will update people via snaps, and refer to the tag #themammoth in order to tag my own content.

First, I want to introduce you to the crew of 9 (will change over time).

We have,

Ana - Mostly a researcher and a botanist girl
Bishop - The super brave weapons, builder and mining guy
Edmund - The Bishop buddy brave companion, He's the best with guns!
Esteban - Recently onboarded future surgeon, gun specialist, operations guy and mining enthusiast
Kayley - The research buddy of Ana and the best Ship all hands operator. A generalist like myself...
Maggie - Oh Maggie... so many issues you have caused me, but an excellent weapons girl, a miner and soon also an industry expert (she was a mess before she learned a few things, and even got bugged by an alien).
Rune - A Chemical engineer that can do SO MANY things... botanist, medical, research and moderately good at weapons! And also can navigate, operate and manage shielding stations!
Ryne - This one is a fricking Comedian, but pairs up with Rune and her stats, although basic medical skills only. Although in addition is good at industry, can construct and do some mining (Rune can't).
Tilley - She is a welder, good at industry and solid construction skills. She's also a great gunner at the ship, and will be the best pilot eventually (once I build a fighter).

The ship has been greatly expanded already, but just to give you a sense of where you start... You start with a crew of 4 and a basically empty ship... only one miner and two builders vessels, and a shuttle.

All the rest here is basically built and designed by yourself (in this case, myself). And also, this is my first experience, I didn't restart the game just to make it perfect... so I am sometimes either finding bugs or little things that I haven't quite yet figured out the best way to use them.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23t74bjxQ4ZC4kbTmhzT8i6j31BQVX99KmiTnvSGbd6GLM2VeXgYiLW82RPBgnhitWX2U.png)

I won't give too much away, because I want it to be a live story mode experience, and whoever follows it, thanks for following along. If you are playing this too, feel free to share some experience and/or comment about my ship design. I have not or had any particular target design, and because it was looking like a big chunk of thing... I decided to call it \

.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23t752C37mJLs8ihDBMZYbdWhPaf78kKDhJ2bHCPEcXDCaVx73L22FfLBtBLkqME4gygR.png)

As you can see, I went the full solar panel mode... it eventually pays off, but I am still very early... to finish the post, my late re-organising of the ship, had to go set the engines in a symmetrical way, because I didn't have space for the long split of the ship.

And having more engines eventually allowed me to extend it for the next adventure. Add more cargo space for more items, and other little improvements, like adding more heaters.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23swfuJfvaxmLs96HusEYG1DRGcLJutEVneQjuz878Tx1SzzjSiwskhuSLWhQbMuWCdKD.png)

One more update before I go. This weekend, I have added the first ship to ship turret (because I am going to fight soon). A new Bed (like to have an extra one just in case I find a new crew and don't yet want to discard someone), while having some extra ones for slaves that I have to rescue and 2 more engines for the next hull expansion.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23sweHuE3BwthhoCy49m3B4msuKnbMJBnRb4w3vurGZ1gMttFzVFH9xPs9koQydwD79kQ.png)

The Mammoth is officially bigger than the screen for some extra definition... and this is how it looks from the outside.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forkyishere/23tGdnmgGXahy3QCFKNq3E6gHRvxgc6xjmqgT4Ucx1h5g3Rdu5JGHrhuYiGjLHAfc8cuu.png)

I am having a blast playing this! Memories all over the place... from the 90's when I was kid.

> ![20260609_121521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpGRARt1yEA9dwSgPy5PJ3P8dDRum83sxWWwe7YmXQpQBN7efLkrFsTZDY3iCrzYrn9.jpg)
After a long time, I finally found these bananas; my mom bought them from a street vendor yesterday. She said the vendor happened to be a close friend of hers, so she was able to buy them quickly and easily. In Indonesia, these bananas are known as “pisang raja”—they have a truly delicious flavor, whether fried or baked into banana cake, making them the star of the show.
Honey-Fried Banana
Well, today is different from usual—I want to fry bananas with honey, as this recipe is currently very popular in our area. No one is selling it yet, but we can easily find the recipe on social media because it was that viral at the time. ![20260609_121451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7N1ZNuEboQEXAkdV67ohr3fpWECg1YNN3qfSiCjzXJptnHeiyVVgi2xh3kQGCfEqNn.jpg) Honey-fried bananas are a combination of ingredients mixed with honey, which serves as the sweetener. To achieve a stunning final result and make them incredibly delicious, the honey is brushed onto the fried bananas. Of course, this makes them even more delicious—even though I don’t use wild honey, store-bought honey is already very tasty. Curious? Let’s check out the recipe.
Ingredients
![20260609_093406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoyQyDSZkSC5R6nx9TPnT2MSq8SF31EQV6bqDeXM4bJjniDgQ9zGdKYa21X9jdQ17hC.jpg)
6 plantains 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon granulated sugar ¼ teaspoon salt 150 grams all-purpose flour 50 grams cornstarch ½ teaspoon baking powder 20 grams melted butter ¼ teaspoon vanilla powder Water as needed
Preparation Instructions
Mix the two flours, then add the honey and water while stirring.
| ![20260609_093434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tSYkDkx8B3eCWw8YiU72rL77Gtn765FeyGa5z9NnomZenfrmhq3Q3wrq9KV9x4E4dQ5.jpg) | ![20260609_093439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u65PtLzN81cXgUKDqYCgUSGPWnNRfhr3kCeqfF27BnfNKzyRwEiHnPJKV2aNAW1VCLW.jpg) | ![20260609_093522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wWyUTppXtvqNw5uwrdNjrKEPTsWjctXtwwfLf9QoQL6N9DcYMUVdqNeorjPqk2aAswV.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Next, add the granulated sugar, salt, baking powder, and vanilla; stir until well combined.
| ![20260609_093526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFW8o2M53qTQGdGR8busfXwHZQCt3uJ1iReE6uxToMF6NDy3B2usYfBUoEhg1hXFeQy.jpg) | ![20260609_093558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wCBw8PxkKdvcHHdvcwRjUFESsfsKivMmUyMMUnDuC2VpoLJuEhEAX6RzwB1fkz8Lr7h.jpg) | ![20260609_093603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tmL4xuyeZai24GvR5Bugm3pq8eZujhfvqwcuLcJqWugJj77HbFtLYKZBfwLTE1qpqSr.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Add the melted butter, then stir again until the batter thickens and is smooth.

> ![20260609_093707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tScUdqbdMoUHB2zJjpB9AkwoC2RLaG1sXLqTt9vgexmbs4w8LRgkXHg6WbfRCtcfjen.jpg)
Peel the bananas and cut them into small pieces as shown in the photo.

> ![20260609_093813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFPqRTZPUA9kjRwPkUrST2zkBJCEfZaiUa9VrA59UhxzaRADnajJT49NNnd7BvQhc5H.jpg) ![20260609_093856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsLdQk3Sn9Ri4xRe1PB3uyfaEapRs7ExSLSnoth3FYTJvRrL97tsYBXMst1ifoTEKnG.jpg)
Add the bananas to the flour mixture and mix well, then fry in a non-stick pan to form round shapes.
| ![20260609_093728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yJLu1xJNdA5WeUJDZp3E74oqKRxReqRSNB7NS2aCjA9cyKx6T91DJGeUHGmBLKErgnH.jpg) | ![20260609_093902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVMX4tDNPhPUBbSr4EmMV33RQSKhY3e4G4EEW8vmHRFkceY9jiZ7QUYKgj3nnm1tHSP.jpg) | ![20260609_093920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tvkt9jMsxEBhG5Byx2jgh6F1fagn2akuNT8vYZJv5mwoKBSW6r5FhbkWKoFEzeBQmub.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Alternatively, use a mold and fry until golden brown.

> ![20260609_094818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2h2o7PZDNZ5excKVWV9ipuyR2R5oBLpqbmiXPW5bYZ4JV8Bm8GvRyBkajSy12N1vu5.jpg)
Results and Serving Suggestions
![20260609_121427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynWbpVbKAPUDc14P5jYLcMDtQWHybiy4mAMCQMwXip1yHGbaJEaKmiR7RPzzKhwE8EF.jpg)
Just look at how appetizing the result is! Finally, after they’re cooked, I spread honey evenly over the surface of the fried bananas. To ensure they turn out delicious and look more appealing, make sure to fry them until they’re a deep golden brown.
| ![20260609_121442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7KpQD2h33mg5Cufj8Fa9DWkZ42juo9D1a6am415YwNEB5aiNEc2UuCJqk8WTmQzGQ9.jpg) | ![20260609_121525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242NqGLhdqR7B6vS1nAEEPh9jvuXijbncgNh54k9kXkyB5xKdSWgFcfcJ7YPWV33Z3Ggs.jpg) | ![20260609_121536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242hWDtZjaU7MUXshESdhYHfWrW8fdfhKNCRnLxTnJgrsbi56b9neftNxUyxtGzPARxfG.jpg) | |-|-|-|
The combination of banana and batter makes the outside crispy and the inside soft—the crispy batter coating is perfect. There’s a natural sweetness from the honey that tastes absolutely delicious; in my opinion, it’s incredibly tasty and different from other versions. Especially when using plantains, it becomes even more delicious and truly amazing.
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

body.title: Hedera helix - Araliaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Hedera helix - Araliaceae (ENG) Ivy (Hedera helix) is an evergreen climbing vine, extremely long-lived and adaptable, capable of climbing trees, walls, and structures thanks to its adventitious roots. It is a common species in Europe and particularly widespread in Italy, where it grows wild in woodlands, hedgerows, and shady areas. ![edera.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqNH9uFUkJV9f3iijRserhGxtQN3p6o8Rv2qGSRsbYrWajmQYFX4j7wdaAwtWkGirZU.png) image created with canva.com Minimum growing temperature: 5°C Ivy tolerates cold well, but below this threshold, it can damage young tissue. **Balsamic season: July This is the time when the leaves reach their maximum concentration of active ingredients. Toxicity: High** The leaves can cause contact dermatitis; the berries are highly toxic and can cause potentially fatal respiratory depression. For this reason, it is considered a risky plant for phytotherapy. **Ivy contains: Ederin Ederacoside Rutin Rutoside Rutinoside** These compounds give it: Cough-repelling properties (expectorant and antitussive action) Confirmed poisoning activity, especially through ingestion of the berries **Phytotherapeutic Use: Regulatory Framework and Safety The Italian Ministry of Health permits the use of ivy-based preparations only in very rare cases, and almost exclusively in cosmetic formulations (anti-cellulite creams, toning gels, skincare products).** Internal use is discouraged and almost completely abandoned due to the high toxicity risk. A study by Professor Trute (1997) showed that ivy extract had a cough-repelling effect comparable to papaverine, but the risks far outweighed the benefits. Since then, the plant has been considered unsafe for internal therapeutic use. Traditional Preparations and Historical Uses **Leaf Decoction** In the Middle Ages, it was used to wash woolen garments, thanks to the presence of natural saponins. **External Compresses** In the past, they were applied for rheumatic pain, but today they are considered potentially irritating. **Modern Cosmetics** Extracts titrated in saponins are used in anti-cellulite products for their draining and toning effects. **Toxicity and Precautions Ivy is one of the most dangerous ornamental plants to ingest: The berries can cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, convulsions, and respiratory arrest. The leaves contain irritating saponins that cause contact dermatitis. Accidental ingestion in children is a medical emergency. For this reason, internal use is absolutely not recommended and is no longer used in modern herbal medicine.** Plant useful only for external cosmetic use in controlled preparations. No internal use recommended. Highly toxic → handle with caution. **It has historical and botanical rather than therapeutic interest.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Hedera helix - Araliaceae (ITA) La edera (Hedera helix) è una liana rampicante sempreverde, estremamente longeva e adattabile, capace di arrampicarsi su alberi, muri e strutture grazie alle sue radici avventizie. È una specie comune in Europa e particolarmente diffusa anche in Italia, dove cresce spontanea in boschi, siepi e zone ombrose. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Temperatura minima di coltivazione: 5 °C L’edera tollera bene il freddo, ma sotto questa soglia può subire danni ai tessuti più giovani. **Periodo balsamico: luglio È il momento in cui le foglie raggiungono la massima concentrazione di principi attivi. Tossicità: alta** Le foglie possono provocare dermatiti da contatto; le bacche sono molto tossiche e possono causare depressione respiratoria potenzialmente letale. Per questo motivo è considerata una pianta fitoterapicamente rischiosa. **L’edera contiene: Ederina Ederacoside Rutina Rutoside Rutinoside** Questi composti le conferiscono: Proprietà tossifughe (azione espettorante e antitussiva) Attività confermata di avvelenamento, soprattutto per ingestione delle bacche **Uso fitoterapico: quadro normativo e sicurezza Il Ministero della Salute italiano consente l’impiego di preparati a base di edera solo in casi rarissimi, e quasi esclusivamente in formulazioni cosmetiche (creme anticellulite, gel tonificanti, prodotti per la pelle).** L’uso interno è sconsigliato e quasi completamente abbandonato per l’elevato rischio tossico. Uno studio del prof. Trute (1997) evidenziò che l’estratto di edera aveva un’azione tossifuga paragonabile alla papaverina, ma i rischi superavano ampiamente i benefici. Da allora, la pianta è considerata non sicura per l’uso terapeutico interno. Preparazioni tradizionali e usi storici **Decotto di foglie** Nel Medioevo veniva utilizzato per lavare gli indumenti di lana, grazie alla presenza di saponine naturali. **Impacchi esterni** In passato venivano applicati per dolori reumatici, ma oggi sono considerati potenzialmente irritanti. **Cosmetici moderni** Gli estratti titolati in saponine sono impiegati in prodotti anticellulite per il loro effetto drenante e tonificante. **Tossicità e precauzioni L’edera è una delle piante ornamentali più pericolose da ingerire: Le bacche possono causare nausea, vomito, diarrea, convulsioni e arresto respiratorio. Le foglie contengono saponine irritanti che provocano dermatiti da contatto. L’ingestione accidentale nei bambini è un’emergenza medica. Per questo motivo, l’uso interno è assolutamente sconsigliato e non trova più applicazione nella fitoterapia moderna.** Sintesi operativa Pianta utile solo per uso cosmetico esterno in preparazioni controllate. Nessun impiego interno raccomandabile. Elevata tossicità → manipolare con cautela. **Interesse storico e botanico più che terapeutico.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/erboristeria/edera.html https://www.erbecedario.it/it/edera-helix ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: Dino Crisis [Let's Play] - 03
body.body:
*Regina reunites with Rick and Gail. They get a distress signal from one of their teammates, Gail says it's probably a trap, but I choose to side with Rick and investigate anyway.*

-----

**Dino Crisis** is a survival panic game developed by the same team behind Resident Evil. It swaps out zombies for dinosaurs. The game follows Regina, a special agent sent to investigate a mysterious island facility after an experiment for a new energy source went horribly wrong!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQz7BtVkjKVHjdCHxokMKPfzanNQgqy9vfSB5dZeEnFZe/VeniceAI_vFc26C8_@2x.webp 




The first **Dino Crisis** game first released on PS1 and features real-time 3D environments with dynamic camera movement. The dinosaurs serve mostly as a background threat as Regina explores the facility and learns more about the 3rd Energy Project!

***This playthrough uses the ReBirth Mod on top of the GoG version of the game.***

I played Dino Crisis during my teenage years. I already played the first hours of Dino Crisis 2 at the time, and with my little English knowledge, Dino Crisis 1 felt complicated in comparison... I didn't know where to go 2 hours into the game. Finally finishing the game now with the GoG version felt incredibly satisfying.

Despite the clunky controls, the game still holds up surprisingly well. With its tense atmosphere and the constant threat of raptors lurking around every corner. The story adds some interesting sci-fi elements, though the the time travel aspect turned out to be more a plot device to introduce the Dinosaurs, rather than the actual main plotline.

While I'd recommend this game to survival horror fans, I did run into some technical issues... FMVs kept skipping themselves which broke some of the cinematic flow. The game features huge amounts of backtracking, especially near the end, so much that I kept a guide open so I figure out what I was missing. Still, the ending was satisfying and worth the journey. You can watch my playthrough below:


----

https://youtu.be/rqIkyxvlPi4
