links.title: MCGI Topic Review | How do we overcome our doubts and anxieties
links.body: \n\n<div class=\

>


https://youtu.be/3SP0PLbP39c?si=eqeqjChvl9eKL0cl





Doubts and anxieties are things that many of us experience in life. I sometimes feel anxious about the future and what I want to do and what I am going to encounter. Now and again I ask myself questions and wonder if things will ever work out. These emotions can make my heart weigh down and rob me of my peace. But when I read God's Word I have been given this insight that I don't have to deal with my doubts and anxieties by myself.

One of the greatest ways to overcome doubts and anxieties is by trusting God completely. The Bible tells us in Proverbs 3:5, \

Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee. I kept going to God in faith and over time, my fear slowly faded. Although some things didn't go exactly as I wanted to, I learned that God works in his time, not mine.\n\nAnother way to overcome doubts is by remembering God's faithfulness. As I remember all the times God helped me, protected me, answered my prayers, I know that He wouldn't abandon me now. Hebrews 13:5 says, \

When fear comes into my heart, this promise gives me strength. Finally, doubts and anxieties can impact all of us, but they have no control over us. They can be overcome by us through faith, prayer, reading the Word of God, and recalling the faithfulness of God. I have discovered that the more I rely on God, the more peace I will have. Whatever difficulties I may encounter, I know that God will be with me to lead and strengthen me.

links.title: Confiando en el proceso
links.body:
Hay días en los que sentimos que caminamos sin avanzar. Días en los que el esfuerzo parece invisible y los resultados se niegan a aparecer. En esos momentos es fácil preguntarse si todo lo que hacemos vale la pena, si estamos en el camino correcto o si deberíamos rendirnos.
Sin embargo, la vida me ha enseñado que muchas de las cosas más importantes crecen en silencio.
Una semilla no se convierte en árbol de la noche a la mañana. Primero debe permanecer bajo tierra, lejos de las miradas, desarrollando raíces fuertes. Desde afuera parece que no ocurre nada, pero en realidad está ocurriendo todo.
Así sucede también con nuestros sueños, nuestros proyectos y nuestras propias vidas.
He pasado por momentos en los que la incertidumbre parecía más grande que la esperanza. Situaciones económicas difíciles, preocupaciones familiares, planes que tardaron más de lo esperado y metas que parecían alejarse cada vez más. Pero con el tiempo comprendí que cada experiencia, incluso las más duras, tenía algo que enseñarme.
Confiar en el proceso no significa quedarse sentado esperando milagros. Significa seguir trabajando, seguir intentándolo y seguir creyendo aun cuando los resultados todavía no sean visibles.
Es tener la paciencia de entender que cada paso cuenta.
A veces queremos que la vida nos muestre inmediatamente el destino final, pero solo nos entrega el siguiente paso. Y aunque eso pueda parecer insuficiente, muchas veces es exactamente lo que necesitamos para continuar.
Hoy miro hacia atrás y veo que muchas de las cosas que antes consideraba obstáculos fueron en realidad parte del camino que me llevó hasta donde estoy. Cada caída me hizo más fuerte. Cada espera me enseñó paciencia. Cada dificultad me recordó el valor de la perseverancia.
Por eso, si estás atravesando un momento de incertidumbre, quiero recordarte algo: no abandones tu camino solo porque aún no ves los resultados.
Sigue sembrando.
Sigue aprendiendo.
Sigue creyendo.
Porque aunque no siempre podamos verlo, el proceso también es progreso.
Y a veces, las mejores cosas de la vida llegan precisamente a quienes tuvieron la valentía de confiar en él.
Gracias por leerme. ¿Alguna vez has tenido que confiar en el proceso cuando todo parecía estar detenido? Me encantaría leer tu experiencia en los comentarios. ❤️

links.body:
Sometimes it's hard to tell whether it's a good thing or a bad thing when, for some reason, some seemingly interesting ideas can't be realized. They're like a ship moored to a pier. It seems there are no obstacles to travel, but it's stuck in port. But on the other hand, there have been so many fruitless, and especially disastrous, sea voyages throughout history, so maybe it's good to see the ship close to its home shore lol. ![1lkl1DSC01543.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRde66HC4m6mbTbeWtJtNUgM6t54pRxpZe8xoUGcaW4HC/1lkl1DSC01543.png) Any idea, like a sea voyage, is in some ways like an apple that you managed to keep safe and sound until winter, but when you bite into it, you discover that it's spoiled inside and the idea no longer looks as appealing as before. ![1lkl1DSC09498.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmb4jrLuLuQHt3P2RHQKGEZg6y3Rb3fhxZPoHGyD8MRxbs/1lkl1DSC09498.png) Spending a lot of time and finding out in the end that the idea wasn't worth it might be sad, but it's no sadder than seeing disposable dishes thrown away... after all, the contents were eaten, or drunk, and then you can think of another idea lol. ![1lkl1DSC09506.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUpioMQBZ52Wd1zcNccgz7ZLkHA5rjTAjXt8VNmwY7VH2/1lkl1DSC09506.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. People often ask me if I just snap a photo and call it a day but for me editing is where the real soul of the work comes alive

I see digital editing as a true art form in its own right it is where I take the raw light and turn it into the vision I had in my head when I stood in front of this wall in this photo 

Because I put so much care into color balancing and texture enhancement these images become something special that collectors and designers love to use 

This is exactly why my photos sell so well on platforms like Shutterstock
they aren't just snapshots but polished pieces of art ready to tell a story wherever they end up

Cheers 🥰

links.title: Nệm 15cm: Bảng giá và TOP 10 mẫu nệm được săn đón năm 2026
links.body:
Trong số các độ dày nệm phổ biến hiện nay, nệm 15cm được nhiều gia đình lựa chọn nhờ khả năng cân bằng giữa sự êm ái, độ bền và tính thẩm mỹ. Đây được xem là độ dày lý tưởng, phù hợp với nhiều đối tượng sử dụng và nhiều không gian phòng ngủ khác nhau.

Điểm nổi bật của nệm dày 15cm là khả năng nâng đỡ cơ thể hiệu quả. Với cấu trúc đủ dày, sản phẩm giúp phân bổ áp lực đồng đều lên các vùng vai, lưng và hông, từ đó hỗ trợ duy trì đường cong tự nhiên của cột sống. Nhờ vậy, người dùng có thể hạn chế tình trạng đau nhức sau khi thức dậy và tận hưởng giấc ngủ sâu hơn mỗi đêm.

Không chỉ mang lại cảm giác thoải mái khi nằm, độ dày 15cm còn giúp nệm có khả năng chịu lực tốt hơn so với các dòng nệm mỏng. Cấu trúc chắc chắn giúp sản phẩm hạn chế xẹp lún, duy trì độ đàn hồi ổn định trong thời gian dài sử dụng. Đây cũng là lý do nhiều dòng nệm chất lượng có thể đồng hành cùng người dùng từ 10 đến 15 năm nếu được bảo quản đúng cách.

Hiện nay, nệm 15cm được sản xuất với nhiều chất liệu khác nhau để đáp ứng nhu cầu đa dạng của khách hàng. Nệm cao su thiên nhiên nổi bật nhờ độ đàn hồi cao, khả năng thoáng khí và độ bền vượt trội. Nệm foam mang đến cảm giác êm ái, ôm sát cơ thể và hỗ trợ giảm áp lực hiệu quả. Trong khi đó, nệm bông ép phù hợp với những người yêu thích bề mặt nằm cứng vừa phải, giúp giữ cột sống ở tư thế ổn định. Ngoài ra, các dòng nệm hybrid kết hợp nhiều lớp vật liệu cũng ngày càng được ưa chuộng nhờ sự cân bằng giữa nâng đỡ và thư giãn.

Một số sản phẩm được người tiêu dùng đánh giá cao hiện nay gồm iComfy Cloud 2.0, iComfy Coolax Massage, Gummi Classic, Gummi Hybrid, Kim Cương Stella, Wonjun Pure Carbon hay Liên Á 5Zone. Mỗi sản phẩm sở hữu những ưu điểm riêng về độ êm, khả năng làm mát và mức giá, giúp người dùng dễ dàng lựa chọn theo nhu cầu thực tế.

Để sử dụng nệm bền lâu, người dùng nên kết hợp với tấm bảo vệ nệm nhằm hạn chế bụi bẩn và chất lỏng thấm vào bên trong. Việc xoay hoặc đảo chiều nệm định kỳ từ 2 đến 3 tháng một lần cũng giúp phân bổ lực đồng đều, giảm nguy cơ lún cục bộ. Đồng thời, cần tránh phơi nệm dưới ánh nắng gắt hoặc tiếp xúc trực tiếp với nguồn nhiệt cao vì có thể ảnh hưởng đến cấu trúc vật liệu.

Với khả năng nâng đỡ tốt, độ bền cao và phù hợp với nhiều đối tượng sử dụng, nệm 15cm là lựa chọn đáng cân nhắc cho những ai muốn đầu tư vào chất lượng giấc ngủ. Một chiếc nệm phù hợp không chỉ giúp cơ thể được nghỉ ngơi trọn vẹn mà còn góp phần nâng cao sức khỏe và chất lượng cuộc sống mỗi ngày.

links.title: Confiando en el proceso
links.body:
Como siempre antes de empezar agradecer a mi hijo @valderalazaro y a mi hija @diazktty también los invito a que lean sus post , agradeciendo desde el corazón a nuestro amigo @bradleyarrow y le deseo pronta recuperación y a su esposa @cathyarrow por su gran corazón hacia mis hijos y mi nieto
🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮🌸💮
Hay días en los que sentimos que caminamos sin avanzar. Días en los que el esfuerzo parece invisible y los resultados se niegan a aparecer. En esos momentos es fácil preguntarse si todo lo que hacemos vale la pena, si estamos en el camino correcto o si deberíamos rendirnos.
Sin embargo, la vida me ha enseñado que muchas de las cosas más importantes crecen en silencio.
Una semilla no se convierte en árbol de la noche a la mañana. Primero debe permanecer bajo tierra, lejos de las miradas, desarrollando raíces fuertes. Desde afuera parece que no ocurre nada, pero en realidad está ocurriendo todo.
Así sucede también con nuestros sueños, nuestros proyectos y nuestras propias vidas.
He pasado por momentos en los que la incertidumbre parecía más grande que la esperanza. Situaciones económicas difíciles, preocupaciones familiares, planes que tardaron más de lo esperado y metas que parecían alejarse cada vez más. Pero con el tiempo comprendí que cada experiencia, incluso las más duras, tenía algo que enseñarme.
Confiar en el proceso no significa quedarse sentado esperando milagros. Significa seguir trabajando, seguir intentándolo y seguir creyendo aun cuando los resultados todavía no sean visibles.
Es tener la paciencia de entender que cada paso cuenta.
A veces queremos que la vida nos muestre inmediatamente el destino final, pero solo nos entrega el siguiente paso. Y aunque eso pueda parecer insuficiente, muchas veces es exactamente lo que necesitamos para continuar.
Hoy miro hacia atrás y veo que muchas de las cosas que antes consideraba obstáculos fueron en realidad parte del camino que me llevó hasta donde estoy. Cada caída me hizo más fuerte. Cada espera me enseñó paciencia. Cada dificultad me recordó el valor de la perseverancia.
Por eso, si estás atravesando un momento de incertidumbre, quiero recordarte algo: no abandones tu camino solo porque aún no ves los resultados.
Sigue sembrando.
Sigue aprendiendo.
Sigue creyendo.
Porque aunque no siempre podamos verlo, el proceso también es progreso.
Y a veces, las mejores cosas de la vida llegan precisamente a quienes tuvieron la valentía de confiar en él.
Gracias por leerme. ¿Alguna vez has tenido que confiar en el proceso cuando todo parecía estar detenido? Me encantaría leer tu experiencia en los comentarios. ❤️
![IMG_20260611_225430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/245wf4xU5cJoSYKojchvS31HkF4D6mzPGH9p8yM1h55gco6aiYgCHgz9MFc6SzSX4gTbF.jpg)

links.title: Скупатися не бажаєте?
links.body:
Ох і прохолодною виглядпє ця бистрорічка. Так глянеш на неї згори, і все, спускатись не хочеться, хіба руки змочити і обличчя вмити, облите спекою.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdKC4uT521chJNNXwFRpwoVmjv8PHPE3LVP1jeu2fY2x/1781416390714.jpg)

Та підійшовши ближче, ніжна прохолода огортає і перетворюється на спокійний тепленький вітерець, який так і манить охолодити стомлене тіло. Звісно, ряска помічена по дорозі, охоту поволі зменшує. А швидкість плину течії геть відкидає бажання окунуться, навіть попри сильну втому і перегрів.

links.body:
![anas-alhajj-jLDBYeNbk-o-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/242hjZ4mho3VBqYQJr13KdqoJeHg7enreBCdEqrtDhTB9rF2YKxsdZf4mQvL2rZYQhmeQ.jpg)

> Jay stood near a teen he had been asked to watch over while Mr Sunshine finished their mission. The kid was on his knees losing his lunch.
> \
/ _You fought and killed them anyway._\n> \
/ _No, a coward runs. A brave person acts even when terrified. You saved lives._\n> \

/ _We're going to try to ensure you won't have to._ -- Anon Guest

The bad part of the scene was that Jay had to document everything that he discovered. And the first thing he discovered was a recent victim who had fought back out of survival reflex and was now suffering the after-effects.

Adrenaline was great for survival instincts. Lousy for keeping your meal remnants on the inside of the body.

This poor kid was _just_ a teenager. Barely weeks past their thirteenth birthday. Currently dry-heaving into the commode where they had been sitting and ridding things via the other exit. At least this waif had had the sense to flush before kneeling.

Jay remembered making that mistake once. When scooping up waifs like this one, he made sure to flush for them before they could get down. Some of them even thanked him later.

\
coached Jay. \

Well. Cleaner than hanging over a toilet bowl and huffing their own puke fumes. This world was still a _deregger_ world and had dodgy air. The vague positive point was that the building was in the high-class region and therefore had cleaner air than the industrial district. Theoretically.

The Alliance had drastically altered Jay's standards in that regard.

The last set of dangerous burping passed, and Jay handed the kid a washcloth. Guaranteed cool and refreshing. The kid was covered in blood spatter, but pointing that out would only result in another emotional crash.

Shaky breathing and straightening up was an improvement. Tears and snot were still there. _They_ would take a longer time to ebb. \
More sobbing. \
\n\n\
said Jay. \
\n\n\
the kid repeated their stumbling point. The exact moment they snapped, and their whole world changed. \
\n\n\
said Jay. \
\n\nReluctant. Warbling. \
\n\n\
said Jay. \

He didn't need to tell the kid about joining Pax Humanis. That was something they could find about at a later date. After the therapists had done their good work to usher the kid through their traumas. \
\n\n\
said Pretty. \
\n\n\
\n\n\
\n\nJay had no other answer but, \
\n\n\
said Pretty. \
\n\nJay started wishing the Therapists would get there sooner. \
He had another washcloth. \
\n\n\

links.title: The Blessedness Of Doing Difficult Things
links.body: <div class=\
>\n\nOne of my mentors once said that \

A lot of people prefer tasks that are easy, comfortable, convenient, and familiar. This is because difficult tasks often require more patience, a lot of work, discipline, efforts, persistence, and even sacrifices. This can explain why some people avoid challenges as much as they seem possible. But what they fail to understand is that there are some of the life's lessons, opportunities, and achievements that can come by doing difficult things. The experience you get from doing difficult things can bring about a lot of benefits and long-term success.

<center>![pexels-karola-g-6256113.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR9JJEzVfsmDjEHHdz2TqQtRsrFnCAJnodDY4mqrDuJH7/pexels-karola-g-6256113.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/disheartened-student-against-blackboard-6256113)</sub></center>

A friend of mine who studied accountancy wanted to become chartered. So he registered to write the popular \

examination that will make him a chartered accountant. This was when he knew that his routine would have to change. Before that time, he used to hang out with his friends after work, and they would stay there till late night, then when he came back home, he would go straight to sleep. Then he would wake up in the morning, prepare for work, and then the circle kept repeating. But when he registered for the exam, a lot of things changed. He knew he was not going to maintain that easy life he once hard. When he got back from work, while his friends would be relaxing and hanging out, he would devote long hours to study his materials, and past questions. The process was stressful, difficult, and he had to make a lot of sacrifices. The exam finally came and he wrote it. It was tough and challenging, but he was glad that he met what he read. When the result came out, he was among the very few that passed in his centre. This opened a lot of opportunities to him that he never knew were available. The benefits were even far more than just passing the exam, it came with a lot of things. It is the difficult things you do today that will give you the kind of easy life you want tomorrow. When I talk about doing difficult things, I do not mean that you should make your life harder than it should be. But it means that you have conditioned yourself to face the necessary challenges that can help you grow, improve, and reach your desired potentials. Whether it is in your place of work, maybe starting a new business, in your personal life, learning new skills, or even developing a good habit, the truth is that difficult tasks will produce the kind of results that you may not get if you go with the easy choices. This is why I normally tell people that the choices you make today will be part of what will create your tomorrow and make you who you are.
![pexels-karola-g-5717778.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRiMw67jknZogzXB9E7qGCquDQvrPUAfVGTgGqZ3nKFxX/pexels-karola-g-5717778.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-sitting-at-the-table-5717778)
One of the benefits of doing difficult things is that it leads to personal growth. More often than not, you achieve growth when you dare to step out of your comfort zone. That it, when you accept and face challenges, you will discover the hidden strength that you have always had that you may not have known you had. As a matter of fact, difficult situations can make you to think differently, and to see life from an entirely different perspective. When you are faced with difficult moments, you will be surprised what you can discover. It might even force you to learn new skills, improve on yourself, develop your confidence, and improve your abilities. Doing difficult things also lead to mental toughness. Life may not be predicted, because it can come with challenges and so on. This is why you need to build yourself mentally to face what life brings your way. People who regularly avoid difficult things often struggle when problems arise. Imagine a soldier who refuses to train, if war comes, he may become the first causality. When you keep facing and overcoming difficult moments, you will better equip yourself to handle pressure, disappointments, setbacks, and uncertainties, because you have trained yourself to persist through difficulties. When you undertake difficult tasks, it also makes you more disciplined, and gives you the confidence to face even bigger challenges and overcome them. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

/>

This morning’s breakfast came with a little twist. Instead of boiling eggs the usual way, I decided to save gas by placing them right on top of the rice while it cooked. It worked perfectly; the steam gently boiled them while the rice was finishing.  
One egg was set aside for my fur baby, **Cardo the Chow Chow**, who always waits patiently for his share. The other two were mine, making for a simple yet satisfying start to the day.  
Sometimes, it’s the small kitchen hacks that make mornings more fun and sharing them with loved ones (whether human or furry) makes them even better.

links.title: The match between Brazil and Morocco ended in a 1-1 draw.
links.body:
Italian coach Carlo Ancelotti, who made his World Cup debut at the age of 67, surprised Brazil with his first match selection. Igor Thiago replaced Matheus Cunha in attack. Roger Ibanez at right back. Morocco kept Brazil under pressure from the start of the match. The Atlas Lions kept possession of the ball for the first seven minutes. Brazil managed to block two shots on the post but somehow managed to block them. Brazil's Igor Thiago missed an easy goal opportunity in the fourteenth minute. Brazil could have taken the lead with a header next to Vini.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWn5b9LF581Zeb7319Wh6YjduJBsEFKXNzm2BqRs4Dpke/1781415595764.jpg)

[scr](https://www.skysports.com/football/brazil-vs-morocco/report/549771)


Although the Seleção could not, Morocco took advantage of the opportunity. Moroccan forward Ismail Saberi chipped in a through pass from Ibrahim Diaz in the twenty-first minute. Morocco got another chance in the twenty-seventh minute. This time the ball went outside the post. After the goal was cleared, Vini Junior came to the rescue of Brazil, who had a messy game. In the 32nd minute, the Brazilian star scored a great goal by entering the Moroccan box from the left side. The two teams went into the break with parity.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrZy2AbtUsoJ5bS2BELHDJG9RPwgu2xsyWkxn4BoTJXJ/1781415880015.jpg)


[scr](https://www.skysports.com/football/brazil-vs-morocco/report/549771)



Although the first half of the match was exciting, the second half started badly. Brazil was ahead in ball position. Morocco tried to focus on defense and go on a counterattack. Brazil could have gone ahead in the second half. Ruffini had a chance in the 67th minute of the match. But this winger could not touch the ball. Brazil attacked again in the 78th minute. This time Ruffini received the ball from the left wing, but this time the Barca footballer failed to beat Yacine Buno.

Towards the very end of the match, a goal opportunity came in front of Morocco. Alisson Becker saved the team from the hand of misfortune by blocking it. Brazil-Morocco high voltage match ends in a draw. Both teams had a chance to win. But in the end, the match ended in a draw. Brazil played their first match in the World Cup under Carlo Ancelotti. And this match was the toughest match in the group. From there, earning a point, the path to the knockout became much easier for Brazil.

links.title: Finally, a new cell phone!!
links.body:
![IMG_20260613_183438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vsHsT1tr2bVhgTuRM9MmcLvsKP58zoebWHYYqctDueWb1EfuimBK2ihmUkavTTWGApH.jpg)



<div class=\

>Estoy muy aliviada y feliz, finalmente pude comprarme un nuevo celular, prácticamente aun lo debo porque lo pague con financiamiento pero al menos pude hacerlo hoy mismo, ya mi celular viejo esta a punto de morir (o al menos su pantalla aunque tambien tiene otras fallas muy extrañas) y si no actuaba rápido me quedaría sin celular pronto, la cosa es que no pude darme el lujo de comprar un celular de la misma calidad del Xiaomi poco nfc, pero estuve pensando que quizás no necesitaba un equipo tan bestial. > I'm so relieved and happy—I finally managed to buy a new cell phone. I still owe money on it since I paid for it on a payment plan, but at least I was able to get it today. My old phone is on its last legs (or at least its screen is, though it has some other really weird glitches too), and if I hadn't acted fast, I would have been without a phone soon. The thing is, I couldn't afford to buy a phone of the same quality as the Xiaomi Poco NFC, but I was thinking that maybe I didn’t need such a high-end device. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>En ese tiempo en el que compre el Xiaomi poco NFC lo hice más que todo por su cámara, me servía bastante para fotografías en general y fotografiar mis maquillajes, sin embargo la fluidez de ese celular fue algo totalmente increíble para mí, nunca había tenido un celular tan rápido, esta vez mis prioridades cambiaron porque realmente esta MUY costoso los celulares en Venezuela, un celular gama baja lo venden como gama media y los gama media como gama alta, es una locura, un celular que en otro país cuesta $90 aquí cuesta casi $200 asi que tuve que priorizar ciertas cosas, esta vez no elegí la cámara por sobre otras características, quise fluidez al menos para las cosas que hago, no soy de jugar en el celular, más bien lo utilizo para comunicarme, ver videos, redes sociales, series… Y si he de jugar algo quizás sea candy crush > Back when I bought the Xiaomi with NFC, I did it mostly for the camera—it worked great for general photography and for taking pictures of my makeup looks. However, the phone’s performance was absolutely incredible to me; I’d never had a phone that fast before. This time, my priorities changed because phones are really VERY expensive in Venezuela—they sell low-end phones as mid-range and mid-range phones as high-end. It’s crazy—a phone that costs $90 in another country costs almost $200 here, so I had to prioritize certain things. This time, I didn’t choose the camera over other features; I wanted smooth performance at least for the things I do. I don’t play games on my phone—I mostly use it for communication, watching videos, social media, and TV shows… And if I do play anything, it’s probably Candy Crush. ![IMG_20260613_183809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23tvgJ7R1xvfyEp6ELh81UG5fnVR1q8Y6LWTV477fjvJTzPfuE9uUf6Ntac6SgnNMfkK9.jpg)

>Asi que encontré esta opción, no fue mi favorita pero confió en que me servirá para las actividades que suelo hacer diariamente, este es el Tecno spark 40C, la verdad se siente muy ligero y eso me gusta, es bastante cómodo de sostener, aún estoy configurándolo perro ya transferí casi todos mis datos y apps, por ahora ha funcionado muy bien, sinceramente esperaba que fuese bastante lento pero va bien. > So I found this option—it wasn't my first choice, but I'm confident it'll work for the things I do every day. This is the Tecno Spark 40C. To be honest, it feels really light, which I like, and it's pretty comfortable to hold. I'm still setting it up, but I've already transferred almost all my data and apps. So far, it's been working great. I honestly expected it to be pretty slow, but it's running smoothly. ![IMG_20260613_182438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xKxJPGJpNkc4taRQEDQ5canCDBX9QWQgkDxLQx9ZJ8aSh7LPsUqUQLkDa7NbBCsPvXs.jpg)

>Y aunque mencione que la cámara no es su fuerte, igualmente me gustaría probarla, pero primero debo aprender a usarla configurarla y explorar las opciones que tiene, además quiero probarla tanto de día como de noche. Realmente mi primera opción era un Tecno Spark 40 pero esa versión no había disponible, solo la versión 40C… Por ahora no me ha decepcionado, aunque es muy pronto para hablar pero a primera vista es fluido y bastante facil de manejar. > And even though I mentioned that the camera isn't its strong suit, I'd still like to try it out—but first I need to learn how to use it, set it up, and explore its features. I also want to test it both during the day and at night. Actually, my first choice was a Tecno Spark 40, but that version wasn’t available—only the 40C version… So far, it hasn’t disappointed me, though it’s too early to tell, but at first glance, it’s smooth and pretty easy to use. ![IMG_20260613_182445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhwwdUZSXN4QGkLkGxGXRTF6nxE1hAzXKnt1r1tkszzNq1EsvPpXv1RTy9TH6x3Rwr6.jpg) ![IMG_20260613_183431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wqiSCJnbz1vxmCLbWJChVFFEXiZkTHJAG7jpF7JqnAEnSxmy8Cop4kcM8gVL3hbSWZ6.jpg)

>Este celular costó $188 solo había disponible el color blanco y al abrirlo me di cuenta que traía su propio forro, es un forro suave y genérico que no se siente demasiado seguro, pero mas adelante comprare otro y tambien le pondré un vidrio templado. > This phone cost $188; it was only available in white, and when I opened the box, I noticed it came with its own case. It’s a soft, generic case that doesn’t feel very secure, but I’ll buy another one later and also add a tempered glass screen protector. ![IMG_20260613_182522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoK6pugyNmEWex7GP6CpgxdjnF7Mxa3RetTqCxcDqDnetGatECztqb6TRKLR38KzFUz.jpg)

>No saben lo raro que es acostumbrarse a algo que funciona bien, por ejemplo, he estado toda la tarde bajando y subiendo el volumen de mi celular nuevo desde la pantalla ya que es lo que solía hacer con mi anterior celular por que se le dañaron los botones jajaja. > You have no idea how strange it is to get used to something that works well. For example, I’ve spent the whole afternoon turning the volume up and down on my new phone using the screen—that’s what I used to do with my old phone because the buttons were broken, ha ha ha.

links.title: Diseased Veggies ,  Knowing how to take care of diseased Veggies, Planting and Replacement.
links.body: Hello Hive ==========
alt=\

/> After about some good period of harvesting, it is finally time to replace these fluted pumpkins veggies. If you take a look at these vegetables, the leaves are no longer soft like they used to be soft, tender and much edible. Whenever fluted pumpkins becomes tired of producing fresh leaves for food, it should be noted that at that time it is either we replace them and plant newer species or allow them to grow for a little while undisturbed wether they can produce some seeds for planting.
alt=\

/> Fluted pumpkins are meant to grow and last for at least 2year circle before they finally die off, that is for the type of specie we have on ground currently, their life cycle is two years, but one thing I have noticed is that for the fluted pumpkins that is planted for commercial purpose they may not last that long before they finally die off. The consistent harvesting often hardens the leaves and once there are no more fresher leaves being produced, the ones on the stems becomes very tough and not edible.
alt=\

/> The fluted pumpkins I have at home currently is about 3years old. Every year it produces leaves which we eat out of it, then it dies off towards the end of the year and gets revived again at the coming year. Whenever it comes alive, it does so with fresher and newer edible leaves. This has been on for 3years now
alt=\

/> But these particular commercially planted ones have only been around for a year now. The leaves have become tough and hardened. After a good while or harvesting, the leaves are turning burnt and no longer edible. And then finally they have now caught some diseases.
alt=\

/> Even after applying Pesticides to the veggies they still remain like this. Whenever this happens, it is a good sign to understand that we have to let go of these veggies and plant newer ones. Diseased plants should be uprooted and burnt in order to stop the spread of the disease to other veggies around. Then again these unedible veggies can be left to produce seeds rather than discarding them right away. If they are left without further disturbance or harvesting of the leaves, they can start producing seeds that will be useful for next session planting.
alt=\

/>\n\nWith farming we learn everyday and every little detail is important, sometimes what you think is a normal for a plant might not end up being that way and what we learn by experience sometimes holds more value than what has been documented about these crops.

links.title: Still floating on cloud nine after last LAUFEY Concert!
links.body: Hello Friends! Yesterday I share what I Think is the basic vision of Laufey’ s Carrier, my favourite one. Now I am sharing my personal experience going to her recent concert. It was on May 12, 2026; for sure an unforgettable day.
alt=\

/> As a teen-secondary student from the Philippines, coming to Hong Kong for my vacation was already a dream, but experiencing a live Laufey concert here was something straight out of a movie. Even before I got to my seat, I could already feel the bass in my chest, even though I was still miles from the venue. There was this nervous, electric flutter in my stomach that only happens right before a live show. 🎶 The concert began at 8 PM, and the second the house lights dropped and the arena went dark, a wave of goosebumps hit my arms. The collective roar of the crowd sent shivers straight down my spine. Looking around at thousands of people dressed in bows, ribbons, and vintage lace, passionately singing along to those beautiful jazz chords was easily one of the most distinctive concert atmospheres I’ve ever experienced. It felt like stepping into a timeless, romantic dream, so different from anything I’ve seen back home, yet so universally beautiful. The concert ended, but the room still felt heavy with the romance of her music, leaving everyone floating out into the night. Walking out of the venue, my ears were ringing with jazz harmonies, and I felt wrapped up in this warm, lingering magic that I didn't want to wash off. Thank you, Laufey, for the most magical night!
alt=\

/>

Hong Kong, you were absolutely beautiful. I’m going to hold onto this memory forever. ❤️🇭🇰

links.body: Так, несподівано для себе, як для любителя виключно великих собак, полюбила врятовану взимку бездомну маленьку Джес. Правда, це тепер вона - Джес, коли ми прийняли остаточне рішення залишити її собі. Але вона й досі відгукується на \

і купу всяких не дуже приємних до себе звернень. Бо не мала колись ні імені, ні дому. Навколишні люди навіть якщо звертали на неї увагу, то тільки тому, що щось живе крутиться навколо них...\nЗ моменту першої зустрічі, незважаючи на повну зашуганість собачки та її недовіру, я встановлювала свої правила спілкування: лапи на мене не ставити; їсти тільки по команді; пізніше - щоб поїсти, треба дещо виконати. Це були прості собачі команди, які навіть дитина може навчити собаку робити: \
.\nДуже швидко завдяки нашому спілкуванню \
мовою, практично без озвучки та звичних для людей \

, ми налагодили довірливі та безпечні відносини. Думаю, саме тому в той страшний морозний день, коли я побачила на морозі під відкритим небом її 6-х новонароджених цуценят, собачка абсолютно без вагань дозволила нам забрати їх у коробку. І сама пішла на ручки, і всю дорогу тихесенько сиділа у мене, навіть не намагаючись вириватися.
І поки Джес вигодовувала своїх діток на нашій літній кухні, я не дуже сильно диктувала їй свої правила. Та потім, коли всі цуценята були прилаштовані, заради цікавості та щоб не втрачати даремно час, я почала постійно вчити Джес всіляким цікавим трюкам. Ну щоб як у кіно: собачка танцює, собачка обіймає, собачка рятує.😁 І, як виявилося, - не треба ніяких породистих шукати для таких занять! Якщо ти зміг налагодити з самого початку спілкування контакт із собакою і ти при цьому - її вожак, то вона й на вухах ходити буде, тільки подай цю пропозицію правильною для неї мовою!
Якщо чесно, - непросто просувається наше навчання. Бо я не вмію вистроїти хореографію, послідовність трюків. Гублюся, і збиваю собачку з толку цим самим. Та немає нічого недосяжного, якщо сильно захотіти. Тож - далі буде!
А поки що - ми вже навчилися робити \

, чому я дуже рада! Але поки що тільки вдома. На фоні місцевих красот Джес позувати не хоче.😅

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Vfp6hqNLpTnWMZbO_IMG_20260609_184124.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/Vfp6hqNLpTnWMZbO_IMG_20260609_184124/Vfp6hqNLpTnWMZbO_IMG_20260609_184124.webp)
![vR5SuAYXZQcKEPCB_IMG_20260609_185933.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/vR5SuAYXZQcKEPCB_IMG_20260609_185933/vR5SuAYXZQcKEPCB_IMG_20260609_185933.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

每次来到根据地，总少不了饭局。推掉了一场，选了另一场相对轻松的。两位老领导相识多年，相处得如同老友，和他们吃饭，我也自在许多。
 
席间还有两位是领导的学生，一位在深圳经商，一位在本地营生。互相介绍完毕，我们便入席用餐。
 
我自觉坐到了末位，不料每个座位前都已斟好了黄酒。我已经两年没碰酒，眼下也不想喝，便坦言正在调养身体，以茶代酒就好。先前多位领导来南昌时，我和飞哥连同一众朋友一起接待，当时人人都喝了酒，往后每次相聚我也都会小酌几杯。如今我说滴酒不沾，几位领导都不大相信，只劝我把杯中酒喝完就行。
 
我深知一旦开了头就停不下来，唯有坚持不喝才是办法。几番推辞下来，场面一时有些尴尬，最后还是我松了口：“那就只喝这一点吧！”我无奈说道。
 
这次是领导的学生做东，我也算蹭饭了。每人先上了一份例汤垫肚子，广东煲汤向来出名，上回喝过的佛跳墙至今念念不忘。
 
桌上还有乳鸽、椒盐海螺等菜肴。几轮杯盏交错，不知不觉我喝了两杯，头渐渐发晕。只好不停喝水，身旁的矿泉水、茶水都被我喝了个精光。酒量不济，也只能靠多喝水来稀释酒意才不至于喝醉。

好在五个人就喝了一瓶洋酒，结束后我们也各自返回住处，到了酒店头还是昏昏沉沉的，休息片刻竟也立马缓和许多。领导打来电话问候我说自己喝多了，下次别让我碰酒了。领导还给我道歉，坦言没想到我有段时间没喝，竟如此弱不禁风。

一个人出门在外，保持头脑清醒才是对自己最大的保护，况且酒这东西本就不喝为好。生意有无也不是几顿酒就能换来的，如今这环境不强求喽！

---

Now the big question is what is the Splinterlands Alpha Pack? It was 2018 when Splinterlands (then called Steem Monsters) launched, this Alpha Pack was released as the very first edition of the game. This was the first 'Core Booster Pack' of the game. These packs are sold to launch the game and provide cards to the initial players. A very limited number of Alpha Packs were released and sold out shortly after release. An Alpha Pack contains a total of 5 random cards, just like any other normal Booster Pack. However, the layout of the cards within it generally follows the rules, i.e., each pack is guaranteed to contain at least 1 Rare card. Where many cards are needed to take the new edition cards to the maximum level, it is possible to combine these alpha cards with a small number to take them to the max level. However, currently the new Alpha Pack is no longer sold directly. But those who want to collect Alpha Pack, can collect it from Secondary Market or other NFT Marketplace. links.title: 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 14.06.2026
links.body: <div class=\

> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23y8N5wm8uxJRFGRmbSfc6H2sFdDxiSztW3GwUkMw7NZoxUwJBwqsSouup7dudYeSxCWH.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 14.06.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tvAs98A6vKwetiE2tmABemjJE2nELPGiGegb2RyV563bSHB33RcazQEWjd6LxBdm5mA.jpg)

---

## 📰 NEWS

### ***🚨 USA nakazuje Anthropic zawiesić modele Fable 5 i Mythos 5 — przełomowe przepisy kontroli eksportu AI***

W historycznej decyzji Biuro Przemysłu i Bezpieczeństwa USA (BIS) nakazało Anthropic natychmiastowe zawieszenie dostępu do modeli Fable 5 i Mythos 5 dla cudzoziemców z krajów objętych restrykcjami — w tym Chin, Rosji, Korei Północnej i Iranu — na podstawie nowych regulacji eksportowych dla frontier AI. Anthropic potwierdził dostosowanie do przepisów i tymczasowe ograniczenie dostępu do modeli klasy Mythos. Telepolis podkreśla, że decyzja może mieć globalne konsekwencje dla europejskich użytkowników i firm, które opierają swoją infrastrukturę na tych modelach. To pierwszy tego rodzaju precedens: regulacja eksportowa zastosowana bezpośrednio do modelu językowego jako \

— technologii podwójnego zastosowania.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23v4VKaUEvMxVLWH6wKgGLer7FrVrtZ6XY8q2GsabrJrn5Jucpt4ZQWjdvJxnWze4KMy3.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/us-gov-asks-anthropic-to-ban-foreign-national-access-to-fable-mythos/) [EN], [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/anthropic-says-it-has-taken-its-latest-ai-models-offline-to-comply-with-new-export-controls/) [EN], [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/us-orders-anthropic-to-suspend-fable-5.html) [EN], [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/oprogramowanie/topowe-modele-ai-tylko-dla-zarzadu-usa-blokuje-dostep-innym-krajom) [PL]*

---

### ***Chińscy hakerzy szpiegowali izolowaną sieć przez dekadę — nowy rekord trwałości APT***

BleepingComputer opisuje przypadek bez precedensu w annałach cybershpiegostwa: chińska grupa APT przez ponad dziesięć lat utrzymywała trwały, niezauważony dostęp do sieci organizacji sklasyfikowanej jako \

lub silnie izolowanej, poprzez kompromitację przepływu uwierzytelniania (authentication flow hijacking). Atakujący przechwycili legitymizacyjne mechanizmy sieci, nie zostawiając typowych śladów anomalnego ruchu. Incydent pokazuje, że \

sieci nie jest wystarczającym zabezpieczeniem, gdy logika uwierzytelniania zostanie skompromitowana na głębokim poziomie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQJYqECkwxSDQ5K3cSgg97UG9xbH5NCCBrVTARMnmcjjhgGYMMfzjF4Vn4MFFUbqS9K.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chinese-hackers-hijack-auth-flow-spy-on-isolated-network-for-a-decade/) [EN]*

---

### ***Walka o AI przenosi się na poziom państw — suwerenność technologiczna jako stawka***

Virtual-IT.pl opisuje narastający trend geopolityczny: kontrola nad zaawansowanymi modelami AI staje się elementem rywalizacji międzynarodowej porównywalnej z wyścigiem zbrojeń nuklearnych w XX wieku. USA, Chiny i UE budują odrębne ekosystemy AI — a decyzja o ograniczeniu eksportu Mythos 5 jest jednym z pierwszych widocznych przykładów, jak AI staje się instrumentem polityki zagranicznej. Dla Polski i UE rodzi to pytanie o własną suwerenność: czy uzależnienie od modeli z jednego kraju nie tworzy nowego rodzaju geopolitycznej ekspozycji?

*Źródło: [Virtual-IT.pl](https://virtual-it.pl/15664-walka-o-ai-przenosi-sie-na-poziom-panstw-stawka-jest-suwerennosc.html) [PL]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Iran (Handala) zhakował sieć wodociągową Kalifornii — mógł zrobić więcej, ale chciał wysłać sygnał***

Security Affairs potwierdza: irańska grupa hakerska Handala uzyskała dostęp do systemów operacyjnych (OT) dużego wodociągu w Kalifornii — systemów sterujących uzdatnianiem i dystrybucją wody. Atak nie spowodował zakłóceń w dostawie wody, lecz eksperci podkreślają niepokojący aspekt: atakujący mieli dostęp i możliwości do wyrządzenia poważnych szkód, lecz świadomie z nich nie skorzystali. To demonstracja siły i ostrzeżenie, nie sabotaż. Handala regularnie głosi możliwości destrukcji infrastruktury krytycznej USA i Izraela.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23z7DYvVqKcwfoFBbWvJfdqDbCaPhGWHskoqBUvhr5hAmz6CWXpTPg477AGDoTZZ4Sz1U.png)

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/193565/uncategorized/iran-linked-handala-breached-a-california-water-utility-it-could-have-done-worse-and-it-knows-that.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Krytyczna luka Splunk Enterprise — zdalne wykonanie kodu bez uwierzytelnienia***

The Hacker News opisuje krytyczną podatność w Splunk Enterprise — wiodącej platformie do zarządzania logami i monitorowania bezpieczeństwa, szeroko stosowanej w centrach SOC i przez agencje rządowe. Luka umożliwia nieuwierzytelnionemu atakującemu zdalne wykonanie kodu na serwerze Splunk. Ironia jest ciężka: platforma służąca do wykrywania ataków na innych staje się wektorem ataku na jej operatorów. Splunk wydało łatkę — wdrożenie jest priorytetowe dla wszystkich SOC-ów używających tej platformy.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkk3UFuQPfes1RLoxBa6HGvCeDMQgPCpgS4vTxxTbyH2nUb4o2D2tH2sf7e2SueRxL9.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/critical-splunk-enterprise-flaw-lets.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Były pracownik działu IT szkoły skazany na 21 miesięcy więzienia za sabotaż systemów byłego pracodawcy***

BleepingComputer opisuje sprawę zakończoną wyrokiem: zwolniony pracownik IT szkolnego okręgu w USA przez kilka miesięcy po zakończeniu stosunku pracy sabotował systemy informatyczne swojej byłej szkoły — usuwał dane, zmieniał hasła i zakłócał działanie e-learningu. Sąd wymierzył mu 21 miesięcy pozbawienia wolności. Przypadek ilustruje klasyczny scenariusz insider threat po zwolnieniu: organizacje często zbyt późno odbierają dostęp byłym pracownikom lub nie monitorują kont po terminie. Natychmiastowa dezaktywacja dostępu w dniu rozwiązania umowy jest absolutnym minimum.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tv6W71ADTuJvySQ9LKCETyEfUV3fvcKS5eXDGQz8KuyR6cReQfUedVDCwuW4QsX6hBh.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/ex-school-district-employee-jailed-for-hacks-on-former-employer/) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***mObywatel z przełomową nowością — urzędowa korespondencja i dokumenty rządowe w jednym miejscu***

Instalki opisują nową funkcję mObywatela, która fundamentalnie zmienia relację obywatela z administracją: aplikacja staje się centralnym miejscem do odbierania całej oficjalnej korespondencji rządowej — pism z ZUS, Urzędu Skarbowego, urzędu gminy i innych instytucji. Koniec z oczekiwaniem na listy polecone lub zagubionymi zawiadomieniami. Nowa funkcja automatycznie powiadamia o nowych dokumentach i pozwala potwierdzić odbiór z prawną skutecznością. To jeden z największych kroków e-government w Polsce od lat.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/243WTXGjgjMte8QBBFXSVbR2uryniMjdUnEnvCNixxFcYjkFqxRS1tUutrh7KZ4QASybA.png)

*Źródło: [Instalki.pl](https://www.instalki.pl/news/internet/mobywatel-z-przelomowa-nowoscia-urzedowa-korespondencja-w-jednym-miejscu/) [PL]*

---

### ***npm 12 zmieni sposób wykonywania skryptów instalacyjnych — defensywna odpowiedź na supply chain***

SecurityWeek opisuje zapowiedziane zmiany w npm 12 (menedżerze pakietów Node.js): skrypty lifecycle (preinstall, install, postinstall) będą wymagać jawnej zgody użytkownika lub konfiguracji projektu, zamiast uruchamiać się automatycznie. To bezpośrednia odpowiedź na falę ataków supply chain, gdzie złośliwe paczki exploitowały automatyczne uruchamianie skryptów do kradzieży danych bez wiedzy developera. Zmiana może jednak naruszyć kompatybilność z wieloma legalnymi projektami — jej implementacja będzie wymagać uwagi od maintainerów.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tv6DkX2GL8sbEzBn9ZZD59fnvQeQ63wJy4bVxVBManrsdH7faAbNQpMiDddSJsWSzBt.png)

*Źródło: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/npm-12-will-change-script-execution-behavior-to-prevent-supply-chain-attacks/) [EN]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***BNP Paribas wydaje komunikat — nowa fala oszustw wymierzonych w klientów banku***

GSMManiak relacjonuje oficjalne ostrzeżenie BNP Paribas: bank identyfikuje nasiloną kampanię wymierzoną w swoich klientów przez fałszywe SMS-y i e-maile podszywające się pod bank. Nowe schematy obejmują \
i \

. Bank podkreśla, że nigdy nie prosi o podanie pełnych danych karty lub kodu SMS przez linki w wiadomościach. W razie wątpliwości: dzwoń wyłącznie na numery ze strony bnpparibas.pl.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/Eopma5mL6h7q3d47yCfucekDi3NtX9HKwhe5y9mXiBy9byVh7imp5a8HWrzfUfTMzEp.png)

*Źródło: [GSMManiak.pl](https://www.gsmmaniak.pl/1664315/komunikat-bnp-paribas-ostrzezenie-oszusci/) [PL]*

---

### ***Nieudane próby logowania do banku to może być początek oszustwa — jak się bronić***

Techno Senior wyjaśnia mechanizm, który jest klasycznym wstępem do oszustwa \
: ofiara próbuje zalogować się do bankowości internetowej i dostaje komunikat o nieprawidłowym haśle lub blokadzie konta. Po chwili dzwoni \
, który pomaga \

. W rzeczywistości blokada może być celowo wywołana przez przestępców, a cały scenariusz jest zaplanowany. Artykuł zawiera konkretne wskazówki, jak rozpoznać tę pułapkę i jak zareagować.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wrA5JPDJjbiajgsCrFstpeHkZCexgobZQMbB3Kjo5XhfemPXHweGhGWjhsS26vDUerB.png)

*Źródło: [Techno Senior](https://techno-senior.com/2026/06/13/nieudane-proby-logowania-do-banku-uwazaj-to-oszustwo/) [PL]*

---

## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА

### ***Cybermagazyn — Globalny wyścig o ludzki umysł i rywalizacja poznawcza mocarstw***

CyberDefence24 publikuje analizę najnowszego oblicza globalnej rywalizacji — \

: walki o kształtowanie przekonań, emocji i decyzji społeczeństw przez celowe operacje informacyjne, deepfaki, manipulację algorytmami social media i dezinformację. Artykuł opisuje, jak Chiny, Rosja i inni aktorzy systematycznie inwestują w zdolności do wpływania na opinię publiczną w krajach demokratycznych. Polska jako kraj frontowy jest szczególnie narażona. Zdolność do krytycznego myślenia i weryfikacji informacji staje się umiejętnością obronną równie ważną jak znajomość cyberbezpieczeństwa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23rBG38NWvvfuMtahpnt1diinKHUyUetHiNjHRw7WQ5jaUytioRFuLTSYvWNdLHTWMuQm.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/cybermagazyn-wojna-o-umysl-najnowsze-oblicze-globalnej-rywalizacji-poznawczej) [PL]*

---

### ***Co oznacza blokada AI Fable 5/Mythos dla europejskich firm i polskich użytkowników?***

Telepolis analizuje konsekwencje decyzji USA o ograniczeniu dostępu do top modeli AI (Fable 5, Mythos 5) dla użytkowników spoza kręgu \

partnerów: jakie firmy w Polsce i UE będą dotknięte, czy istnieją alternatywy i jakie są implikacje długoterminowe. Artykuł stawia trudne pytanie: skoro USA traktuje frontier AI jako broń strategiczną objętą kontrolą eksportową, czy europejska suwerenność cyfrowa jest iluzją bez własnych modeli tej klasy? ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/EoeHoE1AaghwbdhT6XEudr4oYZfUMkKauJgNMBmMVkmxbLxFEdErBrC9YRMUio4D6Np.png) *Źródło: [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/oprogramowanie/topowe-modele-ai-tylko-dla-zarzadu-usa-blokuje-dostep-innym-krajom) [PL]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 13 czerwca 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

Good luck Ladies!!!
Make sure you read over the rules again, and bear in mind the importance of sourcing your images or quotes, and may the greatest imagination win!

Seven suggestions (reminders) to consider:

Guard your password and keys carefully, and only publish with the posting key,
Use your active key only for wallet transactions, Keychain, Peaklock, and Hivesigner
The Master Password and the Owner key are only used to reset compromised passwords,
DO NOT lose your passwords; copy and store offline,
Do not publish other people's work, be it photos or written, without credit, and be sure to source all of your work, even if it is your own.
An introduceyourself tag is used only once , and
Do Not open any links in memos or comments that you do not know who they belong to. If it sounds too good to be true it probably is, so the old saying goes. There is nothing free here.

Buena suerte chicas!!!
Asegúrese de leer las reglas nuevamente y tenga en cuenta la importancia de dar atribución a sus imágenes o citas, y que gane la mayor imaginación!

Siete sugerencias (recordatorios) a considerar:

Proteja sus contraseñas con cuidado y solo publique con la clave de publicación,

La contraseña del propietario solo se usa para restablecer contraseñas comprometidas,
NO pierda sus contraseñas; copiar y almacenar sin conexión,
No publique el trabajo de otras personas, ya sea fotos o escrito, sin crédito,
asegúrese de obtener todo su trabajo, incluso si es suyo.
Una etiqueta de presentación solo se usa una vez, y
Hacer NO abrir cualquier enlace en notas o comentarios que no sepa a quién pertenecen. Si suena demasiado bueno para ser verdad, probablemente lo sea, así dice el viejo dicho. No hay nada gratis aquí.❤️

links.title: Vamos para la playa calaonda
links.body:
Antes de irnos a la playa y apretara más el calor para caminar visitamos varios pueblos, lo que no recordamos es que era la celebración de San Antonio, así que vimos bailes, romerías y muchas celebraciones que no conocía. 


![1000899558.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3hBCsnphgBukqB4isnGfg9UbaVyQLj6AgrSccLLHa4g/1000899558.jpg)

A muchos de estos pueblos los llaman pueblos blancos por su pintura impecablemente de ese color.

Parece que ya me comí los datos de 5g que van más rápidos y ahora me quedan los más lentos y tengo tantas fotos para compartir, pero no voy a poder subirlas todas. 


![1000899813.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxA2K6qvPw75g3h9trbGAc9my1mj1TFLfHCSBkaMjfKy/1000899813.jpg)

Aunque hay muchos parking estacionamientos tuvimos que dar varias vueltas logramos pararnos cerca de playa calaonda y tiene un balcón donde se toman fotos hermosas. Era un castillo para proteger la costa, hay cañones antiguos y una vista para la playa espectacular. 


![1000899821.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUjoYVwiGuckDyXR9xYyrax1bYqdYKZeZTZQPkpE6ZA56/1000899821.jpg)

links.title: A small stumble
links.body: <div class=\

> Hi, I confess that today was a disaster because after everything I wrote yesterday about my weekend training plans, today I had to face a different reality. I couldn't sleep all night, and although for a moment I considered going to train without having rested, I knew it wasn't the right decision. # Sometimes it's hard to accept these changes of plans, especially when you already feel like you're not training as much as you'd like. But I'm also trying to learn to listen to my body. So instead of pushing myself, I rested as much as I could and then went to work. It wasn't the most productive day in terms of exercise, but at least I was able to make some progress with my reading, something I also enjoy and that has been helping me keep my mind occupied lately. Now I'm hoping to go for a run tomorrow with my group. The activity ends at a theme park, so in addition to the exercise, it will be a different and fun experience. And perhaps that's what I need right now: to stop focusing so much on what I didn't do today and think a little more about the good things that still await me tomorrow.
![IMG_2925.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU8U5zKLLmDSf8jXSBURKs7EgJebvQk4eGhH3pCt1Pjma/IMG_2925.jpeg)
Versión en Español

> Hola, confieso que mi día de hoy fue un fracaso porque después de todo lo que escribí ayer sobre mis planes de entrenamiento para el fin de semana, hoy me tocó aceptar una realidad diferente. No pude dormir en toda la noche y, aunque por un momento consideré ir a entrenar sin haber descansado, sabía que no era la decisión correcta. # A veces cuesta aceptar esos cambios de planes, especialmente cuando ya vienes sintiendo que no estás entrenando tanto como te gustaría. Pero también estoy intentando aprender a escuchar a mi cuerpo. Así que en lugar de forzarme, descansé lo que pude y luego fui a trabajar. No fue el día más productivo en términos de ejercicio, pero al menos pude avanzar un poco en mi lectura, algo que también disfruto y que últimamente me ayuda a mantener la mente ocupada. Ahora tengo la esperanza de poder salir a correr mañana con mi grupo. La actividad termina en un parque temático, así que además del ejercicio será una experiencia diferente y divertida. Y quizás eso es lo que necesito en este momento: dejar de enfocarme tanto en lo que no hice hoy y pensar un poco más en las cosas buenas que todavía me esperan mañana.

links.title: El Día que la Luna se Convirtió en Rayo de Sol /The Day the Moon Turned into a Ray of Sunshine
links.body:
<center>

En una alfombra mágica,
la luna un día baja,
llega a una ciudad solitaria 
pero el pavimento no le agrada,
es frío y eso lo espanta. 

Tras varios intentos,
deciende de ella sin miedo
y aunque está frío el suelo,
se va caminando lento,
la ciudad va conociendo. 

>On a magic carpet,
the moon descends one day,
arriving at a lonely city,
but it doesn’t like the pavement,
it’s cold, and that frightens it.

>After several attempts,
it steps down without fear,
and though the ground is cold,
it walks slowly
and gets to know the city.

![68044.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23z7BuzZqwTQVVDah32pEh2ktPTXWjxiQ7aJtgpS3D352YenqEsSGKd8EMTmzZhEvxcnC.gif)

Deja la alfombra mágica olvidada
y un planeta llega a tomarla,
es Mercurio que de azul anda,
se sube en la alfombra con ansias
y feliz al universo se marcha. 

Cuando la Luna al lugar regresa,
nota que robaron su pertenencia 
no puede irse y la noche llega,
entonces una nube se acerca
y le regala un suéter de naranja para que frío no sienta. 

>The magic carpet is left behind,
and a planet comes to take it,
it’s Mercury, gliding through the blue,
eagerly climbing onto the carpet
and happily setting off into the universe. 

>When the Moon returns to the spot,
she notices her possession has been stolen,
she can’t leave, and night falls,
then a cloud approaches
and gives her an orange sweater so she won’t feel the cold. 

![68045.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23w2sW7YH64Niepv83w4EYCJVVCk88sjx6S9iEvUPRiZC6FNyrtARjj9WouyQewXhYJbs.gif)

La Luna ahora está bien vestida
y cuando amanece en la villa,
el sol baja, se acerca enseguida
y carga al astro con alegría 
es un rayito de luz que añoraba en su vida. 

El sol, el rayo falso se lleva
y en el cielo se quedan
la Luna regresó a su vivienda,
ya no como astro de gris belleza 
pero si como un rayo de gran luminiscencia.

>The Moon is now beautifully dressed,
and when dawn breaks over the village,
the sun descends, drawing near at once,
and fills the Moon with joy,
it is a ray of light she had longed for in her life.

>The sun takes the false ray away,
and in the sky remain
the Moon, returned to her home,
no longer a celestial body of gray beauty,
but a ray of brilliant light.


![68292.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23u6B85kRU7Dmu8rWfFPhVptYrRCga7kUzukSzoRazhDvNFx6hBaACV4zdqXUcqBhFSYz.gif)

links.title: Splinterlands: Saltwater Mage is still a great damage dealer in Now You can See Me
links.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Saltwater Mage.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wLt8SQjZs8CDQ8oMxCc5C5N2sMxzGMXrxg4KmcutXrF2VSSH8ZXP73Xad5dwjMRZyX9.png)
Saltwater Mage is a water splinter that costs 8 mana. This splinter starts off with the sneak ability, but leveling it does increase its stats. I use this card quite often in Frontier due to its damage, and sometimes, having sneak is great at taking out that backline.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u5bFHApvMEooVdbs6dsvsrL94Hd25eaE7dmEQ5Yg82CPschFu1Kico9gdGzySv8N7wE.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Now You Can See Me and Lost Legendaries. This means that monsters gain the camouflage ability and no legendary cards can be used. There is also 25 mana available, and I can use every [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except fire and dragon.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Marlai Singariel|6|Summoner|+1 Magic|
|Asel Alagosdil|4|1st|Divine Shield|
|Lunaki Howler|7|2nd||
|Saltwater Mage|8|3rd||
|Total Mana:|25|||

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. My archon is Marlai Singariel because of the +1 magic. Asel Alagosdil is my tank with divine shield, and my backup tank is Lunaki Howler. After that is Saltwater Mage, and most of my damage done by those magic monsters. The ruleset will force my monsteers to focus down on the front, so I think this works out better in the long run.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmKrLab9dAt5FQsahtAtuNQA9AZM2atQF3oBVDUjiPA1Ajr1wg1hCnvYByCgDfYWj3W.png)
At first glance, I think that I have this match won because the magic monsters attack before ranged monsters, and my magic monsters have the same speed as his ranged monsters. 

### Round 6

![round 6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u67Fx2Ve9gBboTDcxiKLLKjNxAqbR1rkZKf3JMN91Q4VGWt2za11VbSWmC1uF8CAfqt.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent's lineup is reduced to 1 monster, and I still have all of mine. This match is my win because my opponent can't attack anymore.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tviisYm4G7LWWZq3AYWW7HekxgQ4i6F5kZuVjF67q39Znw537XXgt6KdBmBUjowSw83.png)
I won the match later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. Using magic monsters worked out well, and the ruleset only benefited me because focusing down monsters was better than spreading out the damage. My opponent was using ranged monsters, and I think that led to his downfall as they can't attack from the front.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_8f26fd3468e905264329510d219711b2?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![UhXMgdTeNMXs5Tg6_654cbca52e522a8520e858dd325770.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/UhXMgdTeNMXs5Tg6_654cbca52e522a8520e858dd325770/UhXMgdTeNMXs5Tg6_654cbca52e522a8520e858dd325770.webp)
![G0sWGPmFfPsiRKCP_c5705c7d80bafd1b0e9b473739e811_livephoto.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/G0sWGPmFfPsiRKCP_c5705c7d80bafd1b0e9b473739e811_livephoto/G0sWGPmFfPsiRKCP_c5705c7d80bafd1b0e9b473739e811_livephoto.webp)
![RiFf4L9ouxzJqfv1_bd7264a7c0afd0c8924a20501f09d2.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/RiFf4L9ouxzJqfv1_bd7264a7c0afd0c8924a20501f09d2/RiFf4L9ouxzJqfv1_bd7264a7c0afd0c8924a20501f09d2.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

近几年来，网络诈骗层出不穷，不断出现各类新式诈骗手段，让人猝不及防。日常生活里，我经常接到陌生号码打来的电话，座机来电我都会直接拒接。若是省内的陌生号码，我大多会选择接听，不过打来的基本都是推销贷款、房产之类的骚扰电话。

前天晚上我接到一通归属地为成都的陌生来电。接通之后，对方开口质问我，询问我的机票信息为什么出现在他的邮箱里。这番问话让我一时摸不着头脑，我的第一直觉便是对方有可能是骗子。

起初我以为对方拨错了号码，于是向他进一步确认。随后他说出了详细信息，问我是否预订了20号成都前往泉州的机票。我猛然想起自己确实购买了这趟航班的机票。

对方十分疑惑，不清楚为何我的购票信息发送到了他的邮箱。之后我向他索要了邮箱账号，发现他的邮箱和我的账号仅相差一个数字。我推测，当初在国航官网注册会员填写邮箱信息时，一时疏忽输错了号码，将邮箱写成了他的。

他致电我的初衷，是好心提醒我机票的相关事宜，担心我接收不到航班延误等通知信息。通话结束时他还主动向我致歉，可在我看来，真正该感到抱歉的人是我。

我不禁暗自思索，如果这条购票信息恰巧发送到了心怀不轨的人手中，对方会不会利用我的出行信息借机做出不法行为。万幸的是，这次我碰到的是一位善良的好心人。

挂断电话后，我立刻拨通国航客服的电话，申请修改邮箱账号。客服线路长时间无人接听，好不容易接通后，工作人员告知需要转接注册服务专线。与此同时，我登录国航官网，找到资料修改入口，及时更正了邮箱。这件事也提醒我，今后填写个人信息时必须万分谨慎。

links.title: Leaf-footed bugs
links.body: > This morning, I went back into the wilderness to hunt for beautiful insects. I left when the sun was just starting to shine and the air was still cool. Strangely, I explored quite a distance without finding a single insect. The area I was visiting was filled with bushes and grass that looked very fresh. It seemed the insects were still sleeping, or perhaps they had already hidden when they saw me heading this way.

> Not giving up, I continued exploring, convinced I had plenty of insects. I continued walking slowly but surely, until I finally came to a tree that filled me with joy. There, I found a group of leaf-footed bugs relaxing on the branches of the plant. It seemed like they had finished their work and were now ready to rest. Most of them were fast asleep.

> The insects I found looked ordinary and very small. However, it's important to know that behind their simple and small bodies, they are greatly feared by farmers, especially chili and tomato farmers. The primary targets of these insects are young branches, young leaves, flowers, and young fruit. They will pierce their needles into the target plant's tissue to suck out its fluids and nutrients. The result can be crop failure or even death of the affected plant.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcwqEAW9JAHB5gBwvBPxM84VNmfpJNMUV7sJjPLSa1CAg/1781409041608.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXS3FbZuaSKgagKsqoxXzCop7x2fHb7SF6NvStiGxfFn3/1781409041703.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVFdPaHNag7gPq1778Ht4JCssMPBYJPyu6VAH1zFvrPV/1781409041774.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmche9e3vCUVz85jz38wcZDywLJe5UHhUGMq8Q14hyYc3Q/1781409041850.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYyVr91zCtt8pCiydwdsUev7q8PjSphdZJQufgKg4UDVm/1781409041963.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4B92C6S95h8f27wP8JNgues1RjVM9W77ZcrgBhiTFRH/1781409058981.jpg) Latin name | Acanthocoris scaber | - | - | Observation date | 14 Jun, 2026 Camera used | realme 7 Pro Photographers | @reachdreams Location | Aceh, Indonesia | Link to original community | | - | https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/371470460 Latitude | Longitude | Map | - | - | - | 4.695135 | 96.7493993 | https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=4.695135&mlon=96.7493993

links.title: [ENG/ESP] A Saturday that gave us the peace of mind to move forward step by step
links.body:
<center>


![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EppLiDZBqbe1QWNuXr6WmeaXwvUUFuH5LBpxcmwDbuGtGhK6SnUGUMZXpbkb11Wnjx4.jpg)


</center>

<div class = \
>\n<div class = \

> **I hope you all have a nice break. This Sunday, I’m going to allow myself to rest a bit, recharge my batteries, and get my mind ready to tackle the pending tasks on Monday—and to be honest, I have quite a few of them. The break was necessary; my body and mind had been asking for it for days. This week, work demanded a lot of time, concentration, and effort, though I must admit that Saturday, by the end of the day, turned out to be a bit easier and more manageable. We got up early to take advantage of the cool morning hours. Since we had left one of the plant’s batteries running, there were still a few left to check. On every trip, the landscape always shows us its best side: mountains that seem to wake up early with us, a clear sky promising a bright and cool day—the kind that makes the journey more pleasant. It’s those little things that make a routine a bit more bearable.**

> *Les deseo un feliz descanso a todos. Este domingo, sí me permitiré descansar un poco, recargar energías y preparar la mente para comenzar el lunes con las tareas pendientes, que siendo les honestas bastantes tengo. La pausa era necesaria; el cuerpo y la mente la pedían desde hace días. Esta semana el trabajo demandó mucho tiempo, concentración y esfuerzo, aunque debo reconocer que el sábado, ya al final de la jornada, resultó un poco más suave y llevadero. Nos levantamos temprano para aprovechar las horas frescas de la mañana. Como habíamos dejado funcionando una batería de la planta, aún quedaban algunos pendientes por revisar. Siempre, en cada recorrido, el paisaje nos regala lo mejor de sí, montañas que parecen despertar temprano con nosotros, el cielo bastante despejado anunciando un día radiante y fresco, de esos qué hace más amable el camino. Esas pequeñas cosas son las que convierten una rutina en algo más llevadero.*
![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpvhNMoBUjCspHTZ3Gc4M7Rciut6zq4RgenjefWS78ZcLrnEHrzAhnf8q8zhfd3Aj4S.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQvGwFGKLgEY5GkWm4FaH3EwN7hpMUCc6qXUJegsDwpcTpkfnz8sofom8iEAakPSAb.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EokdbZdv1zxgYB6Jg42V1rK15oSFzefHHfSq8xhE2EBFCa9KhKi52XQE9wjQYWvFNdv.jpg)
>\n<div class = \

> **When we arrived at the hotel, we went straight to check on the calcium camera, which was due for maintenance. We need to replace some components and make sure everything is working properly to avoid any issues during the event. This kind of work requires patience and concentration to ensure everything is done correctly; when done right, it brings a tremendous sense of satisfaction.**

> *Al llegar al hotel, pasamos directamente a chequear la cámara cálcica, a la cual ya le correspondía mantenimiento. Hay que cambiar algunos componentes y asegurarnos de que todo quede funcionando correctamente para evitar inconvenientes durante. Este tipo de trabajos, requieren paciencia y concentración, para que todo quede correctamente, estos trabajos cuando se hacen bien, dan una satisfacción enorme.*
![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWjt7Cw59YUYdGhKn8D7pCQZ9PJnHonCvTuuHtdXMengSqCJkMBDSqH3BkP31yMGzE.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5D5pNsMEQYMuYJR2M72x9Xvm6jPLC5gpMNwRBWddTwGdciBjm3C2xcgg9x2yefEGh.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-38-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK7htvBM8VA7g1619C5BKCY66Wjhjb5y3q2nA4miHpWJKkqgE5G3BLM9GveCKAmhX8.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-37-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXJzZDBttzR3Cq4pHgELzw1RCYcxWPZsRRBxCU3RuMxAvYUJQ2pVuR4qQZzuKbp4MD.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-37-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA34SSHEypmKpjDcTUNeGM4uyoJiS2QcRQfz2whBNKWheQQ6y9E4ePq2npufoHc83D.jpg)
>\n<div class = \

> **Since we didn’t have any more urgent tasks to complete that day, we decided to call it a day early. We had to go into town to pick up some replacement parts for the filters, because without them we wouldn’t be able to continue with the work scheduled for next week. So the three of us—my husband, our friend Luis, and I—headed into town. The days have been sunny, but also unpredictable; from one moment to the next, it clouds over and a downpour hits. That’s why we preferred that Luis ride with us in the car. Wet pavement isn’t a good combination for a motorcycle, and we all try to be careful to avoid accidents.**

> *Como ya no teníamos más tareas urgentes por completar ese día, decidimos retirarnos temprano. Debíamos ir a la ciudad a buscar algunos repuestos para los filtros, porque sin ellos no podríamos continuar con el trabajo programado para la próxima semana. Así que salimos los tres rumbo a la ciudad; mi esposo, nuestro amigo Luis y yo. Los días han estado radiantes, pero también impredecibles; de un momento a otro se nubla y cae un aguacero. Por eso preferimos que Luis fuera con nosotros en el auto. El pavimento mojado no es buena combinación para la moto, y todos procuramos cuidarnos para evitar accidentes.*
![photo_2026-06-13_22-37-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23yJJhEdcEP7LmMjpd6aZczBYQ8fQawo9HgXoHt7JdcDQetA5gNbpQLS2PfmDAt8CaQfJ.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-37-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQP9QqP6T8tZG69R3ZAN1utWPu8J7tT1hAhNg7yBRxv58CsAkYNbBrxRLE5gaFjG6j.jpg) ![photo_2026-06-13_22-37-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCpmX3weM8ra1xGmMXxfGr6aVhNCLTTo7jJcPhNikj6NvPqs4ch8QH2BA7NwkDmRw.jpg)
>\n<div class = \

> **We visited several stores in the city. It was at Trompo where we finally managed to find some of the parts we needed. That gave us some peace of mind, because it’s hard to find everything on a Saturday—not all stores are open—and on Sunday, even less so. Finding at least some of what we needed was a relief. Knowing that we’ll be able to move forward without any setbacks next week filled us with satisfaction.**

> *En la ciudad recorrimos varios locales. Fue en el Trompo donde finalmente pudimos encontrar algunos de los repuestos que necesitábamos. Eso nos dio cierta tranquilidad, porque un sábado es complicado conseguir todo: no todos los comercios abren y el domingo, mucho menos. Encontrar al menos una parte de lo necesario ya era un alivio. Saber que la próxima semana podremos avanzar sin contratiempos nos llenó de satisfacción.*

links.title: Elon Musk, Social Media Rage, & The Death of Nuance
links.body:
![3dalliance-elon-8534074_640.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacobtothe/AJoDhrVg9XmuzeEMC7DD7rPd4H826Zn6qEvrCbtJe8fJN56FHbACgzExUXVvZXJ.png)
First things first: I am not an Elon Musk fanboy, simp, or cheerleader. I have a lot of doubts and concerns about him, his businesses, and his influence. However, any criticism of his critics is invariably assumed to be \

I want people to make better arguments, and I refuse to join bandwagons. Get over it.

What's this all about? The big news today is that [Elon Musk is officially the world's first trillionaire following the initial public offering of SpaceX stock.](https://www.forbes.com/sites/pr/2026/06/12/forbes-declares-elon-musk-as-the-worlds-first-trillionaire/) This had made many people very angry and has been widely regarded as a bad move (bonus points to whoever gets that reference!) especially on Web2 social media. This rage is usually expressed in ways which demonstrate a fundamental misunderstanding of many basic principles.

The facts: Elon Musk owns 4.8 billion shares and 350 million stock options, or a 38% stake in SpaceX, to paraphrase the information in the Forbes article linked above. This is worth around $800 billion based on current market prices of approximately $160/share. When added to Tesla, The Boring Company, Twitter, Starlink, etc. it seems his net worth is thus north of $1 trillion dollars. This is a mind-boggling sum, and I share a general suspicion of anyone who accumulates so much wealth, but not for the same reasons as the social media meme machine.

# That's just too much money!

It isn't money, it's the present market value of a business in which he owns a major stake. We aren't talking about Scrooge McDuck in a silo of coins here. If he sells his shares, it has two significant effects:

1. An influx of liquid stocks dilutes the pool of available assets on the market. This increase in supply means a new equilibrium point with the demand curve on the market. If he sold 5 billion shares, they would bring in far less than $800 billion.

2. For better or worse, SpaceX stock value is linked to Musk's ownership. Confidence in his business acumen is part of the reason people value stock in his company. If he divests shares, and thus ownership, the value people place on his company falls, potentially dramatically. Musk *holding* his shares is what many other shareholders value.

These are very basic principles, but social media rabblerousers invariably dismiss them, often openly. However, we can't have a serious discussion without building a foundation on facts. If these facts are in error, or omit further significant factors, feel free to chime in with a comment!

# That money could be used for X, Y, and Z!

Suppose you did get $1.1 trillion from confiscating all of Musk's assets and nationalizing SpaceX. Then what? \

If giving government money and power fixed problems, we would live in paradise. That trillion-ish lump sum barely cover just the *interest* on the national debt for one year. That total debt is now pushing $40 trillion, by the way, and the \
crimes.\

body.title: Sore throat: common causes and simple remedies
body.body:
Hello everyone, greetings 
Sore throat is one of the most common healtg problem we encounter. Most of us have experienced some form of sore throat till now.
But what actually causes our throat to become congested and feel painful ??? Let's discuss one by one.

![naturalherbsclinic-achalasia-5265848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4oTeQF2hDojkWKonDXx53HPJUYSuFFDedSBJWvHqMvy/naturalherbsclinic-achalasia-5265848.jpg)
Picture credits: Pixabay

**What is a sore throat?** 
Sore throat simply refers to painful swallowing due to irritating and scratch in the pharynx. Although it is a minor health problem and usually do not cause harm, understanding the simple basics of sore throat and how to deal with them helps us to combat them easily and prevents the use of unnecessary medications during the episodes of sore throat.

**Causes of sore throat**
1) Viral infections: The most common cause of painful swallowing is the viral infection specially with influenza, corona, adenovirus and parainfluenza viral infections, They are usually self limiting and do not require the use of antibiotics and usually settle down on its own within 5-7 days.

2) Bacterial infections: Certain bacterias like *streptococcus pneumoniae*, *streptococcus pyogenes* and *staphylococcus aureus* may cause bacterial throat infections and this condition is quite painful than viral infections and require the use of antibacterial medications for 7-10 days prescribed by a health care professionals.

3) Allergies: Allergic episodes caused by dust, pollen, hairs, dust mites, danders may trigger the throat congestion and post nasal drip that may cause sore throat. 

4) Vocal abuse: Continuous use of voice as in teaching and singing can cause strain of vocal muscles that may cause sore throat.

5) Acid reflux: Gastro-esophageal reflux disease can cause sore throat due to congestion of pharyngeal mucosa and constant irritation by the acid fumes to the airway.

*Remedies**

a) Gargle with saline water: Gargling the pharynx with lukewarm saline water helps to reduce the congestion, swelling and throat irritation.

b) Drink plenty of warm water, soup and herbal liquids that soothes the pharyngeal mucosa and provides relief.

![abbat1-tea-5982485.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf6poqsW9vKpaFxKZcnoMZCzYVQ5wF4yJkx72orUPrq9v/abbat1-tea-5982485.jpg)
Picture credits: Pixabay 
c) Stay in voice rest and avoid vocal abuse. Avoid shouting, prolonged speech and singing for a long period of time.

d) Keep a boiling water kettle or humidifier in the room to provide moisture to the air.

e) Avoid smoking and use of tobacco that may further trigger the airway irritation.

![27707-smoking-951984.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb3AQuYvqjCyNpiPqjhLoqDJzgQm5UPMx74oKeFRei7H7/27707-smoking-951984.png)
Picture credits: Pixabay

f) Can take the antihistamines like levocetrizine or  fexofenadine during night time sleep to help relieve the airway congestion.



**When to see the health care professionals??**
a) High fever and chills.
b) Sore throat lasting for more than a week.
c) Difficulty on swallowing and breathing.
d) White patches or pus points in the pharynx and tonsils.
e) Recurrent episodes.

*References*
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK559007/
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24589314/
