body.title: Deadwood Season 1 completed:  My thoughts
body.body:
As I have mentioned before *Deadwood* is one of those series that a lot of people hold in very high regard and yet I have tried on a number of occasions to watch it, but simply lost interest and put it on the back burner, only to not really be all that enthusiastic about turning it back on and just walking away from it.   I had the DVD box set for season 1 and loaned it to someone and simply forgot that I had done so.   This has happened with a lot of my DVD's and these days, I don't even have very many DVD's and the only DVD player that I have is inside my Playstation - which I never use for that and actually rarely use at all.  

<center> https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Deadwood_a_l.jpg?w=1440&h=810&crop=1
[src](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/11/Deadwood_a_l.jpg?w=1440&h=810&crop=1)</center> 

I finished season 1 of Deadwood last night and as one would expect, they wrapped up a lot of things that they had been working of for the 11 hours of episodes that came before it.  I feel like they did a pretty good job of character establishment and some of the storylines seem like they are just getting started, which I am sure was the intention.  

There will be spoilers ahead, although I will try to limit this as much as possible.

<center> 
![Spoiler-alert-news-feature.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/netflixr/23yU2gtwp7WWgX4bukgoQNVyepvScxRXKZDz4LNtB8uSrfspULssJJDc6dhfFAwmhG8gD.jpg)
</center>

So far, I would say almost all of what we have seen on screen was a 12-hour establishing of characters and an establishment of what the real \

of these characters are going to be in season 2.  There were not a great many things that got moving and resolved in Season 1 and if they were they were kind of issues that were meant to bring on more important happenings probably in season 2.   

One of the major things that the entire show kind of revolves around, is where is it that the *main character* (if there is one) Al Swearengen and whether or not he is a good guy, or a bad guy.   This role is brilliantly played by Ian McShane and to me anyway, is one of the roles that he is likely best known for.  

This guy can be a tyrant, but also can be a savior.  He has a shady past that he spends a lot of time and murders several people over keeping hidden, but at the same time he does some very generous things, some of which are completely selfless, for the benefit of the entire city.   One of the main instances of this happening is when he identifies an issue with smallpox appearing in the camp, then spends vast amounts of his own resources obtaining a vaccine and then distributing it for free.  

Later, he also forms a government of sorts including various positions inside that local government like mayor and sheriff, yet he never so much as even suggests that he should hold any of those roles.   We do kind of figure out that he doesn't actually need to be any of these things because he is so influential and powerful in the camp/town that he realizes the real power doesn't come from titles or positions, but in the influence that one already holds outside of these official positions.   Despite the fact that at least up to this point he holds no official titles, nobody really feels as though they can pull anything over on him.

Then we look over at the other main character Seth Bullock who is played by Timothy Olyphant.

<center> https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/timothy-olyphant-looking-intense-as-seth-bullock-in-deadwood.jpg?w=1600&h=900&fit=crop
[src](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/timothy-olyphant-looking-intense-as-seth-bullock-in-deadwood.jpg?w=1600&h=900&fit=crop)</center>

Olyphant, the actor, is one of those faces that when you see him, you think to yourself \

Well, it is probably *Deadwood* or *Justified*, both of which were quite popular series.  It's funny to me that in both he played some sort of moral law-enforcement type although in *Deadwood* he doesn't really want this position so much as he takes it on after others do such a poor job of it.  

These two characters are considered the central ones in the story and while I do think that Olyphant does a good job as Seth, he is completely overshadowed by the epic performance of Ian McShane.  

Other characters are interesting but they are outside characters who do play some part in the overall story, but you can tell that they are headed at some point in the future, to some sort of fitting end.  

<center> https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/deadwood/images/5/50/Farnum1870s.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200419191401
[src](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/deadwood/images/5/50/Farnum1870s.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200419191401)</center> 


E. B. Farnum is played really well by William Sanderson, and much like many other people in this series, he is one of those faces that you probably *almost* recognize.   E.B. is a sniveling snake and comes across as a coward who is trying to sneak his way into wealthy and influence by riding the coattails of people that are more talented and charismatic.  He annoys others more than he actually demands respect, and Sanderson' portrayal of this sort of person is spot on.  I knew a couple of people in my real life that were like this, and Sanderson really does a good job of playing a total pussy who thinks they are in a position of power.   When the time comes to elect a mayor, he nominates himself and nobody contests.  He takes this as a sign of respect and admiration by the others but it is actually because the truly influential and powerful people in the camp don't give a damn about titles.  

There are a ton of supporting roles and some of them come and go a lot quicker than you would expect and I feel as though this is done in a sort of shocking way that is meant to keep the viewers always guessing about who could die in the next episode.  

<center> https://i0.wp.com/bamfstyle.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/DeadwoodBill-CL2a-ShirtVest.jpg?ssl=1
[src](https://i0.wp.com/bamfstyle.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/DeadwoodBill-CL2a-ShirtVest.jpg?ssl=1)</center>

Wild Bill Hickock is introduced as a major and central character only to have himself get rather unceremoniously murdered in a very quick scene that I guess if you know more about frontier history than I do, you would have seen coming.  In our real world, this real person was genuinely murdered by being shot in the back while playing poker.   I guess it is my fault for not knowing about that, but I do recall hearing about aces and eights being the \

Other side characters that appear of great importance such as the preacher were pretty fantastic and at first glance you don't really understand their purpose in the overall story.

<center> https://unaffiliatedcritic.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Ray-McKinnon-in-DEADWOOD-1x11-Jewels-Boot-is-Made-for-Walking.jpg
[src](https://unaffiliatedcritic.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Ray-McKinnon-in-DEADWOOD-1x11-Jewels-Boot-is-Made-for-Walking.jpg)</center>

The preacher is tolerated by the camp's inhabitants because well, because he is a holy man.  But he becomes very ill and starts to kind of annoy people with his prophetic ways.  He is seriously suffering and eventually Al Swearengen puts him out of his misery not because he is annoying him, but because he can see that his life is simply one of pain and very little other purpose.   It is an act of mercy that makes us feel that perhaps Al is a good guy at heart, but also ruthless when something gets in his way.   

Al has a soft side when it comes to a lot of things and I think this is a major point of the entire first season.  He is established as a ruthless murderer early on, but as the season goes on there are several things that happen to show that he has a very humanistic side and is empathetic to the plight of others, he just doesn't allow himself to show it very often.   

As Season 1 concludes, there are many characters that are kind of pushed aside and forgotten, and there are others that are being pushed towards the \

if you will.  There is a rather obvious showdown brewing between Al and his main Saloon competitor Cy Tolliver, which is a character that is loosely based on a real person as well.

<center> https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cy-tolliver-powers-booth-deadwood-featured.jpg
[src](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cy-tolliver-powers-booth-deadwood-featured.jpg)</center>

Although they are kind of easing into it, you can tell that this person is going to become more and more of a thorn in the side of Al as time goes on, and while I do not have any proof of this and have avoided future spoilers myself, I can see his death being something that happens eventually.  You can't just open a competing saloon across the road from Al Swearengen and not have trouble come your way eventually.   

<hr> 

If you found that to be filled with spoilers I did in fact warn you at multiple times before you got to this point.  I did try to keep them at a minimum.

I do think this series is better than average but I have to be honest and say that I don't really think that this is as outstanding of a series as history would have us believe.   At the time of its release in the early 2000's I would imagine it was just amazing to see given the scope of it, but by my own standards and I suppose the reduced attention span of today's people (including me) things do move awful slow in this.  We have gone through 12 hours already and honestly, not a great deal has actually happened.   

I suppose from an artistic standpoint this is actually better.  They are doing to a \

approach as far as things are concerned and thus far, unless I completely missed something because I was zoning out, there hasn't been ANY narration of any sort yet, which it actually quite refreshing to see.  

I have heard from friends that season 2 is where things get truly entertaining, and I will start on that today.    

<center><sub> This series can be legally streamed as part of a Hulu, HBO-Max, Disney, or Starz membership and can be rented on many others </sub> </center>

body.title: Why is it important to take care of your mental health?
body.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/6669935/pexels-photo-6669935.jpeg [source]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/fashion-love-woman-relaxation-6669935/ ) Even though we give importance to everything in the world, the thing or matter that we do not give importance to at all or may not want to give importance to is our mental health. Which is actually a very risky matter. Because if a person does not take care of his own mental health day after day, he will suffer a great loss. Which is not possible to compensate. In fact, it is not possible to compensate. This is a very important matter. As much as we care about our physical health, as much as we worry, we are indifferent to our mental health. But taking care of mental health is much more important. The reason is that if we do not take care of our mental health day after day. If we neglect our mental health day after day, at some point we will reach a point where we will not be able to make any decisions for ourselves. body.body: > Then Claude noticed Alfred was installed and inspected the clipboard snapshots Alfred keeps in SQLite. Bad news: Alfred's clipboard history is deleted after 24 hours. Claude performed a raw scan of the DB, reverse‑engineered Alfred's data format, located the timestamp portion, reconstructed content across overflow pages... and recovered the exact final version of the report, the last thing copied with Cmd+C

body.title: Got a Lucky Ticket
body.body: So the 1 million dollar will turn into a huge sum of 270-280 million rupees. That is quite a lot, if you ask me. Even a dream of such intensity will seem unrealistic. But, I have recently watched \

, so I find it way more easier to believe it. So yeah, let me brag about it for some time.  


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRkgcxyXzgEsn1wMeBrmm6H5ZW5dLakcq8bDbC3yggdvU/1781412304490.jpg)

  
>**First Reaction**  
  
My first reaction would probably be disbbelief. In a country where pessimism has taken over life in every field and many people struggle to make ends meet, such an amount would be life changing, not just for me but for others as well. Yet, being a realist, I do not believe that suddenly receiving a large amount of money will automatically change everything.

>**For me, busy-ness is the real business**
  
So one thing is clear: I am not quiting my job at all. Many people might call me a idealistic for saying this, but I see work as more than just a source of income. It gives me structure, purpose, social experiences and opporutnities to learn something on daily basis. Therefore, I would continue working until I found myself fully engulfed with other things. Leaving everything behind just because money arrived does not seem like a wise decision. Financial freedom should create opportunities, not sluggish nature.  
  
>**Lucky in a while**

Another necessary thing is to understand that I would never rely solely on luck. Winning money may be a fortunate event, but building and continuing with it requires knowledge, discipline, planning and hard x smart work combo. History is full of stories about people who become rich overnight and lost everything within a few years. All this because they believed that luck is going to continue till death tear them apart. I would not like to treat this money as a reward to spend, rather as a responsibility to manage.

>**Win-Win Scenario**  
  
My major focus would be on building small and medium enterprises (SMEs) throught my country. While many people might expect investments in glamorous businesses or trendy stocks; I would prefer businesses that directly contribute to communities and create employment oppotunities.

Moving forward, I would establish dairy farms, poultry farms, agricultural gardens and eventually invest in commercial plazas and apartment buildings. It may sound traditional investments, but there is a reason these sectors continue to survive. They address basic human needs and provide long-term economic stability.

There is the bonus point in these businesses. They are not individual projects; they are communal efforts. They create a chain of opportunities that extends far beyond proper understanding. Let us say if these ventures collectively employed around 1000 people. Those 1000 individuals would then support their families, educate their children and contribute to local economies. In reality, those simple jobs would positively impacts thousands of lives.

I would love to see people earning through honesty and with dignity. That dignity is, often, more valuable than the money itself. Instead of creating complete dependence, productive bussinesses create sufficiency. The impact is shared by all. From owner to employee to family, from one family to another community, and ultimately, to society as a whole.

Agriculture related businesses would be of great importance to me. Because I come from South Punjab, a region largely famous for it contribution to such field. Investing in agriculture gardens and farmss would not only create employment but also contribute quite positively to the environment. It may be a meager drop, but it does matter especially in this harsh weather conditions. More trees, greener spaces and better practices can improve environment as well as economy.  

>In my opinion, the greatest form of charity is helping them become capable of standing on their own.

And of course, helping people would remain one of my priorities. However, my approach is slightly different in this manner. I would love to establish a charity house. Still, I would prefer a system that encourages folks to earn their way out rather than depend entirely on generations. Charity is noble and necessary, especially during the harsh times, but long-term sweetness is only possible through empowerment. Rather than simply giving away money, ironical I am getting it the same way, I would focus on creating training centers, emplyement opportunities even with zero experience and then skill developing programs. If someone can work, learn and grow, then they can also earn. It is this simple.

  
>**Knowing Taxes**  
  
Legal wealth in any form is full of taxation and financial compliances. Receiving and managing such a large sum requires better understandings. So, I would make sure that taxes, regisstrations and all relevants obligations to be handled properly. I am just going to hire some experts and then decide on the best approach. On humanitarian grounds, good financial management is not about avoiding taxes (still easy in this world); it is about understanding them and planning accordingly. And once again, responsible wealth benefits not only individuals but also the broader economy.

I would also dedicate 25 percent of the total amount to future investments and emerging world. As we all know, the world is changing rapidly. And I would like to stay connected with modern technology, renewable energy, education initiatives or innovative agricultural solutions.

In the end, traveling the world is certainly enjoyable. Buying luxury items also sounds tempting. But neither of those options would create lasting impact. And what about happiness? For me the real value of wealth lies in what remains after the excitement fades. Businesses continue operating. Employees continue earning. Families continue growing. Communities continue developing.

**\

. - Winston Churchill**

............................ 

This is my entry for IndiaUnited's [Contest](https://ecency.com/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-634cceffd1172): What would you do if you won $1 million tomorrow?

body.title: 🎮 In Today's Episode of Narco Whac-A-Mole
body.body:
![1000180471.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melrod97/23xVCyZGYwKJwmPpazxW23Cucs3w8eibqhstuCwRcwzWF7n3eBUGTh19rEfbqKHHXknQN.png)

In the latest must-watch episode of Narco Whac-A-Mole, Donald Trump announced that the U.S. military, teaming up with Venezuelan authorities, delivered a premium Amazon Prime “kinetic strike” on Niño Guerrero turning the founder and top leader of Venezuela’s Tren de Aragua gang into red confetti. One of their finest misunderstood angels, of course.

Color me absolutely devastated. Personally, I could do with a few more of these sudden “retirements” for the narco set, especially the ones running their little empires right in our backyard. Call me old-fashioned, but watching cartel entrepreneurs treat borders like suggestions has gotten more than a tad tiresome.

Tell me honestly: Would you rather live in a country worth staying in, or one you have to desperately flee?

I know, I know human rights, due process, rule of law. Those lovely, fragrant words that always seem to drape like a warm blanket over the predators while their victims get buried, bled dry, or buy one-way tickets out of hell. Spare me the TED Talk about these misunderstood little angels.

Guerrero didn’t exactly run a soup kitchen. His crew specialized in drug trafficking, human trafficking, extortion, kidnapping, and migrant smuggling the fun stuff that turns “living your best life” into a luxury most normal people can only dream about.

It’s almost poetic how bleeding hearts clutch their pearls over a gangster’s rights but get instant amnesia about the families he destroyed, the migrants he preyed on, and the neighborhoods drowning in fear. How many victims does it take before we drop the “product of their environment” fairy tale and admit some people just needed consequences, not a hug and a participation trophy?

And while we’re at it: What better fix for the migration crisis than making people actually want to stay home? Less death-defying journeys, more thriving where they were born. Crazy idea, I know.

The real plot twist? Caracas and Washington suddenly playing nice after years of icy glares. Unprecedented cooperation, they say. Almost as if even the toughest regimes eventually tire of the chaos they export or maybe someone just isn’t leaving them much choice.

No arm-twisting required next door in El Salvador under Bukele. The country went from murder capital of the hemisphere to one of the safest in the Americas simply by deciding gangs aren’t a protected species. Homicides cratered. People can walk the streets again without writing a will first. Approval ratings? Still soaring above 90%. Turns out when you stop coddling the wolves, the sheep quit getting eaten and start throwing parades for the president. Shocking.

So here’s the question that actually matters: When do the rights of ordinary citizens the ones waking up to grind, build businesses, raise kids, and follow the rules finally move to the front of the line? The ones who make a country worth visiting instead of escaping. In my view, there’s a point of no return. That’s when the gloves come off and the criminals get to sample the same fear they love serving their victims.

Now the big one: Will taking out Guerrero actually cripple Tren de Aragua, or is this just another round of whack-a-mole with a fresh head popping up tomorrow? 

What’s your take? 🤔

body.title: Film Review of Fear Street 1994 (2021)
body.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcAvoKVgW7F4oiJxJ26DqnJXRBCs44jgAwMjj85nQtLUC/image.png)source: imdb Netflix's Fear Street Part One: 1994 is the first movie of a trilogy or rather one big movie cut into three parts since they were released in the same year. It was based from the great R.L. Stine's book series (although a lot of things changed in the movie). Watching this movie I thought about Stranger Things not just because of Sadie Sink but because it has a lot of 1990s nostalgia. **Plot Summary** ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmey9jD5xdNUzHMbUhc6sENUGS2bprWjFeCmYDceP7vp8C/image.png) He looks like the slasher from Scream. source: imdb The story takes place in the cursed town of Shadyside. It's a town plagued by tragedy, violence and bad luck for centuries. The main character was Deena Johnson, a teenager who struggles with a recent breakup from her girlfriend Sam Fraser who moved to Sunnyvale, a town the complete opposite of Shadyside since it enjoys endless prosperity. After a strange accident involving Sam, a series of scary events begins. Deena and her friends soon found out that an old witch named Sarah Fier may be the cause for the horrors in Shadyside for generations. As killers from the town's past emerge and start hunting them, the group must uncover the truth behind the curse before they become its next victims. **Analysis and Recommendation** At first, the feels like a classic teen slasher inspired by movies such as Scream, but it soon becomes a supernatural mystery with deep lore like R.L. Stine's writings. The movie has nostalgia with 1994 setting and a soundtrack of songs from the era. The music helps create a sense of nostalgia. The scary parts and creative kills will satisfy horror fans of slasher movies. Despite being based on a young adult book series, Fear Street 1994 is violent. I was drawn more to solving the mystery surrounding Sarah Fier. It was intriguing and kept me to finish the whole series. Fans of the original book may not like the big changes on Sarah Fier but I would like to think it's another plot that R.L. Stine could have taken in the books. I read the original book series and I thought, the movie was a great adaptation/alternate story. The story wasn't bad, it's just different from the book. I highly recommend Fear Street Part One: 1994 and the rest of the series to horror enthusiasts looking for a fun and mysterious movie. The film's violence and intriguing mystery make it one of Netflix's most enjoyable horror movies.

body.title: Yesterday's fish buying experience.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260611162617~3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXCcF34zU39nn5iC9E5zvng46VQe6s5xGCabzExPgYvw2/IMG20260611162617~3.jpg) Yesterday, on a holiday, I went to the local market to buy some fresh fish for my family. In our Bengali culture, the Bengali word for fish and rice did not come up just like that, if there is no fish in the daily diet, it seems that there is no satisfaction. However, the market situation is quite different these days. The first shock that the common man experiences when he goes to the market is the high price of fish. In every fish shop, the sellers are charging high prices, which is going beyond the reach of the middle class and ordinary buyers. ![IMG20260611162620~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSqecch1WGZgf8PVwBWwYQ9hkKx7H3fDgMVwzUSrViB5/IMG20260611162620~2.jpg) Upon entering the market, the first thing that caught his eye was a collection of live fish in large containers. The sellers are constantly sprinkling water on the fish to keep it fresh. Especially the live fish like Sing, Magur and Pangash fish are beautifully arranged in quite large containers. Although I wanted to buy them after seeing the fresh fish, I had to stop a bit after hearing the price. The price of each fish seemed much higher than in the past few weeks. ![IMG20260611162624~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeFiHSnUY2BNAaJGFNH91QLCtoiJHwyuEP8sufSNWHRis/IMG20260611162624~2.jpg) Then, as I moved a little further inside, I saw small and medium-sized white fish arranged in rows on a table covered with red cloth. There, the fish seller was trying to attract buyers by shining bright lights on his shop. The scales of the fish were shining under the lights and the fish were being measured continuously on the scales kept next to it. Here, the abundance of fish like rui, mrigal and carp was remarkable. But here too, there was no relief in terms of prices. I had to haggle with the sellers for quite some time. ![IMG20260611162635~3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRGSupcJLGSvxe1ZEC8DKqAPsQEbUmNC2w45m13V4Vkqn/IMG20260611162635~3.jpg) In another part of the market, the sellers were sitting on large benches covered with blue tarpaulin, arranging different species of fish. There, pabda, tangra, tilapia and large-sized rui or katla fish were neatly stacked. Buyers were surrounding them and bargaining. Despite the abundant supply of fish in the market, there was no sign of a decrease in prices. All in all, the price of fish in the market is now skyrocketing. It has become quite difficult for the common man to meet the daily requirement of this essential protein. Still, considering the family's nutrition and preferences, I finally bought some fresh fish after bargaining a bit. Although the pocket was a little lighter due to the price, at the end of the day, the smile of satisfaction on the faces of everyone in the family and the taste of fresh fish made me forget the trouble. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: 😝International Rock Day! / ¡Día Internacional del Rock! 😎
body.body: > ***June 13th is celebrated annually as International Rock Day.*** This day invites amateur and professional geologists from around the world to get excited about rocks. The study of rocks is important because it reveals so much about the planet. It can help us understand the planet's history, identify where natural resources might be found, and contribute to engineering and construction projects. > El 13 de junio se celebra anualmente el Día Internacional de las Rocas. Esta fecha invita a geólogos aficionados y profesionales de todo el mundo a entusiasmarse con las rocas. El estudio de las rocas es importante porque nos revela mucho sobre el planeta. Puede ayudarnos a comprender la historia del planeta, identificar dónde podrían encontrarse recursos naturales y contribuir a las labores de ingeniería y construcción. The study of rocks is also important for environmental and planetary sciences. Although we don't know for sure who invented International Rock Day or when it was created, we do know that it's a holiday established because the study of rocks is important for human survival, and this has been the case throughout human history. > El estudio de las rocas también es importante para las ciencias ambientales y planetarias. Aunque no sabemos con certeza quién inventó el Día Internacional de las Rocas ni cuándo se inventó, sí sabemos que es una festividad creada porque el estudio de las rocas es importante para la supervivencia humana, y así ha sido a lo largo de la historia de la humanidad. Early humans needed rocks to make tools like flint hammers and knives, building materials for foundations and dwellings, and for spiritual purposes. Many ancient peoples even used rocks for medicinal purposes. The Greeks and Romans used powdered rocks to treat blood disorders, and the Egyptians used azurite for arthritis and liver problems, and malachite for eye infections. Even sulfur was useful in ancient medicine. It was used to treat acne, eczema, and other skin conditions. Learning about rocks and minerals is probably the main way many people will want to celebrate this day. However, it doesn't have to be the only way. You can also take the opportunity to collect rocks, create art with them, or use them for other purposes. > Los primeros humanos necesitaban rocas para fabricar herramientas como martillos y cuchillos de sílex , materiales de construcción para cimientos y viviendas, y con fines espirituales. Muchos pueblos antiguos incluso utilizaban rocas con fines medicinales. Los griegos y los romanos utilizaban rocas pulverizadas para tratar trastornos sanguíneos, y los egipcios empleaban azurita para la artritis y problemas hepáticos, y malaquita para infecciones oculares. Incluso el azufre era útil en la medicina antigua. Se utilizaba para tratar el acné, el eccema y otras afecciones cutáneas. Aprender sobre rocas y minerales es probablemente la principal forma en que muchas personas querrán celebrar este día. Sin embargo, no tiene por qué ser la única. También se puede aprovechar para coleccionar rocas , crear arte con ellas o para otros fines. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thealliance/SszMQ6lq-thealliance20new20pagebreak.png ## Family Time!

It just may be worth your time to [visit the Castle](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) and come check us out. Unlike the 'Addams Family' shows, all of this is live, unrehearsed and not recorded before any audience. Funny things happen. Sad things happen. Smiles and tears get shared. Worries and hopes are passed around. Sometimes, we even eat #pizza, cake and ice cream. Sometimes, we watch movies. Sometimes, giant insects attack the microphones and we have to get out our silly swatters and smack 'em up so we have something to snack on because the popcorn got eaten already by little slugs that left slimy trails everywhere and made the sidewalks slippery so that the pancakes didn't get enough traction on our canoes to steer the spaceships. Exactly. > Puede que valga la pena dedicar tiempo a [visitar el castillo](https://discord.gg/EpyXNyh) y venir a vernos. A diferencia de los shows de 'La Familia Addams', todo esto es en vivo, sin ensayar y no grabado ante ninguna audiencia. Suceden cosas divertidas. Suceden cosas tristes. Se comparten sonrisas y lágrimas. Se transmiten preocupaciones y esperanzas. A veces, incluso comemos #pizza, tarta y helado. A veces vemos películas. A veces, los insectos gigantes atacan los micrófonos y tenemos que sacar nuestros tontos matamoscas y golpearlos para tener algo de comer porque las palomitas de maíz ya se las comieron pequeñas babosas que dejaron rastros viscosos por todas partes y dejaron las aceras resbaladizas para que los panqueques no tuvieran suficiente tracción en nuestras canoas para dirigir las naves espaciales. body.title: Tour of the historic center, discovering its beautiful murals and narrow streets (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**



Continuing my tour of the city's historic center, home to important plazas, colonial houses, and sites of significant events that contributed to the city's establishment and founding, as well as a spectacular view of the Manzanares River, I'd like to share my visit to an area known as the Historic Center Commune. This area begins at the front wall of the San Francisco Convent and extends to the Coco Dorado nursery and the adjacent areas between Sucre Street and Aristiguieta Avenue on the national highway towards Cumanacoa. This space is notable for its striking murals and a large open area in front.

Part of the reenactment of Old Cumaná takes place here to commemorate the city's birthday every November 27th. It's an open area where models and representations of the indigenous groups or the pre-Columbian era are typically displayed. This celebration encompasses several stages; Aboriginal, colonial, independence, and contemporary, the site features several levels that serve to represent the dwellings and economic activities of the indigenous people. There is also a billboard with the figure of Antonio José de Sucre and the phrase \

followed by a beautiful mural depicting La Ermita Street, where it is believed the Marshal of Ayacucho was born. Previously, a church stood there where he was baptized, and in the background, the Santa Inés Church can be seen. The houses stand out for their colorful facades, large doors and windows, and front gardens. The mural is extensive, and to get a complete shot, I had to position myself on the other side of the road. In the following photograph, we see a side view of the mural and details of the houses. On one side, you can see the houses, the flowerpots in front, the wooden doors with rectangles like the windows, the roofs are mostly conical and share the characteristic of a cornice covered with tiles, then we observe the land and there are several trees as I mentioned at the beginning, among them the Bougainvilleas, in fact these plants are common in this area, next to the mural we have the identification of the sector which is called Historic Center, I liked the design, the type of letters and the lamp that adorns it, which corresponds to those that were used in the colonial era.

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**



Continuando mi recorrido por el centro histórico de la ciudad,  donde se encuentran importantes plazas,  casas coloniales y escenarios de eventos relevantes que contribuyeron al establecimiento y fundación de la ciudad,   además una espectacular vista del río Manzanares,  les comparto mi visita a un sector conocido como Comuna centro Histórico,  que inicia en la pared  frontal del convento San Francisco y se extiende hasta el vivero coco dorado y las sectores adyacentes entre la calle Sucre con avenida Aristiguieta en la carretera nacional hacia Cumanacoa,  este espacio destaca por su llamativos murales y un amplio  terreno ubicado al frente.

En este espacio se  realiza parte de la escenificación de la Cumaná de Antaño  para conmemorar el cumpleaños de la ciudad cada 27 de noviembre,  es un área abierta,  donde generalmente se ubican las maquetas y representaciones de los grupos indígenas o etapa aborigen,  esta celebración abarca varias etapas; aborigen, colonial, independentista y contemporánea, el terreno cuenta con varias plantas las cuales sirven para la representación de las viviendas y actividades económicas que realizaban los indígenas, también  hay una valla publicitaria con la figura de Antonio José de Sucre y la frase \

, luego un hermoso mural que representa la calle la Ermita dónde se cree que nació el Mariscal de Ayacucho, anteriormente había una iglesia donde fue bautizado y al fondo se ve la iglesia Santa Inés. Las casas destacan por sus fachadas coloridas, puertas y ventanas grandes, jardines al frente, el mural es amplio y para lograr una toma completa tuve que ubicarme al otro lado de la carretera, en la siguiente fotografía vemos un lateral del mural y los detalles de las casas; rejas, puertas, jardines y los techos con una cornisa de teja, en el otro lado se aprecian las casas, los materos en el frente, las puertas de madera con rectángulos al igual que las ventanas, los techos son de forma cónica, en su mayoría y comparten la característica de una cornisa cubierta con tejas, luego observamos el terreno y hay varios árboles como lo mencioné al principio, entre ellos las Bugambilias, de hecho estas plantas son comunes en esta zona, al lado del mural tenemos la identificación del sector que se llama Centro Histórico, me gustó el diseño, el tipo de letras y la lámpara que lo adorna, la cual corresponde a las que eran utilizadas en la época colonial. ![coco dorado (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EprUZwzKNArumNukxnbKzAMkWb7y27TKtJ95oQMBu76PcWXneWFNnN8u2Pvny7fdHHN.jpeg) ![coco dorado (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqL6mWfmiJyoVajDwCwhNYcWZEoXCdTyCCR89hwMfrHJfCoepugV5UfSTbr3YWYVgej.jpeg) ![coco dorado (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpQuuccYqWaJsAJH6odPbNG82ZDKrK8HGivyy6n4KhHBJLcv7podvfuLQNxjwrnwjNm.jpeg) ![coco dorado (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpnCHe7Ao9p32PNkZqNdnGFYrowDGceVQFLftt34p2XdWuuamg5CBJQas8xo6vq1NSz.jpeg) ![coco dorado (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23zkreGG1Aunjfib5W7KJpBoGXbTgqQ4PKHso562hkuBj1wHA43pQ5rZFY91HMJRVvpry.jpeg) ![coco dorado (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eou8f8EE83ZHS4Sn27QUGYT4tJPEQ6pnqkvYbFnNBMnXW7jzRR2Q1QoZw4GDVzGFMtN.jpeg)

> After exploring the mural area and the grounds in front of the convent, we headed towards a striking building with colorful murals. My favorite was the one of a girl with many flowers in her hair. In the background, there's a bougainvillea plant that also resembles the young woman's hair. Next to it is a sunset mountain landscape with various birds flying. Beside the mountain, a waterfall with blue water, perfect for cooling off. There's also a beautiful path leading up the mountain, surrounded by lush vegetation. The scene ends with a spectacular beach, palm trees, and birds flying at sunset. With the idea of ​​exploring these narrow streets, we went up, and I must say the view from the top is very beautiful. I couldn't take pictures because my phone battery was low, but we were able to see part of the city, specifically the convent, some plazas, and many houses with characteristic colonial roofs. The houses have striking colors and a protective wall that runs along the entire block, painted with various colors that combine geometric shapes such as squares, rectangles, and vertical lines. This is my first time visiting this area and I liked the design of the houses and the beautiful view from this point.

> Luego de hacer un recorrido por la zona de los murales y el terreno al frente del convento, nos dirigimos hacia un llamativo edificio con coloridos murales el que más me gustó es el de una chica con muchas flores en el cabello, en la parte posterior hay una planta de Bugambilia que simula también el cabello de la joven, luego un paisaje de montañas al atardecer con varias aves volando, al lado de la montaña una cascada con agua azul ideal para refrescarse, también un hermoso camino que conduce hacia la montaña rodeado de abundante vegetación, el cuadro termina con una espectacular playa, palmeras y aves volando al atardecer. Con la idea de explorar estas angostas calles subimos y debo decir que la vista desde arriba es muy bonita, no pude tomar fotos porque ya el teléfono tenía poca batería, pero pudimos ver parte de la ciudad, específicamente el convento algunas plazas y muchas casas con los característicos techos coloniales; las casas tienen llamativos colores y un muro protector que abarca toda la cuadra, el cual está pintado con variados colores que combinan a su vez figuras geométricas como cuadrados, rectángulos y líneas verticales; es la primera vez que visito este sector y me gustó el diseño de las casas y la hermosa vista que se aprecia desde este punto. ![coco dorado (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoiX6w2WDJVkcyxufHgaEtrH4GdK4UCiUg5bBAAZ84s7NZob3Zm2ZS2XpDniQefHToH.jpeg) ![coco dorado (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpXJvBsUMKc9WVBHSQrahW1Ak11iD9bJQQRBewWDvtmmB6mvz1bfmygmLRNoLBBzMbe.jpeg) ![coco dorado (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EowGdCQ8NqZj8c1GeCE9BKsXMg1KuihV7chgrfpVBaXFjY5CoFmMLAZnvXj6pSrFvft.jpeg) ![coco dorado (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eou9BG4sfhcAooQMttQnxDmFFsMmXwAmG2itZxwDj3PHFToBPwLUCA1L6gn9Rz4doa1.jpeg) ![coco dorado (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eou9eYvNmQKJoV1WkZjwKB2p6b19kLddKswhiVeE5aU2UTut1CLVcFUGkcL5E5PGWxq.jpeg) ![coco dorado (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep1XKa1ff432VdaAeCCRReRSx3KfzyrNRZ1zAHqg154UvM44Nfdtd5Pfqq4NN278Spp.jpeg)

> ![coco dorado (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eq5DwiHCZmSYfTk1UHoTa4gRbth9tjyQhNN3FuSzJVbjyCNN8Hu1iaLhpC5NVzbsMZJ.jpeg) ![coco dorado (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/244xuL5sumxEAY7LoVhWXKyhmTB2RXefgiHd4a5PFKEwPbjkzasWA61vBSfGc5ArVFuA7.jpeg) ![coco dorado (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eq9UMPG2Ls3YFuPtG6UYaGm8FY3hZ6Gp3JRppwVgZV9vh8wSuEcjfSN3Zf47nFeTJeB.jpeg) ![coco dorado (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnaYL56m47fXKmuSnF7U7uTq4noEwgxdfvwVLR8zVYAeMk1Qumy5AdNKib4dPvVktXb.jpeg) ![coco dorado (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpzyFtuYPPhWEFREuy9oaLqvySdSm112VxkeVzHAB6z7gEmYonptfjVvvUciz1Rc1S5.jpeg)

Este será un espacio para reportar el contenido publicado por @emmaris e igualmente las ganancias serán destinadas para ella al 100%. Hemos decidido crear este reporte para tenderle una mano amiga a una joven madre venezolana, de 36 años, que lucha contra el cáncer que le diagnosticaron en el Estado Nueva Esparta (Isla Margarita) en Venezuela. Específicamente, se le descubrió hace pocos meses un Carcinoma de mamá izquierda y el 23 de febrero le practicaron una Mastectomía Radical. Emmaris es miembro de nuestra comunidad, porque ella publica contenido sobre su hijo de 10 años con autismo no verbal. Además de su príncipe azul, tiene dos hijas pequeñas, una de 6 años y una bebé con pocos meses de nacida. Desde este espacio los invitamos a corroborar la veracidad de su situación a través de sus propias publicaciones, las cuales serán compartidas aquí semanalmente o de acuerdo al ritmo que Emmaris mantenga publicando en HIVE.

body.title: Letras Inspiradoras: ¿Cómo estuvo tu semana?  •||•  Más que Rutina, una Experiencia: Mi Semana Entre el Aula y el Hogar 💖
body.body:
![Letras inspiradoras.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23ynhUeQRt2NuXxTLBoJUazpBaKhU7u6Eqfb7D4Ssr1MtCagr3UpXg8gruVdm1hgdVziN.jpg)
_Photograph of my property._
---
# _Bienvenidos a mi blog_ > _Welcome to my blog_
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGwUbNZi2yp7ysrC2tseYCpCKRy3p3ULs2EQjfXUChQj1PFbpgyXdpYpwHscyz4gNv7.png)

> #
_Español_

Hola mis amigos de Hive y esta linda comunidad es un placer estar con ustedes, en esta nueva oportunidad me uno a la iniciativa de la amiga @syllem en vamos a hablar un poco sobre _**¿Cómo estuvo tu semana?**_, además que este tema es bastante importante para las personas y en la actualidad, espero les guste.

> #
_English_

Hello, my friends from Hive and this beautiful community! It is a pleasure to be with you. In this new opportunity, I am joining the initiative started by our friend @syllem, where we are going to talk a little bit about How was your week? This is quite an important topic for people nowadays, so I hope you like it. ---

## _🌺 Letras inspiradoras: ¿Cómo estuvo tu semana? 🌺_
![1622823420852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/EpXJZ6A2nx7WQYTbNVb2YyaxxSmgZFc46SFvGQX3cFmf8J2rffyXa1jxSzRqswPDSFr.jpg)

> Bienvenidos una vez más a esta parte de mi blog en la comunidad de Women Tribe, en esta oportunidad con la iniciativa de esta buena amiga, así que para resumir un poco lo que fue mi semana, puedo comenzar con decir que estoy con un cansancio eterno desde hace días, más el día de ayer, ya que estuve de salida, así que del resto ha sido una semana productiva. En cuanto al aspecto laboral, puedo decir que me fue muy bien, aunque ya estoy deseando que acaben las clases para poder descansar y dedicarme a otras cosas que deseo, también para tomar unas vacaciones que tanto me hacen falta. Mi semana fue movida, y para todo docente que vive el día a día en aula siempre serán días movidos, así que para decir que mi semana fue mala, estaría mintiendo, ya que se fue muy rápido y casi siempre busco algo que hacer en horas libres para que mi semana sea mejor. El día lunes tuve clases temprano y debía aplicar una evaluación en grupo, así que desde temprano me coloqué a imprimir las evaluaciones y ordenar todo para mi hora, porque trabajo de tarde. Luego, en el colegio fue bien, ya que tenía un solo bloque con horas, así que después de mi día me dediqué a planificar y terminar algunas cosas que tenía pendientes, porque tengo algo claro: muy poco me llevo trabajo a casa.

> Welcome once again to this part of my blog in the Women Tribe community! This time, I’m joining the initiative of this good friend, so to summarize my week a bit, I can start by saying that I've been feeling eternally tired for days—especially yesterday, since I was out and about. Other than that, it has been a productive week. As for work, I can say it went very well, although I'm already looking forward to the end of the school year so I can rest, focus on other things I want to do, and take a much-needed vacation. My week was busy, and for any teacher who experiences the day-to-day life in the classroom, the days will always be busy. So, to say that my week was bad would be a lie, since it went by very quickly, and I almost always find something to do in my free time to make my week better. On Monday, I had classes early and had to give a group assessment. So, from early on, I started printing the tests and organizing everything for my shift, because I work in the afternoon. Later at school, things went well since I only had one block of hours; so after my workday, I dedicated myself to planning and finishing some pending tasks, because I have one thing clear: I rarely take work home. ---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGwUbNZi2yp7ysrC2tseYCpCKRy3p3ULs2EQjfXUChQj1PFbpgyXdpYpwGHGouM6sDW.png)
# _🌸 Letras inspiradoras 🌸_
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23wqgR4zJ1WoAHexKy1DrwGAHrx3Hzfcv8ZzYMH8Sb3XuNvgy289izDiKumC5teX3YVED.png)

> Los martes y miércoles son días bastante agitados para mí, ya que tengo todos los bloques ocupados, así que mi día se reduce a nada, porque siempre salgo y entro entre los salones. Lo que sí es cierto es que en cada aula me llevo una experiencia diferente; además, me gusta poder compartir mis conocimientos con todos esos estudiantes, los que serán los grandes profesionales más adelante. La semana se reduce en trabajo: llevar a mi hijo a su escuela y a la extracurricular, también en cosas del hogar y adelantando trabajo aparte que tengo, pero lo más importante de todo es la experiencia que me llevo de todo esto. Mi día libre es el viernes, pero ese día tengo cosas que hacer en casa y con mi hijo; además, es un día bueno para el descanso y apartar la rutina. Para mí, los viernes son mi curita al alma, ya que salgo de mis días de congestión y llego bien al viernes. Las fotografías que le acabo de mostrar son de una de mis tantas semanas que estoy en el liceo. Fue sinceramente en una actividad bastante alejada de este mes, pero me gustó y por eso la coloqué. También estas fotos son de mi sección de orientación y convivencia, en la cual tengo contacto directo con los padres y representantes, los cuales saben que estas fotos van para mi blog en Hive, así que tengo permiso para esto.

> Tuesdays and Wednesdays are quite hectic days for me since all my blocks are full, so my day flies by because I'm constantly moving from one classroom to another. What is certainly true is that I take a different experience away from every single classroom; plus, I love being able to share my knowledge with all those students, who will become great professionals in the future. The week comes down to work: taking my son to his school and his extracurricular activity, taking care of household chores, and getting ahead on my own side work, but the most important thing of all is the experience I gain from it all. My day off is Friday, but on that day, I have things to do around the house and with my son; plus, it’s a good day to rest and step away from the routine. For me, Fridays are a band-aid for the soul, since I leave behind my hectic days and make it to Friday feeling good. The photographs I just showed you are from one of my many weeks at the high school. Truthfully, they were taken during an activity quite a while before this month, but I liked them and that’s why I included them. These photos are also from my guidance and homeroom section, where I have direct contact with the parents and guardians, who know that these photos are for my Hive blog, so I have permission for this ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGwUbNZi2yp7ysrC2tseYCpCKRy3p3ULs2EQjfXUChQj1PFbpgyXdpYpwGHGouM6sDW.png)

# _Gracias a todos por estar aquí_ > _Thank you all for being here_
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/AKpCAUygvDkpAUzpu2Wqasv3jCMQszDvEQFz2rsTey7uHV74Yom6RYNm2eYRJSK.png)

> Gracias a todos los que me leen, los que participan en el recorrido, aquellos que ayudan al crecimiento y fortalecimiento de la comunidad, aquellos que recién llegan y a todos los que estamos aquí desde hace tiempo, gracias por visitar un estilo de vida para mí, un estilo para la relajación y la paz. Gracias a todos por su receptividad, por su amor y comprensión. Todo el contenido que se encuentra en esta publicación es amplia-mente original del autor, cualquier duda y recopilación del mismo, deben hacer mención de mi persona.

> Thank you to all who read me, those who participate in the tour, those who help the community grow and strengthen, those who are newcomers and all of us who have been here for a long time, thank you for visiting a way of life for me, a way of relaxation and peace. Thank you all for your receptivity, for your love and understanding. All the content that is in this publication is widely original of the author, any doubt and compilation of the same, they should make mention of my person.

body.title: Weekend | Fin de semana | Fim de semana
body.body:
Traducido del Español a Inglés - Portugués

> This is a normal ordinary post, just like the ones I like to write for you all, remember! After all, in these last few months, Hive has become a good friend who reads you, listens to you, and connects you with other people. I'd venture to say that in these last few years I've never had as much communication with other people as I do now, and through this medium. These last few years, maybe four or so, I've lost count of how many times I've moved from place to place, from state to state, and now from country to country. No time to meet people, no time to socialize. The same is true for my children; the constant moving has distanced them from friends, schoolmates, childhood friends, and family. Their closest friendships these past few years have been behind a screen. They're just starting school again, making new friends, and their relationship with the language is getting better all the time. It's funny, but now they're teaching me. After all, everything I do is for them. - Saturday night, I slept a lot today. After spending a week constantly walking back and forth, my feet have been swollen and my body feels like I've been in a washing machine, hahaha, all messed up and lazy. Weekends are definitely my time to be lazy, to stay in bed, watch movies, eat snacks, and feel happy to be in my little temple like a little girl. My babies are doing well; we're making progress and improving every day. **Slow but steady** ![1000298262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/AKAooJhEKV89Mw5LhUpiMR5Q8xHrM61J9FBibgr5hdzAU6nSVZ7sUPDxFtNTjEQ.jpg)

Me atrevería a decir que estos últimos años nunca había tenido tanta comunicación con otras personas como ahora y por este medio. Estos últimos años talvez unos 4 años en los que he perdido la cuenta de cuántas veces me e mudado de lugar, de estado y ahora de país. Sin tiempo para conocer personas, sin tiempo para socializar. Mis bebés están bien, estamos avanzando y mejorando cada día. **Lento pero seguro** ![1000298262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/AKAooJhEKV89Mw5LhUpiMR5Q8xHrM61J9FBibgr5hdzAU6nSVZ7sUPDxFtNTjEQ.jpg) ## Feliz fin de semana HIVE. ❤️

body.title: #MyHiveGoals - Stackin' Hive
body.body: /> So before I get into the numbers this week, I actually have a question....Specifically for everyone that uses @ecency for long form content. I'm not 100% sure of the culture and features of this community, but I really love the front end editor. I think it's the cleanest of all Hive front ends and would love to use it more going forward. A few questions, are the Ecency points still a thing? Is there any drama from using them to promote posts? I know this kind of post promotion was always frowned upon by the higher ups in the blockchain? And along those same lines, do we get any benefits for delegating Hive Power to Ecency itself? Not sure where to look for that... Anywho, enough with the 20 questions....Let's see how the week went on chain. Overall, I've been pretty happy. I have been able to add quite a bit of Hive to my stacks this week, and that's keeping in mind that all I have really to play with is the minimal amount of crypto I earn here on chain. But with the prices of Hive still very low, it's allowing me to grab much more than I thought I would ever be able to secure. That's such a win for me personally..And I love that the stacks are growing...Slowly but steadily. Let's see how the journey went... 50,000 Hive Power ----------------- Like I said, I was able to add a nice chunk of Hive Power this week... **50,000 - 26,679 = 23,321 left to go** Slow and steady has always been my strategy. Both here and in my online businesses over the years. And this is so cool to see. I've really narrowed my focus on what I'm trying to build on chain, and it's come down to Hive and #bbho So that allows me to take all the extra Hive I earn, and power it up! On top of that, my k/e ratio has gone down from 3.85 to **3.77** This is such a fun metric to watch your account get back to respectability lol 350 Subscribers To The Kingdom ------------------------------ We're bringing back the 'plus 1' mentality here ;)

/>

We added one new member to the community this week and we're thrilled to have them onboard!

We're working hard to bring the gospel to souls here on the blockchain with [The Kingdom Bible Community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-142376/created).

Lots of great people have started sharing faith based posts every week in the community and we're looking for more :)

BBHO Things
-----------

My full upvote at #bbh is worth around **68 BBHO** at 100%. Which is slightly down from last week but still, a nice chunk of tokens are beign sent to people that create within the community.

This is such a fantastic little community on Hive and I do think it's overlooked. Mainly because it's never been on any whale's radars, but I enjoy dishing out as many tokens as I can. Maybe that's not the best game plan lol But I think it's great to be able to spread them out.

Anywho....That's the week that was on chain!

And I hope you have a great 7 days on Hive and crush every single one of your goals going forward.

body.body:

![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

This character image that I shared belongs to Splinterlands. It is a very excellent monster whose mana cost is low only four and you can easily play it in low mana battles. Today I was looking at which card to choose so I found this card and I was impressed by its visual display and along with that its abilities are also very excellent.

Therefore I thought to make a visual art of this monster and to share my imagination ideas about this monster that how he hit his enemy units. 

Its special ability is its Bloodline Tribute and when defeated, all allied units of the same bloodline gain plus one health, speed and armor and +1 power to each shared attack type. This is its most special and best ability.

If we look at its stats, its health is four because of which you can place it in the mid to backline position. Besides this its speed is one meaning it will provide its allied unit plus one speed so that they can attack more effectively.

This monster card is available in the market at different prices depending on its level. At Level 1 it costs only $0.40 which is a very reasonable and affordable price for most players. At Level 2 the price increases to around $1.89.

![Screenshot 2026-04-18 222625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wM4ibhYf4Spd2C7dav2xryasXDACByxui3BAYHKPBnVZFugLZiVqbGMkD837184tefB.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

The value of any monster card depends mainly on its level and card count. Lower level cards usually have a lower price because they are basic versions while higher level cards become more valuable due to their improved stats, abilities and stronger battle performance.

Its visual display is very beautiful where you can see that its shape looks similar to an eagle and in its right hand there is an energy power and it looks like it wants to throw it toward the enemy.

Besides this if I talk about its beauty, its dressing style is very beautiful and its claws are very sharp which points toward a dangerous and alarming situation.

I personally kept its imaginative and conceptual aspect in mind and I thought of preparing a specific visual display art of it with the help of ChatGPT and providing some information about it.

body.title: Día 26 cambiando el físico y la vida. Mi informe de Actifit: junio 13 2026
body.body:
Ya casi se hará un mes de hacer ejercicio constante y de tratar de hacer cosas que me ayuden a ser mejor persona y profesionista, siento que el ejercicio ya se está haciendo un hábito y ya sea simplemente caminar, trato de hacer bastante, consciente y enfocado en mi meta de bajar de peso y aumentar masa muscular, cuando comenzamos con esto, pesaba 92 Kg, nunca en mi vida había pesado tanto y eso me desánimo muchísimo, me hizo sentir muy mal conmigo y con mi cuerpo, se que no puedo tener el cuerpo, la condición y todo lo que tenia en prepa y universidad, porque ahí hacia bastante ejercicio, jugando voleibol... Pero quiero mantenerme en forma y tener buena salud, desde pequeño me ha preocupado mucho tener buena salud y ahora estoy muy preocupado por ella, no se cuanto peso ahora, y el lunes me iré de vacaciones a Puerto Vallarta a un hotel todo incluido, pero aún estando ahí, quiero tratar de hacer un poco de ejercicio, se que no debo de estresarme tanto por eso, pero... Si me preocupa. También he estado tratando de trabajar las tareas de mi psicólogo, no he podido hacerlas constantes, pero trato de ser consciente también de lo que implica o la esencia de mis tareas como me recomendó, aunque fue un poco difícil esta semana porque estuvimos viviendo juntos mi novia y yo cuidando la casa de sus padrinos y los perritos Ody y Máx qué fue un caos con las lluvias, pero se logró y hoy ya por fin regresaron a casa, así que trato de ser consiente con mis tareas y trabajarlas aunque no las escriba. Por otro lado profesionalmente, me siento muy atrasado, me siento que no tengo el nivel para hacer todo lo que estoy haciendo y se que muy probablemente tengo el síndrome del impostor, se que no soy el más inteligente o más capaz en mi carrera, pero se que puedo aportar grandes cosas y apoyar a las personas, con su educación, sus finanzas y sus sueños, sólo... Es cuestión de seguir trabajando mis tareas del psicólogo y ponerme al corriente porque en verdad me atrase 3 meses con mi trabajo y ahora, pude ponerme al corriente y que solo me hagan falta un par de pendientes de Mayo, aunque me preocupa que no vaya a trabajar toda una semana, se que es por mi bien también y que debo aprender a descansar porque sino, podría incurrir mucho en mi salud y también en mis resultados, así qué también trato de estar tranquilo con eso. Son muchas cosas en mi cabeza, pero... Creo que por fin estoy llevando un pequeño diario para recordarme que si estoy haciendo las cosas y que no debo atacarme y hacerme menos porque me exijo demasiado y piense que ni siquiera yo soy capaz de lograr las cosas que me exijo. Pero bueno, agradezco hayas llegado hasta aquí. Te deseo lo mejor en cualquier proyecto o cosa que estés desarrollando o haciendo tu también. Te deseo éxito, dinero y paz.

Hola amigos de Open mic y de hive! Quise traerles este icónico tema de esta icónica reina Selena Quintanilla, una muy buena canción para una asombrosa Comunidad, estoy bastante feliz de traerles este video, sé qué no es la calidad de voz que esperan, pero tienen que admitir que hice el intento, obviamente lo hice a mi tiempo pero sin perder la escencia de lo pegajosa y movida que es esta canción, Selena para mí y para muchas personas de este medio será una gran joya guardada en nuestros corazones y a pesar de qué no la pude ver en vivo, sus canciones vivirán en mí para toda la vida, espero disfruten esta canción y nos vemos en la próxima.

# <center><div class=\
> Hive / Open mic - Week #322 (A cappella) Cover - Amor Prohibido/Selena Quintanilla by D-rock [Esp]-[Eng]\n\n

>

>Hello, friends from Open Mic and Hive! I wanted to share this iconic track by the iconic queen, Selena Quintanilla – a brilliant song for an amazing community. I’m really happy to bring you this video; I know the vocal quality isn’t quite what you’d expect, but you have to admit I gave it a go. Obviously, I did it in my own time, but without losing the essence of just how catchy and upbeat this song is. For me, and for many people in this community, Selena will always be a precious gem held close to our hearts, and even though I never got to see her perform live, her songs will live on in me for the rest of my life. I hope you enjoy this song, and see you next time.





<center>
***
***Amor Prohibido - Selena Quintanilla***
***
<div class=pull-right>



![81wXYCf4KnL._UF1000,1000_QL80_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/AKRCp7aUbySw4UgykPUTTh8KaEeTkNrvakRGNPseDhwvmkeYwVnxwGXzjLN583b.jpg)





<center><a href=\

es de esas canciones que se te pegan en la cabeza y no te las puedes sacar en todo el día. Selena Quintanilla aquí nos cuenta la clásica y triste historia de dos personas que se súper aman, pero que la sociedad o la familia no los deja estar juntos porque son de mundos totalmente diferentes, sobre todo por el tema de las clases sociales y el dinero. A pesar de que la gente los mira mal y les tira mala vibra, ella grita a los cuatro vientos que a ella no le importan los lujos ni las billeteras gordas, porque el amor verdadero vale muchísimo más que cualquier cantidad de oro en el mundo. El ritmo de la canción es una cumbia súper alegre y bailable que te dan ganas de mover los pies apenas empieza, creando un contraste genial porque la letra es un poco sufrida pero la música te pone de reojo a bailar. Se convirtió en uno de sus más grandes éxitos porque cualquiera que haya tenido un amor difícil se puede sentir identificado al instante con ese sentimiento tan puro. Al final, es un himno hermoso que nos recuerda que cuando el cariño es de verdad, no hay barrera, ni dinero, ni prejuicio social que pueda apagar ese fuego.



<centro>

![IMG_20221206_192346_917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/d-rock/243MHuAQSZG8uEX2JTKG2g5Mef5cfc6wwLCozn3QKGp2aWxi5qhX29BFdYiKaRYiENbU6.jpg)


<centro>


>\

is one of those songs that gets stuck in your head and you just can’t get rid of it all day long. Here, Selena Quintanilla tells us the classic, sad story of two people who love each other deeply, but whom society or their families won’t let be together because they come from completely different worlds, particularly due to issues of social class and money. Even though people look down on them and give them a hard time, she shouts from the rooftops that she doesn’t care about luxury or fat wallets, because true love is worth far more than any amount of gold in the world. The song’s rhythm is a super-upbeat, danceable cumbia that makes you want to move your feet the moment it starts, creating a brilliant contrast because the lyrics are a bit heart-wrenching but the music makes you want to dance. It became one of his biggest hits because anyone who has experienced a difficult love affair can instantly relate to that pure emotion. Ultimately, it’s a beautiful anthem that reminds us that when love is real, there’s no barrier, no money, and no social prejudice that can extinguish that fire.

body.title: Celebrating Public Knitting Day 🧶💚
body.body: > Greetings and best wishes to my dear knitting friends. I hope you are all in good health and spirits. This Saturday I was lucky enough to experience a very special day. Thanks to an invitation from some friends in the knitting community I’ve met here in Bogotá, I attended the Public Knitting Day celebration, an event that brings together people who share a love of needles, yarn and everything created stitch by stitch. The venue chosen was the beautiful Virgilio Barco Library. We settled in the gardens, under the shade of the trees, surrounded by nature and with the weather seeming to have conspired to be on our side. From the moment I arrived, I felt a wonderful energy.

> Saludos y bendiciones para mis estimadas amigas de las agujas. Espero que estén bien con salud y bienestar. Este sábado tuve la fortuna de vivir un día muy especial. Gracias a la invitación de unas amigas de la comunidad tejeril que he conocido aquí en Bogotá, asistí a la celebración del Día de Tejer en Público, una fecha que reúne a personas que comparten el amor por las agujas, los hilos y todo lo que se crea puntada a puntada. El lugar escogido fue la hermosa Biblioteca Virgilio Barco. Nos instalamos en los jardines, bajo la sombra de los árboles, rodeadas de naturaleza y con un clima que parecía haberse puesto de acuerdo para acompañarnos. Desde que llegué sentí una energía maravillosa. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xKxj5dtFVgqiwMNQYsyQUXY2Tzn2B8X7NQYYud12GmexzUoXQNTv1qgBcxV3anHFACJ.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/Ep1Xs8v4kWx3cUN4DupjnoHcbkPbYSERipA4pfYMQNgcaPRU5nSjk8hxfr8wvf2sqjL.jpg| |--|--| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xoz7DvaCPDQ7o4cp1gdZGkT9ahHVHtLe3MAn1TkdVAmi31diyaqzCXCUnSC2UxgFTse.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23x19JsThXK6QcEcNphwpQwbWe4d7a4T1FaNARNJwYcth54T68TcUwyMKcDV7PqeKGytn.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

> Each of us brought along our work-in-progress, so it was inevitable that we would stop to admire the colours, stitches and textures, and swap ideas. I love how knitting has the power to bring people together. There’s always something new to learn or a tip to share. As well as knitting, we shared delicious snacks that gradually appeared amongst the baskets of yarn and knitted bags. Between snacks, laughter and stitches, the conversation flowed naturally. We talked about knitting, of course, but also about life, our projects and our families. It was a spectacular day that I enjoyed to the full. I left with a few more rows completed on my knitting, but above all with a heart full of gratitude for the company, the friendship and the opportunity to share a hobby that has brought me so much joy. 🧶💚

> Cada una llevó su tejido en progreso, así que fue inevitable detenernos a admirar colores, puntos, texturas e intercambiar ideas. Me encanta cómo el tejido tiene la capacidad de conectar a las personas. Siempre hay algo nuevo que aprender o algún truco que compartir. Además de tejer, compartimos meriendas deliciosas que fueron apareciendo poco a poco entre las canastas de hilo y los bolsos tejidos. body.body: /> **_Day 7 of My SPS Staking Journey: What Happens When You Stake 25 SPS Every Day Without Missing a Single Day?_** Most Splinterlands players focus on big rewards, expensive cards, and massive investments. I'm experimenting with something much simpler. A strategy that anyone can follow. Just 25 SPS staked every day. No shortcuts. No huge purchases. No trying to time the market. Just steady progress. Today marks Day 7 of my personal SPS staking journey, and I've successfully added another 25 SPS to my stake. That brings the total accumulated through this challenge to 175 SPS staked in seven consecutive days.

/> **_Why Am I Doing This?_** Because I believe consistency beats intensity. Anyone can make a large deposit once. The real challenge is building a habit and sticking to it day after day. This experiment isn't only about SPS. It's about discipline. It's about proving that small actions, when repeated consistently, can create meaningful results over time. Every day I add another 25 SPS, I'm investing not only in my Splinterlands account but also in a long-term mindset. **_The Hidden Strength of Small Daily Investments_** Many people underestimate the power of gradual growth. Twenty-five SPS may not seem like much today. But after weeks, months, and eventually a full year, those daily deposits begin stacking into something far more significant. The goal isn't to become wealthy overnight. The goal is to create a system that keeps moving forward regardless of market conditions. A little progress every day is still progress.

>

**_Why I Continue Staking SPS_** There are several reasons why I remain committed to this challenge: Growing my long-term position within the Splinterlands ecosystem. Increasing my participation in SPS governance. Building additional value for my account. Developing stronger investment habits. Staying focused on future growth rather than short-term rewards. Each day of staking reinforces those goals. Now I'm curious to see where this journey leads after 30 days, 60 days, 100 days, and beyond. The challenge continues tomorrow with another 25 SPS added to the stake. Thank you to everyone following this journey and supporting the experiment. What About You? Are you currently staking SPS? How much SPS would you like to have staked by the end of 2026? body.title: Something In Me Suffers Unused
body.body:
![1000177105.jpg](image-1-1000177105.jpg)





![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)








<center>I still notice the hesitation, whenever I want to make something honest and immediately hear the voice that says not enough,
I still notice the hesitation, because in sensitivity gives me vision yet also makes every glance feel sharper than it is,
I still notice the hesitation, knowing the same openness that lets beauty in also leaves me exposed to honest judgment,
I still notice the hesitation, am I truly unready or just frightened of being seen unfinished,
I still notice the hesitation, while my hands still reach for the honest work anyway…





<center>I still know flaws, are not side notes to erase but fingerprints proving a human heart passed through here,
I still know flaws, because polished emptiness has never moved me the way wounded truth has done,
I still know flaws, though I still hide pieces of myself as if neatness were safer than resonance,
I still know flaws, am I editing life out of my failures just to avoid discomfort,
I know flaws, and the page asks for something real, not performance…





<center>I hear the old measuring habit, when other voices seem effortless and mine, feels late rough strange or difficult to trust,
I hear the old measuring habit, and it tries to make another person’s path a verdict against my own becoming,
I hear the old measuring habit, even while knowing no borrowed voice can carry what was given only to me,
I hear the old measuring habit, am I admiring them or abandoning myself all over again,
I hear the old measuring habit, then return to the sound that only I can make…





<center>I choose making, not because confidence arrived first but because silence had begun to wound me even deeper,
I choose making, when protection asks me to hide and expression asks me to risk sincerity all over again,
I choose making, aware that courage often looks like small repeated acts no one applauds,
I choose making, can I bear being misunderstood if it means being real and living me,
I choose making, when protection asks me to hide and expression and risk sincerity all over again, as growth rarely asks for perfection, only your participation…



<center>Watchwords:
Frightened of being seen unfinished
The page asks blood
Abandoning myself again
Silence had begun to wound me
something in me suffers unused

<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

body.title: 生活和小说
body.body:
老大特别喜欢棠下那边的那家京味大包子，一直念念不忘。

前几日的时候，我答应他周末带他去吃，他高兴的不得了，周六这天一反常态，认认真真地坐在桌子前写作业。

有句老话讲的好，“知子莫若父”，我很能理解老大的心情，他是担心要是表现不好我收回“承诺”，因此才“认真”的。

傍晚的时候，我在黄埔这边，打电话让他过来，孩子妈妈对那大包子兴趣没那么大，因此老大跟二宝俩人就出发了。

我们约好在棠下地铁站碰面，我计划着时间应该刚好，结果他们竟然比我早到了，我看了下家里监控，原来这俩人在预定好的出发时间提前十多分钟出发，这才出现了比我早十多分钟到地铁站。

那家包子店就在棠下地铁站出来不远，大约3、400米吧，路上我问二宝，

“你俩怎么不守时呢？”

“我们俩在地铁站都等你10多分钟了！” 二宝回答说。

“迟到了是不守时，提前到也是不守时呀！” 我故意逗他。


![IMG20260613200031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS9zyb616aS3MqusuZ5nCARee8reLzsRYL5thSoRjxCKE/IMG20260613200031.jpg)

![IMG20260613200332.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAsDJQmR2rShLgfzD5Q3rTgApysgymA2rmRGRj6iiHUZ/IMG20260613200332.jpg)

这家店的包子很大，一份有10个。我们点了一份牛肉馅，另一份猪肉馅。

![IMG20260613200502.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmAmkVZKjsfpeHbTKmubgsJyQ4UrDAe2Ye432WEWpq1q/IMG20260613200502.jpg)

俩人埋头苦干吃大包子中。。。囧

不出所料的，2份包子吃不完，还剩下6个包子，打包带回去。


![005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyczQzCKpDg7yicCe7ykPBtN9G8ombYyivfnVdWAzS8y/005.jpg)

我最近在听《主角》这部小说，开始觉得挺有趣，主角和人物都很有趣。

但是，越听到后边，越感觉这个主人公的心理和性格有点奇怪。

嗯，准确地说，是主人公易秦娥的性格有问题。固执和偏执，听不进去别人的意见。

举个最典型的例子。易秦娥觉得在单位工作太辛苦了，想休息下。正常人的做法，就是调休或者申请休假，当然，可能也是因为她是主角，团里给的任务又重，加上一些人的嫉妒和风言风语，导致她身体和精神上都感到很累，想要一个较长的休假。

但是，她这人想问题很偏执，甚至说很极端。她想的主意是怀孕了就可以请长假休息了。我不是说怀孕不好，而是觉得原因有二：

一呢，怀孕生娃是她想要逃避找的一个冠冕堂皇的理由，不是说她真的喜欢孩子，就是想要给自己老公生个孩子为先；

二呢，比如小说里讲了，因为念错词被扣了绩效工资，但是她的领导，也就是单团长人很好，每次都私下又返还给她了。其实不止这些，类似很多事情，从这些可以看出，单团长很会做事做人。

但是完全不考虑其他人的想法，比如这次，完全不给别人任何机会，直接就既定事实，让人非常无奈和无语。易秦娥这个人，平日里话虽然不多，但是一旦有问题，就如同竹筒倒豆子，一股脑将陈芝麻烂谷子都倒出来，让人真的很无语。。。这样性格的人，看起来平日里风平浪静，相安无事，但一旦发作，身边的人是要跟着倒霉的。

至于她的老公刘红兵，性格是很好的，人也很会说话。但是，以我自己的观察，这样的人，往往后边的结果都不会太好，最关键的原因，就是生活尤其是经济上没有独立，说穿了，就是没有学会独自挣钱养家的能力，这在有父亲在的时候可能不会明显，一旦家庭变故或者父亲过世等，问题就很快显露出来，无论是小说《金粉世家》里的燕西，《红楼梦》里的贾宝玉，又或者我身边的真实例子，都有这样的情况。

This is a back to back post around Laksh music journey. Remember sometime last month I did share that he got certified for the Initial Guitar level from Trinity College London. Here is the post that I am referring to - [Laksh – Trinity College London Music Certification Initials Passed with Distinction](https://peakd.com/hive-193816/@gungunkrishu/lakshs-trinity-initial-level-final-performance-or-distinction-achieved-next-stop-grade-1). And now the good news is that he cleared the Grade 1 examination as well with flying colors. As part of the guidelines we were not supposed to share the perfromance on any social media platfrom [even the blockchain #HIVE platform] until the results were out. As I have promised that I would be sharing all his final performance being submittied to the university for the evaluation so here is the Grade 1 perfromance on three songs that was submitted to the university for review...So without a furtherado lets have a look at the stunning perfromance from Laksh here....

---

https://youtu.be/GArN-eMo_N0

---

Curious on the - Exam results from Trinity College London so here it is::

**Candidate name:	Laksh Gupta**
**Category:	Rock & Pop**
**Instrument:	Guitar**
**Level:	Grade 1**

Instead of doing all the writing its better to share the image that speaks the results


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/243zde8RKeSxcpukehe74paQ1r6QnTb22bxiagX2ghrWyAri6JtTUJwN6HjyYD53yd7Po.png)

For every grade, students need to perform three songs selected from a list provided by the university. Laksh chose the following three songs, and I am also sharing the feedback/comments given by the examiner — not the exact wordings, just a brief summary to maintain privacy and confidentiality. 


**Song 1 | Love Is The Drug: Roxy Music**

Laksh showed good rhythm and smooth melodic playing throughout the performance. Despite a few minor mistakes and limited dynamics, it was an overall confident and reliable presentation.

**Song 2 | Oh Yeah: The Subways**

The chord transitions were handled smoothly, and the overall performance remained accurate and well controlled. Although the dynamics could have been more expressive in parts, it was a confident and successful pop rendition overall.


***Song 3 - Technical Focus | I Can't Explain: The Who***

The rhythm and articulation remained steady throughout, with strong power chords in the chorus. Despite a few minor stumbles, the recovery was quick and the overall 60’s pop style came through well.



Have a look at the perfromance and do let me know if your are a guitarist and the comments provided by the examiner is inline or not and what are the areas of foscus should be for LAKSH as he continues in journey for getting certified for Grade 2 Now...thats coming SooN as well... And yes, how could I end this post without sharing the final digital certificate that Laksh received — here it is! We are truly grateful to Trinity College London and to the music academy [UnitedString](https://www.instagram.com/unitedstrings.music/) where he continues to learn and grow as a guitarist. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23vsqgi4vGkuqHJ7N9NDV33VDLFpTtYNT3upkY1RTQFMKRC3iz7iiYLceLCpmk8zgGLyv.png)



Finally - Thanks to everyone who’s been part of this journey and every encouragement/feedback given truly fuels the momentum. Well this should be it for todays post on - \

Enjoy the music and let me know how you feel about the music - whether it inspires you, excites you, or just lifts your mood....cheers
