body.title: SAD STORY
body.body: Hii ... Hope so you are all fine ... Today I have a sad story of an accident ... I still remember that day as if it happened yesterday ... It was a bright Sunday morning, and I was traveling on a busy road ... As I was walking near a market, I noticed a man riding a motorcycle ...  His wife was sitting behind him, and their two young children were sitting between them ... They looked like a happy family enjoying their journey together ... The traffic was normal, and everything seemed peaceful ... The children were smiling and talking to their parents ...  The father was driving carefully, making sure his family was safe ... Seeing them reminded me of how precious family moments are ... Suddenly, everything changed in a few seconds ...  A speeding truck came from the opposite side ... The driver seemed to lose control of the vehicle ... Before anyone could react, the truck crashed into the motorcycle ... The sound of the collision was terrifying ... People nearby started shouting and rushed toward the accident scene ... I was shocked and ran to help ... The motorcycle was badly damaged and lying on the side of the road ... The father and the two children were injured, but they were still alive ...  However, the wife was lying motionless on the ground ... Ambulances arrived quickly, and all of them were taken to the hospital ... Later, I learned the heartbreaking news ... Despite the doctors' efforts, the wife did not survive her injuries ... She passed away shortly after reaching the hospital. When the husband heard the news, he broke down in tears ... The children were too young to understand what had happened, but they kept asking for their mother ... That scene touched my heart deeply .... It made me realize how unpredictable life can be ...  One moment, a family can be happy and enjoying their time together, and the next moment, everything can change forever ... The accident taught me the importance of road safety and careful driving ... Even today, whenever I think about that family, I feel sad ... I can never forget the pain on the husband's face and the innocent children looking for their mother ... It was one of the most tragic incidents I have ever witnessed, and it remains a memory that will stay with me forever ...

body.title: Other Niche Communities Curation Report #2226
body.body: >\nHello everyone! This is the 2226th compilation post of OCD's latest curation efforts. It has been known that OCD has been supporting leading niche communities under its <b><a href=\
>Community Incubation Program. However, there are still a lot of other niche communities not supported by OCD. This curation initiative will help in supporting those communities.

> This newest curation effort aims to encourage authors to post in appropriate communities even if those communities are not under the incubation program. This will also encourage users to explore more into the different communities in Hive.

How this Works

> OCD curators and community leaders will find posts from other niche communities and recommend them for an upvote. Unlike those communities in the incubation program where curation is focused, this curation initiative is spread out. This will help find undervalued posts from smaller communities that deserve support.

> This will highlight both the author and the community where the post is located. This way, smaller niche communities can focus on growing their subscribers and increasing the engagements within their respective communities. A small boost goes a long way.

> Speaking of boost, here are the curated posts for this batch:

Curated Posts

body.title: Scrambled eggs with zucchini, tomato, and onion (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> For breakfast today, I made scrambled eggs with zucchini, tomato, bell peppers, and onion—a delicious combination that really won me over. I’d never added zucchini to this dish before, and I thought it was a great idea that lived up to my expectations. The eggs had a slightly moist texture that I really liked.
![1000120735.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmSSZSRgBHZRyVyPzYZpaQ7et5xSgcFicC13ogWAWTWY8SheL7Jxvcvhfw3ZemF7SUp.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 3 eggs - 1 zucchini - 1 tomato - 6 sweet peppers - 1 onion - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000120726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyZSUG1SASGCvTx7MvZhjAHeiYwrTdVu9mqBg5kELvxkNWABeiTAkbyP9Bm8xPrMgy6.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the zucchini, tomato, and herbs. Then I removed the seeds from any ingredients that needed them. Shortly after, I peeled the onion and zucchini. I then cut them into small pieces, which I added to a preheated skillet with a splash of oil. I stirred and reduced the heat to low until the vegetables and herbs softened. I then added the eggs and stirred, waited a few minutes for them to cook through, and seasoned with salt to taste.
![1000120729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerLkpjwPfHoMGtUqVg6VcYW4caDeskCQ54yH3QkDgSX3WmFn6YtgYKNb6wYr9D37yF.jpg)
Once this mixture was ready, I set about making some arepas to go with the dish. In a deep bowl, I added two cups of water and a pinch of salt, then stirred in about 150 grams of white cornmeal, kneading until there were no lumps and the mixture was smooth. A piping-hot griddle was waiting for the arepas; using the suggested measurements, I made three medium-sized ones and one small one.
![1000120732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvksh4JXTLit6r7D9F847UBiBvbt41BHfEv8jKowVkipnf4qzz8bEQXuVATvfvyoNeB.jpg)
My arepas were ready in about twenty minutes, and since the scrambled eggs were on the stove next to them, the dish stayed warm. So next, I opened the arepas, added a touch of butter, filled them, and thoroughly enjoyed this spectacular breakfast. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Para el desayuno de hoy preparé unos huevos revueltos con calabacín, tomate, ajíes dulces y cebolla, una combinación deliciosa que me dejó cautivada. Nunca había agregado calabacín a esta preparación y me pareció una idea estupenda que cumplió con mis expectativas. Los huevos quedaron con una textura ligeramente húmeda que fue de mi agrado.
![1000120735.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmSSZSRgBHZRyVyPzYZpaQ7et5xSgcFicC13ogWAWTWY8SheL7Jxvcvhfw3ZemF7SUp.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 3 huevos - 1 calabacín - 1 tomate - 6 ajíes dulces - 1 cebolla - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000120726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyZSUG1SASGCvTx7MvZhjAHeiYwrTdVu9mqBg5kELvxkNWABeiTAkbyP9Bm8xPrMgy6.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé el calabacín, el tomate y los aliños. Luego quité las semillas a todos los ingredientes que lo ameritaran. Poco después desconché la cebolla y el calabacín. Luego corté en pedazos pequeños, los cuales llevé a un sartén precalentado y con una medida de aceite, removí y ajusté a fuego bajo hasta que los vegetales y aliños ablandaron. Posteriormente agregué los huevos y revolví, esperé unos minutos para que se cocinaran por completo y ajusté el punto de sal.
![1000120729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerLkpjwPfHoMGtUqVg6VcYW4caDeskCQ54yH3QkDgSX3WmFn6YtgYKNb6wYr9D37yF.jpg)
Una vez que esta preparación estuvo lista, procedí a montar unas arepas para acompañar este plato. En un envase hondo coloqué dos tazas de agua y un punto de sal, luego introduje unos 150 gramos de harina de maíz blanca, amasando hasta no sentir grumos y lograr una mezcla suave. Un budare bien caliente esperaba las arepas, salieron tres medianas y una pequeña con la medida sugerida.
![1000120732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvksh4JXTLit6r7D9F847UBiBvbt41BHfEv8jKowVkipnf4qzz8bEQXuVATvfvyoNeB.jpg)
En unos veinte minutos estaban listas mis arepas y al estar los huevos revueltos en la hornilla de al lado la receta mantuvo su calor, así que lo siguiente fue abrir las arepas, colocarles su toque de mantequilla, proceder a rellenar y darme un gran gusto con este espectacular desayuno.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.body:
Hi @kilvnrex. This is a touching story. You did a nice job of describing the tensions between you and your mother. 

Now and then we provide some feedback to help a writer see where there are opportunities for more development of a story, or some improvements. Here are some tips for you:
* While the tension between you and your mother is clear, there is no explanation of why she moved to another state, or why you didn't want to see her when she returned. So that seems like a missed opportunity. Just a few sentences describing the reasons you are no longer close to her would help the reader follow the story.
* In the following paragraph, it is not clear if you are speaking of one person (your mother) or two people (a girlfriend and your mother). A little more information would have been helpful.

> There was no need to be happy after I had just lost the very person that made me happy. I have had to end things with the person my joy revolves around, and although I knew I needed to do it, it had to be done because I needed peace between the women in life. It was a necessary decision that broke me, and even though I loved both of them, I guess she knew she had also lost something the day I lost her. She had lost a part of her son, and needed to find it. Finally I knew why she was coming and I bluntly spoke the words. Park a few of my things, I will be home to collect them.

* When you write dialogue, you are placing quotes around the part of the sentence that is *not* dialogue, which is not correct. Here is one of the examples:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theinkwell/23tcLvdYCCnVBP29Y9dAN4JfoxGD4BM7EwTGpmXhya7vMFTgqzvAbBGdoJAf4qjn1tPCB.png)

Quotes should be placed on both sides of the what is spoken, like this:

> \
Sorry mum, I would not be coming home tonight.\
I need to be on site tonight and will not be back until tomorrow.\

body.title: Fish marinated in banana leaves (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today, to treat my taste buds and for lunch, I prepared: Spiced Cachorretas in Plantain Leaves. For this, I used 1 kg of fish (Cachorretas); this species closely resembles the cabaña or mackerel—the bigger, the better. I also used banana leaves. Additionally, chili peppers, garlic, carrots, bell peppers, onions, and salt to taste.
![1000458272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242rsJiVHAHAs6HamvsvTqHKgZCeKm1yLCpuh91ZECU2j9zHVgMWJBxrNAwSzmsChodPP.jpg)
Cleaning the fish: Cut it lengthwise, making sure the central bone is exposed, and simultaneously remove the innards, as shown in the photo. Chop the aforementioned ingredients into small cubes (chili peppers, garlic, onion, paprika, carrots). Sauté them in two teaspoons of olive oil with salt to taste; once ready, add them to the fish.
![1000458263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/Eo8SNWxSHvuKyKKFnhuq9PuVFJEwkri7WqLYCgT4hKuQV3QgfHPx2R5GreEZP14nRL1.jpg)
![1000458267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoEq76tphZJqtTjigUWDzGjVbvHvXKq8XrEUqMV6Q4gHv16i3kBXrVxkX8geuHDxCHq.jpg)
Preparation of the plantain leaves: Trim and clean the leaves, then briefly hold them over direct heat. Prepare some plantain fritters. Once the fish are stuffed, roll them up and tie them, as shown in the photo.
![1000458271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoEp4j49kQqNo8f3xvFWRkuEVhXE785jeypiZXFcawvy2XXWiYJktP3GuvtcLJ82xqX.jpg)
Preheat the oven to the highest setting. When it reaches the maximum temperature, place the fish inside and let them cook for about 30 minutes. The dish is exquisite—there’s nothing quite like it. It can be served with rice, spaghetti, arepas, or cassava cakes. It’s extremely healthy, and for people who want to watch their weight, this is exactly what their diet should be. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy para deleitar el paladar y almorzar preparé: Cachorretas al aliño en hojas de plátano. Para ello usé 1 kgr. de pescado (Cachorretas), este espécimen se parece mucho a la cabaña o caballa, mientras más grande mejor. También usé hojas de plátano o cambur. Así mismo ají, ajo, zanahoria, pimentón, cebolla, sal al gusto.
![1000458272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242rsJiVHAHAs6HamvsvTqHKgZCeKm1yLCpuh91ZECU2j9zHVgMWJBxrNAwSzmsChodPP.jpg)
Limpieza del pescado: se abre longitudinalmente, procurando que el hueso del centro quede expuesto, simultáneamente se extraen las vísceras, como se observa en la fotografía. El guiso mencionado se corta en cuadritos pequeños (ají, ajo, cebolla, pimentón, zanahoria). Se realiza un sofrito con dos cucharaditas de aceite de Oliva, sal al gusto, al estar listo se le agrega al pescado.
![1000458263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/Eo8SNWxSHvuKyKKFnhuq9PuVFJEwkri7WqLYCgT4hKuQV3QgfHPx2R5GreEZP14nRL1.jpg)
![1000458267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoEq76tphZJqtTjigUWDzGjVbvHvXKq8XrEUqMV6Q4gHv16i3kBXrVxkX8geuHDxCHq.jpg)
Preparación de las hojas de plátano: se recorta y se limpian las hojas, luego se pasan un poco por fuego directo. Se preparan unos cachipos de plátano. Después que los pescados estén rellenos se precede a enrollarlos y amarrarlos, como se destaca en la foto.
![1000458271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EoEp4j49kQqNo8f3xvFWRkuEVhXE785jeypiZXFcawvy2XXWiYJktP3GuvtcLJ82xqX.jpg)
Previamente se debe encender el horno, full fuego. Al llegar al máximo de temperatura introducir los pescados, y dejar cocinar por 30 minutos aproximadamente. El guiso es exquisito, no hay nada igual Se puede acompañar con arroz, espagueti, arepas o casabe. Es sumamente sana, y para gente que quiere cuidar su figura así debe ser su dieta.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: [ESP-ING] Trazos y Matices
body.body:
>

#### Saludos queridos lectores  y amigos de Hive DIY 🌟




<center>



</center>

<div class=\

> Una de las cosas que más me gusta en esta vida son las manualidades y hace poco me invitaron a una tarde de mujeres llamada trazos y matices, donde la idea era pintar un bolso pequeño con algún dibujo por supuesto que me anoté para esa actividad pues sabía que iba a hacer algo relajante y que me iba a gustar muchísimo, nosotros siempre debemos darnos la oportunidad de hacer cosas diferentes y pasar tiempo de calidad para poder despejarnos de las actividades diarias de nuestros trabajos y Hogar. Realmente pintar no es lo mío, no soy una persona que se dedica a pintar pues siento que no es mi mejor habilidad, sin embargo, no me cierro a aprender y hacer cosas diferentes pues de eso se trata la vida de que podamos salir de nuestras zonas de Confort y afrontar nuevos retos, así que me di la oportunidad de ir y pintar algo a mi gusto y a mi estilo. Para esta actividad pagué un costo de $10 lo que me pareció chévere Porque además de pintar hubieron algunas actividades de juego, y hasta un llavero pude ganarme, Por otra parte, compartir con otras mujeres que no había compartido mucho y esto trae Unión, son personas de la iglesia a la que asisto y pude conocer nuevas personas, al llegar nos recibieron muy bian con cafe y postre, éramos 36 personas y además de hacer otras actividades también nos dieron una palabra de edificación para cada una de nosotras como mujeres. Las mesas estaban ya listas para cuando entráramos, estaba el bolso colocado encima de la mesa, un pincel, un lapicero, y una parte no sé cómo se llama donde se colocan las pinturas, cada quien escogió el bolso que quería pintar, sin embargo, en la actividad nos hicieron movernos de puesto, pero yo me enamoré de ese bolso, así que me llevé mi bolsito hacia donde me movieron, no quería perder ese diseño.

> Habían muchos dibujos diferentes y otros iguales, así que cada quien escogió lo que más le gustaba y trabajamos con colores que eran los que habían en la mesa, trabajamos con pintura al frío lo que quiere decir que no eran pinturas de tela como tal, así que este bolsito es solo de adorno pues no se podrá lavar ya que sí se hace se caerá la pintura, pues no es la adecuada para tela. Como yo no sé pintar le dije a géminis que me ayudara con un dibujo, con ese dibujo cómo lo podría pintar y me dio la foto de cómo lo podría pintar y los colores sin embargo no seguí esa paleta de colores pues no habían esos colores, esta foto de abajo fue la foto que me dio Géminis, colores pasteles, colores claros sin embargo yo quería algo más vibrante pero sí me dio algo de luces o guía al momento de poder pintar ya que como dije antes no es mi fuerte, pero me gustó mi resultado, comencé pintando el libro que en este caso para mí sería la Biblia, la quise pintar en tonos azules con verde tal como me lo decía la imagen de Géminis aunque esos colores eran un poco más sutiles más pasteles.

> Al mezclar colores hice algo parecido y me gustó muchísimo el resultado comencé a pintar y realmente me olvidé de tantas cosas que me concentré bastante en mi pintura que solo tomé una foto durante el proceso, solo iba mezclando y colocando colores y me envolví en un clima de relajación, con música instrumental de fondo, un momento especial.

> Después de tomar la foto de cómo iba mi proceso se me olvidó seguir tomando fotografías, solo me dediqué a pintar y a disfrutar este momento, aunque no es mi fuerte creo que quiero seguir intentándolo, me gustó mezclar colores como el amarillo con el rojo para formar el naranja, el azul con el rojo para formar partes moradas, con el blanco le hice destellos blancos a algunas cosas para Resaltar, siento que me faltó en la parte de abajo colocarle azul, así que pronto veré si tengo pintura azul en casa para terminar esa parte de abajo y hacerle otros detalles que me gustaría como colocar corazones y una firma en la parte de abajo, también me gustaría colocarle trazos de líneas negras, así quedó ya que fue el tiempo que nos dieron. Al finalizar nos tomamos fotografías todas con nuestros trabajos, algunas terminadas y otros no, fue un tiempo de calidad donde pude despejar mi mente y enamorarme de este bello arte de la pintura.

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >! [ENGLISH] > > ### Greetings, dear readers and friends of Hive DIY 🌟 > >One of the things I love most in life is crafts, and recently I was invited to a women’s afternoon gathering called “Trazos y Matices,” where the idea was to paint a small bag with a design. Of course, I signed up for the activity because I knew it would be relaxing and that I would really enjoy it. We should always give ourselves the chance to do different things and spend quality time together so we can clear our minds from the daily grind of work and home life. > >Honestly, painting isn’t really my thing; I’m not someone who dedicates time to painting because I feel it’s not my strongest skill. However, I’m open to learning and trying new things—that’s what life is all about: stepping out of our comfort zones and taking on new challenges. So I gave myself the chance to go and paint something that suited my taste and style. > >For this activity, I paid a fee of $10, which I thought was great because, in addition to painting, there were some games, and I even won a keychain. On the other hand, spending time with other women I hadn’t spent much time with before—and this brings us together—they’re people from the church I attend, and I got to meet new people. When we arrived, they welcomed us warmly with coffee and dessert. There were 36 of us, and in addition to doing other activities, they also shared a word of encouragement with each of us as women. > >The tables were already set up when we walked in. There was a bag on each table, along with a paintbrush, a pencil, and one of those things—I don’t know what it’s called—where you put the paints. Everyone chose the bag they wanted to paint, However, during the activity, they made us switch seats, but I had fallen in love with that bag, so I took my little bag with me to where they moved me—I didn’t want to lose that design. > >

> > >There were lots of different designs and some that were the same, so everyone chose the one they liked best, and we used whatever colors were on the table. We used cold-weather paint, which means it wasn’t fabric paint per se, so this little bag is just for decoration—you can’t wash it because if you do, the paint will come off since it’s not meant for fabric. > >Since I don’t know how to paint, I asked Géminis to help me with a design—how I could paint it based on that design—and she gave me a photo showing how to paint it and the colors. However, I didn’t follow that color palette because those colors weren’t available. The photo below is the one Géminis gave me: pastel colors, light colors. However, I wanted something more vibrant, but it did give me some guidance when it came time to paint, since, as I said before, it’s not my strong suit. But I liked the result. I started by painting the book—which, in this case, would be the Bible for me. I wanted to paint it in shades of blue and green, just as the image from Géminis showed me, although those colors were a bit more subtle and pastel. > >

> > >When I was mixing colors, I did something similar, and I loved the result so much that I started painting and really forgot about everything else. I was so focused on my painting that I only took one photo during the process. I was just mixing and applying colors, and I found myself enveloped in a sense of relaxation, with instrumental music playing in the background—it was a special moment. > >

> > >After taking a photo of how my project was coming along, I forgot to keep taking pictures; I just focused on painting and enjoying the moment. Even though it’s not my strong suit, I think I want to keep trying. I liked mixing colors like yellow and red to make orange, and blue and red to create purple sections. I used white to add white highlights to some parts to make them stand out. I feel like I missed adding blue to the bottom part, so I’ll check soon to see if I have any blue paint at home to finish that bottom section and add other details I’d like, such as hearts and a signature at the bottom. I’d also like to add some black lines. This is how it turned out since that was the time we were given. > >When we finished, we all took pictures with our artwork—some finished, others not. It was a quality time where I could clear my mind and fall in love with this beautiful art of painting. > >

> > ---
